Mr. Kipling Viennese Whirls 6 PackRE: Mr. Kipling Viennese Whirls 6 PackNot even worth a star.I just (March 2012) received two boxes of these (12 biscuits total), they were all in tact, but stale, the jam inside was like hard rubber and the sell by date makes no sense at all unless they were from 1993 They taste like it! Also I was under the illusion that I was getting more than one box of 6 biscuits for $9.99. The Term 6 pack is misleading. 1 box of 6 tiny & stale biscuits is what it should say.I'll never buy food off Amazon again, there's just no quality control! My advice to you is save yourself the disappointment and the hideous price

Just received my first order of these yesterday and and they taste amazing! Granted, they are not soaked in oil, but you could easily fork over more than $50 for a similar quantity of these if you were to get them in those little olive oil-containing bottles you find at the supermarket.I used them for a recipe of Chicken Milano (I simmered them in a heavy cream and chicken broth mixture for 10-15 mins) and I didn't even have to soak them beforehand. They easily absorbed the moisture and the consistency was perfect.And did I mention they taste really fresh?So, to review: great taste + great price + great freshness = 5 stars

I am really disappointed in these tomatos.  I have purchased sundried tomatos previously from Trader Joe's and loved the zesty flavor they contribute to dishes.  These are very disappointing by comparison.

OK, what did I expect? They're sun ripened, DRIED tomatoes, right?  No. These are really dry and really can't be eaten unless you soak them first. If you don't mind soaking them, they taste just fine.

These tomatoes are very dry when compared to store bought dried tomatoes. I tried to soften them by placing in a jar of olive oil but even after weeks they continue to have a very tough, leathery texture. The only way I can use them is to cut them into very fine pieces (a very tedious task without a blender).  Disappointing as I had plans for many dishes, now I have 3 pounds that will need to be ground up for any use.

column9: Buyer Beware: This product contains SULFUR DIOXIDE!
column10: Searching for the best sun-dried tomatoes is always a frustrating one because I am looking for a non sulfur dioxide product with nice flavor and affordability. These are affordable and mind you I read as much as I could including the labels and all the reviews but there was no mention of sulfur dioxide as an ingredient in this particular product. So I bought it with confidence thinking that although it was not organic, it was free of sulfur dioxide. Yesterday I opened it up to make some salad dressing for my raw dishes only to realize by just watching the color of the product alone that it had some additive which the ingredient list confirmed. I can't return the product so now I am stuck with 3 lbs of unsatisfactory product and I still have to go buy additional product that is sulfur free!Roland your company needs to indicate in the description that it's sun-dried product contains sulfur dioxide, health is a big concern so  you don't want to be responsible for any kind of customer health issues from this product.Buyer beware!

I had been unhappy with the expensive sundried tomatoes in the market. I took a chance with this product.  They are delicious!!!  So easy to store. And a great source of the antioxidant lycopene!!  I will order them again. VERY happy w/ quality and price.
We purchased these for our wedding pasta (to serve 125) and were so pleased. Just as tasty as what you would find in the grocery store--at a fraction of the price!

These tomatoes seem very soft for dried tomatoes, which is great! They are also very flavorful. I've been using them in a coconut curry and I don't even bother soaking them to soften them, I just throw 5 of them (five halves) in the vita-mix with everything but the coconut milk, blend for a minute and then simmer together with the coconut milk. Delicious! I originally purchased these because I had some raw food recipes that called for quite a bit of dried tomatoes and these seem nearly perfect for that (the thing that makes them less than perfect to me is that they aren't organic) but 3 pounds is still so much I gave one bag to my boyfriend who thinks I'm weird for giving him a pound of dried tomatoes but once I give him the coconut curry recipe he'll be thanking me.Oh, and the bags zip lock shut after they're opened, which is a nice touch.

These were very nice. I saw other reviews about the flavor being off. I was very happy with the flavor. There are two types of sundried tomatoes. Dried and smoked. These are dried. This gives a medium color and flavor. for those who want the dark or almost black color and a strong flavor. Use the smoked kind. I found these to be very nice. I was cooking a Sundried Tomatoe Chicken (breast meat chuncks), with diced onion,fine diced bell pepper and crushed garlic paste(on the pan seered chicked). I used kitchen sizzors, and cut these into very small diced chuncks. I would recomend slow cooking these (simmer all  ingrediants in water ) or cook the day before and reheat for serving. That brings out the full flavor of the tomatoes (and garlic). it also gives the chicken that light red tomatoe color as the flavor soaks in. Just serve over white rice and it is very Yunny. It is the sundried tomatoes color and flavor,that make this something very special. I have served this recipe to Caterers & 5-star chefs, and they were very impressed, as the flavor and color is unlike any other combination.  Several asked for my recipe.Chef Duke - Hollywood CA
My favorite. I am very happy with this purchase. They arrived in three bags and they smell good too.

column9: Jump on board when it goes on sale
column10: Great coffee and when its price point met that of 8 'oclock I jumped on and bought a big bag. Very happy with the taste, dark, not too sweet, very little bitterness and very smooth. Expiration  date was only 6 months out when I received it but with organic coffee you can expect that. I would buy organic all the time if the price point was comparable to 8 'oclock.

column9: Cafe Altura Peruvian Coffee is the best in the World, except;
column10: I had hoped to save some money on our coffee fetish of drinking only Peruvian grown beans by subscribing to Amazon's program for getting one 5 pound bag of Peruvian beans every two months but two of three bags of beans were so stale I had to throw them out. When this last bag arrived and I opened it, I knew right away it was bad. It smelled like plastic instead of the wonderful aroma of fresh roasted coffee beans, and the beans look stale. So I have cancelled my subscription and will go back to ordering our beans from our local organic food buying club through UNFI. This was an expensive trial, having gotten $100 worth of worthless beans.

I love this tea and have shared it with many of my friends and they all love it.Some say that they are going to order it.  A friend of mine once gave it to meand I tell everyone the only way to get it is order it.  I hope my sharing it willget them to place an order with you.
We tried this herbal tea once and all my family loved it. Great aroma. Can drink it every day. Would recommend it to friends.
We love this tea. I bought it in Sprouts on sale and got hooked up on it ever since. Not only it tastes good but it also has a very pleasant aroma. My family's delicious favorite!

column9: Truson Organic Soy Nuts are Fabulous
column10: I have been a health food aficionado for 38 years and have never tasted such delicious roasted soy nuts. All of the flavors are fabulous. I am especially pleased that the soy nuts are organic which makes them safe with additional health benefits. In today's world so much of our food is GMO whether we know it or not. I like supporting a company like Truson Organics that insists on naturalness and quality. Thank you Truson!Deborah StelfoxSnohomish, WA  USA

column9: THE BEST all natural bar I've had!
column10: Finally, a really tasty bar thats all natural and does not have soy or artificial stuff in it plus it's high in fiber! I am always looking for a bar to carry in my bag when I'm out in the field and just need something to keep me going but I don't want something I feel guilty about eating. No bar can replace a good healthy meal but sometimes you just need something to hold you over. The battle is always coming across bars that taste awful, have the texture of wall plaster or have artificial sweetener and flavorings, soy or too much sugar etc. but here is one I feel good about eating. It has a moist but firm texture and tastes mostly of cocoa with a bit of cinnamon with a very satisfying texture of whole oats, nuts and raisins but is not too sweet. I like these bars far better then any other brand I've tried. They taste like something I would make myself. I can't wait to try the other flavors but I would buy the oatmeal raisin again for sure. I really like this product and it doesn't put me in a sugar crash. THANKS EAT.THINK Smile, great product!All bars are a bit of a trade off depending on your personal needs. Some are looking for high protein low carb bars, this is not one of them. Some don't like artificial bars, some no fat, some want a meal replacement etc.. Here is the package info and ingredients below, judge for yourself if these are right for you.Calories:200Total fat:7gSat Fat 1gcholest:10mgsodium:230mgcarb:34sugar:12gProtein:4gfiber:7grIngr: Whole wheat flour and whole grain corn flour, brown sugar, rolled oats, chicory root extract, canola oil, dextrose, walnuts, raisins, cocoa, brown rice syrup, glycerin, nonfat milk, 2%or less of:eggs, mono and diglycerides, cornstarch, salt, cinnamon, bking pwdr, natural flavor (milk).

column9: A bit dry but still chewy
column10: I do not know about the nutritional / energy contents of this bar, and you cannot take their claims too seriously, but just had my first one, and it is a bit dry, maybe from thin packaging and/or long shelf life, so you need to eat them quickly. From experience, these bars can turn into rocks after a few weeks.For those who care, it makes no sound as you bite and chew, and does not create crumbs falling on your shirt. There is a definite oatmeal, and small amount of raisin taste, and not too sweet.

column9: Mediocre taste with a gritty texture.
column10: These oatmeal raisin bars are purported to be healthy nutrition bars. There is really nothing healthy or nutritious about these "Eat Think Smile" bars. They are high in calories (200), fat (8g) and carbs (34g), they have essentially no vitamin content either. The claim is that because they contain cocoa (chocolate) they are good for you because chocolate is supposed to be an antioxidant. That is a very tenuous assumption that has not been fully proven. The only ingredients that might be healthy are the raisins and the oats. I eat Zone nutrition bars and Kellog's Fiber Plus bars. Both taste much better and contain far more healthy ingredients.I read the hype on the side of the box and whoever wrote it could not have been writing about these "Eat Think Smile" bars. The claim is that these bars are a smart choice! If you are starving and only alternative is eating dirt, the dirt might be a healthier choice actually. I really dislike companies that create this kind of ridiculous untrue hype about any product.These "Eat Think Smile" bars are basically cookies and that would be ok if they tasted good but they don't. They have a gritty texture and taste overly sweet. If you are looking for a great tasting real nutrition bar, then check out the Zone nutrition bars or the Kellog's Fiber Plus bars.If you like gritty cookies with a very hard chocolate taste, very sweet and really nothing nutritious in them, then you might like these bars.If on the other hand you are serious about health and nutrition, then there are a lot of better choices that taste much better.

The chocolate taste is definitely there, along with the oatmeal and raisin. The raisin taste is less noticeable, so the overall flavor is quite bland with the bitterness of dark chocolate/cocoa. Some people might like these semi non-sweet taste, but I really dislike the weird chocolate taste and the aftertaste of slight bitterness. It's not dry at all, but mostly chewy.All in all, I would not buy this product at all simply based on the taste. I would rather eat other nutritional bars, such as Cliffs, Lara, and  granola bars.

column9: Have a glass of milk or water handy
column10: My palate tends to be open to health foods and I really like the flavor of the Oatmeal Raisin bars. Their texture is not as dry as the Cranberry Orange bars, but it is still dry enough to require having a drink at handFlavor analysis: The cinnamon dominates in a pleasant way. It is not as hidden by the cocoa or whole grain flours as in the Orange Cranberry bars. I enjoy this flavor more than the Orange Cranberry, which is a switch for me.Texture: Best described as slightly powdery.Miscellaneous: These could actually do with a little less sweetener. They seem sweeter than the Orange Cranberry.Final Analysis: I can deal with the texture, but if I want a healthy snack, I would prefer that I didn't get that sugar rush feel. They are a decent size and have only 200 calories. That was a nice surprise. Even though the cocoa powder doesn't quite dominate in these bars, it is the second contender in flavor and think it would be better to market them as "Oatmeal Raisin Cocoa" bars.

column9: Lots of calories, lots of carbs, not much protein
column10: I ordered a box of these Oatmeal Raisin as well as well as the Orange Cranberry flavored bars through the Amazon Vine program. Frankly, I cannot think of why anyone would buy these alleged "health" bars. Each of these bars are 200 calories, have 7 grams of fat, 10 mg of cholesterol a whopping 34 grams of carbohydrate and only four grams of protein. Also, based upon a 2,000 calorie per day diet they don't provide any Vitamin A, or Vitamin C, 4% of the recommended Calcium, 8% of the Iron, 6% of Thiamin and 10% of Magnesium. At the time of this writing, this Oatmeal Raisin Flavor bar was not yet available for sale but different flavored 12 packs of this same brand of bar sells for around $19. Not only do these bars fall short from a true health standpoint but they're not very good tasting either. They're not terrible but the consumer would definitely want to have it with coffee or tea. As a stand alone bar it's got kind of a chalky texture. There are so many truly healthy and good tasting bars on the market that I don't see this brand becoming a favorite in many households; certainly not in ours. I would have been mad if I had actually paid for these bars.

column9: Very tasty, very filling, not that nutritious
column10: I really enjoyed these and was surprised at how much they remind me of a "normal" chocolate-oatmeal-raisin cookie. But I don't really feel they should be called nutrition bars, as while they have 28% RDA of dietary fiber per bar, they have only 4g of protein, 4% RDA of calcium and 8% RDA of iron, and that's it; no other vitamins/minerals. When I hear "nutrition bar" I'm expecting a bit more than that. Even so, they are tasty and filling and only 200 calories per bar so I'll buy some from time to time for those "rushed mornings" when a decent breakfast is impossible.
worst product I ever tasted, I had to dispose of it.I don't recommend this product to anyone, not tasty, I doubt its healthy, and it is overpriced!
This is a very strong tasting bar.  It is not very sweet tasting. It is close to imposible to eat this with out a large drink. Does not seem to be very satisfying as an afternoon snack.

column9: More like walnut and chocolate bars
column10: I usually absolutely love anything with oatmeal and raisins in, but this is more of a medley of everything than an oatmeal raisin bar.First, it's a deep brown, so it doesn't even look like an oatmeal raisin bar. And from the ingredients list, it has more walnuts than raisins, and it has more brown sugar than oats.So, I'll have to go somewhere else to get my oatmeal raisin fix. Overall, it tasted pretty good for a relatively healthy bar. I ate all of them, but I never ate more than one in one sitting.Pros:+Decent tasting, relatively healthy snack+Pretty good tasteCons:-Not enough raisins-Not enough oats-Too many walnuts, especially if you don't like walnuts-Weird color

These are Oatmeal Raisin nutrition bars, designed for a healthy snack or when you don't have time for breakfast.Overall, these are rather dry and they do crumble easily if you drop your lunch bag. The oatmeal and raisins are the main flavor, but if there is cocoa in them, it's not very much. They may be healthy for you, but they could definitely use some more flavor in them. They are an OK snack or breakfast substitute or when you just need something to tide you over till your next meal.

These arrived just before we left for family vacation, so they were great to have in the car and at the house we were renting for those "between meal snacks".  They weren't too messy, they tasted great, and kept you full for a while.  I was surprised at the amount of fat in the bars, but there was a lot of other nutrition, so maybe it balanced out.  I would buy again!

Reading some of the other reviews here, I do not agree with some of them calling these bars "dry". Maybe they got a bad batch? Though not overly moist, I did not find them dry at all. They were especialy good with a cup of coffee. They have a different taste, but not a weird one. The cocoa  is the main thing you will notice, but the walnuts and raisins come through as well. The makers of this bar seemed to have found the right combination of these ingrediants to make one delicious snack bar.

column9: Second best bar I've had out of many
column10: I've been on a real Bar-kick recently, mostly for a quick breakfast on the way out to door as I'm always at least 15 minutes late to work but don't want to skip breakfast.  I started with Cliff bars but those got old.  Then I moved on to Larabars, which are good and come in some interesting flavours, but after eating them for a few weeks I decided they were too sweet for anything more than occasional consumption.My favorite, to date, are the 18 Rabbits Bars 18 Rabbits Haute Diggity Date, Organic Granola Bar, 1.9-Ounce Bars (Pack of 12), which are awesome.However, these Eat Think Smile bars were a big surprise ... so far I'd give them the silver medal behind 18 Rabbits, and will keep buying them just to keep some variety.What do I like about these bars?  Let me think about what I like about them ... first, they don't taste like a typical health food bar - while the box says oatmeal raisin, to me they taste more like a brownie (not quite as good as a real brownie but pretty close for a packaged bar).  The second think I really like about these bars is unlike a lot of the bars out there which are too sugary, these are just sweet enough without being sweet but more importantly their carbohydrate content comes from DIETARY FIBER.  28% DV of Dietary Fiber people.  Do you realize like 75% of Americans don't get enough Fiber in their diets?  Hello?So I recommend these and will keep purchasing them myself even though I got this box for free via the Vine program.Thank you for reading this informative review.

Eat. Think. Smile's Oatmeal Raisin bars are a nice alternative to a mid-day candy bar. While perhaps not as tasty as something dipped in chocolate, the Eat. Think. Smile bars are baked and are relatively low in fat (7g, and only 1g saturated fat) although somewhat high in carbohydrates (34g) They also contain CocoaOne, which is described as "a unique blend of African cocoa and a premium Meso-American variety known ads Lavado," supposedly a natural antioxident.Taste-wise, the Eat. Think. Smile bars taste much like a Cliff bar, and have the same shape and texture. The Eat Think Smile bars have a softer texture, and are more crumbly than a Cliff bar.The oatmeal raisin taste is pleasant and not at all overwhelming.Overall, I liked these bars. While not a replacement for a good breakfast or healthy lunch, these bars are perfect for that time of the day when you want a little snack, but don't necessarily want all of the fat and extras in a typical candy bar.

column9: Great low calorie snack to tide you over hunger urges in between meals
column10: The Eat Think Smile Baked Nutrition Bar, Oatmeal Raisin, is a great low calorie nutrition bar/snack to tide you over hunger urges in between regular meals. At 1.8-ounce/200 calorie per bar, it is packed with different vitamins, minerals and fiber, from Vitamin A to Zinc, to supplement your daily nutritional requirements. Fiber content is around 7g per bar. I used mine basically as a pre-workout energy supplement to get that much needed energy to give you a push in your workouts. Be forewarned though that each bar has 200 calories, so if you stuff yourself up with 3 or more of this bar, for those of you that watches their caloric intake, this pretty much accelerates it, so moderation is the key when eating it. Just enough to tide you over those regular, more nutritious on time meals. A great snack, just don't over do it.

column9: No replaqcement for a breakfast. but a great nutrition bar
column10: I don't know how much thinking this requires.This oatmeal raisin bar is a somewhat dry oatmeal raisin bar with a strong chocolate flavor. Somewhat like a dry, chewy brownie.Definately low in fat, but not one of those diet bars.More flavorful, more calories, more nutrition.

column9: Good for Breakfast or a snack
column10: A recent news story noted that Americans are skipping the traditional sit down breakfast for more on-the-go choices. Nuts, snack bars, etc. This is a perfect way to get healthful nutrition and a filling meal or snack on the go. It's a great blend of grans, raisins, and cocoa. It is a filling snack that will give you hours of energy. It tastes good, and not like the cardboard competitors. It also travels well, not melting or turning to mush as you go about your day.Very tasty. I keep a few in my car, and in my office desk.

I eat a lot of Fiber One plus bars, usually 2 per day.I know they are about 130 calories, but they rarely fill me like these seem too.These Oatmeal Raisin bars from Eat, Think, Smile, are really soft and fresh, without the hardness of other bars.These are very soft, and have a really hearty flavor. (not like the lighter rice cake taste of other bars, but not as heavy and sticky as Cliff bars)I could eat these every day.

I enjoyed this nutrition bar, it tastes like a rich chocolate oatmeal raisin cookie. I found it to be very flavorful and the taste of rich cocoa really stood out for me. I think this is a good choice for a breakfast bar for those on the go. Of course I love nutrition bars and one concern I have is that people not use to nutrition bars may find this one a little dry, I also wish the bar was more moist and chewy. But I still enjoyed the flavor and ate them all. The bar is 200 calories, low in sodium 230mg has 34gm of carbohydrates and an excellent 7 grams of fiber. The bar only has 4gm of protein and I like to see them with at least 15 grams of protein. So with that said if it meets your nutritional guidelines I would recommend it.

column9: 25% of Your Daily Fiber in a Healthy Snack
column10: Containing about 25% of the recommended daily intake of fiber, these bars are a fairly tasty way of obtaining it. However, don't expect an oatmeal raisin cookie type snack or a Larabar type snack either. It's dryer (meaning less fat/oil) than many snacks. It's also baked so it doesn't come across as a raw product either. The taste is pleasant and a bit more complex especially with the cocoa powder than many snacks. Finally, it's not an addictive snack which is good in that you won't be tempted to finish a box of these in three days. More health food than candy.

column9: Cocoa and Walnuts, a Good Healthy Snack
column10: Excellent healthy snack.  Strong cocoa and cinnamon flavor with a walnut accent. Very filling.Nutrition:  - 1.8oz/51g bar  - Calories: 200  - Fat Cal: 60  - Total Fat: 7g  - Trans Fat 0g  - Cholesterol: 10mg  - Sodium 230mg  - Total Carbs: 34g  - Protein: 4g  - Sugars: 12g  - 4% calcium,8% iron, 6% thiamin, 10% magnesiumIngredients: Flour (whole wheat and whole grain corn), brown sugar, whole grain rolled oats, chicory root extract, canola oil, dextrose, walnuts, raisins, cocoa, brown rice syrup, glycerin, nonfat milk, 2% or less eggs, mono and diglycerides, cornstarch, salt, cinnamon, baking powder.

"Eat, Think, Smile" is offering a new and interesting variation on the standard granola br, a baked nutrition bar with all natural ingredients and an added dose of cocoa flavor.  The cocoa is a natural antioxidant (who knew?), but it provides a nice finishing touch to the granola bar, like having cocoa sprinkled on top of your latte coffee.  The granola bar itself is oatmeal raisin, with a nice chewy texture.  This reviewer liked the taste.The oatmeal raisin bar with cocoa comes one to a foil packet, rated at 200 calories each.  The bars are available in boxes of twelve.  Recommended as something a little different in a familiar snack.

Good bar that is not overly sweet.  It has a dryer than chewy granola texture and has less sticky feel.  It has good chocolate flavor, but not enough for me to get a "chocolate fix."  I felt full for a good length of time too which was nice.  I did not feel the need to eat a second one or eat again soon.
I love the taste, it is all natural, and the super Cocoa gives you a nice boost of energy and antioxidants.

About the only time I eat something like this is when I haven't allowed enough time for a proper breakfast before dashing out the door. These bars are tasty and filling without being overly sweet as some such products are. Yummy.

I love oatmeal and raisin anything, so I was really looking forward to trying these.  I wasn't disappointed.  The taste is a little more chocolatey than I prefer, but they're still good.  If you're looking for a yummy, thick oatmeal and raisin cookie snack, this is NOT it.  The taste of the oatmeal/raisins is fairly muted.  But if you're looking for something different (as well as healthy), and if the idea of a little chocolate mixed in with your oatmeal sounds good, give these a try.

column9: Like the Convenience, But Not So Much the Taste
column10: I have eaten about 100 different type of food bars over the years since I don't always have time for breakfast or to leave work for lunch so when I saw these I wanted to try them out.  The picture on the box makes them look almost like a no bake cookie with lots of big oats and texture, but when I had my first one I was a bit disappointed since it was really more like a chocolate flavored sugar cookie with almost no texture.  The actual taste is mainly just a chocolate taste and the oatmeal and raisin might just barely come through on some bites.  I don't hate them, but they are certainly not my top pick.

column9: Forget the Name.  Remember the Taste.
column10: Don't the name throw you.  "Eat. Think. Smile" isn't the easiest brand to remember, but their baked nutrition bars are certainly memorable in terms of taste.  I tried two varieties through the Amazon Vine Program, Oatmeal Raisin and Orange Cranberry, and I loved them both.  The bars are soft, chewy, sweet without being sugary, and decently sized (a little bigger than a Clif Bar, perfect for a between meal snack or a before-exercise pick-me-up).  Best of all, they were satisfying without being too filling.  I was a little doubtful about how the addition of cocoa would affect the flavors, but as it turned out, the cocoa was only detectable as a pleasant undertone and didn't overpower the Oatmeal Raisin or Orange Cranberry.When deciding whether or not to recommend a food item I have sampled for free, I always ask myself, "Would I actually pay for this product?"  In the case of "Eat. Think. Smile" nutrition bars, my answer was a resounding "Yes.  I prefer these to some of the other bars I buy at the store."  Therefore, I am pleased to be able to recommend them to you.  Eat.  Think.  Smile.  And enjoy.

column9: Four and a half stars for this nutrition bar
column10: There must be a million energy bars on the market, so what distinguishes this Eat/Think/Smile nutrition bar from its competitors? A not-too-sweet taste, for one thing.As they say in the ads, the idea of a granola bar or an energy bar is to put good food stuffs in a convenient and tasty bar.  This ETS (I'm already tired of typing in the full name!) bar is no different.  What I like about it is that it has a solidly-good taste that means you're not going to chow down on it, but you're going to savor it, and take a few minutes to get through it.  And that's a good thing as I'm concerned.I not claiming it's going to change my like, but these are handy to stuff in the day pack for a trip to the mountains or the coast, and can be relied upon to get some good ingredients into your system.Recommended, if for nothing more than the taste.  I'll try another box soon.  They are healthier than Girl Scout cookies, my go-to food in March.

Im nibbling one on of these as I'm typing.  I like the taste, chocolatey, nutty, a standard 1.8 oz weight, long flat shape.However, the downside of these bars.  While it's a good taste, it's just simply not that filling.  The consistency is very light.  The light and airy taste doesn't leave me very satisfied after I've eaten it -- I want more substance.

Didn't care for it. Color is wrong, doesn't have the flavor. Tastes almost as if it were watered down, or, maybe, birch beer lite. Gonna have to try a different brand. I had pretty high hopes, too, as Pa. is the state where I first was exposed to birch beer. Can't recommend this brand. On the off chance that someone reads my reviews, I will sing loud praises when I find one to my taste.

I bought 2 12 packs of this for my granfather whom used to be able to buy it on post before they stopped carrying it. The shipping was fast and arrived in a timely manner. The bottles where all in good condition and tasted great, i myself had never had a birch beer before i got these for him and will have to say there way better than root beer!

These bars are GREAT!  Very tasty. No high fructose corn syrup.  I bought them for my toddler-age sons, both of whom really liked similar bars from Gerber and NutriGrain.  I was really shocked and disappointed to learn that those bars had high fructose corn syrup, though. (Seriously? A bar specifically for BABIES has HFCS?!)  So I opted for these.  They LOVE them, and so do I.  But I get them for 2.79/box locally. Even the most expensive grocery store around has them for 3.29/box.  I'm all for convenience, but we go through way too many boxes of these for it to be worth paying an extra fifty cents or a dollar (or more - price seems to vary by flavor here) more per box.

I love Kashi products.  I eat one of these every day.  The only complaint I have is with Amazon's price of this product and food products in general.  You can get this at local stores (you know the Red and the Blue one) for less than 3 dollars a box.

I love these Kashi bars, I used to get them at the local Walmart,but for some reason they stopped carrying them. I was looking around on the web to see where I could find them and found out that Amazon had them and at a great price. They are very delicious.

I love these cereal bars!  They are similar to Nutri-Grain but better.  These do not contain high-fructose corn syrup.  I paid $15.20 for the 6-pack with Subscribe & Save discount.  That's $2.53 per box which is cheaper than I can buy them on sale at the local grocery store.  Excellent value.

column9: Perfect for toddlers on the go
column10: My 3-yr-old hates to sit at the table and eat breakfast, she always wants to take a snack in a cup and run around.  Most days, she would rather go without breakfast than sit down and eat.  I finally compromised and got her some Kashi cereal bars that she could eat on the go.  I was so pleased to find something with whole grains, real fruit and no high fructose corn syrup that I could give her.  She loves them, I love that she eats them and they are better for her than other bars on the market.  I wish they had more flavors than the three I'm always buying, I would purchase more to give her more variety!

I have loved Kashi cereal for years and recently found these bars, which are like some of the other cereal bars (NutriGrain?) I have had in the past, but from everything I can tell, seem to be of better quality. I think they work great as a snack or a quick breakfast. Better than a candy bar, but not as good a the raw fruit! :)

I'm becoming a big fan of Kashi for my family and these cereal bars are great!  (And the apple ones, too.)  My 20 month old has severe food allergies and kashi bars are one of the only easy things she can have for breakfast (meaning, if she doesn't have a kashi bar, I'll be whipping something up from scratch... and 20 month olds tend to like breakfast sooner rather than much later).  So for our family, these are a staple.Also, given that we live in the country, these are not available to us locally, so being able to buy them via amazon's subscription makes it VERY helpful for our family.  (Unless amazon runs out and it takes them a month to get them in stock and delivered which kind of defeats to point of a subscription... *ahem*...  amazon, you might want to work on that.)Overall though, I'd recommend these!  I love how healthy they are.  I love how they have wholesome ingredients (that my daughter isn't allergic to).  And I love that they have all that and still taste good!  Thanks, Kashi!

My daughter loves fruit filled bars. I am not such a fan because of the sugar contant and unhealthy flour they use to make most of them. So I decided to try these (since they seemed like they would be healthier).The taste is good. The size is good. The only drawback is that the bar is a little dry and cakey, almost like a bran muffin. The texture took a bit getting used to, but other than that the fruit bar is pretty good.

I enjoy most Kashi products, and this one is no exception.Pros:Tastes great, can taste fresh strawberries plus the whole grains.Not too sweet.No high fructose corn syrup.No artificial ingredients.Individually wrapped.Cons:They are a bit on the dry side.A little more expensive than other cereal bars, but very much worth it.

column9: My 17 year old son will eat these for breakfast.
column10: My 17 year old son will grab one of these as he leaves for school which makes me feel that he is getting something decent for breakfast. He enjoys the straberry flavor of the bar.
Shipped fast and packed well. This is a terrific cereal bar and low cal. It has a great taste and texture. everyone who tries them, loves them. Can't wait to try another flavor.

column9: Yummy. Low calories and great taste
column10: Another great product for those looking for a "healthy" snack without a lot of calories

column9: I love most kashi, but would skip these.
column10: I love most of the kashi products but I've now tried these and the cherry vanilla bars...the texture is a little off putting to me, almost like mushy graham cracker but with a less appealing taste (than graham) the fruit filling is almost bitter tasting to me (and yes these do have a lower sugar count, but I still don't want to eat bitter fruit) On a more important note, my boyfriend had one of these every day for about 5 days when he connected that they were giving him an upset stomach) now that could be an individual problem, perhaps something in them he is slightly allergic to, but he hasn't mentioned any of the other kashi products disturbing him. That being said, if you have a lot of food allergies I'd probably stay away from these, they aren't especially tasty and really they don't serve that much nutritional purpose anyhow...you'd be better served to eat some real strawberries.
The best Kashi bar flavor, tastes great, a awsome snack that does not taste like a bunch of processed food cardboard like bars.

column9: Great, healthy breakfast bar that tastes great!
column10: These are very tasty and healthy! My toddler gets up in the morning and asks for "Bar" (breakfast bar) and devours them. It's great knowing she is getting a healthy start to her breakfast and loves the taste. She normally asks for "More bar?" but by then I have her fruit ready. Thank you, Kashi! Love the healthy, soft breakfast bars for kids. Hoping for more flavor options for the soft cereal bars soon!

I love the strawberry flavor of these.  I bought these with the Subscribe & Save discount and got them for a very reasonable price - $2.53 p/box.  The expiration date for all 6 boxes isn't until Sept 2012.  I can guarantee all of the cereal bars will be eaten way before then!  I had been buying the Nutragrain bars for our house but like a lot of parents, want to give the best foods to my son.  At the price I got through Amazon, I'm able to do that without hurting the bank.  Wish they would come out with more fruit flavors! (On a side note because I was dairy free for a year when my son was a baby & allergic to dairy... these are dairy free!)
They're good breakfast/snack bars... but they're very dry compared to the blackberry flavor. I probably won't be purchasing the strawberry again.
The kids really like these bars and you get a great price with the subscribe and save.  I like that fact that they don't use any high fructose corn syrup!

I love how these bars are so delicious and can be a quick breakfast or light snack. I am glad that Kashi has NO high frutose corn syrup in their products! It is hard to find healthy foods and snacks without corn syrup in it! I can't wait to try the other flavors offered.

column9: Great for Fiber and a quick healthy snack
column10: I try to eat two of these per day, they are great for adding fiber to your diet and I really enjoy the taste.  I've only tried the strawberry flavor.  I subscribed to this item via Amazon prime.

I love all of the Kashi bars, from the granola nut type to these more breakfast type.  The flavors are really good and I really enjoy having choices that are different from the run of the mill chocolate, peanut butter, strawberry, blueberry that are so common in all of the other bars.  The pumpkin is one of my favorite and I love how the strawberry tastes more like the real thing than what seems more like a mere flavor in the other brands.

I love most of the Kashi products I've tried. This was low in sugar which is great right BUT when my kids tried it and refused to finish it I tried it and I now know why. It tastes horrible....it has a very weird funny taste to it.

Slightly more than 100 calories and packed with some fruit and whole grains, this makes for a great breakfast when you have very little time.  My son, Hubby and I like eating these quickly in the morning before rushing off to work.  They're easy to eat and yummy and make very little mess.  The only thing that would make me love them better is if they were organic.
I bought these for my kids.  I'm not fond of strawberry, so I can't comment directly on them, but they sure vanished quickly.  I think that says it all.
This cereal bar is kind of dry.  It is hard to eat without a drink nearby.  The taste is ok but not my favorite for sure.

column9: The best of the novelty hot sauces.
column10: Great flavor, and HAWT! Trust me, this stuff delivers exactly what it says. Get an ice bath ready, and wear loose clothing. haw haw

SHAN spices are sold all over the country from 84c to 99c per pack at your local indian and Pakistani grocery stores.This guy is just rip off and no justification for the over charge. Amazon should be aware of it. As Amazon is a good place to shop and Ido my shopping at Amazon and find prices very resonable.

column9: Good mix if you don't have time or ingredients for homemade
column10: We like this mix when time is shorter or I don't have everything I need for chicken curry made from scratch.  It is a hot mix, but with Shan spice mixes you can use what you like, so if you're leery of the heat, I would suggest just using 1/4-1/2 a packet first. If you want it hotter next time, increase the amount.  I'm surprised at the price for this - we get these mixes locally for 99 cents a box.  Might want to check with the seller what quantity this price is for.

I love dark chocolate covered cranberries, and these were the worst I've ever had.  The chocolate was poor quality and tasted dry and waxy.  They are not "melt in you mouth" enjoyable as they should be.  Very disappointing.

I am sorry to hear the person before me was unsatisfied due to the food's origin, but for those of you that are looking at this as a care-free non-vegan, snacker.... MY FRIENDS AND I LOVE THEM (even my most vegan one who probably didn't do proper research..or did and didn't care enough to write a review about China and confront the company)! They taste great, fit into a bag on the go, and are much healthier to snack on at work than our usual vending machine goods. So whether it comes from an organic farm in the country or a NYC sewer... they taste awesome! I feel bad for the other person who is going to miss out on the yummy goodness of this snack....

column9: Tastes Great but  Made in China
column10: Heads up to all of you out there who love Mrs. Mays.  I too love their products and was a regular customer. I liked the simplicity of ingredients, the fact that most of them were "organic" and that they were Vegan. I purchased a case of various items from them directly, and imagine my surprise when I noticed the box they arrived in said "A Product of China." I emailed them and they confirmed that their product is indeed produced in China. Having traveled in China, and, based on recent problems related to products made in China, I am no longer buying Mrs. Mays. How anyrhinf grown there could be described as "organic" strikes me as disingenous at best. The energy required to ship the product back to the US also strikes me as wasteful. I no longer purchase their product. When they produce their products with locally grown, organic ingredients, I'll be back!

column9: can form part of a breakfast; cheaper elsewhere
column10: These breakfast biscuits/cookies come in three flavors - oat, blueberry, and apple cinnamon.  Each wrapped container contains four biscuits/cookies that are generously sized and oval shaped.  The golden oat flavor reminded me of a graham cracker that had been paired with oats.  The flavor was pleasant with a slightly sweet component.  I think the product is best when paired with tea and a piece of fruit.I did not experience increased energy and when eaten alone the product did not keep me full very long.  When paired with a banana or apple and some almonds, I could see these cookies being used as part of a quick breakfast.The product has a good bit of fat and sugar.  As the product's nutritional profile is not presently listed, here is an abbreviated listing of one serving's nutrition:Serving size: 1 package (four biscuits)230 calories8 grams of fat.5 grams of saturated fat2.5 grams of polyunsaturated fat5 grams of monosaturated fat220 mg. of sodium85 mg of potassium35 grams of carbohydrates3 grams of dietary fiber11 grams of sugar4 grams of proteinIngredients:  whole grain blend (rolled oats, rye flakes), enriched flour [wheat flour, niacin, reduced iron, thiamin mononitrate (vitamin b1), riboflavin (vitamin b2), folic acid], high oleic canola oil, sugar, evaporated cane sugar, whole grain wheat flour, malt syrup (from corn and barley), invert sugar, baking soda, salt, soy lecithin, disodium pyrophosphate, datem, ferric orthophosphate (iron), niacinamide, pyridoxine hydrochloride (vitamin b6), riboflavin (vitamin b2), thiamin mononitrate (vitamin b1).At present, these breakfast biscuits are definitely cheaper in grocery stores and Kraft has been issuing many dollar off coupons so check your local circular.Allergy info:  this product contains wheat and soy.

I just bought a few boxes of Belvita at a local store and I really love the golden oat variety. The taste and texture are so good I'd want to eat them whether they were "healthier" or not (I say "healthier" instead of "healthy" - because although they have no HFCF, contain whole grains and fiber, more "real" ingredients and better handling/baking, they are still a processed food). Anyway, I thought I'd see if amazon had a good deal on them. I'm floored by the price here! Over $25 for 3 boxes??? I think I only paid $2.99/box. Shop around, guys!

I can't say if it gives sustained energy as I just had my first pack.  I will say they were crisp and tasted great!  I'm always looking for portable energy food that is NOT low calorie.  These are about 230 calories per pack and since I take snacks like this hiking/backpacking, that's a good thing.  So far, I really like them.  Perhaps I'll update after I take them hiking and see how they hold up.

column9: Perfect for breakfast on the go
column10: Yes, I know that "breakfast is the most important meal of the day" yada, yada, but I, like many who start the day before the sun is up, don't really feel like eating first thing in the morning. By the time the early domestic tasks have been completed I am usually in the car rushing for work.I have found these biscuits are a great way of starting the day and can be eaten just about anywhere (ok, not while swimming, obviously). There's a lot of calories and oats in there and to me they do seem to be better than a bagel or toast, keeping me going until lunch time.Get them in your local store, as they are unbelievably expensive on line.

I love these little breakfast biscuits.  They are tasty, very filling and full of fiber, without tasting like cardboard.  I only eat 2, in a package and save the others for a snack.  If you like oatmeal cookies you will like these.  I don't care for the "blueberry" flavored ones, they are too artifical for me.

I LOVE THESE BELVITA BREAKFAST BISCUITS ALTHOUGH I WOULD CONSIDER THEM MORE OFA COOKIE. I HAVE ONLY TRIED THE GOLDEN OAT AND THEY ARE VERY GOOD.  I RATED THEM A FIVE STAR ON QUALITY AND TASTE.ONE THING THAT I WOULD SUGGEST THAT AMAZON IMPROVE ON IS A LITTLE MORE CAUTION IN SHIPPINGAS I HAVE RECEIVED SOME THAT WERE HAD SOME BROKEN PIECES.

column9: These little guys are so tasty!  I'll definitely be buying more!
column10: I purchased these several weeks ago and put them at my desk at work for breaksfast on the go.  I've been putting off trying them because I wasn't sure if they would taste like cardboard.  Opened a pack today and was pleasantly surprised!  Will definitely be buying some more.  They taste like a yummy version of a graham cracker.
These are the best breakfast crackers ever!!! A light spread of crunchy peanut butter and you're good to go.  Very tasty and good for you.  What's not to love?
This is one of the best habanero hot sauces out. It has a slight vinegar taste to it, but not overpowering. The flavor is phenomenal!

This is not like any traditional English pudding.  In fact, it is unlike anything I've ever attempted to put in my mouth.  It is pumpkin in color, springy in texture, with globs of stretchy substance which I suppose is the treacle.  I am at a loss to describe the flavor - a sweetness lingers in the background, but what the prevalent taste is I don't know.  It's not buttery, salty, caramelized...it's 'misc.' flavor.  My husband and I each took a bite or two, had a good laugh, and tossed the rest.  We're not fussy food snobs, nor are we unsophisticated eaters.  My husband's best contribution to my attempt at analysis was "if someone told me that was monkey brains, I'd seriously believe them."

When this canned dessert arrived I could hardly wait to open it and try it out but I waited till my son was over and we enjoyed it together! I tasted it cold (got on my fingers while pushing it from the can) and found it very tasty and reminded me of pumpkin. It is supposed to be heated and was very easily done in my microwave. We both liked it heated but I still like it better cold. If you like something sweet, you have to give this a try!
I remember real treacle pudding from when I was little and lived in England.  This canned version is terrible.  It's nothing like the real thing. Don't waste your money.
I bought Heinz Treacle Pudding mainly out of curiosity having heard of it for years but never tasted it. I found it was quite good and will have it again.

Not bad for a canned dessert. I used some whipped cream because it was a little dry.I was surprised upon opening this that the inside of the can isn't lined. I think some can flavor may have leached into the taste, affecting the flavor (or is that "flavour"?)

Like any other food, not every treacle pudding will taste exactly the same.  Personally, I like this better than a number of restaurants' treacle pudding.  And what do you expect from buying canned food? For what it is (cake in a can), this stuff is great.

column9: Eating these since I was a kid...
column10: These little packets carry 4 'leafs' of seaweed... to mee they are kindof like potato chips, salty, cruchy, and wonderful!  I've been eating them since I was a kid!  A great low-calorie snack for dieters.In case you are curious, here's some of the nutritional info per packet:Calories: 1.333Fat: 0High in vitamins: iron, calcium, vitamin A, B1, B2, & C

column9: I have loved these since I was a kid. They are just awesome!!!!
column10: I have loved these since I was a kid. They are just awesome!!!! I started to buy these locally at one of the oriental stores (locally meaning a half hour drive - lol). Unfortunately The store I buy such products from had been shut down and there was no other local oriental store from which I could buy my favorite foods. Although shipping is a bit costly, it's not so bad if you buy a ton of packages at once, thus saving you on shipping costs. Being that I spent 2 years in Japan, I am addicted to quite a few of the foods they make there and this seaweed is an addiction for me. I just love it and I could eat 10 packets of these at once. You must try these seaweed packets. Don't be fooled by the other seaweed products. These are specific, slightly salted, excellent munchy snacks, even taste more wonderful than potato chips, pretzels or anything else. They have less calories. You just cannot go wrong with these wonderful seaweed snacks. If you don't buy these you really are missing out on the awesome foods in life.  XD

column9: Ate some of it, threw most of it away
column10: I love roasted seaweed, and had purchased the Sea's brand on amazon several times. I wanted to branch out and maybe get a better bang for my buck so I tried these. They didn't compare. The seaweed itself was all stale; it lacked the crunch of other roasted seaweed. I supposed I could have tried adding strips to soup or something, but I really just wanted something I enjoy eating directly. I don't know if I just got a bad bag, but I don't think I'm going to try another one. Too bad, I loved the idea of the small wrapped portions that would fit in the pocket.
THIS IS A GREAT PRODUCT, I PUT THEM IN WITH THE  NOODLES JUST BEFORE  I STRAINE THE WATER OUT(CUT THEM INTO PIECES)LET IT STAND FOR  A MINUTE AND ITS GOOD TO GO, IT WILL JAZZ UP ANY PLAIN SOUP,
I was disappointed with this product. I like my seaweed snack thin and crispy. It was chewy. Not happy at all.
These are good and right now they are about the only green food item entering my three year old's mouth, HOWEVER, they are a bit salty AND you can buy them WAY cheaper in an Asian food grocery.

column9: There are many better varieties of dried seaweed
column10: Matsutani Ajitsuke seaweed comes in small packs, which are very handy if you are using these to manage a food or cigarette craving, or to include in kids' lunches if you have open-minded offspring. However, the taste and texture are subpar. These are thicker and tougher than they should be, with a distinct taste of soy sauce. They do not dissolve on the tongue as nicely as competitors' products do. I got through one of the 100 packs in the Amazon shipment but I plan to give the rest away if I can.

I've been eating roasted seaweed in all shapes, sizes, and packaging. I will always love this stuff.This price is definitely not worth it. You can probably get it at a Chinese supermarket for about 5-6$.
It was OK, but a little stale.Ajitsuke Authentic Japanese Seasoned Roasted Nori Seaweed - 100 Snack Packets - Fat Free, Light Spicy Flavor - 3.4 Oz

column9: not Korean seaweed snack... learn the difference!
column10: I'm an avid fan of both the Korean seaweed snacks as well as the Japanese seaweed snacks. This, being the Japanese seaweed snack, is chewier, less oily and less salty than the Korean counterpart because it's not roasted but simply dried. The people who bought this and gave it negative reviews because they thought it was stale don't know the difference between two. This is a great snack if you really enjoy the taste of seaweed and are looking for something more "plain". It's always a good idea to know what you're buying before you buy it and give it negative reviews!

column9: Tasty, but way too much packaging.
column10: Taste good. Mine were crispy and slightly spicy, as advertised. The four extra-thin strips inside one package weighed less that .1 ounce (they did not even register on my scale). Just be aware! The packages at Trader Joe's or Target (Annie Chun's) are MUCH bigger and I can personally eat one of those packages up in a day or two before they get stale.

A healthy and tasty snack for the health/weight consious. Being asian, I am always looking for something unusual to add to my eating routine. This arrived fast and I am loving this unique edible. I can eat them plain but I like to make a little sushi rice and roll it into a ball, then add the seaweed paper over it. I also like to cut it in my food processor adding in toasted sesame seeds. It makes a great topping to steamed jasmine rice. MUCH better than the pre-made-heat-up-in-the-microwave sushi rice/seaweed combos you find in the supermarket..
It delivered really fast comparing with others.I bought a two packs and they were flawless.It is really delicious and it is good for snack!I recommand this product.

Although a bit sweeter than I prefer, these packets of seaweed are easy to take along, fun to eat, & taste good. As a diabetic, depending on public transportation & with no teeth & very limited strength, this is important to me. The seasoned seaweed is good on it's own or slipped into a sandwich, particularly tuna or salmon salad.

I thought it would be like salty seaweed sheets, but they're not salty... they're flavored.At first I thought they were wierd and gross, but after eating 15 because I had nothing else to eat (out of 100), i fell in love ! :)This lasts a long time, and the price is very reasonable for what you are getting, I recommend!
Contains wheat, sugar and sake in the ingredients none of which I eat.  I had to give the whole package away.

column9: I really wanted to like this!
column10: I have never had nori before except in sushi, and I like to try new foods. But this type of food is just too different for my western palate. Neither my wife nor I could try it more than once. It made us sick.

I had purchased a snowman kit about 5 years ago and my kids loved it.  The one I just purchased was not nearly as well made and seemed overpriced for what you got. I don't think it was worth the price.  Perhaps I would recommend it more if it cost less.

column9: Pomegranate in the name is deceiving
column10: I purchased these treats on Amazon thinking they would be like the chocolate covered pomegranate seeds at Trader Joe's, but unfortunately they are not. While they are quite tasty (yes, I will be finishing the bag!), the expectation was that there was actually going to be pomegranate as the main ingredient. The name is misleading and, like many food companies, this seller is jumping on the bandwagon of adding the smallest amount of the fruit in the mix and using its name in the title. The pomegranate juice concentrate is mixed with several other fruit juices, and there is no indication on the package of how much pomegranate is actually in there. Trader Joe's version is actual pomegranate arils covered in a small amount of chocolate - definitely could qualify as a "healthier" treat option. These, unfortunately, do not. Quite tasty, but don't kid yourself on any health benefits here - too much sugar! FYI: 180 calories and 26 grams of sugar in ¼ cup (about 16-20 nuggets).

I just discovered this candy at Walmart and only bought one bag to see how I liked it. I wish I'd bought more!  I love almost any combination of fruit and chocolate and these sweet-but-tart little morsels are a superb example of how delicious that blend can be.  Walmart's price is currently the best by a large margin, so off I go to stock up on my latest confectionary addiction!

column9: Perfect blend of tart and sweet
column10: I got some of these chocolates in December, and just ordered a replacement bag (because two pounds of chocolate should not be consumed quickly :). They are fantastic. It is high quality chocolate (nothing chalky or waxy) and tart pomegrante juice. 20 pieces to a serving, giving you 180 calories and 65 calories from fat.

I've yet to run into a product where, after sampling, I'm asked to go buy more for the office multiple months later. Add to that the boderline health benefits that come from the dark chocolate and fuit filling, and you have the best of both worlds. The tartness of the fruit begins to overpower much of the flavor later, so you can't have more than a small handful, but they're so rich, you won't want to anyway.

column9: Brookside Dark Chocolate Pomegranate are Delicious
column10: I started eating this when Costco carried them and then they disappeared - I guess they're considered "seasonal".  Well, I love these little sweet tooth satisfiers all year long - pop 5 of these and you're good to go!
Considering I don't like pomegranate or dark chocolate individually, I was very surprised to learn that combining the two ingredients created a delicious chocolate treat!

column9: Hands-down, the most delicious chocolate candies EVER MADE!!!!
column10: Words cannot describe how good these are. AMAZING. I used to buy the 12 oz bag from Wal-Mart, but then discovered you can buy a 2-lb bag from Sam's Club for only $10! Such a great deal! But I'm sure the bag I just bought will be gone within the next week : )

If you love chocolate and fruits, this is the product for you. I have just finished my first bag, and I still can't get over the taste. The candies are bite-size, and (even though I hate using cliches) you simply can't get enough of them. The chocolate doesn't taste bitter, but it's not too sweet either, and the pomegranate enhances the flavor with a slightly sour touch. Overall, just like those commercials say, your mouth will thank you.

Don't order chocolate in the summer! Because I had experienced the pomegranate/chocolate pieced before, I know the product is yummy, but the little nuggets had been turned into one big chunk of crumbly chocolate by the time it arrived at my house. Very disappointing.

I love chocolate -- rich, dark, lucious chocolate, and every autumn my love becomes an obsession. For most of the year, I am able to have a bite of good chocolate candy or a rich chocolate pie or ice cream once a month or so, and it is enough. Not as much as I want, but as much as I need, and I'm satisfied. However, as the days cool and get shorter during the autumn, my craving is impossible for me to withstand, and I have always laid in a big supply of Hersheys and mini M&Ms, etc, for Halloween, and then I "graze" on the leftovers for the next six weeks. How long has it been since you have actually TASTED one of these products, rather than just eaten them remembering "you always liked them." When you taste it, you taste a lot of sweet but very little chocolate, and so I'm not satisfied.So, wanting to find a healthier snack in the hope of appeasing these urges, I tried these.Living in Texas, I ordered these during the first solid "cool spell" of fall, which was a mistake. By the time they were shipped and arrived, we had another streak of near-hundred degree days, and so the product arrived and had melted in shipment and re-congealed into a mostly-amorphous mass after arrival. When I opened it, I was irritated at first, but then I realized this was actually a confirmation that I was dealing with a better grade of chocolate, so I carefully extracted the lump and put it on a cutting board, prying the mass apart with a chef's knife.Under a little pressure, the lump broke apart into smaller lumps, but there were a substantial number of the "beads" of chocolate which came apart, reflecting the original consistency of the product, so I tasted them. The flavor, and the combination of pomegrante and the rich Brookside Dark chocolate was amazing. The aroma as you brought it to your mouth, and the release of the vibrant flavors "sang" to whatever area of my brain craves chocolate. 3 small pieces with a small glass of milk, and I was happy.I love chocolate, and I love pomegranate, but who knew what a synergy there is between these flavors! (I love chocolate covered orange peel, and enjoy chocolate dipped raspberries or strawberries, but they are not very significant compared to these small nuggets of chocolate.) As someone married to a creative cook, I can imagine a cheesecake topped with a vanilla and sourcream topping, with these dotting the top rather than the bland white chocolate chips.Back to my story -- just 3 of these with a little milk, and I was both ecstatic and content. I cannot wait to try 2-3 with a fine cup of dark coffee after a meal. I'm not sure how many callories are in one of these, but my guess is the two or three which satisfies is no more than a "mini" chocolate bar, and the flavor lingers in your mouth for minutes.So, to recap, there should be all of the benefits of flavinoids of dark chocolate and pomegranate, and the flavors are rich enough to really register on the palate and brain. In a reasonable and small quantity, they are a "little taste of heaven", that satisfies my brain without blowing my diet!You should order these if you prefer just a little excellent, flavorful chocolate, to a lot of so-so choclolate. Maybe they'll work for you like they are for me. Just make sure the weather is cool before ordering! Since ordering in hot weather was "on me", five stars for this fine product.HIGHLY RECOMMENDED.

my 2 bags of dark chocolate covered pomegranate came to me melted into two blocks of chocolate and pomegranate.  of course, this also means that the chocolate was dried out.  i am going to see if my costco still carries these candies and not buy them by mail again, if i can help it.  the box they were shipped in was not even labeled as to special handling of the contents.  very poor shipping, amazon.the product gets 5 stars.  the (super saver) shipping and handling gets no stars. i guess i got what i paid for.ellen

column9: If you like dark chocolate and even if you don't these are delicous
column10: Delicious candy. When you look at the ingredients they seem much healthier than most chocolates but It is candy though not a health snack. My problem with them is I just can't stop eating them till they are all gone.

This flavored chocolate confection is merely okay.First off, it isn't really chocolate over pomegranate seeds.  That would have been cool.  Instead it is chocolate that supposedly has the flavoring from a different confection from the same manufacturer, and that confection supposedly tastes something like pomegranate.  That stuff is mixed into dark chocolate to make this stuff.The dark chocolate part of this confection isn't semi-sweet, which is what I'm used to seeing for dark chocolate, instead its regular sweet, making it too sweet.Some of the confection appears to have that beige dimpling that occurs when chocolate, particularly dark chocolate, is exposed to the elements.  I don't know if its water, or air that does that, but this package was like that.Many of the small balls were stuck together into large constellations.All in all this confection isn't disgusting, but it hardly deserves the rank it has.  I'd say all in all its pretty 3-star average.EXCEPT, this treat has a fatal flaw: it doesn't taste like pomegranate.  Not even a little bit.  Nope, no trace of pomegranate flavor is perceptible.  It tastes like not-pomegranate.  And that not-pomegranate taste isn't readily identifiable.  I eat fresh pomegranates regularly, and so have an inkling of their flavor, and that pomegranate-flavor isn't contained within this chocolate confection.

column9: Things that didn't occur to me... chocolate melts
column10: Delicious product.  However, be aware of where you live and what the season is.  I ordered these in June in North Carolina and they arrived as a bag of liquid chocolate with suspended animation pomegranate seeds.  Put them in the freezer and then had a chocolate and pomegranate brick.  Still was able to enjoy them by breaking off pieces and making cookies (oatmeal raisin cookies that have chocolatey pomegranate instead of raisins).  Very good cookies.
We are watching what we eat and these prove to be a very satisfying and WONDERFUL snack, while the dark chocolate and Pomegranate anti-oxidants help our health!  LOVE THEM!

I absolutely detest dark chocolate, so when someone gave me these as a gift I was bitterly disappointed. But I couldn't very well throw out this large bag without giving these a try so I ripped it open and took a nibble. My reaction? Holy cow, are these delicious! The dark chocolate covering was nowhere as bitter tasting as I'd feared and it went well with the sweetened internal "juice piece." Now I and the rest of the household are hopeless addicts, because they're just that good.BTW, let's talk about the controversial "juice piece" that other reviewers are mentioning. Just know that when you buy these Brookside candies (blueberry, pomegranate, acai), that the "fruit" in the middle isn't a whole dried fruit; it's some kind of concoction that's a blend of several juice pieces. Some people have described this as being "like jelly" but that's inaccurate. The candy has the exact consistency of chocolate-covered raisins, so in spite of the artificiality of the juice piece, there's nothing particularly funky or fake-ish about the texture that should cause anyone pause. I personally didn't have an issue with the fact that these are "fruit pieces" but some people wanting the "real thing" might want to be aware of what they're getting should they order a bag of these.One last good thing about these Brookside chocolates? They're very filling. Just a small handful and you're stuffed. So there's no danger of gorging on them like you would a less healthy candy. So all in all, a very good product and welcome, much healthier alternative to the usual fare. Just a word of advice: if you're a member of Costco's or BJ's, you're better off buying these over there, because these stores sell them for much cheaper (a little under $10).

column9: Best candy ever! Beware, they are addictive
column10: After finishing five bags over the last year, I was hoarding my supply as Costco has stopped carrying the pomegraniate variety. The Acai are not nearly as good, as the tangy pomagranate compliments the dark chocolate so well. Do not hesitate to buy these, the chocolate is great, total flavor sensational.
I'm pretty sure they put crack in these because it is impossible to stop eating them.  This is my third bag and it's disappearing at an alarming rate! Love it.

Brookside Dark Chocolate Covered Pomegranates 2lb BagUsually I get good prices on Amazon but this product was purchased for me from Costco and paid $8.00 less than Amazon.  Product is delicious but I could purchase 2 - 2 lb bags for the price of one on Amazon.  Sorry.

The chocolate covered pomegranates are luscious.  Wonderful dark chocolate covering these chewy-center candies can't be too bad for you, what with dark chocolate and pomegranates both healthy foods!  They are a little smaller than an M&M Peanut candy, so they would not be appropriate for very young children, so Moms have an excuse to not share. At a party they are great mixed in a bowl with peanuts.  Everyone raves about them and wants to know where I buy them.
These are a delicious tart but sweet candy.  I purchased a bag on a whim and they were loved by everyone in my family.  I doubt they have much nutritious value but they are a tasty treat.

column9: MMMMmmm good!  Love those little balls!
column10: Love these pomegranate balls!  Can't find them everywhere and definitely not in a package this big!!  Bonus!  They satisfy a chocolate craving and they are fruity and chewy.

Someone brought this to the beach as a 'hostess' gift.  My heavens,  I am not sure how we functioned before we had these in our life.  Just a few of these assuages an insistent sweet tooth, for not too many calories.  (We never actually eat a whole serving at one time.)  I am ordering more of these - They are more fun to take as a house gift than a bottle of wine.  Everyone I have given them to loves them!

It has gotten so bad in our household that we have to hide the bag from ourselves. We never miss a week without having a bag of these treats on hand. It has gotten worse because now we can find the chocholate pomegrantes even at Walgreens! Help! They are shamefully delicious and impossible to avoid.

I make sure to keep these in the house because I have huge chocolate cravings and don't feel bad for eating these. They are not super sweet but satisfy that craving, and much "healthier" than a Hershey bar. I get them at BJ's wholesale club for around $10. They are fun to pop in your mouth and everyone I know who has tried them thinks they are great.

I must warn you, these are highly addictive. We're going through our 3d bag now. The taste is so wonderful that when your bag's over, you don't simply want something sweet, you want THEM. The filling is somewhat tart, it's a blend of pomegranate and other juices. The outside dark chocolate is not too sweet and not too bitter - just right to go with the filling (the filling has almost the same texture as the chocolate, it's not liquid or caramel-ish). Costco sells it for a little over $9 for this 2 lbs bag. The candy is completely natural, no artificial anything, no preservatives. Highly highly highly recommended, but... did I mention it's addictive?

I actually bought these at Costco and was just curisous to see others opions. Was really suprised to find so many good review! For me the jelly center was a no go but to each there own. I should have looked closer at the package.
I bought this product for the health benefits of dark chocolate and pomegranate.  I believe, eaten in moderation, it can be a healthy chocolate treat.

Product is delicious.  However we ordered the last shipment in July. Since the hot weather we recieved the item in chunk form as it had melted and stuck together rendering it unedible.  Recommend this item but not for shipment in hot weather.

bought these at costco for a few cents less and figure they will either double in price or never be in stock again glad to know they are here on amazon  They ARE addictingly good..the deep dark chocolate flavor is haunting.  I was looking for choc cherries but these will do nicely

column9: I never liked dark chocolate until I tried this
column10: Dark chocolate has always tasted bitter to me, so I've avoided it even though everyone keeps raving about the antioxidants in dark chocolate. I saw this in a local grocery store, and bought it on a whim. Wow! The ying / yang of (less sweet) dark chocolate to the (more sweet) pomegranate is irresistible. Let's just say that my local grocery store offers only a small pack, and Amazon has a giant 32 oz pack at a less expensive price. Enough said. LOL
The taste is great, but more than half of the bag came melted together making them relatively unenjoyable and hardly easy to eat.  Sad.

column9: Bet  you can't eat just one of these.
column10: These are awesome little dark chocolate covered chewy pomegranate candies.  Average size is about like a peanut M&M candy.  Wonderful, can't think of a bad thing to say about them except that the bag always empties too soon.  Great to have on hand (if you can keep them that long) for when company comes over. I pick them up at Costco where the price is better. What a treat!

column9: Florida+Chocolate+July = one big two pound block of brown stickyness
column10: I should have known better than to order chocolate this time of year.  Most shippers refuse to ship chocolate to Florida in the summer.  As a Prime member I thought it might have been packaged well enough to get here in good shape.  There was nothing in the package to protect it from the heat and what should have been delightful little bites of chocolate covered pomegranate turned out to be a two pound block of chocolate with little bits of 'gummy' candy discs.  They may have been made with some pomegranate juice but not enough to give it that 'kick' that real pomegranate juice has.  Even if I see them on a shelf in a store and I can tell from feeling the package that they have not all melted together, I wouldn't spend this much money for so little pomegranate.
What was I thinking ordering these in the middle of summer. Bought as a gift, and it was melted into a sold block of chocolate when she received it. I was so embarrassed.

This is a wonderful product, we all love these at work, which is why I bought the 2 lb bag. But somewhere along the way it got overheated and all melted together in a big ball. Ruined the chocolate and ended up throwing it away. I guess don't order in the summer or come up with another shipping solution.

column9: Yummy, Yummy In My Tummy - Chapter two!
column10: Oh boy! Here I go again praising the delicious candy made by Brookside. This one is in my opinion just a little bit better then the Blueberry flavor. My family tried "Brookside Dark Chocolate Covered Pomegranates 2lb Bag" and fell in love with this candy. Mix these in a salty trail-mix and you have something special for a hike or eat them straight out of the bag. Great snack. We all love this product. I found this product at Costco for the low price of $9.59. Recommended! Enjoy!

column9: Apparently you can get these at Wal Mart too???
column10: Well, I have never seen them at our local Wal Mart and it may be a regional thing, but these little round chocolate morsels, about the size of a peanut m&m have the combined tastes of pomegranate and dark chocolate and they are GOOD!!!  Easy on them and enjoy in moderation, and with a 2lb pack they oughta last you a while if you only have say 4-5 a day tops.  Lots of sugar I'm sure but treat yourself nice every now and then.  I think you will really enjoy them but be careful if ordering in a hot climate...Some reviewers reported a melted mess.  Ours arrived perfectly fine and well packaged in a box and did not appear melted or congealed and we live in the Houston Texas area and it is mid July.  Go figure huh?

I do not generally prefer dark chocolate or pomegranate, but this product is AMAZING! The company is able to combine two things and make them taste even better. I can't just eat one and it's a party for your mouth.

What a delightful little treat. If you are a "I need a little sweet" person and want just a BIT of yummy to pop in your mouth these are totally satisfying because they have a bit of kick. But the true win in a household of athletes is adding them to trail-mix. If it is hot- They will melt and then glob together with all the other items. These are a delightful little add-in to really upgrade the quality of average trail-mix.Also a nice treat for kids to just snack on something little.

I knew the candy HAD to be without pomegranate seeds, I love chocolate, and so I imagined the flavor would be 'nice.'BUT WAIT! MORE than nice, this candy is spectacular-tasting! The thick dark chocolate melts away to reveal the tangy and chewy pomegranate fruit (yep, no seeds!). Or, if you are a glutton, pop a few and chew away; you will be a happy glutton! And I bet you can't eat only one!

From the very first bite, you are hooked!!!  The combination flavor of dark chocolate & pomegranates is simply delightful & there is no way you can eat just one. . . before you know it, the bag vanishes!!  So, now I order at least 4 bags at a time - they are perfect for gifts & I have used them for dessert, instead of cake, and they just satisfy the craving for something sweet perfectly!  If you are craving chocolate, this is the perfect solution - your taste buds will thank you ~!~
Best candy I've had in a long time! Kind of expensive but good for special occasions. I don't know know about the nutrition value of this candy, but it does taste exceptional!

I've been looking for some snacks that have food value. I don't mind it if the calories are high, but I don't want just all sugar things. I want the snacks for my own consumption and for my little boy (3 1/2 years old). Recently, I found these Brookside Dark Chocolate Covered Pomegranates at my nearby Costco store. They're excellent in taste, as good a chocolate as you can generally find. They're sweetened with fruit juices, especially pomegranate. They're a dark chocolate and are a natural source of antioxidants. Did I mention that they're really, really good tasting? Did I mention that they're not particularly expensive? This is one item that fits the bill. The only difficulty is that they're so good you may have to worry about eating too many of them.Gary Peterson

I actually had to stop buying these because I couldn't stop myself from eating them. Those 2 lb bags were disappearing a lot faster than I would like what with bikini season around the corner. But OH MAN are they good. Seriously, I don't even like sweets that much, but if I am anything, it's a chocolate snob. The chocolate part is this unbelievable melt-in-your-mouth  concoction. I usually like darker chocolate, but for some reason, the milkiness in this is perfect. The inside part is this deliciously tart candy that is kind of the consistency of a jelly bean (trust me, it works). It's definitely not real fruit (this is the case for the acai version as well). It's some kind of juice concentrate mush. You shouldn't fool yourself into thinking these are "antioxidant healthy." They're really just a treat. A whopping 180 calories for 1/4 cup treat. But they truly are to die for.

column9: Great Taste of Brookside Dark Chocolate Covered Pomganites Bag
column10: Brookside Dark Chocolate Covered Pomganites Bag are very good. My sons and I enjoy them alot. We happen to be in Sams Club and seen these and bought them there..I am going to buy more of these next time I go there too...There a hit in my household...

I saw the word "pomegranate" and jumped into action, bought this at Sam's Club.  Tasting these reminded me of the old TV commercial: "where's the beef?".  To me it was just big pieces of chocolate and nothing more.  I expected it to be like raisinettes or something, it wasn't. It was the chocolate without the inner 'raisin.'
