column9: Cento Light Tuna In Olive Oil, Pack of 3 cans 5 oz.
column10: This tuna is not Italian tuna. Also it does not state that it is wild caught as I somehow presumed due to the price per can.I called the company direct and they stated that it was wild caught. Hmmm? They also said it was caught in the oceans off of Somalia or somewhere, & to be honest I forgot that part.The tuna IS definitely better than the other common store brands. I will try to get the Italian wild caught brand in the future if possible.  If not, I'll opt for this brand.

I have been wanting a good tasting teriyaki sauce for a long time. The ones I had tried in the past all had bad after tastes. This one nailed it, I will be buying more of this. It tastes wonderful and has no sugar, awesome job!

I have been enjoying a no/low carb no/low sugar journey for three months. Losing my favorite Yoshida's Gourmet sauce marinade was tough. Next I read scores of positive Seal Sama Sugar free user reviews. One mentioned how well it compared to Yoshida's and another noted it was as good as the best non-diet marinades. We bought three bottles.My wife (not needing diet products) and I have all our thumbs WAY UP for Seal Sama. We have now used it on steaks, chicken and fish and agree that it is amazing. Incredible flavor that does not mask the taste of great steaks, fish etc. Only need 1-2 tablespoons for up to 1lb and only needs two hours marinating time for full flavor. At zero sugar and only 1 carb per serving we are hooked on Seal Sama.Pricing: Lowest we have found - $4.95 with fixed $5 shipping from netrition.com We are delighted to pay this price for such an amazing, helpful and delicious product. Have no idea why Amazon.s price is way too high. Have seen it on other web sites for $6-$7 with higher shipping cost. Delighted to receive a return phone call from none other then Peggy Whitting the gal who created Seal Sama. She answered our query noting the Sugar free shelf-life is 2 years. With that in mind we shall be buying a dozen bottles at netrition using their fixed $5 shipping/no tax so final price will be about $5.40.  Thanks Seal Sama!!!

I love this sauce.  I use it mostly in stir-fries but my kids love it on rice.  It is hard to find low carb condiments to replace some of the products I used before and I was SO happy when I discovered this one.  I usually buy 6 bottles at a time so there is always one on hand.  It handles well in cooking and also is great out of the bottle if you want to add it after the food is prepared.  It is sweet like teriyaki should be but isn't overly sweet or "fake" tasting, as sugar-free products sometimes are.  I highly recommend it!

column9: Very good replacement for the real stuff!
column10: I always use this stuff on my stir-fries ... and always do if given the choice!  It's sweet with a little bite to it and has a great consistency.  As I'm not a dieter, I don't have to use this product ... but I use it anyway!  Even my family can't tell the difference when I use it in recipes!

column9: I've been looking for something like this for years...
column10: Years ago there was a product by Carb Smart that was a 1 carb Teriyaki sauce sweetened with Splenda.  I used to buy this stuff all the time and one day, it simply just disappeared from the shelves.  I've ordered a few variations of Teriyaki sauce over the years and NONE of them were any good.  When I came by this listing I was a bit skeptical at first but placed my order anyways.  The only reason this product does not get 5 Stars is because when I opened the box and removed the bubble wrap and the protective seal there was a little bit of sauce on the lid.  It had spilled out because the cap wasn't screwed on all the way.  Not a lot at all but enough to rinse my hand off in the sink with.  Plus its expensive.  After shipping this 12oz. bottle of sauce was over $12.00.  That is a bit pricey for just sauce, however I still paid it.  Damn curious nature!The sauce itself is WONDERFUL.  It's even better then what I remember.  I will definitely be using this sauce more in the future and I am happy that I found a Sugar Free Substitute.  I cook a lot of chicken and broccoli on my Low Carb Journey and this really makes it that much more enjoyable.  Plus its great on Shirataki Noodles.
Because they showed six barbells for the price,  I ordered them not knowing the price was for one. I paid over $16.00 for 2! They need to change how they describe the product.

column9: Good Energy with No Jitters for me
column10: Despite it's juvenile sounding name, this isn't a child's energy drink that's for sure. Each tube packs about 42,000% the recommended daily dose of Vitamin B12. The high from this is extremely stable and hasn't yet given me the jitters.  Everyone reacts differently though so to guarantee 100% that you will not get the jitters would be a lie.  When I take it, I feel very awake, alert, and clear headed. I use it before a workout and several of the ingredients make it perfect for the gym. The let down is probably the smoothest you'll find among energy drinks. And if you feel a cold coming on, downing one of these may help tremendously.The name comes from the interaction the mix has with water. You pour one vile into a 16-20 oz bottle of water and the stuff fizzes like crazy! If you don't get the lid on fast enough, you'll quickly find there will be a mess! I've found using a wide mouthed nalgene bottle is the best way to prevent these types of accidents.In addition to the massive amounts of Vitamin B12, it has a good amount of Vitamin C (500mg), Niacin (10mg), Vitamin B6 (2.5mg), Calcium (60mg), Magnesium (100mg), and Potassium (905mg). It has almost every water soluble vitamin meaning that a lot of the excess that your body doesn't utilize, will be flushed through your kidneys. With that being said, drink a lot of liquid with this and don't over use the product (company recommends no more than 3 a day) or the chance of getting kidney stones exists.It has a 317mg "proprietary" blend blend of L-Arginine, L-Taurine, Caffeine from guarana, Alpha-lipoic acid, Grape seed extract, Green tea leaf extract, Ginger root, and Ginseng root. I don't know how much each compound contributes to the 317mg but they do acknowledge that 100mg of it is caffeine (about the same as a cup of coffee).There are multiple flavors but I'm partial to Grape and Orange Soda. The flavors are very sweet and candy-like but they surprisingly have no sugar. 10 total Calories and only 2g Total Carb.This is an excellent product and recommend it over any other energy drink.

I like this stuff!  Good source of various vitamins (esp potassium) and it seems to give me energy without some of the adverse effects of other energy drinks.  Not a significantly high amount of caffine which I like.  Heck, this stuff might actually be good for you!  Taste is good, better than many other energy drinks and the price is good compared to anything you might buy in a can.  I prefer the orange flavor.  Probably good for hydration during hot sweaty work or sports events.

After using Zipfizz for a year, I've been amazed at what it offers me.  I get sustained mental alertness and energy with no crash or fatigue.  It doesn't affect my sleep, and I find that it is easier to get up in the morning the day after taking Zipfizz.  You don't even have to use a whole tube if you're cost-conscious.  Sometimes, I use a half tube and find I get the results I need.  I will never drink Red Bull or Monster again.  This stuff is great.FYI, this thing is loaded with Vitamin B12 - as much as getting a Vitamin B shot from your doc.  Please avoid taking more than one or two tubes a day, because too much potassium can overload and be detrimental to your kidneys.

column9: Haven't been sick in TWO years thanks to Zipfizz
column10: This drink is just wonderful.  Although it has caffeine, it doesn't have an alarming amount.  The great thing about this drink is all of the vitamins (I'm not good about taking a multivitamin...).  I drink this fairly diluted; with at least 32 ounces of water instead of 16 ounces and the flavor is just right.  The citrus is my favorite and, sadly, they don't carry that at Costco anymore.  I've been drinking only one Zipfizz daily and work in a school -- a huge breeding ground for germs and viruses -- and haven't been sick in the two years I've been drinking this.  Pretty impressive.  And it is WAY cheaper than a cup of coffee at Starbucks :)

I am a 53 year old female who has been working out 6 mornings a week for years and this product is awesome!.  I have taken this product prior to my morning work out for about 2 years. I have been out of it for a week and can really tell the difference. Also, a half a tube in the afternoon will give you a pickmeup at work if needed. This is the only product I have ever used that has no crash associated with it.  A friend of mine is a dietician and she reviewed the ingredients and states that this is about the healthiest energy product out there.  I have recommmended this product to my friends at the gym and my employees at work and they all have give great feed back and continue to use this product.  I love it!

Just tried my first one and this caffeine addict with very high tolerance can seriously feel the effects and I am not even done with it! High marks for flavor too. The packaging will be very effective at keeping the stuff 'fresh' and will allow you to carry it around without the little packets opening in your bag. You can also re-close it if you do not want the full serving. The old stuff I used was a tablet that was individually foil wrapped and did just fine too and was much less wasteful. Each serving is in a thick rigid plastic tubes that will be around in the landfill for eons! They are #5 type plastic which is technically recyclable but is almost never accepted (think tupperware container) at local recycling centers. I hope the manufacturer will find a better solution to packaging this awesome stuff!

I've used this product for a couple of years and it's great!  You get increased energy and alertness, without any jitters, and it's all natural - not a bunch of chemicals.  I do not recommend this before a work out because you tend to use the bathroom a little more frequently.

To be honest, I was at first skeptical about this drink.  In my mind, an energy drink had always been any drink with sugar and caffeine levels as high as seen in Monster and Redbull.  My mother one day brought this home from Costco and told me to try it out.It took me probably 2 or 3 drinks to get used to the taste. It wasn't that it was terrible. I guess the "problem" when I started out was that the taste was just a bit different from what I'm used to.  But I have to tell ya this company did a great job sweetening the drink without using sugar or some other artificial crap that's seen in others.  Once you get used to this drink you find yourself popping one out casually once a day.That being said I've noticed that this drink doesn't have the same type of boost you get with caffeine.  The problem with Red Bull and coffee is that the caffeine, while kicking in a lot faster than this drink, also causes you to crash and burn several hours later just as quickly.  This drink however doesn't have that effect.  It gives me a subtle yet noticeable boost for several hours before giving me a "gentle landing" back to where I usually would be without the drink.Anyhow, that's where I am.  Down to 5 tubes and hunting for any deals on this at Costco and here.

I never liked Monster or Red Bull energy drinks plus they were costly.  I bought a box of this stuff at Costco and enjoy it before hitting the gym.  I stopped drinking coffee so this is helping me get through long afternoons at work.  I can't believe how sweet it is without sugar.  The packaging is small and I keep it in my office drawer.  I wish it wasn't packaged in plastic though.  Anyway, it's worth a try and you get lots of vitamins.

I'm going to try to keep my review simple.I mix one tube with 8-12oz of water.Pros: noticeable energy boost after 2-3 sips.  When I first tried it, i got a "high" or  a awakening buzz... after 1 sip. you just have to try it to understand.  Strong stuff. take it in sips through the morning.  (I don't recommend drinking the whole tube in 3 mins. )  No crash and jitters. ( But i'm sure you will feel weird if you drink it too fast.)Cons: a little on the expensive side, but far better deal than red bull or coffee from a store.  mixing the powder adds 1 or two extra steps in the morning.Bottom line: I like this product. It simply works.

I have to say that this pink lemonade flavor is simply delightful! I started drinking zipfizz to quash my overwhelming addiction to caffeine that had spiraled out of control.  I find that I have received the same pick-me-up that I was getting from 500-600mg of caffeine.  While ZipFizz does have 100mg of caffeine, it does not come with the same 'crash' that caffeine delivers.The pink lemonade flavor is, by far the best flavor I have had.  You can customize the sweet-tartness level by adding more or less water.  I recommend everyone try this product and you will be instantly hooked! Yaaaaay ZipFizz!

Found this product initially at Costco and wanted more of one flavor.  Found it offered on Amazon when the Costco no longer stocked the item and was more than happy with the order of Citrus flavor 20 tube boxes I received.

column9: Great for keeping you on the go!
column10: Zipfizz, Tastes good and keeps you moving all day .Zipfizz is loaded with energy and is great for those who lack the required rest from the night before.

A friend's doctor recommended this to her for weight loss after having a baby.  It is good, better with a little artificial sweetener added.  Note:  Be sure to drink some of the water out of your bottle, when you add the drink mix, it will fizz up some.

column9: Great boost and flavor in a tube
column10: We have been users of ZipFizz since it first came out.  It is not only a good kick up on energy when working out, when you travel it is easy to put a few in your carry-on for a energy boost when on the road.

I have been using ZipFizz for about 6 months now and I love it.  I am partial to the Grape and Orange, the Pink Lemonade was just a bit sour for me.  I only take one a day and right before I go to the gym.  I compare this to Advocare's "Spark" drink and this product is WAY CHEAPER but contains just about the same things!  Awesome for those on a budget.Some may be confused by what seems like an excess of vitamins on the ingredient label.  But any that you dont use up in the day get flushed from your body though your kidneys.  DO NOT TAKE MORE THAN 3 a day it says on the vile, but I only need one in the morning to help me rip though my workouts.I do not drink caffine in any other form because I am very sensitive to it. But with this drink I have not had a problem, I thought that it would make me jittery or feel awful, but this product does no such thing!  After the gym I am good to go though the time I get home and I sleep fine!

column9: Have been drinking ZIPFIZZ for a couple of weeks...
column10: I have been drinking ZIPFIZZ for a couple of weeks now.  So far my favorite flavor is the Orange.  At first I drank it like medicine... just for the energy.  Now I look forward to it.I was usually very groggy in the AM.  I drank several cups of coffee to wake up, and then I was anxious for the rest of the day.  I was in Sam's one day and there was a lady demonstrating ZIPFIZZ.  I tasted it and it wasn't too bad so I bought a box for 18 dollars.  I have been drinking it almost every day since.I drink half a serving every morning.  It works very quickly for me, and I am not jittery afterwards.  I have more energy and I am even more productive.  My mind is even clearer.I would recommend ZIPFIZZ to anyone looking for energy without the jitters of other energy drinks.  And Sam's seems to have the best price so far.

I really like this stuff but was a little annoyed that in 2 of my vials the product had solidified.  I don't know if water got in there or what but I got less than I paid for.  I will still buy Zipfizz I just hope I've seen the last of the solidified product.  It was rock solid - there was no getting it out and still using it.

column9: Great substitute for Pepsi and other sodas
column10: I am a Pepsi addict who is trying to reform. Zipfizz is being a big help in that process. It's easy to carry around, and when I eat out, I ask for an extra glass of water "to mix with my vitamins." I request a separate glass of ice to be added once it is mixed up. Be sure to drink the water down one to two inches from the rim so the fizz has somewhere to go! One of the things I love about soda is the fizz and the "burn" as it goes down my throat. There's just enough fizz in this stuff to give me some of those sensations, and to help me avoid sodas. I don't drink Zipfizz for the energy, and can't say I've noticed any increase in energy, or relief from fatigue, but that's not what I'm drinking it for!  I LOVE the grape flavor. It reminds me almost exactly of the Grapette I loved as a child. I had been craving it for years, but couldn't find any. Zipfizz Grape really works for me. The orange flavor reminds me of Orange Crush. Sometimes I use about half orange juice, half water to mix it with. That makes it taste more "orangy," and mellows it out a bit.  Citrus and Pink Lemonade are decent flavors, too. I usually add a little extra lemon juice to them, just for more kick. Occasionally, I add a splash of Diet 7-Up or Sprite, or other lemon-lime soda just to change it up a little. Yum!!I buy the grape and orange flavors at my local Sam's Club for about $20 per box of 20. Those are the only two flavors they carry. Citrus and Pink Lemonade, I have to buy online.Thanks to Zipfizz, I'm now drinking about two to four Pepsi*s a week instead of one or two a day!I love the little tubes that Zipfizz comes in, and save them to reuse. They are great for carrying aspirin, or other pills. I take the labels off once I've used the Zipfizz, and put on plain labels so I can mark what I have filled the tubes with. Some I use for the powdered CranAloe drink I take. The tubes are also useful for holding little safety pins, straight pins and needles, toothpicks, salt and/or pepper, sweetener, craft beads, etc. I filled one with my favorite seasoned salt so I can carry it to use when I eat out. At Halloween, I don't give out candy ... I give out the freebies I collect all year long ... bookmarks, keychains, pens and pencils, rulers, kid's meal toys, note pads, AND these little tubes. The kids love them!!

This drink makes me feel like sunshine! Some mornings are hard for me to get up; I feel heavy, slow and sluggish both mentally and physically. And if it's dark outside in the winter, it is even more difficult for me to get out of bed. Zipfizz helps me to "wake up" so I can get started on my day instead of conking out under the covers because I couldn't get out of bed fast enough once I've turned my alarm off. I've always used Zipfizz. I didn't know there was a letdown until I tried 5 Hour Energy which kicked in for about 2.5 hours and then I started feeling sluggish again. Zipfizz gives you enough to help your own body to get itself going so that it can keep going.The taste is nothing great though. Don't buy the powdered drink mix. Buy the drink shot (the tubes) instead to get through it quickly.
I've been sipping on this for a couple of years during my workouts, and just love it. It seems to give me a little lift while it's hydrating me. For me citrus is the only flavor I ever want or need.

column9: Best Energy Drink Around With No Sugar
column10: Zipfizz is a great tasting easy to use energy drink.  The price per unit is less expensive than other bottled energy drinks.  Just mix it into a 12 or 16 oz bottle of purified water and shake.  One word of caution, you need to take a couple of swigs from your water bottle before you pour in the Zipfizz, or you will have an eruption of the flavored mix, two or three tablespoons should be adequate.  My favorite flavors are the Berry and Grape.

I've been trying zipfizz lately and I'm very surprised at how well this drink seems to be working.  Gives me steady energy without the weird crash I might get from Red Bull or Amp or something juiced with a ton of sugar.  Seems to have a lot of vitamins as well so it's actually good for you!

Grape zipfizz will not dissapoint. It is the least bitter out of their lineup and gives you a great energy boost that doesn't knock you out in 2 hours. I also like how I can fill up a bottle with it instead of having a shot like those other drinks. I like to enjoy it and sip slowly, not just shoot it down and be done with it. I also feel slowly drinking an energy drink evenly will lead to a longer buzz and energetic feeling with less comedown. A+++ for this product.

when i ordered this it was the best price on the net for product and shipping on the individual flavor but i have since changed to ordering it from costco because this price went up or they stopped carrying it at least expensive merchant. its a great product i love it i just dont like every flavor so i dont want to order multi paks of it.

I have ordered many boxes of the citrus zipp fizz. This is one of the few places I can get the citrus only (I don't like the combo packs) at a reasonable price. I have never had a problem and I find that I enjoy the zipp fizz in the morning just as much as a cup of coffee.

Ultimately, I think personal preference is going to play the main role in whether or not you will like Zipfizz over any other energy drink.  That said, here is what I have experiencedEnergy BoostFor me it gives a nice boost of energy, equivalent to a full cup of coffee.  It seems to last around 5 hours for me without a crash at the end.  I think this is where individuals will have the most variance, as caffeine reacts differently in different people depending on the product.  For example, I don't like what a Diet Coke does to me but I like this.FlavorThe flavor is great because it is not overpowering and not to subtle either.  Since it is a mix, you can add more or less water to get the flavor you desire.  I have tried grape, orange, and lemonade.  Grape is my favorite, although an interesting twist on orange is to add a bit of vanilla creamer - it makes for a tasty Creamsicle flavored treatZipfizz vs 5-hour energy5-hour energy also has the desired energy boost for me, however, it tends to leave me with cotton mouth.  Zipfizz does not do that since it is mixed with water.  I prefer the added hydration.Lastly, often times I only use half of a canister with 16 oz of water.  This helps maximize the value of the product and for me only half of the canister is plenty of an energy boost.

This product works but the advertising is misleading. Zipp Fizz claims that it's a natural product and on its website says that it is sweetened with xylitol.  Xylitol is a natural sugar made from the birch tree, and used in Europe for over 100 years.  I use xylitol on a regular basis and agree that if it comes from the right source and not from China, where it's made from corn, it is healthy and has very good side effects such as cavity prevention.  But,on the ingredients list, xylitol is the last ingredient, meaning, that it is the smallest ingredient in the formula.  On the other hand Sucralose (also known as Splenda) is very high on the list of ingredients.  That's where the aftertaste is from.  If you don't care what you put in your body then this is a good product as it does work as advertised.  Why add Splenda if the xylitol is in there? Because the splenda is cheaper. So obviously there is no need for the xylitol other than to use it as a marketing ploy.  They know this and have told me that their new product - immune fizz - has no Splenda.  Why not take it out of the regular zipp fizz too and make it healthier too?  I was sucked into the purchase by the xylitol reference only to find the sucralose in the product.  I wonder what else they aren't saying?

column9: used to be the best 70% chocolate

column9: Lindt just lost a 20+ year customer; BRING BACK LINDT CLASSIC!
column10: The flavor is now bland and boring (think Hershey Kiss), and the "new and improved" smooth texture reminds me of plasticizers.I spent probably hundreds of dollars on Lindt 70% chocolate bars over the years, but as soon as I tasted the new version, I will never by another Lindt product of any kind until they bring back the old one. Remember the world in the movie Soylent Green? This is the chocolate for them.

column9: They have ruined a great product
column10: I thought everyone was overeacting. I WAS WRONG!!!!!!!! This is the worst chocolate. Tastes like lard. Please do not waste your money. You cannot send it back.

I'm not sure I'm reviewing exactly the same Lindt 70% bar as shown here, but it's the best match I could find. Here goes:What's good: Silken texture, the Lindt trademark, and strong chocolate flavor.What might be good for some: Intermediate "dark" chocolate flavor, richer than traditional "dark" chocolate, but without the bite of 85% or 90%. I'd rather eat a Hershey bar.  No idea what Lindt is thinking.  Their website says they made this change after extensive consumer tests showed folks wanted a "smoother" taste with a "less intense cocoa flavor."  Who on earth would buy a chocolate bar advertising 70% cocoa content and expect it not to be intense?

The new formula 70% Lindt chocolate bar is terrible. Nothing at all like the old formula which was one of my favorites. I wrote to Lindt about this and they responded that marketing research found more people preferred the taste of the new formula bar.I wonder if they used the same company that recommended "new coke", that British Airways change their tail design, and that Citibank start issuing their PDF statements on 7x14 paper size!Yes, the average American prefers a Hershey bar to most other chocolate, no surprise there. It's what we grew up with. But they're not going to pay $2 for one in a fancy dancy euro-style package.

their New Recipe for 70% is totally atrocious and horrible.It's greasy, cheap tasting with soy lecithin  "to aid the chocolate flowing and molding properly" according the their QA.I don't buy it because their other bars are just fine without soy. Keep in mind that the lecithin is most likely derived from GM soy.Many people are allergic to soy - they don't care!Shame on Lindt! I'm glad others hate it too, maybe they will get a message.You may just as well buy cheaper brand from the candy machine.

Has none of the cocoa bite that it used to.  This is kind of sad, since this chocolate used to be the best readily available dark chocolate on the market.If you're looking for a dark chocolate that's kind of low in carbs, this isn't it. Save yourself some money and buy a hersey bar.

I am not sure why so many folks are so bitter about this chocolate. I might not be a chocolate expert, but I definitely love good Swiss chocolate and I think this product is great (even though it is made in the USA - by a Swiss company). This stuff tastes great, is not too bitter for a 70% bar and gives me my chocolate fix without sending me into a sugar shock. The reason it melts in warm weather is because it is real chocolate - that's what it does. Anyhow, wanted to put in a good word for my favorite snack.
The 70% tastes like cheap Easter bunny chocolate. Green and Black I guess it will have to be. Sad though since the Lindt was very good in France.

There was a square of this chocolate in a bag of Lindt dark chocolate truffles, a sample I guess. So glad I didn't buy a whole bar of this stuff because it was not very good. Left me wondering "where's the chocolate"? Not much flavor at all. :P
Melts and spoils in shipping. Very disappointing in texture and flavor. You're better off buying this locally at full retail.

column9: They ruined a Good Choclate Bar!!
column10: Well, once again a great product has been cheapened in the name of "American taste".  I find it hard to believe that anyone would prefer this "new" recipe that Lindt is using for its Chocolate sold in the USA.  I should of known something was up because I noticed that the Lindt bars were on sale for far too long at the supermarket.  That is often a sign of a product being cheapened some time after an acquisition from a conglomerate or private equity company; Kettle chips come to mind.Those who were previously in charge of marketing and merchandising Lindt bars in the USA had to know that their market was a little more upscale and refined than those who consume a Hershey or a Reeses.  I bet some new (American) management got involved.  That "market taste test" someone referred to is mostly BS; they already knew that Americans in general have unsophisticated child like tastes, that pander to the overly sweet, artificial and creamy.  Sweet artificial and creamy pretty much sums up American food with the exception of meats.  However in the case of meats sweet artificial sauces and fake smoke flavor abound for "dipping"; Americans love their finger dipping food!  Coming off the diatribe, it is clear that Lindt is now more interested in competing with Hershey for the taste of the "average joe".  After all it costs less to produce chocolate for their taste.  So the gamble is this; will they profit more by making a cheaper bar and competing against Hershey for the taste of Joe average or by keeping their quality high and catering to those who know better?  American management is notorious for pursuing the "quick money", and I know this is a pretty audacious assumption but i bet that Lindt hired on a few Americans to run local manufacturing / Marketing and this change is being conducted at their behest.  Short term, these American managers look good (the quick win) because they lowered their cost basis by decreasing production cost.  Long term, American management mostly moved on and Lindt is now a cheapened brand that just barely survives (in the USA) competing with the likes of Hershey.  We shall see, but I will not buy another Lindt product while Stateside.Can anyone advise of an alternative European dark chocolate bar (70-90%) that is reasonably priced and available in the States.  My favorite bar,  Neuhaus is very expensive and limited in terms of availability.

I read a cookbook recently where the author, in addition to giving recipes, interviewed famous and influential chefs of all sorts.  One of the questions that the chefs were asked was "What do you eat when no one is watching?"  In other words, what is your guilty pleasure that might not jive with your being a renowned chef.  The answers were honest and amusing.  Although I am only a foodie and not a chef, if I were asked that question my answer would be "Hormel Corned Beef Hash."Fist, let me be honest about what this is: this is not something that you would want to eat very often if you were worried about fat or sodium content; the potatoes are dehydrated; and the corned beef tastes a little like potted meat.  Still, it is a real comfort food for me and I love it.I almost always add some freshly diced onions or shallots.  I also add either diced bell pepper or minced Serrano.  I put in it a hot skillet over medium heat and let it cook until crispy.  I flip it and while the other side is cooking I cook an egg or two in a separate skillet and place them, sunny side up, on top of the hash.  I like to finish it off with a generous dose of hot sauce.I buy this large size when I have guests (I have to admit that not all of my friends or family share my love for this product.)  I also purchase the 15-Ounce and also the 7.5 oz can when it's just for me (and when I'm not having it for my main meal.)  This is something that I always have on hand (I just hide it from my judgmental foodie friends.)  :-)

I LOVE SHOPPING WITH YOU'.Thank You, Lynda Kalesnick and husband David Dowling.

column9: Best deal on AMZ for bottle pumps
column10: These pumps are very durable.  I've been using the same pump for over a year for my Torani coffee syrups and have no problem with them whatsoever.  The fit is perfect and I never have syrup running down the side of the bottle. The only thing I make sure I do when changing the bottles is rinsing out the pump as sugar crystals can dry around the pump mechanism and cause the pump to get stuck.  Cleaning is easy:  just let the pump soak in clean, warm water (no soap necessary) and then pump water through it a few times to blast away the remaining sugar residue.  Maintaining these pumps this way prolongs the life of the pump.This five-pack is the best deal on Amazon.  Others sold separately cost more by other shippers because of the added shipping costs.  A five-pack now allows me to keep several bottles of different syrup flavors available to chose from while making my morning cappuccino.

I bought these to go with my sugar free syrups that I bought in a sampler pack.  The pumps work very well and make sampling or mixing the syrups with my coffee a real treat.My only complaint would be that they would ship 6 instead of 5 to match the sampler pack.A tip: Before inserting the pump fully into a newly opened bottle, pump the pump to load the pump with syrup...otherwise it will overflow.  If you pump it full of syrup (2 pumps on mine) before inserting it fully, you won't waste any syrup.

This pump seems to work well. My only problem is that it loses prime and must be pumped a couple of times to get the syrup into the nozzel. Not a big deal though. It sure makes metering the syrup easier than pouring it out of the bottle.

column9: Lifesavers and at a great price
column10: We use syrup for homemade coffee drinks, and the pumps were a lifesaver! Grab bottle, open cap, pour (wipe bottle if it drips), retwist cap. Gahh! Put on a pump and enjoy your syrup without drips and leaks! Even if you knock the bottle over! (Has anyone else ever knocked over a Torani bottle and had the lid break on you!?!?!)The pumps I received were all gold, and they were all individually wrapped in Torani bags. Love these pumps! Since I had to give up my Sugar Free Vanilla iced coffee habit at McDonald's, the pumps have made things so much easier! No measuring either; they use pumps at McD's and other places so why shouldn't we?

We purchased these pumps to go with the 25.4-Ounce bottles of Torani Syrup we ordered. They work as advertised. They fit perfectly in the bottles and provide the exact amount of syrup we need. Of course some testing will be required to obtain the amount required for your own taste.

These pumps make it so easy to dispense Torani syrups. No mess and consistent amount. Be sure to draw syrup into the tube on first use before inserting into the bottle - otherwise you'll spill it over the top of the bottle. NBD. Possible negative is how tall they make the bottles 15" tall. I keep mine on the wet bar counter where I've set up my "coffee bar," so height isn't a problem for me.

column9: Colors match and pump works perfectly ... BUT ...
column10: I have these pumps and the color matches perfectly and they work great.My problem is when you go to lock the pump, you pump out one shot of syrup.You need to plan ahead I know, but it is too much trouble. If these were used at a business or for a party they would be great, but I am going to go back to just a regular cap and a measuing spoon.

The pumps work great.  They keep their prime and supply a nice metered dose.They are not Torani pumps however.  They are white no-name pumps not gold to match Torani bottles.A matter of aesthetics I know, but false advertising none the less.I have written amazon and the vendor about it and held off using them for a few weeks.But having received no response from either I went ahead and used them.

Not much surprise here. They fit on the bottle perfectly, the look as pictured, and they work just as you'd expect. My only complaint are that the syrup tends to crystallize on the tip causing less to pump out than when I first started the bottle, and that the syrup comes out so forcefully that you have to be careful to avoid over-spray messes.

The only problem with these pumps is you have to be very careful when putting in the new bottle to keep from wasting product. It also needs to come packed six to a package since the rack is designed to hold six bottles and the variety pack has six flavors.
I wish the pumping action was a little smoother, but I'm hoping it will improve with use. FYI, I put one of these on a larger Torani 1-liter plastic bottle, and it fit perfectly.

column9: Works pretty well on Torani glass bottles
column10: These pumps fit perfectly on my glass Torani bottles (bought from another site, not through Amazon).I haven't tried cleaning them yet, but in my past experience (working at a coffee shop), they should come clean with a good soaking in warm soapy water (don't forget to pump them to clean the inside & use lots of clean water to make sure you get rid of any soap residue).The only issue I have (& why I gave it a 4 star rating) is that when I first use them on a bottle the syrup tends to spray out a lot from the air in the pump. I'd be okay with that, but it seems to be a problem for longer than it should on some bottles. I'm not sure if the seal is bad on those lids or if those pumps have holes in them somewhere? It may even be an issue with the syrups themselves rather than the pumps (which is why my rating isn't any lower). It's not a big problem since I can just place the glass right up under the pump, but it's not quite as convenient as placing the glass down on the counter. It's still better than using a measuring cup, though, so overall I am happy with these pumps.

column9: Use TVP instead of Boca or Morningstar "Crumbles"
column10: TVP is the same base ingredient used for Morningstar "Crumbles" and Boca "Ground Beef" substitute.  The difference?  Pure TVP doesn't have the HUGE amount of added sodium in the aforementioned products (check the labels), plus it is cheaper.  Also, you don't have to freeze this product, and it will last a long time if stored properly.  All you have to do is rehydrate it and use it.  It takes on the flavor of whatever you are cooking and adds welcome protein to the meal.  For our household, this is a staple product.

column9: Much, much better than I expected !
column10: An avid home cook that is a collector of both cookbooks and cooking gadgets writes this review.  My husband and I have been following the "Eat to Live" plan for about 4 months now.  I purchased this product to give the illusion of meat in my chili and marinara sauce.  Both my husband and I were dubious about how this product would taste and what the texture would be.  We were both pleasantly surprised by this product.  I have summarized my observations of this product below:Pros:1. Very easy to use2. Can be stored in the cupboard while dry3. Texture is very similar to ground meat4. Absorbs the flavor of the sauce it is placed in5. Soy product, which is good for your health6. Good source of vegetable proteinCons:1. It isn't going to fool anyone that it is beef or pork it used alone, but it does replicate the textureOverall I recommend this product to anyone that is looking for a vegetable protein.  I have used it both in chili and marinara sauce.  I plan to try adding it to my lentil veggie burgers where I think it will work fine.  I have been pleasantly surprised by this product and would recommend it to anyone that is trying to reduce the saturated fat that his or her family is consuming.  If you aren't vegan I would suggest that you mix the rehydrated TVP into meatballs, and hamburgers.  I can't imagine that your family would even know that it is there if you used a 50/50 mix.

After trying another brand of TVP (which had some less-than-healthy ingredients), I tried this one.  The only ingredient is defatted soy flour.  I add a handful sometimes to soup or stirfry and it works very well.  It easily soaks up the flavor of whatever I am cooking and adds a very nice texture.

I never thought I would like this product at all--after all I am not a vegan or a vegetarian.  However, knew I needed more protein, and I thought I would try to use TVP to get additional healthy vegetable protein into my diet.  I now sprinkle it on yogurt, over a bowl of berries, I use it as a binder in my turkey meatloaf instead of breadcrumbs, and I add it to a bowl of cereal.  Using this as a part of a healthy diet helped me to lose 25 lbs in 12 weeks!It has very little taste, but if used in its natural form (right out of the bag) it adds a nice crunch.

Bob's Red Mill Textured Vegetable Protein is an excellent product and makes a great vegetarian substitute for ground beef.  I reconstitute it adding enough Kitchen Bouquet Seasoning Sauce which makes it look just like ground beef

column4: Mz Jordan "I am who I am and I make no apolog...
column10: Excellent product. My family(avid meat eaters) never knew the difference when I used it in chili or hamburger helper. Love it!

This is good basic TVP.  If you have celiac, the canary-in-the-coal-mine-type that reacts to 18 ppm gluten, this is not for you. It will make you sick, or at least uncomfortable.(My theory about Bob's Red Mill, is that they're great if you get their items that are once-milled; you're not getting exposed to the 10 ppm that is probably in the air when they mill other things in the wheat and oat containing part of the mill.)For reference:  I've been gluten-free for eleven years, and I have no other noticeable food allergies, except kiwis and uncooked corn.  I'm pretty sure this has things in it other than soy.

Good replacement for meat. I wanted a vegetable protein to combine with meat so that my family eat less meat everyday but get enough protein. I am satisfied with my choice. It is very easy to use and gets taste of your meal.

I cooked it in a meat sauce, just to make sure it resembled meat, and it did not at all.  Ended up throwing it away and using ground beef.

column9: Interesting taste at first, but now I like it. Perfect for the holiday time, after dinner and dessert
column10: This Ghirardelli Peppermint Bark chocolate has 3 component to it which makes it taste very interesting as you take a bite at it. This is perfect for the holiday time, after dinner and dessert.I like the Dark Chocolate version compare to the Milk chocolate version because the white chocolate layer is already milky and sweet, as well as the peppermint crust, so the dark chocolate will give more balance and reduce the overall sweetness of this chocolateIf you like this chocolate, you might want to try the after eight mint chocolate which is also very good. Tootsie roll pops, the first lollipop with a chewy center, were born in 1931 at the Sweets Company of America. The company changed its name to Tootsie Roll Industries in 1966. Tootsie Roll Pops are the number one selling lollipop. Bought singly or by the bag, one might pay from 16 to 20 cents for a single pop. The cost conscious consumer buying them by the box of 100 will pay 8 cents or less per pop.A .6 ounce tootsie roll pop has 60 calories, no fat, no cholesterol, no protein,15g of carbs, 10g of sugar, and no vitamins. It's a low calorie way to get that sugar fix if the consumer limits himself/herself to one or two pops. Pops last much longer than a chocolate bar without the high fat and calorie count.Mrs. Spudman is almost addicted to these confections. I buy them by the box of 100 at BJ's. She takes out the flavors she likes and gives the rest to me to enjoy for myself or take to work for the students. (I just bit into the center. column9: Waste of $17.00 but maybe not next time
column10: Now, my neighbor reportedly used this very same catnip (Frontier) and had excellent results.  He even gave me some and I had excellent results.  So I bought my own bag, right here.  Not so fortunate.  I gave my neighbor some and he did not have excellent results either. So that weakens the excuse that not all cats react to catnip. In fact, it reinforces the fact that not all catnip is created the same......

column4: Doreen B. Bishop "Doreen Bishop cat parent"
column10: I have been doing a feral cat program for awhile now. The food is important but they love good cat nip and I HAVE FOUND IT !!!!!This is like medical marijuana to my wild cats. In the worst of times they sniff and eat this and get through the cold and fight to keep their territory...I love my TNR program I donated to Denver for wonderful reasons. We elders must set a example..Thank You Amazon and all the  stores and fast delivery bundling and easy open packaging.. I don't take enough time to thank you and the wonderful people who deliver all my STUFF THANKS THANKS and ALWAYS BE HAPPY :)

It is the best smelling catnip ever! My cat never really liked catnip, but when I saw her licking the corner piece of the package I just cut off, I gave her a pinch, she ate the catnip and started rolling around in it amazing! I gave some to my roommates cats, everyone of them came out of hiding and wanted catnips, they had both hands over the plate claiming to them selves, they just didn't want to share it. Now I just shake the container that has the catnip in it, they all come running over. I was looking for something nice to donate to the Humane Society, so I just ordered another 16oz bag, I'm sure this bag will last a while...

This is a huge bag so I placed it in a freezer zip-lock bag and keep it in the refrigerator bin. It helps keep it fresh for months. This is by far the freshest nip I've ever purchased. My cats love catnip, I put some in old socks and tie the top, and fill their small toys. Both my cats are now laid-back and probably won't be moving much for hours! Great product and price. Highly recommended for cat lovers. You won't be disappointed...I don't like catnip tea so I can't comment on using this as tea but if your cat(s) like catnip they'll love this purchase.

My cats approval makes the review....however, it is so fresh and fragrant, I have no doubt it would be a super cup o' tea too. This is a huge amount...I have contained it in a very large tub and had a quart-size ziplock left to gift to my mother for her cat. Lots of fine leaves and nary a tiny stem.

More catnip than I imagine :) would last for months with 1 bag. Nice foil like package keep the catnip smell from escaping. 5 star :). purchased 3/21/2012. way cheaper than the 3$ from pet store if buying 2 package only 25$ free shiping deal is so good saving 8-9$ on shipping alone :).

This is very good catnip, I've never seen it have this much effect on my cats.  Be warned though, this is more catnip than an animal shelter could use in a year, and you need something to store it in because the bag doesn't reseal

I bought this mostly for my cat, though it has health benefits for humans too, and I will probably make some tea from it since it is just a variety of mint. However, the cat really loves it. I sprinkle it on her scratching pads and some of the areas she likes to hang out, and she just goes nuts for it.

I've purchased many catnips in the past, but my 14 year old Chocolate Point Himalayan has had a blast with this brand! It is extremely fresh, very aromatic and he is sooooo happy with it! Needless to say, I am as well. The price is amazing as is the quality. Highly recommended as it is fresh, fragrant and no rough stems or buds. Perfect for making toys for my boy!!

I grew up making catnip tea, but I always went out in the yard and picked it fresh. I was looking forward to enjoying it again. I was very disappointed. This tea has a strong smell, but it smells and tastes to me, like hay. In all fairness as I said, my expectations were based on fresh (not dried) catnip from our yard. I will not make another cup of tea from it, but my kitties are loving it. If your buying for cats or you have had dried catnip tea and liked it, this may be the tea for you, but if your used to fresh catnip this one will not make you purrrrr.

I ordered this the same day as some Herbes De Provence and put the catnip on autoship so didn't realize it was shipped together until my little furry little drug fiends dug out and pushed aside my Herbes to get at their own herbs! It has wonderful aroma that even I with my puny human nose can smell. So glad I found this excellent deal on organic catnip for my furbabies now sleeping off their nip :)

Product is the highest quality .My cats are getting through self lock down as the snow and cold keep them from wanting to go out .They race around and see things and then sleep for a while .Perfecto !!!

Now I know what a pound of catnip looks like. I just cracked it open and the cat is going bonkers. I hope I get through the whole thing before it (if it) goes stale. Good price if you don't have the weed growing around your home, and an effective product.
they love this stuff, even just opening the bag got them jumping, better quality and value than what you can buy at the store

column4: Desert Gypsy "A Brooklyn Girl Out West"
column10: Great value compared to similar products sold in smaller quantities. Leaves smell very fresh/fragrant and only small amount of stems/coarse pieces mixed in. Arrived in a well sealed foil-type bag to protect from light - I would have preferred a bag with a zip closure to keep the product fresh. Did not have the strong effect on my cat that some reviewers have mentioned but he does enjoy it on his corrugated scratch pad. Also great for stuffing or infusing his catnip toys. Would buy this again.

The best, most potent bulk catnip available ~ and at an affordable price! I use this catnip in handmade cat toys, and its high potency keeps the toys relevant for a long time. The 16 ounce bag is great ~ and the catnip stores well in the refridgerator! Very pleased with the product!

column9: Perhaps this product is too old
column10: I have ordered catnip before but this particular order was a disappointment.  No catnip smell and my cat ignores it completely. Would not order again.

column9: Lots of catnip for a great price.
column10: My cats love it, and it smells great.  This is quite a bargain if you have catnip junkies like me and quickly go through the little 1 or 2 ounce containers.  Catnip is very light in weight, so a pound looks like approximately a gallon in volume.

This stuff sucks.  It seemed to have an interesting, stinky smell when I opened the bag (which was some kind of mylar, sealed, so good packaging), and my two cats both got excited by it, but after a few days it seems to lose all aroma, and the cats are not interested.  They sense a hint of it, but they don't get excited.  I grew some catnip outside that worked much better than this.  I tried pinching and rolling this stuff around in my fingers to release some oils, but it's so dry that it seems that there really isn't anything to release.  Rubbing it does not make a difference to the cats, and it hurts my fingers anyway (too dry, no sticky icky to be found on this schwag).  There has to be good bulk catnip out there, but I may just start growing it myself again, as it is really easy.  Big disappointment, Frontier.. my guess is that this is either many years old or is just not grown well, or just isn't the right variant for good chemical output!

brought box into house, 5 min later had all 4 cats wanting to help open package. gave them a pinch of nip, and they all ate it up, ran around for few minutes, then took nap... wow !!! this stuff is strong, and good

This is a LOT of catnip! I have yet to try this as a tea but my kitty is very happy with this organic catnip. A pound will pretty much outlive all of your cat's 9 lives and then some but whatta deal! I'm going to give some to my daughter for her cats and to my neighbors for their cats because this is a ridiculous amount of nip. For all intents and purposes I'd say this is an excellent quality nip and a great value.
Making kitty toys and my kitty who is very particular LOVES this catnip!HIghly recommend and the quantity is super!

My 1 cat loves Catnip while the other smells it like as to say...."Are you kidding me?"  Some cats could care less, but I bought it for my cat that seems to want to chew grass and I think it helps him not do that so much...not sure.  Anyway, I recommend this item which comes in a mylar balloon type material package.

Based on some reviews on Amazon, I decided to try the Everyday Rub.  It is spectacular.  I've never used a rub with such an intense aroma and flavor.  I'm throwing out all my other pre-packaged rubs and sticking with the Fire and Flavor rubs.  I've occasionally done my own rub mixtures, and I still think this is better.  Paprika/chili flavors seem to dominate.This is a very finely ground rub (unlike the Asian rub), so it sticks well as a coating for grilled meat.  I tried it with grilled pork tenderloin - brush tenderloin with olive oil, then sprinkle and pat on this rub.  Let the meat sit for 10 minutes or so while the grill is heating.

This is supposed to be a grilling rub, but I use it for almost everything.  It's a superb seasoning for empanadas, vegetables, salsas, and dressings. When I run out, it's a cooking disaster in my kitchen!
Came with melted Ice Packs, but maybe about 10% of the chips had melted into chunks. Just freeze and then throw on the ground like a bag of ice to break them up. Best chocolate I know of.

This is a very nice hot cereal. The five grains give it a somewhat nutty flavor and a more complex texture than regular oatmeal, and it's quick to cook on the stove at only about 6 minutes. I like adding Wyman's frozen blueberries and strawberries (I add those when the oatmeal is done cooking but the heat is still on, so the frozen fruit can thaw a bit) as well as a bit of maple syrup and milk. mmm mm mm.

MUCH TO MY DISMAY WHOLE FOODS NO LONGER CARRIES OLD WESSEX FIVE GRAIN CEREAL. I USUALLY STOCK UP ON IT WHEN I GO TO THE STORE. I HAD TO ORDER IT ON LINE AND TAKE A CASE.  MY GRANDAUGHTER WHO IS EIGHT WAS EATING IT OUT OF THE BOX. I GAVE MY DAUGHTER A FEW BOXES AND SHE MADE HER FAMOUS COOKIES WITH CHOCOLATE CHIPS FROM THE RECIPE ON THE BOX. I USUALLY DON'T GET TO EAT LUNCH UNTIL AFTER TWO O'CLOCK SO THIS CEREAL REALLY KEEPS ME WELL FORTIFIED.  I ADD PROTEIN POWDER, WHEAT GERM AND GROUND FLAX SEED TO THE HOT CEREAL AND ALSO SOY MILK.  WHAT A TREAT!!!

I bought this cereal partially to benefit from the omega 3's from the flax.But the company admits their flax is in the form of WHOLE flax .It is a well accepted fact that little if any nutrients can be absorbed from the whole seed.I must admit the cereal is delicious.I recommend the multigrain cereal from Hodgson Mill or the 5 grain multigrain from Bob's Red Mill where the flax seeds are ground so they can be digested and the nutrients absorbed.

Oatmeal doesn't taste good to me without fruit and/or other sweetener, while this blend of oats and other grains tastes great as a savory porridge, to which grated cheese can be added. I've found that a single portion can be cooked in the microwave just so long as the container is big enough -- use twice as much water as dry cereal (for example, 1/2 cup cereal, 1 cup of water), and it cooks fine in the microwave in six minutes. I don't think it saves any time, but it avoids the need for stirring, and if the container is something one can eat out of, that's one less thing to wash (I use a Pyrex 4 cup measure, which seems like a nice big breakfast bowl with a handle). Sometimes I mix the Old Wessex Five Grain Cereal with Bob's Red Mill Seven Grain Cereal -- the Old Wessex is a flaked cereal, while Bob's Red Mill is steel cut, and usually takes a little longer to cook. When cooked up together (1/4 cup of each, combined with 1-1/4 cups of water -- and I add a pinch of salt), the texture seems more interesting than the result with either individually.

I love Old Wessex products and being a huge fitness, bodybuilder, nutrition and health person I love how healthy and great their products are for you! My brother got me into your products and I will never stop eating this delicious wholesome good for you products that you make! Keep up the beautiful work Old Wessex! I love how the 5 grain cereals combine a whole bunch of different grains and not just one kind like Oatmeal or other cereals do!

I've been eating this cereal almost every morning for years.  I have been buying it by the case from my local health-food store but I see Amazon sells it for less AND will deliver it for free.  I love the convenience of this cereal.  It cooks in 6 minutes and is highly portable for breakfast on the go.  I have been cooking it with a small handful of 'craisins' to add a little sweetness.  I like that it isn't mushy like oatmeal.  The nutty taste and texture appeal to me even if there's an occasional husk mixed in.  I wonder if more people, who are otherwise turned-off by oatmeal mush, would eat this if they knew about it.

I ordered the cereal at the first of May- as my husband and I love it and use it daily... we have a subscription to keep us stocked up.  Our last order was damaged so badly- it was not even delivered to us... that has been weeks ago and we have not gotten word of replacement yet... I am not happy.  Please resend the order and let me know what the arrival date is.  Jan Wattles
I alternate this seasoning with faeries grandma's poultry.  Both are delicious and having the pair in the pantry keeps the wife and kids from thinking i'm a one bird boy...
They were exactly what I expected them to be. Took a little over a week to get them (I live in the midwest).

Buttons were much smaller than expected and did not receive before St Patrick's Day even when I requested priority delivery and was willing to pay for faster service.  No response from seller when asked if shipment could be rushed.

column9: Without a doubt, this is the greatest thing ever.
column10: This is for serious HP sauce addicts. I admit, I'm one of them, and this is overpowering for a bachelor. I can plow through half a bottle of the regular HP sauce with fish and chips or a burger or any meat/fish/potato product. However, this is a different animal altogether.When I fill up smaller HP sauce bottles to make it more manageable with this big boy, the big bottle haunts me and stalks me as if to say "Nick, you need to consume me." Have you ever had what you thought was the greatest thing ever and then get a ginormous amount of it? It's *that* intimdating. No single man should ever think about condiments in terms of pounds, let alone double digit pounds. But this is an amazing value, and you can never have too much of a good thing. HP Sauce is like dating a super model: no matter what size you get, it's still a super model.It'll take forever, but I'll consume all of this HP sauce. I will be the Morgan Spurlock of HP sauce.The only downside is that you really need to get one of those pumps for the HP sauce due to the viscosity of the sauce. Viscosity = good.

column9: Best value for money, but needs a pump
column10: HP is like Marmite; you either LOVE it, or you HATE it (I hate Marmite).I'm a huge HP fan, but if you stock up on the glass bottles, you'll end up paying a fortune, plus you can never get the last drops out of the damn bottle.So, this huge jug of HP sauce is the best thing ever. The only thing I hate about it, is getting the sauce out of it, it also looks pretty weird sitting on the table next to the poor ketchup bottle. The bottle REALLY needs a pump, but I haven't been able to find one that fits the it yet.FWIW: this HP sauce is now made by Heinz in the Netherlands, when Heinz purchased HP from Dannon, they shut down the UK factory and moved it abroad. Thankfully this hasn't impacted the flavor one bit.If you like HP sauce, you have absolutely no excuse for not buying this.

column9: The Original and Best...A1 cannot compete.
column10: Fantastic sauce at a great price.  Not made in the UK (made in Holland), but this is the real deal-same recipe as original, and tastes the same.  Highly recommended!

My husband is English and this is sometimes difficult to find other than the very expensive British food stores and....this quantity lasts a long time, saving him the anguish of possibly being without.he puts it on almost everything  including meat, potatoes, curry and eggs. and even I like it on the wonderful bacon buttie( sandwich)GC in Newcastle, CA

column9: Actually, far from great value for money...
column10: By the time you read this, the subject of this review will likely be changed. This item has a list value of $33 -- it is being offered by a single seller here for $48 -- an approximta 50% price-hike on list. column9: Just as good as I remembered!
column10: If you love HP sauce (you probably wouldn't be looking at buying it in bulk unless you do) this is definitely the way to go.  It tastes as good as it ever did and seems to keep without deteriorating at all (in a cool place but not necessarily refrigerated).  My family loves it on many savory items (anything from breakfast eggs to burgers and steak) and we add it to bean dishes and homemade barbeque sauce too.Unreservedly 5 stars!Just wish we could buy Lea and Perrins Worchestershire sauce and Marmite in bulk too...
My husband is English and this is a daily need for him ...and now also myself ...

I have to warn readers that when this was sold for around $33 it was a five star value.  Now however, it is outrageously priced.  I have purchased this at the thity something price, but the idea of paying towards $ 50 for this is truly enough to make you choke on the stuff!!!  Not cool at all..
Best price around on HP. If you use a lot of the stuff, this is the way to go, and the cheapest you will find it at

column9: Full Disclosure: I'm a Raspberry Tea Addict
column10: I love these packets. They are delicious, economical, and perfect to store at my desk at work. I drink these starting in the morning all the way until I get home in the evening. They have helped me kick my soda habit and drink more non-carbonated beverages. It is surprising how quickly you can go through these packets, so don't be afraid of buying the four boxes worth. They were delivered very quickly and well-packaged so I could easily store them for future use. I was also thrilled to receive a product that will not expire for 2 years! These have a great shelf life and are a delicious way to drink more water.

This is a remarkably good sugar-free raspberry tea.  Often the taste is too sharp, and doesn't really taste like raspberry tea at all.  Not so with Diet Snapple.  It is a quick, convenient, and tasty.  Just what I was looking for.
[...]I followed the directions and the flavor is weak, because the powder clumps up and don't disolve.It is ok if you let it sit over night.

column9: GOOD SPICE, HOWEVER NAME IS GARLIC & PEPPER BUT HAS MORE SPICE'S IN IT!
column10: Hi, I love this spice, however it is called and sold as garlic pepper! The true mix of ingredients of this mix also includes 1)Sea Salt 2)red bell pepper 3)Green bell pepper 4) Garlic 5) Black pepper .... So it is not true to what they are selling it as!! However I love it!! I am very happy with it and will buy again! I just want you to know that there are some extra ingredients in it that some people would not want or would be happy with. My only negative is that the salt is pretty overpowering for the way I intended to use it! I like to put lots of garlic and pepper on my food but with the salt you can only put so much on before your dish is like swollowing mouthfuls of sea water!! (I am trying to post?) I have posted some pictures so you can see exactly what I am telling you. I think this was a very good deal for all that I got (12 pack ), but the mix is not just Garlic & Pepper and is cut with salt,green & red bell peppers!! I try and eat healthy and I love french fries!! I have come up with the next best thing... I microwave a potato then slice it like home fries then cover with very much katchup & my Garlic Pepper spice and I got A healthy snack without the deep fried fat and sat. fat!! See my pictures and I hope this helps somebody!!  I forgot to add that the grinder on each bottle works very well and is awesome to have it ground as you need it! I think it helps save much of the flavor sealed inside the garlic and pepper. I find the garlic has a better taste than that powdered garlic they sell everywhere. Also I think I only paid the $12.50ish and the shipping was either lower or free?? I do remembe thinking it came out to a little over a buck each when I bought this 12-pack. My total order was close to $60.00 so I might have gotten free shipping with that?? Either way it still is a fair deal for a good product. One last thing is a 12-pack seems like alot, however it goes fairly quick... not like pepper corns that seem to last forever... This spice mix comes out in nice sized chunks. I am on my 5th bottle and I am one person, who loves Garlic & Pepper!!
We like this product but didn't realize the first time we used it how salty it can make your food. Still adds lots of flavor.We use it sparingly.
This is the worst Mukwas I have ever tasted -- like pieces of raw twigs in among the small sugar balls.  Frankly, I threw it out.

It was a good deal: good price and the taste very good too! Their small size are very convinient to have on a trip, in your office or also for an unexpected gift to someone else. Actually, they were part of my birthday present to my husband who loves balsamic vinagar in his salad. Before, he used to carry a big bottle when he knew he was going to have a box salad for lunch bought at some grocery store.

I am always checking out different balsamics. I bought these, and they are pretty good. What I like, though, is when I'm talking with someone about how much I love balsamic, and they have not tried it, I give them one of these little bottles. Gotta spread the word!

Juicy Juice is always a hit in our family and with my students. Being 100% juice makes it a winner for school snacks and general meal accompaniment. This pack contained the 4 oz size, which is perfect for a quick refresher. Purchased through the Amazon Grocery Subscribe & Save feature, this product was perfectly affordable. When partnered with our Amazon Prime membership for free shipping, it cost less than our local grocer. Simply can't beat having a favorite treat delivered straight to your door for less! And what a fun afternoon...juice by mail! Thank you UPS and Amazon! Very pleased. Looking forward to our next shipment!

I bought these seeds to use them to sprout, but the seeds are either old or not raw. I tried at least 5 batches and could honestly count the number of seeds that sprouted on one hand- out of thousands. I am worried this may not be as effective for health if they are not raw/new, but I am not sure about that. I contacted the company and they were not understanding or accommodating. They gave me the line of "well, we don't know how you are trying to grow them, and we don't guarantee that the seeds will grow."

column9: Decent Coconut Milk at a More-Than-Decent Price
column10: Considering this is available at a subscription at a bit over $1 per can, it's a great bargain.  I've frequently used Thai Kitchen's Coconut Milk and this is comparable in quality, though this product requires a bit more shaking-of-the-can to mix the milk before use.  I don't mind that at all.Note that the picture displays "light" milk.  But the Product description simply says "Ty Ling Coconut Milk."  I received regular milk as opposed to light milk.

This item contains potassium metabisulfite as a preservative. No returns on this item. Sulfites give me a headache.I didn't see an ingredients list on this product. I should have researched it better, that's on me...lessoned learned. Didn't want some one else to make the same mistake. Having said that, it is a great buy if you have no issues with preservatives.

column9: Not the best quality but tolerable.
column10: I purchased this due the price point of the subscription service. I use coconut milk primarily for cooking curries. I found this one to be watery and not as good as others I've used (primary chaokoh). It was useable for cooking but I prefer a thicker, richer milk. I would not buy it again.

column9: Coconut milk ok for the price, probably won't reorder
column10: I buy a lot of coconut milk.  I use it like regular milk in coffee, baking, etc, so I am always looking for a good deal.  This is a very good price.  However, the coconut milk is a little grainy in texture and doesn't have the creamy mouth-feel that full fat coconut milk usually has.  It would be probably ok if used only in cooking.  It is very separated (part solid, part liquid) and it was difficult to blend it to a smooth consistency.  Overall - 3 stars - decent product for the price

column9: Hardly used but when I do it is good
column10: I do not use much but for the one recipe that I do have...I use it and it worked......these bulk orders are just sittingin my pantry waiting for the nex ttime the recipe comes around

column9: Not "Light" as pictured and very watery to be "milk"
column10: I thought I found a deal here for about $1.25/can.  But turned out, not all coconut milk are created equal. I should have read the reviews because the pictured said "Light" and the product sent is regular.  Tried one can anyway and didn't like it at all.  Not much of coconut milk taste and it is so runny for regular.  I like my chicken curry sauce to be thick without adding any water to it.  This product probably got like 10% coconut milk and 90% water so it doesn't make good saucy curry.  I think that's why the cheap price.

The image displayed by amazon shows a can of light coconut milk. I was pleasantly surprised when the coconut milk arrived and it was not light. One can of this goes a long way! Great bargain for coconut milk!

I have tried several coconut milk/cream products from Amazon (I follow the sales) and am very satisfied with this product.  The label says "Light", the box says "Regular", the fat content is approximately half way between the Roland "regular" and the Roland "light" (FYI, 13g per half cup).  And yes, it separates, all canned coconut milk does, but homogenizes at around 70F.I'm using it to make lovely dairy-free ice cream (see recipe in my Donvier Ice Cream Maker review).  Next project is to perfect my "whipped cream" recipe.
The coconut milk was NOT Light. I bought it because it was a case of light coconut milk but it is not.

I approach Triscuits with great caution because I find them irresistible; I can't eat just one, they are absolutely the best cracker on the market; we have to ration ourselves because of my healthy appetite for them.At holiday times or when company is coming over they are always on the menu and are a great favorite with almost any dip. They are delicious by themselves right out of the box or with almost anything you can imagine to add to them.I get a little amused when I read the nutrition label, a serving is 28 grams, I would like to think that's at least a dozen crackers; well I have to admit I've never, ever weighed  any crackers before eating them and I have no idea how many crackers goes into 28 grams.Putting that aside for the moment if one consumes 28 grams one gets 120 calories, 4.5 grams of fat, 180 mg of sodium, 3g of dietary fiber, and 3g of protein and unlimited great taste.I'll further acknowledge that the nutritional value is pretty incidental to the wonderful taste of Triscuits; I eat Triscuits because they taste really, really good!
"Raw" or heated, plain or laden with cheese, ham, turkey, singly or stacked  in twos or threes - this pure wholewheat manna is as the staff of life's supposed to be: delicious and healthy.  Period.

I love Triscuits!  One can eat them plain.  But, better, use them as the base of nice (and even fairly healthy) snacks.  One example: a little bit of sliced chicken on top of a Triscuit; then some Colby Jack cheese on top of the chicken.  Do 4-5 of these critters, stick them in the microwave on a microwaveable dish, and melt the cheese. Yummy.There are any number of variations on this.  Sometimes I'll add a little thinly sliced onion to the mix.Anyhow, Triscuits can be awfully versatile for snacking. And still reasonably healthy as these things go. . . .
I think I've become addicted to Triscuits.  Not a bad addiction though. With cheese or other toppings, or just alone, they're tasty and filling.

Most everyone has had a triscuit before. We like tem in our family because the ingredients are so minimal and basic.  Ordering them through Amazon was a good choice because I know the product and I know we will eat them. I did some price comparing with my local supermarket before making the purchase and it was worth a bit of savings on the family size boxes.

I have been a slim fast drinker for years. One taste of this shake and I'm hooked! I like to put it in the freezer for about 30 min. before drinking it so it is nice and COLD. I love chocolate so the milk chocolate flavor is my pick. It is a much smoother chocolate than the slim fast milk chocolate. I just wish it came in 6 or bonus 8 pack like the slim fast. So far I've only seen it in 4 pack. Because of this it is a bit more costly than slim fast. But again the taste is much better. I highly recommend it!!

column9: High in Sugar and Carbs / low in Protien
column10: While this protien shake is one of the better tasting I've had, it's not a real protien shake. This only has 10grams of protien compared to most shakes that have about 30g and up.The real "keep away" factor for me is that this shake has 29 g of carbs/ 18 g of this is SUGAR. If you're serious about weight loss, there are much better protien shakes on the market.Try EAS Whey Protien - It comes in a bag and each serving contains 170 calories/only 3 grams of carbs and 30g of protein. I haven't tried chocolate but vanilla is very tasty, especially with (skim)or almond milk.In response to a user comment, yes this product is marketed as an "appetite suppressor" rather than protein shake - however, if you're trying to lose weight - you will need to avoid sugary products, such as this. Spring for a protein shake with MORE protein and LESS sugar. The EAS Whey Protein will NOT taste as good - Special K drinks do taste much better - that is for sure (18 grams of sugar!). Sometimes as a 'treat' I will take 1 scoop EAS Whey Protein (chocolate) , 1 banana, 1 cup almond milk and 1 cup ice - blend well in a blender - and you have a DELICIOUS and HEALTHY protein shake.

I had tried drinking Slim Fast in the past as a replacement for breakfast, but the "tinny" taste made me gag. The Special K drinks taste just like having chocolate milk! As some of the other reviewers noted, they do taste much better ice cold than at room temp. I have also added some of the shake to my morning coffee as a replacement for creamer/sugar, and that was great too!My only complaint is that I don't feel very full after drinking them like I do with some of the other shakes I've tried. If I workout in the morning and then drink this for breakfast, I'm hungry again about an hour later. I think maybe they would be better as a mid-afternoon snack to fight off those 4:00 munchies instead of a meal replacement.

While other people have ponited out the heavy SUGAR content and average protein, i have been using the shakes for 2 weeks and lost 7 1/2 pounds. What i have done is had 3 shakes daily, 50 oz of water, 1 to 2 coffee's and dinner. Dinner is primarly a great protein (chicken, turkey, veal, sometimes steak or a burger while only having a small amount of carbs. i do not feel lacking (although the weekends are harder......)or hungry. All of this being said I have not made a true comparisant to other shakes. This one is working though. I figured that out myself and was hoping that there would be a better response.For someone that needs to loose 10 - 30 pounds this is a great option to get started.

Definitely drink it cold.  Amazon has the best prices around and with the Subscribe and Save, it couldn't be easier!

I really like this product. I have been trying to loose the "last ten pounds" for a few months now. The problem is I am hooked on chocolate.
