The bags are great, the metal key ring securely attaches the dispenser to my leash yet I can easily detach the key ring from my leash if I want to, and I have no problem getting the dispenser open. It's too bad the company doesn't use metal key rings instead of the cheap plastic rings and plastic zip ties-- if they did, I'd give this product a 5 instead of a 4.

Using these bags are so much easier than grabbing grocery bags all the time.  Just clip them on your leash and go, They are the perfect size and strength. Its also nice that you dont have to worry about forgetting anything.  Definately a good product.

I was skeptical and at first didn't like the bulkiness of the Bags-On-Board holder attached to my dog's leash.  But once I got used to having the holder and bags in it...it's great.  No more stuffing my pockets with large shopping bags, no more searching in garbage cans for discarded cups or bags to pick up dog poo with...I always have bags with me.  Only down side is being able to find affordable refills...which was no problem on Amazon!  I order the 120 bag refill for $6.30 (so far) and have plenty!The only down side to the style I have is that it is attached with an electrical zip tie and the end scratches my hand occasionally.  Bags-On-Board now offers a retractable leash with the bag holder built in...but I'm not sure of the quality of the leash or the sizes (animal weight) that it comes in.
clips to your leash and gives you a poop bag when needed.  Success.  Fits the common refill bags you can find at most major stores.

i put this on my dog's leash since many times i would forget the plastic bag until i was already outside.  it really comes in handy.  i especially like the fact that right before each perforation there is a white stripe so that you know where to tear.  it comes in handy at night.  they are also very dark, so you can't see the contents.

column9: Very sturdy, but hard to open
column10: A agree with the 1 star review posted in 2008 that this dispenser is difficult to open. I also do not like that the attachment device is a zip tie, which makes it harder to change leashes without modifications by purchaser.But of all the bag dispensers I've owned, this one has stood the test of time. After over a year it is showing no signs of wear or of breaking down.So, if you have strong hands and only ever use one leash.... this is a 5 star choice. But for me there is still room for improvement.

I used to salvage plastic bags from the grocery stores etc. to dispose of kitty litter waste but recently I have stopped using plastic bags and am using cloth bags for my shopping. I purchased these bags because they are the perfect size for multiple daily waste removal (the litter scoop fits right into the bag) and because they are environmentally friendly. I attached the little dispenser right onto the litter box (it comes with a plastic zip tie) and it is super convenient to have the perfect little sized bags ready to go. I have not had a problem with tearing or holes in the bags and they are easy to tie up after use. Will purchase plenty of refills!

We have always used "Bags on Board" for our pet clean up.  Unfortunately, this time, the container that hangs on the leash broke off and we had to purchase a new one.  I can't say how it happened because my husband was walking the dog.  However, I would not let that keep me from purchasing this product. It is lightweight, easily dispensed and, having them on the leash, makes it so simple to clean up after your dog.  Everyone should be required to carry something as a courtesy to walkers.  You can use other types of plastic bags from groceries or other purchases, but these are the most compact and easiest to carry around and use.
I really love this product.  Makes scooping poop really easy; always have what you need right there on the leash.  Been using it for years.

I bought a bag dispenser before which turned out to be a nuisance to use, and which only took refills from the company who made the dispenser.  Unacceptable.  B on B makes excellent bags and put them in an excellent dispenser.  I find the cap a little hard to get off (note: it pops off, but not easily), but I expect as it ages, that will loosen up a bit.  Perhaps the stiffness is intended to give it a longer useful life.BTW, I don't have a dog.  These are the bags I use for my daily scooping of my cat's litter box.

column9: WHAT MORE CAN YOU ASK FOR
column10: This product works perfect.  You can clip to you leash or easily fits in jacket pocket.  Easy to load and use, the cap stays on and doesn't fall off as others do.  There is nothing negative to say about with this product.  There are different styles made by same company, I have used this one here and it works great.  I am actually buying another one.

I have two of the fire hydrant versions of this product. As my dog's name is Gunny, I just couldn't resist getting this version. I received it promptly from Amazon, but when I stuck it on the leash, the "tie" wouldn't "lock" in place. So Amazon exchanged it for another one and the same thing is wrong. I have contacted [...] in order to avoid another exchange (guessing this is a batch problem.) They got back to me in less than 12 hours and are sending me a tie. Do order this, but wait until Amazon has sold their existing units off or sent them back. It is very cute, so between that and bagsonboard's great customer service, they do deserve a 5-star. I wish there was more quality control, but most products don't seem to have any these days...

Canine chic for the diva/don dog or the diva/don dog owner!  I bought this product for my mom who just loves and owns everything leopard print imaginable.  It was the perfect and practical accessory to her schnauzer's leopard collar and matching lead.  Who says you can't "poop & scoop" in style?

No more forgetting the poo bags and having to walk back home to get them! :)I really like these easy, convenient bags. Also, they are earth-friendly, the won't just sit in a landfill somewhere.Great choice for dog owners.
This is cutest thing and it's so convenient to clip onto my dog's leash when we walk. I love it.

If you don't have a lot of hand strength it's not the right container to get.  The lid is pretty much impossible to get off if the plastic is cold.  It gets very frustrating to have to wait for someone else to get the lid off for you.  The bags themselves are great though.  I think the bone shaped one might be easier to use and will probably give that one a shot.

This is a great item, simple yet so useful. No more stuffing bags in our pockets for walkies!I can see why one of the other reviewers didn't like the hard plastic tie that attaches the dispenser to the leash handle, but we just cut the excess off right down to the locking tab and it hasn't scratched our hands.Highly recommended.

column9: Always have my doggie bags with me when we walk!
column10: These are great and they fit right on my leash.  No matter where we go, I have a bag  handy.  I would highly recommend these!

This is very cocoa flavored but still tastes good. I prefer their regular choc chip, but that's a preference. These cookies are only 60 calories each, nice big size, sweet enough, and crunchy for sure. Be warned that the cookies break easily apparently and your box may contain crumbles and not a whole cookie. I bought mine in a retail chain store and had that issue so shipping may be the culprit. Ill buy on amazon in bulk because I enjoyed them a lot, but Ill have to tell the shipper to pack extra careful

I was disappointed in this purchase.  I initially thought, "oh a whole can of the peanuts like you find in the toffee popcorn/peanut mixes."  And they are somewhat like that.  The problem is there is a lot of the peanut "skin" in the can too, and you constantly have to pick it out of your handful.  One of my daughters is enjoying them but I don't like them at all.

I've been drinking 4-5 of these per week for years. The protein in these shakes is very high quality. It's a mix of 7 different components and the predominant one is whey. Perfect for drinking after a workout. Amazingly, they have no sugar and are pretty low in fat. You would never guess that from the taste.In comparison to the Chocolate, which doesn't taste that chocolaty, the Vanilla Ice Cream tastes just like it says. Creamy and it doesn't have that sweet aftertaste that sticks around like you get with shakes that have a lot of sugar.

I think hands down this is the best RTD on the market.  Have had no issues with "chunks" as on review states or with product separation.  Keeping it cold may help.  Also, if past expiration date for any reason, send it back.  Fast, convenient and tastes great.

I have to rely on protein shakes to meet my protein quota of 80 grams a day.  I tell you this product makes it very easy to meet my goals.  IT TASTES GREAT!  I love Lean Body's shakes and this is the best of them all.  I usually would not reach for Vanilla flavored anything...just chocolate.  I tried this one because it was all that was left in the gym and now I know I had been missing out.  This is the best protein shake and ...it is filling, full of nutrition, and has 40g of protein.  It is low in carbs also.  I was once an EAS Advantedge user.  This has double the protein and taste.  Warning: the air bubbles that may form while you are drinking can make you feel like something is in your drink but it is just an air bubble.  Also, it tastes good when is served cold.

After doing some research on the best RTD Protein Shakes, I've come to the conclusion that Labrada's Lean Body is the best tasting RTD out there.  I was a fan of Muscle Milk, but Labrada tastes better and gives you more protein in a similar drink size.  I also like that the drink doesn't sit in your stomach.  The only reason I don't give it 5 stars is because of the price.  But if you're looking for a quick protein drink on the go, look no further.

column9: A great shake and a great value
column10: Personal tastes vary, but this is one of my favorite ready-to-drink shakes. Lean Body shakes have the consistency of milk, are mixed well, and have only a minimal aftertaste. If you are a fan of really thick shakes, this probably won't appeal to you. If you are looking for a shake that provides a nice level of protein and vitamins for the price, this is a good choice. If you are looking for a post-workout shake, this is easily digested 15-25 minutes after a hard workout.
This is the best tasting low carb drink i have ever had.  Great texture, lots of protein.  Good price.  You will not be disapointed.

This is the best tasting Protein Shake I have ever tried, and it's pretty lean at only 6.5 Calories per gram of protein. I've had Chocolate Ice Cream, Vanilla Ice Cream, and Cookies and Cream; they are all good, but I like Vanilla the best. These shakes make dieting a lot more pleasant by reducing hunger and keeping your protein intake up, even while calories are reduced.

column9: tastes like melted vanilla ice cream
column10: absolutely the best tasting ready to drink protein drink i have found.  the negative review said that they received a bad (separated) product.  This has happened to me too.  After all, it is protein - and if it gets too hot - (like when the delivery people leave it in the hot Sacramento sun in the summer) - it will clot.  I just called the company and they shipped out a replacement order.....no problemOr, like the reviewer said.... just order the powdered version.

Another instance of LG providing a quality product.  Helped keep my strength up even after an involuntary layoff of almost 2 weeks.  A little pricey for the casual supp user, however, if your interest in supps is only casual you don't need this anyway.

If you're loooking for a ready-to-drink shake, try a different brand. Over the course of two months I ordered two 12-packs of the Labrada shake. Delivery was prompt, but in both cases the whey protein and other solids in every carton had separated from the liquid, congealing into a chunk that couldn't be remixed by shaking the container for as long as a minute (as the manufacturer recommends.) In one instance, getting the contents out required slicing open the carton. Once the contents had been put into a blender, the shakes were satisfactory --- creamy. delicious and filling. But not RTD. If you're going to end up using a blender or shake bottle anyway, buy Labrada meal supplements in powdered form to begin with. I've found them equally tasty (although made with sugar,) equally nutritious and you'll be getting what you expected.
The product is bright and cheerful pink and very sturdy.  The customer service was excellent.  I had some questions and they were responded to in a very timely manner with much respect.

have to disagree with the other reviewer. these sardines are large (usually 4 or 5 per can) and firm. they have a nice flavor without the overly "fishy" or "oily" textures of some of the other brands. within the varieties offered by Wild Planet, the plain XV olive oil ones are my favorite (the "with lemon" variety has a slice of lemon in the can that unfortunately, adds bitterness to the flavors without bringing a lot of "lemon" to the party - avoid).
Large firm sardines with skin largely intact.  Great flavor.  Caught off the US west coast.  BPA free cans.  I eat one of these cans as part of my lunch at least once a week.

too mild, bland and watery. i eat a can of sardines every day, so i buy them by the case right here on amazon.  my favorites so far are crown prince brisling sardines and cento skinless and boneless, both in olive oil or extra virgin olive oil.  However, i do try and will continue to try and compare.  "wild planet wild sardines" to me are just...okay.

Opened my first tin and heard myself say "Wow, those are beautiful" at the sardines within.What splendid coloring! Rich and inviting....Dug in to find 3 of the largest sardines I've had the pleasure to meet.As I pulled the first one out, again, heard myself say "wow, those ARE beautiful."These look, and taste, like solid healthy fishies..... I just drained the tin... even that seemed easier, and tastier, than I'm used to.I've had nothing but good experiences from "Wild Planet" -- so much so that I half-expected this to be a dud or, at best, average.But once again, I am so impressed with the products this company puts out.>>>UPDATE:  Ingredients say "Sardines, extra virgin olive oil, water, sea salt, aqueous natural smoke."

Pros: Got this for about $2 per can with Amazon's subscribe and save. Cheap considering it is packed in olive oil. Packed with 3 large sardines with skins and bones for extra nutrients.Cons: Where is the flavor? I have tasted various canned sardines. I can occasionally tell the differing flavor characteristics that each brand seems to have. Some taste very smokey. Others seem to take in the taste of the olive oil they are packed in. One brand I noticed had a lemony aftertaste. I actually prefer strong tasting fish but I can find that I appreciate each brand and really haven't found one I wouldn't buy again.  Until now. I wouldn't mark in in the dislike column. More towards the didn't really prefer. After a brief almost non-existent smoke taste, the fish itself is flavorless. It is also dry. The olive oil seemed to impart no flavor or moisture to this product. I had to pile on the hot sauce to get through the first two cans (I usually plop one can over rice as a quick snack). Plus this product was processed in Vietnam.Conclusion: I bought 12 cans. Definitely will shop for other brands due to the bland flavor of this product. But for the excellent price, I will still give it 3 stars. I wouldn't say I didn't like it. It is just canned sardines. Just pile on your choices of salt, spices, and sauces. Then chow away.

column9: smoky taste good, tin not full
column10: After reading the reviews I was interested to try these. I am enjoying my first tin at this moment. When I opened it, I said, that reviewer was right. They were very casual about filling the tin. Three not that large sardines floating in a LOT of oil, room for at least two more sardines. I dont think I will be buying these again unless it turns out this one can was a fluke and the others are more full. The smoky flavor is nice, but its not enough to make up for the insufficient quantity. My favorite brands are Season and Crown Prince. I would always get Crown Prince except they are like twice the price.

My husband was at first surprised by the larger size & lighter taste of Wild Planet sardines as opposed to King Oscar ones which he likes. By the time he finished the 6 cans, he asked me to order another pack. Delivery on both orders was prompt as always.I'm working on learning to like sardines, since they are so good for you.

column9: Tasty Sardines - Perfect for an Easy to Pack Weekday Lunch
column10: I've tried Wild Planet's Wild Sardines-water packed and this product, the Wild Sardines in extra virgin olive oil. By far the tastier, according to my taste buds, are the little guys packed in the EVOO. I agree with other reviewers that the fish are firm, large (average only 3 per tin) and not overly "fishy" tasting. My 14 and 15 year old teens, a boy and a girl, both enjoy these quite a bit, and have Mom and Dad's permission to eat a can whenever they want, as long as they eat the bones too! Neither objected to that.I would enjoy trying some packed with mustard or Italian herbs/seasonings - a little something to add some variety. I frequently grab a tin of these for a healthy, work-day lunch, and since we are buying through the subscription plan, the cost is almost half of that at the local natural/health food store.I too have enjoyed reading through the company's website and find them to be very transparent, including their response here on Amazon to "Shebear's" criticism of where the sardines were processed. I live in Michigan, where we can only eat our local fish once a month (many kinds anyway), so any fish I try to incorporate into my family's diet has to come from far away. In a product like this, I'm happy to pay a higher price for the increased carbon footprint and this relatively small, in the grand scheme of our lives, deviation to being devoted Locovors.

I will begin this with the statement that I have never been a fan of canned sardines. Recently, I read about their tremendous health benefits and have wanted to cut back on meat.  Fresh fish in the market is so expensive and has so much mercury in the wild versions and don't get me started on the farm raised varieties. Anyway, the smaller the fish, the lower the levels of mercury. I bought the Wild Planet brand and rinse them in cold water. I don't need all the oil and I think it gives them a much fresher taste. The slightly smokey flavour is delicious. I highly recommend them.I don't know where Shebear "Shebear" gets their information about the source of the sardines. The Wild Planet website specifically says that they are caught off the California coastline. I grew up in the Monterey Cannery Row area. The sardines were a thriving industry at one time but then they were gone. These are the return of the Pacific Coast sardines.Edit: found this FAQ on the wild Planet site. I am impressed with the transparency of this company. The sardines are truly caught in US Pacific waters, however, they are processed in Vietnam. Here is their statement:Why are Wild Planet tuna and sardines caught in the US but packed in Vietnam?Unfortunately, there is no US sardine or tuna cannery capable of processing our volume requirements and the last sardine factory in the United States closed in 2010. In addition, the US cost of production would greatly increase the retail price beyond the reach of most families. Our goal is to make US-sourced sustainable seafood choices mainstream and thus have a greater impact on fishery harvest practices for the long-term good of ocean conservation.We have elected to process our 5oz cans of albacore and skipjack tuna as well as our sardines in a highly respected partner facility in Vietnam. This facility offers state-of-the-art canning expertise in an immaculately clean, accredited environment that produces higher quality finished products than any cannery we have seen in the US.[...]Also, btw, their cans are BPA free, a big plus in my book.

Hi, I'm not by nature a sardine-lover, but for health reasons my husband & I started eating them regularly.These are not too salty and taste so fresh!  I really like them a lot.  The only down side is the cost, at over $2.00 a can they are (sadly)a little too pricey for us to eat every day.

We love these sardines.They are firm and whole, they don't fall to pieces when you pick them up. We tried some from Walmart and they were mushy so my kids would not eat them. We think they taste great and they are a convenient way to get some fish into our diet.

column9: The best sardines on the planet!
column10: Excellent company, nutritious and wholesome product, fast service.  These sardines are the best.  Good value for your $$$.  Add Wild Planet Wild Sardines in Extra Virgin Olive Oil to your subscription and save with a discount and free shipping.

column9: Taste great, but a product of Vietnam.
column10: Best tasting non-artisanal (mass-produced & moderately priced) canned sardines I've had.But seeing that they are packed in Vietnam gives me a bit of pause... as quality control in third-world countries often is a crap-shoot.

column9: Taste Terrible, Caught in Cali but Processed in Vietnam?
column10: If you hate sardines and fish and you like albacore tuna white meat you might like this.First off these have no fishy sardine taste.These are not cracker sea salt and "extra"olive oil quality sardines by a long shot.I'll have to hide these in my salads. I bought 2 packs of 6 I bought extra lettuce to down these. Yuck!I love sardines! Canned fresh, with or without heads and guts, with skin andbones in water and or oil... always have always will.I don't like mustard or marinara because it hides the taste of the sardines!!I can even tolerate them raw... "cooked" in vinegar. But usually too dry cooked in vinegarBut if this were my first and only try at a sardine, I would pass!These sardines are DRY< DRY <DRY< DRY< DRY ! Olive oil does not mask the dryness!It tastes as if all they natural oil was sucked out of it and they tried to hide it with theleast flavorful olive oil they could find. OO loses it's flavor with heat so this is almost forgiving.But these are Tough! I'm used to sardines flesh kinda fatty and giving away, at the touch of the forknot the kind you have to stab hard to break apart.Also, not prominently mentioned is that they are smoked. This could be why they are so dry,but while not my favorite I've had smoked sardines that are not this dry.Also I don't like the caught off the coast of California as an ad technique then on the packageit is shown as processed in Vietnam. Could be why they don't taste at all fresh. Probablyfreeze dried to make the voyage.I was looking forward to having sardines without the BPA. I'd rather BPA thanthese nasty, dry, tough things they are passing off as sardines!

column9: Not canned in the US but very high quality.
column10: I was looking for US produced sardines and this is as close as I can find. It is a shame that Bumblebee killed off all the US canneries. At least they are caught in US waters. They are delicious and I have ordered more and would give them 5 stars if they were canned in the US.

VERY  WATERY &  NOTICIBLE  ARTIFICIAL  FLAVOR ;  I  DIDNT  LIKE &  WONT BUY  AGAIN , SEEMS  TO BE  VERY "SUBSTANDARD" ;  I  HAVE BOUGHT &  EATEN  MANY  SARDINES IN OVER 30 YRS & these are the "LEAST QUALITY" by FAR ; JUST BECAUSE IT SAYS:  "ORGANIC/SUSTAINABLE/ETC>"  DOSENT SEEM TO REALLY MATTER (JUST SOME SUBJECTIVE SPIN) SO WILL APPEAL TO SOMEONE/GROUP .
I have been around the world and tried many dark chocolates and in my opinion Santander dark chocolate 70% cacao is the best hands down. I highly recommend this Colombian wonder!!!!!!

Our 10 year old pointer / husky cross has been a picky eater the last few years.  I was told this was a great one try to get away from the basic chicken formulas.  Our dog absolutely  loves it !  In less than 2 weeks we have seen a noticeable difference her in coat as well.  It's shiny and feels really soft.  Really pleased with this.  Worth the price !  We were also told to occasionally switch formulas  of meat so that they don't get tired of their food.  Example :  chicken to duck  to fish.  Great idea !
Used this product for a summer party.  It was great!  It didn't clump, and was easy to keep heated.  Good tasting too.

These are fabulous. Too bad they don't come with tape to secure them directly to my hips :)They arrived quickly and in perfect condition.The other reviewer must be referring to a time when this product was accidentally placed in the pet category. These things happen and I would imagine it should be obvious that they're not pet treats

column9: no extra charge for the crumbs?
column10: I love Keebler cookies and these chocolate-mint covered grahams are a long time favorite so I thought getting 6 packages at once would be a no-brainer. Unfortunately, the box must have gotten some hard knocks in transit because each and every package arrived with about a quarter of the cookies magically transformed to cookie-dust!!!As much as I love the brand and this flavor, I doubt I'll re-order them. From here on I'll probably just rely on getting one package at a time from the market...

column9: Closest thing to 70s Girl Scout Fudge Patties I've found yet--Keebler Fudge Filled Cookies
column10: For anyone who remembers those fudgy little cookies and has been missing them, this is a good news/bad news story.  The bad news--the crisp cookie part of this treat is a chocolate one, unlike the plain vanilla of Fudge Patties past.  The good news--you probably won't notice the difference.For the uninitiated:  this is a lighter, more crisp version of a vanilla wafer (though chocolate), slightly hollowed out to accommodate a dollop of creamy fudge.  The whole thing is then covered in more chocolate.This is no gourmet cookie; but for chocolate lovers who've never forgotten the joy of biting into that thick, creamy fudge layer before  finding the crunchy cookie inside, it's not bad.Serving suggestion:  Best eaten at warm-ish room temp, when the outer blanket of chocolate is just soft enough to be a bit tacky but not messy, allowing your teeth to sink into the inner fudgy layer...with a glass of milk nearby.

The last time my boyfriend was in town, we say these at walmart and bought 4 boxes since the markets in his area do not stock these. They didn't last long at all once he got them home! I ordered these for the same price per box that we got them at wallyworld and had them shipped to his house. He forgot that the package was for him, and once he opened it he was delighted to find a weeks worth of these yummy cookies! Normally he would be stocking up on the girl scout thin mints this time of year, but he is delighted to find that keebler has a similar product for so much cheaper and available all year. He is now joking that the serving size is a box instead of a sleeve!Apparently these taste amazing with peanut butter.

In the past, Keebler was the maker of "Thin Mints" for the Girl Scouts of America.After Keebler lost the license to make GSCs, they bought Little Brownie Bakers, one of the 2 remaining licensees.So, rest asured, these are a great way to get your fix between fundraisers.Remember, broken cookies and crumbs have no calories, so it's OKay to subscribe-n-save a 6-pack of these every month, right?*Edited 2011-03-01 to correct Keebler licensee status based on comments*
The sugar content is more than I thought it would be, wow, are these sweet. I love sugar, but not that much, in my desserts.
I love this tea. Its flavor is awakening your senses. It deserves A+!!! The price is the only inconvenience, if it would be a bit lower I would buy more often.

column9: Reformulated version much worse than before
column10: When this product became a "Helper Complete Meal" instead of just a regular "Complete Meal", they reformulated the topping, which used to be a breadcrumb-based parmesan-cheese blend. The new topping is literally just parmesan cheese, and not a lot of it, and the product is notably worse off for it.Overall, the flavor is very mild, not "Alfredo" at all, but it is still reasonably tasty and the chicken tastes pretty good. The overall flavor is a generic creamy chicken dish with some hints of cheese. It is, however, a delusion to suggest it feeds 4 - the amount of chicken is enough for 2 (or maybe 2 adults + 1 child).What is there is indeed easy to make, and tastes pretty good for a thing out of a box. If you're just running out of steam but still want something with some 'comfort food' vibe, then this is OK. However, if you're looking for a high-quality meal, look elsewhere. The mexican-style version of this with the rice is much better tastewise, for the same price.

After trying one of the supposed Chicken Fettuccine Alfredo I can say that this is NOT Chicken Fettuccine Alfredo. I would classify it more as a creamy chicken and egg noodles. That being said I made this in my microwave and it wasn't bad. The chicken, what of it there was, actually tasted like chicken. One package makes enough to feed 2-3, but if you are like me and have to feed five you'll need to use more than one box, which it does have instructions for on the box. One box would make a decent side, however, Lipton makes a similar product that costs less if that was your intent. Also it is not complete either and you will need to be sure to have milk to add to it.

So this does not beat my love for macadamia nut matcha and I probably even like the almond matcha more HOWEVER this is a very good matcha!Its funny because pistachios are my favorite nut although macadamia does run a close second the things are just too darn expensive! Not that pistachios are cheap or anything but for the price - heck I will just buy matcha instead!This pistachio matcha really does smell like pistachio.There is a slight very slight chemical like smell but it does not come out in the blend when you make your matcha regardless of if you use just water or make a latte with it.I really do like this matcha and the base comes through very nicely and with pistachio for some reason seems to make even more sense because pistachios have green on them. Yeah I know its a mental thing and I am after all somewhat mental however this may also be quite nice in a white base as well!Try as many of these Red Leaf Matcha as you can you won't be unhappy with your matcha flavors!

This is a delicious matcha with pistachio flavoring that is authentic and lovely. When I first smelled the prepared bowl of matcha, I was surprised and confused that it smelled kind of spicy, like nutmeg and cloves. It wasn't unpleasant, just totally unexpected. The smell carries over to just the beginning part of the taste, where it initially seems a bit spicy but then morphs into a nutty, rich pistachio flavor. The matcha underneath definitely takes on an earthy flavor, and I can't help but wonder if the spiciness isn't at least in part from the matcha that the pistachio flavoring is just bringing to the foreground. Overall the nutty flavors really work well with matcha and make for a great energizing drink!

column9: Deliciously nutty, naturally sweet and smokey!
column10: The matcha straight out of the bag smells very strongly like sweet pistachio, reminding me of pistachio halva. Very intoxicating smell!The matcha frothed up well during whisking and is a lovely green colour, matching a perfect colour to pistachios too!As a traditional cup of hot matcha, great strong earthy green tea base holding hands next to the  pistachio flavor. The matcha isn't astringent. Slight bitterness, but it fits the bill almost with a smokeyness of the pistachio. There is a sweet nutty taste at the end of my sip. The best part of this cup is that sweet nutty taste, very well done! I'm thinking I could drink this one as a traditional cup all the time.As a iced latte (prepared with matcha, ice, soy milk and a bit of sweetner), this pretty much tastes like pistachio ice cream! Creamy, sweet, and nutty with strong green tea base. This one came out sweeter than normal because of the sweetness of the flavoring. With that said, if adding sweetener, be gentle.So my tea peeps, totally give this one a shot. I guess it sounds kinda weird since I think others might associate pistachios as just a salty snack, but this one is sweet, nutty and tasty!

I was a little surprised by how big these are...they are not the standard size for sugar cones and can fit a large amount of ice cream.  (That can be a good or a bad thing depending on your goal.)  They are packaged very safely but once they are out of the pack they crumble very easily and I've had disappointed kids on a few occasions.  Still, my kids love them and I would buy them again.

The cones met our expectations.The company needs better packing material because several of the cones are damaged and unusable.We have found the cones to the best as far as waffle cones go and will continue ordering them even if some of them are broken.

When I recieved  my case of Keebler Waffle Cones the box  was crunched up in a few areas.  Mostly at the corners.  I opened the box and some of the cone boxes were also crushed a little.  You could shake the boxes and tell they were broken.  I opened each box and out of the 6 boxes 90& of the cones were broken.  I called Amazon and they were sincerely apologetic and sent me another case.  Unfortunately the same thing happened.  I didn't bother calling this time.  I was afraid they would think I was scamming them.  I think between the 2 cases(12 boxes) I got 5 boxes of cones if you took all the damaged ones out.  When I say damaged I don't mean cones with just a little bit broken.  I  mean totally unable to use at all.

These taste pretty good and are made by a great company in the ol' USA.  However, you have to put the waffle bowl inside of a regular bowl because they are very fragile.  I was expecting these to be nice and thick waffle bowls like you get at an ice cream shoppe.  As long as you don't plan on using these bowls as a stand alone bowl you should be pleased.
These chips are really good.  Will definitely take the place of regular potato chips without feeling like you gave anything up.  I purchased them locally for $2.50 though so this price is high.
Friends often comment about how good the coffee is. I try a number of coffees from Amazon. This one is a keeer.

column9: I like this brand of coffee
column10: I've never been disappointed with the Cafe Excellence brand of coffee.  The Serendipity blend has that good coffee aroma with a taste to match.  I've given it a 4 star rating instead of a 5 because it doesn't live up to the other blends of Cafe Excellence that I have tried.  It is still better than most other coffees.

I guess the people at amazon who decided this Nielsen Massey Orange FlowerWater is a good substitute for Monteux can't taste, smell or feel. First, it tastesmore like oranges than orange blossoms. And there's a hint of a gasoline-likeflavor in there, too. Second, it doesn't smell like orange blossoms. It smells kindof like aged oranges - with a hint of that gasoline again. And it isn't a water. It'sactually oily on the fingertips and you need to wash your hands after touching it.Monteux Orange Blossom Water was truly a water. Besides a flavoring, youcould use it cosmetically. It had the slight perfume taste and smell of orangeblossoms. And no fumes. I have no idea what to buy now that Monteux is sohard to get but I do know that Nielsen Massey isn't it.

Nielsen-Massey's Orange Blossom Water is dreadful -- primarily because it isn't orange blossom water at all. It's a mixture of chemicals with orange oil added. I bought it and will not use it in my cooking -- I'm afraid it'll ruin what I'm making. If you've used Monteaux in the past, be warned THIS IS NOT MONTEAUX!!

I didn't purchase this product because of the reviews.  So I went searching and found it at:  olivenation.com.  You do have to enter "Orange Water" in the search box to find it.  I'll order from them and hope theirs is better than this one.

I haven't used this product, but people seem to be slightly in the dark about how to acquire orange flower water without difficulty or great expense, so here it is.  Think outside the box and go to an Indian or Pakistan grocer.  They'll have super-cheap, big bottles of decent rose and orange flower water for a few bucks.  This is really not the kind of thing you have to throw money at unless you're in a small or non-diverse area.

It smells like diesel fuel and has absolutely no orange blossom/flower fragrance.It lists orange oil and other natural flavors in the ingredients. There should be noorange oil in true orange blossom water. I'm surprised that a brand like Nielsen-Masseywould sell an inferior product like this. I couldn't even use this in cosmetic preparations.

I had a bottle of this sitting on my counter for a while. Tropical flavors are so hit and miss. So when I ran out of my favorite Flavrz (Cherry Berry) I pulled this one out.  I was so pleasantly surprised that it had a coconut flavor to it. SOLD. I went through the entire bottle in less than a few days. I really recommend the packets more than the bottle. They seem to last longer for me. :)

I discovered Flavrz while looking for a way to flavor water so I wouldn't drink so much soda. I found that almost every flavor packet had artificial sweeteners in them. Flavrz was the only one I found without artificial sweetners. The taste is excellent. Super happy with the product. Just wish my local supermarket would keep it stocked.

I found this beverage to be refreshing,light and low calorie.  A wonderful addition to water if you are trying to increase your intake. A great change from the store bought hydration drinks that contain questionablFlavrz Organic Drink Mix Concentrate- Cherry BerryFlavrz Organic Drink Mix Concentrate- Tropicale ingredients and manmade sweetners.

column9: Both kids and adults love Flavorz!
column10: Length:: 2:46 MinsThis is a really delicious, healthy way to drink water.  All you do is add a little bit of the concentrate to your glass of water and you have a tasty, low calorie, low cost,low carb, good for you drink.  Now I can get my kids to drink water and I love it too.  I love all 3 of the flavors- cherry berry Flavrz Organic Drink Mix Concentrate- Cherry Berry, tropical Flavrz Organic Drink Mix Concentrate- Tropicaland lemon lime Flavrz Organic Drink Mix Concentrate- Lemon Limei.  Try them all!  You're going to love it!

column9: Get them free in your SP Pack
column10: Yep I used to get them for free. All you had to do was go out into the field in Viet Nam (67-68). And they would send a box of goodies "Sundries Pack (SP)" that would have Chuckles on the top layer. You guessed it when the box was opened it looked like a shark feeding frenzy. I guess I never got over it and to this day have to have a Chuckles fix periodically.The sugar coating keeps them from being sticky. The artificial flavors are seductive. The black ones taste like licorice.
I love chuckles but they are very expensive at the local candy store, so I was gratefull to be able to see them on line and purchase them at a decent price.  Thanks

column9: Super easy product to grow, loved by my cats!!
column10: My cats love this product!  They eat the grass every day.  My male cat, Chester, will chew ANY plant so I must be very careful about what I bring into the house...so I have orchids only for display, which are safe for kitties.But for the kitties fun, snack and pleasure, I grow Cat Grass Plus.  I usually have 2 packages "ready to eat" at all times, and 2 packages growing.Try it!! Fun and easy. And MUCH less expensive online.

So, my "Cat Grass Plus Catnip Seeds" arrived today, looks exactly like the one pictured.Here's my problem:Seller- "Product contains Aged Pine Bark Peat Moss Perlite Vermiculite Hardwood Charcoal Plantagel and Nepeta Cataria (Catnip Seeds)."Package- "Ingredients: Wheat or oat seed, vermiculite and Plantagel (potassium propenoate and propenamide copolymers). Plantagel is a non-toxic water absorption agent."Seems like I'm missing something here...Well, I'm going to keep it because my cats have had this kind of thing from the pet store before but, I really wanted catnip.
Made aware of GREEN Darjeeling by a present; looking for a replacement, found this online; Unbelievably inexpensive; Chanced it. Winner! Very satisfactory everyday green tea.

column9: CHANGE THE PICTURE - THESE ARE WHITE, NOT BROWN CUBES
column10: Unfortunately, I didn't see the other reviews warning that the image falsely advertises brown cubes and am now stuck with 4 boxes of white cubes that I do not want. Not happy. Amazon, or whoever is the supplier, needs to change the photo so that it correctly displays the white cubes.  I feel like the victim of a bait and switch scheme!

Hands down the best cubes to use for absinthe and I mean superior to the slightly refined white cubes. There's just something fittingly Belle Epoque about the raw brown cane sugar cubes. At first I thought the price was a little high but since it's four boxes it works out to be a little cheaper than buying them in the store. I think it rather comes down to how often you foresee yourself using sugar cubes. I'd absolutely recommend the cubes in terms of quality, not sure one needs four boxes of the things however. See what you think.As with any brown sugar, these cubes offer the subtle flavours derives from the presence of molasses that aren't found in white, refined, sugar. Since I use these primarily for absinthe, that adds something nice to the resulting drink.So the cubes are highly recommended, the price is probably dependant on buying them in four packs, but it'd be nice if they were available individually from this seller.

I ordered this item as a gift for me dear friend. But unfortunately, Amazon has put the WRONG PICTURE on this item. I ordered this thinking that I would receive brown sugar, as pictured, but instead was very angry and disappointed to find a BLUE box of WHITE sugar. Not brown. And since this is a grocery item, I'm not even allowed to return the product that I never wanted to begin with. This is very unsatisfying, coming from Amazon itself. Very unprofessional. And this is after I went out of my way to promote Amazon to everyone I knew, raving about how fantastic it was, just to be met with a large amount of disappointment. VERY ANGRY.

column9: This is WHITE sugar, wrong product picture
column10: The product itself is good. La Perruche Pure Cane sugar, both white and brown, are very good.However, the picture on this item is wrong. The white sugar boxes are BLUE boxes with WHITE sugar pictures on the box.As of this writing (and when I bought this), the picture on this item is WRONG. It has the brown sugar box picture on (with orange box with brown sugar pictures).When I looked for "La Perruche Brown Sugar", this item came up on a list of 10x items, and I bought this thinking this was the brown sugar due to the picture.Well, white sugar came and I checked my order, and of course, I bought the "La Perruche Pure Cane Rough Cut White Sugar Cubes" with the brown sugar picture on it...I also couldn't return it, since it was a grocery item. That being said, the white sugar is good too, I just prefer the brown one and was expecting brown sugars.So please Amazon, change the picture to the correct one to avoid confusion!

column9: I can't believe this is healthy food!
column10: I'm so addicted to these fruit bars! I do not have the best diet, and I really don't like eating fresh fruit. That's It bars have changed all that for me. Now I can get 2 servings of fruit and feel like I'm eating candy. There's no added sugar - it really is just fruit! I also recommend it to my vegan friends. :)

Ok Seriously These Bars are SO GOOD! I have only tried the apple and apricot one so far. But WOW, what's the catch? I mean, it's just fruit! The texture is better then I thought it would be and just tastes perfect! I now have a new love! THese are so easy to grab and eat anywhere, have in your purse, car, desk, and are great for my kids too! Hope they like them! Larabar's are great and have nuts for the added protein but the fruit taste in That's it bars are so much better!!!! Love these!!!

I purchase the variety pack after reviewing the ingredients.  It really is just fruit.I only eat organic, and this was a great mid day snack for me at work.  I am recommending them to everyone.  The delivery couldn't have been quicker an easier!

My kids are addicted to candy (like most other children) and tend to shy away from fresh fruit when I try to put fruit in their lunch boxes but they ABSOLUTELY LOVE these apple and cherry natural fruit bars. To them, they tastes like candy, but I know how guilt free these fruit bars are, which makes me a happy mom. My kids have at least one a day which satisfies their required daily allotment for fruit and saves me time in washing, peeling, and cutting fruit. These bars are a terrific fresh fruit substitute for our crazy busy lifestyle!

Love these fruit bars.  Can't compare to the other ones.  Other bars are "heavy" tasting and always leave an after-taste.  The "That's it" bars have a lovely and subtle real taste of the fruit and no after-taste. Wonderful to read the ingredients and only have 2 ...  both natural.
Great way to keep fruit in your diet. If you follow Weight Watcher this is a good snack for you. Three point and you get more fruit in your diet.

column9: Very good, but also a little small
column10: I really enjoy these fruit bars and love that they have such simple ingredients.  I've been looking for healthy snack options and these definitely fit that bill!  The Apple + Cherry is my absolute favorite of the pack.  I will say they are a little on the small side, but I suppose that is what allows them to be only 100 calories each.  I will definitely continue buying them.

I was lucky enough to meet one of the owners of the company when I going for a walk around Bellevue. He gave me a couple of sample bars, and I enjoyed them so much, I went to Whole Foods and bought out the entire stock. Now I am ordering them from Amazon. This is  perfect when you want to snack on something healthy.In fact if you have kids and have trouble getting them to eat fruit, try this, just don't tell them it is healthy. This is better than any candy bar.

These bars are a simple and quick way to get some fruit into your daily diet. The ingredients consist of 1 Apple and 3 Apricots, and "That's It." The bars are small and will definitely not work as a meal supplement, but are great for an add-on to lunch or breakfast, or a small snack between meals. The only downside to the bars (and it is very minor unless you are picky) is that they are dark brown in color, but I would expect that when you mash fruits together and turn it into a bar.Overall, these bars taste great, and I would definitely recommend them to others.Other great flavors include:That's It. Apple + Pear, 12 Pack Natural Fruit BarsThat's It. Apple + Cherry, 12 Pack Natural Fruit Bars

These bars are a simple and quick way to get some fruit into your daily diet. The ingredients consist of 1 Apple and 1 Pear, and "That's It." The bars are small and will definitely not work as a meal supplement, but are great for an add-on to lunch or breakfast, or a small snack between meals. The only downside to the bars (and it is very minor unless you are picky) is that they are dark brown in color, but I would expect that when you mash fruits together and turn it into a bar.Overall, these bars taste great, and I would definitely recommend them to others.Other great flavors include:That's It. Apple + Cherry, 12 Pack Natural Fruit BarsThat's It. Apple + Apricot, 12 Pack Natural Fruit Bars

These bars are a simple and quick way to get some fruit into your daily diet. The ingredients consist of 1 apple and 10 cherries, and "That's It." The bars are small and will definitely not work as a meal supplement, but are great for an add-on to lunch or breakfast, or a small snack between meals. The only downside to the bars (and it is very minor unless you are picky) is that they are dark brown in color, but I would expect that when you mash fruits together and turn it into a bar.Overall, these bars taste great, and I would definitely recommend them to others.Other great flavors include:That's It. Apple + Pear, 12 Pack Natural Fruit BarsThat's It. Apple + Apricot, 12 Pack Natural Fruit Bars
These are tasty little treats but relatively small for the price.  Low calorie count by having no nuts.  Hope it comes back with free shipping.

I've been on the hunt for the best tasting, healthiest snack/energy bars I could find and these guys have topped my list. I love the ingredient list- it's short and simple. I don't need a laundry list of unpronounceable ingredients, I just want a simple afternoon snack to get me through to dinner. Apple and Pear is my favorite so I've been stocking up with the 12 pack. The portion size is perfect for me as a daily snack and provides a couple servings of fruit. The consistency is a little gummy which can cause bits to stick in your teeth but I'm still happy with the bars overall and I'm glad they aren't too dry actually. I've used energy bars as breakfast replacement when I'm traveling light and I don't think these have quite the calories for that use but they are perfect as a snack.
Had these today at the local farmer's market. I bought a box on the spot. They are so tasty. If you have a sweet-tooth but are health conscious, this is perfect for you.
Finding these delicious little packages of fruit was a score!Perfect on-the-go snack.Apple Apricot is my favorite flavor.

I'm constantly on the look out for great tasting snacks to stash in my car that are portable and healthy. I'm a big fruit eater, but when I'm on the road for work, it's hard to keep fresh fruit on hand, so these apple and pear fruit bars are the perfect solution. They're closest thing to fresh fruit, and they taste super fresh and pure. I love the fact that they only have two ingredients: apples and pears. No added sugar or anything else for that matter. Pretty genius idea!

I just learned about these new fruit bars and I must say, they taste amazing! Not to mention the fact that I love all-natural products that are corn syrup-free and have no additives or emulsifiers. This is the perfect afternoon snack to have after lunch and before dinner when I need a little boost of energy. Also, I really like the tangy flavor of the apple + apricot bar. Great product!

I don't have time for fruit! Saw these in my building lobby shop in Century City...gave them a try and came back the same afternoon to buy a few of all 3 flavors.  Easy/healthy way for me to get my fruit without having to peel anything! The cherry version is amazing and so is the pear!!

We received a bar in a snack pack on a transcontinental flight with our 16 month old son.  While we thought the rest of the pack wasn't appropriate for his age, this seemed okay since, as the name implies, is just fruit. He ate the bar in less than 2 minutes!  He loved it.  Granted, our little guy is a fruit and veggie nut so this is not a problem for us, but the convenience of a bar when we are out and about is very appealing.  So we kept the wrapper and are going to purchase a box from Amazon.  Great product even for a toddler.

Fresh and tasty corn.  I just got back into making popcorn old fashioned style (on the stove) and what a difference.  The microwave popcorn that everyone is eating is like super salty cardboard compared to stove-top popcorn.Do yourself a favor - try this stuff (they have smaller sizes).  I promise, you won't go back to microwave.

I think this popcorn tastes great, especially when made in my stovetop popcorn popper. I love that this comes in 3 different varieties, for 3 different tastes. I would recommend this popcorn brand to everyone! The shipping was reasonable and arrived quickly.

column9: Dr. Pepper flavor works well in a BBQ sauce!
column10: As a long-time fan of Dr. Pepper I thought I'd give this sauce a try. I wasn't expecting it to taste very much like Dr. Pepper and figured it'd just be a pretty standard barbecue. Not only does it have the distinct Dr. Pepper flavoring, it works very well on everything I've tried it with - chicken, burgers, and in baked beans. Even some people that aren't Dr. Pepper soda fans liked it. If you're a fan of barbecue sauce and a fan of Dr. Pepper you're almost guaranteed to like it!

I bought this for my boyfriend because it combines his two favorite things in the world: Dr. Pepper and barbecue sauce. He loves this sauce and uses it for almost everything. We used it to make a Dr. Pepper barbecue chicken pizza...he was a very pleased with it.Now, my opinion...I like Dr. Pepper, don't love it. This sauce just doesn't mix well with my taste buds and leaves an odd after taste for me.I'd say if you are a Dr. Pepper fanatic who loves to cook then you'd probably enjoy this.

column9: If you like a sweet Kansas City sauce, this is it!
column10: We're partial to thick, sweet sauces for our BBQ so if you are also -- you might like this.  My husband said he can taste the Dr. Pepper, but honestly, I do not (and neither do our kids.)  No real heat, barely a hint of heat anyway.  I made pulled chicken, and pulled pork with this.  I added a bottle to the pork during cooking and it held up really well in the Croc Pot.  And the meat really took on the flavor, so while it's thick you can still get the flavor into the meat during preparation.Not trying to take anything away from Amazon, but you can buy a single bottle to try at your local store.  And buy in bulk from Amazon because was much 25% cheaper.
This is a great product for the fans of the soda.  Almost smells like Dr. Pepper and has a great taste.  Great for Dr. Pepper and BBQ enthusiasts.

column9: Not what I was hoping for....
column10: Sadly this BBQ sauce does not meet up to expectations at all.  You will easily be better off taking regular BBQ sauce and mixing in a can of Dr. Pepper as this sauce has a very faint Dr. Pepper taste.

column9: Not the same as cooking with Dr. P
column10: Does not have the same flavor as when you cook things with Dr. Pepper. It actually is just cheap BBQ Sauce with Dr. Pepper on the label.  By some good sauce and mix in your own DP it is much better that way (don't forget to reduce the dp)

As a fan of Dr. Pepper, I couldn't wait to try this BBQ sauce.  Unfortunately, I did get a lot of the Dr. Pepper flavor.  I used it on pork chops, and while it was a sweet sauce, I really missed the Dr. Pepper flavor it promised.  Not a bad sauce, just not a lot of Dr. Pepper!
This bbq sauce is absolutely delicious.  I have shared this with my friends, and now they are buying it.

I got this on a lark since my nephew is a huge BBQ sauce fan, and has never tried this particular brand. I can take or leave Dr. Pepper soda. It's not bad, but I don't exactly seek it out. So I was not expecting that I'd really care much for this sauce.It's actually quite good! It excels as a dipping sauce, especially for chicken. Not bad on pulled pork either. I also tried it as a cooking sauce and was less impressed - not bad, but it really is best as a dipping sauce. As expected, it's pretty sweet, but has enough tang so you get a variety of flavors.While I still prefer my own homemade BBQ sauce, for a bottled version this is pretty good.
I like this sauce on grilled beef and once again it has disappeared from stores.

I won a bottle of this originally from buying a bunch of 2 liter Dr. Pepper bottles. I never heard of it and assumed it would taste horrible, but after it came I was pleasantly surprised to find it was up there with Chik-Fil-A BBQ Sauce. It's sweet and not overbearingly spicy like most store bought BBQ sauces are. Great as a dipping sauce for chicken nuggets/tenders and good on ribs too. If only Chik-Fil-A would bottle their sauce, but this is a great alternative.

I bought this as a Christmas gift for my husband. We are big Dr.Pepper fans, & I frequently use Dr. Pepper soda in my cooking.  When I saw the BBQ sauce, I thought perfect, I'll have it on hand & won't have to make it myself.  This is a MAJOR disappointment.  It's not sweet, it's more acid than I like, it doesn't taste at all like Dr. Pepper, there are no indications in the ingredients list that it is remotely related to Dr.Pepper, about the only thing I can say good about this stuff - it does bring some heat.  Save your money.  This is not what you're looking for!

When I saw this I though "I HAVE TO try this." To be honest, it was a waste. It was very watery and definitely NOT "kickin'." I really couldn't taste ANY Dr. Pepper in this product. If I had to do it all over again I would have ignored the novelty of the product and looked for a quality BBQ sauce. This is what I recommend you do. Try Tony Roma's BBQ sauce. Comes in a lot of great flavors and it is nice and thick.

column9: These are really tasty jelly sticks
column10: My boyfriend purchased a two-pound bag of these at BJ's and they are very, very good.  Do note, however, that the orange slices pictured on the front of the bag implies that these are oranges covered in chocolate which they are not. The packaging is misleading yet very smart marketing for those who don't read the label. My boyfriend thought he was buying chocolate covered oranges.This is actually an orange flavored jelly stick covered in dark chocolate that is made with real orange juice.  It does, however, taste like chocolate covered oranges but without the texture associated with eating oranges. Four pieces are 140 calories with 30 fat calories and 21 grams of sugar. For those with peanut allergies, these are processed in a peanut free plant as per the description on the back of the bag.This is definitely candy and definitely tasty to both me and my boyfriend.

column9: Perfect little touch of chocolate with orange
column10: These little pieces of candy are amazing.  The chocolate coating is just enough to quench your chocolate craving and when you bite into the jelly center which is orange flavored, you go WOW!  Texture is great.  Doesn't melt in your hand.  They travel well, and here's a suggestion for you.  Freeze them.  They take on a whole new texture when you bite into them cold.  Highly recommend them as a little snack that feels like an indulgence.

most people i know have a favorite piece in bridge mix--the smooth, dark chocolate ovals with the jellied orange inside.  i tasted these sunkist sticks at costco and they're almost as good.  the chocolate outer covering isn't quite as smooth.  however, i've since been frustrated and have been unable to find them in any food store-not jewel, costco, dominicks, treasure island.

We have a favorite cookie in this house (from England) called Jaffa Cakes. It is a soft cookie with orange jelly in the middle and a dark chocolate topping. The best part of it is the jelly and chocolate.So when we came across these, we were in heaven. The best of Jaffa Cakes and available locally!The middle is an orange flavored jelly and the outside is a dark chocolate coating. They are not super sweet but that's what makes them tasty. They are semi-tart orange with the deep flavor of the chocolate. A perfect combination.The chocolate can look cloudy or scuffed when taken out of the bag but I believe it's because they get tossed around inside. If you want a perfect chocolate finish, you have to buy them individually packed.I picked up a 2 lb bag at BJs for $10.

column9: Orange sticks are yummy,  chocolate- dark but stale tasting!
column10: HI THERE! WE ARE GREAT FANS OF THE SUNKIST DARK CHOCOLATE ORANGE STICKS, HOWEVER, IN THIS BAG THE DARK CHOCOLATE COATING IS DRY, DULL AND BITTER! DARK CHOCOLATE IS USUALLY SMOOTH AND GOOD, NOT DRY AND BITTER...INFO ON THE BAG:  #120322FS1D BEST BEFORE SEP 22 2013. BOUGHT @ COSTCO SKU654798, 7/14/2012 $7.79

I bought these expecting them to be like others I've had in the past. But what a sickening surprise! The chocolate coating is fine but the orange center is so tangy as to be almost lacking in sweetness entirely. My tongue could not take it! I contacted Jelly Belly only to be told I would have to send back the entire bag for a substitute product, as if, and at my own expense. Such a lack of customer service I've never encountered. I had to throw the whole bag out and vow to not deal with them again. Consider this a forewarning to be taken seriously.

column9: Just what I was looking for...
column10: Whenever I get to the grocery, I have trouble remembering which noodles are the good ones for Vietnamese Spring Rolls.  This is a good product--perfect for my needs.  Plus they come packaged in small amounts so you can use what you need and keep the rest fresh.  Nice product.

column9: Great if you're on a low-protein diet!
column10: If you have kidney problems and want to restrict your protein intake and yet get ample calories, this is a great product. It was one of the first products I found that met my needs...I cook them up and mix them into all sorts of vegetables and frequently serve on top of a warm tortilla, like a pizza!  Yummy with seasonings like garlic, onions, peppers and sesame or olive oil.  A lifesaver!

column9: FABULOUS as a meal or snack

column9: Goodbye Rawhides! Hello Peace of Mind - & Dogs Love 'em!
column10: Love these! Well, because...we have 3 dogs (2 were unplanned children ;-) & our 60-LB German Shepherd AND our 40-LB we-have-no-clue-what-she-is dog have both choked on various shapes & sizes of rawhides. The Shepherd choked so badly that, this time, it wouldn't come up. She couldn't cough & started to literally choke to death. I actually straddled her back, attempting the only thing I  knew how to do - the human Heimlich Maneuver! Like where exactly is a dog's sternum, anyway? Well, I tried anyway and thank God it finally did dislodge & we got it out! Was it the Heimlich? I don't know. Probably not. I mean, she still won't tell me... After all, I guess it was very traumatic for her.But in all seriousness, what I do know, is that was the last time any of my dogs have had any kind of regular rawhide bones!
