He was VERY sick the 3rd time, so we definitely stopped that! The ONLY kind I did finally take a chance with were granulated rawhide munchy sticks, & they're all fine w/these; though I'm still nervous about them choking on a piece, but neither of them have had any problems with Boodas so far, & they don't swell up in their throats like regular rawhides.So, now... It's Booda Bones!Yes, they are a bit on the pricey side, especially for my 2 larger aggressive chewers. I agree with some other reviewers that they are not very long-lasting. But it's all I'll give them now. But, for my half Chihuahua/half something else(20lbs), I give him the smallest ones and they are like mega-saurus bones for him(it is my hope that the manufacturer will start selling these in bulk packages, for less $). I get 3 different sizes for my 3 different whatever-they-are-dogs. They absolutely love them! This includes the assorted flavors, the bacon-flavored, and the yogurt-flavored. Whichever is cheaper at the time and shipped by Amazon.And I owe a big thank you to Brian Amazon, all of you for all of your reviews, Booda Bones, and Amazon!** Confession: This was originally a comment I posted to a reviewer by the name of "Brian Amazon" a long time ago. I have been buying Bones from Amazon, and, only Booda Bones, ever since. They are so great that I've been wanting to write a review, & now finally have the chance to (I have, however, resorted to copying and pasting much of my original [brief... LOL] comment, with some editing).
My dog loves Booda Bones.  They are a bit pricy so I only give him a couple a week as a special treat.  I'll continue buying them from Amazon for the best price.

We have a dog with a liver shunt - so she can't have a lot of protein / can't digest protein.  Booda Bones are the BEST treat for her (and our other dog loves them as well!).  The only 'downside' whatsoever is that they're a tad expensive - but they're worth it!

column9: More of a treat then something to keep your dog busy.
column10: Let me start by saying our dogs love these. As soon as they see the bag they stop whatever they're doing and run to their crates (where we typically give these to them). However, for our dogs these are definitely more of a treat then an activity. I have one dog who is an aggressive chewer who finishes these in under five minutes. He doesn't chew them as much as bite of chunks of it. My other dog isn't quite as strong of a chewer but it usually takes her just around fifteen minutes to eat the whole thing (this review is specific to the Biggest Boodas). So for my dogs this is less of a chewing experience and more of a treat. And when the eat them this quickly, they do get expensive quick.

My dog loves the chicken, steak, and peanut butter booda bones, but he's not as fond of the spearmint/peppermint variety.  My dog will eat it if offered, but my dad's dog who I often sit for will not even touch these.  I wouldn't recommend for a dog who prefers meat.

column9: My dogs have rated Booda Bones 5 Stars!
column10: I have three King Charles Cavalier Spaniels and they are picky, picky eaters even when it comes to Treats.  They love the peanut flavored Booda Bones and have one every day.  They insisted I write this review on Amazon so their opinions could be known.  They're pushy that way...

I was very disappointed by the product.  They are NOT long lasting as I was lead to believe.  I was going to buy Chewlotta's which take my dog about 2 hrs to go through 1, but I thought it was too pricey at $3 a pop.  My dog could eat this whole bag in less than 2 hours.  He does enjoy them though.

column9: Dog really likes, but they go fast.
column10: I have an 11 pound Couton De Tulear.  Small sharp teeth.Dog loves them.These don't last long.  From a value standpoint, I prefer "Checkups," when Costco has them in stock.

column9: love that these are yogurt flavor!  my dog loves booda bones!
column10: I have no problem w/my dog eating these.  He loves these booda bones. I had never seen the yogurt ones; he loves them.
Our dog, a Siberian Husky, just loves Booda Bones.We give her one for lunch most everyday and shepesters us till we give it to her.

Our Boston Terrier loves these bones - we give them to her as a treat or to keep her busy when we have company.  For a 16 lbs. dog she's a mighty chewer and these last her a couple of hours, with breaks to investigate if she's missing anything!  We'll buy more of these!

column9: My dog goes crazy for these!
column10: My chihuahua loves these, especially the peanut butter, chicken, and bacon varities. They have become increasingly hard to find at pet stores so I was happy to find them on amazon. I like that they are safer than rawhide bones and easy to digest and she really seems to enjoy them more than other bones I've bought for her. I tried a few other brands when I stopped being able to find the booda bones at pet stores and she would not even eat some of them. You can't go wrong with these, they are reasonibly priced, safe, help reduce tartar, and dogs seem to love them.
My 3 year old miniature schnauzer loves these bones. I'm really glad that they started making them wheat-free because he has food allergies.
My dogs beg for these treats every night after dinner.  I always make sure I have plenty of supply at hand.
My dog is addicted to these and they're actually fully digestible and don't hurt anything. I've purchased them from everywhere on the planet and will buy from here from now on!

column9: My dogs do not like the flavor
column10: Regular flavor Budda Bones are great for my dogs but they apparently do not care for the minty flavor on these.
The dog really loved these bones and it seemed to freshen her breath.  It was a good treat for a dog with tummy troubles.
My dog really enjoys the Booda bones.  I was very pleased with the price I received and also the fact that they arrived  earlier than expected.
OUR BEAGLE JUST  LOVES THIS PRODUCTSHE TAKES ONE WITH HER WHEREVER SHE GOESESPECIALLY LIKES O CHEW WHILE IN THE CAR
We have three darling Shitzus.  All of them adore Booda Bones and look forward to this wonderful treat.  Thank you Amazon!!

I have a dog who until we adopted her never had oral care,so her teeth were in bad shape. We brush her teeth every 3 weeks and give her 1 booda bone weekly . Not only are her teeth cleaner but some of the staining has gone away. Our vet told us that these are the best thing for her because they digest easily and do not contain plastics.
These are great, but my dog likes to augment them with other types of bones
These took FOREVER to ship and when they did arrive they were not as durable as advertized.  Was looking for a bone to keep our dogs busy, these were more like a snack.

column9: NOT the regular size gumballs that you see in the store
column10: Bought these thinking they were the 'regular-size' gumballs sold in the store, variety tubes, as pictured, but was delivered tiny 'penny' gumballs in tubes, and they are ALL pink.The regular size gumballs sell between 80 cents and a dollar a piece, so this seemed like a good deal, getting 36 tubes for $16.The tubes that I received are all marked "25 CENTS" right on top, but as you will notice in the picture on the listing, the tubes are all turned around so that you can't SEE this.(However, the photo DOES feature the variety of colors/flavors).Do the math, 25 cents a tube, 36 tubes, $9.00.  I just paid $15.90 for $9 (RETAIL) worth of gum.Deceptive listing.  Feeling ripped off.OH, and to top it all off....they're STALE.

column9: Highest quality organic soy milk + shelf stable + delicious!!
column10: EdenSoy is a brand that I have come to trust. We try to only eat organic and natural healthy foods, and all of the EdenSoy products are pantry staples in our home. They adhere to the highest standards for both product and manufacturing processes, far exceeding the requirements for organic certification. This is the most delicious soy milk we have tried, and I like that it is enriched with vitamins. Our daughter loves the vanilla. I like all of the flavors. I use it to mix up my protein vitamin shakes - YUM! Another great idea: add frozen banana slices and ice to the soy milk, blend, and you have a terrific healthy breakfast smoothie that the kids (and you) will love! Great to have milk in a shelf-stable package -- just chill when you choose, or pour over ice when you want to enjoy a healthy delicious drink. I used to order cases directly from EdenSoy (at high shipping cost due to weight!) Now I am SO happy that Amazon is carrying this soymilk (and other EdenSoy products) with free super-saver shipping!!

column9: There are two types of Edensoy Vanilla Soy Milk.
column10: Edensoy Vanilla soy milk comes in fortified with vitamins, and regular without additional vitamins.  I love the regular unfortified vanilla soy milk.  It is especially delicious with cereal.  There may be some confusion about this product because it comes in two different versions.  The fortified version, which has vitamins and minerals added to it, I found to be terrible tasting because I could actually taste the vitamins and minerals.  (I take a vitamin pill every day, but I do not want that vitamin taste in my soy milk.)

I have tried many different soymilks.  Some are OK and some are terrible.  The bad ones taste like latex paint, or worse yet, sweetened latex paint.  But this one, especially when cold, is, in my opinion, excellent.  I find it exceptionally refreshing.  I prefer the 8.45-ounce boxes, because the flavor is not as good after the box has been open for a while and the product has been exposed to oxygen.

i'm not one of those people that love stuff knowing it's good for you. it has to taste fairly ok at least, but when this soymilk is cold(it has to be cold for me to like it) it hits the spot-especially if you're hungry and you need a quick fix. i tried other brands of soymilk and hated them all, but this vanilla flavor has a nice hint of nuttyness. it tastes smooth and fresh(some other brands had this "old" flavor) and really soothes an empty belly. i've reordered this product a couple of times from amazon and i'll continue to do so-it's more expensive in the grocery....it's been several months now of reordering and it's still wonderful, unfortunately, i only now realize that it does contain wheat and my family and i are allergic.i wasn't careful to look at the ingredients and i've finally traced the bloating etc. to the wheat in the soy milk. sooooooo sad, because it is the only soy milk that i like :^(

I'm new to drinking soy milk.  I first tried Silk vanillaand really enjoyed it. I think I can easily swich from fat free milk to drinking soymilk. Next I decided to try another brand, EdenSoy, which I ended up spilling in the sink (on purpose.) This milk is too disqusting for me to drink.  The color is not even white, it's grayish which is not appetizing. The taste is not to my liking so I won't purchase this brand again.  But I'll keep drinking other brands of soymilk.

Very delicious, refreshing (when very cold)and very good for you!  EdenSoy appears to have very high production standards.  I try to limit my sugar consumption.  This soymilk is slightly sweetened without using refined sugar.

column9: Buyer Beware!  Read ingredient list contains Gluten
column10: Beware!  I methodically check ingredient lists for everything purchased in the store for hidden gluten.  I went to buy my regular Soy-On-the-Go boxes but Amazom is out of them so I quickly changed and ordered this one.  Imagine my dismay when receiving the $30 pack of milk boxes and finding they contain both Wheat and Barley!  Yes, they are listed (I went and checked today after receiving the shipment) but ... who on earth would think soy milk would have gluten?!  Now I have 27 milk boxes that my casein and gluten intolerant daughter can't drink.

column9: Awarded the Kitty Mafia Seal of Approval
column10: Our three cats--the Kitty Mafia--are notoriously fussy eaters. Although they will eat dry food, it can't be just any dry food. We were especially pleased when all three of them were willing to eat Kit N Kaboodle. We favor Purina products, and this one has two things going for it: the cats will eat it, and the price is right. (Our dogs also give it a paws up--the little sneaks!)

It's her favorite dry food and her day is not complete without a heaping cup in her dish.  This is a new packaging approach for us and I think I'm going to like it because it came in bulk at a very reasonable price and should stay fresh in the unopened boxes longer than the larger bags do.  It's also much easier for her assistant to pick up the smaller sizes than the usual heavier bags!  ;>)
When I bought this, I believed it was the exact same product I was getting from my grocery store, but instead, it is a poor substitute that is thickened with guar gum.  Bleah.

I was worried after reading other reviews about receiving dented cans.  I decided to take my chances for $1.77/can vs paying $2.50-$3 per can at my local grocery stores.  I just received my shipment and inspected all the cans. Everything is perfect!  No dents and far away expiration dates.  This is the exact stuff that's available in the stores now.  We go thru this like crazy and so glad I'm able to get it at a great discount.
These cans keep arriving dented even though the boxes they come in are fine.  I believe we are intentionally being sold dented cans without any type of disclosure.

My one star rating above is not for the coconut milk itself but for the way the product arrived. I use this coconut milk all the time and was excited to see the price that Amazon was offering it at, but like one other reviewer reported all six of the cans came with dents...and not just tiny ones. The box they came in was in perfect condition so I can only come to a similar conclusion that Amazon is trying to offload the undesirable cans without disclosing their compromised condition. Pretty lame and shady if you ask me. My first thought was to return them, but apparently grocery items are not eligible for return.

I love coconut milk, but many brands contain sulphites, which set off my asthma, and other brands are gritty-textured or thin.This brand is thick, creamy, and natural.  It works well for making ice cream; it's great in my coffee, and it works well in place of evaporated milk in baking recipes.  I use it in pumpkin pie for an excellent dairy-free version.

I ordered this product last week, got it right on time, BUT, it wasn't what I was expecting. I have ordered what I thought was the same product before, the label has changed but I didn't think too much of that. The issues I have with this product are - it has water as an added ingredient, I know the light coconut milk has water added but I have never purchased full fat coconut milk with water added, it has no "solids" in the can, the full fat milk I have purchased before (I thought this was the exact same thing) had a good chunk of solids at the top, this is straight liquid and to top it off the cans are a mess! I ordered 12 cans total and I think at least 9 are dented, one significantly. Just very unhappy, if I had wanted light coconut milk I would have ordered it.

I was concerned about ordering based on several reviews mentioning dented cans. I'm happy to report that my cans were not dented and they came in a plastic bag. I was able to inspect them before removing the packaging.I have used this brand of coconut milk for a couple of years. It makes fantastic vegan ice cream when using the cream that rises to the top. :-)

EVERY can is severely damaged and dented.  The box that they came is is perfect, which means they were dented before they left the warehouse.  The cans of coconut milk I received are NOT the same as what is pictured in this ad!  Incorrect product that is severely damaged!

Was so excited to find this on Amazon at such a great price - and in a 6-pack, too! Due to lactose intolerance AND a love for Thai curries, we go through a lot of this stuff. We make our own coconut milk icecream using the KitchenAid ice cream maker attachment, and this brand of coconut milk works better than all others, IMO. The organic option is a plus for us, too.

I buy this same Karaj Hungarian Pork Loin regularly at our local Hungarian grocer, and have found it delicious. It serves well as a quick snack, or as a sandwich fixing (with a little mustard or light BBQ sauce).Imagine the aroma of a nearby campfire, after pork has lingered on the grill, but not burnt. Somehow, that flavor, through careful smoking and salting, is infused into the Karaj Hungarian Pork Loin.I prefer it in thin slices, eaten cool, but it is also an ingredient in various Hungarian soups. It goes well in a kind of pigs-in-a-blanket crescent roll wrap. Take an uncooked crescent roll, place a thin slice of the karaj, and bake as usual. Very fun for parties -- something different in the midst of something familiar. We serve it guests when we need a quick, tasty snack.It isn't spicy even though it is packed with taste. Fans of BBQ joints and smokehouse steakhouses with find the flavor familiar.It keeps around six months unopened. I fully recommend the Karaj Hungarian Pork Loin.Anthony Trendleditor, HungarianBookstore.com
several of the cans were crushed and open.  The were larvae crawling around, so I decided to throw out the entire shipment.  Disgusting.

column9: the best thing i've done for my dog
column10: my dog is in his second remission from lymphoma and the doctor suggested a grain-free cooked diet. he is 3 years out from his initial diagnosis and people can't believe his age (10) or that he's ever been sick!  the product arrives consistently well-packed and the quality of the food itself is consistent. i'll admit that my dog has a healthier diet than i do!

The items (cans) were all badly dented and banged up, although I did not find any that were actually open. The dog food itself was good but I don't trust that they can get the product to me safely so I will not be ordering any more of it.

column9: Too rich for my lab puppy
column10: My dog loved the taste of this dog food but it didn't agree with his system. He is a 7 month old lab puppy. The amount of food recommended was too much food for the dog. I think the stuff is too expensive also.

Nature's Instinct is a great product.  My toy pekenese, Lacey has been on it for about a year.  Besides being  nutritious, and healthy for her, she loves it.The product does not smell like your typical dog food.The vet says she is very healthy and at a healthy weight 10.2 pounds. I will always buy this product.We have mainly tried the chicken and beef, but are going to try the other flavors.
My dogs love the food. Good value for no grain dog food. Also, I feel this product helps to maintain a healthy weight for my dogs.
This ginger really adds to our pies and pastries. It is not readily available in the local super markets. The shipment was quick and the price  was good.  Try it you'' like it.

column9: Taste Ok. The Name is misleading.
column10: These pasta shells of of good, not great quality.  As long as price remains reasonable, they are worth the money.Main problem is the Label and Amazon (who relied on the copy from the Manufacturer), says "LARGE SHELLS".These can only be called "SMALL".So if you need large, for whatever reason, do NOT buy these.  Get "Primo Pasta" brand Large Shells.  They are LARGE and superb (but more expensive).

column9: Yummy Earth makes another great product
column10: Our children have many sensitivities, so this is a great option for no food coloring, no preservatives, great tasting...what can I say?  Our children like it!

I can't say the coffee tastes BAD as far as coffees go, plain coffees. But I ordered Irish Creme flavor, and Irish Creme it Ain't. Not at ALL. You really have to search for even a hint of ANY flavoring, and even then you catch maybe a hint of creamy something, and an even tinier suggestion of rum or something. But no Irish Creme. Not at all.Very disappointing since it's nearly impossible to find Irish Creme in any local stores, and that is why I resorted to ordering it from here and from what seemed to be a respectable brand in the first place. Only I didn't find it here either as it turns out. Blah.I guess the search goes on. Only now I have to figure out what to do with the other three bags...

With so many different PEZ dispensers out there, how can I say that you ask?  There are a couple of reasons.First, most PEZ dispensers are simply that: PEZ dispensers.  They perform no other function (unless you count "catching dust").  This one is also a pullback car, which crosses the floor at a pretty good clip.Second, I'm old enough to remember when PEZ dispensers actually shot the candy into your mouth.  Trial lawyers ended that fun; modern PEZ dispensers are designed to merely push a piece of candy out far enough so that you can grab it with your fingers.  However, these PEZ dispensers use an entirely different mechanism, and at least in some of them, when you push down the button at the front, you can bounce candy off the ceiling!Note: Should you be so lucky as to acquire one of these accidental throwbacks, please be content to catch the candy in your mouth ON THE REBOUND off the ceiling, and for God's sake don't tell a trial lawyer!There are seven other models that I know of, differing only in plastic color, paint, and decals:PEZ Candy Dispenser NASCAR Race Car Blue #24 Jeff GordonPEZ Candy Dispenser NASCAR Race Car Red #9 Kasey KahnePEZ Candy Dispenser NASCAR Race Car Blue #2 Rusty WallacePEZ Candy Dispenser NASCAR Race Car Yellow #17 Matt KensethPEZ Candy Dispenser NASCAR Race Car Light Blue #43 Richard PettyPEZ Candy Dispenser NASCAR Race Car Green #18 Bobby LabontePEZ Candy Dispenser NASCAR Race Car Black Daytona 500 50th Anniv.Comes with three rolls of PEZ candy.Note: A randomly selected three out of these four: #2, #9, #20, and #24, is also available here: PEZ NASCAR Pull and Go Cars O.87-Ounce Assorted Cars & Candy Dispenser (Pack of 3).

column9: speaking on behaive of my dogs..
column10: Usually we feed our dogs dry food. Canned food is a treat, to spoil them once in a while. Needless to say the dogs love it! Natural balance fish/sweet potato is my trusted brand. We have switched to it 2-3 years ago, after it has fixed my dog's skin problems.

Two of my dogs have sensitive stomachs and they not only gobbled this down, but kept it down.  I mix it with Hill's Science diet kibble to give them some variety.  The down side is it does have a strong smell, but so does natural fish.  I wish it weren't as expensive, but it does beat having to clean up from a sensitive doggy tummy.

column9: Fish Potato dog food Minimal Ingredient
column10: Dogs love it.  Minimal ingredients especially for dogs with allergies.  One of our dogs has allergies - we still aren't sure to what, but the itching has improved with this food.

column9: healthy ingredients but, my dog wouldn't eat it
column10: My dachshund has itchy skin so the vet/dermatologist put him on a special diet to see if it was the foods which caused the problem but, he just wouldn't eat it.

column9: Listed for dogs loved by cats
column10: I know this product is listed for dogs but my cats love it.  They are not beggars but when we have smoked salmon out they go nuts and this is the next best thing.  Even my shy boy who does not usually take treats goes for it.  I am not a pet food expert but this looks like it is  basically just dried salmon and has to be good for them. Great product, reasonable quantity for the price. One warning - it does smell like salmon and is a bit chewy.  My cats are large and like chewing on it.  Little cats might find it tough.  I will definitely re-order

If you love your dog, and want them to have a nutritious treat that is good for them, these are fantastic!  They are also human-grade.  There isn't a lot to the bag, but my dog is only 10 pounds and luckily they last longer.  But take my word she would eat the whole bag at once if given the chance.  You can't go wrong with these.

As a dog trainer, animal lover and dog mom, I'm very careful about what I feed my dogs. I have them on a homemade diet (if you've seen all the recalls on pet food, you'll understand why) and will only allow them to have commercial treats that are made of high quality products and unquestionable ingredients.I love Salmon Paws because their ingredients are simple and made with human grade food. It says so right on their website. So, it's a treat that I can give them with a sound, peaceful mind. My dogs love Salmon Paws too. If I'm ever having a hard time getting them to eat, I just tear up some salmon pieces and put it in their food. I rotate between the filets and the Salmon Meal Topper Dog Treat--. Within a few seconds, it's gone and they have full, happy bellies.I also use this product to train my dogs. They're easy to rip up and fast to chew. My dogs will do anything for Salmon Paws!

column9: What won't she do for these treats?
column10: My puppy loves Salmon Paws! I was given a free sample by the local pet food store and my puppy loved it! Yes it's more expensive than other treats out there and you don't get a lot, but it's quality - 100% salmon with no fillers. It's recommended that you refrigerate these treats because it's natural and it is fish. My dog is finicky with her food and treats and has rejected so many different treats that the pet stores in the area (with a no-questions asked return policy) let me open bags to let her try in the store just so I can save a trip coming back to return them (she's that bad!). So when I saw her get excited from just having a little bit of Salmon Paws, I just had to get it for her because it's so difficult finding stuff she likes.

column9: You have got to try these!
column10: Hula Hoops were the first "junk food" we ate. They are addictive. Similar to Pringles, these have more flavor and crispness. We have been back in America for 11 years and I still order them regularly.
This bar has a pleasing taste - to me. Hunger goes away after I eat just one. So,  they're good for an on-the-go quick snack - only 200 calories per bar.
These Macrobars are one of the very few snacks that are organic and made from carob.  The bars are enjoyable and taste very good.  I recommend them without hesitation and would purchase them again.

These bars have great texture and great ingredients, but they made one mistake--they used coconut oil.  That's the dominant taste--coconut.  Not Carob or Almond.  If they used an oil that doesn't have a strong taste, they'd be great.  Disappointing.

I bought these based on the recommendation from my nutritionist and I have to say - they are just okay.  I was looking for an organic bar, higher in protein and very little sugar - I am now eating a different one.
We order this product quite regularly, it taste good and I guess it is also healthy.  I didn't give it five stars only because when I eat it, my toes don't curl up.
These are very good. They are not dry at all. Good for when you want something sweet. One of my favorites!

Carob is one of the best of the natural sweeteners. The other ingredients in this product did not sit well with my stomach though. Every person will handle it differently. I'm not sure what they are saying "tastes-like-chocolate". The carob I'm sure does taste like chocolate. But, the bar itself does not. The bar tastes a little more like rice than anything else to me.

I love the Alo line of fruit juices, but this stuff is just nasty.  It tastes like the borscht my mom used to make me eat when I was a kid.  I thought I'd be getting something similar to a V8 Splash, but that's just not the case.  The cooked cabbage flavor just overwhelms the beverage, and I couldn't even finish half the bottle.I have to strain the Alo pulp with any of the Alo juices I drink because having floaties in my beverages triggers a gag reflex for me.  But in this case, the gag reflex was triggered even with the Alo pulp strained.I'll be ordering more Alo juices in the future, but definitely not this one.

This juice tastes great and would be a wonderful way to get some healthful Aloe. Unfortunately, there is way too much pulp for my preferences. I feel as if I am eating rather than drinking this product.

I've been cooking with this salt for over a year now.  Flavor holds up, it's from a great region in Sicily, I was so happy to find it online.  The bag it comes in is a little delicate, though. So be careful with sharp objects or just store it in another container.  Ciao!
Good moderately flavored salt for a bargain price. Our favorite use is in pasta and potato water, but is also great for bbq rub.
well, I thought I was ordering a book about Sicilian salt but SURPRISE-it was a bag of sea salt from Sicily.

Upon recieving order, Boston Baked Beans were immediately thrown in the trash. It may be a personal preferrence but, they were hard as a rock and not soft at all where the coating is concerned.They were removed from my list. I ordered a good supply but, was really disapointed. Not so much in the seller but, in the product.

column9: Great to have in any kitchen
column10: It's a staple in many Asian recipes but here's a tip... add a teaspoon to any instant noodle and it will bring the broth to life! It was a stalwart companion during my years of living in the dorm room.
Kadoya Sesame Oil is delicious, with a deep, dark, full sesame taste. Unlike many sesame oils which are watered down, this one is the real thing. Great for all Asian-style cooking.

I use this sesame oil in some of my stir-fry, and it's fantastic. Just a few drops of this goes a long way in enhancing the aroma of the food. Too much can be overwhelming, coating all of the food with a strong sesame taste. Definitely recommended if you like stir-frying!

column9: Taste is what it's all about!
column10: I had this sesame oil by accident, as it were, in that I was in an out-of-town store & it was one of the only ones available, so I got it.  I've been using it on my fresh salads with wine vinegar & love it. I tried using other brands after this first experience & was so disappointed, I frantically searched for Kadoya & bought several bottles.  Love it! Taste is so rich & full. In my opinion, the way sesame oil should taste, if it's good stuff.

This oil is fantastic for many great tasting recipes and for Asian cooking in general. Also this oil seems to withstand high heat without burning. In my house we use it all the time for many different dishes. Sesame oil contains vitamin E which is an anti-oxidant. This means it helps lower your cholesterol.I like to cut up broccoli, peppers (green and red), brussel sprouts and a chicken breast. Then I add soy sauce, hot sauce, ginger & garlic paste, water and of course sesame oil. You only need a little sesame oil. Less is better here because if you put too much the sesame oil will overpower the other flavors. A teaspoon or a little less is just right. This makes a quick tasty meal when mixed and stirred in a hot pan on high heat. It only takes about 10 minutes and serves at least 2 people. Very simple and quick meal that tastes great with sesame oil.I'm sure there are loads of tasty sesame oil recipes. All you have to do is search the internet and you'll be busy for hours if you like to cook. The main thing is to use it sparingly. This oil is dark, rich and very tasty.

I used to have to buy Kadoya Pure Sesame Oil directly from the manufacturer - a case at a time. I'm so happy Amazon stocks it! Give it a try - the flavor is so delicious, you'll get hooked on it, just as I am. Makes everything taste better - try frying eggs in a bit of it! Yum! :-)
This sesame oil is rich and aromatic, definitely top quality. I like to add it to noodles and Asian style vegetable salad with honey-roasted peanuts. mmmmm tasty~
This is the best Sesame Oil I have ever used. Has a very rich and full flavor. Highly recommend this product. Excellent service, shipping fast and product well packaged. Will definitely order again.
This is a good grocery for us.If you cook something,you can use it.It is smells so good.You should buy it.
Product worth the money! It makes asian food easy to make.My kitchen smells days after cooking and I get no cpmplains from picky children :)

column9: Too expensive compared to La Tourangelle brand that is also produced in Japan
column10: This is darker and richer than La Tourangelle but I grew tired of always running out and feeling terribly extravagent restocking it. It finally annoyed me too much that this bottle is difficult to clean for recycling.  The plastic cap cannot be removed from the glass bottle!
Ads a very pleasant taste to my stir fry experience. As tasty in my home cooking , comparable to that in a chinese restaurant. A product that I will always keep on hand for my cooking pleasure.
This is a great gluten-free treat! The taste and texture is just what it should be for a ginger cookie. We enjoyed them very much. Too bad they are so expensive.
These cookies have a delightful  flavor. The texture is fabulous, with little bits of spicy ginger to sink my teeth into!

I am now a Lucy's cookies addict, as are my family, my co-workers and my friends.  I had to subscribe because I have to give so many away!  All Lucy cookies are delicious, but the ginger snaps are sublime!

These are hands down the best cookies I have ever eaten! That includes regular cookies before I was diagosed gluton intolerant. They are crisp and crunchy and then you get this little zing of chewy crystalized ginger. I really have to exercise self control and ration myself or I could eat the whole box. Love,love,love them!! I order them by the case of 4 boxes from Amazon and they are almost a dollar cheaper than the grocery store. With Prime free shipping you can't beat the deal.

These ginger snaps are gingery, tasty, crisp gems.  I am so glad to have found such a delicious replacement for the wheat-laden variety.  Now my only problem is getting the family (who don't have to eat gluten free) to leave me at least one!
These gingersnap cookies are positively addictive.  You can't go wrong with Lucy's - All their flavors are great, but these are a stand-out among the selections.

This is the best tea I've ever tasted. It is mild--only slightly lemony, a little ginger taste. I drink it every day, all day long. After a year of drinking it, I'm still not tired of it, and I have tried to add other types, but they have all been rejected and given away. I guess I'm stuck on it. And since it's decaf, it's okay to drink a lot, so how can I go wrong? Especially when it contains all those wonderful antioxidants? I really like Numi's Gunpowder Green Tea, as well, but don't drink as much of it because of the caffeine.

column9: Best Decaf Green Tea I have Ever Had
column10: Numi just knows how to make, market, and package tea. This tea has an outstanding taste. I drink a glass of this hot tea most nights before I go to bed.It is the best green tea I have ever had. I don't even add a sweetener to it. It is the ginger that adds that extra special something. I will probably stick with this for a long time.

I have tried many decaf green teas, both organic and conventional and this is the ONLY one I like or consider worth buying.  I've been buying it for a few years now, wish it were easier to find in the stores.

Well, I've only had one cup so far, so I'll soldier on and keep trying to like it.  (After all, I did get stuck with 3 boxes.)  But this tea is definitely not what I expected.  Mostly tasteless and what taste there is is bitter ... I can't taste lemon OR ginger.  I've always loved Numi teas - the mint one is to die for.  But this one gets a thumbs down from me.
sadly, i have become a Teavana tea drinker and i no longer order my teas from here in bulk but these were decent teas.

column9: Part of one of my favorite lunches.
column10: I can't get the Hormel chili without beans anywhere locally, so was really glad to find it online at amazon. Well, what ISN'T online at amazon? Anyway, this product is an essential ingredient to my favorite diet lunch. I mostly eat the Nutrisystem way, only with my own foods. Low glycemic index, high protein. I use a low calorie hot dog bun, opened on the plate, put 2 40-calorie hot dogs on it, one on each half of the bun, then top it with 1/2 cup of hot chili and 1/4 cup of fat free cheddar cheese, then microwave it to melt the cheese. I have this with a big salad and all the calorie-free (watch your portion anyway) Walden Farms dressing I need. This fills me up, satisfies all the cravings I have for "real food" and makes me lose weight. And, it's delicious.

I'm sorely disappointed, I'll give it two stars because the flavor was pretty good but the turkey chunks are gross. I couldn't even get through half a can after cutting it with my own fresh chunks of pork. Would not recommend this.

I used these at a party for a neurosurgeon.  I was pleased with the speed of shipping and the product itself.  The brains were a little smashed together and not as plump and colorful as another brand of gummy brain I'd purchased in the past (but were unavailable at this time).  The flavor was good.
I like the flavor of white matcha but I wouldn't say it's white.  It is loaded with antioxidants and definitely has many health benefits.

If you prefer a less earthy matcha and the health benefits of a white tea this is the way to go! I want to address that Red Leaf Tea has an excellent QUALITY tea provided to you! Customer service is excellent as well! I was very pleased with my purchase of this white matcha from Red Leaf Tea.

My sister bought me the small one, of 30g. I was looking for a natural product to help me with some slightly increased blood sugar level. I was drinking it for a period of one month (one cup per day, skipped few times so you can say that 30g is good for about 30 cups) and my blood results were indeed better. Was it this tea or my general sugar issue awareness - I can't tell, but this was one of the best teas I have ever tasted.
I have been drinking this tea exclusively since the day I first got it.  It's got a nice, herbal flavor, smooth finish, and subtle, citrus aftertaste.
I really like this tea.I like the unique flavor, not your everyday tea.Highly recommended, and would make a great gift.

column9: Quite good. Not enough nuts though
column10: Like the title says. There just aren't that many nuts. The picture shows a good amount of almonds,peanuts and cranberry. But the bars are mostly made of oats w/ high maltose corn syrup......Whatever that is. But those are really the first 2 ingredients. Other wise it's actually a pretty good bar. Probably not as healthy as a kind bar. But a lot cheaper. If you have sam's club member ship look into buying these there. You can get a pack of 30- 1.2 oz bars for  $10.

I always keep a box of these bars in my refrigerator. If I had never seen the Fruit and Nut bars before, one look at the label would tell me that they are not particularly healthful.  The ingredients include corn syrup, honey, and sugar listed twice.  In fact, there are 14 grams of sugar in every 34 gram bar.  That is forty percent!  Although the label does claim all natural ingredients, that does not necessarily mean that the contents are all good for you. The sugar seems to be what holds the fruit and nuts together.  The reason that I keep them in the refrigerator is that when the bars get warm, they do not hold their shape.  You do not want to put one in your pocket on a warm day.  They become a sticky blob. So why do I keep a big supply of them around?  I like them.  When cooled, they keep their shape as a crunchy rectangle of nuts and fruit.  Their nutty texture is very nice.  The taste is great, although the sugar does make its presence known.  I do not eat them every day or take them with me to go hiking.  For that, I like the Oats and Honey, Almond, or Peanut Butter varieties of Nature Valley granola bars.  Those varieties have a more reasonable sugar content.  However, I like a Fruit and Nut bar as an occasional treat to go with tea or coffee.  Maybe I am addicted to them.

I had bought this elsewhere and found the packaging graphics and text quite deceptive.There is not that much nut or berry content, just dry tasting cereal that leaves you thirsty and wishing you did not buy and use it.

column9: does not meet quantity as advertised
column10: This ad is for a box of 48 bars.  I recieved a box of 30 but charged the price of $19 and change.
Great chewy bars. Very tasty, easy to chew. I finished the box over the weekend.I'm in college, this is a great to keep my brain working.

I've been eating these bars for years and I've notice that lately that the quality is notas good as they were before.  They have these hard things in them that can break yourteeth! So quality control is not being monitored and I'm going to call the company andlet them know that the last 4 boxes I've purchased are not up to par. They taste reallygood as long as you don't bite into something hard. It's like biting into a nutshelland they need to know this asap.
Could have been a bit fresher tasting, seems like the packages in the box had gotten hot, not sure how they were stored before shipment but all in all pleased with the product.

column9: I love these granola bars but the condition was not great
column10: Ok. I love these granola bars and I purchased a large box of them for a very good price.  They taste great and I will reorder.  I gave a sort of low rating for 1 reason.  The bars must have been stored in a hot warehouse or truck, because you know the stuff that the nuts and granola are covered with, and that holds the bar together?  Well it's like it melted and ran to one side of the bar. I am not confused.  I am not talking about the sweet and salty nut granola bar with a praline layer.  I am talking about these bars.  Again though, they still taste just fine and I will order more.

column9: Great deal for soft granola bars
column10: This is a staple in our office. All love it! Product is consistent in taste and quality. Recommend it for an inexpensive snack for the office team.

These Nature Valley bars are one of my favorite granola bars. They taste great, don't have tons of calories, and are just the right size for a quick snack. Much better than the "crunchy" variety of Nature Valley bars.
This is a good price for saffron. I use alot of it to make rice, and it's hard to find it in bulk, so I will definitely purchase from this supplier again.
Saffron is usually soooooooooo expensive! This is an excellent-quality product and was very reasonably priced. It's well-packaged for lengthy storage, which is great because a little goes a long way!

column9: I enjoy the fine quality of exir saffron
column10: I enjoy saffron a lot, I find it very exotic.

column9: Best BBQ sauce on the market today, hands down.
column10: And I've tried them all.Maybe its the anchovies. Who in their right mind but these radio clowns John Boy and Billywould put anchovies in barbecue sauce right! Well why not, most all good steak sauces andWorcestershire have anchovies, and you cant make a decent Caesar Salad without them either.What this sauce does to food is amazing. For ribs and chicken it just doesn't get any better.Not a real tomato taste like most mainstream BBQ sauce, and not a mustard flavor either likeyou will find in Florida and South Carolina. And although JB&B are in North Carolina, its nota traditional NC style sauce either and thank god for that cause NC BBQ is the most overhypedand overrated stuff I've ever had. So they went in a whole new direction with this recipecause there's nothing else like it.I use it as a finishing sauce on the grill, or you can dilute it with beer or vinegar and useit for a marinade, even on steak. Its also great on rotisserie chicken and wings. If you wantmore heat get the Hot and Spicy version. Its even better.BTW, my favorite recipe is for ribs using Emeril's Rib Rub and John Boy and Billy's GrillinSauce as a finisher. Great combination. Check the web for other more creative recipes likeThe Spammer (one can Spam, one bottle Grillin Sauce and an oven) haw haw

column9: Love the brand, but what was delivered was not what I ordered
column10: I absolutely love Drew's Salsa - it's not overly garlicy, and it uses apple cider vinegar instead of corn vinegar. IT's some of the best salsa around. Still, I ordered regular salsa, and the seller delivered thick and chunky instead. Still good, but not what I'd been yearning for.

This stuff is great on everything from eggs to burgers to BBQ anything. It has wonderful smokey flavor, and as the label says it's fairly hot(for true chile heads It's pretty mild). This is the real deal Chipotle flavor from south of the border, the only problem is $12.99 for a 5.8 oz. bottle??? Must be a type-o or something, PEOPLE YOU CAN BUY THIS PRODUCT DOWN AT YOUR LOCAL MEGA-MART FOR $1.69! Yes that's what I said $1.69.Buyer Beware

I routinely keep a stockpile of up to fifty (yes that's 50) hot sauces in my refigerator. It is safe to say that I have a hot sauce "problem". This is the sauce that gets used the fastest and re-purchased the most often. It is not a "typical" sauce by any means - It has a fruity flavor, but it can bring a little pain at times too. I would recommend this sauce to anyone who wants something out of the ordinary and exceptional.

column9: OK, grill up a pork tenderloin, use this magic elixir
column10: as a glaze/finisher, and put me in your Will. Thankee.Just a perfectly mild blend of habaneros with hints of papaya, honey, garlic, ginger, in a creamy mustard base that is just fantastic!!! A must for any hot sauce collector. 5 Scovies

I received my shipment of the house blend coffee late this morning and within a short time I had brewed a pot. When I opened the 12 oz. package, the aroma of the dry coffee was very rich and the cup of brewed coffee tasted bold and rich. I would highly recommend this product!

column9: Excellent Product For Dog's Teeth and Economical in Bulk
column10: I was skeptical that these dentatix would work that well, and had a little sticker shock from the price.  None of the other chew type products had produced noticable results.When I found Dentatix at the bulk price, it seemed reasonable enough to give them a try, and I have been very happy with the results. My dog's teeth are clean with the buildup removed and my vet has not tried to get me to leave her for a cleaning since.  My dog also like them as a treat, and ate them so fast, I wasn't sure they could have mush effect, but the did, and I would recommend them highly based on the great results.
Since giving my dogs these dentastix, their teeth look great.  They also love getting them as a treat.  Finally something that really lives up to the hype.

I give my Catahoula one Dentastix after her breakfast and one after her dinner. (I was delighted to find the Dentastix available in this 40-count economy size on Amazon.  I haven't been able to find these super-size bags in my pet store).  I find it very hard to brush her teeth (she HATES it) so I thought this would be a good alternative.  I think I was right.  The dog is 7 years old and the veterinarian says her teeth are beautiful.  She could do commercials for a toothpaste company!!  After she's eaten her meal(s) she automatically goes for the stix so I assume they are tasty.  Because of the veterinarian's glowing remarks re the condition of the dogs teeth I believe I can safely say that the Dentastix are doing their job.

My doggies love dentastix treats......Both my doggies, one a senior & the other middle aged stand around waiting for treat, barking & making turns, the minute I reach for the bag and say "time for your dental stix" once a day....

I purchased Dentastix about a month ago.  My dog loves them, however, whether they really help to prevent tartar, is too erly to tell.  My dog devours them a little yoo fast, which makes it doutful that the sticks serve their purpose. By all means, it won't hurt to use them.Ursula Behrens

My vet thinks my dogs teeth are in great shape and probably never need to be cleaned.  I get the Dentastixs in large and small size.  I like getting the good this way because it is less expensive, I buy enough for free shipping and my dogs LOVE them.  Thank you Amazon
Really liked the coffee, but most providers sell three boxes of coffee for less than this one box.  Seems overpriced to me.

column9: Much better than the Senseo decaf
column10: We buy these to work in our Senseo coffee maker.  They are more expensive per-cup than the Senseo pods, but still less than a cup would cost at a coffeeshop, and this is quite a tasty decaf.  They work perfectly in the Senseo.

column9: As good or better than non-decaf...
column10: I use this in my Senseo coffee maker, and, surprisingly, it tastes as good or better than most non-decaffeinated coffees I have drunk.  It costs just a little less than the Senseo brand of decaf, which I have not tried yet, but I am very pleased with this brand--best defaf I have ever tasted.

column9: Love the name, and the flavor!
column10: I love the name of this sauce! It tastes great too! It has a nice smokey Chipotle flavor, and not too spicy.

column4: Judith G. Bronsonstem Svcs "Judith Gunn Brons...
column9: A huge hit with one of my cats
column10: One of my cats, who rotates to a new favorite food about every 6 months, is currently wildly in love with this; it's about 80% of her diet.  Oddly, my other cat, who also adores salmon, eats only a few crunchies of it a week.  Who can understand these creatures....?

column9: See the guy on the label?
column10: He aint lying.Oh man, this stuff is so good and so breathtakingly and peacefully hot at the same time its unbelievable. Very thick, use sparingly or just slather it on and take your punishment. It has a great tart/sweet flavor that shows through the habanero. Good stuff.

I've been using Batch #37 ("The Batch") for YEARS and it is hands down my favorite hot sauce. I recall when I first stumbled upon The Batch I thought it was so good that I went out and ordered all the Pain Is Good hot sauces to give them a try. Some were good, some were crap but none compared to The Batch.If you like hot hot sauce, you must try The Batch. It is the perfect balance of flavor and heat. Many of the really hot sauces are so hot they lose any and all of their flavor. Supermarket hot sauces on the other hand, often times have decent flavor but very little heat.I eat The Batch to spice up salsa, straight on tortilla chips or whatever needs a little kick...I recently added a few drops to some cocktail sauce for dipping shrimp and it was amazing!!! Before it was available on Amazon, I would literally buy it by the case directly from the folks at Pain Is Good and give half the bottles away as gifts.WARNING: DO NOT give it to people that do not openly volunteer their love of hot sauces as they usually can't take the heat...literally.Now go get some Batch #37 and enjoy!!!
One of the best hot sauce is out there, with a definitely different flavor! I have been buying this particular brand for years. And some of the other variations thereof.

Hey, if you like hot sauce and who doesn't. you'll love this!  And it has garlic, so it's the best of both worlds.  A little goes a long way.  I purchased this for myself as well as to give as a gift to several friends who enjoy hot sauces.

This is an amazing hot sauce for those who really like to kick it up a notch without inducing extreme pain. It has the perfect blend of heat and flavor and it goes with everything. I have a collection of hot sauces, but this is the only one I almost need by the case. For a real delight, mix it with sour cream for a fast dip that is bound to get you big points. I can't say enough positive things about this product. In a world full of sauces that exist only to be hot, this is truly a condiment designed to be savored.

We first tried this sauce at Firehouse subs. It is a very nice blend of spices. Just the right amount of heat. Tastes great on  Subs, potatoes, lots of stuff! This is not your ordinary hot sauce, it is full of flavor!

Wow.  On the recommendation of the store owner, my husband and I bought a bottle of Gator Hammock at a specialty hot sauce shop in Dahlonega, GA.  This is some truly flavorful hot sauce.  Yes, it is hot, but not the kind of hot that you have to sign a waiver for or that will make you cry.  I'd rate this at about a 5 on a 1-10 heat scale.  Heat is great, I guess, if you're just trying to prove how macho you are or are the kind of person that thinks that eating should start with a dare.  But what we really love about this sauce is the flavor it imparts.  It must be in the mystery "spice blend" mentioned on the bottle.  It's a bit fruity from the peppers but not at all sweet.  It has some savory notes and is much more complex than a basic Tabasco or Texas Pete.  There is not a pronounced vinegar flavor as is the case with some other hot sauces.  I haven't tried this yet, but I'd imagine it would be amazing to add just a splash to tomato soup or to a Bloody Mary.What I have done is 1)mix it half and half with ketchup for a spicy burger topping, 2)added a splash to scrambled eggs (best scrambled eggs ever) and 3)added a little to some pulled pork barbeque along with a splash of vinegar and a tiny squeeze of honey.  Voila--instant barbecue sauce.I cannot say enough good things about Gator Hammock.  I went to their website the other day, and they make a wide range of products.  Guess I'll be working my way through their inventory over the next few months!

I found this hot sauce while shopping in old town St. Augustine Florida. The store was filled with Sauces of every kind. I asked the woman working there for her favorite and she instantly led me to the-Made in Florida-Gator Hammock.  Now I order by the case. I can not be without... seriously.  It is a sauce with a full and unique flavor. Delicious. I have also purchased their other flavors. Lethal Hammock -wonderfully Really Hot. Swamp Gator medium heat and of course Gator which is mild but hot. Their sprinkles are great too, in chili and stir fry. Worth a try. If you love hot sauce, this will become your favorite.

column9: Very good sauce, not too hot, great flavor
column10: I just got back from Firehouse Subs where they have numerous sauces available to try.  I'm not a huge hot sauce aficionado, but I do enjoy good food.  This sauce is good.  It is not very hot and does not have an overpowering vinegar base.  The flavor of the peppers and spices is strong and comes across nicely with other foods.  I will be purchasing a bottle of this sauce.

This sauce is awesome.  I went on a month long quest for the next best table hot sauce.  I read a million reviews from different hot sauce sites only to order product after product and finding it flavorless, under-powered, over-powered, or simply disgusting.  This is THE most versatile hot sauce out there.  It makes a fantastic table sauce as well as an excellent marinade for some wings.  It showcases the cayenne and garlic without making the cayenne or garlic so much that it's unwelcome.  It is an immediate medium burn and should satisfy anyone seeking a nice well rounded table sauce.BTW:  These independent hot sauce reviews (non-Amazon) were hard to go through.  A lot of them are video reviews.  Why do people reviewing hot sauce think we want to see them eating hot sauce on a cracker over a crappy webcam.  And then they review the sauce while continuing to munch on a mouthful of hot cracker.  Gross...

This noodle tastes great and is almost as good as their spicy black shin ramyun noodle soup. It's got a different flavour and is not too spicy for my standards. Nong Shim does make a vareity of flavours that taste good.
This is an excellent product, really convenient for on the go, but I was surprised at how expensive it is on here.  At Babies R Us they are $1.20 each.  Same brand and everything.

I have scoured the internet trying to find the source of the produce used in this product and have not been able to locate ANY information on production.  There is only information regarding its New York City base, but nothing regarding where the food is grown, packaged and/or whether it is imported.  Though it is "certified organic" I will discontinue use of the product until I have answers to the above.

I love having Plum Organics Baby Food as a choice for my baby. Whoever thought of having organic fruits and veggies in a pouch knows parents today are looking for fast, easy and healthy. These are great when you are traveling. I feel like eating green vegetables is one of the hardest things to get my child to do and he has no problem eating them everyday with these Spinach, Peas & Pear pouches. I will continue buying these as long as he eats them! Better bargain here on Amazon then buying them at my local Target store.
Great for self-feeding. My son is getting picky, but still loves these pouches! Plus, great company, organic, uses no GMO ingredients!

I really liked this flavor because it seems to be pretty healthy for a pre-made baby food. But I do wish the packs were bigger and they used less pears so it's not so sugary. Also, I contacted them once and asked what countries did all their ingredients come from and they never answered... Don't know why. Probably China???
I love these, they are super convenient. My son loves them and I'm happy he is getting organic fruits and veggies he can feed himself.

I normally make my own baby food...but I could not duplicate the great taste of this one.  My older girl (who is now 1.5) still loves her green "smoothie" and eats it by herself.  Great on trips or when you are out.  I started giving it to my 6mo old and she loves it too!!!  Definitely worth spending a little extra if my kids are going to eat spinach!!!
My toddler love them she knows right where they are in the kitchen and she will ask for them at sack time and or for dinner time.....Really helps us so she will eat her veggies!!! Great product!!!!
This is great!  I can get something that is green down my triplets without them gagging on it.  I get it every month.

column9: Great taste. So handy. Great value.
column10: This is such a great product. I love that it's all organic and my 8 month old son LOVES sucking the puree out of these pouches. I keep one in the bottom of the diaper bag so we always have something on hand if errands start running long.

column9: Convenient Nutrition, but cheaper at Babies R Us.
column10: My 18 month old loves this flavor of Plum Organics.  She was born with cleft lip/palate and is only allowed to eat from a bottle so I mix these in with formula and she loves them.  We go through 3 or 4 packets of Plum Organics food everyday.  I was thrilled to find a flavor that she liked that provided her with some green veggies!  I'm surprised that these are so expensive on Amazon.  I never pay more than $1 per packet at Babies R Us b/c they're on sale so frequently.

My daughter really likes this product.  She seems to like all of the Plum Organics products we've tried thus far so I would say this is a pretty safe purchase for those who haven't given it to their baby yet.

do not think twice about these packets.  if you can spend the money, a good way to get green veggies into their diets.  i recycle plenty to off-set the "badness" of this packaging.  a very convenient item.
Nutritious and delicious-need I say more?  Baby loves it-mom is happy.  The product is easy to carry everywhere, easy to use and store, squeezes right into the spoon for travelling.  Excellent!

good balance.  he eats them well.  as far as the sour thing, ive found corn/apple and pumpkin/bana  a little tart.  ive also gotten home and had some that have been opened and soured.  now i check and squeeze to make sure they are full/closed.

Bought this item when it was on a Friday Sale. My son (a little over a year) really enjoys the food - I know this since he keeps reaching/pointing at the package. I actually tried it and it wasn't too bad so props to Plum Organics to make baby food that is tolerable for adults. Great on the go.

These packages of food are absolutely awesome for on-the-go feedings.  No mess, no spoons.  My little one just sucks it down through the spout attached to the tube and can feed herself.  Just love these things!  Great invention and a necessity for on-the-go moms!

column9: Tastes more like spinach than pears
column10: I was hoping the pears would mask the spinach and peas flavor, but it does not and my daughter doesn't care for it.

column9: So sour it made me pucker...
column10: My daughter loved this food when I bought it for the first time at Wholefoods. I also tried it and it tasted really good. It was mild and sweet. I decided to buy the box along with other varieties from Plum. When I gave her the Peas, pears and spinach, she refused to eat it after the first two bites so I tried it.I was surprised and alarmed that it was SO incredibly sour. It almost gave me a canker sore. I tasted nothing except lemons, felt like I was sucking on one too.Tried to contact the company twice and NO one responded. Wanted to know if they had recalls for their food. Apparently they do have recalls but not for the pea, pears and spinach. Still trying to get in touch with them so they know that it was sour and maybe try to fix it. I plan to stick to Earth's Best at the moment until they get their act straight or finally contact me.A month later...I finally got a response from the rep and they are sending coupons so I can replace the boxes I bought. Hopefully, they will figure out what the issue is.

column9: These are always on hand in the diaper bag.
column10: These are wonderful for busy moms and dads.  When our little one needs to eat, these tubes offer a quick way to deliver food.  After some practice he has learned to suck out the food with little to no mess.  Plus you won't find them any cheaper than on Amazon.com.
My baby loves all of Plum organics, but this is his favorite.  Earth's Best is good, but Plum is better.  I only wish it was in jars instead of pouches.

The odd little tea berries produce a tea with wonderful flavor.  And the price is wonderful compared to the price of Lipton tea in a grocery store.  I enjoy it as Iced Tea adding a teaspoon of ground cinnamon to the tea berries before brewing.

column9: Anchovy - Love it or Hate it
column10: I love anchovies. These are a great value. Some folks do not care for anchovies because of the saltiness. I find if you rinse them cold water first and then use a little lemon jouice on them it cuts the salt factor by half. Enjoy!!
This hot sauce is full of flavor and a decent amount of heat. I love the garlic flavors and will purchase again.
This is a great hot sauce with a kick. My boyfriend likes to marienate it with carne asada and everyone seems to like it. Not to hot, just the right kick for that extra flavor.

I was glad to find this on Amazon after learning that my local wholesale grocer no longer carries it.Not too many people know that gelatin contains both chondroitin and glucosamine, both of which are used widely to relieve arthritis pain. I prefer the whole food, besides which it's cheaper. I start with a mug 3/4 full of bouillon or apple juice, and put in a coffee measure (2 Tablespoons) full of gelatin. It does not need to be stirred as it will slowly absorb the liquid. Then I put a lid on the mug (my lid came from an old candy dish) and place it on a low-wattage candle warmer or mug warmer. In two hours or so I have a hot yummy protein drink ready to stir and enjoy. I do this twice a day so a 1-lb can will last a month or so. I really notice a difference in my pain levels from doing this.Note: make sure the lid fits inside the top edge of the mug.

Its so much better than adding rice cereal to thicken formula b/c this has no clumps and doesn't clog the nipples.  I mix up a pitcher of this formula b/c its hard to mix and foams up at first.

Our three-month-old son has GERD and we were in dire straits trying to find a solution. The doctor tried several medications but it really didn't matter because he'd spit them up every time. She gave us a sample of this formula to try and voila! Our son still struggles with his reflux but he's not the vomit factory he once was. Bonus - he sleeps 12 hours straight at night now (don't hate me).We are converts. Our daughter was a Similac baby but Enfamil A.R. saved our sanity and our son's health.

I never write reviews however, after trying 4 different formulas we found a winner. Our little one has acid reflux and the doctor recommended this. It was so bad that she cried for hours. I noticed a difference with 24 hours. We use Dr. Brown bottles and we had to buy stage 2 nipples because the formula is thick. Yes, it can make your baby constipated however, I called the doctor and he said that it is ok to give 1 oz of prune juice and 1 oz of water daily to keep her regular. We also use gas drops at every other feeding to help with the gas.  FYI Target has there own brand that works great to  for a reduced cost $15.99 :).

Yes, this formula does reduce the amount of spit up.... but at what cost? This formula caused my poor daughter to be so constipated that she cries every time she poops. She also pushed so hard that I found blood in her diaper! And it took her half an hour to finish only 4 oz because it's so thick and frothy! I just returned a bunch of this formula and bought Similac Sensitive for Spit Up, that has much better reviews in regards to it's effectiveness and no constipation. It only comes in Ready to Feed but it's worth the extra money not to see my baby in pain all day! I would not recommend this formula for any baby!

My daughter has a moderate reflux problem and this formula was recommended by her doctor.  It greatly reduces the amount and frequency of her reflux, and I find that once she had been on the formula for a few weeks she no longer had trouble with constipation.  Her doctor advised me to give her 1 ounce of prune juice diluted with 1 ounce of water whenever she went more than 30 hours without having a bowel movement, and that really does the trick to get things moving again.  She also said that only 50% of infants have long term constipation issues with the A.R. formula.

This stuff does greatly reduce spit-ups but I would rather be covered in spit-up all day than have my baby scream because he is constipated. He's a happy spitter and keeps enough down that he's doing fine so this stuff is going in the trash!

column9: powder mixes with tons of bubbles
column10: The whole point of this formula is to prevent spit up. However, our daughter could not drink it because the powder created too many bubbles once mixed (and we tried all the tricks - mixed it with a spoon, kept it in the refrigerator for hours...). We now feed our daughter the ready-to-feed Enfamil AR and it works like a charm. But the powder was not an answer for us.

My baby spit up alot since day one.  After trying a couple different kinds of formula, even ones that are lactose & soy free, I landed on Enfamil AR.  It started working right away...we hardly even need a burp cloth now.  Every once in awhile, I try to go back to Similac just to see if my baby has grown out of his reflux.  Every time he starts spitting up again, so back to the AR I go.  The Up & Up Brand (Target) with Rice Starch works just as good and isn't as expensive.

This formula isn't the same as adding rice cereal to formula or breast milk.  Unlike when you add rice cereal, this formula is a smooth, easy to swallow liquid that's barely thicker than regular formula or milk.  It doesn't thicken until it meets the baby's stomach acid, which keeps it from coming up as easily.  Some pediatricians are okay with rice cereal at 4 months and others aren't - most seem to recommend waiting until 6 months, so check with yours before making any big changes!  Our son was refusing to eat breast milk or regular formula, and our ped said no rice cereal, so we tried this and he hasn't refused it yet (it's been a month).  It's made a huge difference for him.
After switching to AR, our child has spit-up a lot less. He still spits up some, but this formula was a life saver! Hightly Recommend.

My son is 3 months old and was just diagnosed with reflux, we were told to try this formula as it is supposed to be the holy grail of formula's to help babies with reflux and spit up.My son did not seem to have a problem drinking this formula out of his level 1 nipple, as it is a heavier formula.As for the spitting up, which the thicker formula is supposed to help prevent by helping keep food in babies tummy versus mommys shirt, it was a nightmare. The amount of spit up my son experienced did not go down, if anything it increased. Ontop of that, of course it was a thicker, oatmeal like consistency. He spat up so horribly on this one time it soaked his whole front of his shirt and it was horrible to wipe off, you can't wipe off the chunks easily...Also, inside the tub in the scoop wrapper there is a pamphlet that says their special formula won't make your child constipated, could not be further from the truth!!! My baby has been on 4 other formulas for his reflux and has never had a constipation issue. I literally fed him 4 bottles of this formula and the poor kid had major poop issues.I would not reccomend this to a parent with an infant with reflux, research other formulas first and use this as a LAST RESORT! Not worth the $$.

My daughter is 4 months old and has reflux and this is the ONLY formula she can hold down and we've tried almost all of them.  We've even tried adding rice cereal (I know you're not supposed to, but let's be honest...we all do) to other brands, but nope, spit that up too. This formula actually helped her almost immediately.  Within the first day of using it, her spitting up drastically reduced.  It does constipate her, like other reviewers have said, but our ped said we could give her 4oz of apple juice every day to help with it.  We do that, and it helps a little, but we've found that the baby probiotic, baby giaia, works waaaaay better-don't get it on amazon, got to your local pharmacy and get it there.  It's expensive (like $30), but with the formula and the probiotic, my daughter is now an angel!

My lo started choking during feeds and choking, gagging and coughing after feeds started at 2 weeks old.  I was breast and formula feeding.  We got referred to a gi pediatrician who said it's reflux.  Told us to thicken his milk w/ cereal and try zantac.  Thickening didn't help cause i couldn't get the right consistency w/ the right nipple hole size...and so still choking.  Zantac made it worse, after 3 days, i gave up on it, eventhough i know we're suppse to give it 2 wks.  Then gi dr. told us to try prevacid as well as alimentum formula.  Both made tings really bad.  He was having violent choking after his feeds, and i could hear all the liquids in his body moving, and waking up hrs after feeds choking.  I gave up the prevacid after day 5 and got an upper gi study and found out all structures were normal.  I found online Enfamil AR which has added rice starch that expands after they drink it in their tummy to help w/ spitup.  Lo wasn't spitting up alot but it was choking and gagging him cause it would come up to his throat.  So i tried the formula...today is day 5 and lets say it's been a miracle!  He is not choking during drinking anymore and only had a handful of times he's choked in the last 5 days which aren't even bad chokes, but more like coughs.  Where he would  to choke about 1 to 8 times after each feedings before.  I had to be extremely careful not to move him after his feedings before or he would likely choke...now I can move him more and he will not choke.  It seems like his choking is replaced w/ either nothing or a bit of spitup or a throat clear or cough at times.  I'm not giving any meds now.  The only thing is the AR can cause constipation for some, so I'm mixing the formula w/ 15 % enfamil newborn.  I may try adding some prune juice to one bottle a day to soften his stool.  So far he can go but it's a little dry.  I like the AR vs adding rice cereal myself cause it goes in like regular milk but thickens in the stomach.  I use dr. brown's #2 nipples cause its a tiny bit thicker than the enfamil newborn milk but it's perfect cause when the milk is too thin my lo chokes on it.  He is 7 weeks now.  By the way it's very easy to mix w/ warm water...no clumps and no clogging the nipple.

column9: Works for my daughter w/ mild spit up issues
column10: My daughter does not have GERD or diagnosed acid reflux, but she did have a lot of spit up and gas with the formula we used for our first two kids (Good Start).  (To fix the gas problem, we switched to Dr. Brown's bottles.) Unfortunately Nestle doesn't have an already thickened formula, so we switched to Enfamil.  There was an immediate improvement in my daughter's spitting up.  Since she wasn't 4 months yet, I did not want to add rice cereal directly to her bottles (yes, adding cereal to a bottle is controversial, but one can decide what is best for their child).  Enfamil AR is not formula with rice cereal added.  It is just a component of the rice (I believe just the rice starch).  It is enough to thicken it up for many babies to easily digest, but it is not as thick as adding rice cereal.If you do decide you want to add cereal to the bottle at a later date, this formula does not work well for that.  It almost immediately becomes too thick to drink (no matter how little you add).  I tried using the regular Enfamil and adding cereal (she is older now), but she won't drink it.  Adding the cereal for my other two helped them sleep through the night better, but since she won't take a bottle w/ the cereal added, she is still getting up one or two times for a bottle at night.  The no spit up is worth it though.The reason I didn't give it 5 stars is because she still does spit up some, but it's a great improvement from before.
