It also is suppose to make you happy, although I think that theory is being debated.Dark chocolate definitely makes me happy!  I wish I had a whole crate of Newman's dark chocolate bars.  It has a nice sweet taste, without tasting like milk chocolate. (Not that I have anything whatsoever against milk chocolate.)  It also does not leave a bad acid aftereffect as some chocolate bars do.  And if you only eat a small amount a day, there will be no bad weight aftereffect, either.

column4: Fred Vogt "author of See Sally Kick A**: A Wo...
column10: This is an excellent creamy smooth dark chocolate with more depth then expected for a 54% cocoa bar. This is between the best milk chocolate and the best dark chocolate. So if you are venturing into dark chocolate for the first time or want something in the middle then this product is very good. I taste tested this with three other chocolate lovers and we rated this the best mid level dark chocolate we had tasted. One taster stated this could become her new favorite chocolate. This is probably not for the extreme dark chocolate lovers, but all in all, a very good chocolate and highly recommended!!

column9: A posthumous chocolate Oscar to Mr Newman
column10: I have not yet experienced a strikeout amongst the Newman's Own line of products, and this is no exception. Smooth, delightful, with just the right balance of bitter and sweet, this is the perfect capper to a light dinner or late coffee...or even just as a quick boost or snack. It was difficult to do, but I rationed myself to one small piece a night until it was gone. And when it was gone, I immediately went and bought another one. And of course, charity benefits from the profits.

I'm a big fan of Newman's and wish I could say this is the very best of the best...but...It is very good and I could eat a truck load of it but I compared it side by side with my Hersheys dark chocolate and I'd have to give a bit of an edge to the Hersheys'..  I can't say anything bad about it but  it's not quite there for me...Perhaps you'll disagree????

Newman's Own is not known as a chocolate brand. They make organic stuff like lemonade and pizza, so I was a bit skeptical.What I really like about this chocolate bar is its balance: it is not as silky smooth as a Lindt or Dove, it is not as bitter as you would expect from a 56% cacao bar. It is dark but not too dark, Sweet but not too sweet. Smooth but not too velvety. I could not help but finish the entire bar in one sitting.

column9: Very Bland and Not Really Dark
column10: I prefer dark chocolate to milk, but I do eat both. I shared this bar with my kids: a daughter who loves dark chocolate and my some who will only eat milk chocolate.Me: I do not consider 54% cacao to be dark chocolate, that's a bit of a mislabel. The flavor was very bland. I'm glad it's organic and all that, but if it doesn't taste that great, why buy it?My daughter: Kinda waxy, like a Hershey bar, and it's too sweet. This bar is about the same size as a Hershey bar too.My son: I'd rather have a Hershey bar, this is too dry.

column9: Pleasant tasting dark chocolate for those who usually don't like dark chocolate
column10: I am surprised to see so many strong negative reviews for "Newman's Own Organics Dark Chocolate Bar". Personally, I find the taste to be delicious; it (the taste) is rich in chocolate flavor, while also avoiding the overly-sweet sugar taste that is common with lower-end chocolate confections. "Newman's Own Organics Dark Chocolate Bar" also manages to minimize the bitter taste that is common for dark chocolate, which is a huge plus for me, considering that I am not a big fan of dark chocolate in the first place.In all, highly recommended.

As a fan of chocolate I couldn't miss the opportunity to taste test Newman's Own Organics Dark Chocolate.  Probably the only drawback was that I was going to have to share some with my wife.  The chocolate doesn't have a strong aroma when you open the package, but the taste is excellent.  The chocolate breaks nicely, doesn't crumble.  It isn't waxy and has a great feel in the mouth, very creamy.  While it has a good taste, the chocolate doesn't overwhelm your taste buds.  I was a little disappointed in the "finish" - there wasn't a long lasting flavor in the chocolate, and that, perhaps is the one drawback I had from eating the chocolate.

Smooth and delicious, this chocolate bar is great for baking or good just on its own. Although dark chocolate, it is sweeter than most and doesn't have a noticeable bitter aftertaste (similar to milk chocolate). At 54% chocolate, it falls below a lot of other quality chocolates. Still, quite delicious. The small size is a disappointment.

column9: Dark chocolate a milk chocolate lover LOVES!
column10: I really didn't think that this dark chocolate could be that much different than any of the other fine dark chocolates I've had recently.  How could it seriously compare to La Maison du Chocolat, at ten bucks a bar?  But I have to say, it is, and it does...  in a very good way!  In particular, my wife LOVES this chocolate, and usually she eats just milk chocolate.  But it still tastes like dark chocolate.

The package was a lot smaller than I expected, but I'm a nut for dark chocolate.  This particular bar tastes great, and I kept wanting more than the wrapper could hold.Very much recommended, and this is coming from someone who is a dark chocolate fiend, but also very particular about the nuanced taste in each variation.

column9: Less bitter than most dark chocolate; earthy and delicious.
column10: I love dark chocolate; I vastly prefer it over the overly-sweet milk chocolate, so when I saw this organic dark chocolate, I knew I had to try it.It's delicious!  I will admit that I like my dark chocolate somewhat bitter, and this isn't terribly bitter the way some darks can be.  However it does have a unique, somewhat "earthy" taste that is all its own.  I ate my test bar in three different sittings in order to gauge its taste in three ways:1. With coffee... after a bitter cup of coffee, this chocolate is just sinfully delicious!2. After Italian food... after some garlic, again, this stuff is just sinfully delicious!3. After some chocolate ice cream... after this, the dark chocolate did have a less sugary taste, and "seemed" more bitter just because of that difference.  Again, it really hit the spot here too.Overall I will definitely be trying some more of this.  It is REALLY good stuff!

column9: Tasty & Organic, but Hershey's Gets the Gold
column10: When I received my Newman's Dark Chocolate Bar, I resisted the urge to tear right into it since I wanted to write a meaningful review.  When my wife got home from work, we each tried a small bite and agreed it was pretty tasty.  But you can say that about almost any chocolate bar; so the question is, just how tasty is it?  To decide I bought two other bars that seemed pretty comparable: a Hershey's Extra Dark Chocolate Bar ($1.89 for 3.52 oz) and a Cadbury Royal Dark Bar ($1.35 for 3.5 oz).  The Newman's bar runs about $2.15 each for 2.25 oz when bought in a pack of 12.  My wife and I sampled each, and here's what we found:- Newman's: A very mild and smooth taste, almost bland.  It has a slight sugar aftertaste.- Hershey's: The most chocolaty tasting, and sweetest, but with a slightly waxy texture.- Cadbury: Creamy, with a sharper taste, less sweetness, and more bitterness.Our unanimous verdict: While they were all good, and we'd have been happy to eat more of any of these bars, Hershey's was the best, with Newman's running second.If I was concerned about buying an organic chocolate bar, Newman's would be a fine choice.  But you pay more, and get less chocolate, to have the "organic" label.  For me, I'll stick with the Hershey's, unless I'm in the mood for a more bitter experience, and then I'll go for the Cadbury's.

column9: I liked it... but your results might vary!!!
column10: I let the bar sit on the counter for a couple of days after it was delivered (Vine Program)  I split the bar with my 17 year old daughter and she agreed with my assessment.  The bar had good dark chocolate taste, typical aftertaste, a bit of grit (not a bad thing)and generally an excellent experience.  The difference between this bar and most other dark chocolates I have tried was how creamy the texture was as I was chewing it.  Reminded me more of a Hershey's bar in consistency...  Perusing other folks' reviews, I saw several mentions of the taste being bitter.  Assuming that folks weren't eating these right after dinner - I am wondering if there are any issues with quality control - since I only had the one bar to try, that is only a thought!!!All in all... I thought the bar was excellent, uniquely creamy and soft versus my normal dark chocolate bars, and left me wanting more.  With the varied reviews, I will probably pick a bar or two up at the store and try again before buying 12 packs...All the best,Jay

column9: Scores well for what it is
column10: There are so many dark chocolate bars out these days from all over the world.  Many claim to be delicious as well as healthy.  Newman's Own Organics Dark Chocolate Bar seems worthy of praise even though the percent of dark chocolate is somewhat low compared to others. However, it has a creaminess and flavor that are above some dark bars.The waxiness of some chocolate bars is overly apparent, but Newman's is soft without the waxy feel.  It melts nicely in your mouth and because it's organic, it makes you feel like you're eating something that may be good for you.  People worry about additives, pesticides, etc. and this product, being organic, seems to avoid all the bad stuff.  Of course, it is a bit higher in fat than most dark chocolate bars, but if you don't mind that, the taste is good.The size of the bar is a bit small, 2.25 ounce, the price is about the same for other similar products.  On the other hand, a smaller bar is probably better than buying a large size one and devouring all of it.  I think it's a delicious tasting dark chocolate and I would probably buy it again.

column9: There's still some of the bar left, not a good sign...
column10: We love dark chocolate here so we waited eagerly to try the Newman's Own Organics Dark Chocolate Bar.  It was something of a disappointment:  kind of waxy, too sweet, and the intense flavor of really good dark chocolate was missing.  You can really tell how good something is around here by how long it lasts -- and we still have about 1/3 of the bar left after about two weeks.  I'd skip the chocolate bar, but the Newman's Own "oreo" cookies are fabulous.

I really enjoyed this candy bar, but then I tend to always enjoy Newman products. I'd have preferred a higher percentage of Cocoa in this, but what here was delicious and a nice little treat. It also helps that the bar is all organic and that Newman donates its profits to a lot of worthy charities.The bar here isn't as good as Endangered Species (Which is what i tend to purchase), but it was one of the better Dark Chocolate bars I've had in a while and it's great to see the Newman's Own company branching out into confectionary.

column9: Good taste, but great economic impact
column10: MMMM chocolate.  Can you ever actually give a bad review of chocolate?  In my opinion, no.  Even bad chocolate is still pretty good, because, well, it's chocolate.  However, this chocolate was exceptionally good.Consistent with the Newman branding, this product is organic and takes into consider the impact it's purchases make by using cocoa purchases certified by the Rainforest Alliance.This dark chocolate, made with real sugar, was slightly sweeter than I expected, but still had a rich depth to it.  Although it was 54% cocoa, it tasted like more.  Honestly, I've had better, but considering that this is both organic and sustainably produced some sacrifices have to be made.  This is a high fat and high calorie product, so be careful not to eat too much.  This probably comes partially from their use of whole milk but the percent of milk and chocolate liquor weren't specified so it's unclear what the technical classification of this product should be:  dark chocolate or milk chocolate.Overall a tasty treat that is great choice for those concerned about organic and sustainable products.  If  health or taste are your primary concern, you'll find better choices elsewhere.

column9: Sorry to say, not a hit in our household
column10: We love lots of different Newman's Own products, and have been devotees of Sockarooni pasta sauce and the mint chocolate chip cookies and the Caesar dressing for years. So we had high hopes for this chocolate. But sadly, those hopes were not fulfilled. The chocolate is good, not overly sweet, but just does not seem to rise to premium grade. The mouth feel was not as silky or smooth as we would like, and frankly a bit waxy. And there was something just not very distinctive to the chocolatiness of it all.

column9: Nice for someone who doesn't like too dark chocolate
column10: I'm a chocolate lover and I passionately dislike "Hershey's" kind of fake Chocolate.I usually eat 70% and above dark chocolate, but my daughter doesn't like sour taste of very dark chocolate. She really likes this Newman's Own 54%.I think it has OK taste. I don't love it, but I don't dislike it either.I'd recommend this to someone who doesn't like milk chocolate so much, but don't like very dark chocolate either. It's a good "between" chocolate.

column4: P. Colin McGraw "AV, Computer & EnviroTech Nut"
column9: Some of the Yummiest Dark Chocolate I've Eaten!
column10: Maybe it's because it was the end of a long day and I was hungry, but this is easily some of the best dark chocolate I've tried (and some of the best chocolate period)!I had some Rocky Mountain Chocolate and Russel Stover's truffles leftover from Valentine's day, and after eating those, I found myself wanting more of the Newman's Own stuff!

I am a fan of the Newman's Own company, and its philanthropic mission. Some of their products are quite good, such as their spaghetti sauce and oreo-type cookies. This chocolate bar was not quite what I anticipated - sweeter and more buttery than I expect from a premium dark chocolate bar. The flavor does not linger on the palate and each square seems "over" far too soon.  Still, one thing I've learned from reading and writing reviews on Amazon is that there's an enthusiastic audience for just about anything, so I'm sure other folks will enjoy this more than I did.  Still, I think Newman's would do well to butch this bar up a bit, and let those with sweet tooths go for their milk chocolate instead.  Each to their own, I suppose.

column9: Disappointing - but hey! It's still chocolate!
column10: Let me preface my review with this confession: I'm a chocoholic.  There's no such thing as "too rich" or "too much chocolate" or "too decadent."  I love me some chocolate goodness.  Milk chocolate, dark chocolate...not so much white chocolate and none of the fruit flavored chocolate.  My personal favorite is dark chocolate, but not that too dark chocolate that seems to be popular lately.  Now on with the review...I'm a huge fan of the Newman's Own brand and have a complete appreciation for organic products.  I had very high hopes for this chocolate bar.  Unfortunately I was a bit disappointed on several levels.  I found the chocolate to be drier than what my palate prefers, resulting in chocolate crumbles when I break off the pieces.  I don't like when chocolate (even the crumbles) goes to waste.  After all, any chocolate is good chocolate.I could tell, however, that the flavor of this chocolate was very pure.  It didn't have that "additive" flavor to it that some chocolate brands have.My last beef with Newman's Own Organics Dark Chocolate bar is that the squares are too big and don't break off easily.  I like bars that have smaller squares/rectangles to break off.  Because of the dry nature of the chocolate, there was never a clean break on the pieces.  It's a small, nitpicky thing, I know, but still something that matters to me when selecting a chocolate bar.And what made me ultimately give this chocolate only 3 stars was that after I broke off a few pieces and tucked the rest back in my purse, I COMPLETELY forgot I had any leftover.  This never happens to me.  I always break off a piece, and then save some for "later."  Later meaning about 3 minutes.  Newman's Own Organics Dark Chocolate Bar had me forgetting I even had any accessible chocolate for several DAYS until I happened to spot it in my purse again.  That should tell you something.

My husband is Belgian, and Belgians know their chocolate.  One of the many benefits of being married to him is the exposure to the vast array of superb Belgian chocolate.  Over time, my chocolate palate has become a lot more refined, to the point that I generally prefer dark chocolate with all its richness and subtleties to the overly sweet stuff that passes for chocolate in the U.S.I'm pleased to say that this chocolate does not disappoint.  From the very first bite, I knew it was a winner.  It's smooth with a soft but pleasantly bitter edge.  It's the kind of chocolate that needs to be consumed slowly, allowed to dissolve in the mouth so that you can appreciate all of its subtle qualities.  I thought this one had some nice berry undertones.  My husband gave it his seal of approval.  The first day, we only ate one square each which, to me, is a mark of quality chocolate: it's best eaten slowly and enjoyed in small quantities.  We finished the remained of the bar the next day, and found it just as good as we had the first day.  Truth be told, I think this chocolate was about as good as any I've had in Belgium--though I may keep that part from my husband!

Ok so its chocolate that alone gets it two stars that being said this wasn't that great. I have tried many of the Newman line products and usually its pretty good/great. I still have more than half of it in my freezer that would not have happened if it wasnt so bland, with a strong after taste. Hershey dark chocolate has it beat by a mile. I will probably not be buying this one pity too I like what the company is trying to do but the taste eeehhh.

I love chocolate, and indulge in it regularly. When I buy bar chocolate, I always buy dark. Now I don't go crazy and get the 85 or even 90% cocoa, but usually anywhere from 50-70ish% is great. Normally I love Newman's Own products, from their salad dressings, to lemonade, and even my dogs like the dog snacks. However, this chocolate falls short.It's VERY sweet, much sweeter than regular dark chocolate. I found the texture a little lacking, also-- somewhat crumbly and unappealing. (It brings to mind the episode of "Friends" when Monica had to work with a product called "Mockolate" and she said she loved the way it crumbled in her mouth.) I have to admit I was expecting a little more from this brand, and am let down.I'm not a fan, and don't see myself finishing the bar. I might just give it to someone who enjoys milk chocolate.

I feel like Darth Vader suggesting this, but really, Newman's Own Organics Chocolate Bar, come over to the dark side!  Reviewing a chocolate bar is not easy because so much depends upon the consumer.  I'm inclined to dark chocolates with high cocoa content and a sharp, bitter bite that mellows to a smooth richness in the mouth.  Alas, at 54%, this bar doesn't pack a dark punch.  Not to make light of it, but you'll find it a bit suspect -- as if it's fraternizing with the enemy (read: milk chocolate) -- if you're a true fan of dark.  If, on the other hand, you're equally at home with a milk chocolate, you will probably find more to like in this bar.  So consider your cocoa quotient, then proceed from there.

column9: Didn't like it as much as Hershey's dark chocolate
column10: I'm not a huge chocolate eater.  I don't care much for overly rich chocolates, but I do enjoy semi-sweet dark chocolates (like Hershey's) and eat them often, even if not in huge quantities.  The Newman's dark chocolate wasn't quite as tasty to me.  As other reviewers have noted, it has a rather waxy texture to it that sort of threw me off.  I felt like I couldn't taste the flavor as well because it was too smooth and waxy.  Overall it was more bitter compared to the Hershey's.  And while that may suit some people, it wasn't quite my cup of tea.  I'll stick with my semi-sweets and let the real dark chocolate lovers have the Newman's.

You call this dark?!I love dark chocolate--the darker, the better: anything in the 80%+ cacao range is just dandy, as far as I'm concerned. Admittedly, it should have been obvious from the 54% designation on the wrapper that this was in another category altogether--call it "dark chocolate lite," for people who would really rather just have a Hershey bar. But I guess I had hoped that the fact that it was organic and fair-traded would somehow make up for the missing cacao. In general, I really support what Newman's Own is trying to accomplish.Alas, it was not to be. My main objection is that it tastes mass produced, like a so-called high-end chocolate bar you'd buy in a supermarket but that really is just a run-of-the-mill bar imported from Europe. In particular, there's a subtle but annoying undertaste that I don't detect in the other dark chocolate bars I'm fond of. I don't know if it's the soy lecithin or something related to how it's processed--there really are very few ingredients, which is good--but each bite has elicited nothing more than "eh" from me. I shared some of it with a chocoholic friend who also has a fondness for the really dark stuff, and her reaction was the same as mine.As a taste test, I bought one of Newman's Own's 70% cacao bars, which was the darkest I could find in that line in my local health food store, and it was somewhat better--at least the undertaste was missing. But it too falls short of what I seek in my empty calories, so I won't be buying any more of these, at least not until I see cacao content of 80%+.If you enjoy very dark chocolate, try Equal Exchange's 80% (lovely texture), Endangered Species 88% (with the black panther on the wrapper) or Valrhona's 85%. There's really no comparison.Two stars for an organic, fair-traded but otherwise insipid product.

In terms of the chocolate spectrum, I usually fall between dark milk and dark chocolate. This bar was good, but fell a bit too far on the dark side for me. It has a very rich dark chocolate flavor. It's good, but was a bit much for my taste buds. It's probably best eaten in smaller doses.
This is GOOD chocolate!!  It's dark chocolate, not milk, and the flavor is intense.  I don't know what else I can say here but NOM NOM NOM please sir can I have some more?

Newman's Own dark chocolate is labeled as 54% cocoa. This percentage indicates how much of the natural cocoa butter and cacao solids are in the chocolate bar. Lighter chocolates typically contain more milk and sugar (and/or other ingredients) by weight. The higher the percentage of cacao in a chocolate bar, the darker and more bitter the chocolate becomes.At 54%, I'd have to rate this as a medium dark chocolate. I've eaten 70% chocolate and I think it's just too bitter for eating out of hand. This Newman's dark chocolate strikes a nice balance: it's dark enough to get some of the health benefits from the flavonoid content of dark chocolate without having the bitter flavor. But it's not sickly sweet like some cheap national brands of chocolate. I like that the ingredients are organic so I can avoid artificial flavors, high-fructose corn syrup, and the other icky ingredients some brands add to their products. Newman's has a nice flavor and doesn't leave a bitter aftertaste. It's got a rich mouthfeel without being too heavy and doesn't leave my teeth feeling fuzzy.The nutrition facts show 330 calories for the entire bar, but the bar is divided into six segments so you can easily break off a piece and only consume 55 calories at a time. I'm not into eating huge bars in one gulp, so I appreciate this. The chocolate makes a nice after-dinner treat with coffee.

column9: Not bad but not Good enough to justify the price.
column10: Not a bad candybar it tastes just fine, but I won't be giving up Hershey's or even Cadbury's Dark chocolate bars anytime soon.What you are really paying for is the name & the opportunity to be politically correct. The candybar itself is half the size and more than twice the price of other dark choclate bars that are so similar in taste that the real bitter after-taste will be in your wallet. I would be more inclined to eat this more often if the pricing were more reasonable. Even if you are trying to do the right thing ecologically all the more reason you should not be punished by paying more for it.

column9: So nice to find chocolate that tastes like chocolate!
column10: I'd started to think that a good chocolate bar was a thing of the past. For the past several years, commercial chocolate bars taste more like coconut oils and chemicals than true milk chocolate. So I was delighted to taste NEWMAN'S OWN ORGANIC DARK CHOCOLATE BAR because it actually TASTES like good, rich dark chocolate. It is by far the best chocolate candy I've tasted in years. And by the way, after eating about half the bar, I needed a chocolate sauce for a family dessert. I simply melted the last half of the NEWMAN'S OWN Organic Dark Chocolate bar in the microwave until soft, and wisked in heavy cream - a small amount at a time. It created a truly decadent chocolate sauce! I will definitely be buying this chocolate again.

If you like dark chocolate this is good, but I find it no better than any other dark chocolate so I would go more with price. This is organic though so it does command a higher price, I prefer organics but I also have to watch the budget too. If you have the extra money, you won't go wrong buying this.

As product lines go, Newman's is tough to beat. Organic, all natural, and money goes to charity. What's not to like?For this product, however, it's a swing and a foul ball. It's not a miss. The 50+% cacao stands out, with rich dark chocolate flavor similar to other bars. However, the mouthfeel and texture of this bar is all wrong. It's not creamy in the way chocolate should be, instead it leaves a thick coating on the inside of the mouth that is both unpleasant and ruins the flavor. I'm not certain what it is, but perhaps the type of fat or the fat content they used doesn't mesh with the chocolate bar. I found it rather unenjoyable to eat the entire thing.

I like a little taste of dark chocolate as a sweet treat, that isn't quite as unhealthful as, say, a Hershey's bar... Newman's gets the balance just right for my taste.  It's dark not milk chocolate which I gather is somewhat better for you.  But its not disgustingly bitter tasting to the point that you don't feel like you're eating chocolate at all like some dark chocolates taste -- it still tastes pretty much like a good old chocolate bar (maybe slightly more "dark" / bitter).

I'm a big fan of organics as well as dark chocolate. When the Newman's Own Dark Chocolate bar arrived, I was going to pace myself and have just a little and save some for the next day. Ha! After I took the first bite, that wasn't going to happen. This chocolate, unlike other dark chocolates I've tried, was creamy and totally delicious. There was no bitter aftertaste. Best chocolate I've had in a long time.

column4: Sean P. Logue "If you can't win, change the r...
column10: This appears smaller than it is because it is thicker than standard bars.  That makes it very satisfying to eat, and helps give each bite a big chocolate taste.It is less sweet than a milk chocolate bar, but sweeter than one of the really dark bars.Still, I really liked it, and I normally like my chocolate super-dark.Sean P. Logue, 2011

As usual, Newman's own produces a superior kind of a common product.  This is a very smooth and mellow dark chocolate, with 54%cocoa.  Everyone in the family loved it, including me, and I am the milk chocolate lover in this household.  My teenage daughters love dark chocolate though, and they really loved this.  Superior ingredients really do make a superior product, and this organic chocolate was yummy!

column9: Not too sweet - not too bitter - YUM!
column10: I'm a serious chocoholic, but I tend to stay away from dark chocolate, because it's often too bitter. The Newman brand produces so many other good food products that I thought I would give this a try. What a treat! The texture is smooth, and the flavor is just right for my taste. It's just a little bit darker than semi-sweet. Not too sweet and not too bitter. So good that I wanted to eat the entire big bar in one sitting, but I forced myself to show a little (very little) restraint. Once again, the Newman brand comes through. Excellent dark chocolate bar!

I love chocolate, and especially dark chocolate, which to me has an exceptional taste. It's therefore no surprise that I really enjoyed this new chocolate bar. It has the crisp flavor of dark chocolate (it's 54% cocoa) but there is a sweetness to it that you usually don't get in dark chocolate. According to the label, all of the ingredients are organic, which is good news to those who appreciate that kind of thing. Bottom line: it is an excellent chocolate bar which I think will be enjoyed by anyone who is a chocoholic such as myself.

This is an excellent dark chocolate.  Very nice quality.  Smooth.  Not too sweet.  It is a dark chocolate (54%).  I really like dark chocolate better for treats than milk chocolate as the flavor is more enhanced.  This is one of the best dark chocolates generally available.  The fact that I can snag some anytime from Amazon is fantastic.I am planning to make a gelato this weekend with slivers of this chocolate mixed in for a kinda chocolate chip variation.  It should be really good.

Good things:1 The thickness is a plus, it is nice to bite a thicker piece of chocolate.2 It is all organic.Not so good things:1 The initial aroma is a bit off putting somewhat like a cross between coffee and ashtray.2 Takes a while to actually taste this product, it's overall weak on cocoa flavor but at least it doesn't taste like it smells!3 Has a waxiness to it, even though there is no paraffin in it, not sure why.4 My initial reaction to this supposedly dark chocolate was that it was way too sweet and not at all complex in flavor.5 Anticlimactic chocolate lacking any particularly distinguishing notes.I am a big fan of Lindt chocolate, especially the very dark high cocoa percentage bars with their rich, wonderful, full spectrum of complex flavors and fruity notes. This product was just plain bland and nothing special. Three stars instead of two because I didn't hate it but I wouldn't buy it.

There isn't much not to like about this bar, except that it seems kind of small for the price.  The chocolate is organic, it's difficult to top that.  No guilt about pesticides, etc.This bar is 54% cacao mass.  Sometimes with a super-dark chocolate the taste is very bitter.  This one is not, it has a nice mellow taste.  It's not sweet, but definitely balanced.  I am a mass-quantity chocolate eater, so that usually means milk chocolate for me.  I do like dark chocolate, but if I had the choice, it would be milk as first choice.  This one is really perfect for me because I can eat this a little bit at a time without feeling like I want to eat it all at once.  In fact, one bar lasted me about five days, which is a seriously long time in my pantry.  At this time of the year, I really need to re-think my chocolate consumption so perhaps this is the way to go, so I will eat less and perhaps enjoy more.The squares on this bar are kind of large, but easily broken up into smaller squares without wasting chocolate. Yes, I worry about wasting my chocolate, even if it is tiny amounts!  Enjoy!

column4: V S "Developed a $6 OBD1 Handheld in 1986"
column10: This wasnt really smooth or creamy at all. It had a distinct bitter taste, and was a little gritty like baker's chocolate. It was neither great, nor terrible. I wouldnt buy this as a snack, especially at the retail value.  For healthier eating, one should concentrate on main meals, not snacks and desserts. This is not one of the Newman line of "better" products, but most of them arent. Nothing beats the original salad dressing though, wow.

The chocolate taste was good (not great), and not too sweet, but the texture was lacking that silky smoothness (a bit chalky) of good dark chocolate. This is a mediocre effort all around. Not bad, but nothing I'd seek out for a second try.

column4: Mrs. K "From the wilds of the Mojave"
column10: This was nothing special. It reminded me a lot of other commercial chocolates I've tried.  I was disappointed that it was relatively waxy, and it didn't have enough of a dark chocolate flavor. It was a lot sweeter than what I expected. I would choose this over Hershey's or Ghiradelli, but there are a lot of other organic brands that provide a better chocolate experience (Dove Dark is even better than this).I did appreciate that it came wrapped in foiled paper.  It might make for a nice alternative to other commercial bars if you're looking for something wrapped up more like the old Hershey bar design. I can see someone removing the outside wrapper and putting a custom paper wrapper around the foil as a favor for a baby or wedding shower or maybe a special anniversary party.

I love chocolate in general and dark chocolate in particular.  But this chocolate bar is just ok.  It has kind of a waxy character to it and isn't what I'd call smooth.  Really kind of a slightly harsh cocoa flavor to it, which is probably due to it's high 54% cocoa content.It's certainly not bad.  I don't think I've ever met a chocolate bar that I didn't like.  But it's not especially good either.

I love the "Newman's Own" line of products, but this chocolate is not my favorite. I think if you like milk chocolate you will probably like this.  I like the 70% cacao version better but even it has a bit of a waxy taste and doesn't give you the mouth feel of truly great chocolate. While I like the 70% better, I set out the 54% next to the 70% Newman's Own and 2 people preferred the 54% - one of those 2 I consider a chocolate lover.  While I won't buy more of this, don't get me wrong. If this is sitting out next to some Hershey's, I'm going with this.I personally like Green & Black's Organic Chocolate Bar, 70% Cocoa, 3.5-Ounce Bars (Pack of 10).  MUCH better in my opinion.

column9: Too sweet with strange off flavors
column10: Organic chocolate in my experience can be pretty hit-or-miss, especially if it's American-made. This is a perfect example -- while the Newman's folks probably liked it, it just doesn't do much for me. It's too sweet for my taste (though that may be more a factor of the 54% cacao content -- I'm used to more), and it has a weird solventy aftertaste to it that just ruins it for me.I wouldn't buy it. If you like sweet dark chocolate, though, you might.

column4: Miz Ellen "all the letters of my real name"
column10: Whatever your preference, this is excellent chocolate: rich, smooth and sweet on the tongue. It kicks like a cup of coffee and serves to brighten a dull afternoon. However at 54% cocoa, it doesn't really qualify as dark chocolate.I'd draw the line for dark chocolate at about 60% cocoa content. Still rate this as a quality product, easily superior to Dove or Hershey. Newman's Organic label consistently strives for the best in their line of food products. I think they have gone for the "best" flavor here and have created a chocolate bar that is sweeter than my personal preference.If milk chocolate is for kids, then this is merely teenage chocolate...it still has some growing up to do. Real dark chocolate doesn't get by on sweetness alone. Real dark chocolate comforts because it has known adult sorrow but has managed to overcome it without becoming too bitter. Real dark chocolate knows about sin but winks at guilt. This may be too philosophical for a review about a candy product. Have some more chocolate and don't think too much about it...

column9: It's CHOCOLATE! What's not to like?
column10: This was an easy review because I love good chocolate and especially dark chocolate! This also carried the Newman name which always means quality and the fact that it is organic adds to the desirability. It is made from best ingredients and special organci cocoa beans. That said, why is it REALLY good? Because it is rich, dark chocolate that has just the right amount of that dark chocolate sharpness to it. I loved the bar and would buy more!

I think I have good taste in chocolate. I do not normally buy the everyday sweets such as Hershey, Toblerone or Godiva because I like the high-quality confection and I only want to eat it on a special occasion.  I was pleasantly surprised with Newman's Own. It reminded me of a bean-to-bar chocolate I had tried in Guatemala. It was smooth without a hint of grit, pleasant to the tongue without being overly sweet, the squares snapped brightly without any bend and if you just let a square sit on your tongue for a few moments, breathing in the taste and resisting the urge to hastily bite into it, the a perfect chocolate aroma fills your whole mouth and nose before slowly warming up and melting.  Yes, this is definitely one that I would look for on a special day!

I would certainly choose this bar over lower quality chocolate like Hershey's or Dove.  However, among the better quality chocolates like Dagoba, Lindt, Ghirardelli, etc., there isn't much that makes this bar stand out.There is a strong chocolate flavor (not at all bitter), and I also detected a hint of fruit.  I was surprised that the cocoa content is only 54%, since it has the taste and texture of a much darker chocolate.  I do appreciate the fact that it is made with real vanilla.
I am a dark chocolate person and found that this particular chocolate was a little on the bitter side. Probably good for baking; however, I am not sure if I would buy it for regular consumption.

I found this chocolate to have a waxy mouth feel with a residual grit. Almost as if the chocolate was not conched long enough. The flavor was okay but the melting point seemed to be higher than usual for chocolate so it didn't melt so well on the tongue and, rather, needed to be chewed.It could be the higher cocoa content causing these texture issues but I was hoping for this bar to make my mouth zing with smooth chocolaty goodness and it didn't come close.Left me a bit disappointed.

column9: Decent Premium Chocolate But A Bit Pricy
column10: Ever since I saw on TV how much work the cocoa farmers have to do to get their product into the sack and to market I have tried to purchase chocolate that treats the farmers more fairly. Rainforest Alliance Certified Cocoa used in Newman's Own Organics products meets this requirement.As for this product, 54% cocoa is a nice step up for people who normally do not like dark chocolate. While it may be a bit tame for those who like really dark chocolate, I thought it was quite good. It has a nice smooth texture that didn't have the waxy feel of standard store-bought chocolate. It melted smoothly without any off flavors or nasty aftertaste.So what's not to like? The price is a bit steep even for premium chocolate. Given a choice, I will stick to Divine (certified Fair Trade) for the few times I give into the chocolate urge.

"Newman's Own" products are generally very good, with high quality ingediants and perfect execution.  This Organic Dark Chocolate bar (54% cocoa) was perfectly sweet, without being bitter or too rich.  Two of us spent an hour slowly munching through one bar, savoring every bite.A real treat of high quality dark chocolate.  Definitely worth a try!

column9: Kids loved this bar, less fat, less sugar, win win
column10: I am on a restricted diet right now, so I tested Newman's Own Organics Dark Chocolate Bar on my 14 year old and her friend. Let's keep it simple, they loved it.  They found the taste more "choclatey" than cheaper bars, and even though there is way less sugar in Newman's bar, they found it nicely sweet.  I asked them if they would pay triple the price of Hershey's Dark to have this one and they said no. I asked if they would pay double and they both agreed, it would be worth it!  So there you are, the kids loved it and that's good enough for me.

I love dark chocolate, and I really like most of the other Newman's Own products. I use their Extra Bold Keurig K-Cups for my morning coffee, for example, and their salsa is a household staple. I like this too, although I will have to do some price comparisons the next time I'm shopping for chocolate. Nice that it's organic and rain-forest certified.This dark chocolate is 54% cacao, so not the absolutely darkest stuff out there. But it's good, has a rich chocolate flavor. Texture-wise, it's neither chalky nor oily -- that is, it seems to strike a nice balance in terms of the fat content. It leans toward the sweet side of the sugary vs. bitter scale, but not overly so.In short, well above average, unless your "average" includes boutique candies, handmade truffles, etc. Recommended!

If you like dark chocolate, this is certainly a contender.  And if you want organic, that narrows the field considerably.  For us, in an ideal world (with unlimited funds), organic would be nice.  But we happily settle for any good dark chocolate.  This wasn't bad by any stretch of the imagination, but it just did not stand out.What we didn't expect was such a great difference in the chocolate flavor compared to what we usually eat (I'll come to that in a moment).  Our favorite reasonably affordable dark chocolate is 60% cacao.  It's not organic, and doesn't have a star's name attached to it, but it's still considered a good brand.  At just 6% less than what we're used to (54%), both my wife and I were surprised that the chocolate taste didn't just jump out.What we compare to is the San Francisco-based Ghirarxxxxx Chocolate Company's 60% bittersweet chocolate.  While not organic, they at least advertise theirs as "all natural."  But we buy it for the taste.  It has a much more prominent dark chocolate flavor.  Newman's Own seemed rather bland to both of us - much more so than we would have expected for 54% vs. 60% cocoa.For some, the issue of cost may also be an issue.  Currently (at the time of this review) the 2.25 oz bar is not available on Amazon, but the 3.5 oz size is available, ranging from $1.33/oz to $2.06/oz, or ranging between roughly $21 - $33 per pound of Newman's Own.  One can go to WMart (they have frequent sales on this) or many grocery stores and pick up an 11.5 oz bag of Ghirarxxxxx Premium Baking Chips, 60% Cacao Bittersweet Chocolate, the same thing as the fancy-packaged squares on the candy aisle at a far higher price, for between $2.50 per bag (on sale) to the upper $3 range per bag.  The key is to look for it in the baking aisle in bags, where the price is far lower than the candy-aisle version.  Even at $3.50/bag, that works out to about $4.90 per pound - a considerable difference from Newman's Own.  Even if Newman's was 1/4 the price shown elsewhere on Amazon for the 3.5 oz size, in order to make it price-competitive with the Ghirarxxxxx 60% dark, we'd go for the latter without hesitation - there's that much difference in taste.  My wife uses the Ghirarxxxxx frequently for baking, and if Newman's Own was competitive in price (and available as chips instead of squares), she'd still get the Ghirarxxxxx.Some reviews complained of a waxy texture with the Newman's Own.  We didn't really find that to be the case.  It melted nicely in our mouths (which we like to do before swallowing it in order to really enjoy the taste) and had what we both considered a nice consistency.  It was simply lacking a strong chocolate taste, though what was there was still decent.  I'd expect (and generally find it to be the case) that a dark chocolate with a high percentage of cocoa would have a fairly strong chocolate taste - much stronger than the namby-pamby taste of milk chocolate (which I used to love, and no longer even enjoy since our switch to dark).Some may say we're comparing apples and oranges (organic vs. non-organic).  Yes, and I realize that's not entirely fair.  But for us, though we buy a lot of organic foods, that isn't the major consideration when it comes to "recreational" chocolate (we're really addicted ;)  ).  Taste is the major factor, followed by affordability, and hands down our preferred brand comes out the winner.  I would not anticipate a follow up purchase of Newman's Own in the future, as a result of this sample.But if you've got the money, have to have organic, and want dark chocolate, you probably won't be disappointed with this product - it just isn't a stand-out.  I honestly expected more.

I thought my review from the single item listing would carry over to here, but it didn't. I've got to warn guys off of this useless "tool."This thing was obviously designed by a woman. Trying to be "proper" with my comments, women don't have the same "hardware" to be cleaned.It doesn't fit your hand. When you're slick with soap the plastic shell makes it hard to hold onto. It's useless for building lather, even with our soft water. Both sides are too small. Because of the shell, you can't run it between your toes, nor use it even on ground-in dirt between your fingers.And I'll try to be as delicate as I can here-- For washing male "private parts," it's impossible. Both front and back.My wife's normal pink "poof" is far better.Put it in packaging you might see in an auto parts store, and label it a "tool." (Obvious male-directed marketing.) It's still trash. If I were to buy a tool as useless as this, it would be returned to the parts store ASAP.

column9: Read before using this Fish Scaler!
column10: I got this in a large pack of Dove body wash at a big name bulk store and was excited to try it out.  I normally use the pouf to shower with (Don't tell my Pals!), but decided to give this a go.  It's, as another person posted, "Like using a Brillo Pad!".  I have very sensitive skin so it's way too rough for me.  It's too small, gets very slick, and it's impossible to reach in between the Guy parts.  I don't see how any Man could ever use this other than for scrubbing dirty, greasy hands.  It's made more for the mechanic or coal miner who needs to scrub their skin to get clean and definitely not for a Guy who occasionally does some yard work, etc.  If you arrive home looking like Mike Rowe after a hard day at "Dirty Jobs" then this may just be for you!

The body puff side feels rough, and is good for scouring pores in the chest and upper back areas.  My skin does feel smoother afterwards.  It's not very good at creating lather though.  Not sure if it's because the mesh is rougher, or the mesh is only exposed on one side.The back side is too rough for the skin -- I've been using it to sand down foot calluses.Might need to just use a regular body puff to apply soap, and use the Dove shower tool as a loofah and pumice stone.

column9: If you like to shower with Brillo Pads....
column10: Then this is the shower tool for you.  I purchased these for my fiance', he used it once and said it was terrible.  I tried it once and completely agreed with him.  The exfoliate side is nice but the pouf side is so rough it's like showering with a Brillo Pad.  Not to mention it isn't poufy enough to use on some parts of the body.  I was unable to complete one shower with this "shower tool" I had to go back to my normal pouf.  If you like roughness when you take a shower and no lather with your soap than this item is for you.  I disagree with the other reviewers when they say this item provides enough lather because it doesn't provide any.  I totally agree with the other person who said that you could not use this item to clean your "personal area".  That statement is 250% true.  It's unfortunate for me that I purchased the 4 pack, now I am with 3 extras to collect dust.  I guess when I need to use a brillo pad for cleaning a pan I could use this instead.  Don't waste your money on this 4 pack before you at least purchase 1 to make sure you like them.  Chances are you will not, and will be glad you didn't buy a 4 pack like I did.

column9: Not bad, but two problems. Pad needs to be replaceable and additional rope.
column10: This item isn't bad, but it has two big problems, it needs a replaceable pad, so one wouldn't have to buy a whole new one every so often, eliminates a lot of waste that way, as with many things. The second problem is that it needs a second rope on the other side, to allow for pulling back and forth (especially on the hard to reach places on the back, nearest the neck, I modified my unit to do this. It is the same with the one made to use with AXE products. Nice idea, but needs more thought through for practical purposes.

column9: Everyone who wrote bad comments clearly doesn't like to be clean
column10: I really don't understand why everyone is bashing this product. I have tried both the axe and dove versions (basically the same things but the tan side of the dove scrubber is a little nicer than the red side of the axe version) and they do exactly what they're supposed to be doing, making me clean. Some people are saying it doesn't allow the scrubber to be replaced.... DEAL WITH IT. Its meant to last for 4-6 weeks so I don't know why you would need "replacement parts," just buy a new one! Secondly, I don't know how some people say they can't reach their "junk" with this. I don't know anyone who isn't either one, strong enough to squeeze the scrubber (Its made of rubber, mesh, and cloth; all three can bend/fold/etc. pretty easily) or two, flexible enough to touch their "junk." It's quite easy if you have any sort of motor skills.Furthermore, I just want to say I thoroughly enjoy this product (both sides) and that by combining it with the dove exfoliating body wash, I have very soft and smooth skin. Both of which are characteristics that (most) women love in regards to mens skin.The ONLY issue I have with this scrubber is that I feel like it's difficult to thoroughly wash the soap out of it at the end of the shower.LASTLY, I AM A MAN, not a woman or dove representative that has a tainted perspective of this product. I like it because it WORKS.

I got this four pack after doing research and finding out they were more expensive to buy signally from Walmart.They work great and definitely get you clean.  It took a little getting used to. At first it was if it irritated my skin, but it really didn't. It was as if it was getting scratched... but I guess that was just it working.I think I use a little less of the body wash... with better lather.I disagree with the other person who said they'd just use a cheap o applicator.  These are designed to get you clean.  And that they do.
I have been using this product for about a month and I LOVE IT.  So handy and works great.  Holds soap well and holds up to the rigors of a vigorous shower.
I have always used the soap.  Now I have a durable luffa to use with it.  It has lasted 10x longer than a typical nylon luffa.

This thing is a total waste of money. This scrubber has two sides, both are abrasive as hell. I felt like my skin was going to fall off after using this thing. It also doesn't lather up no matter how much soap you put on it. Save your money and use your girlfriends shower pouf. If you already bought one, like me, use it after working on your car or dirty yard work so your girlfriend doesn't know you are using her pouf lol.

I had been using the Axe Detailer thing, but I got these because they were cheaper. Both Axe and Dove are Unilever companies, and while they're pretty comparable, I prefer the Axe ones, because they're firmer, and the back abrasive side is more abrasive. This one isn't bad, and I can see how someone would feel the opposite way, so I guess it's just personal preference.
I'll stick with the $3 ones at Walmart that look the same but have different brand names on them
This thing is worthless!  Please, save your hard earned money.  If you decide to purchase this, good luck washing between your butt cheeks or their neighbors.  Keep trying Dove.

I've used many bags of this NOW brand Lactose and it's a top quality product (not to mention unique -- one of the only lactose sources I've been able to find).This lactose dissolves readily in liquid after stirring.This is one of the ingredients in the milk-based infant formula from the Nourishing Traditions:  The Cookbook that Challenges Politically Correct Nutrition and the Diet Dictocrats cookbook.
Great product. Love the new NOW brand packaging. I use this to make homemade baby formula, and it is an excellent product.

column9: This is a great product to clean my stomach
column10: I am sensitive to lactose, hence I drink 2% fat milk daily to clean my body.  But I have to drink 500-700cc milk in order to work.  And it will take 1-2 hours for my stomach starts to activate.By using this lactose with 200cc cold water it works great and only takes 30 min to completely flush my body.Also, this is cheap than milk.  But I don't suggest to use daily.  I use only when I travel or 2-3 times a month.

*****St. Dalfour's wonderful Certified Organic Earl Grey Tea is made from hand-picked, organic Ceylon tea. The flavor is enhanced by "the all natural flavor or bergamot orange", which added interest and made my tea experience delightful. The orange flavor was subtle, not overwhelming at all. I left the tea bag in as I drank the tea (the whole time, much longer than recommended), which turns most teas bitter, but not this one.St. Dalfour is a French firm that makes natural teas, including this organic tea. There is not a lot of information about them on their web site beyond the basics, but what is there looks good.Earl Grey teas are one of my favorite black teas, so if you are a fan also, this tea is one not to miss. Note that black tea does contain caffeine.Definitely recommended.*****

*****St. Dalfour's Certified Organic Earl Grey Tea is made from hand-picked, organic Ceylon tea. It is enhanced by "the all natural flavor or bergamot orange", which added interest and made my tea experience simply wonderful! The orange flavor was subtle, not overwhelming at all. I left the tea bag in as I drank the tea (the whole time, much longer than recommended), which turns most teas bitter, but not this one.St. Dalfour is a French firm that makes natural teas, including this organic tea. Note that black tea does contain caffeine.Definitely recommended.*****

I'm an avid tea drinker and seldom use tea bags but I'll have a few bags handy for convenience and because they have long shelf lives so I don't have to worry about using them up soon.St. Dalfour is a French brand but it's a pretty common one that you can find in many stores. The brand has been around for a long time. I like the fact that this tea is organic.I agree with the above poster that the bergamot taste in this one is pretty subtle. The tea itself has a somewhat dusky taste which is not bad and which sets itself apart from other Earl Grey's. Overall, it's not a bad tea and I recommend it.

column9: Not typical bergamot flavor - has an unappealing chemical taste that I didn't like
column10: I will stick with Tazo, Republic of Tea or another premium brand for authentic bergamot flavor. I will not buy this tea again.  Some may like the flavor but I found it cloying and slightly sweet - not Earl Grey in my book.

I first had this tea in a small restaurant in Ashland, OR and I marveled at the flavor.  When I came home to AZ I checked all the stores and couldn't find it.  Thank goodness for the internet.  I like my tea iced and so I brew for four minutes and then pour the hot tea over ice.  The box says to brew for only one minute (I haven't tried that yet) the previous tea I was using said to brew for eight minutes but it was often bitter.  Also this tea is organic which is so important for tea.  Tea leaves can't be washed after picking so it's great to know that these were grown naturally.

This is a very mild tea.  Like the previous person said it is not at all bitter.  Someone gave this to me to try and I really enjoy it.  Just started to drink teas as an alternative to coffee.  Enjoy flavored teas as an afternoon treat.  This is a wonderful full flavored mild tea.  Highly recommend for any time of the day. I have found organic teas to be less bitter and milder teas - have tried Davidsons and this and it is true with both brands.

I love these tortilla chips.  I am hypoglycemic and it is difficult to find foods that meet the criteria of my diet.  These not only meet the criteria, but they taste great and are healthy with all the of various grains.  I would recommend these to everyone!

Kenyan is one of my favorite kinds of coffee. However, this Kenyan was nothing special. Nothing bad, and nothing especially great. There are so many other wonderful coffees, why settle for average. On the positive side, the coffee was affordably priced and arrived promptly after ordering.

We really like making this as a drink (FYI, it translates as Blueberry Soup) for cold evening, and putting whip cream as a topping. Not anywhere near lo-cal, but it tastes great. Each box contains 2 pouches, and each pouch is a handy size to make 2 mugs of soup.

Over 25 years ago (I was very young), my mom found a hot blueberry beverage drink mix at a discount store.  I loved it, but we could never find it again. I recently tried to find out what it was so that I could find something similar, and this is it!  It is lovely to drink in the evening and a nice change from the herbal teas I usually drink.
The price was EXCEPTIONAL for the amount of product, and the product is a delicious as it's supposed to be. The time it took for delivery was average.
My husband and I found these in Rome and Malta on our honeymoon, and I feel in love with them.  They are the best Pringles!  I wish these were sold in the US!
Also found these while touring Europe.  Love them!  I always ask for a can when I hear someone is headed to Europe.  They taste a little like bar-b-que, but so much more.

Ordered paprika pringle potato chips.What I received was 2 cans of potato crumbs. The cans were in a cardboard box with out any packing material. Before I opened the box that it would be crumbs.That would have been OK if they weren't stale. These were as a surprise for my daughter. She had them when she was in Europe and raved about them. These she didn't rave about. What a disappointment!"

column9: Love the flavor, hate the packaging
column10: These Pringles are my favorite, and I always buy them when I go to Europe. I was so excited to see that I could order them online and did so with happiness. Then they arrived - broken, sad little Pringles. I used the crumbs to coat chicken, but could not enjoy the chips as chips because they were merely bits. I have brought these home in my suitcase with more success.

I also found these while living in France for 6 weeks.  My favorite potato chips of all time!!  I even contacted the company to see if they would distribute in teh U.S.  They said it was all based on surveys and tests, etc.  I think they are missing a great market for these here.  LLLLLLLLLOOOOOOOOOOOVVVVVVVVVVEEEEEEEEE them!

INSTEAD OF 5 of: NOW Foods Pistachios Salt, 12 Ounce Bags (Pack of 4).I RECIEVED 5 of: NOW Foods Pistachios Salt, 12 Ounce Bags (Pack of 1). IN OTHER WORDS WHAT SHOULD HAVE BEEN 20 , 12 OZ BAGS FOR $48.00, AS ADVERTISED, I RECIEVED ONLY 5, 12 OZ BAGS.  PLUS THEY ARE BUG INFESTED

column9: Best popcorn for someone with colan problems
column10: No popcorn is completely hulless however this is the best I've had. With severe colon problems for a popcorn addict...this won't hurt you!

column9: This popcorn is perfect for little ones!
column10: Our 5 year old son loves popcorn but we are always concerned about the hulls in most popcorn's and the potential choking hazard with little ones.  This popcorn is perfect!  Although there is no true "hull free" popcorn, this one comes as close as it gets!  It tastes great and, in our opinion, is very "kid friendly".  This is the only brand of popcorn we use in our popcorn machine at home!
Great product! Pops well and we love the absence of hulls. We went thru our 6 pounds in less than a month. Delicious!

column9: Strange love/hate relationship with this popcorn
column10: I think hate is too strong a word.  I do have a strange like/dislike relationship with this popcorn.  My first impression was "OMG, it's popping all over my kitchen".  My second impression was, "Look how cute it is", followed by "this tastes REALLY good".  And finally, "I need a spoon to eat this stuff".Love:1. It truly is a very "clean" popcorn.  The lack of hulls makes it 100% worthwhile2. Taste:  It's delicious.Not so much love:1. I suppose because the small seeds are so light, it is truly (as one review said) a volcanic erruption.  I had to hold a towel over the opening to my air popper to assure the seeds stayed inside and didn't fly all over the kitchen.  If you want to entertain small children, pets or even yourself, put in the recommended 1/2 cup and stand back and watch the show.  You can totally get around this by adding a generous 3/4 cups of seeds instead of the "do not exceed" 1/2 cup.  It has caused no problems with our popper.2.  Because the kernels are so small it's easy to drop them before you get them to your mouth.  This doesn't bother me that much, but it was a deal breaker for my mother when she came for a visit.Overall, I would definitely recommend this popcorn for it's taste.  My 5-year old loves the small size so I'll break out my spoon and deal with the tiny kernels.

We use a stove top popper and this absolutely my family's favorite popcorn. Hardly any unpopped kernels, it tastes fantastic and the diminutive size is charming and a lot of fun. Plus because it's so tiny, when we use the caramel flavor with it, it's all well coated and a nice sweet treat.I thought my husband wouldn't like it because it was so small, he just eats a couple pieces at a time.It pops up to about half the size of regular popcorn, very delicate and pretty and just fancy enough to thrill my daughter. No big hulls to get caught in teeth. Lovely!
Lady Finger is the BEST popcorn ever. It has small kernals, but they are so tender and there are no hulls to get stuck in your teeth. I usually order three 6lb bags at a time!!!!!  We LOVE it.

column9: If you like the bottom of the bag
column10: First the good - it tastes as good as Orville's (if you like Orville).  Now the bad - Eating Lady Finger is like eating popcorn crumbs.  If you are looking for popcorn you can eat without a spoon, try something else.  The popped corn is only slightly larger than the kernels.

If you have not tried this popcorn, you are missing out on a wonderful healthy snack. Little or no husks and taste great. This producer does things right with the packaging and shipping. I will order again from the. Thank you!!
We had a chance to try some of this popcorn at a friends house and fell in love with it.It is by far the best we have ever eaten. We will be a regular customer as time goes on.

My 11 year old son recently got braces and was devastated when his orthodontist said no more popcorn.  We tried Lady Finger popcorn and it's small enough and soft enough that he can eat it with no problems.
My daughter makes popcorn in her whirly pop.  We all agree this is the very best popcorn we have ever had!  Medium sized kernels and very flavorful.
this is very tasty popcorn and is great for smaller children because it pops with almost no shell left over.

column9: There's a reason it has less hull
column10: I'm almost embarrassed to admit it.....but, there is one reason, and one reason only that this popcorn has less hull/husk than typical popcorn...it's because the kernels are much smaller than regular size popcorn.  Smaller kernels means less hull, less popcorn (duh ;-)I don't know why I didn't think of it before ordering.  I could have purchased six pounds of popcorn at the local grocers, for a fraction of the cost.
This popcorn is excellent, crispy and tender.  I received it promptly and timely. I will recommend it to my friends and definitely buy it again.

This corn should be reserved for company or for adults because it's just too good for kids to appreciate.  The shipping is a little steep but if its used for special events, it's well worth the price.This is a very light, fragile corn with virtually no hulls.  Very good quality.
This is the best popcorn I have ever had.  Crunchy goodness. I use coconut oil and it is perfect. Try it and you won't be sorry.

The texture and flavor of this popcorn is unlike any other. Really delicious. BUT I find it best to use an air-popper as with the stovetop method many kernals refuse to pop. You'll need to double the amount and pour 1 full cup into the blower, or spend a good half an hour cleaning the house when the small kernals come roaring out like a volcano. Even then you'll be finding them crunching underfoot for a week or more. Great tasting popcorn though - a real treat.
My husband and mother love this as they hate hulls in their popcorn. I love all popcorn. Great product. I would reorder this.

This is the best tasting, easy to eat popcorn I have ever eaten. Don't even try to pop this in an air popper - the kernels are too small to stay in and just fly all over the place. It is well worth the extra effort of stove top popping. It has absolutely ruined me for any other popcorn.

column9: great in theory, not in practice
column10: There is a reason orville made it big... big kernels are easy and fun to eat.  small lady finger kernels aren't.  the popcorn tastes great, pops good, and I don't get any husks in my teeth.  The problem is that because the kernels are so small it is almost a chore to eat.
GOOD,  I like the reg. American milk chocolate better. word word word word word word word word word word word.

Could potentially yield a quality brew if I knew what the hell I was doing. Definitely recommend for a beginner to homebrewing. The only advice from experience I can give is: ignore the directions provided where it says to use cane sugar in the wort. Use malt extract for that portion and then use corn sugar when bottling. Using cane sugar makes it taste cidery, and you'll end up with a little over 2 cases of off tasting beer, unless that's what you're going for.

OMG, Venus Sausages are on Amazon!!!  Amazon you ROCK for carrying Venus.  These are the best chinese sausages in the world, I grew up eating them and they bring back great memories of dinner with my family.  Try the Taiwanese Sweet Sausages.  They are so good if you throw them in the rice cooker and it makes your rice smell delicious! I'm psyched!
I was buying these from a local Costco and they stopped carrying them.  Thank God for Amazon.  I loved them with chicken salad, tuna salad and various cheeses and spreads.
This was exactly as promised, & was a great experience. Shipping got delayed by 2 weeks due to extreme wheather back east, however, that would be UPS's fault.GOOD GOOD GOOD!!!

I thought that considering these are called "Sensible Portions" that they would be come as 5 single servings per box, but that's not the case.  The product is good, but a big open box just makes me want to overeat.
A Very nice Budget caviar pack of 12 box. Not too salty, good taste almost of the black Beluga $60.00 a jar for fraction of the cost. I would buy again.

If you're new to caviar or don't like overly fishy tastes, this is a fine pick. I prefer stronger taste and larger eggs. With better caviars, a little goes a long way. With this, you'll use larger portions - luckily, it's inexpensive enough to do so.

This caviar arrives, via Priority Mail from the USPS, not on ice but vacuum sealed in a set of four glass jars. I immediately put it into the fridge for a later date, which was today.The caviar is of the very small variety and did, despite not arriving chilled, maintain a mild crunch. The taste is over-salted, and a glance at the ingredients explains why. 620mg of sodium X 4 servings in one tiny jar of 3.5 oz. So 2480mg of sodium total. And the poor list of ingredients doesn't stop there. There is a stabilizer added, a preservative added, and three food colorings added. You may as well go to the grocery store and buy off the shelf rather than have this sent to you. I won't be buying it again. Please see my other review of a very fine salmon roe that arrives shipped overnight for free with ice packs. That same company also offers a delightful whitefish caviar that ships in the same manner and is very reasonable.

This is a lovely caviar, mildly salty.  If you are giving a gift and you're not sure if they like caviar or not, this is the one to get.  Not that the taste is weak...it is wonderful.  And you get a good sized jar, too!

Let me make this very simple. Unless you're spending $30/oz. on "inexpensive" sturgeon caviar, this may be your best option for flavor, and it's almost certainly your best option on a price / value basis. The black caviar is small (which you'd expect of white fish), but it's clean and crisp tasting, with the freshness of the sea. Works really well as a garnish. At this price and this quantity, you can't ask for anything more. Highly recommended.

I'd never tried caviar before so this was a first for me. While this brand may be filed under the inexpensive caviar list, nothing about the taste, smell or packaging seems cheap or under done. As far as taste, when paired with the usual caviar toppings and chocolate its quite tasty!
Good tasting caviar, I think I personally like the eggs when they are larger, in this caviar the eggs are small, but all the same, a tasty and well priced item.

We just bought this caviar, its a great price, and if you buy at least $25 worth, it ships for free, so I got two boxes. I have had all sort of caviar, and for the price this is great, I do wish the eggs were larger, but that costs more. At $4.69 per 3.5 ounce jar you cannot beat the price. Would buy this again!

I am not a caviar expert.  I've had the really, really good stuff and this is not it... but its not bad.  I have purchased the grocery store type for garnish or parties.  This in contrast is a finer texture with OK flavor.  I would purchase again if I needed a lot as its cheaper.  To treat myself I'd go back to the grocery store brand.  I just like the texture of larger eggs better. However these jars are wonderful.  As an artist I'm always on the lookout for small wide mouth jars - perfect.
My grandparents love caviar so I bought this hoping it would be good.  We were all pleasantly surprised.  I would order this product again.

loved it. it is as good as caviar costing as much as $650.00 and up,i would recommend this caviar to anyone who likes a fine caviar and also someone who has been wanting to try caviar but isn,t sure what to buy. i had  been buying caviar (lumpfish)for years in a 2 ounce jar for $7.99 a jar and it did not have the taste or texture of this caviar and it comes in a larger size. when i opened the package i was pleasantly supprised to find the size of these jars and again to find the taste to be as tasty as caviar costing so very much more.i will always buy this caviar again and again

I sent this as a birthday gift to a girlfriend that absolutely loves Caviar, and celebrates appetizer Fridays every week. I called to ask her how she liked it and her response was "Delicious"!! We are retired flight attendants and in our previous life enjoyed the best of the Beluga,carried home personally by either one of us. On fixed income we can no longer afford the Beluga, purchased locally.She stated that it was not only tasty but the salt was not overpowering and she was thrilled with the 4 pack for it afforded her 4 Fridays.Sent with the Mother of Pearl serving spoon and the iceing server it was the perfect elegant yet affordable gift. I will purchase the Caviar for myself in the future.My only concern was the packing. The box did not indicate it was perishable, nor was it contained in ice. I had to call her and advise what was in the package for she's known for storing gifts until her actual day.The Caviar was no surprise, however the server shipped separately was.

Tasty caviar, very small bead but with an excellent mild flavor. Goes great with about anything, and it's quite addictive - Cold Smoked Salmon and Cream Chesse with this are really good - And for the price, you can eat all you want - 4 3.5oz jars, a product of Iceland - Refrigerate well before using -

My husband has always wanted to try caviar and has asked repeatedly for me to order some as we don't get out much, plus we live in a small town and have never seen it available at restaurants here.  I ordered this one due to the affordability and good reviews and was not disappointed.  He has asked me to order two more boxes of 4, so he must have liked it.
It didn't really taste at all like caviar, salty and fishy.  I would prefer the lumpfish caviar we've had to this.

OK.. it's not beluga. But you can't beat this caviar for everyday topping for eggs, potatoes or canapes. Spread it on top of molded softened cream or other soft spreadable cheese.  Serve it with bagels, lox etc. It's just wonderful.
Excellent product and prompt delivery.  My son and I love caviar, and this Black Capelin Caviar is delicious, and I will surely order soon again.

I bought them becasue price is good and didn't see ingredients in product description, so I assume that they are caviar and salt.  Turns out it has food coloring.  Our family do not eat food coloring, so it is a big minus to us.  We ended up having to give them away.  I am sure we will enjoy it very much if there was not unatural additives. We give three stars becasue we don't want to be unfair to the vendor.  If they list more details, customers can decide better for themselves. Thank you.

I found the caviar, or rather fish eggs, to have a smooth, deep flavor.  But it had a ton of salt in it. I've been eating caviar of all kinds, especially the types, like yours, I can afford, for 48 years (since I was 10) and never had a saltier caviar. Cut DOWN on the salt, please. You will you have a better product.  I am still trying to think up ways of diluting the salt taste.  Crackers, eggs, etc. David P. McClellan

column9: taste was pretty good for the price, but the caviar was very small
column10: I read the reviews and I thought, eh, give it a try--I bought it as a gift for someone who eats caviar regularly. This would probably be good for someone who is not that familiar with caviar.  I was told that the flavor was okay and the eggs were very very small.  It's a good value for the price but I should have known to get better.
The caviar was very good with a mild taste and popped as you ate it,I would buy this product again without any problem.
This is the second caviar I've tried from Amazon that came up as highly rated and very reasonable.  What's the difference between this and the stuff from Iran?  About $950.

I love salmon caviar and other expensive caviars with large eggs. This was a gamble that the taste would be good without the expense. I am well satisfied. The eggs are very small but a thin layer spread on top of cream cheese on a bagel was just right. To really get the flavor though, it is necessary to chew the eggs. Their smallness means you might just swish them in your mouth with your tongue and that won't impart the full flavor.

this is a very mild, good caviar! I was kind of hoping it would have been a bit stronger flavored but it was very good and had tiny crunch. great on cucumber slices... mmmm :)I would order this again or sure, plus you cant beat the price! Very pleased overall
Product was okay for use as a topping on an appetizer that will stand on its own. Small eggs with  middle of the road flavor. Not the right choice to stand alone.

This caviar is on the smaller side, and is quite tasty.  Since the price isn't too high, we don't feel guilty spreading generous portions of it over buttered toast!  Give it a try, you'll thank Amazon you did.

I was excited to know that my desire for caviar was well taken care of, and for a very decent price!  Instead of a 2 oz. bottle like some sellers, this came in three ounce bottles and four to a package, making an extra four ounces, when compared to Romanoff's bottled amount!

MyThreads is new to Amazon. Hopefully, they are here to stay. Not only is the product (Icelandic caviar) tasty and relatively inexpensive, but the service was exceptional. Recently, a number of supermarkets have stopped carrying caviar. Fortunately, there is an alternative.
Great price and delivered on time. Not Beluga but I cannot afford that so this is a tasty alternative at a fraction of the cost.

column9: Caveat Emptor on this Caviar!  Well packaged Budget Caviar - But I got Sick from this!
column10: Hate to give a bad review but hopefully people who are at least sensitive to this brand will find benefit and avoid this item:I was raised with Seafood and used to eating caviar/roes and was very happy with some of the Romanoff purchases but I got sick off of this brand.Almost like a bacteria attack on my body and really bad feeling and I'm a very fit guy.
