I sent this to my Mom for Mother's Day. She's a very picky person when it comes to gifts so when she wrote me saying what a surprise it was to get such a wonderful box with such nice teas in it I was very happy. As I am far from home I'm taking her word for it.

It was interesting that Eight O'Clock Coffee French Vanilla Whole Bean came came in the door about the same time my old favorite coffee, Folger's French Vanilla Whole Bean was going out (dicontinued). The flavor of this Eight O'Clock Coffee French Vanilla is identical to that of the old Folger's French Vanilla.I also think the Amazon's price is comparable to my nearest grocer which is about 30 miles away. I used to make a monthly trip specifically to pick up 15 to 20 bags of this Eight O'Clock Coffee French Vanilla. Now, with Amazon's free shipping, I save about 1.5 hr driving and the associated fuel costs every month.

I will pass up every cafe coffee just to brew my own 8 o'clock coffee at home. The French Vanilla Whole Beam is my favorite and was a good value in the 4 bag pack...with super saver shipping it was a no-brainer.

column9: Good coffee at a good price
column10: This is a very decent whole-bean coffee with a nice flavor.  It's not as tasty as some of the more upscale brands, of course, but its also not nearly as expensive.  I got the coffee here on Amazon at a better price than I'd pay at the grocery store, but YMMV.  Anyhow, if you want a good cuppa without shelling out a ton of money, this is a good brand to try.
I like 8 o'clock coffee in general.  This has not been a disappointment. and it's a good price  using amazon prime.
What a great deal!!!  I love having it sent right to my house monthly!!!!!

Although the price is not much different from the grocery store the availibility and ease of ordering is great. No shipping charge is a great plus. My store is always running out and these guys don't.
I recently ordered the Sour Punch Twists. They arrived in perfect condition and taste fresh. I would definitely use this seller again.

Not being in the Puget Sound area, where we are used to a wide variety of bulk food availability, we turned to Amazon for finding bulgur wheat for my wife's 'famous' Tabouli Salad.We were very surprised to find this product on line and at such a reasonable price. . . we spend hours and hours and MANY miles trying to find this here in the Surprize, AZ area. . . we'd been smart to start on Amazon.
I started eating bulgur instead of rice and this was a great deal. The bulgur is great quality and delicious. Totally recommend this company to order from.
The taste is what I expected - earthy grain, somewhat nutty. Goes well with many different vegetables and meats. Quality looks about as good as it gets.

This is my favorite greek yogurt. It's thick, creamy, and of course, delicious!I usually add fresh blueberries only. As the other reviewers said, add whatever your favorite things on it.The only thing I don't like here is it's too expensive!! I got this $4.29 at a local store!Come on, $6? seriously?
This yogurt is thick and creamy, and tastes delicious mixed with your favorite low-fat or low-calorie breakfast cereal.

Excellent Greek style yogurt - it's thick & rich like sour cream but has a lot of protein with a minimal amount of carbs (plain unsweetened version). I haven't tried the fruity versions but my friends tell me they're delicious. I like to use the unsweetened plain & sweeten it up with a little sprinkle of powdered stevia. Great refreshing protein-rich low-carb snack.
I enjoy this yogurt.  It can be prepared in many exciting ways depending on your taste.  I like to add fruit, artificial sweetner and cinnamon.  Just add your favorite items and it's wonderful.

Fage Total Greek yogurt has become my absolute favorite.  I like the taste and the texture. It is creamy,firm and fresh tasting.I have many uses for Fage yogurt.  I eat it as a refreshing desert with or without fresh fruit. I use it to substitute for sour cream in recipes to lower the caloric content.  I also use it to make smoothing.I have tried many different yogurts, but Fage remains my very favorite.

column9: An excellent but excessively expensive Greek yogurt
column10: Be sure to notice that this is sold both here and in supermarkets in a 17.6 ounce container for just a little more than is charged for other brands' 32 ounce containers. I am assuming that you, gentle reader, can do arithmetic and that you see that makes Fage mighty "dear", to use an antiquated term.However it is good and reasonably well strained. By that I refer to what percentage of the liquid or whey is removed from the yogurt prior to packaging. I've made plenty of my own Greek yogurt and know that as much of the whey as you remove, more will settle out. With this yogurt, in this package, I got approximately a quarter cup of liquid. It can be stirred back in but the real point is that Greek yogurt is around twice as expensive as regular - because, of course, so much of the original weight was in the removed liquid. So if a "cheaty" producer wants to make more per container, he leaves more of the liquid in. It is up to us, the consumers (depending on the role of the FDA which I haven't investigated), to notice this and purchase the "good" products. I believe Fage is doing a reasonable job of straining but still cannot justify its price per unit.This Greek yogurt does have an excellent dairy taste and is free of the ingredients other producers use to disguise sloppiness and (to me) ruin the taste: emulsifiers, thickeners such as pectin, guar gum, locust bean gum and the like. A really good yogurt simply does not require those. It also has only a mild acidity.The ingredients listed on my current container of Fage nonfat plain Greek yogurt:-Grade A pasteurized skimmed milk-Live active yogurt cultures (L. Bulgaricus, S. Thermophilus, L. Acidophilus, Bifidus, L. Casei)A one-cup serving (227g) has 130 calories with 0% fat and cholesterol, 85mg sodium, 9g carbohydrate and 23g protein.If price is no object, I highly recommend it.

I like to eat this with honey on top. DELICIOUS. The cold consistency is firm. Almost like cheese cake (not the taste though)! For 'sour cream' I substitute 'Greek Style' plain yogurt, just don't dump the vanilla stuff on your fajita on accident. It's pronounced "Faaay-yeh" is that correct?

Greek yogurt is an acquired tasted. It is very thick and tart tasting. While it tastes good with toppings like strawberry or honey, the taste is not something that I would choose without any additional flavor.

Oh yes. This cereal is delicious. It's O-shaped corn pieces with "good things in the middle", like real oatmeal. This is a Quaker product, after all. The caramel-like taste, which I'd compare to Cap'n Crunch or old school Mr T, Gremlins and Batman cereal, is sweetened with honey, graham (cracker) flour and brown sugar.It's not a good-tasting but a great-tasting cereal, easily one of the best I've ever tried. But; get this; it's too crunchy. No, it wont get soggy in milk, at-least not in any reasonable amount of time, but that's the problem because it makes for a hard chew. If it had the texture and consistency of, say, Cheerios, it'd be perfect.marcellee.com

Pound-for-pound, Oh's is the best tasting cereal ever created. When this Cereal was being perfected, GOD morphed himself into the maker and then took over. Other than that, Ralph's grocery store needs to ad this to their list. And what ever happened to the apple cinnamon flavor?

column9: Imparts wonderful, light flavor to dishes
column10: I discovered these oils years ago, bought one of each flavor, and was thunderstruck at the quality. I use these in place of vegetable or olive oil whenever a dish calls for a similar flavor ingredient (to give it the extra flavor "kick"), but I found myself using them sparingly since I didn't know where to find more when they're gone! I'm almost out of the bottles I bought (just opened 2 of them, and they're fresh as ever!) and was thrilled to see them available on Amazon! The Lemon oil makes a wonderful Greek Saganaki (flamed Feta or Kaseri cheese), the Lime oil is fantastic for Thai cooking and it's many lime-based dishes, and the Orange oil I use in Salmon marinades, as well as with Oriental stir-fry & Chinese duck--I may even try it in making Duck a L'Orange! I don't recall what I paid when I initially purchased them, but as gourmet oils are pricey to begin with, I would consider this a reasonable price, especially considering Amazon's free shipping & the convenience of to-your-door delivery! The bottles are also attractive to display, & are so tall & slim that they take up very little space on your counter. Treat yourself to these oils!

Best used for a dinner party or family dinner, you can use it on a salad, but it that salad better be pretty darn special. I think the best meat would be chicken (white meat). Flavor of the oil will expllode in your mouth!

column9: MUCH better than low-fat dried milk!
column10: This is a review from Marc's wife:  I have throughly tested this Product.Order this exact one: Nestle Nido makes a confusing array of products with similar names and labels!  Con:Taste not IDENTICAL to whole milk!  Pro:Dissolves easily, smells good.  -Tried this as creamer in tea with sugar-a person used to whole milk in his tea thought it tasted fine.  -in cooking- tried it in my favorite pancake recipe-no perceived difference.  -tried using it as substitute for milk in a couple of sauces: no complaints from anyone, I thought it tasted slighty low-fat. Certainly in a cheese or other highly flavored sauce should be fine.  -substituted for half the non-fat dried milk in our instant hot cholate mix recipe. Everyone raved about the flavor! I noticed our mix wasn't being used up at the same phenomenal clip as people professed themselves more satisfied.- Perfect for single people who want small amounts of milk, mostly for creamer in hot beverages. If you're going to use it slowly, maybe put in a glass jar in the fridge.- Disaster supplies;earthquake,hurricane,etc.- save on gasoline! Won't have to make trips for the sole purpose of someone having milk in their coffee or cereal!- Camping,etc. where weight is an issue;bring this powder and reconstitute as needed.Buy it-you will love it! If two cans seems a big quantity for you, give/resell the other one to a friend,neighbor,etc.NEW ADVANTAGES_ADDED 8-01-11-Easier to use in cooking than liquid milk- in any recipe where it calls for scalding and then cooling the milk, you can skip that step by just mixing up the amount of milk used in your recipe from the milk powder and lukewarm water. Faster and saves on pots needed too.-Absolutely ESSENTIAL if you make yougurt at home. Milk solids are added to milk in making yougurt to stiffen the milk so the resulting yougurt will have the texture people have come to expect from store-bought yogurt.By using this whole milk powder instead of nonfat milk powder, the yougurt thickens better, and it tastes better-for the best yogurt you have ever eaten, try homemade yogurt made with whole milk AND this whole milk powder!!

column9: Best value, sorta but half expired
column10: I like the product and have been pleased with it from other vendors. I looked at all the vendors on amazon and found this one to be the best value on a delivered price per ounce value (assuming you have amazon prime). However, the savings was very small compared to the next best value and this particular vendor shipped me containers that the date stamps showed they were already at least half expired. So if you are planning on storing this and not using it all within 6 months, I suggest you buy it elsewhere. If you plan to use it all within 6 months than it is the best value for your money (maybe because it is discounted for being old stock). BTW, amazon does not allow the return of these as the are classified as "Grocery Items" which are non-returnable.

column9: good product, but not sure about seller/expiration date
column10: Another reviewer mentioned that perhaps the price is lower from this seller because the cans of Nido are nearer expiration. After receiving my 2-can package in the mail I would have to agree. I have purchased this at the supermarket with an expiration date 12-18 months away. These two, however, will expire just six months from now. Just something to be aware of if you are buying this intending it for longer-term storage.The milk itself is delicious. Much, much better than instant nonfat milks. Tastes very similar to 'real' milk and makes excellent hot chocolate!

So, I was planning food for a backpacking trip for 10, including 5 kids age 14 or younger.  And I bought this for all the reasons you might imagine.  It worked well - kids didn't really like the taste by itself, but when used with other breakfast stuff (cocoa, pancakes, etc.) it completely fit the bill.  We also used it for sauces for dinners.  And the adults weren't unhappy with the taste - actually we were fairly impressed.  Better than most of the other powdered milk we have had.  This is the stuff we'll buy for our sierra trip again next year.

Unlike powdered milk that tastes like skimmed no fat milk this product tastes like 2 percent milk and has a taste I can easily enjoy.  In building our preperations that we are going to need this is a very essential item especially with the little children.  I know I can add canned milk to powdered milk to get the better taste but this is by far an easier solution.

column9: F L A V O R.....O K....E X C E P T....I N....C O F F E E
column10: NIDO INSTANT DRY WHOLE MILK POWDER seemed the answer to the prayers of anyone with a too-small-for-their-needs-refrigerator-and-who-can't-afford-to-presently-purchase-a-new-refrigerator -- like me.  I've tried non-fat dry milk to save room in my refrigerator --but the taste is AWFUL!  I've tried to substitute sweetened condensed milk, (too sweet), and 1/2 and 1/2, (which needs refrigeration -- but not that much room in the refrigerator.  OK -- but no Vitamin D!  Nido Instant Dry Whole Milk Powder, though expensive, seemed just want I wanted -- and, though expensive, is not as expensive as buying a new refrigerator!The taste of NIDO is much better than non-fat dry milk.  And for most purposes, works quite well.  But somehow, when I try to use it with coffee -- and Splenda -- the sweetness of the Splenda is lessened.  I like sweet coffee -- but putting 3 or 4 times my usual amount of Splenda to achieve the sweetness I like in coffee could be dangerous.(My doctor has already told me to cut down, as too much Splenda seems to be bad for the liver.) I suspect that the LECITHIN in NIDO is what gets in the way of the sweetness, as lecithin is NOT found in most liquid whole milks, (that I know of, anyway).  So my advice would be to use NIDO in anything that does not require too much sweetness, (sweentess from Splenda, and/or sucralose, at any rate.)  But if you don't require too much sweetness in your coffee, it's OK to use, I guess.  And it can always be used, if an emergency strikes and your refrigerator stops working.

column9: Creates great milk froth for lattes and capps!
column10: I make a latte with this every morning. I use two tablespoons of this or the regular Nido and a bit of stevia liquid (Kal brand is the best) and use two short pours (about 3.5 oz. total) of hot water from my Nespresso and then froth with my Black & Decker frother. Both sold here. Tilt the glass and keep the frother near the top after initial mixing. Makes delicious, thick froth as good as Nespresso's. I then add a 4 oz. pour of espresso. I use the Ristretto. Mix for a second with the frother so there's still milk froth on top and add a dash of cinnamon. Delicious and only 80 calories. No smelling the milk to see if it's still good and throwing out milk that went bad if you don't use it for anything else.

column9: The next best thing to Peak Instant Milk
column10: I have used both Nido and Peak Dry Whole Milk Powder, 900-Grams for years and I will say that this is the runner-up for high quality,dried whole milk. It is great to have in the pantry for emergencies or if you simply can't ever get to the bottom of a carton of fresh milk before it goes off.* I find that Nido doesn't dissolve as readily as Peak powder.* Also,I feel that Peak simply has a superior creaminess factor to Nido,which makes it better for drinking,so I would rather use Nido for baking and cooking.* Check the expiry dates before purchase if you buying for emergency purposes,aiming at a 24 month window.
It's not as good as fresh milk, to me, but it's a good "staple" to have on hand. It tastes like VHT or shelf-stable milk, if you've ever had that. Similar to evaporated milk, but thinner, of course.
I use this as an addition to liquid milk in making homemade yogurt.  Helps make the end product richer, creamier.

I use it for coffee and tea.... no problem there, tastes good... unless one is used to those creamers in the market already.... I also drink it with the Milo chocolate powder... been doing for years now....

Actually I'd like to buy this dry milk powder. But I saw one past review saying that the expiration date of this product is Sep. 2012 which means it only has 5 months left. I left this review, because I'd like to ask the owner when is the expiration date for the product we will receive if we order now. Thanks.

Unlike most other hollandaise sauce packet preparations on the market, you don't need to add butter or milk or both to this.  This is just water, boil and it comes out perfectly silky every time.  I add an ounce of shredded cheese and dash of hot sauce for my Eggs Benedict.  Thyme and lemon for asparagus or cauliflower.  It's not cloyingly rich like homemade, and it's ready in as fast as you can boil a cup of water on the stove (stupidly fast).  We used to find this in the supermarket in the fresh veggie section clipped to the end of the aisles, then in the 'packet' aisle, then it disappeared from the store altogether and now we have to buy it online, but it's worth it at less than 2 bucks a packet.

column9: Easier than from scratch. Better tasting??
column10: The first few times I made hollandaise sauce from scratch, I failed about as often as I succeeded. You need to attend to this dish as you prepare it, or it curdles. I finally learned that lesson. When I made it right, boy did it add great taste to, for example, asparagus. On the other hand, it took lots of attention.So, as a compromise, I sometimes go to these packaged products.  Concord Foods makes a useable hollandaise sauce. The key advantage is ease of preparation. The cost? It's not as rich a taste as when I make my own. So, it's a tradeoff. But, in the end, this packaged product works well enough to justify my buying it from time to time.

The tea was great!  And was the only thing that took care of All Day sickness by the third trimester.The only bad thing about it was the company I bought it from.  They charged $17.00 shipping for two boxes of this tea.  Next time I'll be ordering this from someone else.

Just OK.  I miss coffee, so this probably influences my feedback.Simply put, other decaf teas I have tried have much more flavor-- this one just never gets to the point of being anything but weak-- even if you use two bags.That said, I like the good stuff in here, so I've been using this with a supplemental tea bag to add flavor.The idea is great-- I just wish they would do a little more product development to make this a tasty product.

column9: Beware if You are in Early Pregnancy
column10: This is a very tasty tea, but you should be very careful if you are pregnant.  I decided to check the ingredients before drinking it.  As it turns out, there is some debate regarding the very first ingredient, raspberry leaf.  It is unclear whether this is safe early in a pregnancy, or whether it should only be used at the end...when trying to induce labor.  Rather than take any chances, I threw the stuff out!I think the manufacturer should warn people not to consume this during early pregnancy, or at least advise of the risks.  The advertising is irresponsible, in my view.  No more Yogi products for me.

column4: ChibiNeko "Sooo many books, so little time!"
column10: Having tried & adored most of this brand's soup cups, I eagerly grabbed a cup of their lentil & couscous soup. Thirty minutes later, I was pretty underwhelmed by the experience.The soup may have less sodium, but it is incredibly bland tasting. It doesn't need salt, but a pinch of extra seasoning would have helped the taste. This may be great for some, but for me it would deter me from purchasing more of this product unless I were to get some extra seasoning to dump in it.The best part of the soup is that it is incredibly filling- even more so than some of McDougall's other products. It's just that I'd rather have something that tastes good rather than something that is filling. If you don't mind bland food or can season it to perfection, get this product. If you are like me & just don't have the time to season food at work, you may want to skip this & give their other products a try.*Oh, and I recommend letting this sit for 8 minutes rather than 5. It made the lentils & couscous much more tender!

column9: Very filling, great if you are on a diet!
column10: I agree with the other reviewers who commented on the filling aspects of this product. I had no idea that 190 calories could keep me full for over 4 hours! For someone who is having a rought time losing the baby weight after child number 2, this food is awesome! True, the taste can be a little bland... but I've played around with some spices to make it a little more interesting. But honestly, it doesn't taste bad and I love a) the convenience and b) the fullness factor. I will be buying this product again shortly.

Dr. McDougall's Right Foods Vegan Lentil Couscous Soup, 2.1-Ounce Cups (Pack of 6). I've tried Jenny Craig and the other nutrisystem pre-packaged food to lose weight. Most of their food is very high is sodium, tasteless, and they carry a limited vegan/vegetarian selection. On average, when you buy the extra grocery items, the cost of food $12-15. daily. I've discovered I can buy better tasting and low priced items on Amazon.This is a single serving (careful some of his products list nutrition info for 2 servings for one container). The high fiber fills you up. It's warm, good natural source of iron, Vit. A and protein. To help me lose weigh and eat correctly, I've been using a free food diary and analysis site (caloriecount dot about dot com). They give this product an A minus for nutritional value.

Like many high-carbohydrate instant "soups," the Lentil Couscous Soup is more couscous than soup.  Preparation is easy, although mine boiled over when prepared according to the very precise (1 minute, 40 seconds) cooking time in the instructions.  I would have preferred a more vague time endpoint and directions to watch for boiling.  The resulting food is quite bland as other reviewers have noted, and what this "low-sodium" (330 mg) soup really needed was more salt.  The flavors that were present were nondescript, neither the couscous nor the lentils providing a distinctive flavor note.  I kept looking at the package to see what kind of flavor I should have been expecting.  The texture was also pretty monotonous, and the couscous itself did not have the best texture, which was disappointing because good couscous is not that hard to make.  As for healthy eating, the product is essentially pasta with lentils added to provide some protein and fiber, and with 37 grams of carbs the 190 calories are pretty empty -- not all that much different from macaroni with low-fat cheese.  I'm glad I tried it, I won't mind eating the other 5 cups in the pack, but I won't be buying it again.

This flavor is awesomely good, in my opinion. I recently ordered 5 different varieties of Dr. McDougall's soups, and this flavor quickly became my favorite. I just ordered several more 6-packs of the lentil couscous soup.I was looking for high fiber, and this soup has lots of fiber. My stomach is pretty finicky, but the only problem this product caused me was a craving for more.Some people complained about it not having enough salt, but the label says "lower sodium," for goodness sakes! Duh! Anyway,I would have preferred even less sodium. For me, the flavor is great!

column9: Outstanding, quick and easy healthy meal!
column10: Reading some of the reviews for this, I was worried it would be tasteless drool...but it is very well seasoned.  The "blandness" so often mentioned by others is due to the lack of salt...and this is a "Lower Sodium" soup, so I'm not sure what else people expect.  The fact is, other seasonings cannot make up for lack of salt.  You can add other (non-sodium) seasonings and change the flavor, but it will still have something "missing".  I believe tastes very good as it is, or you can "spice it up" if you want.This soup is also very healthy (especially considering other "quick" meal or snack options)...try getting the same fiber and protein, with almost no fat or sugar and only 190 calories, in anything else this warm and filling.  Now, others seem to have tried to compare it to soup from a five-star restaurant, complaining of missing "distinct flavor notes" and incorrect "texture"...this is dehydrated soup in a cup, people!  I prepared it with hot water, and let it sit for over 5 minutes.  The soup was not "mushy" at all...the couscous was fine, the lentils were quite soft, but they did not break up into a nebulous grey glob or anything.  It is what it is, and for an instant "cup of soup", it is excellent!Considering how easy it is to store and make, the quality of ingredients, how healthy it is for a fairly filling quick meal or snack, and how inexpensive it is (the cost breaks down to less than the cost of a can of name-brand soup at the supermarket)...I am going to be buying this again for sure!

This is an excellent product!  I know many reviewers have written that it has a lousy taste, or no taste, but in my opinion it is very flavorful.  To me, it has sort of a spicy flavor that is not overwhelming.  The primary reason for eating McDougall's products is to enjoy a healthier lifestyle.  When I think of all the fast food that people think is flavorful, it makes me nauseous.The ingredients absorb all the water so it will be thick.  You can add more water if you like.  My first cup turned out perfect, and although this is a smaller-size cup it was a lot to eat.  I actually had this for my breakfast and I stayed and felt full all morning!  Actually there are only 180 calories, so that is fantastic.  Prepare yourself for a lot of gas after consuming this, but that can usually be expected after eating something so healthy.
I have really enjoyed other Dr. McDougall products, but not this one. It was really bland and needs to be cooked longer than on the directions. I gave it 2 tries, but couldn't finish either.

It isn't always easy to find vegan food.  So whenever a product is found, then there is reason to be happy.Free shipping to your door is an advantage of having Amazon Prime so you can receive vegan and other products without spending gas money.The variety of soups offered are good.  The taste is very nice - some may want to add a touch spice to the mix but don't just reach for the easy salt container.  Try fresh herbs added to the mix.Overall, a winner.

Sorry to say I thought it was tastless...not good at all...I even through out part of the one cup I made...unfortunately I am stuck with 5 of them I cannot eat because they will not take them back...JudyK
i've tried every flavor of these mcdougall soups now and i really like them all. they're the perfect eat-at-your-desk quick lunch!

I find the Lentil and CousCous flavor a little bland, but a packet of each Hot and Fire sauce from TB makes it perfect.  It's a sub-$2 vegan lunch which beats the vending machine and cafe food, thanks to Amazon's subscribe and save.
Watch out -- this comes up on Amazon when you click through to the gluten-free section, but it contains wheat.
As said less salt, I just addded some salt. Very good product.Ok, this product is good yummy and fresh in the package. Delivery time was good too. Price is excellent too. Thank you.
This one doesn't have as much flavor as the split pea, but it is still very good.  I found it thick and satisfying.

Arrived within a week, just as planned, and these soups taste awesome.  They are extremely easy to store and prepare, and are also composed of quality ingredients.  Highly recommended for travel, camping, or even for a lunch break at school or work.  All that is needed is water, a heating source, and a spoon.

Tastes great. Very warm and filling on a winter day. Heats up quickly. It doesn't really come out like "soup" as the title would suggest. More like regular couscous.I usually add a little extra water to keep it from getting too dried out. Has a strong cumin flavor.

column9: Good stuff and good for ya
column10: I like to have lo-cal nutritious alternatives around for a quick meal or snack - so I am not tempted by sweets. This lentil couscous soup fits perfectly. Add lots of Tabasco, some fresh pepper, lime zest, lime juice and green onions to give it some life and you'll be very pleased - and feel good at the same time.
Like most McDougalls soups, they are convenient but need a little seasoning. I always add a squirt of Braggs Liquid and a little hot sauce.

column9: For what it is - its ok
column10: Its fast, not a lot of calories but not a whole lot of taste either. I can eat the rest, but probably won't order this one again. I have other Dr. McDougall's and some I like - some I don't. I'll rate them as I try them.
This is nice and filling, not the best taste in the world but if your like me and trying to cut calories and feel like you've had a meal this is a great choice.
This is a great quick and healthy solution for the lunch box. Like that it is low sodium,easy to fix in a hurry and that it is Vegan with a good taste!
Being a low sodium eater I found this little cup of soup to be quite good.  The seasoning is what makes it.  I think they are great and will be ordering more.
Great Tasting! Very Healthy With Protein!  Reasonably priced as well!I always reorder before running out!Patricia
This is so yummy and healthy! Just add the hot water and have a salad while you wait for it to cook. Great vegan lunch!
Super delicious and very convenient!I love me some couscous... and add some lentils and curry flavor in there... you've got yourself a delightful lunch. :)

This is one of my favorites from this company.  It's low-calorie and tasty.  It feels like I actually ate something more than just soup.  The package is a bit smaller than some of the other varieties, probably to keep the calories low.
I only like the Light Sodium varieties, as I think the others have too much salt for such small servings. This one uses whole wheat couscous.

This product is good, and better than expected. When following the directions, it comes out thick, not like a soup. The seasoning reminds me of seasonings used in falafel mixes. I liked that it was reduced sodium, and didn't think it needed more salt. More or different spices would be good though. I didn't think it was amazing, so I rated it 4 stars. I would purchase again.

I should preface this by saying that I am not a vegan.  I eat meat!!!  That being said, I am looking to clean up my diet and I needed a quick and easy lunch to make at work that would taste good enough so that I wouldn't be running up to the hamburger stand.  I also didn't want to eat something full of all kinds of dangerous chemicals, and I wanted it to be fairly inexpensive.I saw these little soup in a cup things at Hannaford in Waterville, Maine.  I read the ingredients and it fit the bill so I bought 4 different varieties.  I am trying the lentil and couscous first and I am very pleasantly surprised.  I thought something that was low sodium vegan might be bland but it really isn't.  It's yummy and flavorful.Well done!  I might just buy a case!
This is healthy and quick and easy. My son only has 1/2 hour to eat at middle school, and this is perfect.
I've tried several Dr. McDougall's vegan soups.  This is not a favorite.  It is really too thick for soup.  It is also on the bland side.  A little hot sauce helps.
Maybe I just dont like couscous but this stuff does not taste very good!It was rather hardy once made but its hard to get over the taste!

Very healthy and filling, low in calories and sodium and very tasty too. A surprisingly good product. It's too bad that the brand doesn't have more products with nutritional information posted for I would likely buy more of them.
The "soup" is very thick (not in a pleasant way) and very bland.  It's one of my least favorite cups from Dr. McDougall's.

I like Couscous and I like lentil soup. Must have been some seasoning in this combination that I didn't like. I just couldn't get it down. My husband was able to eat it, but wasn't very fond of it either.  He thought it was very bland.

I was initially skeptical of this type of packaged soup, but was pleasantly surprised. Not only does it taste good, but the big deal with this McDougall soup is that it has minimal fat content (there are no added oils), and it has reasonably low sodium content which is rare in pre-packaged soups. So all in all, it's a great package that is worth having as an easy & healthy snack/meal on the go or part of your lunch at work.  It also goes well as a gravy/sauce over brown rice. Really good and worth a try.
I am not a huge fan of lentils but I thought with the couscous I might could eat it.Took 2-3 bites and could not finish it.

I have loved all of the other McDougalls soups that I have tried, but I have a hard time recommending this one.  It is pretty bland and the size of the cup is a bit smaller than the others.  To me, it is not worth the price.  I like the texture of the soup, however.

column9: McDougall's soups are the best "Eat to live" type soups
column10: If you follow a plant strong, no added oil diet this is the soup for you! I like the lentil couscous soup as it has 12g of protein and only just over 300mg of sodium. It is filling and it tastes good. I can even taste the small garlic pieces. This soup does not take the full 5 min to become fully hydrated which helps if you are in a rush. The price is also very good, if you do subscribe and save can't find it cheaper!

First off my "soup" boiled over at about 1 minute and frothed out of the little cup all over my plate. So then I let it sit and calm down and then I gave it another 30 seconds (trying for the 1 min and 40 sec instructions) and it boiled over again. At this point I just let it sit in the microwave for 6 minutes and then tried eating it. It was not soup though, it was very thick. Also it had no real flavor and it needed salt badly though I know it is supposed to be low sodium. But only some salt could make this blandness appealing to ingest. The texture was like couscous. Too bad I got the 6 pack. I felt compelled to eat some of it but frankly, I think I will just call this a loss and see if anyone at work wants the rest of them.

column9: Great product, but beware of all that fiber!
column10: I adore this product, but know that it has A LOT of fiber in it. I eat a very healthy diet and the fiber content was high enough that it caused me some discomfort in public.  Suffice it to say this particular flavor does not make an ideal lunch for a crowded workplace.  Other flavors of this same brand are just as delicious and have more socially acceptable results :)

It says Light on Sodium but it should say Light on Flavor.  Grind up some tree bark, soak it in water and you have this this Lentil Couscous.  I put some of this in my dog's bowl to see what he thought of it after I forced three spoonfuls down.  I swear to God my Jack Russell dry heaved.  He walked away with half of the spoonful still in the bowl and he eats EVERYTHING.  If anything, this purchase was worth it just to see my dog do that.  I will never forget the look he game me that said 'Oh man, what did you just give me?!'.  Utterly hilarious.  The five left from the package are in the garbage.

I first tasted this coffee at a conference center. Went back to the kitchen to find the brand name. I ordered the ground coffee first, but it didn't taste the same. Changed coffee makers, started using unbleached filters and filtered water, but it still didn't taste right. Finally ordered the whole beans and everything came together. What an amazingly rich flavor!!!

column9: THE BEST COFFEE YOU WILL EVER HAVE!!!
column10: This coffee is a special blend, found it in a little "Bagel store", hunted it down and found it at AMAZON! OF COURSE!After you have this coffee, this will be your coffee of choice. No after taste, no bitterness to coffee, every cup is perfect. My coffee of choice.

My wife loves coffee and right now this is her favorite. She's had a few over the years that either tied with or perhaps maybe bested Douwe Egberts, but on the whole this is her favorite day-to-day coffee. She loves it and whenever we have company over, they love it too.

This coffee is rich, dark, flavorful and aromatic, from Holland.  The taste stands out among all the other available brands of coffee, in all forms.  It has the perfect pure, full coffee flavor and it tastes just like it smells.  I first tasted Douwe Egberts coffee at a friend's home.  I had no idea what she had given me, but it was good enough to ask her what it was.  She had given me a cup of instant Douwe Egberts coffee, from a jar she had purchased in Germany.  The taste was so good and it didn't in any way resemble any instant coffee I ever had.  I thought she had brewed a pot of something special for me.  My next experience was at a restaurant, when I ordered a cup of coffee after dinner.  It was amazingly good, and when I asked the waitress what kind of coffee it was, she told me Douwe Egberts.  I noticed a pattern here.  I then began my search for the coffee.  I couldn't find a store that sells Douwe Egberts coffee, so I found it online at Amazon, and ordered two bags of whole bean.  I experimented with amounts, and finally produced that perfect cup that I had in the restaurant.  Douwe Egberts provided the best morning coffee I've ever made. Since the price is not prohibitive, I will be ordering more.

column9: Good, Smooth, Not Too Strong Cuppa Joe
column10: If you like Starbuck's coffee you will not like this coffee. It will be too "wimpy" for you. If you like Dunkin Donuts coffee...welcome home to a great cup!My husband loves Starbucks, and contrary to his opinion, I don't think coffee should be stong and BITTER. This coffee is smooth and mellow, with plenty of good coffee flavor.My perfect AM cup.
If you like a full bodied, smooth cup of coffee with great aroma, you won't be disappointed. Delivery was very prompt as well.

We first tried this coffee at a hospital in Portland, Maine. We liked it so much, we wrote the name down. It's a strong coffee, good and worth trying. We like to try different coffees and I think this one is a good one to try if you like bold blends.

I have had Douwe Egberts coffee for many years.  Mostly at resturants, which has a different proccess then the avarage home.  I have tried to find this coffee in many places & fortunitly Amazon.com was the only place I could, besides Aruba!  However, I'm not going to fly to Aruba to buy it when I need it, I will continure to order it from Amazon.com & highly recommend this coffee if you are a coffee lover like I am.

This is the best coffee on the planet, it truly is.  Super smooth, really nice deep taste.  I gave it to an uncle as a gift and he says its the only coffee he's ever had that actually tastes better without any cream & sugar.  Awesome product, highly recommended.
Best coffee ever!!!  Very smooth, not strong or bitter.  After drinking this brand I can't drink anything else!!
I love this coffee and the convenience of having it mailed to me!  The coffee has a smooth rich auroma and taste.  I really think it is the best!

Excellent coffee. I rarely ask restaurants about the coffee they brew, but last year I was so taken by the coffee that I asked and was told it was Douwe Egberts Dark European Roast. I was unable to find that particular roast, but this one is excellent as well, offering a bold flavor without being bitter.

Best tasting coffee I have ever tasted. Love the bold flavor, not bitter, no after taste. Doesn't taste like fertilizer like another brand name coffee I have tasted. Hands down the best tasting coffee, definitely worth every penny.

I drank this coffee at the grand casino biloxi and knew I had to have it. its great at any price but especially at amazons lol. the whole bean is also great since I dont grind it until I am ready to brew. you should try this if you like great coffee

This is my favorite coffee to make at home. It is great in a drip machine, a Keurig, a French press, etc... The taste is full and rich without being bitter, burnt, or too strong. It almost has a slight chocolately flavor to it. Even the beans make the whole house smell good when I put them in the grinder. I have been on auto delivery for years and the bags are always fresh and come within two or three days of shipment. It does take a few tries to perfect your cup of coffee, not too much, not too little, etc... but once you do and you can duplicate it you won't be sorry.

This is "decent" coffee but I'm not sure why all the other reviews rave about it.  It is not particularly smooth and has some bitterness - the beans are also a bit "dry" looking which is a bad sign to me as well.

I had some fantastic coffee at a Sunday Brunch. The waitress gave me the brand name which was Douwe and Egberts.  Ordered the whole beans from Amazon and unfortunately was disappointed. The coffee taste was no where near the same as at the one I enjoyed at the restaurant. The coffee was not horrible it's just that I can get the same or better quality bean from any local roaster or supermarket for less cost and trouble.

This is my favorite coffee so far. It has rich aroma and it's not bitter. If you like European style coffee you are going like this one. Amazon is usually good with packaging but this time they didn't include any paperwork and the coffee bag was not air tight. There was plenty of air inside and it effects the freshness of the product. I give 5 stars to the coffee itself.

column9: I am still looking for a rich good taste coffee.
column10: Order and delivery eas excellent. Coffee I am still looking for a rich good taste coffee. Did nott find in this flavor but better then the mountain.

column9: A nice cup of coffee, but still searching for the right blend
column10: Let me start by saying that I LOVE my coffee.  I'd been looking for Douwe Egberts coffee beans since first experiencing the very smooth, full-bodied cup about 5 years ago.  The coffee I tasted then, and in one other restaurant since, was quite distinct--the best cup of coffee I had EVER tasted.  (Those were the only two times I'd ever asked a waitress what type of coffee they served.) Until recently, I could not find Douwe Egberts coffee beans online nor in gourmet specialty shops.  The Arome Excellent that I recently found and purchased on Amazon, is pretty good, but not as full-bodied or as creamy-smooth as what I had before. (I still go to that restaurant for their great DE coffee.)  I just ordered the Arome Rood and another blend, in hopes of finding the one that most closely tastes like the cups I've had at the restaurants.Overall, this coffee is amongst the best I've brewed, but I'm still searching for the smooth blend that I had before.
This coffee not only smells wonderful while it's brewing, it has a smooth full-flavored quality that just cannot be beat!

column9: Seriously the best coffee we have ever had
column10: My husband is a full time Coffee Drinker, morning, noon, night, weekdays, weekends, summer, fall, winter, spring. We actually tasted this coffee at TGI Fridays when we went there for dinner one night, and he feel in love this coffee and asked the waitress what it was. Sadly we couldn't find it in any of our stores anywhere, and we couldn't even get it off the Douwe or Sara Lee website. Gladly Amazon is a lifesaver and we were so happy to have found it on here and such a GREAT price. We receive 2 bags every month through the subscription option. The house smells so amazing everytime we brew this coffee. Even though the package is in a different language, I think it's their middle strength of coffee but it is SO FULL of flavor better than Maxwell or Folgers anyday!

First off, I'm not a huge coffee drinker, maybe one or two cups a month, and I only drink it when it's GOOD coffee. This stuff is awesome. Not bitter at all. My husband is the coffee drinker in our house and always says that when I make his coffee it's better... that's because I make this when I make his coffee, and he just puts a breakfast blend k-cup in the Keurig. Anyway, I use my Magic Bullet to grind enough of this for about a week, then I reuse some of the old k-cups that I have cleaned out. Usually, about 1.5 tbsp of coffe or a little more will fit into the k-cup. I found some great little plastic lids here on Amazon that snap right on and Viola! Awesome single-cup coffee, which is MUCH cheaper than shelling out $11 for a box of 18 k-cups! I actually use the same coffee grounds twice to get a bigger cup of coffee. Anyway, I hope this helps. This is great coffee, and it's very smooth. Definitely worth trying.

Having recently got a Superautomatic I was looking around for some nice but not overly pricey COffee Beans.  I wanted to try out several before settling down on the ones I like best and decided to try this Dutch Coffee Brand.  Generally one hears about the South American or African or Hawaiian grown coffees, or other coffees where Starbucks is trying to sell a story along with the coffee etc etc. So I figured I'd be a contrarian and try out this unheard of brand, but I am very satisfied with the Douwe Egbert Beans.  When I got it was about 25% more on Amazon than it currently is, even then I thought it was an excellent choice.  Not a Barista Connoisseur by any stretch of imagination but I see great Crema every time I make an espresso, so the beans must be very good in my mind.  As I try more beans if I find a striking difference compared to other brands, I will update this review as appropriate.

We first had Douwe Egberts coffee at the Farmstead Inn in Shipshewana, IN, on vacation.  Since then, no other coffee quite measures up.  This coffee is definitely worth the price.  It is never bitter, and just has an EXCELLENT taste.  It's our absolute favorite and as long as they are making it, we'll be buying it!

There are a lot of great coffees around, but this is simply the best. It is smooth and buttery with subtle nutty undertones, there is no bitterness. It is a medium roast that is full of flavor - perfect for that everyday cup. The beans are so aromatic, they will make your mouth water in anticipation of that great cup of coffee. You can find this coffee in restaurants, but the flavor is a bit different. The restaurant version has a very sweet taste. These beans don't have that sweetness, but give a much fuller flavor - similar to the flavor you would expect of a gourmet blend.
Nice medium roast. Pleasing aroma. No bitterness. Price is reasonable enough for me that I have made it my "everyday" coffee. (Still searching for my "special occasion" coffee.)

We were told by a relative this was the best coffee they had had.We love our morning coffee and we use a Jura compressa machine to make it. We were not pleased with the taste of this coffee even compared to local store brands. Still better than instant coffee.

This coffee was ok...I had Douwe Egbert at a buffet at Fallsview Casino in Niagara Fall Canada.I loved it! It did not taste like this variety however. I seem to migrate back to Starbucks French Roast whole bean. I do like to try other coffees once in a while.

After drinking some most excellent coffee in Hungary, I discovered it was Douwe Egberts coffee, so I ordered some from Amazon.  After paying almost as much in postage as the package of coffee cost, I was extremely disappointed in the coffee itself.  The package I received was stale and flavorless.  I can buy Tully's French Roast at the supermarket for about $7 per 12 ounces, and it is far better coffee, fresh, with a rich aroma, full bodied flavor and no harshness or bitterness.
Very fruity and tasty - my personal favorite acai tea. Expensive as all Teavana teas are, but well worth it.

There are sometimes where I could definitely use a great warm cup of coffee, to keep my day going. While I've tried so many different brands from Maxwell House, and Taster's Choice, there is no coffee that really stands out like Folger's. I love their coffee the most becasue it is delicious, and smells the best. This 12 pack of individual 2 oz. jars, is very convient in price for coffee, becasue most jars cost about $5.00 in price. Although I just wish they could've packaged bigger jars of the instant brand, rather than the small, tiny ones. I absolutely recommend Folger's coffee the most, and if you haven't tried their coffee, get this coffee, and smell the aroma yourself.Price: BTaste: AOverall: A-
My cats love it, they don't puke it up and it's corn free.  Great for one cat with grain sensitivities.  Pricey though.

I started using this food after much research. My cat was diagnosed with stomach cancer. She needed a food that did not contain grains and was high in protein. It also had to be good for cats with sensitive stomachs. I also had a cat with diabetes. She needed a no grain food. This food met the needs of both cats. They have both since passed away but I continue to use this food. My 7 month old cat loves it as well as my 2 ferals I take care of. Yes it is pricey but greatr for cats with health problems. Cats do not need wheat or gluten. They need protein. Cat food or dog food should have chicken or fish as the fist ingredient not chicken meal or some by product. Add some of this food to your existing food at first and slowly change them over.

My cats are picky.  They will not eat wet cat food if it's grilled, diced, or sliced.  It has to be the classic cat food "mush" and it can't contain tuna.  Luckily, they love Blue Buffalo chicken and turkey, as well as their salmon variety.  Great product!

Not one of my 5 cats will touch this food which is supposed to contain good ingredients. I bought a case of this because of amazon reviews; I was looking for "healthy" food for my guys when Friskies was dissed a few times. My guys like chicken and turkey so I thought this would be met with wagging tails and slurpy eating...it was not.Most cat food can be left out for about 12 hours (so say several cat food guides). This one starts to STINK badly within a few hours. Can you blame the cats for not liking it??Unfortunately I cannot return it since I opened 3 different cans, thinking that perhaps just one or 2 were tainted. The cost to return would be high since it's a heavy case, so I'm stuck...will probably just chuck it...maybe my chickens will eat it, since they will eat icky things from the ground, like worms in dirt.I would NOT recommend this "stuff." I am out $34+ and not very happy about that!

column9: These are the BEST sour gummies!
column10: I thought the five-flavor sour gummies(in the green bag) was fantastic. Then I tried the mix o reds, and now the red ones are all I want.  This is my addiction - they are SO good!  Perfectly sour, and perfectly juicy... perfectly addictive!  I'd buy them here, but this is a ridiculously high price for this candy.  The grocery store usually has them for $1.50 or $1.75 per pack, and occasionally, $1 per pack.  Now do the math on these (divide by 12, and...whatever!).

I make this product, not as a sauce, but as a seasoning for steak. I first add a little olive oil, then I add the Au Jus and end it with soy sauce (instead of salt or pepper as they dries and bitters your steak if left on too long during marination). Afterwards, I marinate in the fridge from 4 hours to overnight.  Then I pan sear + oven cook the steaks.  The result: the taste is just as good as any steak I've eaten at any of Bobby Flay's restaurants.  It's that good.

i originally purchased this product in an attempt to quit smoking by using this mullein and some lavender to help with my cravings to smoke. not only does is taste great as an herbal cigarette, the sender left a little card with instructions for how to make a delicious tea with her product! i was very happy with this service and how quickly the product arrived. Thank you!

I looooooove these medium sized peach gummies!! they are a pretty concentrated peach flavored candy so if you like something that is light, and doesn't liven your senses then this isn't the candy for you. They are very very sweet and have a strong peach flavor. I prefer not so much of the sugar coating so I rub some off. But overall, this is a great peach gummy candy and is now my favorite!!

So, at first glance, these just look like any other Olive stuffed with pimento. But they're not! Both the olives and the peppers used are unique varietals and they go together beautifully. I thought the "buttery" description was just ad copy when I first got them, but something about this olive variety really is more hearty and buttery than the typical martini olive. And the peppers use have a more vibrant, sweet character than pimento that really pops and complements the olive. They are easily my favorite olive, and furthermore the only brand I've tried that stands out among martini olives.The only problem with them is that I snack on them too much, so they never last. Even worse: the only local store that carries them always runs out of the pepper variety almost immediately, so they're never in stock. The citrus ones are tasty too but the flavors don't complement each other as well, so you really want these ones in particular.So let's put it this way: I'm on Amazon today because I'm willing to pay a $2.00 premium per jar to get these olives shipped to me, THAT's how good they are!
Great tasting olives.  Perfect for your straight-up martini (gin, of course.) So much better than a bar olive! Pricey, but worth it.
I was very pleased with the quality and pricing of this item!  I've used it primarily for baking--but great in apple cider, too.

First:  You've got to be kidding me, $50.00 for one damn bottle?  This reseller has no business sense and believes in ripping their customer off.  I can't believe you would actually sell this and say it's pricy but try to back it up by saing it's rare.  IT's NOT RARE!  many local stores sell this in my area and at $1.50 a bottle.Now, this is a pretty good product, it's okay.  I love drinks in aluminum bottles, they just seem to carry more flavor over and contain their "crispness".  I have to admit though, it's still made with corn syrup and the small bottle doesn't justify spending that kind of money ($1.50) on this drink.  I'd rather spend the money on a 12oz glass bottle, mexico coke.  Mexico coke is made with real sugar and also tasts better.  3 stars for the product considering taste/value.0 stars for this worthless company gouging your wallet.

Found this bottle for the first time while travelling through JFK-New York.  Searched all over Utah for more and only found a few limited independent stores selling them. Ordered a case through Amazon/AlwaysDirect. Coke seems to taste so much better out of this bottle . . very refreshing and stays cold!!

I had it for the first time at a NYC Sheraton while attending the U.S. Open tennis. Don't know why, but it is extra refreshing to drink chilled right out of the aluminum bottle~don't pour over ice~ definitely a must try!!
you can get this for less then $5.00, please people shop around i have this same item and it did not cost $50.00
this bottle is not rare! don't waste your money. its worth like a dollar. tons of stores near me sell these. gosh
10 bucks a soda? Are you kidding? I can buy these at Wegman's for 2 bucks each. RIP OFFWhy would anyone waste money on this?

I was really happy to find this online thru Amazon, I have bought spices from  Sunny Caribbee while traveling, they are very good , especially the fish spice. Last time there I purchased a pound worth. Excellent on any white fish.

Have been using their spices for 21 yrs. I have gotten several of my friends hooked on them also. Favorites are Seasoned Sea Salt, Herb Pepper Blend, and Fish Spice- would say I use these everyday...Also like- Presto Pesto and Sunshine Salsa. We started going down to the British Virgin Islands in 1991 and bought spices the first time then...now if we aren't making a trip down I order them online. You will LOVE them!
I've had their sauces before, which I'd highly recommend, and their spices/rubs didn't disappoint!  Great flavors on anything you're cooking.

I don't do unsweetened, unsalted, peanut butter made from 100% peanuts, but I do like my peanut butter "spread" to be all-natural without high fructose corn syrup or hydrogenated oils.  This spread fits the bill, with a better flavor than it's Jif or Skippy counterparts.

Don't let the previous negative reviews fool you. This peanut butter ROCKS! It's as peanutty as can be, making the texture slightly thicker and a bit stiff. Not a big deal, just take an extra 15 seconds to spread it. As far as fillers go, there aren't any, just (in order) roasted peanuts, ONLY 3 grams of sugar per 32 gram serving, with only 3.5 grams of saturated fat and only 6% sodium. The nutritional values are very high, including substantial levels of Niacin, Magnesium, Vitamin E, Iron and Calcium. Of course there will be a bit of naturally occurring oil, but it's minimal and does not need stirring like other Natural peanut butter. My daughters and I, sometimes eat it right off the spoon! If you enjoy baking peanut butter cookies, you'll never use any other brand of peanut butter. TRY IT!

almost expired when I got it!  I ordered like 8 of this to share it with my family out of the country, it will take time for the package to get there, so I figured by the time they can have it, its expired, so there's no sense of ordering this many.  4 package in 1.  It still better to get in the grocery store, so you can check the expiration date.

I must say I was a bit skeptical and little hesitant to purchase this product after reading other reviews. We are usually a Jiff only family. However, this came up on sale, so I decided to give it a try. FANTASTIC!!! It is not oily and weak as others have stated. The product we received was very rich and flavorful. I actually prefer over Jiff now. The kids raved about it.

I'm a huge peanut butter fan and tried pretty much every peanut butter by every brand and I honestly think this is the worse peanut butter I had ever tried. It tastes terrible and is kind of rubbery. This is my least favorite brand of peanut butter.

I assumed that, like most natural peanut butters, this would contain peanuts and nothing else. Wrong! After tasting the first sugary bite, I checked the ingredients. Not only sugar, but salt and palm oil! One of the reasons I eat peanut butter is that the real kind has no cholesterol. Palm oil, on the other hand, is a tropical oil that is high in saturated fats. I'm very frugal and it takes alot to make me throw something out, but this stuff went in the trash. Unhealthy and unpleasantly sweet!

column9: Doesn't spread and DOES need stirring!
column10: I bought the Planters Natural Creamy Peanut Butter because it had 2g less carbs than the Jif Natural. The label itself says no need to stir, but that was not true. It had a thick layer of oil on top. Also, it didn't spread well at all, it rolled around on the bread and tore it up. I went back to Jif Natural. I'll sacrifice the extra 2g of carbs for peanut butter that is easy to spread, slightly better tasting, and really doesn't need stirring.

column9: Compare this to Maple Grove Farms one ingredient: 100% peanuts
column10: I tried Planters Natural peanut butter because of a coupon offer and thought the name represented high quality. After reading the ingredients on the label: peanuts, sugar, palm oil and salt I was skeptical but because of the low bargain price I decided to try it. Very disappointed. Oily taste, faint taste of peanuts. I always buy Maple Grove Farms at my local Pathmark or any brand with the magical ingredient of just peanuts, sometimes with some salt. I am frugal but the taste of 100% peanuts is worth the price and I don't think its any more expensive/or perhaps just a little more expensive than the poorer quality brands. Far superior to this disappointment.

I haven't tasted this.  But it is listed as Peanut Butter.  And the label pictured says "Peanut Butter *Spread* "Plus, it says 90% peanuts.  Don't make a mistake and buy this, thinking that it is peanut butter.  It is not!

I use potatoes a lot and by the time I have to cook and peel and slice them--I'm almost too tired to eat them. I also live by myself and if I buy the bags--they usually spoil before I can eat them all.I love these sliced canned potatoes, I use them in soups and fry them for breakfast and they are so good with ketchip on them.Libbys seems to be the best I have found, in quality and flavor.Everything I have purchased from Libbys at Amazon.com has been really great.

column9: Used for years - Camping - salads -fried w/eggs-Ham
column10: This is the best on the market - RINSE very well then pan fry/dice for potato salad/ add to crockpot meals last 20/30 minutes to heat thru.

When there is only one or two persons in the household, these are perfect. You don't have to keep a lot of potatoes around to go rotten, they save the effort of peeling, and they are just the right amount for a meal for one or two people. Price is right too.

I agree with the other reviewers. These are handy, quick additions to home cooked meals. I'm cooking more at home and zipping less frequently through the fast food lines. These make for quick, easier cost effective meals at home OR around the campfire. BONUS: no more stinky rotten potatoes at home!

welllllllllll,i never thot i would brag on canned potatoes! especially since i haven't bought many in my cooking life. none of that mushy stuff at the bottom of can. uniformly cut. i just opened a can, drained the water, put a little peanut oil in a 10" frying pan and ate em all - heh.  also ordered another case, since i know i will have them on a regular basis.  like others, convenience and much much less work and no rotting or dried up potatoes in the pantry. i'm thinking of scalloped potatoes next.  this is a perfect staple for anyone, but especially the aging and/or disabled, which i might be one or both. i'm gonna have to stop with the ordering, as i'm running out of storage space.  but i know i'm well stocked and that can really make one feel secure.

I like to keep canned potatoes on hand to make potato soup or fried potatoes or put in vegetable soup.  I like being able to have Amazon ship it at certain times without having to place the order.  Libby is also a quality product.Gingerraye
I really like this product because u can just open a can and it is ready to use after a little  warming up.

I love potatoes! And before I bought these I was frying the frozen shredded hash browns we get at Albertson's. But the Libby's potatoes tasted much better and I pan fry them in olive oil, adding various ingredients some times, but most of the time by themselves. In fact these days I eat a can and a half a day by myself.AND they make great potato salad too.BUT THE PACKAGING IS POOR. Several times the cans came so dented they could not be opened with a can opener. I complained and Amazon replaced them but if they used wrinkled up wrapping paper for packing instead of air pockets they wouldn't have these problems.Walmart use the paper and their products all arive undamaged.

My dog is extremely picky, but she definitely preferred the plain hooves for whatever reason.  I can't say its a problem with the product, which arrived quickly, well-packaged and in good condition.  But the plain one she has chewed on for weeks, whereas she showed no interest in these.  Fortunately it wasn't terribly expensive, as I think the remaining hooves are going to the neighbor's dog.

I was surprised to get this product and read the ingredient label which is different from the one listed on the item's description. The third ingredient is molasses which my dog can not have. I hope the ingredients are updated to avoid upset customers.
I first had this in a Latin restaurant and chased it down to make at home. when the local supply disappeared, i started buying it on line. Fruity without being too sweet. i drink the decaf version.

I bought three bags of this at my local grocery store when it was on sale for $1 per bag.  It smelled bad upon opening the bag, I soaked it as directed on the package and tossed it with some spaghetti.  Inedible!  The second bag I soaked, rinsed, and then soaked in red wine for 1 hour.  YUK!  I threw the third bag directly into the trash.

Great product.  Bought as Halloween treat for my grandsons.  The Cocoa mix is orange in color when mixed with water or milk.  Looks cool to the youngsters and tastes like regular cocoa. Delivered quickly and as advertised.

column9: GO DAWGS!!!  University of Washington  Good Stuff!
column10: "WOW! You're going to University of Washington!"  I made my son a box of things to take along to his dorm and thought this was fun to add.  I also gave one to his sister and grandma to share the excitement.  They loved it  :)
It smells bad, drinks bad, and the color is orange,it is not chololate totally.If I can return it, I will do it.
The pecans are good, not great.  I've had others that were like eating candy.  Although, they do offer bigger cans.

These pecans are just delish.  A little bit sweet. A little bit salty.  Crunchy and crispy.  It is difficult not to scarf down the whole container.  I have ordered these many times and given them in gift baskets.....always found consistant deliciousness.
I have ordered these nuts many times now, they are the best honey roasted pecans i have had, would recommend to all to punches from this company, prompt service and reasonable prices, will be back

column9: Salty - these are better with unsalted butter
column10: I bought this cookie mix locally and have made it several times.  The first time I used regular salted butter and the cookies were too salty (I like salt, but this was too salty even for me or my family)... I've used all of Betty Crocker's cookie mixes and none of the others have ever been salty tasting.  So after that first time of making the white chip macadamia cookies, I've made sure to use unsalted butter (and of course I use a large egg as instructed on the package) and I add a packed tablespoon of brown sugar.  Everybody loves these cookies this way!  They are really good.  I used the medium size OXO cookie scoop, and bake on a parchment paper-line baking sheet at 350* for 11 minutes.I think I paid two or three dollars per package for this cookie mix locally.

column9: My loud mouth cat loves it.
column10: My Cat is coming up on his 13th year and suddenly when we are home he never stops yowling. There is nothing wrong with him medically, he just began demanding an insane amount of attention (he already gets more attention than most children) and begs for food even when he is not hungry because he wants you to come in the kitchen and pay attention to him. So as much as I love incessant meowing while I am trying to read, type, talk or think.....Anywho we didn't want to reward the yowling with treats or feeding him at times other than his normal meals but ignoring the behavior as per the vet and other people instructed simply did not work. After months of his crying we chalked it up to old age and wound up just giving him treats and snacks of his wet food so we could have a phone conversation without the person on the other line thinking we were killing our animal. He mostly ignored the extra food and would gobble up the treats but we knew it wasn't a perma fix. So we tried the cat milk. He loves it. Laps it up like me at a $2 martini happy hour. It appears to have a soothing effect on him because he stops meowing for a while after he gets it. Plus we feed him premium food and he was still a little flaky. (I think due to the dry heat in our home) The cat milk seems to help with the flakiness and his coat seems smoother. I would definitely limit it to a small serving once a day, I gave him a leetle too much when I first got it and I paid for it the next day when I was scooping the box. Other than the one incident it actually seems to help his poop. cheers!

column9: Great for cats that don't drink enough fluids
column10: My older cat, male, has had issues with dehydration, constipation (I know, too much information), so I tried one of these and he drinks quite a bit, and so I've started to mix a little water in it. He's 14, was getting very thin, and it seems that this has helped him put on a little weight.

My cat kept getting sick and refusing to eat.  He would go anorexic and become lethargic I had to keep taking him to the vet.  The last time it was so bad that he was put on IV's for dehydration.  He also had a high fever and some other weird stuff going on.  I was really afraid he was not going to live very long (he was only about 4 years old).  After he was back home from the vets and feeling better, it started up again within a week.  He stopped eating and became lethargic.  My husband bought Whiskas Milk because we were trying to get him to at least drink something.  I was going to bottle feed him if I had to, but as soon as he sniffed the Whiskas Milk, he cleaned out the dish and he has not been sick since then and it has been about 2 years.  I give him a small amount several times a week or whenever he asks for it.  There must be some kind of nutrition in it that he needed that he was not getting.  If I forget to give it to him, he'll meow in a different tone so I know he wants it.  It's really a miracle, he went from being a very sick cat to very healthy.  I have not taken him to the vets since I started giving him the milk.  My other two cats who are healthy will not drink it at all, but that's okay, they don't need it.
My cats all 4 of them love this milk-Thank goodness it was available here-for some reason no one in town had it-It was actually a pretty good deal!

Several years ago I realized that two of my cats were prone to bladder infections.  I started giving them Whiskas Cat Milk before bedtime just as a means of getting more fluid into their systems, and they love it!  No bladder infections in years, and no other pre-bedtime treat will suffice!

This product and CAT SIP are both really great for any kitty that is underweight due to kidney failure or anything else that has left your kitty not eating or drinking enough.  It's also a nice treat for any kitty but be careful not to give too much at a time or too frequently.

Whiskas has a very-fine formulation, for all felines. It comes in 200mL cartons, and is affordable .. for almost any cat-owner. It's 98% reduced, in lactose ... and contains malt and calcium (of course), for the health of the feline. Use this, and alternate with a helping of "regular" milk, in doses .. and you shouldn't be disappointed with the results.

column9: My picky old cat loves it!
column10: My cat is seventeen and in the early stage of kidney failure. She barely eats anything, mainly justs sucks juice out of her canned food. She barely touches her dry food or treats. She was getting so bony and I worried about her. So I decided to try the whiskas cat milk and she loves it! She also put on weight and looks healthier. She likes it cold from the fridge, I keep it in an empty pb jar and use disposable paper bowls, because she begs for it all day. Yes, if you need some extra nutrition or hydration or just a tasty treat, I'd buy some whiskas cat milk. Dogs love it too!

I bought this one time when PetSmart was out of Cat-Sip Real Milk. My cats wouldn't even try it. They ran up to it excitedly, expecting it to be Cat-Sip. They each sniffed it, and literally turned their noses up! Then they just walked away. It didn't go to waste as my dogs were excited to have it. Passed the dog taste test, but that doesn't mean much. After reading the ingredients, I probably shouldn't have even fed it to my dogs. Full of random stuff: guar gum, corn syrup solids...just to name a couple. And it is completely watered down too. I'm going to stick with Cat-Sip, and I recommend you try that brand as well. Cat-Sip has only 3 ingredients; low fat milk, lactase enzyme (to help the cats break down the dairy as cats are naturally lactose intolerant), and taurine (an essential nutrient for cats). Also, Cat-Sip is usually a few cents cheaper than the Wiskas stuff!

column9: One of the many highlights of my kittens day!
column10: My 7 month old kitten loves this milk! He actually begs for it every single day at the same exact time each day, sometimes more but I only give it to him once a day.  There are 3 to 4 servings in each little container and he really seems to like it. column9: Save yoursefl some money and use lactaid
column10: Most cats have a hard time digesting cows' milk, as much as they love it.  The problem is the lactose, and Whiskas Catmilk is a reduced lactose milk product with taurine and other vitamins added.Cats need taurine.  Most mammals can make their own, but cats can't.  They have to eat taurine.  However, powdered taurine is cheap, and you can find it right here on Amazon.  These little boxes of brown milk will cost you more per ounce than grass fed organic milk costs.  For me, it makes sense to keep them handy, because my geyser cat can keep this stuff down when no other food product will stay in her, and that keeps her out of a fatty liver crisis.  But if what you are trying to accomplish is as simple as giving your cat who eats normal food a treat?  Try having a carton of lactaid on hand.
My cat just loves this milk, which is great because it makes it a lot easier to give her the medication she needs.
a great product for kittens and adult cats. They have no problem digesting this product. I will continue to buy for my pets.

The picture on the product page still shows the older, rectangular packaging. What arrived was 24 of the new, smaller containers but they hold the same amount of Whiskas Cat Milk. I applaud Whiskas for reducing the packaging but, since I'm a bit slow, I ordered this based on the picture of the old rectangular boxes. My local store started carrying the new packs and I, without bothering to read the fine print, thought they were selling less product for the same price. I'm glad I did though because this was a great buy (of course I now have over a 6 month supply but the "Best By" date is beyond the 6 months).I started giving this to my little IBS kitty every day because she was on a course of medicine that, although it was supposed to be tuna flavored, she wouldn't take. I mixed it into the Cat Milk and she lapped it up. After we'd finished up the medicine, she still asked for her Cat Milk treat so now I give it to her while I dish out everyone's canned food. It's a perfect distraction 'cause she used to try to "help" and be in the way "testing" each bowl as I dished out the canned food. I guess you could say the Cat Milk is a bribe but either the medicine worked or the Cat Milk helped (or both) 'cause she's put back on the weight she'd lost during her last Irritable Bowl bout (and when my vet weighed her he said keep on doing whatever it is you're doing).

I definitely recommend this product. My cats can be finicky but when it comes to milk they go nuts. I don't like giving my cats regular milk because it makes them sick, so I bought this for them. Great alternative, highly recommend!

I was on a cruise and had a Spicy Chipotle Martini.  It was yummy.  Sweet with a little kick!  Loved it!  Here is the recipe.  Hope you like it as much as me.2 oz Finlandia (or your favorite Vodka)1 oz Monin Chipolte Pineapple syrup1 oz Pineapple Juice1/2 oz simple syrup6-8 mint leaves, Garnish with Mint Leaf

Really good product. I bought this after having a chipotle pineapple mojito at a local restaurant. It really gives a nice chipotle kick which helps cut the sweetness of the pineapple. If you like chipotle, you should try this syrup. It could be adapted for use in any number of drinks. Plus, it is sweetened with cane rather than refined sugar or high fructose corn syrup. That alone made it an easy purchase for me. I have used about 1/3 of one bottle in making 6 or 7 mojitos so far. I am probably a bit heavy handed with my pour on this as I like the chipotle so much and these have been made in tall glasses. So, you should be able to get at least 20-25 drinks from a bottle--more if you are lighter than me on your mix.Update--I like my drinks really spicy so I was tending to overpour the Monin. Two problems there: uses too much syrup and it tends towards the too sweet side. My solution was to cut back on the Monin and sprinkle a bit of chipotle chili powder in my drink. Works great that way for me.

column9: Splinters easily. GI vs Ranger Rib

Swallowing these sharp pieces could be very dangerous and has me monitoring my dog very closely when she chews on these ranger ribs.I previously bought the Merrick GI bones. The bone is much thicker and does not splinter. One bone for her has lasted her (collie/hound mix) for more than a month and she has barely cracked the bone. Other breeds, her roommate the american bulldog/lab mix makes it look easier to crack the GI bone, but she practically devours the ranger rib very quickly.I would consider buying the ranger ribs only on a treat basis. MAYBE once a week if at that. They get eaten up way too fast. Although they are much cheaper than the GI bones, I don't believe they are worth buying if you want a bone that will last.
