column10: This product looks so good but tastes so awful. How can you ruin cocoa? Emerald has. This is not the adult treat it appears to be, but something only the kiddies will love. Way too much fake vanilla and not enough 'get down' cocoa flavor. What a serious disappointment. Just awful.

When these came out I couldn't get enough of them... until I read the ingredients. THERE ARE ARTIFICIAL FLAVORS IN THIS "HEALTHY" SNACK! I stopped cold turkey! Still jonesing for them when I pass them in the store isles. But, I just found here on Amazon that Blue Diamond puts one out as well with no BAD ingredients, according to their website. Gonna give them a try. EMERALD IS CHEATING & MISLEADIING! They know what they're doing. That's like the MSG flavoring in Chinese food...BAD!

I popped several of these into my mouth without reading the ingredients (which I thought were pretty well covered in the product description). They tasted good for a brief instant and got progressively worse as I chewed. For one thing, they're quite dry (if this review for some reason piques your desire to whip out your credit card, make sure you have mass quantities of liquid on hand--you'll need it). These are, in fact, the driest almonds I've ever eaten.The Dutch-processed cocoa used tasted anemic (I grew up on Hershey's). Insult compounded injury in the form of a bizarre aftertaste. This prompted me to actually read the label...imagine my surprise at discovering that the nuts are sweetened by none other than Sucralose.I don't like Sucralose. The feeling is apparently mutual: it gives me a headache.2 oz. of Cocoa Roast Almonds (Emerald having eschewed the two-word modifier) provides 150 calories, 120 of which, despite their dryness, are from fat. It seems to me that those watching their weight and/or sugar intake could probably find a more enjoyable source of 150 calories.

Emerald Cocoa Roast Almonds, Dark Chocolate, hit the nose quite pleasantly when the canister is opened. Each almond is coated in a dark chocolate cocoa powder, and it really is a nice little treat, even though I normally don't go for almonds when sifting through a can of mixed nuts. I also tend to prefer a more traditional chocolate coating on nuts, but I'm still giving these 5 stars. While I probably wouldn't choose them over a bag of chocolate covered peanuts, these are a high-quality and highly enjoyable alternative that I kept popping into my mouth despite my usual aversion to almonds outside of an Almond Joy bar or bag of M&M's. You'll need a drink handy though. Almonds are dry little nuts, and since these employ a powder for their not very sweet cocoa flavoring, they're no exception. The container is very attractive, by the way, and my only complaint about it is that it does not close very securely. I mean, it's one of those lids you can turn easily past the tightening point. Still, a great product I highly recommend trying to anyone who loves the taste of cocoa and almonds. Might not be your cup of tea, but they're well worth a try.From the container:Ingredients: Dry Roasted Almonds, Modified Food Starch (potato), Natural and Artificial Flavors, Cocoa Powder (processed with alkali), Salt, Acesulfame Potassium, Sucralose.Allergy Information: Processed on equipment that also processes other tree nuts, peanuts, wheat, soy, milk, and sesame seeds. May contain other tree nuts, peanuts, wheat, soy, milk, and sesame seeds.Nutritional Information per serving (l ounce): Calories 150, 120 from fat, Total Fat 13g, Saturated Fat 1g, Trans Fat 0, Polyunsaturated Fat 3g, Monounsaturated Fat 8g, Cholesterol 0, Sodium 25mg, Potassium 210mg, Total Carbohydrate 6g, Dietary Fiber 3g, Sugars 1g, Protein 6g, Calcium 6%, Iron 8%, Vitamin E 35%.

column9: Two tastes that don't mix well
column10: I was excited to try this product.  I am reasonable fan of almonds.  (especially fond of smoked almonds) and I like chocolate.However the combination of the dry cocoa powder, which is slightly bitter, and the dry unsalted taste of the almond doesn't really seem to work.Frankly first impression is one of blandness.Maybe because my palette leans toward the sweet side, these just seem bland.  The combination almost offsets the benefits of either taste.  It's just not a sweet taste, and that was what I expected.

I love real chocolate covered almonds, so I was not expecting to like these "cocoa roast almonds". I must say I was pleasantly surprised. They have a nice chocolate flavor, not too sweet, and very crunchy, toasted almonds. For the same calories as regular almonds, that's quite a feat. My only complaint would be they're a little dry. Have a beverage nearby to fully enjoy your snack. I passed them around at work and the consensus was "pretty good!" It's not as good as the real thing, but quite a good substitute!

column9: Somewhat dry, but a pleasant enough alternative to chocolate coated nuts...
column10: Emerald's Cocoa Roast Almonds is a fine, alternative way to indulge ones chocolate/nut cravings without all of the chocolate calories.Rather than dipping almonds into chocolate syrup or batter, the nuts are roasted with a lightly coated layer of chocolate powder. One ounce is only 150 calories, with only one gram of saturated fats, making this a healthy alternative to standard chocolate treats.The taste? Pleasant enough, but lacking the inherent richness one commonly associates with the tasty combo of chocolate and nuts, replaced in its stead by the fairly dry, pasty sensation of dipping whole nuts into instant hot chocolate mix. This means that Emerald's Cocoa Roast Almonds is a fairly satisfying nut snack, even if it is rather lacking as a chocolate one.All in all, not bad, but best washed down with a cold, or hot, glass of milk.

column4: Anthony Lawrence "Unix, Linux and Mac OS X"
column9: I did not care for this.
column10: I was first disappointed to read the ingredient list and find chemical names that I don't even recognize.  It wasn't horrible, but I'd rather have a more pure product.I popped a handful in my mouth and at first thought the flavor was good, but very quickly came a bitter or stale after-taste.Definitely not something I'd recommend.  We'll be tossing these out for the birds and the squirrels.

These taste great and are heart healthy.Features and benefits:  Lightly sweet with a hint of dark chocolate flavored cocoa powder. A light chocolate flavor and big crunch, without the calories and fat of chocolate-dipped nuts. Baked-in flavor = no mess!Only 150 calories per serving: the same number of calories as a handful of regular almonds!  Excellent source of Vitamin E  No trans fat  Low sodium  On-the-go canister fits in car cup holder  Twist-on lid locks in freshness  Lid measures 1.5 oz serving of nutsEat these for fun too!

column9: Way to much splenda on these.
column10: These would have been a lot better if they hadn't coated them in splenda. Bleh I wish that it was clearly printed on the front of this product that it contained sucralose and I would have chosen another flavor. That's something I feel should be clearly printed on the front of the label and not hidden in the ingredients list on the back. I do not eat sucralose because it causes my eczema to flair and I feel that if it's doing that then it must be causing some sort if harm in my body. I do NOT like not having it clearly stated that this product contains it.****update**** 10/26/2011I changed my stars (from 1-3) even though I still think the sucralose (splenda) should be labeled better but because the person I gave them to really enjoys them. So if you able and willing to eat sucralose that this product maybe worth a try for you.

The nuts were very tasty and if you don't mind the artificial sweeteners, they may be for you.  If you are expecting chocolate covered almonds, you'll be disappointed.  They are what they say however; "cocoa roasted".  They have a modest cocoa flavor with a bit of sweetness.The reason I gave them only 2 stars is because they fail to disclose on the front label that they contain not only one but two artificial sweeteners.  This annoys me because 1) artificial sweeteners bother my stomach and 2) many people don't want to eat artificial sweeteners or give them to their kids.  It irks me when manufacturers try to pawn their wares as a "healthy" snack yet omit the fact that they contain artificial sweeteners or ingredients.One used to be able to spot artificial sweeteners easily by "sugar free" or "NutraSweet" clearly printed on the label but for some reason, the FSA allows products to contain sucralose (a.k.a. Splenda) without any clear labeling at all.  You must read the ingredients to learn these nuts contain both sucralose and acesulfame potassium, two artificial sweeteners.  Shame on you Emerald!

column9: These Almonds Have Me Sitting On The Fence
column10: When I got my hands on these Emerald Cocoa Roast Almonds, I thought that the concept was actually pretty good.  I had my doubts, though.  When I opened the container, there was a very, very light chocolate smell that was overwhelmed by the natural smell of the almonds.After trying a few of the almonds, I tasted only a slight hint of chocolate (especially in the aftertaste).  I tasted no salt whatsoever.  The almonds themselves had a rather bland taste to them.  Perhaps it was the mixing of the two flavors that negated both of them.  Mind you, there was nothing terrible about the taste.  It was just bland.The crunch factor was about the only redeeming quality of these almonds.  Dry roasting provided a very nice loud crunch.  The dark chocolate "dust" wasn't messy, but a tiny tad of it did get on my fingers.  It was easily washed off, however, and this really isn't a major concern for me.What has me fence-sitting, though, is the fact that when my wife came home later in the evening, she tried the almonds and fell in love with them.  I was fully prepared to give a two-star rating to these almonds until she gave them such glowing approval.  In the end, I guess that it all boils down to personal taste.  If you like very light and (at least to me) very bland chocolate and nutty tastes mixed together, get yourself some of these Emerald Cocoa Roast Almonds.  However, if you're taste buds lean heavier towards the chocolate end of the spectrum, stick with Goobers.

column9: Great taste and convenience, questionable ingredients
column10: There's a lot to love about these nuts.- Great taste.  Subtle, not overpowering chocolate flavor.- Convenient package (bounces if it hits the floor, easy to pour, etc.)- No sticky mess on your hands.  Not gonna melt on a hike.But alas, I don't plan on getting these again.  Here's why:- "Artificial flavors."  Who wants that stuff?- Acesulfame Potassium and sucralose.  Ugh :(You know, give me nuts with a few more calories but all-natural, and I'll be a happier snacker.  I bet you would be, too.

column9: WHEN "NUTS TO YOU!" IS A GOOD THING
column10: Upon opening this can of almonds we first noticed the fresh aroma - a very good sign.  They tasted as if they'd been packed yesterday. We love chocolate covered nuts, but these are the first nuts we have tried that were covered with a chocolate powder rather than the usual chocolate glaze, and we liked the change very much.  The powder coating seemed to enrich the taste of the nuts rather than covering it. We have found them to be appreciated when served with pre-dinner cocktails or as an after supper treat.  They're a welcome addition to our pantry shelf!
Almonds dusted with dark chocolate was very good eaten by itself, on ice cream or cereal.  For not wanting it too sweet, it was just right.

column9: Good product, but pricing change abused
column10: These are great!  BUT, the price went up 40% on last Subscribe & Save shipment.  Now it's back down to the normal price.  Very questionable pricing policy.

column9: Bought a whole bunch of these in early 2010 & they are still fresh!
column10: I bought a whole bunch of these in early 2010 & they are still fresh now mid 2012. I only have a few jars left but the ones I've been opening still seem fresh and just as good as when I bought them in 2010.

Completely takes care of my sweet-tooth, they are heart-healthy, very filling even at half a serving, taste great, and the pricing on here, if you subscribe, WAS about the same as the cheapest price you can find locally if you continuously hunt for sales and bargains over weeks times. This was much easier. But Amazon stopped this?You shouldn't pay over $4-5 for an 11 oz. canister. All the sellers I saw on here recently were charging way over even the suggested retail price. I guess if you aren't able to get them locally where you live, you may desperately have to resort to that if you love them....otherwise, either wait until Amazon starts selling them again, or I am going to have to search for local sales.

column9: Heaven for low-carbers and almond addicts
column10: Low-carbers who've experienced the make-or-break chocolate-craving moment can thank their lucky stars that these exist. Just when your will is weakest, a few of these extremely chocolatey treats can make a respectable substitute for peanut M&Ms. In a way, they're even better, because they don't make your blood sugar seesaw wildly.I do agree with some of the critical reviews of these almonds: They are not for people who hate Splenda. However, I don't find the amount of Splenda excessive. I find it just right. Most importantly, the almonds are huge and fresh and perfectly roasted. The cap also makes a handy serving size. I keep one canister in the car and one by my desk to ward off hunger pangs and candy cravings. And my 5-year-old son loves these and eats 'em like candy. He doesn't know they're good for him... that'll be my little secret.
These things are ridiculously good - and low carb!! Great way to get a chocolate fix. Surprisingly, one serving has fewer calories (150) than the plain Blue Diamond roasted almonds (170).
they taste great, the chocolate flavor is a nice subtle one, they are baked very well and the overall package is just awesome.

Everything about these nuts are subtle.This is what makes them taste perfect to me.Nothing over-powers & it comes together for a perfect taste.The one thing I have not seen mentioned that is very important to me is texture.These have the perfect roast, not to brittle & dry, & not too soft.A great crunch.I was really very pleasantly surprised & will buy these again for sure.

What can I say...taste great and good for you!  Everywhere you read nowadays it is saying chocolate (dark) is good for you...yippee!  And nuts are too.  Combine them and you get Emerald Cocoa Roast Almonds.  When you buy here at Amazon with the Subscribe & Save...it's a GREAT DEAL!  Nice tasty, healthy snack.Emerald Cocoa Roast Almonds, Dark Chocolate, 11oz Canister (Pack of 4)

column9: Great taste and a great almond!!!
column10: Use these almonds everyday as a snack. Leave them at home and measure 1/4 cup of nuts out for a snack to take to work with you during the day. Do not keep them on your desk because you wont stop eating them!!

To me nuts are ho-hum.  I can take them or leave them.  They are a good snack and make you full; these on the other hand are awesome!!!I have to move the canister so I wouldn't eat them all.To me at first bite it tastes like a chocolate covered donut.  The flavor mixture of almond and semi-sweet dark chocolate makes my taste buds do a happy dance.I have found my new pick me up, need something sweet that won't ruin my calories for the day, snack!!

column9: Best Almonds ever esp if you are trying to control salt.
column10: Best Almonds ever esp if you are trying to control salt.As an added bonus, Cocoa is an antioxidant. Enjoy. I eat 2 boxes of these a week.

These have a lot less sugar than other brands, but still a lot of chocolate flavor.  I'd eat plain almonds every now and then but they left my mouth dry.  These are addictive, and I eat them every day.  They make a great, healthy snack.

I have been trying to cut way down on my sugar content.  I have a huge sweet tooth and trying to eat healthier is a challenge.  I really liked this product a lot.  It very much helps me with my chocolate craving.  Yes they are dry, they are ALMONDS! There is a tiny aftertaste from the Sucralose but I HATE any kind of artificial sweetners and really for me this wasn't bad in the least.  This is a health food product not candy and I think should be rated as such.

Yes, almonds are one of the good foods and so is dark chocolate. Put them together and you've got a can't beat combination. These almonds are toasted to perfection and the antioxidants in there are good for you. The only danger with this terrific snack is the possibility of overeating. Try these one time and no other almonds will compare.

I wasn't even aware of Emerald Cocoa Roast Almonds until earlier this week. I saw that Amazon was having a sale on most all of that brand, the reviews looked great and so I ordered them.Not really sure what to expect when I got these, I opened them up and tried one. Immediately I was hooked!! The best way I can describe the flavor is nutty with a rich cocoa flavor that's not too sweet. My daughter compared the flavor (not the sweetness) to Cocoa Puffs. I'm not sure about that, but figured I'd add it into my review anyway.I like that these have a good amount of protein, not a much sugar (sweetened w/ sucralose) and relatively low in carbs. All in all a good snack alternative to satisfy my sweet cravings.At the time of this review these Emerald nuts and many others are being offered at a nice checkout discount and if you choose Subscribe & Save it is an even better deal!

column9: Perfect for a nip of chocolate flavor without gooey sweetness
column10: I love these almonds.  They are absolutely perfect for that mid-afternoon snack time when your tongue is desiring chocolate but your body needs something a bit more healthful to get through the day.These have a very light cocoa flavoring.  I appreciate that because I find them refreshing rather than cloying in their sweetness.  It's just enough of an accent to the natural almond flavor to be interesting without overwhelming the nut.  I appreciate, too, that this doesn't have the sugar content of candy, but it satisfies the craving.

This was a tasty product, if you like the bittersweet taste of dark chocolate.  I liked that it was "healthy" with the almonds. The chocolate coating was like a dusting of that you might use for cocoa, rather than the creamy chocolate of a candy bar.  It would be good for a light snack that also has some health benefits in case you're looking for that in a snack.

column9: Sooooo Yummy but plan on going to the gym afterwards!
column10: These arrived in the mail and although I am usually the one to open all packages my husband got to these first. How did I know that? Well, half the container was mysteriously empty and the UPS guy JUST delivered them. After one bite of these delicious nuts, I solved the mystery. My husband was in his office just finishing off his last handful when I walked in and he yells "THESE ARE ADDICTIVE, THEY ARE INCREDIBLE". Right then and there I knew, I could only eat a few more or someone would have to call the show Intervention on me. I like almonds but these are exceptional with their slight, not overwhelming cocoa/chocolately taste. They taste  so good I just can't bring myself to buy anymore because one is just not enough. I HIGHLY recommend these in moderation otherwise, eat a whole container but then spend at least an entire week at the gym burning them off. Enjoy!!

column9: Chocolate Covered Almonds w/o the Chocolate?
column10: Cocoa Roast Almonds?  Dark chocolate flavor?Well, I love nuts, and I also love chocolate.  And these almonds DO have a chocolate flavor to them - no doubt about it.  Of course the do NOT have that nice, soft, creamy chocolate covering that melts in your mouth...  But then, the only reason you are even CONSIDERING these is because ... you are on a diet.  (sigh).Considering the diet restrictions, this product will give you the taste satisfaction of chocolate and nuts, but not all the satisfaction of sucking off the chocolate and then eating the nut.  Sorry about that, but that's the way it is.  But, you do get a very healthy snack, and if you are wanting something different, the strong hint of dark chocolate, you gotta try these!

I'd heard about these from a few people, but the price in the supermarket, generally about $6/jar, kept me from trying them.  These aren't too sweet and the chocolate flavor isn't overwhelming--think of a dark chocolate bar.  I don't have much of a sweet tooth so I found these pretty satisfying, but I'd keep these as an occasional treat only.

These are surprisingly good - and actually, they are not as addictive as salted almonds.  I can find myself eating maybe 10 of these cocoa roast ones at a time before closing the container.  Of course most nuts and chocolate go together very well but this was definitely a clever idea.

column9: Crisp, cocoa flavored is a winner any day
column10: I got this product from Amazon just a few days after placing an order. I was pleasantly surprised by its contents. Crisp roasted almonds with cocoa flavor sounds almost irresistible any day. I almost finished the carton that day, as I kept going back to it as I studied.This is a healthful and tasty treat for anyone who wants to eat right.

I like the Emerald Cocoa Roast Almonds.  They are still crunchy and have the light dusting of Cocoa so it is not too rich nor too light.  You still have the taste of the almonds as well.Nice snack if you just want a quick bite and on the run.  Get Emerald Cocoa Roast Almonds.

column9: Training is everything. The peach was once a bitter almond; cauliflower is nothing but cabbage with a college education.-M.Twain
column10: I don't usually like plain almonds; when I eat almonds they are usually highly sugared, covered in cinnamon or gooey'd up in honey like the ones you can get warm at the mall.  When I saw this product, I thought it sounded yummy, so I thought I'd give them a try, turns out I was right.  They have just enough cocoa to satisfy my sweet tooth, but not too much that it covers up the flavor of the nut.  It's not as sweet or as sugared as those mall almonds, these have a more subtle taste.I have been trying to snack in between meals and found grabbing a small handful of these was both delicious and satisfying.  Even my husband and son enjoyed them.  I was pleasantly surprised with this product and can see me keeping these in my pantry for my little midnight snack attacks.Cherise Everhard, June 2008

column9: Definitely different and a nice change from salted nuts
column10: I really like Emerald nuts, and have been buying their smoked almonds and cashews a while. These cocoa roast almonds preserve much of what I like about Emerald nuts - freshness, not too much oil, high quality - but are more of a semi-sweet snack instead of a salty one.Their sweetness doesn't come from sugar, though. They are sweetened lightly with sucralose (the sweetener sold under the brand name Splenda).Note that the product doesn't contain chocolate, though it's described as "dark chocolate flavor". The cocoa is roasted into the surface of the nut, but the almonds are not coated in chocolate. The good part about that is that they don't make a mess, and they're a better choice for someone who is trying to avoid sweets. But I'm sure some have bought these expecting to get chocolate and were disappointed.I liked them enough that I'll get them again, especially when I need something to cut the craving for chocolate candy. They have just enough chocolate flavor to do that, while having only one gram of sugars per serving.

I tried them and they are quite good - a novelty over regular almonds. The quality was quite high. The nuts in a newly opened package were fresh and crisp in texture with a very good taste.  I had 3 people try them, and all three said they liked them, and two said they would buy them at the grocery.  I would also buy them. Now more people have tried them with very positve response.  The only negative was too much green in the packaging, which did not affect the flavor if served in the dark.

column9: As a snack, ok.  As an ingredient, wonderful.
column10: As a snack directly out out of the can I found these dry.  I guess when I think of chocolate almonds I like the mouth feel of actual chocolate melting and thus these almonds left me wanting more.  However, I found them to be an excellent ingredient in recipes that call for almonds.  Since they have  a LOT less salt than the typical almond they do not conflict with the sweetness of a dessert and the coating seems to keep them more crunchy in the batter.  I used them both whole in  brownies (fantastic) and chopped in choc chip cookies (great).  I chopped up too many for the cookies and used them to dust over vanilla ice cream served with the brownies.  Everyone raved about them.

"Chocolate without guilt" is a good idea, and coating nuts with sweetened cocoa powder (the sweetener is a mixture of a sugar alcohol -- sucralose -- and acesulfame) not a bad one at all. But the result is disappointing.The chocolate and almond tastes tend to hide each other rather than to complement each other. I was expecting an intense chocolate+almond taste, but didn't get it. There wasn't much of either.I tried sucking off the cocoa, but the naked almond was not particularly satisfying. A "good" almond, but not a great one.Almonds have a relatively delicate taste that (for me) is best appreciated without any enhancement. (I never cared for Jordan almonds.) A cocoa coating would probably work better with a stronger-flavored nut.

Almonds in this product are quite good.  The coating is well-bonded, and they are neat to eat.  Having the lid measure out a 1.5 ounce serving is a nice touch, but not a big deal.  The flavor definitely reminds me more of cocoa than of chocolate, and isn't terribly strong.  Definitely do not buy these thinking you are getting chocolate-covered nuts of some sort!  But they are a decently healthy snack, and much healthier than eating said chocolate-covered nuts.  I'd rate them higher if the price was more economical, but as it is they are too pricey for a casual snack, but not "snazzy" enough for something ornate and formal.  For this price, I'd rather get cashews!

Usually when I think of nuts and chocolate together, I imagine the typical chocolate-dipped candy that happens to have a nut inside.  These Emerald Cocoa Roast Almonds were a surprise departure from the "candy" path.  The nuts are dusted with a fine layer of dark chocolate power, meaning that the almond flavor is primary with a subtle chocolate background.  As a person who loves both those flavors, I felt like I was getting the best of both worlds...  a healthy snack that had a bit more "zing" than the typical offering.If I were in the mood for something to munch on without resorting to candy, this would be something I'd now consider as a possibility.  Another nice feature is the packaging...  the lid measures out a serving when you use it as the "bowl" for the nuts.  That goes a long ways towards avoiding the typical over-estimation of portion size.Good flavor, helpful packaging...  This probably won't be my last purchase of these almonds.

column9: Nuts and chocolate, how can you go wrong?
column10: Chocolate and nuts, two things that are great by themselves, but even better together!I love almonds, raw, roasted, spicy, sweet, you name it. So when I had the opportunity to try these I jumped on them.The first thing I did was read the label and I was disappointed to see that they added artificial flavoring and sweetener to them, not exactly my favorite thing to read on a label. Nonetheless I cracked the package open and tasted.After eating a small handful I was glad to see that they weren't overly sweet and you still tasted the almond.The chocolate coating is a dry coating, so it doesn't melt off or leave a sticky residue. Sadly though I found the chocolate to be a bit weak and more of a semi-sweet, not dark.The nuts themselves were high quality, not a single one was over roasted or left a bitter nasty taste in my mouth, Diamond definitely provides a high quality nut!Overall these are a great snack, barely sweet and with a hint of cocoa. That and they are a good source of protein and vitamin E.

Not too sweet, not too plain. Perfect amount of dark chocolate coating, great cruncy treat, perfect for movies, at the theater or at home. Nobody else whose tried 'em didn't like 'em. If you like almonds or chocolate you're in, if you like both pace yourself.

'Men's Health' magazine has been heralding nutritious foods for men of different ages for some time now.  Almonds have conspicuously been high on their lists (along with Merlot wine and dark chocolate) as a flavorful food high on the chart for heart health.While I've implemented almonds in my diet for quite some time now, I couldn't help but notice Emerald's "Cocoa Roast" Almonds are fresher and tastier than the "bulk" almonds I get at the grocery store.  With a hint of dark chocolate, yet retaining a nutty "roasted" base, these savory little nuggets make a good, light snack.High in vitamin E, iron, and calcium, and having mostly good lipids (fats), almonds are a delicious way to keep a balanced diet.  Don't expect "Cocoa Roast" Almonds to be a total confection--like chocolate covered raisins.  With only 150 calories per ounce, a little bit goes a long way.  Having only the best ingredients, these almonds are a great reward for all hard-working people on the go.(With four canisters per order and 11 oz each, you can reward yourself nutritiously for an entire month!)(Nutrition: 5 *'s, Taste 3.5 *'s, Value 4.5 *'s  Overall: 4 stars)

Being an almond farmer myself, I am always interested to see what new flavors come out. Emerald is a subsidiary of Diamond Walnuts. The description indicates that this flavor is a substitute for the  chocolate covered nuts you may have already had.These merely have cocoa baked onto them. It does give the nut a nice earthy flavor. They have been roasted to the proper crunchiness. But these are not very sweet. If you are looking for them to be a dessert type snack you will be disappointed. The flavor is slightly more savory. The cocoa does not come off in your hand as much as you might expect... a good thing. These would be a nice classy addition to a party/gathering.

Wow. These are amazing. They are not coated with chocolate candy, like one would expect. They are simply flavored (and have a dark, powdery look) with dark chocolate. They are not too sweet. They don't taste like candy. They are every chocolate and almond lover's dream - a snack that doesn't overpower the almond with candy.I do have one problem with this product. Keeping it away from my husband.

Pretty good! I was expecting them to be covered in Cocoa, but it really is just a light dusting. Very tasty, good for watching a movie with a cool beverage. My wife feels the same way. I will buy more at the store when these run out.

column9: great for the dark chocolate and almonds lover
column10: When I had ordered this product, I was expecting lightly dark chocolate covered almonds. These almonds were a bit different from what I had expected. They're actually almonds that have been dusted with dark cocoa powder.  I only point this out for others who may have expected smooth dark chocolate covered almonds. At any rate, these almonds were still very delicious and the dark chocolate cocoa powder complimented the taste of roasted almonds very nicely. Here are some pros and cons in my humble opinon:Pros:-Great taste with a bouquet of complex aromas and textures... yummy.-Large 11 oz canister container, perhaps not good if you're on a diet :)Cons:-I would've liked it a bit sweeter... perhaps a touch of honey would have been splendid... in fact, I'm sure it would've been.conclusion: If you enjoy roasted almonds and love dark chocolate, these almonds will hit the spot. Just remember... these are dusted, not chocolate dipped!

I'm not paranoid about artificial sweetners, but I am unable to eat Sucralose (AKA Splenda). One soda with the stuff in it gives me a migraine. Being an idiot, I've tested this with several different Splenda containing products & found that the sweetner is the problem. SO if you are like me, avoid this product.That said, I did pop a few in my mouth before reading the label & they are yummy. I am only a sometimes fan of almonds, but I love dark chocolate.My partner (who doesn't have a Splenda hating noggin & who loves dark chocolate even more than me) was quite fond of these little nuggets. 6g protein (and 13g fat) in a 1/4 cup...not bad. Though I do wonder what they'd taste like if the Sucralose were left out...

I would hope it would go without saying, but if you don't like plain almonds, you probably won't like them sprinkled with cocoa powder. I like almonds, particularly for their health benefits that are fairly well known. I usually avoid them covered in salt and flavoring powder, but I'm glad I gave these a try. The packaging suggests Dark Chocolate, and it would be easy to get the wrong idea that these will taste chocolate in the sense of Milk Chocolate perhaps. I just expected them to taste like almonds and cocoa, which they do, so they are semi sweet and like other reviewers have noted, they will appeal most to dark chocolate fans.

column9: Emerald - Cocoa Roast Alomonds, Net Wt. 11 ounces
column10: Delicious snack that's easily addictive. I like this flavor just as much as the other two Emerald cannister of almonds I've tried recently. Has a most distinctive dark chocolate almond flavor. I've seen this item in the grocery  store for $2.99 and sometimes slightly higher. Appears to have the chocolate powder sprinkled and baked onto the almond - so there's no mess. Great to sneak in under your jacket when catching a movie at the neighborhood theater.

What I expected were almonds covered with a chocolate glaze, like the ones you'd get at the movies, except dark instead of milk chocolate. These aren't that. The almonds are instead covered with a very light, only subtly sweet powdering of chocolate - only one gram of sugar per quarter-cup serving, which is hardly any. It's not really a sweet and you don't feel like you're eating candy. If you have these around, the kids won't eat them. They'll leave them for you.

column4: Raquel S. "Avid Amazon Fan and Kindle User"
column9: Cocoa Roast Almonds - Yummy all the way.
column10: Emerald makes great nuts and their delicious Cocoa Roast Almonds continues to show off the quality you get from them. Each crunchy roasted almond is powder coated with a fleeting but rich cocoa flavor. The taste is wonderfully delicious but not decadently so.My first taste gave me a blast from the past if just for a brief millisecond. COCOA PEBBLES! Ah! But it was only for the briefest moment, then the yummy nutty roasted almond flavor kicks in. I have no complaints with that...snacking on sugary childhood cereals, though divine on the lips, will wreck havoc on the hips. I'll gladly upgrade to Emerald Cocoa Roast Almonds and enjoy nearly the same divine pleasure without the guilt.The cocoa flavor is rather fleeting but it still makes these snacks worthwhile. I enjoy roasted almonds, but I tend to get bored with them quickly. Too many jars of roasted almonds have gotten stale on my shelf from neglect. With Emerald Cocoa Roast almonds, the cocoa roast flavor keeps me coming for more without wanting to overindulge either. A few nuts is all it takes for me to enjoy a tasty cocoa treat, still enjoy the healthy benefits of almonds, and be satisfied. It's a great balance of wanting to spoil yourself yet still enjoy a healthy treat.Now, the naughty girl in me will want to spill these lovely cocoa-covered nuts on top of a chocolate frosted chocolate chip cake, call it healthy, and have a divine chocolate experience...but that's cheating big time. I'll be happy with these cocoa roasted nuts and avoid the cake for now.My only negative with Emerald is their price, but you get what you pay for. With Emerald, I always know I'm getting quality nuts that are going to taste GREAT, regardless of the flavor.If you like roasted almonds and enjoy the flavor of cocoa, I don't doubt you'll enjoy these nuts. Emerald make good nuts and these are no exception. Cocoa roasted almonds are the healthy alternative choice to chocolate almond candies. No guilt on the conscience.UPDATE: I've shared these with my family and the one thing we agree on is that the cocoa flavor goes too quickly. Longer lasting cocoa flavor would be super. Other than that, we all like and enjoy these nuts. As for me, I'm getting quickly addicted to them. I'm finding myself floating back to these yummy nuts to get more. Great snack! I'll GLADLY buy these again.UPDATE #2: I WANT TO UPGRADE TO FIVE STARS! I've tried some other of Emerald's nuts and the Cocoa Almonds come out tops! These have become number one in my book. I crave these!

Admittedly, food preferences are very personal.  That said, wow!  To me these taste like homemade almond brownies.  I like the flavor. The cocoa flavor is rich and the baking process increases its depth. And they'd be great for guests.  But there is no way I'll keep something like this in the house.And I find the idea that the container is shaped for the cup holder of a car to be very strange.  The idea of driving along and popping these little caloric bombs makes me shudder.  I doubt this is what nutritionists mean when they suggest eating nuts as part of a balanced diet.

With almonds and chocolate, what's not to love? Well... these aren't dipped in chocolate almonds, these are baked in chocolate flavor. The baked in chocolate flavor provides no mess but the baked in flavor kind of gives it a burnt flavor to me. These almonds were just alright, I was a little disappointed in them. They also get their lightly sweet flavor from Sucralose which I think provides a fake kind of sweetness flavor. Overall, if you really love almonds and are looking for a healthy snack then you might like these but if you are looking for a chocolate snack then you'll be disappointed with these.
Almonds on their own are a great snack, now dust them with cocoa and you've got an even better snack!! The canister makes them great to travel with in the car or leave in the desk at the office.

i put myself back on phase 1 of south beach, which means1) i am always hungry2) there are about 4 things in the world that i'm allowed to eat3) i am a woman; i need chocolate...i cannot have it.  this is a problem.these nuts have only 1g of sugar...i'm pretty sure that's an ok amt...and they are SO. GOOD.as soon as the case is available, i may just be buying in bulk.

When I ate my first handful of these I thought "wow, these bad boys are amazing and I have a feeling I'll be pounding through a canister really quickly". However, shortly thereafter I had that awful aftertaste in my mouth of artificial sweetener. In shock, I looked at the ingredients and sure enough, there was the dreaded ingredient.All-in-all, not bad if you don't mind artificial sweetener. I hate the stuff so these were not for me.

While the Almond taste is on point, the chocolate taste is not. They were pretty much just plain dry roasted almonds with Cocoa powder mixed with Splenda sprinkled on them. I could only really taste the chocolate with my first bite. After a few bites, All I could taste is almond. The light chocolate taste was just a little too light for me. And for someone who eats chocolate like it's becoming extinct, this is a bad thing. Plus, the chocolate powder was very difficult to remove from my hands.PROS1. Great Almond FlavorCONS1. Just a hint of chocolate - for others this may be a pro but for me, EH, not such a good thing2. Coated in a messy chocolate powder. - It's Best if you have mouth to canister contact when eating these.To sum it all up, I've had better.

I have had a number of other emerald products and all have been good. These just didn't taste right to me. So I offered them to a number of coworkers and they all agreed.Most say they needed salt. A few said they needed some sugar. About three people liked them they way they were. About two thirds said they would not purchase them. I myself wouldn't buy them if offered a choice.The two flavors just don't seem to mix well.

column9: Satisfying, Tasty, Vitamin E Rich Snack
column10: Emerald Cocoa Roast Almonds are a fabulous new product. They somehow provide the nutrition and satisfying crunch of almonds with the flavor of delicious rich dark chocolate.  The chocolate really is baked in and does not come off in a powdery mess on hands, face or clothes like so many snack products do.  Because there is virtually no mess or clean up these chocolate almonds are a great snack for the office or on the go.  The lid can even be used as a measured container for one serving to help with portion control and the canister can easily be tucked in a desk drawer or stowed in a car. There are eleven, 150 calorie, one ounce servings in each canister and each ounce only has six grams of carbohydrates making this a great treat for carb counters as well as calorie watchers.

I like a wide variety of nuts and find myself choosing to snack on nuts (if not fruit) when I get the urge to munch.  So as not to get too monotonous, I do like to switch things up among some of the more high protein nuts.  Consequently, upon seeing these cocoa roasted almonds, I was thrilled to try them.I actually love the taste of these nuts.  My comments:(1)  They have just enough cocoa to give them a nice sweetness without being overwhelming (and making you feel like you just consumed a week's worth of calories in a single snack).  I am not a big sweet lover which makes this characteristic appealing; To one with a big sweet-tooth or looking for an after-dinner dessert, you might find yourself disappointed with these.(2)  For the people that tested these in my household, the appeal was widespread.  My husband and two children (ages 2 and 5) loved them, probably even more than I.  They came to the consensus that the cocoa coating tasted a bit like an Oreo cookie.  With the lower calories and healthy protein, I am happy to have my children snack on these versus some of the other cookie/cracker options out there.(3)  The container is nice -- a good size and shape for holding.  It was easily managed by myself as well as my 2-year old.  The top is a screw-top which, in my opinion, is much nicer than the common flip tops.  I am uncertain as to whether the snacks stay fresher this way (the nuts did not last long enough to test it) but the top minimizes spills that can be frustrating with the flip tops.All in all, I would buy these again.  Further, I would recommend them to someone who likes almonds and can appreciate the mild sweetness of the cocoa coating.  If you are looking for a sweet, chocolate covered nut (like a mini milk-chocolate snickers), you will be disappointed.  This is not a candy bar but it is a great alternative snack.

column9: Sorry, I didn't agree with y'all
column10: These fell short on flavor, sweetness, and satisfaction. As other reviewers have mentioned, they do have a bit of an after taste too.  Trader Joe's are way better and at a much better price.For those that absolutely want less calories and low sugar they would get you by, but for me, I'd rather have a little less of something really good.

column9: Tastes good, but not for chocolate lovers (3+ stars)
column10: Anything that claims to be "dark chocolate" flavored immediately has my attention, as I'm a true chocoholic with a preference for the intense bittersweet flavor of a good dark chocolate.  Unfortunately, these cocoa-dipped almonds don't deliver on the promise of their name, although they are indeed a good, nutritious (but high fat) snack with a hint of sweetness and chocolate flavor.  Not surprisingly, the predominant flavor is almond; the nutty, skin-on taste overwhelms the chocolate dusting.  Nut lovers will likely appreciate the twist on an old favorite since the cocoa does indeed bring out the almond flavor.  The almonds are crunchy and roasted to perfection, with few or no overdone brown interiors.Diabetics and others who watch their sugar intake will be pleased to learn that this snack contains only 1 gram of sugar per 1/4 cup serving because of the addition of sucralose, an artificial sweeteners better known commercially as Splenda.  Dieters, however, will want to be careful with the 13 grams of fat in that same size serving.In general, I like Emerald nut products, but this one disappointed me, mostly because I found the chocolate flavor lacking and because I try to avoid artificial sweeteners.  When I crave nuts, I go right for this canister, but when I crave chocolate, I look for something else.Also from the same company and recommended by me:  Emerald Nuts Glazed Pecans, Pecan Pie, 5-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 12), Emerald Nuts Dry Roasted Peanut, Honey Roasted Peanut & Cocktail Peanut, 4.5-Ounce Canisters (Pack of 18), Emerald Nuts Glazed Walnuts, Original, 7-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 12)

These cocoa dusted almonds are really nice; since they are not covered in melted chocolate they are drier and nuttier with that dark cocoa topping, overall way better than candy. I find myself reaching for them a few times a day, after a while I really develop a taste for them.I like that these are slightly drier, it makes for a crispy snack versus the Marcona almonds which are chewier. I liked both though.

I'm shocked at the number of elementary students who seem to subsist on hot cheetos, so I took my containter of cocoa roast almonds to school to see if kids could be induced to try something semi healthy.  For my part, I found the almonds a little dry, so I was not sure how the kids would like it.  But I was pleasantly surprised.  They loved the almonds and begged for more.  So if you want to give your kids something more healthy for lunches and snack (and anything is better than hot cheetos) then this is a great product.  Now, if only we could get these cocoa almonds for the same price as cheap chessy snacks utterly devoid of nutritional value.

I was introduced to this product several years ago from a cousin who likes healthy and delicious foods too. I have never been without it since then and recommend it highly. It has healthy nuts and dark chocolate without all the calories of regular sweet chocolate candy.Emerald Cocoa Roast Almonds, Dark Chocolate, 11oz Canister (Pack of 4)

We started getting these almonds when it was recommended to substitute the cocoa covered almonds for chocolate covered almonds for health and weight issues.  They have been a hit and success in our family.

column9: Emerald Cocoa Roasted Almonds, dark chocolate
column10: This is the best dark chocolate roasted almonds out there. I tried Blue Diamond & other brands, this one's the best. Note: it does NOT have sugar, no gooey chocolate coating, just a dusting of dark chocolate powder. About 21 almonds have 150 calories. It's great for diabetics and low carb eaters. Even a few almonds helps with hunger. It's so delicious that if you have a sweet tooth, and would have a craving for a chocolate bar, this will do the trick. But since they are so delicious, the trick is to eat just a few at a time. You can order this via Amazon as I do, for convenience, but it is widely available at major stores as well.

For taste, I love these!! I also like that they do not add sugar or unhealthy fats.These are covered in cocoa and a sugar substitute, not an icing like layer of chocolate. The only problem that affects me is the price. The price here at Amazon is mediocre. I have seen better on-sale prices in the grocery store.
These taste great and and being able to use subscribe and save to keep them in supply is an added bonus. I add them to a protein shake as a part of my morning routine.
Love these and they are very popular with the whole family.  Prices here on Amazon seem ridiculously high at times and you can find good deals on them all over.  One of my favorite snacks.

I have had gastric bypass.  High protein snacks and foods are what I focus on.  These nuts fit that extremely well.  They are high protein yet not high in carbs.  And they satisfy my craving for something sweet. It is also and excellent price.
The cocoa on the almonds is just right.  This makes a healthy snack or dessert.  I went through a can in two days...

column9: Best Almonds if you like Chocolate
column10: I had these for the first time when my brother shared a handful of the almonds with me. This was so good that I have this shipped to me every 2 months from Amazon. These almonds are also curbing my sweet tooth during the office Biggest Loser contest, especially being around lots of Halloween candy.
These are so yummy. Even if you are not a dark chocolate lover you'll still love these - the chocolate isn't bitter at all.

These almonds are wonderful!  I eat a handful with an Atkins coconut bar, and it completely fills me up, and keeps me full until the next meal.  I've tried other meal replacements, like Slim Fast (which I love, and drink nearly every day!), but these almonds satisfy me more than any other meal replacement.  I'm on the go every day, and these come in a durable plastic can with a twist off lid. They're portable. They taste delicious. The chocolate is satisfying, but not overpowering.  They are absolutely fresh and very crunchy.  I always keep these on hand.  Amazon had them to my door 4 days after I ordered them!

These are exactly what they say they are- cocoa roasted almonds.  People expecting an overly sweet, chocolate covered almond are going to be disappointed.  They do contain artificial sweeteners which seem to be one of the biggest complaints, but I'd also counter that with the argument that normal chocolate covered almonds have it too.  Overall, they're sweet, but not overtly so.  A good snack for people looking for a slightly less sugar loaded version of a sweet almond.
I learned about this tea from the Abs Diet book and let me tell it is awesome.  Tastes great and gives you a real energy boost.  Would definitely buy it again.

Two great flavors in one cookie. The shortbread is melt-in-your-mouth scrumptious and the tooth-satisfying crunch of the hazelnuts make me crave them. They make the best accompaniment to a cup of tea. Elegant enough to serve to honored guests. I'm addicted. Eat them every day. Yumm.

column9: Almost like Grossmutter used to make
column10: Update Dec 2011 - I went to order these for a third year in a row, and was confused by the new description and pricing. It used to be by 8 oz bag, now 3 oz bag but buy 4 get 1 free. In fact, I just checked with the seller and the ten dollars is for five bags, not just one. Whew--Christmas is saved!My mother and I miss the German Christmas cookies we used to make from my grandmother's recipes, but neither of us can manage baking them anymore. These are very similar to what we called Haselnuss Brot, but without the royal icing and hazelnut half on top. I ordered these for last Christmas, and we were very pleased--pleased enough to be ordering them again this year. (FYI, the ones we got last year were round, not heart-shaped like the ones in the photo.)

column9: Dingo Munchy Stix made my dog very sick
column10: Please don't buy these for your dog. These have artificial colors and pork in them that is not listed on the product description online. These made my dog very ill. He had diarrhea and was throwing up for a week. I was very worried about him. This was the only change in his diet, I feed him all natural food with no artificial anything. I thought these were made of chicken & natural accourding to the online description but they are not.

column9: Our Dogs Like These, By Jingo!
column10: The ten Munchy Stix are encased in a clear plastic shell backed by a bone shaped piece of cardboard. The chews are roughly five inches in length and look like little, thin salamis or slim Jims. Unlike the former, however, these rawhide chews are not soft and pliable, but rigid and crunchy. Each Stix is a compressed , cylindrical stick formed with bits of rawhide, chicken, and  pork. Dingo®  tells us that these Stix have the same great taste as the larger chicken/rawhide chews in an easy to chew treat. Further, we are told, these Stix are healthy and fun to chew, helping to promote clean teeth and gums.Ingredients: Rawhide, chicken, Pork, Water, Corn, Sugar, Salt, Potassium sorbate, Red 40.Both of our dogs and their occasional guests love these Stix. I don't know how much chew value they have because they're totally consumed in about five minutes, sometimes longer for little Piper. I'd rather these were manufactured in the US and not China, but so far through many packags of Stix our dogs have had no ill effects and still look forward to their Stix.

I spoil my little Italian Greyhound rotten and although she's not picky about treats, she does tend to get tired of things after a little while.  But so far she hasn't tired of these.  I buy her lots of treats and this is one of the tried and true favorites.
Length:: 0:31 MinsI'm not sure how Dingo did it, but they've managed to combine rawhide, chicken, pork, and sugar into a crunchy stick.Delicious? Sydney thinks so.Rawhide Chewiness? Absolutely not.

I have a very very very picky Chihuahua that will only eat one brand of dog treats , Wagon Train . I think I spend more money a week on his little butt then I do my self =] . Every now an then I watch my sons Chihuahua which is from the same litter as mine and he just so happen had a few stix's with him . Now idk if it was a little competition thing between the dogs , but Pimp & Daddy were both fighting over them !! So I decided to order a few one day since the price was so low . Sure enough he has been eating them ever since !! So I order him 2 packs every time I place a order from amazon =] .FYI: Not to mention he looks so cute with his little paws holding them and although he is small he is still able to hold them , run with them , and eat them .

I just wanted to add that my order on March 11, 2007 came with 15 dingo stix per package, thats 50% more free, and they are still priced @ 1.25 with buy 3 get one free, a great deal and the dogs love everything dingo so far.

column9: Old stand by that Briley still loves!
column10: We've bought these for years and Briley always enjoys them, so much so that she knows what the word "Dingo" means. Dingo = Treat Time for Briley

column9: My three dogs say no thanks
column10: These maybe very nice fir some dogs  but my dogs won't even take them out my hand.I have a beagle a beagle mix and a mini daushund that are all very aggressive treat eaters.I buy them all kinds and brands and had never before found treats or bone that they wouldn't eat.For goodness sake I didn't think there was such a treat considering some of the garbage the are willing to eat.Inexpensive so I didn't loose much just letting y'all know our experience.

column9: Nice little chew sticks, but pricey
column10: I got these Dingo Munchy Stix on sale and my smaller Australian Kelpie liked these treats.After I bought these, the price went back up and I won't pay full price for them, as twenty-two cents for each stix is too expensive in my opinion.

column9: Great treat for your dog; great price
column10: These bones make great treats for dogs. My Golden Retriever loves them. This is also a great value for a 10 pack of bones. My dog and I highly recommend!
My dog loves these stix, she takes it and then runs as fast as she can back to her bed to enjoy at her leisure

I had previously purchased Dingo mini rawhide bones for my parents Siberian Husky and Shar Pei and those two ate those bones without any hesitation.  With this knowledge, I thought that I would try these Munchy Stix for our Yorkshire Terrier for Christmas.  At the time, Amazon had these for a ridiculously low price and I purchased way more than was needed to fill her stocking.  She ate these up like there was no tomorrow and they leave little to no crumbs afterwards.  I do not know what else I can say about these, as I can not comment on their flavor or texture, but our puppy loves them.

We have a small terrier mix and two chihuahua mixed pups. The terrier is very curious and loves when the mailman brings "boxes" ~ she has to go through everything with me when I open them and then turns the box over to make sure nothing is left inside of it. Occasionally, she gets her own "box" with pup toys (which I am also looking into ordering from Amazon as they have some nice products and many 4 for 3 deals), etc., so these were a great treat for her to find in a box full of towel sets I had also ordered. There were more in the package than I had expected, all the pups liked them (the terrier, the largest, is 16 pounds). I could see how a larger pup would go through these very fast however they were a perfect surprise for our smaller pups and at one a day for each of them, will last a little while. For the price however, they were a great treat and a good value for us. And our little terrier mix is just beside herself with joy that there was something special in the box just for her (and the other pups as well).
My dog loves Dingo products -- she gets one a week as a BIG treat and she loves these !!!

column4: A. Gift For You "An Amazon customer"
column10: Dog ate them and seemed to like them. So, if the dog liked them, I guess they were OK. :)

I bought this product for my little puppy of 3 months and he love it!, he can stop to eat it!... I feel very happy because when I give one of this to my puppy he entertain a lot of time playing alone, give me mor time for relax o for make something. I RECOMMEND!

Dingo Munchy Stick / B000FPM5DAWhen I first bought these, my puppy was 3 months old and 6 pounds heavy. I wanted something that he could chew on to keep him interested and out of trouble when I couldn't watch him for short periods of time, for instance, when I take a shower. The treats didn't quite last the entire shower, but they did the trick for a time. Now he's a month older and another 6 pounds heavier and I'm lucky if the treat lasts long enough for me to get to the shower!Obviously, my dog likes these. He finishes them very quickly, maybe too quickly for the price, but the Amazon 4-for-3 deal still makes it worthwhile. I'm a little concerned about the rawhide in the sticks - I have been told by our trainer that rawhide can cause impaction in the digestive tract - but I think that the small shreds of rawhide in these sticks are probably safe. Still, I'm considering phasing these out to beef-hide sticks (not the same as rawhide), especially since the Dingo Stix do not last very long.As usual, I had no trouble with Amazon shipping, and the Stix look and smell the same as the ones from the local pet store - no weird odor or any signs of spoilage from sitting in a warehouse too long. I will probably continue to order these for as long as the 4-for-3 deal lasts.~ Ana Mardoll
I have 2 dogs and both of them LOVE these things. They don't last long (at least not with my dogs) but they are great treats to give them. Highly recommend.
My dog really loves these things and devours them right up.He is a small size 18 pound Bichon Frise.He recommends them.

I have a black lab and mini eskimo spitz and they both love dingo munchy stix!  These are great for a quick treat or snack, but if your dog needs more of a "chewing workout" try the mini bones or rawhides instead.  These munchy stix come in 2 flavors: beef (red) and a parsley and baking soda (green)variety that helps freshen stinky dog breath.  My dogs recommend that you get both!

I bought these snack treats for my poodle.  However, she didn't like them too much.  I don't know if other dogs might like them.  My dog is usually not very picky when it comes to food so your dog might like them.

very poor quality item; my schnauzer did not want to eat it. Product contains sugar from corn syrup which harmful for dog's teeth and will lead to decay. I live in rural area and coyotes sometimes come by; so I left it in the bak yard, but even coyotes turned it down.Maybe it is only for starved Dingos, but seriously AMAZON should not sell any crap someone wants put there.

I really just got this item as a filler, but they sure did make my dog happy.  He ate them up in no time, and really enjoyed them.  I liked how easy they were to give him, and that they were not messy and that they were actually chewed up and eaten, and I did not find them hidden in my closet the next day. I'd buy them again for him.

column9: Made both of my dogs sick
column10: I gave these to my two shih tzu's and they have been throwing up for the past two days.  It was the only new item in their diets, so I know it is because of the treats. It seems I am not the only one with this problems according to the other reviews.

I was very concerned when I rec'd this product.  it was made in China, and a number of the "sticks" were broken with grayish brown sediment around them. They had a terrible smell.  My dog took one sniff and walked away (she usually eats any "treat" I give her).  I think this product should be taken off of the Amazon sales site.  I usually like to shop for products at Amazon.  Now I am leery to do so.

this is very good. it's hard but i like it like that. it's not that chewy like taffy. it's a bit sweet so i cant eat it all at the same time but it's good to have a piece or two after dinner. my dad also liked this with his coffee (but he had a hard time eating it because he has false teeth). the fact that it comes in bite size packets is very convenient. try it, it's super yummers :)

I do not consume oatmeal on a regular basis but I thought I would give this brand a try since the combo of apples and raisins with spice seems very appealing and the fact it was organic. My first bowl knocked me over with flavor. This stuff is really good albeit a bit sweet with a rich dark color full of apple chunks and raisins and a nice spice flavor. I ordered two lbs. and I have almost finished that order off so I ordered four more lbs. Yes it is really that good tasting and easy to prepare just had boiling water and mix. A truly satisfying meal for breakfast or anytime.

Haha they give you so much!  But it's totally worth it, I gave 2 away and signed up for every 3 months for the subscription discount.  I love the flavor, too bad it's not in my stores.  I also mix in some mushrooms and turkey meat to add a little more nutrition.  5 ******. Thanks!
We like this pasta sauce more than other (like prego) on the market.  The sauce is thicker and tastier.  Amazon packaging need to improve since one of the bottle cap crack during the shipping.

This spaghetti sauce tastes good and has nice chunks of veggies in it. It is pretty flavorful and I find that I don't have to add a lot of seasonings to it for it to taste good. It is not a thin or runny sauce. The size of the jar is great for larger batches of pasta and the price here at Amazon is much better than the grocery store! I also like the fact that these come in plastic jars as opposed to glass. I find that it keeps well for about a week or so in the fridge if you do not use the whole jar at once. I am pleased with the purchase and would recommend this Ragu Chunky Pasta Sauce if you like a thick, rich sauce.
This product is as good as the ones bought in the store with about a year expiration date on the lid. I would order again
Is a good product and can be used for many different dishes. Makes a good quick sauce for busy week nights.

Not as many chunks as I would have thought but I'm still very satisfied. Not only is it good on pasta but it makes a fine pizza sauce too. The garlic and onion flavors are present but not overpowering at all.

With high grocery prices in my area I'm always on the search for a deal and this has to be one of the best deals I've ever found on Amazon. The jars are larger than the normal grocery size so they really last. The jars are plastic and they double box, so they were in perfect shape when delivered. With the subscribe and save option it is an even better deal. The tomato, garlic, and onion was out of stock for a bit, but it did end up coming back in so I was able to order again. Highly recommend if you go through pasta sauce as quickly as we do!
Love this Sauce. Taste is perfect, I use this Sauce with so many food but mostly with macaroni cheese so Go for it. Best Sauce...!!!
Love the taste of this sauce. We have been using this for over a year. Great price, good quality, using this makes the pasta very yummy. A great buy.

column9: Sugar - I knew I was making a mistake
column10: I remember buying Ragu a few years ago and never buying it again, but I could not remember why. Just look at the container, its tomato sauce, what could go wrong. Everything about it is wrong for me now that I tried it once more and I am writing a review to remind me later. This contains sugar and sugar is same as poison for me, the taste just makes me mad. The container label says there is only 10g of sugar per 1/2 cup/128g serving, but when I eat it it feels like 50g. There is no tangy tomato flavor, it feels like I am eating juice or jam or something too sweet, not pasta sauce like. I compared it with a can of "Del Monte Chunky garlic and herb" sauce and Del Monte is so much better. It contains 9g High Fructose Syrup in place of Sugar but I felt it was much more satisfying, tastier, less sweet and more tangy than Ragu and its cheaper too. Did i miss to say Del Monte is Chunky while Ragu is not!, even when labelled Chunky. If you want to buy Del Monte sauce online with fast shipping try Amazon's grocery site "soap" dot com. Ragu is America's worst tasting sauce not like advertised at all, more like America's favorite Tomato flavored jam/syrup.Also double checked ingredient list on the bottle and it says sugar while amazon says corn syrup. Amazon should have said sugar and helped me save $18, so 1 star for amazon too.

column9: Great Fruit Tasting ORANGE OCEAN Drink Mix
column10: Great "Fruit Tasting" Orange Ocean Drink Mix from Hawaiian Punch is so delicious and refreshing for your on-the-go (at work) lifestyle. I now drink much more water than I used to.This drink beats most others in that IT DOESN'T HAVE that chemical after taste that makes your throat sore.
I am so glad I can buy this online. I have a hard time finding it in stores. It's a great drink!
This item is better then the other coconut waers I have tried but is my least favorite flavor of the three REVA items I tried.  Again the convenience is great!

I have tried almost all the Coconut Waters in the market and I like this one the best. I usual drink this after I get done with a long ride or after my work outs. I have read that it is very good for hydration and for me, at least, that seems to be very true. I will definately buy this product again because it is easy to take with me to the gym and taste great.
This is my favorite flavor out of the 3!!!! You should try it! The powder mixes easily with water and the packets arevery easy to carry around.

These are my most favorite flavor of Jelly Belly. I hind sight I should have ordered all of my order Sours, (I ordered 5 other containers). This is a great snack when a chip isn't enough, nice mix of sour and sweet. Great color and extremely fast delivery.

Got these to go with my Jelly Belly jelly bean dispenser I got for Christmas. These things are great! You will love them - especially if you love sour candy. Even though I love sour candy, I often find myself not liking certain flavors in a variety pack such as this, but with Jelly Belly Sours, this is not the case. All five flavors: Apple, Lemon, Cherry, Grape and Orange taste great separately and together. And they have only 140 calories for a whopping 35 beans!
These sours mix jelly beans are so much fun!  So much flavor packed into a tiny bean! They arrived fresh and sealed for continued freshness.  We discovered this mix by happy accident and love them.

These are wonderful dog treats and are made in the USA instead of China!! I actually break them into smaller pieces and sprinkle over my dogs' dry food. I have some very picky eaters, but all the picky-ness went out the window when we got these!!! I highly recommend them!!

Ah, finally, a treat that JP, my dog loves. Wellness came out with a "Pure Rewards" beef jerky bits for dogs, and these all-natural, tender jerky treats are highly palatable, even to the most discriminating palate. Best of all, the ingredients are easy to understand (which is important), and contain: beef, dried chicory root, cultured whey, sea salt, lecithin, and mixed tocopherols (which is a natural preservative). Four paws up for these tasty treats! Absolutely tasty and palatable!

Real meat treats your dogs will love!  Dogs that are not motivated by treats even like these tasty nuggets.  These small little treats are great for training rewards.  Small enough to put a bunch in your pocket, and you can even break them up into smaller pieces for smaller dogs.

column9: sweet and tart, great when warmed up
column10: The cranberries' tartness is a nice counterpoint to the bar's sweetness. These are much improved by warming them up: remove from wrapper, microwave for 10-15 seconds. Made with lots of good stuff and having lots of fiber and protein; they also contain plant sterols, which supposedly help lower cholesterol.

Picked up a mixed bag of 12 at Costco today-as they were only selling them for a limited time there.  I sampled all 5 flavors and found that I enjoyed the banana and the cranberry the most.  Much cheaper too!  There were selling them for $7.49 for a box of 12.  Almost wished I had picked up more now that I see the price here on Amazon.  Hopefully they did well enough that they will become a staple at Costco.

this is great for taking to work or to eat in the car, but dont try to use it as a meal replacement at home unless you got really great will power! i am the last guy to give in to cravings, but the last time i tried it as a meal replacement i ended up eating 10 of them, and that 180 cal meal replacement turned into a 1800 cal meal... so from now on i only take one or two with me to work

I like the Peanut Butter and Chocolate Chip flavors of these bars, but the Cranberry Flax one is a little too tart for my taste.  My husband hates them and won't come near them.  I love Corazona bars in general, but this flavor is just not that great.
These are so yummy I've ordered 6 boxes in a couple of months!  They have just the right of sweetness and stop the hunger.
I really like buying these as gift, esp for old folks. My aunts and uncles love these. Found out recently that Costco is selling these a lot cheaper.

I love the tast of the the cranberry squares.  A touch of tartness, dense but soft to the palate.  Eating them in place of other 'sweets' seems to kill the urge to gourge on other sweets for me.  My wife finds them too dense, so if that is a problem for you... best to try it as a 'test' and see if you like it first.

It terms of being a healthy snack these cranberry flax oatmeal squares are great. Each bar has 6g of fiber, 13g of whole grain, no trans fat, 6g of protein, low sodium, all natural and packed with a bunch of vitamins. Plus it says on the package it's proven to help lower cholesterol. But there's one problem - it doesn't taste too good. It tastes like health food. It's like eating chewy and nutritious cardboard. I didn't really like it and probably won't be buying them again.
These are healthy and DELICIOUS!  My only complaint is that the sugar seems high at 14 grams per serving.

I am very impressed with these bars. I like both the cranberry and Chocolate chip. I may try others as well. Low fat, high fiber, good protein, fortified with vitamins, whole grain, plant sterols. Did I mention delicious?! Not quite organic but close and healthy!
These are so good it's hard to believe they're really good for you. Lots of healthy, yet yummy ingredients. So glad I found these. They are thick and chewy and taste very good.

I am probably the biggest fan of Corazona's oatmeal squares.  I have had to resort to purchasing on line because Costco will not carry this item at my store (Well, it does now, but for how long) so I purchased a bunch while the buying was good and the prices were fantastic.  I highly recommend any Corazona product.  Amazon is always there when I need it.
Tastes really good and has a great texture.  My favorite of all the flavors.  The price is not bad either!

Bought a few of these when my Safeway store 1st carried them. They started out at a bargain price of $1.00 each. Loved this flavor and also the choc chip ones. Would eat one on the way to work at midnight to hold me over until a 4 am lunch. They did just that, satisfying and filling. They are chewy so a glass or container of liquid of your choice would be good.Then they went up to their regular price of about $1.35 to $1.50 each and I didn't buy them again. But I missed them so I shopped around and found them here at Amazon for a great price when I ordered 2 boxes cause that made the shipping free!They have 6 g fiber, 13 g whole grain, 6 g protein and are low in sodium at 180 calories.The choc chip ones have 5 g fiber, 16 g whole grain, 6 g protein and also low in sodium at 190 calories.

I tried one of these a year ago and have been hooked ever since.  I usually eat regular oatmeal on the weekends but have one of these every morning of the week for breakfast, either with my smoothie or non-fat latte.  They are the perfect size to feel satisfied.  I love that they're not too sweet and have the benefits of all natural ingredients, low sodium and high amounts of lots of recommended daily vitamins, along with whole grains, fiber and protein.  My favorite is the Cranberry Flax. I buy them by the box and it seemed the store was always out of stock so I was so happy to discover that I could order them online on a continuous basis delivered right to my mailbox!

column9: Great tasting bar and reasonably healthy
column10: I really like the cranberry and flax variety. The chocolate chip is also really good and much less expensive than the other varieties. I'm not a fan of the peanut butter variety.

I really like the cranberry Corazonas. They are moist and not too sweet. They taste healthy, keep me full when I grab one for a quick breakfast on the go, or work well for a quick snack without guilt or huge sugar spike.I love that they are on the subscription list...keep them coming!

I tried these because the ingredients are healthy, and I needed something that I could take along for a quick, easy, and healthy snack for me and my 17-month-old twins. All three of us like them a lot. We just finished our first box, so I'm going to sign up now for "subscribe and save."
What a delicious alternative to what is out there in the market today. Great flavor and so good for you too. Chocolate almond is my favorite flavor but this is a  close second.

column9: I liked them but found they contain MSG unfortunately :(
column10: I liked these (although not as much as the chocolate chip) and the ingredients and vitamins seemed good (even though a tad too sweet) but..everytime I'd eat one I'd become ill.  I couldn't figure out why until I researched the ingredients.I'm moderately to severely allergic to MSG and it gets worse as I get older.  I kept reading the ingredients wondering if there was something in these affecting me and after a little internet research found that the "Maltodextrin, Brown Rice Syrup, Natural Flavorings, Whey Protein Isolate and possibly a few other ingredients contain varying amounts of MSG.  The combination of all these was enough to make me sick.  I'll have to stick to snacks without such a high combination as other snacks haven't had such an effect on me. They did taste good, however... :(

I tried these as a diet help, plus to regulate my bowels.  I fell in love with the taste and texture of them, and they taste good, and help with both things mentioned in my first sentence.  If I weren't dieting, I would eat more than one a day!!!!!

column9: Just like a big soft oatmeal cookie!
column10: These are very very good. Tasty, soft, just enough spice and cranberries. They really are like a big chewy oatmeal cookie and definitely fill you up!

This is a great condiment; not truly vinegar, but agrodolce, as it is blended with unfermented grape must.  That adds a wonderful, balancing sweetness to it that enhances most anything you put it on or in.  I've been using this for several years now, and it's to the point that I use it in some way almost every night. Find it cheaper elsewhere, though.

The first bottle showed up broken, and they rectified this situation nicely (of course I didn't need 2 phone calls...just what we ordered).  But it's the thought that counts.  They went overboard to make sure we were happy.And the vinegar is a gem.  Try it on a steak on the grill!

Any microwave popcorn claiming to be low fat/calorie does not compare to this Smart Balance brand.  This one has the lowest calories.  Does it taste like movie theatre butter popcorn?  Well, no, but it is still good, and you get used to skipping all that butter.  I call it guilt-free microwave popcorn.

The product is very handy to have around especially when I am walking and playing golf. Makes it so easy to consume all of the fluids that I need while I am sweating. Taste great so i consume more water than normal.
I've bought other brands here but decided to save some money and chose Roland. I'm sorry to say they were not very good.  The best so far have been Byzantine, Peloponnese and Barnier.
... and they taste good, the olives have seeds, there is an appropriate amount on brine, and there are some bits of spices mixed in here and there.

My husband was addicted to the Byzantine olive mix, but since this was priced so much better we gave it a try.  Although I would give it one less star, this mix is very tasty and is a good value.  We enjoyed the seasoning.

I did not like them, they seemed flavorless compared to other brands.  The Byzantine olives are a little more, but are a MUCH better product.  I will likely never buy a Roland olive product again, as I was disappointed with their black olives as well.
They were all melted together...there was no coushin or cooling pac in with them..they were just rubber banned to a piece of cardboard...

column9: Makes Ande's Mints look like gourmet chocolate
column10: These things are simply horrible.  They make Ande's Mints look like gourmet chocolate (and I love Ande's). Waxy tasting, putrid mint taste and texture not unlike sandpaper. Blah...why can't Hershey ever make a decent chocolate?  No wonder when I went to Hershey, the plant is half shut down.  Garbage chocolate, period.
only ordered for the mint but got regular chocolate wtf, cant return but i got the wrong item bait and switch

I love Ezekiel products.  No flour=no fat gain.  I use Ezekiel for bodybuilding because they make the most nutritional grains that provide sustained energy with a minimal insulin response, and of course they are a reputable ALL NATURAL company.  Flour containing products are not as healthy and spike insulin (causing fat gain) compared to than sprouted grains, so to me flour has no place in everday diet (occasional desserts are a different story).
