I have been eating pure Maple Syrup for more than 20 years and this is an excellent one that met all of my expectations. I do not think that you will be disappointed. I had it with my pancakes yesterday.

column9: great syrup - huge opening so pour slowly!
column10: This syrup is very delicious - my husband loves it.  It is a thinner syrup and the opening is very large so you have to be very careful when pouring it.  I will purchase this again.

Saturday brunch: whole wheat pancakes with fresh organic figs, pat of butter and lots of Vermont maple syrup. Highlands Sugarworks syrup great flavor, lovely amber color and poured beautifully down my stack of pancakes.
Great service, as always, from Amazon.I enjoy this maple syrup everyday with yoghurt and with my cream of wheat.
This is just what I expected, undeniably real maple syrup.  Dark in color, robust flavor, my children preferred it to the store bought, maple flavoured pancake syrup.  I will definitely buy it again.

I grew up in Vermont and my grandparents still make/bottle maple syrup every year so I know a thing or two about this stuff. I got this when it was on sale. Personally, I like the Medium Amber. It's not as thick as Dark, and the Light is almost like water. Grade A is best for Pancakes and French Toast. Grade B is better for Baking and putting on top of Ice Cream. I ordered this and it arrived in 2 days via Amazon Prime. The product is great.

column9: Good syrup; a little weaker than Vermont grade
column10: This good maple syrup, in medium amber, the most popular grade.  It's from Vermont, which has slightly more stringent standards about maple syrup density.  Thus I was surprised that this Highland Sugarworks syrup was weaker than the L.L. Bean syrup I was about to run out of.  But reading the label provides a clue to my disappointment.  It's labeled "Pure NEW ENGLAND Maple Syrup", as opposed to "Pure VERMONT Maple Syrup".  The reverse of the label says "We also purchase syrup from our friends and neighbors".  (The L.L. Bean container says "Packed in Vermont".)  So I conclude that this is rated on the (weaker) U.S. scale rather than the Vermont scale.It's still good syrup; it just seems a bit "watered-down" compared to what I expected.

column9: Maple habit can get expensive, but worth it
column10: I really love maple syrup, and this is some of the best. Buying it this way is relatively inexpensive.

My husband uses maple syrup by the gallon. He just loves the stuff, and he said this syrup was much better than what he had been buying. I have not tasted it yet but if he likes it I am sure that you will too.
Love this syrup!  comes in two bottles, so it doesn't take up as much space in the fridge. I only need to refrigerate the open bottle.  Kids love it and NO corn syrup.

column9: Terrible!!! This syrup was from a bad tree.
column10: We always buy expensive syrup, either labeled organic or pure maple. I ordered this brand based on the testimonials. This is the first time I'm writing a review because this syrup was so bad, I had to throw it out. I couldn't eat it but didn't say anything to my family. One by one, all at separate times, tried the syrup. Each and every one said it was the worst syrup they had ever tasted. My husband told me to send it back but I just tossed it into the garbage. I will never buy this product again.

I love brownies but I hate all the fat and unhealthful ingredients.  I found this box on the shelf with all the "bad" box mixes and decided to give it a try.  The first time I made it I substituted half the butter for yogurt.  They were moist and delicious.  I still felt guilty about the added fat of the butter so the second time I used all yogurt.  They were fantastic!  Please give these a try, they are filling but not as heavy as you would expect, considering they are whole grain.

I make these whole grain brownies even healthier by substituting non-fat Greek yogurt for the butter and substituting prune juice for the water called for on the box.  I also add an extra egg and chopped pecans to the mix.  When I make them this way, my husband--who usually hates anything whole grain--loves them.

Best brownies I've ever eaten. Seriously delicious. They have a grainy texture that I love, but are still extremely moist and chewy. The mix requires you to add butter, two eggs and a couple of tablespoons of oil and water, but you do not need an electric mixer and it is simple to stir everything together with a wooden spoon. The directions say to melt the butter before adding it to the mix, and since you must also grease the pan, I follow this little trick to make life easier: I melt the butter in the microwave inside the glass pan that I am going to bake the brownies in. After it is melted, I tip the pan from side to side to coat the bottom and sides, then I pour the melted butter into the bowl that I am using to mix everything together. After mixing I pour the batter back into the buttered glass pan. This way I don't need to use cooking spray to coat the pan, nor do I need to dirty a separate small bowl to melt the butter, plus the brownies taste better when the pan is buttered instead of coated with Pam. A win-win!Another thing I have done is bake half the mix to make a smaller batch of brownies and save the rest for another time. This is easy to do because the amount of eggs and butter called for is easy to divide in half (two eggs means you can half it and use one egg; 1/2 cup butter goes to 1/4 cup, 2 tbsp oil goes to 1 tbsp).Note that the brownie mix has chunks of chocolate in it--and very good chocolate at that.  That must be why they call it "double chocolate."  I wasn't sure if I would like this but it is fabulous.  The quality of the chocolate alone justifies the fact that this mix cost more than other mixes.  Trust me--you won't be disappointed.PS - their pancake/waffle mix is great, too, and for that you only add water. It is so easy and so much better than Bisquick, Krusteaz, etc.PPS - I just read the other reviews and I see that many people are commenting on the health aspects such as whole wheat and no fillers.  I did not buy these for that reason but what a terrific bonus.  They are so good I would buy them as a special treat even if they were bad for me.  :)

column9: Delicious and fudgy from a "nut-free facility"
column10: We love these brownies!  They bake up rich and fudgy and so very delicious.  Ingredients: crystallized cane juice, 100% whole grain wheat flour, all natural dark chocolate chips, natural cocoa, natural vanilla, salt, leavening, vital wheat gluten.  The box says, specifically "Contains: wheat and soy, and traces of milk and eggs. Made in a nut-free facility."  We used to be able to find these on the shelf at our local grocery store.  Now, we order a case (6 boxes) from Amazon and always keep some on hand.  Easy, tasty, our family's favorite!

I found these brownies when I was buying Kodiak Cakes pancake mix (also fabulous). 100% whole grain flour, all natural ingredients and they taste fantastic! Plus, it's less expensive when you purchase on Amazon vs. the manufacturer's website when you have Amazon Prime.

We started eating healthier about 9 years ago and a major part of that was eating all 100% whole grains.  Now, these are brownies, so they have a lot of sugar in them, so that does not fit in with our lifestyle as much, but if you are going to be bad a least do it 100% whole grain with excellent taste and texture!  They are so richly chocolate it is amazing, and the chocolate chips don't hurt either!  Honestly you'd never know they are 100% whole grain.  they do take quite a lot of fat, a whole stick of butter plus 2 T oil, but you can substitute.  It is said that for any brownie mix on the market, to make them more healthy you can substitute any/all of the fats/liquids asked for in the instructions except the eggs (so like oil, butter, water) for an equal amount of any of the following: yogurt, apple sauce, pureed black beans.  I have not been brave enough yet to try the black beans, but I did try yogurt and apple sauce, they were fine, there was a bit of taste to each of those but not too much, and of course the texture was a little different without the fat.  We belong to a CSA and get a 3/4 bushel box of fresh local organic veggies/fruit each week during the growing season and one week I had a bundle of baby beet that I did not know what to do with, so I boiled them, peeled them, pureed them, and substituted them in the Big Bear Brownies for the oil, butter, and water,and they were great!  I served them twice when company was over and everyone loved them and asked for seconds, and my girls love them and ask for more and dig the slight pink tint they brownies have.  Next I am going to experiment with pureed summer squash :)  Now I am just waiting for Kodiak Cakes to come up with a recipe for chocolate cake!  No matter what you do, if you want to still be able to eat brownies but want to do it healthier without sacrificing a thing then get these brownies!

Not going to lie - I got these due to the packaging. Hey, I had money left over, so why not get a nice high quality brownie mix too?For a little bit of background, I love to home-bake and I'm the kind of guy that enjoys waking up to a nice breakfast I prepare for myself. I have a deep respect and interest in appreciating quality over quanity. Granted I'll get the cheapo brand for a lot of stuff, but when it comes to something I don't regularly make (like Brownies or Pancakes) I'll totally go up a notch and either buy the nicer brand or get good quality ingredients to scratch-cook it myself (with college and work though, I only do scratch cooking now if time and patience permits!).However I was pretty disappointed by these. By far, at about $4.68 per box at my local store, this was the most expensive brownie mix you could get on the shelf (keep in mind you still need to have all the other ingredients including the oil, eggs, butter). I'm a huge fan of skipping fillers and keeping to the good stuff so I tried them out.Unfortunatly, these brownies bake pretty dry. The moist fudgy/cake-like taste you expect from brownies was totally absent and their texture is closer to a thick gingerbread more than anything. They taste noticably worse than even the 99c brownies you can buy, and the wheat-nature of the brownies doesn't seem to enough of a saving grace to warrant an insane $5 price tag per small box (I love whole wheat, I only buy whole wheat bread and enjoy wheat pancakes). Mind you they don't taste bad, but they simply aren't what you'd expect out of a $5 box of brownies.As far as health goes, for a fraction of the price, you can easily scratch-cook your own brownies using coco and whole wheat flour for a fraction of the cost. As a matter of fact, that's pretty much what the ingredients are for this - so if you are a fan of wholesome no-bull baked goods, you're better off just making it yourself. And seeing how easy brownies are to make, its not a major inconvenience to do this either. If I am going all out on buying a dessert mix (what this brand is priced at), you might as well put the tiny amount of extra effort to combine the coco and flour yourself. If I am in the mood for no-frills, then I can get a better tasting experience just buying 99c brownies (even if it uses white enriched instead of whole wheat).
The image is of a bag of Royal Canin SO diet. The product claims to be Purina UR, which comes in a white and purple bag.

I've never had bake dried pears before but these were tough like leather and I had difficulty chewing them even though I have all my own teeth.  Small pieces of stems were left on.  The flavor was difficult to discern because of the difficulty I had chewing these dried pears. I would recommend their apple chips. They are small, but tasty and definately chip-like in texture and much easier to eat.

*****These dried D'Anjou pears are very sweet, very chewy and very yummy! They are 100% certified organic, baked with no added sugar, no preservatives or chemicals, no pesticides or herbicides, and they are gluten free. There are 2 servings in every 2.2 ounce bag, with 81 calories in each serving. These are a truly healthy and delicious snack.Note that as these are a natural food, they may contain occasional seeds, stems, or core fragments. This doesn't sound good, but I didn't really notice much of anything at all that I couldn't eat or that was hard. These dried pears are very fibrous (like jerky), so you need to have healthy teeth to be able to chew them. I totally loved them--I think they are my favorite of all of the Bare Fruit snacks!Highly recommended.*****

We like these because you get quite a few pears and they are cut in wedges, so no seeds like in the kind that are just sliced through--seeds, stems, and all. My kids gobble them up, but they are very tough, but somehow our 2.5 year old manages.
Bare Fruit makes some of my favorite dried fruits. I really like how the pear slices weren't too sweet, were chewy, and were generally good to eat =)

I love that these are organic and come in individual serving size bags which make it easy to provide healthy snacks for my daughter.  But they are so tough and chewy.  None of us like to eat them, and now I have a giant box of them sitting around.  The apple chips are much better.
Bare Fruit does a great job making healthy no junk added organic bake dried fruit. Stock up for quick kid snacks and emergency packs. They are tasty and healthy.
Yes, these do contain an occasional stem or seed.  I just pull it off before eating and life goes on.  These are a great snack for weight watchers.

column9: Seems to be a quality product
column10: This is one of very few dog foods at my local Walmart that lists beef as the first ingredient.  Most of the others are made primarily from corn meal.  I'm no dog food expert, but I would think that's a definite plus.  It is not the cheapest food you can buy, but the price is on the low end, especially when compared to small bags of premium brand dog food.  The bits are well-sized for small breeds and my 10 pound dog has no trouble at all.

I fed Purina One to my Beautiful cocker spaniel her whole life. That is all she ate  No table scraps except for an occasional hot dog at barbecues. My vet told me that "whatever I was feeding her to keep feeding her" her weight and health was perfect. Her only health issue was the dreaded cocker spaniel ears.I now have a new 14 lbs Shorkie. He eats Purina One as his only food...He was a rescue dog and at three years old had some digestive issues. He doesn't have anymore problems after I started him on this food.I wouldn't think of feeding him anything else.

column9: Great for small or medium breeds
column10: My dog loves this but the kibble size is tooooo small. Would be perfect for dogs under 35lb in my opinion. But I still use it as supplement to my dog's main kibbles Blue and Nutro Max. It seems that the kibbles have real dried beef mixed in it. I haven't seen other kibbles have such lookingly real ingredients. Not sure about the product quality but will keep an eye on it.

I received my order in a timely manner but when I tasted the lemon packets they didn't taste right.  Couldn't find a expiration date so I didn't feel comfortable using them.  I threw them away. Didn't mind wasting the cost of the lemon packets but the shipping had doubled the price. Lesson learned.

The Realemon taste just like  a fresh lemon, I use one  per 16oz glass of water, in tea, or just for seasoning in cooking, the use for these packs of lemons is endless, and they stay fresh, will re-order from this same seller.

column9: The item is terrific, and was delivered as represented
column10: This item is very hard for the public to purchase.  We came across it at some resterants.  It really is a great buy.  We had almost given up on finding it for home use.  Thank's to Amazon.comfor having it available for us.  We have learned to go to Amazon.com for All items we are lookingfor.  we go there First now.  Thank you Amazon.com

BEST we have ever had- same difference as the madhouse potao chips- light crispy crunch and amazing corn flavor- cooked in a light oil and better for you. We use them to dip, microwave nachos these are the best!!!!! Too good to have around the house!

column9: Madhouse Munchies Blue Corn Tortilla Chips
column10: These blue corn chips were super delicious, just the right amount of salt, not greasy - they became a bit too pricey for us, so we stopped ordering them.

I love these chips. They're big and they taste great and they're my favorite chip by far. But that's not what I'm writing about. I'm writing about they way I received a box of these from Amazon and they were destroyed. Almost all the bags were opened and bits of the chips were everywhere - it looked like someone set off a bomb in my box of chips. So I called Amazon and complained, and they were nice enough to send me another box. But the new box arrived in the same sorry state state as the original box.I wrote an email to Madhouse Munchies and told them I love their chips but unfortunately Amazon doesn't know how to ship them so I'm going to have to buy some crappy Tostitos down at the local ShopRite. A girl from Madhouse responded with some questions. What kind of box did it arrive in? A white box with a perforated section that wasn't punched out.  What? That's a display box - those idiots aren't supposed to ship them in that! Well, that's what they sent me both times. Okay, we'll ship you a new box from the factory. And they did. It was the same white box only it was packaged INSIDE another bigger box, and everything arrived in perfect shape, crunch, crunch, oh yeah.She also told me they would talk to Amazon about how to ship their products and I guess they did, because I've ordered them again from Amazon many times and they've always arrived with the improved packaging and they've always been perfect.

column9: Perfect chip in every way, but a terrible bag!
column10: I love these chips,  Perfect, really,  Just the right amount of salt, fresh tasting, healthy,  I am so impressed with this product,  They're not too thick, unlike so many tortilla chips,  My only complaint is the bag they come in,  It's terrible, It has absolutely no flexibility to it, so when you open it to get out just a few chips, the entire bag rips,  It's really irritating,  I end up having to transfer the chips into a ziplock bag,  Not too cool,  So, if this company wants to make this the perfect tortilla chip, they'd package them in a different bag, Pronto!
Great chips...made with olive oil.  We go through a whole bag everytime we open one.
I had never tried this brand, but they may be some of the best corn chips I've had!  Very crunchy and just the right amount of salt.  I highly recommend.

The question about any product is always, Is it worth it's price? Here, no. THe tea's taste is reviewed elsewhere, so check it out, and maybe it's standard practice by certain connie suers to ignore price, but I never do. I gave it a try, like it, but won't buy it again. Tastes tannicky. I'll stick to Barry's, and that's double what Trader Joe's Irish Breakfast cost, which is pretty good itself.
I loved this corn meal!  It was very tasty and I have been told, very nutritious.  I put some into pancakes and my kids loved the beautiful purple color!I would definately buy it again.

After spending a couple of weeks in Italy, I brought some Tarallini home to enjoy....when i ran out, I searched and searched for the brand I got in Italy (Tarallificio dei Trulli) but couldn't find it, so I gave these a shot....They are terrific! The Tarallificio were a "hair" better, but these are still great and I'm going to go back for more!
Contrary to the previously purchased Twix of the same size package and ordered/shipped together, these are fresh tasting, great with a cup of coffee and a good value for the money.
My order arrived in good condition and before the projected delivery date. I have no complaints.
My son rated this as approved for heaven...and this is one picky kid...doesn't eat sweets much and is very finicky about everything he eats

column9: Gotta love that Kit Kat Bar!
column10: This is my 2nd favorite candy bar. I like to put these in the freezer before I eat them. They are even more crisp. Dunk them in milk. What pleasure that is.

This is one of my favorite candies to satisfy my chocolate sweet tooth. The milk chocolate has a nice smooth taste, and the wafer has just the right texture--not too hard or soft or crumbly. The combination is delicious.Shop for price. I buy these at my local Costco for twenty dollars.

I love Kit Kat bars.  Always have!  They taste delicious and they have, as another poster wrote, just the right amount of crunch!  Yum yum!These little bars are addictive, as I can attest.  :-)I just had my second Kit Kat bar.......so that's two, inside of 4 minutes!  LOL!And they go so well with a nice, cold glass of milk!
Hershey's chocolate contains PGPR (Polyglycerol Polyricinoleate) which is derived from castor beans.  The chemical weapon ricin is made from castor beans too.  I'd rather eat real chocolate!
This mix has a very good taste and zero nutritional value.  You might as well be drinking a soda.  So, if you want a smoothie with some nutrition, you're going to have to add your own stuff.

There is an image displaying 20 different K cups, you do not get that in this package. Beware of the Fine Print. I received Doubles of 10 different brands.  Some of the brands I received were shown in the picture and some were not.  We were hoping to try the Starbucks blonde brand and that one was not in the box, but it is featured in the picture to the bottom right. I would not buy this product again.

Tastes great hard as heck to make. When I saw the box I thought to my self, Really? It was small but when you mix the ingredients you make quite a bit of batter Makes the exact amount the box says it does, I think it was 48 or 64 4inch churros, its been a few months since I bought them though. If you make them right they come out as churros, if you make them wrong you end up with a churro-funnel cake hybrid. Still tastes good regardless.
This is the only tomato product I use to cook with.  I was so glad to find it on Amazon.  So much less expensive than the local store and they don't always stock it.

column9: For a quick and healthy meal...
column10: ...put some dry pasta (I like rotini) in an 8x8 pan, crumble some dry basil over it, or any spices you like. Take a can of these wonderful tomatoes, dump over the dry pasta and enough boiling water to barely cover the pasta and cover with foil....bake until water is absorbed and pasta is tender. Every pantry needs these tomatoes!
This product is terrific; I use it all the time in my cooking.  I love the idea that my family isn't being exposed to extra pesticides and herbicides since the tomatoes are organic.  Yum!!

Holy pizza, Batman! We just put this on our pizza tonight, and it is the best sauce we have used so far. Just the right amount of sauce, nice big chunks of flavorful tomato. I never want to try anything else, now. Unfortunately, the cost is a little pricey for my budget, but the price here at Amazon is definitely the best I have seen. Muir Glen knows how to treat a tomato!
this tomato sauce has more flavor than any of the other brands I have tried.full of flavor and less sodium than other name brands.
This is a great tasting and quality product.  It is a great consistency for all my recipes.  I have used it many times & it is on my reorder list.

Muir Glen cans are lined in plastic and leach Bisphenol A. Too bad because this was a great product and was a standard in my household. My initial conversations with them they contradicted this fact, which to me was misleading. General Mills owns Cascadian Farms as well and now I don't buy there either.Now we use BioNature in jars or Pomi products in Tetra Pak cartons. All canned tomato products use BPA and so do many of the lids of jars used in food containment.Now I also just make from scratch which is made simple by chef Andrew Carmellini in Everyday Italian. Lydia Bastianich is another favorite chef that deserves mention for simple yet big flavors.Boil, peel, freeze and store. Can manufacturing companies that I corresponded with said they were working on a solution for later this year or next year.

My husband bought this donut mix for me to try with our mini donut maker.  We had been using recipes for our donut batter and thought we'd try something different. Unfortunately, the donuts we made with this mix were disgusting.  The texture was okay, but the taste was artificial and left a bad aftertaste.  The chocolate was fake and chemically, the frosting being even worse than the donut itself.  We'll stick to making our own batter and using real ingredients.

column9: The right blend of Ginger and Black tea
column10: Before buying this, I was dissuaded by the negative reviews on this.Agree that this does not have a super strong ginger flavor which comes out and hits at you, but a subtle flavor which you can enjoy.For a perfect blend, boil (yes boil, not dip) 2 tea bags in 250 ml of water or milk.

highly disappointed !!!!! i have been using Tetley cardamom for years and was very pleased with it. I thought of trying ginger flavor but felt like cheated.....using even two teabags at once does not give even an essence of ginger...wish Tetley had a better quality assurance department to check things before they send them out for sale...
We absolutely LOVE this ginger tea. It is black tea with some ginger flavoring, and is quite delightful, especially with a spoonful of sugar. My daughter likes it with milk.
This rice has a good flavor. I keep them on hand when I need a quick side dish.  Nice amount of spices.

Knorr/Lipton Rice Sides, Herb & Butter, 5.4-Ounce Packages (Pack of 12)  A long time ago you had a very very good product that was known as herb & butter rice ( NO SIDES-pasta), and it could be used alone or to be mixed with ground meat, bell peppers,& tomatoes to create unstuffed bell peppers.  Then some one decided to IMPROVE!!? the mix by adding pasta, and it is just not as good, but it is the only way I can get the rice that I like.  PLEASE PLEASE go back to the pastaless rice.  Thanks in advance

This rice tastes great and is a great compliment to any main dish.  It's flavorful but not overpowering so you can pair it with chicken, fish, beef, seafooed or vegetables for a completely satisfying meal!

column9: Seems good for this type of thing
column10: This is not only pre-seasoned, but it makes it's own sauce.  Not too much, but a fair amount.  It's good; however if you let this sit a bit, it will congeal.This product makes a good balancer for spicy toppings; it helps to cut some of the heat when served with spiced foods.I admit that I'm not quite used to these kinds of products, since I typically have made rice from scratch; but I've been trying a few different convenience products just to check them out.  So this, like all of them, has that "convenience food" quality to it, and you aren't going to confuse it with fresh; but for what it is, it's a nice basic that has a lot of applications.
Rice Sides, Herb & Butter was very tasty. It was better than I thought it would be. I intend to keep buying it.

Of the few Knorr rice sides that our household has tried, this is the only one we like. It doesn't taste like dehydrated camping food. It is a good product. The flavor and texture of the rice is  very nice.

Am very limited in what I can eat, and this product is a definite keeper. Is easily and very quickly prepared. Left-overs store very nicely, and this is yet another  product I cannot find where I live, so am doubly grateful that Amazon carries this.

column9: Use it a million different ways!
column10: Lipton Rice Sides, Herb & Butter is something to keep on hand so you're never without a quick meal. It's got a wonderful flavor (not overpowering) and a nice texture.Use your imagination and add shrimp, beef, pork, diced chicken,toasted nuts, etc.! There are no limits to what you can make with it by adding leftovers or whatever you have on hand. Take that ground meat you would have used for burgers, cook up some mini-meatballs and toss them with the rice! Put broccoli flowerettes around the sides, sprinkle with grated parmesan or cheddar!You can have lots of fun with this product!

This product is amazing. The smell as soon as the bag is open is heavenly - such a 'real' chocolate aroma. And the taste is so much better!It is promoted as being able to brew just like coffee - that is you can use it in a drip machine or french press. But it doesn't 'taste' like coffee - this is full on chocolate tasting!!  Personally I dont like it made with water, I prefer the creaminess of a hot chocolate made with milk.  But i do make the concentrate as per instructions on their website - mix some Crio Bru (quite a bit!) with sugar and water - boil and simmer to make a cacao concentrate that can be added to anything for a chocolate fix.  Even poured over ice cream!  And that it has no sugar or fat (marginal) of its own - it is guilt free, which you just cant believe as you take a sip - the flavour is so much fuller, stronger, smoother than any hot chocolate or even candy bar I've had. And I'll happily give them up and live on Crio Bru!  The only down side is that being ground cacao beans, you do need to strain any liquid drinks or syrups you make - although they grind is quite edible on its own if you dont mind a bit of 'roughage'. It is great added into granola or the like 'raw' straight from the pouch.

column9: Been reported to Amazon.  Buyer beware.
column10: Never received the salsa and the vendor never responded to my email.  Amazon reimbursed me thanks to their A thru Z guarantee.  This vendor should be removed from the site.

It's a neet gift idea for the person that has everything but after the last box arrived I realized that I paid a lot of money for salsa that is just Ok.  I'm not sure where the Gourmet part comes in. I've had better from the Market.
I ordered this as a gift for my son for his birthday. shipping was very fast, only two days. And best of all he loved his salsa. Thanks a Bunch!

column9: Salsa of the Month was Great!
column10: I just received The Salsa of the Month Club package and everything was great!  I was excited to try two new salsas from different specialty companies that I would've never been able to try.  They arrived in a sturdy box with foam packing peanuts.  I admit that I was a little nervous that they wouldn't arrive safely, but the glass jars were completely fine.  They were even accompanied by a newsletter giving some background about the salsas and the companies who made them.  They both looked so good, it was hard to decide which one to open first!  My wife and I decided to open the Pink's Mild Salsa from Pennsylvania to accompany our fajitas that we were making for dinner.  It was bold, fresh and made with minimal ingredients and also contained no allergens.  Medically, my wife has to follow a Gluten Free diet, so we are always concerned with allergens and trying to eat foods closer to nature.  A few days later we opened the second salsa (after scraping the first jar dry) and were equally impressed!  The second jar was a Picante Salsa from Hillside Orchard farms in Georgia and was very flavorful and had some visibly large cilantro pieces (my favorite), but was not as chunky as the other one.  This one was great to pour over tacos, as it had more of a sauce consistency, but it was a little harder to pick up with a chip.  Overall, I was very satisfied and I'm looking forward to next month's salsas!  This was the perfect gift for us and would highly recommend the Salsa of the Month Club!

I am so hooked on Big Train brand Chai tea products.  I only like them hot really.  I've been buying the No Sugar Added Vanilla Chai because I need the no sugar product, and, surprisingly, it does not lack in flavor.  It is a little more caloric than other teas, but it is really quite good.

Just confirming my previous experience with LaCosta Gourmet--the product was great-great value for the price -helped with shipping arrangements--and when I had to return something(my fault)-they were great about it and refunded my $ promptly...I will continue to order from them as they have a great selection--and they do samples--which was wonderful to be able to try!!!

So ordering this was an experiment, I'd never tried it before and wasn't sure what to expect, but I was trying to eat all-natural (vegan) and this looked like a decent option. It was fantastic. I even sent some to a friend of mine and she was equally thrilled. I added about a cup of cashews to the mix and it was pretty much perfect.

pretty stale dates, for the price quality seemed guaranteed but a major disappointment. Hate to give a bad review since their approval rate is very high I hope it was only this item that was bad and rest of buyers get a fresh and edible item.

When I received this is tasted terrible! I have been buying this brand locally for some time and I know how it should taste. This must be really old. I noticed there was no expiration dates on the product but when I buy it locally it always has an expiration date. I wouldn't recommend buying this! Beware
THIS TEA IS GREAT, BUT I COULDN'T FIND IT ANY MORE IN MY GROCERY STORE. THEN I FOUND IT ON AMAZON FOR THE SAME PRICE AS MY STORE. IT FITS IN MY ONE CUP COFFEE STEAMER JUST RIGHT.

I have a dog that doesn't just eat any and all dog treats. She is now 12 and with age continues to become even more "selective" in her choices when I try to find nutritious treats for her. She LOVES these! They are a little pricey in my opinion but worth it because I love my pup so much.

I purchase several types of snacks for my hubby and I but find this product to be one of our favorites. It has lots of sesame sticks, which we love. Also the idea that four packages are included in the price is a good buy. I would definitely buy again.

column9: Very tastey product, no wheat or potatoes.Passes wife test
column10: I bought this to season home made french fries for guests.  It was a big hit for those that like Vinegar chips like me.Unfortunately, I developed an allergy to potatoes, bread, wheat and other starches.  Gives me arthritis for the short answer.So, I use it on my home made chicken wings.  Wow, bangin'. I really like this stuff.I have not tried a whole bunch of Vinegar powder/salt options but this stuff tastes real good.My wife really likes fries and vinegar chips as well.  This was a great addition to my seasonings.BIG DEAL...  This stuff does not have any kind of flower in it to prevent caking. This means those with some allergies can eat it!!!Check first to be sure they don't change the formula on me.

column9: stick to real salt and vinegar
column10: Save yourself some money and get better results. To get this flavoring on your fries you are much better off buying a bottle of malt vinegar and some salt. I did not find it particular flavorful or convenient

I used this on popcorn and let me tell you...it was fantastic if you are a big salt and vinegar fan. Just be sure not to put too much (or too little lol) on it, it could make or break it. But once you figure out the perfect amount, you will not regret it! i havent tried it on anything else yet but i'm sure it'd be great on potato or whatever else you can think of lol.

If you like vinegar flavor then this is a healthy low calorie seasoning option. I use this on popcorn which I eat almost every other day as it makes a great low calorie healthy snack. This is a large container of seasoning though and I feel this will last me for a year.I bought 3 smaller packs of this seasoning at target and I gave 2 to my relatives. I recently found that Target stopped keeping these on their shelves and I had couple of restless weeks eating land popcorn. Glad to find this on Amazon!

column9: Excellent sprinkled on Kale Chips and nuts
column10: I baked up a batch of Kale Chips then sprinkled this Salt & Vinegar seasoning on them and it was addictive. A good balance between the salt and vinegar flavors. Also sprinkled them on some smoked almonds and macadamia nuts, it was good but the seasoning had a hard time sticking to the nuts. Overall a tasty low-carb way to season foods for some great snacks.

I use it on popcorn, fries salad, eggs soups etc. I love it! I have not had one bad experience with this yet. I tried the J&d malt and it tastes nasty. This is the real deal. Oh of course it is amazing on chicken fried or baked. Great alternative on baked chicken to get hot wings flavor with less calories.

Got this to sprinkle on almonds and walnuts as an alternative to purchasing more expensive flavored nuts. It's okay; a little sharp. I may try soaking the nuts in water and then sprinkling with this so the flavor is more infused.

Very good product - makes just about anything "Salt & Vinegar" without the moosh.  S&V Popcorn is outstanding!  Thinking about buying it in bulk, my life would be empty without this stuff from now on!
The flavor is very vinegary and salty, just like the flavor on store bought chips! You can use it on anything, can't wait to try it on homemade chips. Very good product.
forget the second coming, i am saved.  i used to wander around the kitchen, a lost soul with no direction.  NO MORE!

These breakfast cookies are delicious! They have a fresh ginger taste, and they really do keep you full. I usually have a small snack about two hours after breakfast, but since eating these, I don't feel hungry again for at least 4 hours. At 290 calories, I would recommend them to anyone who needs a quick, healthy breakfstt.

column9: Great, but No Need for them as Skittles is now Gelatin-free
column10: Would be awesome a couple of years ago when Skittles had gelatin but now there is no need to sell these because Skittles is now gelatin-free.

I am so happy to have found this gum that I so fondly remember from my past.  This is the gum that was 2 cents at some drug stores, maybe 5 cents at others.  I love the flavor although it doesn't last more than a few minutes.  It will bring you back to those good old days where Grandma gave you a nickel and you had to choose wisely.  This green apple gum was almost always the way I spent my nickel...and worth every penny!

This gum was a flavor I chewed when I was younger! I couldn't find it anywhere! I was so excited when I found it and shared half of the box with my best friend who also loved it when we were in junior high. The flavor is still the same!!!!!!! Highly recommend it! It is green in the wrapper and turns blue in your mouth! So cool and so yummy! Blows big bubbles!
Tasty!  The only reason this does not get 5 stars is because I think it might be a leading cause of cavities in my mouth.

the hotel i stayed at in paris(hotel claret)september 2010, had carte noire as the "house coffee" they served it in a cup, espresso and cappuccino and i was in love.i thought i would have to go alllllllll the way to france for this again or spend a ton on overseas shipping but here it is!EVERYONE THAT READS THIS, BUY IT RIGHT NOW DONT THINK JUST CLICK "BUY NOW"
Cafe Noire is so smooth and decadent that drinking it feels like you are treating yourself very special and what a fabulous way to start the day!

Carte Noire is simply the best French coffee from France you can buy on line: It is every thing the French like in coffee: dark, rich and cheap.  Unlike the American coffee medium roast, it the best dark-medium roast you can buy.
This was a fantastic serving of the Serrano hams.  It has inspired me to save up for the Jamon Ibérico Bellota.

Healthy, tasty and portable.  These packets are great 'on-the-go' and perfect for the gym bag.  When you can't tote around fresh, this is the next best option.  More pear than mango flavor and the texture of smooth applesauce.  Most recently, packed these for a work trip.  It was a good way to add a little something healthy to the hotel and fast food that often dominate when it comes to business travel.

My 11 month old loves these.  He can suck the food out himself and be independent.  We just went on a week long trip and brought a bunch of these along for when he got hungry in between our meals.  It worked great.
Luv this all natural Zero calorie sugar subsitute!  I use it in my coffee, tea, ceral, on fruit and everything else I put sugar in or on.
Stevia is the only sweetener that I use because it is the only save zero calaorie natural sweetener. To find it as an organic product is a double plus.

I BBQ quite a bit w/a real emphasis on Chicken & Pork.  I'm guessing that the Korean culture perfected BBQ sauces when the USA was a dream some thousand years away.  Give this stuff a shot on chicken, ribs or tenderloin.  I was skeptical but thouroghly rewarded upon my first use.  You can use this as a marinade as well as a mop/baste with great results.  Not a great dipping sauce on a standalone basis but it's strength is when heat is applied.

column9: It's the perfect lunch box snack
column10: These are small bags, just the right size as a snack for my kindergartener.  They are not the size you find at stores so don't be surprised when you receive them.  Also, they ship all 300 loosely thrown into a cardboard box so you'll open the box and there they are...  Not neat at all, but that's how they come.  My son loves these.
Svenhard's varity pack pastries are great.  Individually wrapped to stay fresh and very tasty.  Box of 36 of different varities.  Freezes well.  I eat one every day that we are at home!

Quality is fantastic. Received order faster than promised. Would like to have the option of ordering a smaller package. 4 ~ 100 to 150 means I received over 400 petals. Considerably more than I needed, but at least I am not driving all over town looking for these at local retailers.

I've been buying this brand of seltzer water from my local grocer for many years.  In fact, I have a bottle of this next to me on the desk right now to sip as I surf.  I wasn't even looking for this, in particular.  Coincidence? In my case, probably not.Something about the bubbles settles my stomach.  (I weaned myself off of Coke and the like years ago, but I still want my fizz!)This has been a good and dependable brand as long as I have known it, and that's a long time.  My only caution, and this is important, is to unscrew the cap SLOWLY the first time, because otherwise, you may get an unexpected baptism.  It doesn't happen every time, but it's happened aften enough to make me very careful!If you like seltzer, you'll like this.  I also recommend the lemon-lime flavor as well as the orange and raspberry varieties.  I'm not wild about the cherry.  I'd rather drink the plain than the cherry, but that's a personal thing.  I also use this product to top up my Crystal Light type drinks to give them a little "pop."  Pun intended.Oh, and in answer to the other reviewer, it's one liter bottles, 12 of them to a case. I drink it warm, I drink it cold.  I just like it.

I am interested in buying this for personal use.  There is no description at all about what I am buying other than it's Vintage brand seltzer.  What is 28 pounds?  Is it 1 pound of product and 27 pounds of container?  27.9 pounds of seltzer and .1 pounds of container?  How much is a pound of seltzer anyway? Are all 28 pounds in one container,  16 ounce bottles, 1 oz. bottles, one pound bottles?I can't imagine they're moving too much of this product through this ad.

I had tried the original, and liked them. Unfortunately, they are hard to chew, because I have weak muscles. I was pretty happy finding the chewy version, where I can suck on them, and get them to break down faster!They are very similar to Skittles-Original Fruit Candies, 3.5lb Bag, but larger, and not made with real fruit.

I was glad to find these Kraft Sweet & SourSauce cups at Amazon because Kraft hasdiscontinued the bottles that I used tobuy at the grocery store.  The sauce itselfis just so-so; OK but nothing real special.I've had much better at Asian restaurants.We've tried several other brands sold atthe grocery store in the Oriental foodssection, but we still haven't found onethat we consider excellent.  These will dofor now because I frequently make homemadechicken tenders and wings and the sweet/souris our favorite flavor of dipping sauce.These little cups are very convenient tothrow in the picnic basket or lunch bag too.
Excellent nuts.  hard to find in stores.  great to be able to get these, especially the salted variety.  will continue to order

These sunflower seeds are larger and more flavorful than the big name brand jumbo sunflower seeds. As another reviewer posted, there is an abundance of salt on the shell, but that doesn't detract from the great taste. Warning: they are extremely addictive!

column9: Too much salt that is hardened on sunflower seeds....
column10: Terrible. I have tried before the one with no salt. They were fine. But these ones with salt are not good. Too much salt that is stuck on the seeds. I tried to wash them. It is still not easy to wash it off. I won't buy this product any more.

The Endangered Species bars are immensely popular due to their environmental consciousness,as well as being vegan. As chocolate bars,they're a mixed bunch. The peanut butter bar tastes more like cardboard,but the one with cherry essence is PERFECT! The koala bar not only has facts about Australia's favorite animal (along with the kangaroo),but it tastes great. It has a pleasant fruity flavor. Endangered Species bars give part of their profits to save the environment, so it tastes good and does good too!

A great company and well priced organic chocolate. The Cherry is very good, not overpowering. This is one of my favorite flavor of thier chocolates I have had so far (Blueberry,Peanut Butter, Milk Chocolate, and Dark Chocolate).

I made this cupcakes after biting the bullet because they are way too expensive for a mix, but I hoped for the best. They were rather dry and donuty and the frosting had an off unpleasant taste. I'm not sure but the vanilla in the frosting tasted artificial. I would not reccommend this mix because of the high price and rather low quality.

I usually like Stonewall Kitchen products, so I was excited to see one of my favorite recipe book author lending her name to a product.  I finally bit the bullet and shelled out $10+ for a boxed mix and I was SOOOO disappointed!  The box comes with three packets - the cake mix, coconut, & "frosting mix" (which is just powdered sugar).  The cupcakes were okay - they were pretty moist, but I used all the coconut in the cake rather then reserving 1/3 for the topping (I used additional store-bought coconut for the topping).  The "frosting" was awful - it's the packet of sugar mixed with butter and cream cheese and it was very bad when made as directed.  I added in about another cup of powered sugar to make the constancy spreadable and taste right.Over all, the cupcakes were a hit, but for a $10+ mix that makes 12 cupcakes I shouldn't have to buy and add my own ingredients!  I could have easily done this from scratch for the same or less money and it would have been just as simple!
loved this recipe as i am a coconut lover to begin with ,but this mix went far beyound the typical mixes-it was like homemade-thankyou
These things are awesome and worth the money. If you're really into the coconut cake/cupcakes, try Ina's recipe for coconut cake on the Food Network website, it is work-intensive but so good.

I thought 10 bucks was a little much for the cupcakes but I love Ina Garten and really wanted to try them so I went ahead and bought it. I'm glad I did because they were delicious! I couldn't wait for them to cool to frost them and the top of the little cupcakes were nice and crunchy (I may have baked them for a couple of minuted too long). They were fantastic with and without the frosting! I got the original recipe off of Food TV's website, made it and the end product tasted exactly the same as the boxed one I'd made. I will probably not buy the box again since I have the recipe and can make more with less money from that. I do highly recommand this though!

I just made these cupcakes; they are to die for.  They are very easy to make and if you like coconut, you will LOVE these cupcakes.  I left the coconut off 3 of the cupcakes and they are delicious even without.  Mmmmmmmmmmmmmm.N.B. This mix makes TEN cupcakes not 12 like you might expect.

There are not enough verbs in the English language to describe how good these are!!  My mom loves coconut and I made these for her 60th birthday.  She loved them...but I am IN LOVE with them!!!  I love the cupcake and am going to try the coconut cake next time!

I originally received this mix as a party favor. When I finally got around to making the cupcakes for some friends, everyone loved them! I was sad to have to tell everyone that they came from a mix but everyone asked for the recipe. I even took the leftovers to work where one of my co-workers made me promise to make her a cake out of them for her birthday (which I did). They are kind of pricey but it's almost a year later and people still bring them up!

I'm not one for the boxed mix -- this was a gift. I've just finished frosting these cupcakes and am in love! This super easy kit produces the finest cupcake; moist, dense and flavorful, that I've tasted.  The cream cheese frosting is silky and perfect.Well done Barefoot Contessa, well done!

column9: Aloha Sunset Apple Cinnamon Macadamia Nut flavor Pancake Mix
column10: This product is absolutely DELICIOUS! No syrup is even needed.  It has such a nice sweet tastey flavor all by itself.
The products are delicious, however, the size of the basket is disappointing for the price.  The products are comparable to  snack sizes, so don't be mislead.
The jpg is almost actual size.  Definitely not worth the money.  You WILL be disappointed. Very small, not a good value.
It was better than expected. I sent it as a gift to my cousin and she was very happy with the presentation and the items in it.

column9: The mystery flavor is people... people!
column10: But seriously, I think it's a sort of strawberry lemonade. In any case, it's absolutely fantastic.  It's the kind of tartness that produces a ton of saliva, and really perks up your mouth.  Hubba Bubba has the perfect consistency for blowing bubbles, too, it's my favorite brand for it.  I highly recommend this flavor, I sure hope they don't discontinue it.
A member of my family chews gum all the time so buying in bulk is the answer.  This makes keeping a supply on hand very easy.

column9: There is no mystery...this gum tastes great!
column10: I am a huge fan of Hubba Bubba Max gum.  I love the texture of this gum.  It is super soft and the flavor lasts long.  I've tried all of the flavors and this is my favorite one thus far!  The mystery flavor is lemonade with a little cherry added in the middle.  It has a sour kick to it, so if you like sour candy you will love this gum.

My husband loves these granola bars.  He uses them to satisfy his sweet tooth and his chocolate cravings and I don't mind because they're a lot better than eating a candy bar.  The price is a decent savings from what I've seen in stores but I haven't been able to find this particular kind locally anymore so I'll continue to buy from here.

column9: Dark Chocolate Peanut and Almond Bars
column10: Very tasty. We eat them in place of a candy bar. I do not know if you could say these are really healthy but they taste really yummy and I am sure they are much healthier than a candy bar. Full of nuts and little chunks of dark chocolate. The chocolate has a good flavor, not bitter. So if you get a craving for a candy bar just reach into your brief case or purse and eat one of these instead. These are sweet but they don't set my teeth on edge like a candy bar does. Ours were fresh and chewy, I wonder if the other reviewer might have got an old batch or something. These are wrapped individually and are great to throw in a back pack, purse or in the car for a snack on the run.

column9: I used to absolutely love this!-EDIT
column10: (Update on May 22, 2012) I used to absolutely love this granola bar! One problem, in the last 2 batches of subcription I received, I've noticed they changed the recipe! Bad mistake, General Mills! The current variation is now more sticky and tougher to chew. The taste is not as balanced as before either, and the nutritional value is different.Calories are the same, but the Total Fat is increased. Saturated Fat is decreased, but the Sodium increased, carbs is increased. Fiber is DECREASED with Sugars INCREASED! What this means for me is what used to be a 4 Weight Watchers Points Plus breakfast, is now 5 points. Sure it's only 1 points, but the taste isn't as good any more.In the ingredients list one notable difference is that there is now less dark chocolate chunks, but more sugar.All in all, I wish they would go back to the old recipe. It's still good, but not as great as before.---- Earlier review: (5/9/11) ----This is a chewy delicious granola bar that is pretty sweet but not overly so because it has dark chocolate instead of milk chocolate.The almonds give it a nice crunch, and there is a peanut-butter-like layer on the bottom, and I dont even like peanut butter that much and I love it.I'm on the Weight Watcher Points Plus and I was looking for a nice filling granola bar that I can either eat as a breakfast bar, or as dessert, and it fits both perfectly, and at 4 points per bar, I still have enough points to eat a good portion lunch or dinner.I highly recommend it so much that I'm going to get an amazon subscription for it!

So far, Nature Valley Sweet & Salty Nut is the best bar for my use.  I carry them on my motorcycle for a quick and easy snack on the road.  They work well for me because they don't crumble or get sticky goo on my hands.  Easy to eat and handle is a big deal when there are no clean-up facilities.  Oh, yeah, they taste great too.
Of the many sweet & salty granola bars there is one for everyones taste,and from a quick snack to a trail meal that keeps you on the go it is perfect.

I love these bars and have one for breakfast every morning. With the chocolate, peanut butter and nuts I start my morning with a happy face. They are also cheaper to buy at Amazon than the grocery store

My wife and I love to travel: bicycle in summer time, snowboard in winter time, car all year around and these snacks are really good in all situations. I was fan of peanut bar but once I tried peanut & almond it has become my favorite. Highly recommended!

These taste sinfully good. Addictive, delicious! Chocolate and nuts, in my opinion, one can't go wrong with that combo! I recommend this product to anybody, but especially to those who want a terrific snack lower in calories. These are really good!!!
Love these Sweet & Salty bars. Unfortunately, they are addictive but we limit ourselves to only one a day :) Better than other brands - we have them on auto ship with Amazon!

column9: Nature Valley Bars are the Greatest!
column10: I love the almond and peanut bars made from Nature Valley.  In addition to being healthy they have a great taste.  They make a great afternoon Pick-me up.

These Nature Valley "Sweet & Salty Nut Granola Bars" are good for between meal snacks and are fairly filling. While not very big, these bars pack a lot of flavor and energy that make them a real treat and I like that my kids will eat these in place of a candy bar.The only issue with these is that the bottom peanut butter layer can be come very soft and messy when heated up by a warm day of from being held in the hand too long, but I have learned to eat these held in the open wrapper to avoid the problem.My family also enjoys Nature Valley Sweet & Salty Nut Granola Bars, Peanut, 6-Count Boxes (Pack of 12)Recommended!CFH
They were okay and I did eat them but for some reason I remembered these as being chewy and they were limp and did not have a lot of texture.  I do not really think i will order again.

they taste good but weather its the peanuts or sunflower inside is rancid and taste old which upset my stomack and throw therest of the order out.a lot of times this is not because theproduct sits on the shelves too long but the company uses cheap ingredients to begin with. just went bought some fresh almonds and added some fresh honey to it.

Worth every penny - fresh and well packed from Maine to Seattle in one day.  Packed in 2 pound "netted" packages surrounded with "blue ice" packages for refrigeration. All in a sturdy styrofoam container and boxed. Out of my 4 pound order, only 3 of the clams were broken and had to be thrown away. All the others were fresh and "closed". Cleaning and cooking instuctions included. Maine steamed clams are one of the most tender varieties - not chewy like little necks or other varieties.  Steam 10 minutes, take beard off neck, dip in butter and arrive in Heaven.

I was concerned when I got these because I don't know that much about clams but had a really amazing recipe I wanted to try. I was happily surprised after doing some research and finding out that they were okay and how to eat them. We had the most amazing dinner in the world. I will absolutely order from them again!

column9: fine pasta, but beware the size
column10: FYI this alphabet pasta is called "soup cut" size, but a better description would be 'teeny-tiny'.  It is much smaller than the alphabet pasta in canned soups, which is the size I thought I'd be getting.  I have a son who, oddly, will try anything in ABC/123 form, so I thought I'd try to get him to eat pasta with these, and I couldn't find them in any store locally.These letters are so small, I had to put the meat sauce on the plate and then the letters on top, just so the kids would see what they are.  They'd be completely lost under a ladle of sauce.  To give you an idea, I'm guessing a bowl of alphabet soup has MAYBE 50-75 letters in it?  A child would have to eat hundreds of these letters to equate one meal.  There must be well over 1000 in a small package.I also used them to make "frog-eye salad,' which it was a good size for.  But now I have several bags left over I'm tempted to hand out to friends for free!  Come to think of it, maybe I'll let the kids use some for arts/crafts.  But they could write an entire book with just one bag!

I have searched every grocery store in my area with no success. Checked out several places on the internet until I found this product on Amazon. The box of 12 packages cost a little more than when available in local store, but the look on my grandchildren's faces and the fun they had with their dinner, made it well worth the expense. It also pleased an eighty-six year old mother-in-law who also had not been able to find alphabet pasta for many years. The pasta was well-packaged, fresh and cooked up very well.

column9: Real brown sugar, not white sugar with molasses-this stuff should replace brown sugar!
column10: It's really good, and as described-a caramelly taste.It's almost like eating candy-the only downside is shipping-15 dollars total, other than that it tastes pretty good.I'm excited to put it in my oatmeal :); if I could describe it I'd say it resembles brown sugar in both taste, and color. In this time we're living in now, it's exciting to see how versatile, and a true blessing coconuts are.They provide us with food, water,sweetner,moisturizer,oil for cooking, and an overall healthy natural product for us consumers.Enjoy!

I have been looking for healthier sweeteners.  Coconut sugar is supposed to be less processed and I do like the taste.  It is fragrant, with subtle layers of coconut flavour, so if you don't want your beverage to acquire any additional flavour then this is not for you.  It is also less sweet than regular white sugar, which is good.  Overall, I think the flavour is lovely and it doesn't bother me even in teas like Earl Grey.

column9: The perfect snack or side dish.
column10: This is one of my grandson's favorite Happy Baby flavor.  Perfect for dipping his pancake pieces in.  Great with chicken and turkey.  An excellent way to make sure he gets his veggies.  An added bonus:  Salba, a strain of chia seed that is super nutritious - lots of omega 3s, fiber, protein and antioxidents.Only Happy Baby adds special ingredients like this.Happy Baby HAPPYTOT BUTTERNUT SQUASH & APPLE organic super food for kids 4.22 oz

column9: Great item but not a great price!
column10: My children (almost 3 & 1-1/2) love squeezable fruit & veggie pouches.  This product is a great way to sneak in veggies for picky eaters and a great way to have variety and meet your daily values when out and about; I also find them to be a great snack. However, it is very difficult to find pouches with veggies at the local stores; mostly fruit pouches are sold, not many organic ones.  So I went to Amazon.  While I was happy to find Happy Tots by Happy baby (one of my favorite brands) the price was not that great.  I later found it for substantially less ($2 less) at a local organic market.  As to taste, while i've tried all other flavors and levels/stages, I will say that there is a particular taste to the Happy Tots because of the addition of a particular grain (Salba).  Give this product a try and see if your kids like it.
Great product. Tastes great, less acid, and helps me feel good knowing I'm making a smart choice for me. Nice to be able to buy it here. Great service. I'll be ordering more now. :)

I was kind of skeptical of this at first, mostly of the taste.  I have had instant coffee before.  This is very rich and yummy, tastes, just like coffee, not instant, but fresh brewed.  I love it, and knowing that it is benefitting my health is a huge bonus!
I first ordered this because of the low acid in the coffee then realized all the health benefits that the mushroom can give.  Don't be fooled though....all you will get is a great coffee taste!
I like the coffee either black or with cream.  And, I feel better after drinking it.
Thank you so much for making this available. It is absolutely delicious. I will not use store bought acid coffee again.

Ganocafe is a product derived from coffee, so it retains the flavor of coffee, but the Reishi mushroom is what I enjoy most about this product. Reishi mushroom is not an easy ingredient to find and has been touted as a wonderdrug for hundreds of ailments and preventative for even more, including many forms of cancer.I'm unable to consume caffeine, so I had to find alternatives. Many coffee alternatives taste too "earthy" or "forest-y" and not much like coffee at all.This is the best that I've found.The classic style is no cream, no sugar, just a plain old cup of coffee and while it's not exactly like coffee, it's the closest to the real flavor.For all the people out there who can't drink coffee, enjoy!

I started using this Instant Gano Coffee after my friend recommended its health benefits, as it is made from "reishi mushrooms".  It is very tasty, and I look forward to my cup every morning, adding a bit of Stevia for sweetness. Since it comes in individual packets, it is easy to put them in your purse, or to travel with.  Enjoy!  DLS
Lovely evening drink for coffee lovers.  Close your eyes and don't think about mushrooms.

column9: Gano Classsic Cafe 3 in 1 - The Best Quality Ganoderma Coffee
column10: There are three things I would like to share. One is the taste and quality. I have tried other brands and company, but, this one from gano excel beats it. The taste of good coffee without sacrificing the health benefits of ganoderma coffee is amazing.Second is its source of energy. I have that extra energy to get me through the day that I can't get from ordinary coffee.Third is its weight loss benefit. I have been drinking this coffee for the past 5 years and my metabolism is running in its optimum rate. I am in very comfortable weight that allows me to function effectively. the best of all is my over all Health. thanks you gano cafe.

Does ganoderma do all it's said to do?  Heck, I don't know.  I do know that when I drink it in the morning, I seem to think more clearly throughout the day.  At 60, this is a good thing.  I also doubt it's the placebo effect, or the green tea I drank for years would have done the same thing.  So I think it must have at least some of the health benefits it's touted to have.That said, even without the ganoderma, this is just plain good coffee and for far less than running through the local Starbucks (more convenient too).  So there's really not much to lose in trying it.This vendor is very fast and attentive.  Nice job!

My husband and I have been pleasantly surprised by how much we've come to love this product. We tried Ganocafe because a friend gave us a sample. At first it seemed a little pricey to use the individually packaged servings. But once I realized how often we were throwing out a half-drunk pot of coffee, or all the times I used to run by a drive-thru for a cup of coffee I didn't have time to brew, it makes more sense to use the individual packet with hot water from our dispenser. We buy the regular flavor, and it compares well with freshly brewed. My husband prefers Ganocafe to brewed coffee, because the Ganocafe doesn't bother his stomach the way regular coffee does. That might be explained by our distributor friend's assertion that the Ganocafe doesn't contain the acid of regular coffee (I've never researched that claim). I also notice that regular coffee can give me a little tickle in my throat, but I don't experience that with Ganocafe. I always keep a packet of Ganocafe in my purse, and when I'm really desperate for coffee and can't get to hot water, I've even been known to pour Ganocafe into a chilled water bottle, shake well, and drink it as a cold beverage. I've lost count of how many times we've reordered this product, which is now a staple in our cupboard.

I know a couple people who rep for Gano USA. I was recently given a small sampler pack that had two of each of their coffee's in it. I usually don't drink coffee on a regular basis as most brands make me feel like I dropped an acid bomb in my tummy (Starbucks is like an acid neutron bomb to the gut). Ganocafe Classic is pretty good stuff especially if you like your coffee black. Low acidity and a great taste and it doesn't give you the jitters like a lot of those energy drinks on the market. I know some of you that rely on western culture might think the red mushroom and it's healing properties is a gimmick but I believe it really works. My dad swears by this stuff and it even helped him take positive steps to get over the bottle and some of the long term effects that my pops was suffering from due to overuse of the bottle. Now I'm not saying this is the be all and end all cure to everything including cancer and aids but I will say that this stuff does work. I feel like I got more pep in my step and can't recall feeling that crashing feeling from it. I will be ordering a box or two of the classic for the office. As a matter fact all the flavors I have tried so far are pretty darn good (Ganocafe Mocha, 3-in-1 and the classic).

I discovered Ganoderma through a friend and found this particular brand via an Amazon search. I really like it. It's smoother than other brands I've tried. Great taste and gives me a pick me up when I need it. My only complaint is that the packets are impossible to tear. I have to use scissors to cut them in order to pour out the powdered coffee. Just a little slit in the edge would make a huge difference.

column9: I've become a coffee snob since trying this
column10: My reaction to my first sip was, wow, that is the smoothest coffee I've ever had.  That was a little over a year ago, and I haven't been able to drink a "regular" cup of coffee since then. My boyfriend and I have been called coffee snobs because we won't drink any other coffee!Because it's instant, you can adjust the strength to your taste. We have found that one packet makes two cups of coffee for us.  One packet to one cup of water was way too strong, so we doubled the water and now it's perfect for us.  It doesn't have any added sweeteners or creamers like some of the others, so you can add whatever you want or nothing at all.  I usually like a little agave and almond milk in mine, but this is actually the only coffee I've ever had that I can drink black and not gag.One nice thing is that it's in packets, so it travels well.  I keep one in my purse, take some to work, and we pack some when we travel.  I can always have "my" coffee wherever I go.  Added BONUS that it's non-acidic and very low caffeine.  I'm hooked!

Even though I'm not supposed to be drinking coffee due to my UC condition and low vitamin absorption problem I started getting hooked, especially since it was the only thing that took care of my migraines. My doctor recommended I try Gano Cafe instead. I was very skeptical at first and worried about the taste because despite my body getting used to caffeine I really liked the taste of coffee. The first time I tried Gano Cafe I couldn't believe how delicious it was! I dare to even say it tastes better than regular coffee! I have never been able to drink my coffee black so I do add some creamer and a little bit of brown cane sugar. It's so smooth and creamy. I like the fact that it has antioxidants, or so it says...I looked up this Reishi mushroom extract stuff and was amazed at all the health benefits. Some reviews report feeling better but the only difference I notice right after drinking this is experiencing a slight feeling of mellowness, which I'm not sure if it's a good thing because I've never been a morning person and feeling sleepy while working isn't ideal for me.The only thing I dislike about Gano Cafe is the smell when first mixing it in. Can't describe it but to me it definitely doesn't smell like regular coffee. At first I was disappointed that it came in individual packets like the instant coffees but after seeing how much coffee it makes and how amazing it tastes I was fine with that. Plus this way I can keep some in my purse. Overall I'm very glad I made the switch.

I have started every morning for the last 7 months with a cup of Ganocafe Classic coffee. In my opinion it must be providing some benefits, I haven't had even one cold or any flu in that time. At age 71 years my blood pressure is lower than my doctor's nurse. I actually generally just feel better all around than I have in years. A daily 1 mile walk and an hour exercising in the pool could have some bearing on my general health. I recommend trying Ganocafe Classic, you will probably see a difference.
I bought it for my mother and she is very happy we the results. She feels great!! They arrived on time as well

Tried a couple of samples I took home from an Expo. Loved the sustained energy it gave while I cleaned my house. No nervousness, headache or energy crash like I usually get from coffee. Really helped me with focusing.
This coffee has a great flavor and seems to perk you up.  I leave it to my wife to drink now as it makes me buzz.  Good stuff, definitely recommend.
This is the best coffee, hands down.  Very smooth and easy to drink. Don't need any sweetner or creamer added to make it taste better, great just the way it is.

I bought this coffee for it's healing properties, however it's great tasting coffee. This coffee is so smooth that even if you use to put sweetener in your coffee you can drink this one with it. I drink my coffee black and this is great tasting.
its ok,it tast like coffee to me,I don't see much differince except this cost a grip,I don't think i will get anymore anytime soon
Not sure if this is regulated by FDA.  Had several medical issues after taking this for two weeks.  May contact lawyer.

column10: The pepper blend was exceptionally good.  The lime flavoring was very light and got lost.  With a little tinkering and experimenting (infusing with lime juice, or just dousing the food with extra lime juice), we made it work. But as the man said, "close, but no cigar".

I've always loved tic tacs and fruit-flavored candies so when I spotted these "new" fruit adventure flavored tic tacs, I just had to try them. And they did not disappoint. column9: Treats too Big for Small Dogs.
column10: Actual treats are 3 times larger than the picture on the box.  My King Charles Spaniel cannot even chew them they are so big.  They are roughly the size of a double stuff oreo and hard as a rock.

column9: My dog likes all but the cheese.
column10: My dogs favorites are the beef and the pizza. preferably the beef. we were able to bribe her with some to teach her some new tricks. let your dogs try these. :)

What is the magic secret ingredient? Having trouble getting them locally- Petsmart no longer carries them so I have to buy them online. The quality of life at my house will be greatly diminished If they are siscontinued.

Firm/dense but not rock hard.  Enough to give a decent teeth cleaning but little dogs can still break them apart.  They crumble when chewed but not particularly messy like some dry snacks.  I was really disappointed to not find them locally anymore but at least we can get them online.

These premo treats are getting harder to find locally, and the dog loves them. Supplier got them to us fast with a great price. The product is good for large dogs and smaller dogs, but probably not under 20 lbs.; the treat size might be too generous for little guys.Big dogs love the great portion size. One large Scooby Snack will be very well received by the biggest dogs, saving you $$$.

She gets other toys (from Petsmart) which are very tough as well, but have smaller openings, like KONG Stuff-A-Ball. It takes her over 20 minutes to get them out.  These cookies are much harder than regular biscuits. It takes her 5 minutes to get the regular biscuits and snaps out of any toy.my rat terrier is a very powerful chewer...

In addition this is a very good product.

For those of you that have never had real shortbread or cheap shortbread then you MUST try Walkers! They make the BEST shortbread you'll ever eat! I bought a couple bulk packs since the price was so good, they make a great afternoon snack to tide you over for dinner. Catch these on a good deal and you wont be disappointed!

These Walker's Shortbread Fingers in single serving packs of two are fabulous!!  Here's why:1)  Yes, as everyone says, these Walker cookies are exceptional.  You may think it's all just buzz, but if you haven't tried them, don't judge us as silly until you do (!).2)  But what happens if you open a box -- you finish it, right!  BAD.  These little suckers aren't the greatest thing for you, to put it mildly.3)  Answer:  single serving packaging!!  It really works.  My husband is addicted to these cookies.  I'd always have a box on hand in case of unexpected guests -- at least, I'd think I had one, but the box would usually have disappeared unexpectedly whenever I went to look for it.  True confessions:  I love them too and was occasionally looking to sneak some for myself!  So having them around just in case was a bad, BAD idea.  But a case full of packs with 2 cookies each is ideal.  Two seems to satisfy my husband's craving -- he almost never takes more than one packet.  And I open a packet occasionally and make 2 cookies last 2 days, instead of a whole box lasting almost forever and my worrying that they'd go stale or attract ants.Bonus:  they're easily packable!  When my husband's expecting an exceptionally tough day at work, I'll usually sneak a pack into his lunch if he hasn't already appropriated one for himself.And when he's especially wiped out at the end of an unusually demanding day, a pack of these really seems to perk him up and help him muster strength for tomorrow.  He brings it upstairs while he's watching TV and waits a while before opening the bag and savoring his treasure.  Whether for lunch or after dinner, the gleam in his eye as he talks about how wonderful it is to have a treat when he's so stressed means a lot to me, especially when I know he's only eating in moderation instead of wolfing down ten or twenty servings at a time. column9: Good ingredients?  I don't think so....
column10: Let me start with a positive.... Amazon saved a lot in shipping with these syrups.  If you order directly from the manufacturers web site, you will probably pay twenty dollars or more in shipping which is outrageous!  Now the negatives...  I was born and raised in Hawaii and the delicious shave ice there is a common treat, much like ice cream in the continental US.  Sorry, but these syrups barely taste like the ones in Hawaii.  I sampled the cherry and it tasted very much like cherry cough syrup, yuck!  But that's not what really ticked me off.  Looking at the ingredients listed on the bottle, instead of cane sugar (which Hawaii used to produce and distribute in abundance), the second main ingredient listed after water is high fructose corn syrup.  Double yuck!  I'll stick with the Davinci syrups which use cane sugar and to me and my kids, taste a lot better.  This company needs to rethink it's ingredients, especially when they claim they use quality ingredients.

These shave ice syrups did not dissapoint!  I bought some less expensive syrups at another retailer, and they were dissapointingly thin and less flavorful.  In contrast, these syrups are viscous, tasty, and really cling to the ice as they should.  Any lover of shave ice or snowcones should pick up this 10 pack from Amazon.  I looked all over the web trying to find a better deal, and Amazon absolutely has the best price.  Even better, they were on my doorstep about 3 days after ordering.
This is the BEST BEST BEST snow cone stuff! I love it and will buy more from them when mine is all gone!
