Instead of having to use a piller to force a pill down their throat, they think they are getting a treat.  It works very well.  After having to use a piller on my cat for about a month, I woke up in the middle of the night after having a dream about a treat that could hold the pill in it.  I was ready to make at least a hundred thousand bucks.  Then I did a google search and it turns it already exists -- so I'm sending them my money instead.  Oh well...it's an excellent product.

I have a cat who has had to recieve a pill each day for years and after trying every technique with more or less success I found these pill pockets. They are so easy to use and my cat has never refused a pill and actually looks forward to it as a treat.I recommend it for anyone who has a cat that needs meds, daily or not.I've also found that the pocket treats stay fresh for a long time but I like to not only close the bag but keep it in a plastic container to keep them from ever drying out.

Designed to insert a pet's pill in the pocket. Squeeze or pinch the top of the pocket over and the pill is concealed from a pet in a treat. In fact, the treat is so soft and supple, you don't even have to put the pill in the pocket. You can just push the treat onto the pill and squeeze the rest of the treat material around the pill to hide it. Works well when hiding multiple pills that might not fit in the pocket. I buy the cat size for my small dog (4.5 lb), and she just loves them. Never has refused a pill hidden in one. I even use them empty as a treat!

column9: This is an Awesome Vegan Jel!
column10: My children hve tried all the flavors that Natural Desserts offers for their Jel Dessert. It sets quick and is great tasting! I love knowing that they are not getting a dessert loaded with gelatin and food dyes! I have yet to try adding fruit in the mix.

column9: Lyle's Golden Syrup can substitute for corn syrup
column10: I am allergic to corn, so eating marshmallows, candy, pecan pie etc. without being able to have corn syrup is a real problem.The Lyle's Golden Syrup, which is made from cane sugar syrup, can be used as a substitute for corn syrup.  It doesn't taste quite the same, though very good.  So I think, if one calls the pecan pie made from Lyle's Golden Syrup sugar pecan pie, for instance, it will be very satisfying as its own thing instead of a substitute for pecan pie.To me, it seems a little sweeter than corn syrup.

Dried fruit can be a great snack and was looking forward to the mixed fruit.  I'm sure this is not just an issue for Mariana but after opening 3 different bags, I couldn't get past the horrible smell and somehow when all the dried fruit is in one bag each fruit item almost taste the same.  Anyway, I'm sure if you don't mind the smell, these are not only good for you but a good source of sustenance, especially handy for traveling.

The piece of dried peach was overly dry, chewy, and unappetizing. Not wanting to waste a piece of fruit, I put it in an empty birdbath outside for the squirrels or birds. Serendipitously it rained that night, and the next morning I discovered a rehydrated peach with a totally different appearance and appeal. I've since learned that dehydrated fruit can be rehydrated by soaking it in hot water for a few minutes. It can even be hydrated with fruit juice for even more flavor.The Mariani mixed fruit is convenient for those who like having fruit on hand, but want to avoid the waste of fresh fruit going over-ripe before one gets around to eating it. It's a nice mix of fruit that all ends up having similar taste since the eclectic mix has been together in the close quarters of a bag for so long. My favorites in the mix are the dried apples and dried pears. Dried plums predominate in this Mariani product, but they are pretty good too.For best taste, put the opened bag in your refrigerator. Refrigeration ensures freshness and cuts down on the icky, sticky factor of the dried fruits.

I didn't purchase this fruit from Amazon, I got it from my own grocery store.The bag I bought was very heavy on the plums but they were good. I didn't like the apricots at all, they were huge and had some sort of grit on them that crunched my teeth when I bit in.A positive though is that everything was nice and soft - even though it's called dried fruit for a reason that doesn't mean I want petrified. Also all the pieces of fruit were larger than what I usually get, at least two bites per piece.

really good stuff here, bag is a good size to snack with or as a way to get good fruit.half a bag is 330 cal. 75 total carbs, and all natural sweetness. no added sugar...dried but soft and full of flavor. pears are awesome! my fav. is the plum, the apricots are tangy, apples are sweet and good natural color,the fuzz on the peaches are kinda rough but my dog likes them :) but overall an awesome product!!

I WAS VERY UPSET WHEN I WASN'T ABLE TO LOCATE THE DRIED MIXED FRIUT HERE IN AUSTIN BUT...HOORAY I DID FIND IT ON AMAZON AND I MAKE A WONDERFUL FRUIT COMPOTE WITH IT.  IT IS GOOD HOT OR COLD AND IT IS SO GOOD HEALTH WISE FOR ME.  THANKS AMAZON !
Best dried fruit I have ever eaten.  Gourmet quality dried fruit like this usually costs much more, so its a bargain as well.
The Mariani Mixed Fruit was not my favorite. We could challenge each other's palate here, but there was a faux-taste that could not be described with words. Something was missing (not sugar)???

I bought these trying to get away from having chips sent by my ex-wife. The price quoted $10.23 for shipping but when I got the email confirmation I was charged $26.49 to have it sent to an APO for a grand total of $47.00 for 4 bags of chips. 12.00 per bag of chips?????? Rediculous. I haven't even got them yet and unless every chip is unbroken this was a total waste of money. I'll go back to bugging the ex and get a suprise gift of candy for alot less. I know this is to rate an item but until they come up with rate a seller this will have to do.

column9: The best store bought tortilla chips!
column10: I love salsa and chips.  Throughout the years I've tried many brands of chips.  Rarely, however, I have returned to one particular brand.  That was until I happened upon the On the Border chips at my local Kroger.  Wow.  Go find some of these chips now.  They taste freshly made (especially when warmed) and are sure to make your favorite salsa taste extra special.I like to get salsa to go from a local Mexican restaurant.  I had struggled to find a chip that was "worthy" of the restaurant's salsa.  As noted previously, I've sampled many varieties of chips.  Many were good but none great.  These chips are just as good as the made-from-scratch ones that my favorite Mexican restaurant gives to customers. I love placing some of these chips in the oven for a couple of minutes; they taste even more authentic when warmed.  Best of all, they are the perfect complement to the salsa made by my local restaurant.The chips are labeled as low in sodium and have about 80 mg of salt per serving.  Despite the lower sodium content, I did not find myself pouring salt on them.  I found them to have a very nice salty component.The only issue I have had with these chips is the excessive number of crushed chips about 2/3 - 3/4 through the bag.  Many bags of chips have those small pieces that are nearly worthless for dipping.  The five to six bags I have purchased over the last couple of months from different Kroger stores have had this issue.  It is like someone smashed the bag 2/3 of the way down into tiny bits but left the chips in the upper portion of the bag alone.I purchase these chips from my local Kroger for about 3 dollars a bag.

column9: It was not what I expected
column10: I guess I'm in the minority with my low rating, but I was hoping for REAL mulling spices (leaves, flowers, bark, etc.) to boil in my cider (or wine). I wasn't expecting a dissolvable powder. This is more like a powdered drink mix.Heads up for the purists out there!

Wish I had noticed Linda Moore's warning. Advertised as "mulling spices," but it's really a drink mix--sugar granules with flavoring powder. Not a clove, cinnamon stick, or dried orange peel to be found. Labeling provided to Amazon description is misleading, and so is the labeling on the package. Buyer beware!

My wife is the big fan of mulling spice and eggnog spice, I just knew to find it in William Sonoma but it just serve only during chrismas time, and she was so dissapointed when trying to find it now she can't find it in WS, so I find in Amazon to surprise her, out of my expectation she was way too happy and make it very nice drink and food with those spices....she is the best cooks for me.
A very good product.  We got the first at Cracker Barrel and got hooked on it.  They quit stocking it then, so we were able to find it on Amazon.com.  Thanks very much.

Put this in some tea with some lemon juice, and it's better than Calgon calling! It tastes just fabulous! It is so good, when I ordered it for the first time, I ordered about 36 cartons of it for fear Amazon would run out! It is equally good in warmed up apple juice.

The BEST cider spice you can get. Tastes great when added to apple juice, but better when added to apple cider. Wonderful in the winter months!! My Sunday school class really loves it when I bring it to church. They skip the coffee, and go for the spiced cider!!
Get this going in a crock pot with apple juice. The scent will fill your home and get you in the Christmas spirit! This is absolutely the BEST mulling spices I've found.

I take a can of this with when I eat out because I can't consume high fructose corn syrup.  This soda is made with real sugar, and is about the same calories as other sodas.  The flavor is pleasant and mild.  I have the root beer in this brand also, but this wild raspberry is my favorite.
Very tasty...Our family loves this soda.  I especially like that it's all natural! No HFCS.  It's very light and fruity and not too sweet.  It has a very pleasant light pink color.

Had never heard of this brand before and was looking for something new to try.  So very glad I gave this brand and the raspberry flavor a try.  This is the definitely one of the best tasting sodas I have ever tried before.  It was fresh, flavorful, crisp, not too sweet and very refreshing.  I am most definitely a satisfied and returning customer!

We love the Stella D'Oro Anisette Toast cookies.  For some reason, they are no longer stocked in our local stores.  So, we have resorted to ordering them on line.  This last shipment, in boxes,  expiring Dec. 2009,  are stale and hard.  Every box. One of the boxes had a hole in the plastic inner wrap.  I really miss our Anisette toast.  How can we get them fresher.Very disappointed,  Jacqueline W.

column9: Cookies are horrible since they moved from the Bronx
column10: I used to buy Stella D'Oro  Anisette and Almond Toast to eat for breakfast all the time,  but have found them to be stale and hard as rocks since corporate greed shut down the ages old Bronx factory.  Quality and care are gone from the Stella D'Oro brand and I will no longer be buying their products.  If you think I'm kidding, try squeezing one of the cookies through the cellophane/plastic bag and you will feel a rock hard, rather than spongy texture, regardless of the date stamped.

column9: Stella Doro - a wonderful food destroyed by greed
column10: The Stella Doro company was sold and they are now baking in the south.  I believe North Carolina.  Although the recipes may be the same, the machines used are not the same and they use high-speed cake mixers which destroy the texture of the dough. I called the company after purchasing Anisette Biscuits which were awful and had a sandy texture rather than spongy.  The company apologized and sent me coupons saying they were trying to get the process correct.  I again purchased the biscuits and, just like my first purchase, I threw them away.  Sad to lose such a wonderful product over cheap labor, bad baking and bad business practices.

As others have said, they no longer are spongy, but have been stale and hard for a few months now. But now, to add insult to injury, they have decreased the size of the cookies, making them even easier to become "hard" or stale. Well... nothing lasts forever, I guess even a proven cookie that has sold well. I'm done with Stella Doro Anisette Toast. I'd rather have fond memories than rock hard dunkers.

I reviewed this already, but apparently I need to do it again! I ordered them by accident, I clicked on Breakfast treats (you must try them, they are awesome) but somehow I ended up ordering theese instead. I am glad this happened, because they are AWESOME! Not just with coffee, but alone! I curl up in bed at night and could eat the whole pack by myself! I would definitely order them again, but would have to keep it a secret from my husband LOL! I think I'll have some right now....see ya!

My wife likes Stella D'oro Anisette Toast biscotti's, but has had difficulty in locating them in local grocery stores as we travel through the summer.  So we found them online and took a chance.  They arrived in good condition and were dated as fresh ( dated to expire)for four months.  If you like these, it can be a good way to obtain them.

This brand may be a little more expensive but I feel it is well worth it. For one thing we did a blind taste test with several major brands just out of curiosity one day and all picked this one as the best tasting. Most major brands taste like flavored water in my opinion. This actually tastes like beef. I noticed that Amazon does not list the ingredients so i went to Imagine's web site to see for myself. I copied and pasted them here. Thought this might be helpful. I care a lot about ingredients which is the second reason I purchase this brand. P.S. The chicken broth is also very good.Ingredientsorganic beef broth (filtered water, organic beef), organic onions, organic celery, sea salt, organic beef flavor, organic beef extract, organic carrots, organic garlic, organic spice.

column9: Tea from seller TeaCakeCoffee is NOT advertised product
column10: In case you didn't know, this tea has been discontinued and the only boxes available for purchase are old stock, many of which are from who-knows-where and are who-knows-how-old, as I found out the hard way:I ordered this product from a seller named TeaCakeCoffee, whose profile says they ship out of Texas.  Unfortunately for me, it turned out that they ship from China.  The tea's box design looked different from that shown in this photo and from what I used to buy all the time from the grocery store, but I figured maybe I was sent the European version.  Despite the tea's Taiwanese postmark, I somehow got up the nerve to try one cup of it.  I don't know what the heck is in this "tea", but it sure ain't Twinings.  It didn't smell or taste whatsoever of vanilla, and the tea tasted completely, absolutely weird.  I threw the box out and thanked my lucky stars I didn't end up with a stomachache.Purchasing this discontinued tea is not recommended, unless you manage to find a stray box on your local grocery store's shelf.  As for buying from TeaCakeCoffee, that's the last time I'll make that mistake.

Twinings tea is almost always better than what can be found elsewhere, and this vanilla tea is no exception. Smooth, rich, and with the perfect touch of vanilla, its full-bodied flavour is elegant and creates a wonderful aroma.

As a child I loved to go to my grandmothers house and see what was on her table.  Being from England, she always had something interesting. But, her favorite and mine was her "mint jelly". She always made her own, and we ate it on toasted English Muffins. The muffins would always be crunchy and the mint jelly always seemed to wake you up, perk you up, for whatever she had planed to do that day. I've searched for "mint jelly" for some time before I realized that is was pretty rare in today's stores.  But, when I came across the "Maple Grove Jelly," made with real mint. Well, I must admit, I bought a whole carton.  My husband thought I was nuts, but, now he's tried it, and every other day, I have to put a new jar out.
The information on line did not include the fact that the product contains sorbital which can cause diarrhea and could have had a dangerous affect on my dog who has a sensitive stomach

column9: This blend is not the same as the Special Dark of a few years ago.
column10: Although this cocoa is called Special Dark, it isn't the same Special Dark cocoa of a few years ago.  The previous Special Dark was 100% Dutched Cocoa, while the current Special Dark is a blend of Dutched and Natural Cocoas, so it isn't as dark or as strong as the previous one.  It is very good and has a pleasant fruity taste as compared to the more bitter and richer cocoa taste of its predecessor.  Initially I preferred the previous Special Dark, but am getting used to the new blend. The price is very good.

I make some pretty killer brownies, that always draw requests for the recipe whenever I make them.  A little while back I tried making them with Hershey's Special Dark cocoa and it really pushed my brownies to a decadent level.  Ever since I finished my last container, I've been scouring the local groceries in search of some more, and had just about giving up on ever finding it again. What a surprise to find it on Amazon--I'm thrilled!

I was between the Girardelli (I don't know if that's how you spell it) and this Hershey's Cocoa Special Dark.  I had tried Girardelli's powdered cocoa before and remember the first time I tried it as hot chocolate I thought to myself it's ok but nothing amazing so this time I bought the Hersheys.  The first thing I noticed is the almost black-gray color when you mix it into the hot milk with barely a trace of brown.  That didn't seem too appetizing but I prefer it to having artificial colors added.  From the first sip the taste was amazing!  One of those situations where you just can't put the cup down and keep taking small sips even though this liquid was steaming hot.  I made it with powdered milk (0 fat) raw sugar, and a quarter teaspoon of salt.  The dark chocolate taste is amazingly full and satisfying.  When I started to drink this I thought I might get a stomach-ache since it looked so dark but not at all (Used a very heaping teaspoon)

I've been drinking this for several years and just looked on Amazon because lately it's not available in any of my supermarkets.  It's value is that it is half natural cocoa which is extremely high in antioxidents and half dutch processed which dissolves and blends well.  I can just stir in a teaspoon full into plain hot water for a healthy, delicious bitter cocoa drink. Way better than coffee.The only things that could make it any better is being organic and from fair trade sources.

This stuff is really hard to find in the stores when it's not the holiday season. I was thrilled to find it here at Amazon for a decent price.I've been making raw vegan chocolate avocado pudding, and the color just isn't as appetizing when you use regular cocoa; you need the special dark to avoid it turning out greenish-brown.In case you're wondering, here's the recipe:5 Tablespoons Hershey's Special Dark Cocoa5 Tablespoons honey or agave (agave gives a milder taste)3/4 C full-fat coconut milk or cream (canned is fine)1 tsp vanilla2 ripe avocadosThrow it all in a blender and blend, blend, blend until it's totally smooth. Spoon into small dishes (this stuff is rich!) and chill. That's it! You won't believe how awesome this tastes; you don't taste the avocado at all.

column9: Warning for brownie addicts - this bakes up fantastic!
column10: I use this Hershey's Cocoa Special Dark in King Arthur Flour's brownie recipe and I'm telling you, it makes the most luscious, decadent brownies.  Follow the recipe to the "T"...it calls for heating the sugar/butter mixture twice, resulting in that gorgeous shiny topped brownie you see in bakeries, and a teaspoon of espresso powder.  (I get mine right here on Amazon: Ferrara Instant Espresso powder).  I also use a good quality vanilla.Anyway, my husband's co-workers, my college son & his roommates, my two teenage daughters and all their marching band pals, love love love my brownies.  I know this Special Dark blend of Hershey's Cocoa helps make them extra special!!

column9: I live off this stuff!~  A healthy alternative chocolate flavoring.
column10: I've discovered that this cocoa is a wonderful healthy flavoring for protein shakes and yogurt.  This dark chocolate variety even has antioxidants.  I get my chocolate fix for only 10 calories per tablespoon!  Mix it in yogurt and freeze for an extremely low-fat, low-sugar healthy yogurt.  Also, I often mix some of this and protein powder in yogurt for a post-workout recovery food.  I stopped being able to find it at my grocery store; I'm pleased to see I can order it from Amazon in bulk for even cheaper.

column9: Can't beat it for the price!
column10: This is a VERY hard to find product. We searched all of our local stores with no luck.After not being able to locate it we though we'd try regular Hershey's Cocoa but it was a flop. The flavor just wasn't there like it was with the dark.I was very pleased to find the product on Amazon. The price is amazing and the shipping was very quick. They packaged the containers very well, too.

I love baking cocoa because I can't take sugar but love chocolate. This product is delicious and a six can flat will last me for quite some time. There is a lot of fiber and nutrients (which may or may not be absorbable, but hell, it's chocolate!) in this product and it's great for dieters (in moderation, of course).
Hershey's Special Dark Cocoa is wonderful!  Amazon brought it right to our doorstep as the grocery stores in So. Calif. don't seem to carry it.It is rich and dark.....yum!
This cocoa has a dark color, but is basically tasteless. It is not even remotely like the no longer available Hershey's European Dutch-Processed Cocoa with the silver label.

column9: Not All Hersheys Cocoas Are Created Equal
column10: I ordered this product for cocoa-antioxidants that do body good. To my surprize when I received the order, the product's cans indicated that this cocoa's antioxidants were fewer than its cousin product-Hershey's Cocoa, Natural, Unsweetened. Had this fact been described in the promotion ad, I would not have ordered Hershey's Cocoa, Special Dark.

I ordered this bulk package because I needed A LOT of cocoa powder to make hot cocoa mix gift sets for Christmas.  The cocoa was fresh and worked exceptionally well for cocoa mix.  I did not bake with it, so I have no idea how this cocoa will perform in baked goods.  The description doesn't say dutch process cocoa (that I noticed), but it is.  The price when I ordered came to 2.72/unit, which was a bargain compared to store prices.  I tend to choose Hershey over other brands when I have the choice so I don't have a lot to compare to, but this does live up to the quality chocolate taste I expect from Hershey.  I would definitely recommend this product.

Amazing! extra chocolately flavor...if you really love chocolate, this is the stuff.can mix with any sweetener you desire...its a shame it was only in stores a short time...I bought up everyting I could find .Thrilled to ind it on line!!
This chocolate is deep, rich and delightful. If you are into dark chocolate, then this is the product for you.
Hershey's Special Dark Cocoa is the favorite baking cocoa in our house!  Check out the Hershey's website for recipe ideas.  Our favorite is the Hershey's Epsecially Dark chocolate cake.

column9: Great chocolate taste and the dark chocolate is healthy too
column10: We love this Hershey dark chocolate.  Besides making a great cup of hot chocolate to enjoy, we add it to our protein shakes for a rich chocolate flavor.

Love this stuff--rich, rich chocolate flavor.  I add it to my protein shakes, make ganache icing from it--if it needs chocolate, this product is what I use.Hershey's Cocoa, Special Dark, 8-Ounce Cans (Pack of 6)

tasty cross between Dutch process and natural; heaping Tablespoon in chocolate cake mixes, brownies, cookies, frostings, pudding, custards; perfect for white/yellow cake mix if you are out of chocolate varieties, great addition for powdered mocha mix http://www.amazon.com/Caf%C3%A9-DVita-Mocha-Cappuccino-Cold/dp/B0018VDKHU/ref=sr_1_1?ie=UTF8&qid=1349919269&sr=8-1&keywords=mocha+mix - good anti-oxidant, too!
I use this too add to my protein drinks.  It arrived in a timely fashion, in good packaging.. I would buy again.

I'd never used this before, or heard of it, so compared to regular Hershey's cocoa (which I managed to run out of) this had a noticeably stronger and better chocolate flavor to it when I made a "Hershey's Collector's Cocoa Cake" recipe from a Hershey's cocoa package around 1988. I've made that recipe dozens of times. This time I tried some and was surprised at how good it tasted, and I'd been buying Penzey's cocoa for several years. I liked this product just fine, no complaints at all!---We made the chocolate mousse recipe printed on the back of the container and it turned out GREAT. It's basically cream and gelatin with cocoa and sugar. Totally easy and more importantly COOL to prepare in the summer months. Serve it in wine glasses and it looks really fancy. The cocoa, again, carried the day. Deep, intense chocolate flavor. Pleased but puzzled to find a top-quality chocolate product from Hershey's, for some reason. Exceeds my expectations by a noticeable measure.
Makes great hot cocoa & brownies!!! Lots of wonderful chocolate taste & all the health benefits of dark cocoa without the calories of the cocoa butter fat.

I love Hershey's Special Dark for all of my baking and other "treat" needs.  Great flavor and results in a very dark finished product that looks great with white or colored frosting, fruit, etc.  I am so glad I can buy it here because I haven't been able to find it in a grocery store for several years.

If you love chocolate and want to eat more dark chocolate as nutritionists recommend, but are limiting calories, this special dark chocolate is delicious.  For about 10 calories a tablespoon, you can make tasty cocoa or I like to put it in iced coffee for a mocha iced coffee with a bit of sweetener.  A nutritionist recommended stevia as a natural sweetener which is calorie free and sweeter than sugar.  Just heat up some milk, add the cocoa and stevia and for about 110 calories, you have a great drink.
This is a great product. I wanted a cocoa powder that was not too sweet for hot chocolate. The dark cocoa was perfect, both price and quality!

column9: Dark, but not bitter!! Oh.... taste very nice
column10: I used to use the regular Hershey's Cocoa. After reading reviews here, I decided to make a chiffon cake with this Special Dark Cocoa. The color of the cake is much darker, and the cake is more moist and tastes rich chocolate flavor, but not bitter at all!! My 3 kids loves this chocolate powder!!

I thought I'd up the chocolate factor in my chocolate cake and bought a bunch of Ghirardelli cocoa off this site.  It was terrible.  I came back and this popped up and being a fan of dark chocolate, i thought I'd give it a try.  HEAVEN!  I will be ordering more of this very soon!  YUM
I ordered this cocoa from amazon.com because its the only cocoa my husband likes.I couldn't find it in any of the stores where I live.  Amazon is a great place to shop.
Simply mix with hot water and sugar... a nonfat, delicious chocolaty drink.Add some coffee-- mocha.My favorite drink!
Not sweet at all.  a little bit bitter but it does the job done when I mix with Protein shake.  works well.

Made a batch of chocolate ice cream and it was Great.  Rich, deep chocolate flavor.  If it works this well in ice cream it will be wonderful in normal baked goods.  No more melting other chocolate for me.

column9: HERSHEY'S Dark Cocoa is the BEST and it's good for you!
column10: Our local supermarkets do not carry the Hershey's Dark, so I priced out the Hershey's Dark on the internet. Amazon has the best price for a pack of 6 cans. This will last a while.  We love the dark cocoa--it gives your cocoa or whatever baking items an extra bit of flavor. Plus the dark chocolate is good for you, right?  This purchase averaged out to about $3.75 per can, which is a great deal, considering our supermarket charges over $5.00 per can for the regular cocoa. Can't go wrong here!

If you're a real chocoholic, you need to have this cocoa on hand.  You can buy it anywhere but I found that Amazon had the best price.  I shared a few with family and friends and kept a couple for me.  This is NOT the same as their Dutch process.  I wish they'd bring that back!!  This is dark baking cocoa.  But with the right recipes, you can do a lot with it.

I love this cocoa for baking. I have several recipes that I converted to Special Dark Chocolate. I also love to make hot chocolate with this cocoa and add just a hint of peppermint extract. The flavor is clean, refreshing and just great!
This product has been hard to find.  I finally found it at a bargain price.  It's the best chocolate for cakes, ever!  Thank you!

I haven't been able to find the Special Dark in the stores.  I like it better than the regular Hershey's Cocoa because it has more iron in it, so when I saw it at Amazon, I purchased it right away.  I put it in my coffee with a little sugar (or a candy cane at Christmas time) and it makes a delicious Mocha.As usual, I received it in the time stated.  Thanks, Amazon!

column4: Jacki Gunter "good movie or book lover"
column10: This Dark Chocolate is the best for baking of any of the chocolates.Also makes a good cup of cocoa occasionally.

I am the unofficial baker for my chocolate loving office and our new favorite cake (or cupcakes) is the Hershey's Special Dark Cake with Dark Chocolate Icing.  I ran out of the Special Dark Cocoa and was going crazy trying to find it in any of my grocery stores when I thought, "why not check Amazon?"  I am glad I did - I will never run out of this delicious, much used ingredient again.  If anyone is interested, the recipe can be found online at the Hershey's website.  It is possibly the best chocolate cake ever!
I use the Hershey's Special Dark Cocoa in my morning shake. It is rich and delicious. More chocolaty than the plain cocoa.

Very satisfied with this transaction and this seller. This is my second time ordering. I'm unable to find this product in my area after the one available source closed. Grateful to know I can still find it online.Thanks!

If you know what real Dutch processed cocoa is, you probably won't like this.  This may use a traditional method somewhere in its production, but it is nothing like the reddish-brown loveliness you get with the 'real' alkaline-process cocoas.DO NOT get this thinking it's the genuine article.  If you want strong flavor, this will certainly do, but if you care about true chocolate flavor, avoid this like the plague.Hershey's used to make an authentic Dutch processed cocoa I can't find any more - it had a silver label.  If they still sell it, get that instead - it's very good and as reasonably priced as their other cocoa products.As far as flavor goes, I put this well below their normal powdered cocoa.

column9: Hershey's Cocoa, Special Dark, 8-Ounce Cans (Pack of 6)
column10: Great products, price is very reasonable. Quick ship. Product arrived in great shape. Would do business again.
My wife made a recipe where we used dark chocolate with Scallops and Leeks.  WOW! It was so delicious!

This product, while possibly satisfactory for some, was not as represented.  I had searched for 100% Dutch process cocoa, and that was what I thought I was gettuing.  Wrong!  This  product is a blend of natural and Dutch process cocoas.  The description is misleading.  I have written a letter to Customer Service about this, but my hopes for a good result are not high.  Apparently because this a food item, even though none of the cans was opened, it is not a returnable item.  I'm not a happy camper!
maybe its because I'm from seattle and we like real coffee..not brown water..I won'tbe getting the decaf again.

I'm on long-term antibiotics and found that regular coffee triggered reflux and other GI problems - so I've switched to decaf - found the Gevalia decaf T-discs at Bed, Bath and Beyond but they are rather pricey and I don't like to go shopping - so using Subscribe and Save, these are a lot cheaper and are delivered to my door -I make a cup of this every morning and have half with my oatmeal and then mid-morning, have a snack and finish my cup - just right!

column9: The best decaf that I found.

column9: The manna is quite good, but what a royal pain to use - if you live in cold weather areas, order this in summer
column10: Does it taste good? Yes. If you like the taste and texture of coconut butter, you will most certainly like this product.Does it spread nicely? Well, that depends on where you live and how patient you are. In cold weather this is a royal pain to use because the oil separates and hardens at temperatures below 76 F. The instructions on the label say to place the container in hot water for 5 to 10 minutes to soften the manna. Well, in my kitchen (room temperature about 70 F) it took almost a half hour for this thing to melt.I placed the jar inside a stainless steel saucepan filled with hot water that must have been at least 180 F. After 5 minutes the water had cooled quite a bit and yet the oil had not even started to melt. I used a blunt knife to try and break the manna into pieces. Did the same thing two more times. Finally, the fourth water change did the trick and the manna now had acquired a nice consistency, perfect for spreading, but at that point I was not a very happy camper.I wanted to use this as a breakfast spread and that's not going to happen, at least not during the week. I just don't have the time nor the patience. It just takes too long.I buy natural organic peanut butter, which also must be mixed well for the oil to combine, but I only have to do that once so I don't mind at all. With this manna it's an everyday event.I ordered two jars, one of them will live in my pantry until next summer, and we'll treat coconut manna as a warm weather food, I guess.This is a very nice tasting coconut product, which I would have rated 5 stars otherwise. Certainly worth a try, if you happen to keep your house above 75 F year round.

So it's not raw, which is likely why that one is more expensive, but it tastes just as good and makes my wallet happy.To the reviewers who were disappointed - it's definitely NOT like coconut oil, you MUST stir it up, it's a very versatile product to use as a replacement. So, the minute I found out that there was something called coconut manna, I couldn't sleep thinking about it!  There is so LITTLE information about it online, as to what "manna" truly was that I just had to try it for myself. Well, first what is it?  It's basically mashed up/ground coconut "meat". It has the consistancy of peanut butter that has been slightly melted.  It is also a little gritty too.I was under the impression that it was sweet but it's not.  It is as sweet as unsweetened coconut mash would be.  I was misled by other reviewers that said that it was soooo delicious and they eat it straight from the jar.  I wouldn't do that.  It's just plain boring.  BUT...I think it's the kind of product that would work well in a recipe that called for coconut flavor or texture like cookies, cakes, smoothies, and frostings.  But just to repeat, IT IS NOT SWEET LIKE PEANUT BUTTER!I rate it a 5 out of 10. If you have a sweet tooth like me, this is not the product for you.  If you just need an authentic coconut spread, you've got it.  PLEASE NOTE:  It may be too hard to eat at first.  In that case, warm the jar in boiled water for 15 minutes, stir with a butter knife, and let the "ok" times roll!

column9: Great Product, Super in Glass, Must Be Mixed
column10: ****This Nutiva Organic Coconut Manna is actually a type of coconut cream or coconut butter NOT coconut oil. The difference is that the cream or butter is much thicker, has whole coconut in it, and a very strong coconut flavor. You would not use the coconut manna for cooking. It is used more as a spread (which you wouldn't usually do with coconut oil) or can even be eaten by itself or made into a candy (because it is slightly sweet). It can be added to smoothies or used in many other creative ways. Think of it like whole coconut meat in a creamy form.The reason I did not give this coconut manna five stars is because it is hard to actually use. In order to mix the ingredients, which do separate at most normal room temperature, the container must be heated gradually to a very warm room temperature (say 80 degrees, I'd think, or even higher) or else put in hot water for 30 minutes, stirred, and left in hot water for 30 more minutes. Nutiva just began offering this Coconut Manna in this glass jar instead of the previous plastic tub, which is a huge improvement. Still, it is so hard to get it to a consistency in which it can be mixed! I tried heating it in the microwave on the lowest setting (do not do this!) but no matter what I did it would suddenly burn. It's best to start an hour or more ahead of time and just do the hot water prep.Other than that, it's a great product. It is very slightly sweet and tastes strongly like coconut. The consistency is a bit gritty or grainy due to part of the coconut flesh that is powder and has been reconstituted, but I found that fine, not off-putting at all. It's great all by itself, added to smoothies, or put into the freezer in molds for a whole foods raw candy.Recommended.****

column9: Not the treat of yesteryear, that's for sure.
column10: Thinking I'd be wickedly clever and get a fun treat -- one that's vegan and also contains fiber, hee hee -- into my kids and the rest of the unsuspecting Trick-or-Treaters this year, I ordered a bunch of these bulk boxes of Cracker Jack bags for distribution last Halloween.What a disappointment, in two ways.1. My suspicion is that, unlike the 1970s and 80s when I was a kid and enjoyed these, modern food science has now created a popcorn scanner that sees inside each popped kernel to find out whether it has popped fully or incompletely-- incompletely meaning a hard stone part lurks inside.  If the latter is ascertained, it gets routed onto the Cracker Jack bag-filling line.  I'd say a good half or more of the popped corns in the bags we received contained an unchewable hard part.2. I strongly suspect attorneys seeking to limit settlements by Cracker Jack, Inc. to parents whose children found a way to harm themselves with yesterday's prizes like plastic spinners and "moving" pictures have mandated that all Cracker Jack prize designers limit their creations to "paper only" models.  They were undoubtedly encouraged to do so by some MBA whiz (most likely a Harvard Business School graduate) who also realized how cheap and lightweight paper is to manufacture, thereby saving on both production and shipping costs, in addition to settlement fees.The unfortunate result is that, unlike the actually fun prizes I remember (a few of which, I am embarrassed to say, I still have packed away somewhere), today's children can look forward to Cracker Jack prizes like paper pencil toppers (two slits and put on the end of that pencil -- wow!) and -- I kid you not -- "arrange the face of Abe Lincoln" or "turn the young face into the elderly Susan B. Anthony" activities.Don't get me wrong; I love the Abolitionists and Suffragettes, and Susan B. Anthony, having the honor of being among both camps, is my favorite among them. I will also add that my self-righteous pride expanded as I realized I was distributing to neighborhood children lessons about American historical figures along with a vegan, fiber-containing snack, all masquerading as a Halloween treat.But the Cracker Jacks that children love are gone.  Mine, who are in 1st and 4th grade, won't even eat the leftover bags, and so I started eating them myself-- except I couldn't force myself to chew through all those hard kernels. And when I tossed my kids the prizes, they said, "no, thanks."I write this not to deride a classic treat but to beseech the powers-that-be at Cracker Jack to restore their product to the quality of its glory days, when hard kernels weren't plentiful and the prizes were worth finishing your bag or box for.  Arise, Crack Jack, to this challenge, and reclaim your rightful place in American childhood!

Tamaki short grain rice is available in different varieties.  This particular variety is brown.  ANY rice not white is brown,even black and red. The distinction is not truly one of color, it references bran.  White rice is white because the bran (the best,most healthful part of the rice grain) is removed completely.  What makes the Tamaki Haiga type of rice so desirable is that thegrain itself is just as light as a white rice would be AND it still has the bran germ intact.  This difference makes for an incredibledifference in taste.  Where white rice (with perhaps the exception of Basmati) is largely bland and flavorless and requires spices, herbsand or fats to make it worth your while, Tamaki Haiga has the bran AND the flavor.  Oh and although it is a short grain variety, (which beingthicker also takes longer to cook than white) it does cook in much shorter time than the average brown rice.If you are eating this rice and not noticing a real difference in flavor (it should have a noticeable nutty flavor)then perhaps you are not preparingit properly.  Contrary to the average white rice it does require soaking.  I have found that after proper rinsing soaking my haiga for 30 minutesor so before turning my rice cooker on leads to a perfectly moist and flavorful dish.Remember also, this is a sushi type rice and is meant to be moist and sticky as opposed to the firm and easily separated texture of the average white rice.This truly is a superior rice product and JVS has proven to be a reliable distributor.  They deliver fresh product, well packaged and on time.  I agree thatthe price for this rice is a bit high but this vendor makes it available at a much cheaper price than some others. And don't forget that the shipping that they arecharging is seriously discounted.  All in all a very good deal for rice that is actually good for you AND really good tasting as well.  I am Costa Rican andI eat rice every day.  This is not the rice I grew up but it is an integral part of get healthy diet now.

column10: I've been using Dreamfields pasta for about a year and a half now. It's become a kitchen staple for us. I bought it to help keep my sugar under control while still enjoying pasta dishes. My husband, a very finicky eater, didn't even notice it was high-fiber (well, until he got a bit gassy later). Tastewise, this is just as good as regular, quality pasta. (And not gritty like whole wheat ones can be.)A very nice product, and a boon to those watching their sugar numbers. I'll add that I don't get the super-sleepiness after eating this pasta that I used to eating regular pasta (you know, that post-carb napping syndrome).I've used the penne, the linguine, the elbow (for mac'n'cheese) and the lasagna (for veggie and regular lasagne casseroles). Great. All of them.Thumbs up flavorwise.My only complaint is that it seems pricey for pasta, but buying in bulk with no shipping fees helps until my local stores carry it.

At last-a good tasting pasta that is not raising my blood sugars too much that my husband will actually eat as well!  This pasta tastes delicious and is much more healthy than traditional white pasta.

I've used Dreamfields lasanga before, so I know it's a great product.  I bought a case of lasagna because I can't get it locally.  It's cheaper to buy it through Amazon (free shipping) than direct from the company.  I am disappointed that many pieces in each box are shattered-- usable, but not ideal.  Maybe you'll have better luck.From my experience, I would guess that the lasagna and spaghetti would break more easily in transit than the shaped pastas (rotini, penne, and elbow).
I give the Dreamfields lasagna 5 stars for taste a quality.  I give this method of ordering 0 stars since I found this product and exact quantity for $20 less elsewhere! Ripoff!

I really like Dreamfields Pasta.  My husband is a diabetic.  He can eat Dreamfields Pasta without having his blood sugars affected. I ordered a case of Lasagna noodles because I could not find them at our local grocery Dreamfields Pasta Healthy Carb Living, Lasagna, 13.25-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12)stores. When they arrived one box was broken and the lasagna in several boxes was quite broken up. I will have to make the best of it, fortunately they are now selling Dreamfields Lasagna noodles at our local "Top's".

I have been waiting years to find low carb lasagna noodles.  To my amazement, I found them on Amazon!  These were excellent. They taste just like regular lasagna, but without the guilt.  I didn't notice any sharp changes in blood sugar and didn't have any weight fluctuations, even though I ate a good portion of the pan over several days.  This is a really great treat when you want something that tastes so good, but is still good for you!

We have been very pleased with the taste and texture of the Dreamfield Pasta products, especially the effective carb count since we are trying to lower our weight as well as eat healthy. All the Dreamfield products we've tried are delicious. The only problem is that they are difficult to locate, for all grocery store do not stock them. But our order through Amazon arrived promptly and in good condition

column9: Pasta fine, shipping broke a lot of noodles
column10: Nothing wrong with the pasta, fine flavor. UPS broke a lot of noodles...the case sounded like broken glass when I picked it up and there are lots of noodle pieces...very few whole noodles. I hope I have better luck with the angel hair I ordered or it will be angel fuzz.

I bought the dreamfields lasagna noodles because I have several Diabetics in my family and this pasta has a slow digestive quality that allows diabetics to have it and not have raised blood sugar. I love these lasagna noodles. I make a low fat lasagna with them and everyone loves it. YUM! Way to go dreamfields!

column9: use it for blood sugar control in my diabetes diet
column10: I use Dreamfields pasta as a means to control my blood sugar.  It is and excellent product and tastes as good as the real pasta but without the digestible carbs that real pasta has.  If you have diabetes this is a good product to use in lieu of real pasta.
Finally, a low carb pasta that tastes like regular pasta.  If you think the whole wheat pasta is terrible like I do, give this a try.

column9: Fantastic Low Carb Pasta! Highly Recommended
column10: This great tasting pasta is a diabetic's Godsend! Being a Type 2 Diabetic, I am always looking for ways to reduce my carb intake. column9: Dreamfields is the Pasta of my Dreams!
column10: I have been a huge fan of Dreamfields since I tried them a couple of years ago; I had to do an online search for lasagne noodles as I could not find them in my local grocery store. The pasta does not taste like its low-carb; it cooks up al dente every time, and the fact that I can heat healthy, with low carbs with a low glycemic index, is a godsend.  For anyone who is like me, a pasta and bread lover (but not so much of a sweets lover) who struggles with eating right and losing weight, any of the Dreamfields pasta products should be tried.  I swear by them, and can't believe that they aren't more popular.
I would buy this pasta even if I weren't carb conscious.  Made from an italian recipe, the result is very similar to Di Cecco and other high quality italian brands.

I have tried all of the "special" Dolce Gusto drinks since getting my machine.  I am not a fan of plain coffee, but drinks like the Mocha, Latte Macchiato were all good.  However, with each of them I was still not happy with the flavor I got.  They all seemed to me missing something (like the mocha in the Mocha drink)Not any more!  This Caramel Latte Macchiato is AMAZING.  It is way better than anything I have had from this machine or any coffee house in my life.  The smell while using the milk cup is great.  The caramel flavoring is in the milk and it smells so good.  I wish they would make a candle or something out of that smell.As for the drink itself, it is very, very good.  I like to stir mine to mix the flavors but you can enjoy it either way.  Just like the normal Latte Macchiato, this one gives you the same look when using a clear glass.  It is very smooth as well with no bad after taste.My only issue (which is with the whole Dolce Gusto machine in general) is the price!  For the roughly 8oz you get with this drink, you are paying around $1.00.  I could go to starbucks and get a much larger cup of a caramel latte for around the same price I would pay if I had to use 3 sets of cups.  The whole point of buying the machine was to save money, but that is just not happening.  It also doesn't help that Amazon does not have this on the monthly reorder service to save a few dollars, but hopefully that will be coming soon.  The price alone is what makes this amazing drink get a four stars from me.

column9: The flavor I've been waiting for!
column10: I have been using the Vanilla Macchiato Dolce Gusto pods and adding flavored syrups because I like a dweeter latte.  I tried the Caramel latte today and fell in love! The smell is heavenly but I am not having to add flavored syrups.  I did add a swirl of caramel sauce left over from icecream toppings - better than Starbucks!  The drink is very smooth and creamy.  I have found the cost to be approx. $1 for an 8 oz latte.
I love my dolce gusto, but I do cast an envious eye on the number of choices for other machines. The caramel latte is a tast addition to Dolces limited selection. I will definately buy again.

I tried this new Caramel Latte Macchiato for the first time today and WOW! The Vanilla Latte has been my favorite of the Dolce Gusto coffees since I bought my Piccolo, but this Caramel Latte is tied with the Vanilla now. It smells so good brewing - sort of like the best caramel apples at the state fair combined with a hint of pecan pie baking. Inhaling it made me think of the first fall frosts. The taste is smooth and silky and there is no doubt this is a caramel flavored coffee - the Vanilla is a hint of flavor and this one is not shy or subtle in the least. I normally add a teaspoon of sugar to the other flavors, but this one is sweet enough on it's own to not need any additional sugar. Make sa very nice after dinner coffee or late afternoon soda replacement.
It taste just like the Vanilla Latter, to be honest aside from the expresso all Dolce Gusto coffe tastes the same to me.
This is not too bad with rich caramel flavor.  Wish the coffee is a bit stronger with this one.  My favorite is still Cappuccino at this time.
This product and a lot of the other like products are great.  I am happy I went with this system over the others
Excellent, sweet with good coffee flavor? Better than Starbucks or any of the others at 1/10th the cost? Would buy again and again.

column9: Nescafé Dolce Gusto Brewers, Caramel Latte Macchiato
column10: The caramel flavor on this caramel latte macchiato is rich and flavorful. The milk froths up well is very foamy. I only wish the capsules would make 8 ounces instead of 7. If you press the button for more it waters down the flavor, so I would rather use more capsules instead. I have to say I like the caramel latte macchiato, mocha and iced coffee flavors the best. Also, I wish nestle would have more uniform prices as the price varies depending upon which flavor you select. In spite of all of this, I would still recommend the nescafe dolce guto capsules and machine!

Since I bought my Dolce Gusto machine I have tried 9 different varieties of capsules, and the caramel latte is the one I buy over and over.  It smells intoxicating when you brew it and has a delicious caramel flavor, and I'm convinced there is a speck of cinnamon in it as well. It is not overly sweet, so I add sweetener. I have also been known to ramp up the flavor with Coffee Mate caramel or even vanilla or hazelnut. This coffee plays well with other flavors! I really wish they would introduce a bigger variety of capsules, but until that happens, caramel latte will be my favorite.

column9: Nescafe has done this flavor right.
column10: For me, this is the only flavor that is great for the dolce gusto machine.  I have a cup of this every morning and it is very good.The only other flavors I have liked besides this one for this machine is the hot chocolate and the iced macchiato, but I would rank this caramel latte macciato in first place above those other two flavors.  Nescafe has done this flavor right for a change.  These are hard to find in stores so I am glad Amazon carries them.

This is a great latte. The caramel aroma for me is enough but for those who might like a very strong one should perhaps add more but for me personally I enjoy this and add a little sugar as I do for any coffee of mine.

I am really enjoying my dolce gusto caramel latte macchiatos.  They are not quite as good as Starbucks but the convenience factor has replaced my routine coffee runs.  It is not overly sweet and certainly doesn't need added sugar but I do, at times, add a little of the starbucks caramel sauce.  The amount per serving was a tad disappointing at first, but I quickly got use to the amount and am now completely satisfied with a single serving.

Another great coffee available for the Nescafe Dolce Gusto machine by Krups. I'm thrilled new flavors are being added. The coffee is similar to Dolce Gusto cafe grande intenso and the milk pod is sweetened and flavored with a rich caramel flavor so I still get a pretty good cup of coffee even using twice the water.I wish Nestle would sell the milk pods separately from the coffee so there would be 16 servings per box rather than just 8. There are 8 pods of coffee and 8 pods of milk per box which makes the flavored coffees twice the price of the ones without milk, which can get pretty expensive for a coffee lover as myself. Therefore I shall reverve this for the ocassional treat and continue using grande intenso as my main beverage.

I bought this flavor since I had been buying the plain macchiato and adding caramel syrup.  I do not care for the taste of this one, though.  The flavoring seems more like coconut than caramel and it is a thinner consistency than the other drinks with milk pods that I've tried.  I would not purchase it again.

If you have a dolce gusto machine, do yourself a favor and try this. I think they hit this out of the park. The caramel flavor is authentic and adds just the right amount of flavor for one cup. Also, just like most of the other flavors, this one isn't very sweet and will allow for individual adjustment. I hope they keep going in this direction since this is fantastic!
I really love the Caramel latte, and add a scoop of thick home-made caramel sauce in to my espresso. Yummmmm

column9: I love this not too sweet
column10: I only have one a day but I also buy iced cappuccino and grande intenso each month.I despise walmart and will not buy from them after we paid $10 for caramel latte and left it on accident and we called when we got home and they told us that they had put it back on the shelf to resale it.
The service was great, but the only problem is that when I try to re- order 3 week's later suddenly this item is no longer available to be ship to my address.
rajah garam masala helped me make great tandoori chicken.  the spices were fresh and fragrant and made a delicious dinner. i would recommend it to others.

column9: Product was PAST THE EXPIRATION DATE
column10: Good spice blend.  However, I was very dissapointed that I received the spice well after the expiration date on the package.

I've used several brands of Garam Masala in my Chicken Tikka Masala recipe, and this one is by far the heaviest on nutmeg.  If you're a fan of nutmeg, that's fine, but it does leave a slight aftertaste and it doesn't appeal to me quite as much as others.The smell of the spice mix is nice (again, heavy on nutmeg scent), and the consistency is good. There were no lumps and it did seem fresh enough.  Overall, I'd buy it again if I still can't find the stuff I used to buy near my home.

My order was filled almost immediately and arrived four days before the estimated time. Since this is a spice I am using for a recipe, I am now able to make the recipe a lot sooner than expected. Thanks for the GREAT customer service!!!
Excellent product. We were very pleased with the fast service we received from this business, and look forward to doing more in the future.

Rajah Garam Masala (Spice Mix) 100g  We have been watching Bal Arneson (Spice Goddess) on the cooking channel and had decided that we need to add some great tasting spices to our collection of spices, being as we just Love Bal's recipes.

I just finished making a huge batch of buttercream frosting using my typical recipe, I tasted the untinted version and was satisfied.  Unfortunately for me I did not do a small test amount before applying this Christmas Red to the entire batch - it has completely spoilt the frosting, leaving it with a harsh, very unpleasant after taste.  I have purchased cakes from Costco in the past and have learned to avoid anything that has red frosting as I get the exact same taste.  I also did not find this to be anywhere close to a Christmas red, perhaps I did not use enough, but given the resulting taste having only achieved a pinkish red, I can only imagine what a horrible tasting mess you would be left with if you tried to achieve a real red - my frosting ended up being inedible!

column9: Not a substitute for Norfolk Lavender's Lily of the Valley
column10: I was looking for a substitute for the Lily of the Valley products that I had always loved from Norfolk Lavender, since they appear no longer to be producing that scent. On the recommendation of someone reviewing the Caswell-Massey version, I bought a tin of the talc. This stuff doesn't smell at all like the Lily of the Valley that I know and love. It smells more like Easter Lilies or hyacinths. It is blatant and heady, unlike the Norfolk Lavender version, which was light and lovely. When I use up this tin, I will look elsewhere. I certainly won't buy this again, as it comes close to being the heady kind of perfume that gives me headaches. As talc, it is fine, but the scent is not what I wanted in the least.

We love The Cravings Place Ooey Gooey Chocolatey Chewy Brownie Mix.  They're very easy to make, and free of the most common allergens (gluten, dairy, eggs, soy and nuts), and just the right balance between chewy and cakelike.  Delicious!
I did not not like Streit's chicken soup mix.....It did not have the good taste of Carmel Chicken soup mix......

Photo of the cake looks good and I was happy I can send a choco cake to someone really far away from me.I called store to make sure they can deliver item on time (about a week). I kept on checking the delivery tracking because I was concerned it might not arrive on time. It did not arrive on time. In fact it didnt arrive at all. Very very disappointed. I ended up sending a gift card.

The best value in cost per ounce for Goldfish on Amazon. As a college student I go through about two of these boxes a month -- and at this price, my wallet isn't complaining. I managed to order two for $13 shipped. My only complaint is that the price fluctuates day to day, so just be wary of the cost.

Goldfish snacks seem to have been around forever. Unless you are trying to avoid gluten, this is a good snack choice for that occasional urge to munch. Kids like the cute fish shape while adults might like the small size that's perfect snacking while doing something else at the same time, like reading or TV viewing.Goldfish are all natural with zero trans fat and no artificial preservatives. The foil lined bag keeps the Gold fish fresh as long as one remembers to refold the bag and hold the fold with a secure clip. A serving of 55 crackers is only 140 calories.The crackers have a mild, subdued taste which is actually a good thing - it's good for children and may help older snackers from over doing it.To me these whole grain fish taste and look like the regular Goldfish; the first ingredient of these though (after Smiles) is whole grain wheat flour. I like the taste of these in tomato soup and the aesthetics of watching the little fish float on the surface. The fun factor of this snack is immeasurable.

These were so much better than I expected!  Why I switched from regular to these, I still don't know, probably because I wanted to try something new.My unhealthy habit #25: snacking.  I've loved to snack on Gold Fish since I was a kid.These were scrumptious and a bit better for me nutritiously than the standard Gold Fish (not by much).  The price on these are pretty high (hence the 4 star) compared to the regular but I will probably buy these again because they are just that good; have a bit more crunch and substance.  I still love the Fishes!
You can purchase this item in the grocery store or wholesale store for so much less!  Don't waste your money.

My family loves gold fish, we eat them all of the time. Put them in soup, snack on them at lunch and late at night. I bought the whole grain version to have something a bit healthier... although they aren't healthy by any means! The box is a great size, it's a bit smaller then the ones you might see at a grocery store though so do not expect one of the humongous boxes but it is still a great size and lasted my family of 3 for about a month which is a lot more affordable than buying the smaller boxes every week!

column9: How Pure is this Extract to Volume?
column10: While identified as pure cherry extract, the label states the ingredients to be: cherry extract, alcohol, and water.  Since it appears other extracts commonly contain alcohol and water, I can live with these additional ingredients as a compositional reality for extracts.Disappointingly, however, the label does not state the percentages of each ingredient.  For some extracts, the FDA specifies certain minimum percentages and/or weight to volume requirements be met for them to be marketed as an extract.  Required or not for cherry extracts, I would like Olive Nation/JR Mushrooms to provide this additional transparency on its ingredients label.Finally, I purchased this cherry extract to be used, in combination with the liquid form of Carlsons "Very Finest" Fish oil, as a supplement for various medical conditions.  While it's too early for me to assess any personal medical benefits of this extract, I can state it tastes a bit like cherry cough syrup.  Lacking any other opinions for now, I decided to rate this product 4 stars, and hope more reviewers start weighing in for a broader based rating and overview.

Here in Chicago I had not seen this jelly delight since 1978! Found in the local kosher deli my gentile girlfriend loved 'em!  Dark chocolate covering rasberry jelly-what a delight.  Happy we can get them via Amazon.

column10: I bought this because it's lower in carbs than other pastas, but it has become my favorite brand because of the taste and texture!
If you are on a low carb diet, this is the best tasting pasta you will find.  The taste is very close to the real thing.  I am a pastahollic, but must watch the carbs.  Love Dreamfields pasta.

column9: You Can't Tell it's Low Carb
column10: I've been using Dreamfields for a couple of years and love every shape. It tastes no different than your regular white dried pasta and no one I've served it to has suspected it is "different". While we try to eat whole grains to lower the carb count and GI impact, but we just don't like whole wheat pasta so Dreamfields is the perfect solution.Unless you like your pasta very al dente, you will probably want to cook it for a few more minutes than called for on the box.

I first sampled this product when I got it at our local HyVee food store. However, to my dismay, they did not restock this item. It is a boon for us diabetic people in that it has only 5 digestable carbs per serving. It tastes great, and I can enjoy a little more food with this product. Amazon has a great price on this when buying a case and it is much cheaper than HyVee. I got free shipping too and that helped sweeten the deal.

This pasta product will help to keep your sugar down if you mare a diabetic.  The product does not have a off taste and for those pasta lovers it fits the bill.  Due to the way it is made, cooking time will be greater than with regular pasta.

column9: The carbs DO absorb...8-16 hours later...
column10: I'm a type I diabetic, so it's pretty easy for me to measure whether the "5 net carb" claim on the Dreamfield's package is actually true.Here's what I discovered after four iterations of testing on my own body:2 hours after eating 5 net carbs worth of Dreamfields pasta, my blood sugar increased by about 30 mg/dL.  This mild rise in blood sugar supports the claim that Dreamfields is, in fact, only releasing 5 grams of sugar into my body.  At first I was ecstatic.But...about 8 fasting hours after eating Dreamfields, I noticed my blood sugar started to rise and remained greater than 300 for a number of hours.  It became a fight between my blood sugar and insulin.  My blood sugar was still high well into the next day.I've tried this experiment with Dreamfields four times.  The body absorbs all the Dreamfields carbs, and not just the "net" carbs.It's extremely dangerous for a product to be so misleading.  If you're a type I diabetic and you're eating Dreamfields and wondering why your blood sugar is so high the next day, it's because of this pasta!

If you love regular pasta but hate the high amount of refined carbs that go with it...you have to try Dreamfiels Pasta.  It has the Good Housekeeping Seal of approval!  Get this, five grams of net usable carbs per serving!  You have to try this, cooked as directed, it has the mouthfeel of regular pasta.  Good if you don't like the chewiness of whole wheat pasta.  :  )
well, i'm just going to go on faith that the 5 carbs = 5 carbs.  I don't have a lab at my house. And it tastes great!

My son is diabetic so this product really helps him manage his sugar levels and still have pasta.  It tastes just like regular pasta--as long as you don't over cook it, but then, you shouldn't over cook any pasta.  I've been using this in his favorite casseroles with great results.

My husband has Type II diabetes and pasta was off the list of food he could eat.  One small spoon of regular pasts piked his levels up 70 points.  Then I found Dreamfields.  I made it two days in a row and there was NO spike at all in his glucose levels.  Pasta is back on the menu.  One warning.  If you use Spaghetti sauce from jar read the labels to make sure that is also very low in carbs. Now if they could make low carb Italian bread we would be in heaven.

This tastes just like regular pasta.  I dare anyone to tell the difference from any other dried pasta.  It is a real treat for someone who watches their carbs.  I highly recommend everyone try this and cut down on the carb intake.
Product exceeds all of my expectations. Tastes great does not raise my blood sugar like regular refined pasta. Wish they had more styles or shapes of pasta.

i love this guilty-free pasta!  not only can i eat all i want and not worry about the high carbs associated with regular pasta, but my mom who's diet i have to watch, can eat it as well.  she's diabetic and high glycemic foods are definately a cause for concern for her, but not dreamlands pasta. versatile and good tasting.

column9: Gets an A+ from My Doctor
column10: Since I am not a diabetic, I cannot comment on the reviews by others who found that this pasta affected their insulin levels.  I can, however, report what I have learned.I discussed the pros and cons of Dreamfields pasta products with my gastroenterologist.  To begin with, he tells me that this is the only pasta he eats at home.  It leaves him without the gassy, bloated feeling associated with other pastas.  (I also find this to be true.)  When I questioned him about a reviewer's findings that, acids (tomato sauce) change the ability of this pasta to remain a low-carb food (and thus, rendering its claim to be invalid), he told me that this makes no sense.  Tomato-based products are low acid.  Our bodies' own digestive acids are extremely strong.  If they weren't, we would be unable to properly digest our food.  As the pasta passes through the stomach and intestines, the carbohydrate level does not increase.For those who are gluten intolerant (Celiac disease), this is not a gluten-free product.  But, for those of us who mildly react to gluten, you may be pleasantly surprised at how well your body tolerates Dreamfields pasta.Eating this pasta product in normal quantities (2 ounces dried), as with any pasta product, is important.  If we follow the example of Italians, pasta is only a small portion of the meal.  To eat a large portion of pasta without also consuming a helping of vegetables, a salad, and a protein, is not healthy.As for texture and taste, Dreamfields pasta is excellent.  It looks, feels, and tastes like any regular brand of pasta.  You can use it as you would with any of your pasta recipes.  With the A+ rating it gets from my doctor, this will be our brand of pasta from now on.

We've been watching carbs as a way of managing our weight and if you do the same you'll know that it gets tough doing without pasta. Well the good folks at Dreamfields have developed a method to make it possible to bring some of that comfort food back into your diet without tossing the low carb life out the window. Honestly, it is hard to imagine anyone not jumping off the wagon from time to time for a special occasion but as with any program, you need to get back on the next day. With these pasta products the majority of the carbs are coated and locked up somehow so you don't absorb them and as such can be easily incorporated into those many 'on the wagon' days all without any compromise on taste! That's right, no compromise on taste! It is real pasta and it tastes like it should so this is an awesome product in the low carb world!! Try it, you'll love it. Even if you are not necessarily on a low carb program, this pasta offers everyone a simple substitution to their food purchases and a chance to cut a few carbs from their daily diet.

I have nothing but praises for this product. Call me naive, call me a pasta lover, but I am firmly bought on the idea that this is a low carb pasta and prefer to not dispute the fact or second guess it. I love pasta, always have, always will! But since time does take a toll and careless living does have a consequence I ended being basically blocked from regular pasta. By basically I mean, that once I got a little smarter, I realized that most of my eating habits would have to change If I ever was to conquer my limitations. It was either or and going back to my many meals of italian origin, be that canneloni, lasagña, a la bolognesi, tutu di mare, pesto, I can go on and on and get hungry at the exact same time. The point is that Dreamfields Pasta (with such a beautiful name it can be the pasta of dreams) offers me a way out or should I rephrase and say: I way in. Man Oh Mama Mia, pasta a la alfredo, just with parmesan and butter (for me I can't believe it's not butter for the rest the real deal from the cow's mouth!) pasta primavera...I better stop! I am getting emotional and my eyes are heating up! With the upcoming Wonderfully Exciting FIFA World Cup 2010 and the beautiful first days of Summer Dreamfields Pasta appear like the saviors in a market that mostly ignore the needs, of perhaps the few, but never the less active, dedicated, and deserving as anyone else to enjoy life at its fullest! I hope this is the best of all world cups ever and I give 5 Stars to the only kid in town!

column9: If it's too good to be true . . .
column10: . . . it probably is.If you can get past the big number 5 on the front and look at the nutritional information, you'll see that each 2 oz serving contains 41g of carbohydrates like most other pastas.  I don't buy into the "net carbs" mentality - a carb is a carb, and I was disappointed that they'd put something so hokey on their packaging without anything to back it up.  Some poking around on their website will tell you they have a method of producing the starch so that it gets through undigested, and decided I was going to drink the kool-aid and give it a try.The pasta tastes - like pasta! Do I really think I'm only getting 5g of carbs per serving?  No.  But it tastes normal and it can't be any worse than regulary pasta so I'm going to keep buying it just in case they're right.
