But honestly, I'm not willing to buy another bag to find out. I've recently started buying from the Roasterie and Atomic Cafe -- with coffee so good, that there's no going back for me. :-)

I don't know why this product received so many 5 star reviews.  I would rate this somewhere between Folgers and Rocamojo Coffee (one of the better coffee beans that you can buy on Amazon).  It is about half the price of Rocamojo coffee but it is also twice as expensive as Folgers.  Does it taste 2x better than Folgers? No.  Is it 50% as good as Rocamojo? Yes.

This coffee is terrible. It neither smells nor tastes like a true French Roast coffee. For anyone who has had the pleasure of drinking the standard coffee in a French cafe (as in France) or if you buy French Roast beans from a quality roaster you will HATE this stuff. I cannot imagine why Amazon sells it.
The coffee is smooth and mild on the palate. It doesn't have a strong harsh after taste. A wonderful way to relax and unwind.

This Eight O'clock coffee is most assuredly, 'finestkind'! You can go out and plunk down bundles of bucks for your 'high-fallutin' name-brand coffee, but you'll only be spittin' in the wind. The French roast is robust, smooth, and aromatic, with no trace of bitterness. The original [red bag] is excellent, as well. We usually buy the whole beans and grind them at home. If you're not already using the Melita funnel drip system, give it a try. After all, your coffee will only be as good as the water you start with! Have you ever experienced a decidedly sour cup of coffee? If you have, look no further than the coffee-maker's water delivery system. In between batches, the stagnant water in the tubing becomes a bit funky. I once tore-down a typical brewing machine, the greenish slime that I found in the water lines was the stuff of sci-fi thrillers! Incidentally, for all of you coffee connoisseur snobs out there, if this brand of coffee was good enough for my parents' ol' percolator, than it's certainly plenty good enough for me.
This has been my favorite coffee for years. Really glad to find it on Amazon. The local store does not carry the French Roast, just the regular. Thanks Amazon.

I thought french roast would give me more flavor and smell, same thing, nothing special about this coffee, when opens up, it is flat and plain, no lust and didnt smell much, seems like it's been in the shelf for a long time. Price is good, that's the only good about it, otherwise it is just so-so.

This is a great coffee - love the whole bean freshness. But the pricing was too high. I can buy it cheaper locally in my grocery store (with no tax or shipping). And if you go on Eight O'Clock's website, you can sometimes get coupons to further reduce your costs. I won't be buying this from Amazon again!
I'm a lover of the Italian & French roast coffees but this one lacks the boldness of a real French roast. More of a breakfast blend at best. Will not buy again.
This coffee lacks the richness I am used to in coffee beans that are french roasted. Although it doesn't make a bad cup of coffee in my book it is not frech roasted.

We are daily home brewers and love full flavors like French Roast. After bouncing around from various retailer chain-branded coffees (which were inconsistent in my opinion), and occasionally trying the stronger roasts of more maintstream coffee brands, we decided to try Eight O'Clock. I think I heard it was highly regarded by Consumer Reports. Aside from the convenience and value of buying in bulk here, we are loving the taste - smooth, rich and no bitterness. Great product.

I buy this French Roast as an alternative to Eight O'Clocks Italian Roast.  This has more 'bite' or astringency to it.  The Italian is smooth and almost chocolate in flavor.  I think they complement each other really well.  When I get a little bored with the smoothness of Italian Roast this is the best!

What can I say about getting coffee from Amazon?  All the bags came sealed well and in perfect condition.  The beans were fresh and made great tasting coffee.  I grind my own and was looking for an inexpensive way of buying 8 O'Clock brand cheaper instead of waiting for it to go on Buy One Get One Free at my local supermarket and this was ok I guess.  The price isn't really any cheaper or more expensive...  just another option.  I will say that 8 O'Clock makes all around coffee that isn't burnt and grinds really easily.  I use it in both a French Press and an Auto Drip Maker and it turns out great.

After my husband and I took a trip to Europe, I never thought I would find a coffee he would drink. He just loved the European coffees so much. When I found this one on Amazon, I bought it hoping it would satisfy his taste buds. It did and he won't drink any other brand. He even makes it in a mug to go because he doesn't like anyone else's. THE BEST purchase I have ever made!!!!

I have used this coffee for years. You are the only way I can find it in this ares. I had a young repairman here a few weeks ago and I offered him a cup. Before he left he asked to see the bag and wrote down all the info. He said it is the best coffee he ever had, so for what it is worth that makes two of us.

column4: MagnoliaSouth "As soon go kindle fire with sn...
column9: Love it so much that I subscribe to it.
column10: I read Happy Customer's review and I could swear that I wrote that myself! I have to agree wholeheartedly with that review.I too started my coffee addiction back in the 90s and I was a coffee late bloomer, in my thirties. I lived in Alaska and that's practically required. I too have tried every kind of coffee maker (and grinder) known to mankind, as well as every blend of coffee. Jamaican Blue, for example, is supposed to be one of the best. In a Tom Clancy book, he says that's what the president drinks.I originally bought more expensive beans. They looked pretty and by looks I assumed it would be better coffee. Then my ex, who had more than just a few problems, emptied out the bank account. I had to cut back on a number of things, but coffee was one that I could not shed. Enter Eight O'Clock coffee.I was quite surprised when I tasted it. It was really very good. I thought that must be a fluke. When it was gone, I tried it again and to my dismay I still liked it. I've never gone back either. I am very happy with it.You must understand though that it's not pretty. They don't have the shiny beans that actually costs you extra and are of no benefit. Some are even broken beans, but so what? I'm not eating the beans, I'm grinding them. I don't care if they're already broken.All in all, I'm so pleased that I subscribe to it regularly. Also another perk: I found it was cheaper here to buy this via subscription than it is to buy it at Walmart!

I grew up in NY and remember this being the coffee of my parents choice.Well, Mom and Dad knew their coffee. I like French Roast, so this is perfectfor me. It seems I need to use less beans when fresh ground as well. Plus it'sa little cheaper on Amazon than at the local grocery.
This coffee is a little more Robust than the original...but has a great, smooth flavor.  We like the whole beans so we can gind it ourselves.  We love it and will continue to purchase this product.
This coffee always tastes good (not bitter) and for a decent price I feel this is the best value coffee available.
It's good enough that I would buy it for the coffee pot at work.  I like french roasts and this is a solid cup of coffee.

I've had to search stores locally to find this. Sometimes I can find it, sometimes not. Now that I know I can get it from Amazon, at a lower price, I have zero reason to walk the coffee aisles at the local grocery store. Thanks, Amazon, for making my life so much simpler, even with the simple little pleasures in life, such as a good cup of coffee.

column9: Not What I Know as French Roast
column10: With the French-roast beans I usually buy, I open the bag and am hit with a strong aroma; inside I are dark and nearing black, shiny beans.  But with this coffee, I get a very faint aroma from slightly more than medium-roasted beans.  The flavor is mellow and slightly acidic.  I was not very impressed; but then, I am highly partial to a dark roast.  Bad batch?  Perhaps.  If you like a dark, robust, French roast, then be wary of Eight O'Clock.
great coffee........ My wife loved it. Its just a little hard to get thou. every time I order it  they were out of stock.

As a coffee lover and admitted addict and having tried most coffees commercially available, Eight O'Clock is the best value by far.  I usually buy the beans, grind them, and brew my coffee in an old fashioned, stove top percolator pot (also from Amazon).  The BEST.  This coffee has a full flavor but is never bitter or sour (as Starbucks coffee often is).
The beans are over-roasted and the only dominant flavor is charcoal. The price is great, but the coffee isn't.
The package came in good condition as promised in a timely manner.Now we are enjoying freshly ground coffee every morning.Thank You Amazon.

We have always liked this coffee, since it was available for years at the A&P Stores with the coffee grinder near by.With our new coffee grinder at home, preparing our pot freshly ground every morning, the coffee is delightful, an excellent waker upper. The convenient delivery of 4 packs assures us, coffee is always on hand.
I have loved having our coffee delivered to our home it is easy and a lower price than the grocery store.

I am soooo disappointed when I tried at first.It has no aroma and taste at all.I really don't know why many people recommend this...  I'll try to contact the customer service and ask if I can return rest of the bags.

I like a good cup of Joe every morning and this coffee makes it a great experience.  French roast is one of my favorite.  The taste is bold yet there's no bitterness to it.  Like other reviewers, I too kept overlooking a `cheap' bag of coffee, how deceived I was!  :)  I really enjoy all the eight o'clock roasts and flavors.  Definitely recommend and buy again.

This coffee is not very strong and I am surprised they even call it French Roast b/c it has about the same taste as folders or maxwell coffees which are terrible.  The beans do not have much oil on them when you open the bag and the aroma from the beans is not very strong.  This coffee is no where near as good as Starbucks or Trader Joe's whole beans.  If you are looking for dark rich coffee, look elsewhere.

I love Eight O'Clock Coffee.  It is a good value and the coffee is delicious.  The flavor is rich, full, and consistent.  I sometimes try other coffee but I always come back to Eight O'Clock and it's always delicious when I return.  My husband is a convert too (quite a change for a guy who used to love Dunkin' Donuts' coffee).  We prefer the French roast (I like my coffee strong and dark).  We haven't found Eight O'Clock in California so I'm really thankful that Amazon sells it.

I bought this coffee for my daughter who has a coffee grinder. I had read that this brand of coffee won the taste test of supermarket coffees. It is just as they say, a real winner. Good price on Amazon so I couldn't pass that up.
Got these when half off and subscribe and save so price is alot cheaper than typical grocery store.

column9: Great price for a great product!
column10: Eight O'Clock Coffee French Roast fits our bill for an everyday brew.  We grind the whole beans ourselves to a relatively fine grind.  This is a medium dark french roast with complex earthy flavors.  You won't find (or miss) Starbuck's burnt taste.  If you're looking for a good morning coffee at the right price I'd give this one a try.

This is an excellent coffee, but the packages are too small. The alternate, 5-pound bag of the same product is much more expensive. As of today's (4/9/2008) pricing, this small bag is 44 cents per ounce, but the 5-pound bag is 52 cents per ounce, about 18 percent higher for a more efficient package.
Not the best coffee I've ever tasted, but well worth the price and if freshly ground and brewed it holds up well.
I bought this item, 8 o'clock coffee beans, thinking they would be better than the ground type. They weren't.  Will try Starbucks....JE

I drink coffee daily, brewed in a Toddy Cold Brew System.  This french roast has a rich complex flavor at a great price.  I've tried coffee beans all over the world and the only better I've had was from a friend's plantation on Kona at about four times the cost.  So I'd suggest you give it a shot.  If you don't like it, ship it to me!

column4: Bartok Kinski "A casual stroll through the lu...
column10: I was disappointed to find that the Beans came Whole.  Since I don't own a fancy Coffee machine like French snobs or a fancy grinder, I didn't know how to use them.  I tried to smash them with a hammer but they were inconsistent.  When I did manage to borrow a grinder from a homeless man, I found that the Coffee tasted like poo.
This product is a good one and enhance the taste of the food or chicken. It also makes easy preparation with instruction on how to cook or mix all the ingredients.

column9: pro plan shredded blend large breed formula
column10: My vet recommended some different brands (healthier than I was using) and I have been using proplan for almost a year. The nearest retail outlet is in Midland, 125 mi one way. An outlet opened in Fort Stockton,57 mi one way, but they don't carry this particular type. Living in rural West Texas is tough for shopping, so you have to love the internet. Thank you, Amazon, for the shipping to Balmorhea PO. The price is decent and the shipping is worth it. My only complaint was that the bag was opened inside the box with my first shipment.

column9: My dogs love this and its worth the price!
column10: I have this on monthly re-order.  I have two dos who are older, so I decided to try a dog food with some "softer" pieces.  This works great for them both Greyhound and Aust. Sheppard).
These are the perfect size for work or play. Delicious straight or mixed and provides healthy ingredients as well. Worth the small amount of calories-awesome!

Let me say I have been buying this oil for a few years now from Whole Foods Market and let me tell you it is my favorite olive oil in the world nice fruity and grassy notes . I got very excited when I found this oil on amazon.com now I can have delivered it to my front doorstep with out any more worries. I truly feel that it is the best olive oil in the world try it im very sure that you will not be dissapointed.

I was lucky enough to tour this olive oil factory and orchard in Sicily just last week. I went with my extended family of 20 people (adults and kids) and we spent two hours in the orchards and in the factory itself learning about the process and then tasting the final results. This is, by far, one of the best olive oils I have ever tasted, period. The flavor is both smooth and deep with lovely color and a rich, full feeling on the tongue. Actually, all their olive oils are fantastic...and they also sell an organic version of the Primo (but I believe it doesn't have the DOP label). And the deep dedication and care the family takes with their trees and production is very, very obvious. Sadly, they don't sell it in the stores on the West Coast so I have to get my fix here. But for all you East Coasters...it's available in Whole Foods and other fine grocery stores (but the pricing is better on Amazon).
There is EVOO and then there is Monti Iblei.  You will use this because you worship your food.  Drizzled over salad, pasta, fish, antipasti.  Sublime.

The aromas are best appreciated on warm bread. We are told that olive oil savants judge the character and quality by taste at 28 degrees Celsius.  I found this product, already highly rated, as very good. John A Howard

I received this olive oil a few months ago and i have been using it for alotof different things. from salads and marinades and cooking, to just dipping bread in it.This olive oil is absolutely amazing...upon opening the bottle for the firsttime, i must say that it was an experience!!When you open this bottle for the first time...the aroma hits you like a runaway freight train. I personally have never encounteredolive oil of this caliber. This was obviously a true labor of love. The coldpress date is on the bottle and this batch was cold pressed in november of 2010,so it is definately VERY fresh. I cannot recommend this product enough!! I have tried many different olive oils and pretty much most if not all ofthe ones i see in stores never have the cold press date on them and if theydo, its like 2 years old..rediculous...these people are proud of what they do andit shows in the fact that they clearly list the cold press date right on the bottle. and the pressing of this is only about 6-7 months old..amazing.One last thing...When i recieved this bottle of olive oil it was packaged ina box...and the bottle is a dark DARK green, which says to me that theyhave also packaged this oil correctly..ie..it was probably immediately packagedin the box to keep sunlight away from it! and also the bottle color is correct..olive oil's main enemy is sunlight... So all that being said...it is amazing..buy it...you will not be disapointed!

column9: Excellent for arthritis sufferers plus great taste!
column10: I have suffered with arthritis for some time and found little natural relief.  I read that cherry juice could help and that some juices were better than others.  I'd tried some other kinds of cherry juice and got a little relief from my arthritis pain.  Then I tried this one and it is significantly better.  I love the taste of cherries and cherry juice and this is one of the best.  But to get the added health benefits, too, is wonderful.  Whether you want it for your health or the taste, you'll find this to be a great product!

I have trouble getting to sleep and sleeping soundly.  I have heard from a few people and saw on Dr.Oz (lol...yes, I try some of the things he suggests) that a few ounces of 100% unsweetened 'pie cherry' juice (which I have since found out is Montmorency cherry juice) can be of help.  Well...it is helping me...and its full of antioxidants too...another good reason to have a sip of this juice daily.  Have read more and I now know that this juice is full of tryptophan, the same stuff in turkey =) that helps you feel so snoozy!  I shopped around in Amazon AND in local stores, this is THE best price.  8 plastic jugs came cardboard divided, in a box,I will be purchasing from this seller again through Amazon.  A Made in Michigan product.  (PS/this is TART but not unpleasant in the least, to me its not as tartas cranberry juice.  It made me remember the days of my Nana making cherry piesand I got to drink the left over cherry juice...its the same juice)
This cherry juice is really good. If you like juices that are not combined with sugarcane or corn syrup, you'll love this.
This was a good value, but as a diabetic I cannot drink it due to a very high sugar content of 28 g per glass.  I prefer getting the concentrate which has 1/10th the sugar level.
This Indian Summer Montmorency Cherry juice is a great sour cherry juice I like it better than the others. Sams Club sells it to for about the same price.

This juice does its magic! I recently read that this juice helps fight some cancer, helps with arthritis, and helps you rest better at night and I personally purchased this for the sleep and it works!!! It is source and almost tastes like wine but I enjoy it very well and my family enjoys it too! Just went through one bottle in a week and I'm sure we'll purchase more of this in the future!Highly recommend buying this juice! Very quick delivery and packaged neatly! Thanks!

We have now ordered three cases of this wonderful juice. It has the perfect blend of tart and sweet. Tastes just like you picked the very best cherries, squeezed them and drank the juice. I first ordered it because I had heard that cherry juice helped with gout. (I haven't had a flareup since beginning drinking this juice.) Then I started drinking it just because I couldn't think of anything that tasted better! The price is very reasonable, shipping was fast and the labels come off easily so I can use them in my shop for nails, screws, etc., after they're empty. If you are a gout sufferer and just HAVE to have a bit of vodka, tequila, etc., now and then, try mixing your favorite adult beverage with Indian Summer Cherry Juice. You'll never go back to cranberry, lemonade, etc. I just hope they never run out of cherries!!!
The quality of this product is great, the comparative cost is very competative.  Healing information is included but not pushed.  I liked it.Dave Larsen

Hubby and I (both 63) have been drinking about 4 oz a night for a few months now. We both found that we are falling into a deep sleep faster and for a longer time (eliminating the 2 or 4 am wake up).  My sister and her hubby also tried it and like it very much for the same reason.Indian Summer 100% Juice, Montmorency Cherry, 46-Ounce Containers (Pack of 8)

My son and I have both been taking tart cherry juice for about 2 months.  His gout is better and my back and sleeping are better also.  He has stopped taking his gout medicine and when it starts to bother him, drinks about a 5 oz. glass of juice.  I drink mine before I go to bed at night.

6 ounces a day is all you need to help ease some of your aches.  Many of the members of my husband over 65 years old softball team enjoys this product.  Taken everyday it will ease joint pain and much less expensive than your local grocery store.
A really tasty juice that is not too sweet. I drink it before going to bed and sleep much better and my joint pain is also improved. A great natural way indeed.

The miracle of living pain free for the first time in years!I have just reordered this fabulous juice. The anti-inflammatory promise of tart cherry juice has changed my life.After trying numerous brands, i find that this performs the best for me.1/2 a cup twice a day really does keep my arthritis pain at bay.I have recommended this to numerous people, most of whom have had great results.

I had been looking for a reasonably priced Tart Cherry Juice and found it on Amazon.com.  The product met all of my expectations including the pricing and I will definitely reorder!  Thanks for providing consumers with an alternative!

Ive been drinking cherry juice for about 2 weeks solid...had about 7 different brands and would have to say that this is 'up there in the favorite list'.  Happy with the fact that there is no added sugar, artifical sweetner or water.  Plastic bottle that it comes in is really quite durable....since Im drinking about 1 ever week I was trying to think how I could use this in one of my kids art projects as it seems a little wasteful to just send this straight to the recyle bin....anyway...no ideas yet...but Im sure Ill think of something (currently trying to use 2 Litre soda bottles to build a greenhouse)

column9: Great tart cherry juice, sweet, tart and helps a bit with muscle soreness
column10: I was a little worried that the juice wouldn't be as strong as the "tart cherry concentrates", but I still find myself needing to water it down as much as I do POM pomegranate juice.The juice is a bit tart, but very sweet as well on it's own. It's fresher tasting then other ones I've tried as well- without old sediment floating on the bottom.An 8 pack sounds like a lot- but the bottles are only 46 ounces, not 64 like I usually get from Costco.The price on them is fairly higher than buying other juices from Costco locally- but I'm not just buying them for the taste- it also helps a bit with reducing muscle soreness after working out.It's a good tasting juice, reasonable price, and helps reduce muscle soreness- I'll definitely keep buying!

Helps u lose weight and to kill pain.It might take you 2 or 3 of these containers of indian summer tart cherry juice to start feeling the affects of the pain killing. I drink 2 to 3 glasses of tart cherry juice a day (8-10 oz glasses). So instead of killing your stomach with aspirin or destroying your liver with tylenol drink start cherry juice and you have a natural way of killing your pain.To your health!!!

So far I like this cherry juice best.  I was expecting it to be thinner and watered down compared to the concentrate (I had been mixing Tart is Smart concentrate 1/2 cup per Qt of water which I believe is what they suggest) but this tastes much better and stronger.  Perhaps tastes better because it tastes stronger to me.  The tart cherry juice works better than Glucosamine for me, my knees creak far less and I am much more limber when I wake up.  I can't say anything about sleeping better as I slept fine before I started drinking cherry juice.

column9: Cheaper than the stores, if they carry it
column10: Tart cherry juice, no added sugar, is a healthy drink, which you can always sweeten with a bit of diet 7-Up or Sprite, if your lips pucker. Even with shipping, it's less than city stores and none carry it in rural AR. The product is good and shipping fairly reasonable, if you order by the case.Not sure if Dr Oz' recommendation means anything (He has won a Pigasus, you know - look it up), but he endorses cherry juice among a thousand other things.

There have been studies on cherry juice and athletic performance so I thought I'll give it a personal test. Unfortunately I've become unemployed so my training and competition had to stop cause I can't afford the cost that is associated with the training and the competition.I've only consumed the juice for three weeks before stopping training so I can't make a judgement on the effectiveness as a sports performance supplement. I can, however, say that the taste of this juice is pretty good. Since I stopped training the taste has become too sweet so I have to add 25% water to dilute it before I can stomach it. It is not tart and if you like the taste of cherry you'll probably like this juice.
The juice showed up right away and was exactly what I was expecting. I'm adding it to my diet to help manage gout symptoms, so hopefully it works.

Pure sex in fudge form... I WILL be buying more in the future, and would like to try out some of the other flavors offered. I'm looking at you peanut butter...What great packaging these fine people use! The fudge itself came in a nice cozy little box, which was lined with a special ice pack to keep it cold during transport, which was then wrapped in a special bubble wrap which I assume keeps EVERYTHING well insulated! Arrived perfectly un-spoiled and ready to eat out of the box.I shared this delish treat with my room-mate, and we both went NUTS over it!
If you're into fudge, Amish Buggy is by far the best. It's creamy, smooth and delicious, and tastes like it all just came out of your mother's kitchen. Pure heaven.

I bought the Turtle fudge for Father's day and it was the perfect gift. The fudge was delicious, creamy, and high quality. The shipping and packaging was great. Even though they delayed the shipping because of the heat wave that was going on my fudge arrived on time. The packaging was amazing; the box was lined in with insulation, had packaging peanuts to keep the fudge secure, and a couple reusable ice packs (which i think is an added bonus) to keep the fudge fresh.Overall it was a great buy and I will definitely buy again!! :)

i've had most of the  best fudge the U.S. has to offer(mackinaw fudge from michigan).On a whim i decided to try out their peanut butter fudge,it was as good or perhaps even better than fudge from mackinaw island.
this is the best chocolate mint fudge i have ever eaten. i will be ordering this item again and again.

better then a grocery store, the shipping does lose the top notch fressness/quality. but i would gladly buy these online before going to the local store to buy fudge. with that being said, everyone who tried some luved it, i would suggest this to anyone who can't get fresh made fudge at home
Wow..  Great tasting fudge.  The seller notified when item wasto be shipped.  It arrived in a great wrapped box with ice to keep it cold.I can't wait to try there other flavors.Price was great too.

column9: You had fudge? Not like this.
column10: If you have had fudge it hasn't been this good.  When I got this I immediately put it in the fridge.  By the time an hour passed it was able to be cut and tasted awesome. I am not a big chocolate fan but I eat too much of this.
Says it's Amish homemade fudge, it can be any mass manufactured fudge. I do not recommend if your looking for homemade.

Got two pounds of Amish Buggy fudge for my mom for mother's day - it came really early! It's hard to get her treats because we live over 2,000 miles apart, but apparently this fudge ships really well. My mom reports that she has been enjoying the fudge for several days now. I got her the chocolate pecan and the turtle kind, and she said both are delicious. The turtle one is softer, she says, but she liked the chocolate pecan one best. Will definitely be purchasing from this place in the future!

This Turtle Fudge was simply scrumptious!  It contained the perfect combination of pecans, caramel, and creamy chocolate.  It arrived well wrapped and securely packaged.  I am looking forward to trying other combinations of fudge from this company.

Bought this Fudge for a last minute Christmas gift, I mean what do you get the guy who has everything? You get fudge that has the elusive(to the West Coast) Black Walnut in it. Seller shipped it so fast my head was spinning! Product was excellent and may friend loved it! Highly recommend this product and this seller! Thank you!

I ordered some as a special treat for myself and my mom.  We both love it!  It's very sweet, very soft, and uses a very strong mint flavor like we both love.  The two different sizes in cuts is kind of confusing to me but I think it adds to the homemade charm of the fudge itself.I really also appreciate the effort it took to get it here.  My fudge was packed in ice packs.  And I also appreciate the little plastic knife for cutting.
This fudge is delcious with the perfect amount of pecan bits in each bite.  A little sweet but still very nice.  Reminds me of something I would buy in a small town sweet shop.

The packaging was excellent. But the quality of the fudge was not up to my expectations, especially after reading the other reviews. I love mint, so I was really excited about this fudge. But I felt that the fudge was too sweet and the mint flavor of the fudge was overpowered by the sweetness. Will probably not buy again.
I buy this juice often. It taste really good to me because of no other addition which makes strange taste.

column9: don't drink if you are diabetic
column10: Do not drink this if you are diabetic ... it may cause blood sugar to drop....It is known to cause problems with blood sugar....

Mayonnaise is easily my favorite condiment, and nothing but Hellmann's (aka Best Foods west of the Rockies) will do.  It's super thick so my sandwiches don't get soggy in the lunchbox, and it has the perfect amount of tanginess!  The only other mayo that can compare is fancy-pants Japanese mayo, but I still like this stuff a lot better.  The squeeze bottles have a slightly different consistency and flavor, I've found.  5/5 for the jar type though!

column9: The Gold Standard of Mayonnaise for decades
column10: Hellman's is arguably the absolute finest mass-market mayonnaise available -- at least 40 years of my sandwiches attest to this fact.  My grandmother used to mix it with ketchup and call it Russian Dressing.  My grandmother was wierd.
There is seldom truth in advertising but bring out the Hellmann is bring out the best is an exception as it really is the best

I grew up w/ a mom who ONLY bought this brand, and it's the only brand I buy too.It's the best mayo there is.  It makes great chicken, tuna, and egg salad.  Never any weird taste in it that is NOT mayonaise.  Yes, it is fattening, but the good thing is that it only takes a bit on a sandwich to make it taste great.  I always spread it really thin and it is wonderful.
The product arrived packed safely so it would not break. I opened it and tested/tasted it. Good quality mayo. Got what I asked for.

column9: Same great flavor as Best Foods
column10: I started hunting for Best Foods Mayo online, because at the store it costs $4.99 for a 30 ox bottle.  When I did some research I found that it is called "Best Foods" on the west coast and "Hellmann's Mayo" on the east coast.  I ordered the 3 pack, and it is the same thing.  Thank goodness, because we use a bunch of it, and now it is cost-effective!
I don't know how to evaluate this product, it's mayonnaise.  It arrive on time, it is the right taste, color, flavor, etc.  Same stuff you get in the store.

These Tupperware containers are wonderful.  It's amazing! Compare to food frozen in plastic freezer bags.  No ice build-up, food never has that dried "frozen" taste.  Use for storage in refrigerator as well.  A perfect product!

Not knowing this was a Kraft Foods brand, we bought this in Paris and brought it home to the US. It is one of the best whole bean coffees we have ever had. I just wish our local stores sold it.Not too bitter, with a very complete taste. I like more flavorful, and he likes bitter - we both loved this coffee. Highly recommended.

Came across this coffee in a hotel in Kazakhstan during a business visit. Really enjoyed it ,but it is not available in Australia to the consumer. Found it on Amazon, and now have it every morning.If you like coffee with real "guts" and a bit of flavour but none of that bitterness, this is the one.

We have tried many coffees and a number of home coffee makers but have  been unable to brew anything to match the quality of the coffees we enjoy in our favorite restaurants. But this morning we tried the Carte Noire given us as a Christmas gift. What a delightful surprise. It has that "blackness" that we associate with good coffee but none of the bitterness. It is unquestionably the best coffee we have ever made at home. And with a small addition of Irish Creme syrup (another Christmas present), it was simply quite wonderful.

I found Carte Noire in France in 1993 and started bringing packages back with me three or four times each year.  What captured my attention so firmly?  What makes this coffee so great?It is unusual simply because: (1) It is 100% Arabica; (2) It is 100% Colombian.  (3) It is roasted by the French.  There is only one other coffee with this particular rare pedigree, and it is good, but not quite as good as Carte Noire.  Amazon's ad terminology calls this an after dinner coffee.  I disagree with them.  We have always used it exclusively in the morning, as do the Europeans who value its rich taste.This coffee is bold but not overpowering.  It avoids giving you a thin or a bitter coffee taste.  One package of 250 grams (very finely ground) will last for exactly five days when brewed in a 12-cup pot.  My coffee philosophy is this:  If you're going to drink coffee, buy and drink the best one you can find anywhere.  This is it.  I wouldn't lie about something this important.

I haven't ordered this from Amazon, but can certainly vouch that this coffee is without a doubt the best! It is a pity that it should be so pricey online while you can get a three pack in a regular supermarket in France for less that 10 euros.  Quite shameful, really...

My wife and I found this coffee in France during a "coffee buying spree".  We bought a little of everything and enjoyed them through out the year.  One of the more inexpensive brands (in France) is Carte Noire.  It might be common coffee in France, but to us it was the absolute best.  We order several each year.  I'm the hit with my fellow adults when I bring it to a Boy Scout camp out. My fellow adults even pout when I run out.This is some great stuff and the seller does a nice job in shipping it.  Be aware that sometimes it is out of stock, so you might join us and order a few and stock it up in the freezer.

While in France this year, we were drinking this brand of coffee every day for two weeks and very happy to have found that it was available here.  It's a great coffee, bold, rich, great aroma and very French.  The shipment came in perfect order and faster than quoted.  Over all, very please with vendor and of course, love the coffee.  Recommend it to all coffee drinkers.

During the winter of 2008 I lived in Paris, surviving on very little money. Carte Noire was the cheapest coffee in the Monoprix supermarket, costing perhaps 2 euro. That stuff rocked--it shames every American brand. Ironic that here it's pretty pricy.
I had this coffee during my trip to Paris, it was very good. I bought this coffee but it was not fresh or had the same aroma as the one I had in Paris, I don't think I will buy it again.
Great coffee always! I knew it since I tried it long time ago in Europe. I want to try whole beans because since instant is so good, the whole beans should be excellent.

Have traveled the world and tasting coffee for over 52 years; have been a Carte Noir lover for a long time. Great to have it available in the USA. If there is a better coffee somewhere out there, I'd sure like to try it.

We became addicted to Carte Noire while living in Paris.  It is available through Amazon and others as individual serving pods for Tassimo machines, also.  Which was the main reason we bought one of those, when we returned to the U.S..  Now, if we could just transplant our favorite cafe, too....Quel bonheur!!!

This green tea tastes really good and it gets concentrated for all the benefits of green tea! If you let the cup sit for a while it gets dark!! We got 4 boxes for a very good price! Not to mention that those are whole leaves and bagged and organic!

column9: Skimpy grazing in these parts with this product, sad to say
column10: Last month after my local pet store ran out of the Cosmic cat grass my cats had long been using to fight off hairballs,  I came here to Amazon, found two products that looked interesting and bought  one of each.  I had very disappointing luck with this one.  I  read the instructions and followed them clearly, paying particular attention to keeping the soil moist and warm and the light dim until germination. I used an 8-inch garden pot and the same Miracle Grow potting soil that had worked wonders in my outdoor garden pots.  But the results were disappointing.  All I got were a scattered few strands of grass.  A  second attempt, using more seeds and a different, smaller pot netted the same meager results.Meanwhile my other purchase, the Pet Greens Garden Wheat Grass Self-Grow Kit--which came with similar instructions, but  its own soil, disposable planter pouch and far fewer seeds at twice the price--produced a veritable thicket of grass that kept  growing and growing and, despite daily grazings from three cats,  lasted  five full weeks.I still have some Nibble-Licious seeds left, so would gladly appreciate comments from those of you who've had good results with  this product on what you did right that I may have done wrong and how to fix it.Pet Greens Garden Wheat Grass Self-Grow Kit

In the spring and summer this grass grows with no problem and no sun. It is an absolute miracle to watch. I plant this grass in a plastic planter box and water it just a bit to get the grass started. After a few days it sprouts and then within a few more days it grows three or more inches. Eventually it grows to about six inches and then starts to wilt. Of course by then the cats have had a feeding frenzy and the grass is all torn up and ready to be pulled up. One bag of seeds lasts me through the summer and I plant new seeds about every two to three weeks. So far I've never had problems with this company's seeds but if you are nervous buy some first from a pet store. One thing I do that might be the reason I have success with these seeds is I spread them out on the soil and then barely cover them with a thin layer of soil. I also water them about twice before they sprout. I just think it is amazing that this grass grows without any direct sunlight. My cats adore this grass and I'm sure your cats will too.~The Rebecca ReviewP.S. I moved to a place with full sun on a patio and this grass grew much differently with sun. I almost think it growsbetter in a shaded area.

The previous reveiw is way off base.  They didn't read the details.  This is a great product for growing grass for my cat.  Germinates fine, and he loves it.  Don't be put off by the negative input from the prior review.

First, the price tag on the plastic was 2 for $1.50 and paid more than 75 cents per bag.  Secondly, the peanuts were old and stale!  Learned my lesson!  Sellers should check the expiration or any holes on pkgs.  Never again!
My crazy picky calicos just love this stuff.  I'm so surprised because they only want dry food.  I will continue to buy this very high quality product!

I've spent years trying to figure out what my cat likes.  I thought I had narrowed it down to chicken, but he eventually got sick of that too.  Based on previous purchases I was sure he hated all seafood except for tuna water.  Being that Tiki has a lot of tuna mixes, I thought I'd give it a try.Amazingly, he loved it! He's still insanely picky and doesn't like the same food several days in a row, but I can combine even a little bit of this with his other foods and he'll eat it.  Very happy with this find!!

column9: My sick cat loved this stuff

I have a cat who has to have a calorie-restricted diet and was not doing well on the Rx food from the vet. Much heaving and discomfort. I am sure I gave him extra years of life by putting him on this food.

There is quite a variety and he favored some much more than others. But the best way to find out is get a sample pack and see what he/she likes.Theres a variety of tuna combinations, calimari, sardines, mackeral, lobster and crab. The fish is very fresh and apparently fished in low mercury oceans so you can relax about the amount you feed your kitty.Our cat now demands fish nearly every day. column9: Too much fish for a variety pack, but....
column10: I bought this variety pack so my cats could try the chicken flavors without fish, but they hated it. However, they did like a couple of flavors...so I will order those (if I can remember which ones! argh)My BIG questions/concern: the fine print on the bottom of each can says "feed one can for every 3 lbs of bodyweight daily"...One of our cats weights 16 lbs (Maine Coon) and the other, 12 lbs, so I will need to feed a total of 9 cans/day. (who can afford that?) This MUST be wrong info?What cat would eat that much food in one day?Makes me question the company. (they also included one flavor that had menadione sodium bisulfate - a known carcinigen - listed on the can, but when I called I was assured they eliminated that from all flavors last year, and that they just haven't "caught up" with new labels yet.  hmmmmm.If you are feeding this food, do YOU feed according to the label instructions?I've been feeding/offering 1-2 cans of Fancy Feast Classic/day to my 2 cats, but they never finish it.Why do I need to almost triple that amount of Tiki Cat?  (I do put out high quality (40% protein) kibble 24/7.  A good quality, high protein kibble fills up cats in all the right ways, so one expects them to eat less. My cats only eat 1/2 cup of kibble/day (that's total for both, not each cat!)  Seems way too little, but they maintain their weight just fine on it and the FF. So, I have to wonder about how TikiCat came up with the huge amount needed to feed?I'd love to hear what others do. If cats "need" that many cans of TIKI CAT, then each can must be very low on nutrients, as I assume to get the proper nutrients, they need all those cans as per the label?  I hope someone can make sense out of this.  I emailed the company just now as I totally missed that last line until placing an order for Hookena Luau, Hana Luau & Napili Luau. (some of their cans have better (safer) ingredients than others; and those are the more expensive ones & of course those are the ones I will feed IF I find out I don't need to follow the feeding guidelines.....)

I'm not an "energy-shot" kind of person generally. You won't find me rappelling down mountainsides, kayaking over rapids, or hang-gliding over Death Valley. I have an office job, and my stimulant of choice is coffee or tea.BUT...There are times when I really need heightened concentration and I'm already exhausted. I can't just drink coffee indefinitely, because it makes me irritable and makes my heart race if I overindulge. That's when I use energy shots. I've been in the habit of using 5-hour Energy. But 5-hour Energy is... well, how shall I say this... yucky. I've tried every flavor, and they all taste metallic and leave an aftertaste reminiscent of boiled-down Diet Dr Pepper.Thankfully, Red Rain has the exact same effect on me as 5-hour Energy (the regular strength, not the extra strength), but tastes far better. What is the effect, you ask? For me, it's a very gentle lift. It's not so much a caffeine jolt as an improved ability to focus on creative or technically-demanding tasks. And it's a lot cheaper than 5-Hour Energy, too, even if you get your 5-Hour Energy at a warehouse store.If you're looking for a kick in the pants that helps you party all night long, I can't recommend Red Rain. If you're looking for a subtle pick-me-up that will help you get through the tasks at hand, this could be the one.

I work in a hot warehouse 12hrs for 4 days a week and by the end of the day I am DOG TIRED! After moving boxes around for nearly 6 hours it's boring, tedious, and tiresome. What's the solution? Red Rain! I used to buy the extra strength 5hr shots, but at nearly 4$ a pop it gets kinda expensive quickly! These you can buy at walmart or any dollar store for MUCH CHEAPER!Do yourself a favor and compare the labels! A red rain shot is the EXACT same thing as the normal 5hr shot, but at less than half the cost and quite frankly...the 5hr shots taste bad. So save yourself some money, safe your tastebuds the chemical aftertaste and BUY THIS! You can have almost 3 of these for the price of ONE 5hr shot!
I have tried many other energy shots. Most were more expensive and did not do whatthey advertised. Red Rain is exactly what it claims to be. Would and have shared with others.
Better tasting and cheaper than 5hr energy.  In my experience the energy boost is equal to 5hr energy and lasts just as long.  However, I prefer the taste of this and it saves me money.

My husband thinks this is the best and most reasonably priced product on the market. In fact we can no longer even find it on the store shelves, guess they are always sold out. So glad we were able to find it at Amazon.com!!

It works really well. I gets me throw my days that I don't sleep well. Between being a working woman and a mom plus working out this is the only thing that works. I have tryed all kinds of them and this one works the best..

I echo what the other reviewers said.  This is an excellent alternative for 5 hr energy, and by buying from amazon, you save a ton of money.  I take them every morning and it really helps me get through lunch (I'm fine after then anyways).  The only downside was that when I first started taking it, I felt a weird tingling in my legs, which I never got from 5 hour energy.  However, this went away after a few days.

column9: No effect for either me or my husband
column10: My husband is an energy drink addict on the weekends in his attempts to stay up all night. I thought maybe if these worked for him, he could cut down on his energy drink intake and therefore cut down on all the calories and sugar that comes with it. Unfortunately, these did absolutely nothing for him.I tried them as well, thinking that it might just be him. I don't really drink anything with caffeine besides a coffee every few days sometimes and do not ever drink energy drinks or anything of the sort. I tried drinking one of these an hour before I would normally start getting tired at night for four nights in a row. And all four nights, I was asleep before my usual bedtime. These might work great for some people (as shown by how many good reviews these have) but they didn't have any effect on either me or my husband. Looks like my husband will be making due with his energy drinks for a while longer.

This stuff is great to have around! You never know when you'll have to pull an all-nighter or two studying. It is NOT safe to drive to and from school on such little sleep without some form of energy like Red Rain.Red Rain has all of the positive effects of coffee (energy & delicious taste) without all of the negative effects (freaking constipation & diarrhea).
To me, red rain does the exact same thing as 5 hour energy at a fraction of the price.  I would recommend red rain to anyone currently using 5 hour energy because you are over paying for 5 hour.

I have ordered this exact item from Amazon a few times before. It is basically two 12 packs in one box. One of the 12 packs was already opened and was missing four of the mini bottles. This is the first time I have had this happen. It's not worth sending back, but it's extremely annoying.I will say that the product is great otherwise. It's virtually identical to 5 hour energy, but it costs half as much. The berry flavor isn't great, but it's not terrible either.
This didn't have any effect on me at all - I had a few friends try them and they stated that they didn't feel anything from the energy shot(s) either.Age range tested 20 - 25 years old.
Nice boost of energy when you need it! And the price is perfect. Much cheaper than in the stores and other brands.

If you get a lot of "zing" from caffeine you will from this also. I generally use half the quantity at a time. It is certainly more reasonably priced also.

This works, tastes better than other similar products (though I don't think any energy shot product can really taste GOOD) and was much less expensive than others. It's really sweet and tart but doesn't leave the bad taste in your mouth I've experienced with stuff like 5 hr energy. I've gone through about half of them, and I don't take the whole thing at once usually half in the morning and half around lunchtime. "Cons" might include that the part of the plastic that provides the bottle's seal is not always easy to remove cleanly (doesn't follow perforation, and it can be kind of annoying) and that on a couple bottles (so far 2 of 11) have dried up dirty brownish looking product in the threaded part of the cap (another reviewer may have mentioned this as well). It's nothing that's going to kill you and I usually can just wipe it off, but it's a little bit unappetizing.Overall this is a good alternative to drinking coffee or soda and I'd buy it again if I need more when they're all gone.

I was only recently introduced to energy shots, and before now I have only tried 5-Hour Energy. I was hoping to save a bit of money by buying these instead. Sadly, I have to take two of them to feel anything, and even that does not give me the amount of energy and concentration provided by the more popular brand. I've noted that the energy I do get from these doesn't last very long; about two hours after I take them, my energy levels drops to normal. I've also noticed that they tend to make me feel slightly lightheaded; and a friend that tried one had the same effect.I'll finish off the remainder of my box anyway, because the lightheaded effect isn't bad, but I will not buy these again. They aren't really saving me any money since I have to take two of them, and the fact that the energy doesn't last long is the real deal breaker for me.
It works and the taste is very pleasing. I will order again to get through those occasional sleepy afternoons. Works faster than a cup of coffee.

column9: Meh..Not for people that use energy shots/drinks often
column10: Pros:  The taste is fantastic, a sweet berry.  Although I admit I kinda like the acerbic taste of some drinks/shots so that's not that important to me.Cons:  I simply don't get any energy from them.  Admittedly, for my job and as the father of 21 month old I drink more than my fair share of energy drinks.  So if you don't drink a ton, maybe these will be fine for you.  For me though, they simply don't cut it, which is a shame considering the great price.  Compare the back labels of these versus five hr though and these have about half the amount on most ingredients. I might try the red rain extra strength and see if they have more of a kick.  Otherwise its back to Power Horse drinks, also sold here on Amazon, and at a great price.

These are great! Before I was so tired in the morning, and could barely stay awake in class. The thing putting me off so long was the price. 10 dollars for 6 at my local store! With subscribe and save, its less than 20 for 24! They taste AMAZING, too! The packaging is lovely. I highly recommend this!!
Great savings if you purchase the 24 pack, I wish they had the 24 pack in watermelon flavor but berry is also tasty and provides great energy.

I picked up a case of these, hoping to find a cheaper alternative to 5-Hour Energy (at less than 1/3 the price, this is definitely cheaper).  Red Rain tastes fine (berry flavor) and provides a similar pick me up that you'd find from 5-Hour Energy, although it seems to last somewhere around 3-4 hours rather than 5-6 like 5-Hour Energy.  Overall, I'd say the price tradeoff is worth it.
This product seems to work the same as other similar energy drink products of this size, for a good price.
Not as long lasting as 5-hour Energy, but the price is too low to be beat. I only paid $16.60 for 24 bottles!

Having fought the battle to remain awake for most of my adult life, I was always seeking an elixir to prop open my heavy eyelids. I have no taste for coffee, therefore I have searched extensively for something with a similar effect, easy on the stomach, and palatable. None of the various stimulant tablets suffice, though some will wake me, even shake me; alas there is no pleasure in swallowing a pill. One day, I tried -- Red Rain -- tasty, stimulating, no stomach pain! I drink it without haste for I love the taste and it keeps my sleepies away. Every month Amazon.com sends seventy-two bottles to my lair at a discounted price that is quite fair. Red Rain Energy Shot, Berry, 2 oz, 12 ct I used Red Rain to wake enough to finish my novel "Nepenthes" also available on Amazon Nepenthes. "Nepenthes" is a fantasy steeped in dreams and love and libertarianism, and yes, there is a bit of violence. My wife and I highly recommend reading it while slowly sipping Red Rain; seems an excellent thing to do!

I got these because of their price primarily.  Taste is great.  Picks me up a bit.  But really doesn't do much.  I can drink two and not feel that jittery (keep in mind, I drink lots of caffeinated beverages, so I have a tolerance).I wish the extra strength came in packs of 24 at this price, that would be awesome.This is a great product, but for a caffeine junkie like me, it's not up to snuff.

I don't use energy shots often but wanted to have some around just in case.  So I've bought a pack of this stuff and two months later the results have usually been hit or miss. Sometimes I feel it, sometimes I forget I've taken it and go about my business.  So I won't be going into details on the performance.The price was great and flavor was good with no strong after taste or anything.My issue with this product is that 90% of the time I open a bottle it, it has brown residue around the rim of the bottle. I see this after peeling off perforated cap band and unscrewing the cap.  I think that if the band were not there the caps would eventually come loose and all of the liquid would spill out.  I do not fear that the bottles have been tampered with but it's a bit unsettling.  Before anyone says it's due to how long I've had it, it's only been two months and I store them in my kitchen cabinets and my desk drawer at work.I believe Red Rain competitors have a small foil seal under the caps which prevent leakage.  Perhaps the lack of this enables them to cut the cost of the product?  At the moment, i will not be buying this item again, if however this issue was corrected I may consider buying Red Rain again.

I had a chance to get a sample package of these cookies last week.  I was very surprised - they were actually better than regular sandwich cookies.  I don't like overly sweet things and these were just right.  It was very hard to tell that they were GF.  I think if you put them out and didn't say anything, no one would notice and might even prefer these cookies.I plan on ordering soon.  Dr. Schar products are usually very good and the cookies live up to their reputation.Update: I ordered a box (6 pkgs) of these from Amazon and they were as good as the sample I tried.  I would love to try some of the other cookies.I wish Amazon had more Schar products in the bulk packages - this product is hard to get in our area.  Some of the other sellers are offering single packages at a very high price and then adding shipping to it.

I made this cake and frosted it with a combination of the Pillsbury already mixed frosting and my own creamchees frosting.  The cake was absolutely delicious I couldn't tell it was from a mix.  I highly recommend this particular cake.Mackey Kean

The boxes are smaller than I expected. They look really cute on the counter. I also bought the butchers salt and the gardeners salt. It is too bad that they do not package them together as a trio. I have two houses so it was not  a big deal for me to have two of each. They were not packed very well when shipped and arrived somewhat damaged, I had to glue two of the boxes back together.The salt is of medium coarseness, the salt to herb ratio is 3/4 to 1/4 respectably. Yet another great product with a great taste.  PERFECT for gift bags.  Guests LOVED them.  So easy to use! No mess no clean up.  Just tear, pour, add liquor and DRINK.

This is the best Lemon Drop cocktail mix and closest in taste to my favorite at the Cheesecake Factory. If you dont live anywhere near a good cocktail bar or Cheesecake Factory this is the best alternative!!I LOVE IT!! I hope that one day the US suppliers also ship directly to the UK, or maybe that a UK suppier startys importing these. As it stands today I had to order it to be delivered to a friend in the US who brought it in his luggage on his trip out to the UK - BUT hey this hassle is worth it!
My cats have never had more energy or a healthier coat!This is great stuff.... even if my cats do eat better than me!

I've been eating this wing sauce for years.  Found it in a massive container at a surplus store and have been using it in a variety of ways.  My favorite is mixing it with some ranch for a zesty dipping sauce.  I've used it to make buffalo chicken pizza, I've poured it on wings, I've made buffalo chicken dip with it.I feel that its got the perfect flavor.  I've tried many others, but none have the zesty, tangy spice that this one offers.  I'm a big sauce fan and this one is always stocked in the fridge.
I absolutely love this sauce!  I use it as a dipping sauce for my grilled chicken and even turkey.  It makes a healthy alternative to fried wings.

I got a bottle of Budweiser Mild & Tangy Wing Sauce at my local farmer's store for a decent price.  However, I ended up dumping the stuff out - both my son and I agreed that it tasted like salad dressing. I'm sticking with Frank's Red Hot.

column9: Way too salty -  ended up cooking it into a custom sauce to make it edible..
column10: I don't what they were thinking on the sodium content of this sauce.  As if chicken wings already don't have enough flavor.  This sauce is terrible out of the bottle --  sure, it's mild -  not tangy at all, and so salty that it's just disgusting.  I ended up more than doubling the volume just to reduce the sodium content to a reasonable level -  added some apple cider vinegar, water, brown sugar, a couple tablespoons of honey - a little cornstarch as a thickener and cooked it up on the stove.  They should be selling the sauce I made because it's three times better than this stuff.

I drink all kinds of energy drinks and shots, and when I found this on my store shelf I knew I had to try it.I love the packaging and name of this stuff, referring to it affectionately as DEMON BLOOD. I can imagine using this stuff for my demonic practices and rituals.The drink has a blood red color, and actually doesn't taste half bad. Beware, though, it tastes somewhat like cherry cough syrup, and has a similar consistancy as well. I like the taste of cough syrup, so this didn't really bother me much.I have a few gripes with this drink, however. Keep in mind that these are 4 oz bottles, so they are twice the size of normal energy shots or 1/4 the size of regular energy drinks. The 666 energy drinks use REAL SUGAR, which I applaud, but unfortunately they have about half the calories of a 16 oz can of NOS or Monster. Drinking one of these is like drinking a can of soda, there is just A LOT of sugar in this stuff.So for about a soda's worth of sugar, what energy are you getting?200 mg of caffeine20 mg of vitamin B3  100%20 mg of B6  1000%250 mg of B12  4166%Drinking one of the cheap $1 energy shots at the dollar store will probably give you a better boost than this. And they are sugar free.I'm at the point now where I would have to drink at least 2 of these to get going, but at that point, why not just buy a can of NOS?The 666 energy drink company does have a sugar free version, a decent fake lemonade flavor with the same nutritional value.I found them at a discount retailer (Ollie's) with a few misprints. They originally were selling them for .89 cents a piece, but clearanced most of them out for $2.00 per case (there are a lot of older and religious people where I live, haha). I wouldn't pay anymore than $1.00 per bottle.In summary, these are alright tasting and will give energy-drink junkies a mild boost. The main draw of these is the name and look of the drink. No other energy drink out there can rightfully be called DEMON BLOOD.
I mean wow. the removable table is awesome. Definitely meets the needs of this musician!

I bought these on a whim when I saw them at a local store, and figured I'd try them out.  I just had this rice, and heated up a pouch of teriyaki tuna: Starkist Light Meat Tuna Fillets, Teriyaki, 5-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 10)The combination was filling and tasty, and took a whopping 2:15 total in the microwave.  This is something I would buy again!

I did not buy my rice packs off of Amazon. Instead, I got them at the commissary where they are roughly half the price.The product could not be easier to make. Peel back the plastic cover on one corner, microwave for 2 minutes, and you have hot ready to eat rice!There are stove top directions as well.In the microwave, the rice turned out perfectly. It's not overcooked, or a mushy mess. Perfect slightly sticky rice.I'll definitely buy this again. However, it is somewhat expensive, considering you could buy an entire bag of dry rice for this price, and it would feed you many times over what these do.

While I didn't buy this off Amazon (I get it for 2/3 of the price at World Market), it's still worth the higher price if you can't get it cheaper. Yes, it is most definitely less expensive to just buy a bag of rice and steam it yourself, but, speaking as one of the subset of the population who can't cook to save their lives - yes, you can burn water; don't ask - this is the perfect solution for rice lovers. No worry about making too much or too little or having it too mushy or not steamed enough, all the hard work is already done for you. So long as you have m@d skillz with the microwave - you know, pushing those buttons like a pro - you'll have the right portion of perfectly cooked rice in a minute or so. Doesn't get much better than that.

I love most things that are hot and spicy, especially if they have a lot of taste to go with the heat.  Chipotle peppers are one of my favorites because they deliver just that, heat with a rich, smokey flavor that works well with many hearty dishes.  I usually buy chipotles whole as well as ground.  Although I have dozens of ground peppers in my cabinet, Chipotle, along with Cayenne and Ancho, are the hardest working spices in my kitchen.There are times when I prefer a pepper paste instead of a dried pepper.  I can make my own, but having it pre-made is a great convenience.  I have recently started using the Roland brand of Chipotle Peppers in Adobo Sauce instead of my usual brand and I like them better.  I am now using this paste and I couldn't be happier with it.  I add it to soups, stews, chilies, anything that is thick and rich.  The paste blends with these types of dishes better than powders and imparts an unmistakable Chipotle flavor to everything that it touches.  The heat is just about right and a little goes a long way.  I plan on keeping several cans on hand at all times.

I selected these chips while purchasing too much food because I was hungry, even though i know that's bad grocery store juju. However, these chips were just absolutely delicious. Thinner than I expected, the average thickness of a regular chip. Made with just a touch of oil and other than that, they are an embodiment about all of the good parts of eating apples. I would continue eating them even if they were terrible for me, they are so good.

column10: I've tried about 30 different coffee pods, and the Aloha Island Diamond is the best of all of them!I use the Grindmaster OPOD brewing system, and I've found that when sampling coffee, it's best to use a brew strength of "STRONG".  This brings out the best and worst in a coffee, and when a coffee is great, such as this one, you'll really taste the goodness that way.

This cake mix is absolutely the best!  I make it for all my clients who are gluten free and they LOVE it! Even people who don't have a gluten allergy find it delicious. This is the perfect cake if you are having a birthday party and you want to only make one cake, instead of 1 gluten free and 1 regular. Everyone will enjoy this cake.P.S. column9: My favorite blend from Celestial Seasonings in K-Cups for convenience
column10: I love this blend of tea--I've been drinking it since it came on the market (back in the old days when the packages were psychedelic and quirky, and Red Zinger had almost 20 different herbal ingredients--now sadly reduced to a much less complex blend.) However, Sleepytime may have changed its package but the blend is the same--lime blossom (linden flowers or tilia, same thing), chamomile and spearmint. This is a brilliant mix, the linden and chamomile floral, sweet and soporific, the spearmint adding just enough of a hit to make it interesting. It's good as an after-dinner digestif, or as a before-bed soothing drink.Each ingredient has a purpose; linden is a relaxer and is said to restore the liver (hence, it's used as a tisane in France, where livers are always suspected of being upset), chamomile is a tension-tamer and soothes the stomach, and spearmint is a digestive (unless you have GERD--mints can be irritating, sad to say.) After a heavy meal, this tea can soothe a stomach. As a before-bed potion, it's unparalleled. I drink this almost every evening. You can serve it to children with a bit of milk and sugar to make "cambric tea" which is an old recipe for a posset to serve to children, too young for caffeine. (Cambric is a white, sheer fabric, so "cambric tea" is white and thin, no color.)You actually don't need to have K-cups--just brew a cup of hot water from the Keurig and dip in a Sleepytime tea bag. But if you are serving guests at table or in your office, a dripping tea bag is a nuisance and I for one am not a person who drinks her tea with the bag sitting in the mug. I just can't do it, though I know many people do. Call me a fussbudget but I don't like sipping past a steeping bag. The K-Cup makes a perfectly steeped cup immediately and no messy bag to clean up. So if you drink this on the way to work in a travel mug or don't want to deal with a tea bag, the K-Cup is very  nice indeed.

Oh, how I love this tea! I brew a cup of this tea and stir in a little honey at bedtime. I curl up in bed with my Kindle and sip my tea while I read my story. By the time I finish my tea, I am calm and drowsy and ready for a gentle nights sleep. My mind doesn't whirl around with all the things I have left undone or have to do. I just sleep and dream. I Love it!
I love this tea!  It is so much easier than having to use tea bags. Will definitely buy more when I run out!!
I've been drinking sleepytime tea since I was 8 years old, and it is by FAR one of my favorite herbal tea's. Great flavor, great scents when it's brewing, and all natural caffine free product.
I love this tea...very soothing and comforting!! It is my wake up tea and my "going to bed now" tea!
I think this is a great tea either in bags or k-cups...of course I love my keurig and this makes it easy to brew.  Great flavor!

Great deal and great taste. I love making tea in my Mr.Coffee Keurig brewer, and this is by far one of my favorites. For all you tea lovers, try the Lemon Zest flavor by Celestial Seasonings as well, it's amazing.

Unfortunately, this is the only asafoetida (hing) that is readily available in the US. It is preground and mixed with edible adulterants to make it easier to handle. Unfortunately, due to this processing, the quality is not high. While it will certainly work for your recipe, it is nowhere as good as the chunks of pure sap that are harder to find in the US. Search out the good stuff if you know a reputable spice merchant.If you're in NYC, I've found better quality hing at Dual Specialty Store in the East Village. It's still not as good as the super stinky chunks of Afghani asafoetida that I picked up in Varanasi, but it will do.

This Asafoetida is great.  It does not smell very appetizing raw, but once subjected to heat it adds a depth of flavor that some compare to garlic or onion.  I think it's more subtle that that and adds a savory flavor that is unique to this compound.

I got these Oreos for my boyfriend and they were delicious the chocolate coating on them was creamy and yummy. column9: The Best Thing I Have Ever Put In My Mouth
column10: I don't even know where to begin... this is honestly the best soup I have ever had... and out of a bag!!  The flavor is amazing... its spicy but sweet, tangy but creamy all at the same time. column9: Only tried one flavor so far, but it is amazing.

I saw these pouched soups while I was shopping at Wal-Mart and was surprised to see that they were not only Campbell's brand soups but how  out of left field the flavor choices were for Campbell's. While different, that didn't immediately make me confident that the flavors would actually be successful.I decided to buy only one pouch of the Coconut Curry Chicken to try it out. I like curry so if this worked out yay me! Well Yay Me! This was RIDICULOUSLY good. While it was heating in the microwave (as it said to do in the directions) the fragrant aromas started seeping out. I was shocked. This smelled almost exactly like when I make coconut curry sauce on my own. It smelled so fresh and authentic, the only thing left to doubt was the taste. Surely the aroma was just some canned, chemically manufactured olfactory trick. I was happily proven wrong. The taste and the smell all fit together. And unlike Campbell's canned soups, where you had small pieces of of mushy vegetables or meat, here you had big pieces of carrots and chicken and crunchy water chestnuts, the shittake mushrooms were small however, but not negligible.Seriously try it out for yourself. You won't be disappointed. As for me I'm going to go buy a heck of a lot more.

I'm not much for writing reviews, especially long ones.This is the best packaged soup I have ever had. Each one was like I was sitting in a restaurant that just made it for me. Let me start by saying that I can't stand hot chocolate mixes that you add water to .. for me, it must be made with fresh milk!  I recently read some online reviews on hot chocolate and this brand received rave reviews.  I've tried both the organic and the old world and both are fabulous.  The organic is a powder mix and the old world is chocolate shavings. I guess I'd say the old world is more intense and rich, but you can control the strength by how much you add to your hot milk. Both are definately worth the extra money and makes a nice holiday gift (with a couple festive mugs).  You can also find this brand at Whole Foods Market.

I like hot chocolate and I drink a lot of it.  Naturally, I have experimented with many different hot chocolate mixes, including the big national brands.  Lake Champlain hot chocolate is my favorite. The Organic and the Old World are very good, but Traditional is my absolute favorite and I used to make special trips to out of the way stores just to get it. The Aztec is an interesting spicy change of pace. Sometimes when supplies run out I have had to make do with other brands and you can just tell the difference if like a really chocolaty taste. I am glad that Amazon is finally stocking it.  Try it and compare.  Try it for baking your favorite chocolate desserts.  Their chocolate bars are very good as well.Lake Champlain Hot Chocolate Mixes

I was very lucky to receive a gift package of Lake Champlain hot cocoa mixes. Very lucky. The three varieties included were: Traditional, Mocha, and Aztec. Three wonderfully chunky one pound cans of hot cocoa mix. Oh, boy! This is an all-natural product without additives or preservatives. The Lake Champlain company has been reverentially producing chocolate goodness from its factory in Vermont for over 25 years. They offer a variety of chocolate indulgences, including gift baskets and gift samplers. In addition to the addictive hot cocoas, they also tempt you with truffles, caramels, chocolate bars and other items of divine decadence. The hot cocoa mixes are rich and satisfying, made with milk and soothing to the soul and the senses. The flavors of the mixes are so full-bodied that I even added spoonfuls of the hot cocoa mix into the batter for brownies, cookies, cakes and etc. I also made my own gourmet mocha madness mixes by combining the hot cocoa dry mix with instant coffee granules and powdered creamer. I had my own private stash at work, and the scent of my cocoa-powered coffee creations had others asking what I was drinking. I was benevolent and shared some of the mix. I think I started something ; )

I ordered this not knowing exactly what to expect. The thing you have to understand with this Root Beer is that it is not your typical store brand. This is all natural root beer and if that's the flavor you are looking for then this is a great product.At first it has a funny after-taste but that goes away and becomes expected so it's not a big shock with the second can.

this soda taste like root beer, that's what you're looking for right?  Very refreshing.  I don't feel guilty letting my boys drink it, they don't drink soda on a regular basis anyway, but, when they do this is perfect.

I bought 4 six packs of this brand at a local "Good Earth" store where I was seeking sodas without HFCS after being thoroughly disgusted that every single soda in the grocery stores where I shop had high fructose corn syrup in them!  I really liked this one! I bought the same amount of "Hansen's Creamy Root Beer" and a couple of "Virgil's Root Beer" at the same time--in hopes of finding a root beer my family liked minus the HFCS.  Both "Blue Sky" and "Hansen's" were winners at our house.  Half my family liked the "Blue Sky Creamy Root Beer" the best, and the other half liked "Hansen's Creamy Root Beer" the best.  I got the "Blue Sky" on sale at $.37/can. "Hansen's" was $.49/can. No after taste with either, just good old fashioned root beer!  Another thing we liked was none of these were so carbonated that they burned going down.  Plenty of fizz, but more like the old fashioned root beer I grew up with--anyone remember "Frosty Root Beer" or "A&W" in the mug--pre-HFCS days???  The "Blue Sky" brand was a tiny bit less carbonated than "Hansen's."  "Virgil's" was excellent too, very unique root beer taste, but more expensive at $1.45 per 12 oz. bottle.  Glad to see all three we tried, here on Amazon, which means you can get them wherever you live!!!P.S.  Another family favorite "Blue Sky" soda was their "Cherry Vanilla Creme Soda!"  Yum!  Serve them all ice cold for optimum flavor!!!  Also, loved "Orange Creme" (Like an orange creamcicle with natural orange creme flavor!)and Lemon Lime (Natural lemon and lime flavors!) These sodas are so good, you'll want to try all their flavors! We did, loved them, and our family is never going back to sodas with HFCS! Why aren't these in the chain grocery stores??? Thank you Amazon!!!P.P.S.  Blue Sky does make a no sugar "Creamy Root Beer" too.  It is sweetened with Stevia.  Not my choice, but I felt I should clarify the other review about that here.  The one I bought lists these ingredients on the label:  Filtered carbonated water, real sugar, natural root beer flavor, and caramel color (from sugar), citric acid.
Tastes similar to Barque's Root Beer, so if you like that you'll like this.  Can't beat it though becuase it is organic :)

To me this soda did taste like a mild root beer, very similar to A & W but without the intense syrup gag.  It's mild and creamy, similar to a cream soda but with that root beer flavor.  Unlike the other reviewer, I did not have any aftertaste from it.  I will definitely keep on buying this root beer!

It's really, really sweet, as are most Stevia-based sodas.  I'm not a fan of sugary stuff in the first place, and this just ruins it.  It does taste like root beer, but like I said, way too sweet.  Diet A&W is much better.
