I've made my share of banana nut breads but having this Quaker version on hand was convenient to enjoy anytime I wanted and it was definitely delicious! I received this complimentary from Influenster mom voxbox and have it on my 'to buy' items for our next grocery shopping!

This bar tastes so good. I will definitely purchase. I enjoyed mine warmed up in the microwave, but they would also be delicious right out of the package. They are really flavorful and you can taste all the different ingredients. It almost tastes like homemade banana bread.I received this Cereal Bar complementary for review purposes from Influenster.

I received this product free from Influenster to try out and review.  ([...])  I loved the taste of this Quaker product.  I thought it was perfect for a snack.  I didn't warm mine up although it says you can.  I will definitely be going out to purchase these and will be trying them warm next time, too!

I absolutely love this bar.  I took it with me when I had to get up early and didn't have time for breakfast.  On the package it says great warmed up, but this bar was just as delicious straight out of the package.  It has great taste, the banana is obviously there but it is not completely overwhelming.  I look forward to trying more flavors, but I have a feeling that this is going to be my favorite because I just really love bananas.

column9: Healthy and a snack I have to hide
column10: I received the Quaker Banana Nut Bread Flavor from Influenster. I should have asked for several. Before I could say a word my kids had pilfered it and it was GONE!! Then they came back asking if I had anymore. If my kids eat it I will buy it. Plus it is a product I can trust to be safe and healthy for my kids. Definitely on my grocery list.
i recieved this compliementary of influenster.com and i absolutely love them! they taste just like banana nut bread and they wonderful heated up.

I was tentative about trying this product when I received a complimentary sample bar from Influenster. On first glance, it seemed too heavy of a snack. However, after warming in the microwave (which I HIGHLY recommend!!), you can't just have one bite! I ended up eating the whole bar and it left me wanting more. It's healthy and easy and tastes so good!

column9: Healthy Snack, Great for On The Go!
column10: I received a Banana Soft Baked Bar through Influenster. I was pleasantly surprised how yummy this was. It really tasted like banana nut bread. I love that the bar was soft and chewy.4 stars because I've been looking for these all over the place and can't find any. If anyone knows where I can find them (LA area), please comment below and let me know =)

The Quaker Soft Baked Banana Nut bar was pretty good. I enjoyed the banana flavor and the nuts combined were nice. I like that it was soft and moist too. I would definitely try some more from this brand.

I love this quaker oatmeal bar!!! Low in calories, high in fiber :) I feel healthy at the same time I feel like im eating dessert. I received this product for free to try from influenster and i am not paid to write reviews or to try it, just simply to give my honest feedback. I went and bought a full box! I travel a lot and this comes in handy to throw a bunch in my bag or purse. I highly reccommend this bar!

The Quaker Soft Baked Cereal Bar was okay at first, but once I microwaved it for a few seconds it was delicious. Almost like having my moms fresh bakes banana nut bread. These are perfect since I don't have much time to eat in the morning an to take with me. This is a product I will continue to purchase in the future.

I was expecting homemade creamy soft banana bread.  I bit it and was a little surprised by the texture.  It almost had a crispy quality to it- like the innards of a Crunch bar.  There were little crisp pieces in every bite!  Not like my homemade recipe AT ALL.  Back to the actual bread part of the banana bread- it was good!  Not the same as homemade- but it was good!  It also had walnut pieces on it- which is great for nut lovers like me!  I prefer pecans on banana bread- but walnuts will do.

I received a sample of Quaker Banana Nut Bread, and was pleasantly surprised.  I warmed it in the microwave for 15 seconds and it tasted fresh and very tasty. It is a great thing to eat on the go, at work, or school, very easy to throw in your bag for a snack or a late breakfast.

column9: Tried this bar and loved it!
column10: These Quaker soft baked cereal bar in the banana nut bread flavor are so awesomely good!! I could definitely eat more than one in a sitting! So yummy!

column9: If you like oatmeal and you like banana bread, this is for you!
column10: I received a free bar in the mail with the Influenster VoxBox program and gave it a try. It really did have the taste of banana nut bread, but the consistency was so so for me. It was literally what you think it would be .... a banana nut oatmeal made into a bar. If you like that kind of oatmeal, you'll enjoy the easy on the go bar!
My husband really liked this bar. He thought the flavor was great. He also figured it would be awesome if you were in a hurry in the morning - what a great breakfast on the go!

I love these Quaker cereal bars! Not only are they delicious, but healthy too! I would recommend these especially to those that love banana nut bread! They are microwaveable so you can warm them up, which makes them even better!

I received a Quaker Soft Baked Banana Bread Bar as part of my Influenster Summer Beauty Vox Box. I'm staunchly anti-banana, but this little treat sounded right up my mum's alley, so I had her eat it. This is what she thought. Keep in mind, Mum is already a big Quaker fan, and an even bigger fan of banana nut bread. She had Quaker oats for breakfast this morning actually. As prompted by the directions, she microwaved it for 10 seconds. She liked the packaging, since you could see the product, it had a full ingredient list, and plenty of nutritional information. The bar is 1.48oz (42g).Mum's initial thoughts were that the bar seemed to have decent nutritional value, and would make a convenient lunch time/after work snack. When she took her first bite, she seemed really impressed that it tasted "like real banana nut bread!", and said it had a crunchy but chewy texture with lots of almonds. She said the banana and nut flavors were well balanced.  She really liked it, she ate it super fast (she always yells at me about eating too fast ;_;). She saved tiny morsels of it for both our dogs, who agreed it was delicious.Overall, Mum really liked this Quaker bar. She said she'll probably buy a box of them next time she goes to the grocery store (provided she can find a coupon). She thinks full price ($3.30 MSRP for 6 bars) is reasonable, but like me, she kinda loves saving money. Her only complaint about Quaker's Soft Baked Banana Nut Bread Bar is that it contains corn syrup, aside from that, it was a hit. She gave it a 4/5.

column9: Very good! Replacement for an average granola bar!
column10: This product was delicious! A great source of energy for breakfast on the go or a lunch-time snack! I highly recommened!
This is a yummy product!  So convenient too.  I love to warm mine in the microwave for 10 seconds then dive in!
These banana nut bars are soft and chewy, with a nice banana bread flavor. They go great with a cup of coffee for a quick, light breakfast or an afternoon snack.

I thought the Quaker Banana Nut Bread cereal bar was delicious--it tasted just like banana bread! It was incredibly soft and had a variety of ingredients (not just cake and bananas). It certainly tasted as good as some of the less healthy options, but it was only 140 calories! Unfortunately, it didn't really satisfy my hunger so the calories weren't worth it.
This baked bar has the delicious equivalence of banana bread, and is a great on the go breakfast. Although it was moist, it was a little spongy, but nonetheless i definitely recommend it.

I received the Banana Nut Bread soft baked bar in my Influenster Summer Beauty VoxBox and I wasn't that big of a fan of it. I personally do not care for bananas to begin with so I knew that the chances of me liking it would be slim. My mom loved it though.

I also received this as part of my Influenster Vox Box and I have to say that I'm disappointed in the taste. Upon receiving this item, I was really excited as I love Quaker Oats' oatmeal, flavored and even the whole oats. When I prepared to try this, I heated it up as it suggests on the packaging. I thought the smell was quite wonderful and was preparing to savor that first bite. Unfortunately, the taste of this cereal bar was not too pleasing. It had an artificial taste to me. However, I thought the texture was nice and the amount is perfect for a breakfast on the go. I would be willing to give their apple crisp bar a try as I may have more luck with that.

column9: Soft and Delicious- Almost like eating Banana Bread!
column10: This cereal bar had me skeptical at first.  Usually products with banana in them have fake banana flavoring that tastes funky.  I was pleasantly surprised.  These bars taste almost just like eating banana bread (texture aside since bread and a bar are slightly different).  These make a great snack or breakfast on the go.  They weren't even very crumbly (just be careful of the nuts on top), either which kept my car happy and clean as I ate it on the way to the gym.

I got to try this as part of my Influenster sample package for this month.  I was excited because I love banana nut bread - I even heated it up in the microwave like it suggested on the package.  It tastes..  healthy... but not in the good way.  I've had Luna bars and Clif bars - they taste "healthy" but its edible and even good in its own way.  I don't think this one really is..  Its such a shame - their apple cinnamon breakfast bars are delicious!  But I definitely wouldn't get this kind..

I really thought this was an awesome yummy product. I love the way that it tasted and I felt like it was good for me too. I do not really like nutty products but I do love almonds so this was perfect for me. I did not try it in the microwave but I want to pick up some more and try it warm. I think this is a perfect on the go snack, I also think that kids would enjoy this product too!

I got this as a sample first and I immediately tried the product, it was so delicious!  The banana flavor with the nutty-ness.  I actually went and bought a box and wow, it was even better warmed up!  It's very healthy with a lots of protein and keeps you full in the morning.  I love this bar!

column9: Quaker Soft Baked Banana Nut Bar Review
column10: So so so good! I'm not a huge fan of banana nut bread, but this bar is delicious! It is the perfect snack and leaves you feeling full. It is soft and the perfect consistency. I highly recommend this product!

column9: I love quaker, but not so much banana flavor
column10: I love Quaker foods, but I have had their banana nut soft baked cookies before and I am not a big fan of banana flavor so I didn't enjoy this bar as much. I did try putting it in the microwave, and that made it so delicious and chewy, but the nuts on top still gave it a good crunch. I don't like banana flavor, unless its a real banana, so this bar wasn't my favorite, but it was still a very good bar.
Sampled this product and found them in my local grocery store, they are delish warmed up!!  Only 140 calories perfect for an evening snack!!

I am NOT a fan of banana flavored ANYTHING, but that may be old news for me. Soft, chewy and very delicious I was left surprisingly satisfied after indulging in this cereal bar. No fake flavor or yucky after taste were to be found. Even my coworker loved it! Well, the small portion I was willing to share with her!
I liked this product but the flavor is kind of off. Thought it would taste more like cake. It's hood for something quick on the go.

When i first open a Quaker Soft Baked Banana Nut Bar i felt like i was at a bakery. It smelled fresh like homemade banana bread. From the first bite i felt like i was eating something completely unhealthy (but its completely good for you!). Quaker Soft Baked Banana Nut Bar's are sweet but not too sweet, chewy but the nuts add a nice amount of crunch, and the flavor is authentic to banana nut bread. best served heated in a toaster oven.

I love Quaker products but these soft bar is delicious! It's made of wholesome products with real bananas and almonds. You can taste the banana and shredded almonds are sprinkled on top. The nutrition isn't bad, it's actually quiet good. The soft bad makes a GREAT snack! I can't tell you how much I love these

Oh my goodness this was sooo yummy! I ate this cold but I am sure this would be even better warmed up. This is the perfect solution to those of us that may have been stuck in a morning breakfast rut. I will be buying more of these in the future!

column9: On the Run? Grab One and Go!
column10: The Bottom Line:Great packaging. Robust flavor. Correct portion size - substantial and filling without feeling overly-full. Another great product from Quaker.More Details:I LOVE the flavor of banana bread, and having a Quaker Soft Baked Bar is a great way for me to get that flavor without the work of baking or buying a loaf (that would undoubtedly go bad before I could finish it!) The bar has a very nutty texture - which I enjoyed. I am interested in trying other flavors to see if there are some that are less chunky. Tried half without warming and half with (just 10 seconds in the microwave)...definitely preferred the warmed-up bar! Tasted soft and more "homemade." Give it a whirl! Overall, this great breakfast when you're heading out the door or a filling snack to keep ya goin'. Next step for me: seek out other available flavors and Quaker products!

It always makes me happy when I find a snack that is both delicious and healthy! It's sweet and chewy but not loaded with sugar and carbs I really enjoyed this snack & will be repurchasing! Highly recommend!
Not my favorite. The almonds were too much, it was kind of gritty and not that great. I normally love any sort of tasty granola or oatmeal bar, but I was just not excited about this.
I got to try these for free from inluenster.com, and liked them! I tried the banana nut, and it was very moist and made for a great on-the-go breakfast!

I love these bars. They are great snacks for those who are on the go, or even a part of a breakfast while rushing out the door. For something so small they are extremely filling. So far I've tried the banana nut and pecan, and both are fantastic. I carry these to work almost every day for my mid morning snack. column9: Won Over A Non- Banana Bread Lover
column10: I received one of these to review as a member of Influenster. I was hesitant to try them because I actually detest  banana bread. I found myself famished one day and went ahead and took the plunge. I couldn't believe how delicious they were. Nothing like your standard banana nut bread. These bars are soft, chewy, yet have crunchy bits of nuts and crispy soy rice as well as oatmeal. I was really pleasantly surprised.  They make a perfect snack when you're trying to maintain your weight. Lots of protein at 6g per serving!

Best idea for a preggo person. I bought a box last week because I loved it so much. I keep one in my purse for when I am out and about to give myself a little boost through the day. It saved me after the gym yesterday.

From the second I opened the packaging, I knew I would enjoy eating this product. It had a very nice and sweet aroma. Although I was a little apprehensive about the nuts, the product tasted great. It had a nice mixture of the banana and nut flavors, plus the texture of the bread was very soft and chewy. This product was very delicious and would go great with milk.

I received a sample of this product from influenster's summer beauty voxbox. I don't usually eat much in the morning and I don't like to have anything too sweet. I've tried numerous granola bars and soft fruit flavored breads and by far this is the best I have tasted. It has the right amount of sweetness and the right amount of crunch. This was perfect with my morning green tea soy latte and mixed fruit. I didn't heat it up because I don't like my bread warm. I like to eat it just the way it is. It is very convenient and I bring it to work every morning and I snack on it as well. I bought a box of it the next day after eating the sample. The downside of it is the product is a bit pricey. Although, I find that the Quaker products are worth the price you will pay for.

I received this as a sample for testing from Influenster.  I LOVE it! It's so convenient.  You just pop it in the microwave for 10 seconds.  It's delicious, and I love the texture and moutfeel of the bar.  It doesn't taste and feel like a convenience bar.  The warmth of it after microwaving is just right.  I'm definitely going to buy more. =)

Its not too often that people take the time out to write a review about a healthy snack bar. This was so yummy and didnt taste bland at all. I was expecting it to taste weird, not be very filling but low and behold I was totally caught by surprise! Quaker has done it again, this was a snack for me on a summery hot day. It was very light, flavorful and I cant wait to purchase a whole box of these! Kids will love them too!!

column9: Good if you like banana nut bread!
column10: I received this product complimentary from Influenster and I didn't particularly like it. I think you would though if you're a fan of banana nut bread!
I received one of these from Influenster for review and it was delicious! I followed the warming instructions on the package and had it with coffee. I will definitely be buying more of these!
The banana nut bread bar was absolutely delicious. It was perfectly moist and yummy! It was full of flavor and I would love to eat this as a snack everyday.
I received this product by Influenster for testing and review. It was great and sweet it had all textures which was great! I would purchase!

I received this in my Summer Beauty VoxBox by Influenster. I've never heard of this product by Quaker and I'm glad I got to try it. It tastes so good! It's soft, chewy and the flavor is great. I've tried my fair share of breakfast bar and this one blows all of them out of the water. I plan to definitely buy more of these. They are fantastic!

I received the banana nut bread flavor free for review from Influenster.  I love oatmeal and I love banana nut bread so this seemed like something I would totally be into.  I saw on the package it said great warmed up so I tried that.  Oh boy it was delicious!  It was like having dessert for breakfast!  The flavors are terrific and while it's not exactly like eating a slice of banana bread it definitely has the banana bread taste in there.  This is a great little snack to carry with you for those I feel like having a snack moments.  It's also good to keep handy at work and avoid the dreaded vending machine.

column9: Yummy bars from Influenster Vox Box
column10: I received a sample of these in my Influenster Vox Box. Let me tell you, it was absolutely delicious. I just ordered some on here. They are healthy and delicious which is all I can ask for.

column9: Quaker Soft Baked Banana Nut Bar
column10: I surprisingly enjoyed this. Surprised because these kinds of bars are usually so sickly sweet and unnatural tasting. But the Quaker Soft Baked Banana Nut Bar was tasty and hearty and perfect for breakfast or a afternoon or late night snack. Looking forward to trying other flavors. I received a complimentary sample in my Summer Influenster Voxbox.
This is one of the healthiest and tastiest snacks I've ever had. It is a must buy for on-the-go snacking!

I received a sample of the Quaker Soft Baked Cereal Bar complimentary for testing purposes from Influenster. I warmed it in the microwave at work and it was delicious! It is a quick simple snack that is tasty and healthier for you to hold you over till your next meal. I will be buying a box the next time I am at the grocery store!

This is a great, yummy snack! It's healthy and easy to grab on the go AND still tastes great. I would recommend it to anyone, especially if you love Banana Nut Bread... it tastes just like the real thing.

I received one of these bars in my Influenster Summer VoxBox and it was a nice treat! The banana nut bread flavor was really good. At first I bit into it and realized I was suppose to put it in the microwave. After I did, I was surprised how good it made it. Looking forward to trying other flavors!

column9: Premium snack for those in a rush!
column10: I hate bananas, and because of that, I'm not a big fan of banana nut bread either. I didn't expect to like this much. I was so wrong! I loved it. It's good both cold and warmed up for 10 seconds, but I prefer it warm. My favorite part is the fact that it can be microwaved for 10 seconds in the plastic bag it came in, so you don't have to worry about finding another plate or something to heat it on. The "nuts" on top don't seem like nuts at all to me, but in a good way. The rest of the bar is very moist and soft, so the nuts add a nice contrast of crisp and crunchy texture. We often sacrifice taste and/or texture with snacks that are easy for on the go, but that isn't the case at all here. I'd recommend this to anyone who is looking for a convenient snack, or even the kind of person who is lazy in the kitchen but craves the taste of homemade banana nut bread. This will quench your craving in a big way.
this product was not only really tasty but its healthy at the same time ! a good treat for those who are trying to eat healthy but still have a sweet tooth to satisfy!
The banana nut bread was much better then i thought.  I would have never bought this in he store but trying it has changed my mind.

This was pretty tasty!! ... the first couple bites. Honestly, after about half the bar, it was difficult for me to finish. The taste was too overpowering after a while. I don't think I'll be purchasing again. :/
Tastes great on its own but oh my, its so amazing when it's warmed up.Whenever you're in the mood for a little banana nut bread, but don't have time to bake, this makes a great substitute
These bars are fantastic and nutritional as well.  I highly recommend them to everyone.  Great for on the go as well as when you need something sweet.
These were great, I wish I had more patience to actually wait for the microwave to heat it up a bit but room temp was pretty delish too - can't wait to try the other flavors!!
It is hard to believe that these have any nutritional value whatsoever as they REALLY DO taste like a banana nut muffin!  Will certainly be buying in the future!

I wasn't blown away by the flavor. I thought it would be more banana-y, but it wasn't. It was also super dry. Not like the cookies. THe cookies were moist. I don't know this was not for me. I don't think I will be buying this product. I received this for free in my Influenster Summer Beauty Vox Box.

This bar was soft and chewy. I did warm mine slightly in the microwave before eating. It had a very banana taste, but not your typical nut flavor as the undertone. It tasted more of almonds instead of pecans or walnuts.

This is pretty good for a bar. I love oats and oatmeal, so I knew I would like this. It's filling and kind of dense, but it doesn't taste like artificial flavors and sweeteners. I think it would be better warmed up, but I didn't think of that before I ate it.

Being someone who actually does NOT like bananas, this was actually quite delicious. Though this product, among a few others, was sent to me for testing purposes compliments of Influentser through their "Summer Beauty Voxbox" program, I would say that this would be a nice "pick me up" snack on the go. Moreover, though I did eat half of it, I ended up warming up the other half of the soft baked banana nut bread bar in the microwave (as directed) and it tasted good as well! With all that being said, is this my "Holy Grail" of snacks (I'm actually not much of a snack person to begin with) and I cannot live without it? No, BUT if I happen to see this in the stores and I wanted to pick up something, I would re-purchase this item due to it being a "healthier" option, a nice size (in my opinion) and the taste of it is quite pleasant.

It wasn't the best thing i've ever eaten, but it wasn't the worst either. I did warm it up before I ate it, and it just tasted like warm granola. The banana nut flavor isn't as strong as I'd have liked.

I got this amazing product from my Influencer Summer 2012 Beauty Vox Box and fell in love. Since trying this amazingly tasty snack by Quaker. I've bought 5 boxes and now I need to pick up another because we're all out. I recommend this product to anyone who like myself loves anything Banana Nut.

Oh my GOODNESS, this was DELICIOUS.  This snack bar is definitely going to be a staple in my pantry. It was soft and flavorful and satisfied my snack craving. It would be perfect for a quick energy boost at work, or just as a meal on the go in the morning! I will definitely be purchasing this item again.
I absolutely love this bar from Quaker, very convenient for on the go for breakfast or a quick snack, and most of all it's loaded with healthy nutrition to keep you moving throughout the day!

I thought this was just OK, not my favorite Quaker product and I don't know that I would actually buy it.  It does taste like banana bread a bit and it is soft, but it's also crunchy in some places.  Almost like it was overcooked.  I think I'll take nice warm homemade banana bread and if I need something quick I'll stick with quaker granola bars!

This bar was pretty good. I really taste homemade. I liked the nuts on the top added a little texture to the bite. I heated my bad up in the microwave for 10 seconds as recommended, tasted great. Good alternative if you dont like muffins which can be a little dry. This bar was nice and most. But if you dont like sweets in the morning..id steer clear.

These bars were so good, i honestly had real banana bread in the oven when i got my VoxBox in the mail, which is how i was given one of these to try :)anyway, i had real banana bread in the oven, and while it was baking i tried this bar, it was so soft, and chewy and full of banana flavor, and had a great nutty top! then later when i cut my own banana bread.. i was disappointed that it wasnt nearly as good as the Quaker bar was.. :(they are on the top of my next shopping list! :)
These taste great! Even better when heated in the microwave! You can really taste the banana and it contains a great crunch from the almonds on the top! My new goto breakfast bar!

column9: Quaker Soft Baked Banana Nut Bar
column10: These bars are amazing, and so healthy & filling, perfect for on the go, car trips, a day at the beach, at the office, they are satisfying, even better when heated up. I recommend heading out and buying a box or 2 of these. I received one for free in my [...] Summer beauty voxbox and after trying it, I myself went out and bought a couple boxes.

Quaker Soft Baked Cereal Bar, Banana Nut Bread, 7.4-Ounce Packages (Pack of 6)  I received a small sample of Quaker Soft Baked Cereal Bar, Banana Nut Bread from Influenster.com, a site that offers free samples to people who they believe influence others. Mind you, I won't write a positive review about something I don't like, wouldn't buy or wouldn't use. I love swag, but my opinions can't be bought. So, having written that I must say that I love this bar. I am not a fan of snack bars in general, preferring to get my nutrition and calories from other foods. But this little bar had me changing my tune. It tasted freshly baked, was moist and chewy - as promised - and didn't make me feel guilty about indulging. The only thing that I regret is the fact that the sample was so small. But I'll rectify that when I visit Amazon.com to buy a box. Or two. Or three. Yeah, they were that good.
I loved these little packages of Quaker Soft Baked Cereal bars. The bar is pretty big and satisfying, definitely filling.

I've these before in replacement of my traditional granola bar. I received in my summer voxbox from Influenster last week, but this time I warmed it up before devouring it. OH MY!!! It was incredible. I definitely recommend warming them up. This will be a great warm breakfast for fall. Banana nut bread goodness.
I got this as a part of my summer Voxbox and was very impressed. I makes for a great quick snack to toss in your bag and taste great. I thought it might be too dry at first but I ended up liking it!

I was able to try my quaker bar complimentary through Influenster, and was pleasantly surprised with how delicious it was. It was soft and flavorful! I did not try it hot, but I ended up buying a box and my friend heated it up and said it was even better. These bread bars are a perfect breakfast treat, I definitely recommend them!

Eat them cold or eat them hot just remember to take them on the go! I have ate them both ways and they are delicious! Since I first tried the Banana Nut Bread flavor I have went through 4 boxes. (In less than a month!) They are a healthy snack ranking in at only 140 calories with 5 grams of fiber and 6 grams of protein. They are covered in almonds with a crunchy texture and smell so delightful. I love them so much! They are my new favorite treat! Trust me, go buy yourself a box and give them a try!
I am in love with these Banana Nut Bread bars. I like them better cold, but they are good warmed up too. Try 'em out. You'll love them too. :)

I really enjoyed my Quaker Oak Banana Nut Bread Bar. I ate it when I was feeling quite famished before setting up my classroom for the new school year. The bar tasted just like banana nut bread. It had the right taste and was just the right size. Yummlicious

I didn't have a chance to try this warmed up but I still loved it straight out of the package. This bar was soft and moist and had great texture. It didn't seem like I was just eating some prepackaged Quaker bar, it seemed like I was eating something fresh from a bakery or cafe. I will def be repurchasing and trying this out warmed up.

I got to try these through influenster and immediately went out and bought several more boxes!! I am not normally one that likes healthy snacks, but these are so delicious and full of natural ingrediaents and flavor. These remind me of my grandfathers homemade banna nut pancakes he makes! :) I Loved these and will continue to buy them for school snacks and on the go or just because!!

I was so happy to get to try out this bar free through the Influenster Voxbox I got! I am definitely one of those people that goes to any type of snack bar when feeling a little empty in the stomach. My favorite brand of bars to purchase have always been Quaker so I was pleased to get to try out something new!My number one type of bars to have are always ones that are along the lines of granola, oats, nuts and such. However, I was so excited to see something that's like a compacted baked good! The flavor I got was of course Banana Nut Bread and I have never tried actual Banana bread but I liked this bar! I love how it included almonds on the top because like I said, I enjoy that! This bar was very soft and chewy which is definitely something I look for but it also had some crunchiness which I also like - it was all just very balanced! I'm not a huge fan of bananas necessarily but I think this tasted great! You definitely get an after taste hint of banana but it all just works really well. This is definitely like having Grandma's goodies on the go!Overall, I think these would be amazing as a quick breakfast or snack any day! This bar was great (Quaker never fails to please) and I will definitely be trying out some other baked bars they have!

i received a bar in my influenster summer voxbox for review purposes and i liked it a lot!most likely, i'll purchase a box of these myself... and perhaps try a few other flavors..one busy day at work, i didn't have time to stop for lunch and this bar gave me the energy to continue on with my day. luckily i had stowed the bar i received from influenster in my purse the day i got my voxbox!

I received a bar in my Influenster voxbox for review and I just fell in love with them.  I absolutely adore these !!!!  I gave a little piece to every one in my family to try out and they all loved them as well so when I found them at Target, I bought two boxes.  These bars have a really nice and big banana nut taste, they're quite filling and even more delicious when warmed up a bit.  I'm seriously stocking up on these so I can put them in my kids' lunch boxes when school starts !
I received this in my influenster beauty vox box and didnt expect it to be very good. i was very pleasantly surprised. woul definitely buy for myself!
I like to pop them in the microwave for a few seconds and eat them when they are warm. They taste like homemade!

I received a sample bar in my Influenster VoxBox. Soooo delicious! I absolutely love these! No weird artificial banana flavor taste, just banana nut bread goodness. Makes a perfect breakfast on the go! Can't wait to buy a box so I can try these warmed up!

I received a banana bread bar for review with influenster.com's summer beauty voxbox program. This bar tastes so delicious! I went out the next day and bought a box. not to mention, it's good for you!

column9: Finally a bar that tastes good
column10: I received one of these banana nut bars in my Influenster box and all I can say is yummy. So many bars are so hard they break your teeth, or they taste kind of like cardboard with a grainy texture. These soft bars are really something I could get used to. Too bad there was only one in the box because my husband snagged more than half of it. I have not found it on the shelf yet, but hope to soon.

I loved these bars. I heated one up and oh my god it was so good. It comes in very handy when you don't have time to get breakfast before work or school. Just pop it in the microwave for a few seconds and Wah-Lah! Breakfast is ready.I definitely recommend this.
I found this snack to be tasty, healthy and satisfying! When I microwaved it, it was delicious.  Also very convenient for snacking on go.

column9: Went Out and Purchased Right Away
column10: I received a sample of this in my Influenster box. I ate it right away and knew that I had to buy a box which I did just the other day. My mom tried a bite, and she loved them too! They really do taste like banana nut bread but lighter and less messy. Love these for a quick breakfast!

column9: Quaker makes the best Banana Nut Bread
column10: I received a single Banana Nut bread in my summer voxbox from influenster and it was the first thing I tried, I love it,the taste is great. I eat it after a workout instead of a smoothie, or I have it for breakfast with my coffee. It's also great as a snack for in between meals. I'm going definitely purchase these in the future. I love Quaker for many years so this is just another awesome product to add to my shopping list.

I like these as a quick snack at work.  I just pop them in the microwave to warm them up, and munch away.  It's nice to have the banana bread taste without having to bake any.  I also like that these have some fiber in them to keep things moving along ;)

column9: Theres a party in my tummy, so yummy so yummy
column10: These are so delicious. They burst with flavour in your mouth! I cant even begin to tell you how much i love these. They are sweet but not too sweet. They taste like a home made confection but are so much more healthy! Even my two year old son loves there. They are perfect when you are on the go, or even if you want a treat with your morning coffee. You cant go wrong with these.

To be honest I was never a big fan of quaker but when i tried this banana nut bread i completely had a different intake to quaker. i love this bread treat especially when i pop it in the microwave to warm it up. its perfect for a in between meal to satisfy your hunger.
Very yummy! Just the right amount of moisture & the taste is absolutely delicious. Great for a snack on the go or for a very quick breakfast. Quite filling for a bar.

column9: Quaker Soft Baked Banana Nut Ba
column10: This is light, tasty, healthy snack. I loved it and it really helped with curving my hunger. I love the texture, aroma, and taste. Thanks!
So yummy. I got bought a box just to try them from the microwave. Great snack with a glass milk. Travels very well, so I keep a bar in my bag. Worth the buy!

column9: Quaker Soft Baked Cereal Banana Nut Bread
column10: I got my Influenster VoxBox with awesome products inside.  One of the products inside was the Quaker Oaks Soft Banana Nut Bar. I thoroughly enjoyed this bar.  It is a great snack that one can have enjoy eating without the worry of it being unhealthy.  I would definitely purchase them.

I love this quaker oatmeal bar because you can heat it up or eat it right out of the package. It was so delicious that I even picked up a box at the store the next week at the grocery store and my husband has been taking them for breakfast every day and eating them on the way to work. thank you!

If you like banana bread, then you will love this bar! It's pretty soft and chewy, with lots of flavoring. It is a little too sweet for my liking (but then again I am not a big fan of banana nut anything in general). The nuts don't overpower the bar taste, which is good! The price is a little high but I do think you get what you pay for - especially since it is a very healthy product.

I received the Quaker Soft Baked Banana Nut bread compliments of Influenster.  Wow!  This bread is amazingly good, soft, chewy, delectable -- a real morning treat!!  It also contains 5g of fiber content -- that is 20% of the RDA of fiber!!  Most people don't get the recommended 25-30g of fiber per day, so this is an excellent way to increase your fiber intake easily because it tastes so good!

These bars are so delicious! I really recommend heating them up, as suggested on the packaging. It tastes like warm banana bread straight out of the oven! Yum! I can't wait to eat these as a nice hot breakfast on a cold winter morning.
Quaker Soft Baked Bars have quickly become my favorite morning snack.  The little bars are nutritious and leave me feeling full until lunch time.  The Pecan Bread flavor is also worth a try.

I just LOVE LOVE LOVE LOVE this banana nut soft baked breads! I eat this stuff on my 10 minute break and it's just awesome. I've already bought two boxes of it and my bf says I'm too gaga about them! So go figureee !

column9: Delicious and not bad for my waist line!
column10: These breakfast bars are so yummy!  The Banana Nut Bread tastes just like a banana nut muffing, minus a ton of calories and fat!  These are great warmed up in the microwave for breakfast or for a quick afternoon snack.  Will definitely keep buying these.

I know very few people who dislike banana nut bread. I also know very few people who can make a really good banana nut bread. One problem I do have with banana nut bread is self control. This bar is a fix for all those things. All of the taste and enjoyment of banana nut bread in a perfect portion, packaged perfectly for an on-the-go snack.Trick! Warm it up in the microwave for 10-12 seconds (13 or more and you will burn yourself terribly) and this transforms from a simple snack to a wonderful, healthy desert.

I tried Quaker's Soft Baked Bar in Banana Nut Bread from my Summer Beauty VoxBox by Influenster for breakfast.  I thought it was okay tasting, it wasn't that sweet. It also looked different compared to the official picture. Maybe it was just the one I received that looked like that. The one thing I forgot to do, however, was to warm it up. It probably would have tasted better if I did. It's okay for whenever you're in too much of a hurry to stop for a snack. It's small enough too.

column9: Pleasantly Surprised By This Delicious Snack
column10: I received a Quaker Banana Nut Bread Soft Baked Bar in my Summer Influenster Vox Box for product testing purposes.  I received the bar free to try, and am not getting paid for my review.I did not have high expectations of this snack because I generally don't like banana flavoring and most of the time when I try a pre-packaged bar or cookie type snack I find it to have an undesireable texture, usually too soft with a greasy aftertaste.  But I do like nuts and this snack seemed to have an abundance of them.  First, I have to say that this is a perfect sized snack for on the go.  It can be eaten either straight out of the package and cold, or can be warmed up.  I had mine straight out of the package.  What I thought upon first bite was that this bar has a really nice texture.  It was not soft and soggy like I expected.  It had a crunch to it, and was just the right amount of firmness.  The taste was very nutty, with the banana flavoring present and you could also taste the oats in there as well.  The banana taste was not overpowering, which was what I feared.  I think the bar also had just the right amount of sweetness.  It wasn't too rich or too bland.  I knew after my third bite I'd be looking for these in the store.  I'm happy to say this snack did not leave the greasy feeling in my mouth when I was finished eating it.Each bar has 140 calories, and while I would prefer it to be a little lower, it does have 5g of dietary fiber and 50g of protein which I feel makes up for it.  I would say this is a nutritious snack that I will personally enjoy in the morning for breakfast, during the day while on the go (this is perfect for carrying around in your purse or even out in your car because heat won't melt the bar, it may even taste better heated up), and I think it will be a great snack to have at bedtime as well.  I'm planning on trying the other flavor of Cinnamon Pecan Bread after I finish the box of Banana Nut Bread flavor I just bought at the grocery store.  And I have yet to try this Banana Nut Bread flavor warmed, which I look forward to.  I think many people will enjoy this snack and should definitely give it a try.Thank you Influenster and Quaker for sending me this tasty snack to try.  I'm a fan now!

okay so this one I did not care for. I HATE packaged banana flavor so this is actually still sitting around with an experation date of Oct 29th.... seems like it can sit for a good while. Not sure how I like that but I'm just weird about food like that.

Received this complimentary by Influenster for testing purposes! I must say, I LOVED it. I am a picky eater so I never try out new food. I must admit, I was hesitant at first. However, after that first bite, I do not regret opening this package at all! :D It was crunchy and the taste was amazing. On top of that, it's healthy. I recommend this 100%

column9: Quaker Soft Baked Banana Nut Bar
column10: Muffins with out the mess! Easy portable on the go snack!Kids love them,and adults do too! Quaker is a brand you can trust.

I didn't love this as much as i had wanted to. The box said that they use actual banana but it tasted very fake and overpowering to me...i don't know, maybe the bananas used to make the bar that I ate were a little over ripe. I liked the idea, and i bet some of their other flavors would be better.
Very good. Tastes best when microwaved for 10 seconds as directed on the package. I trust the Quaker brand, and this product does not disappoint!

I got this in my influenster box and it tastes really good.  I like that it is soft and good to take to school when I have classes all day.  It also taste good when you warm it up a little =).  A great snack.
I hike a great deal, and this is the perfect snack to take on long hikes.  This item can fit neatly into a backpack, or a purse.

Oh...one huge word for these YUM!  I was surprised at how good this tasted. I got a free sample of these to try.  I've always liked and trusted Quaker products, but still was wondering how good a soft baked bar would taste in a wrapper.  We tried it heated up and cold.  Heated was better, but eating it cold was great also.  For those watching calories..the count is not bad at all (or so I think in my opinion).  The first time we went grocery shopping after trying this we bought a box of these and a box of their other flavor Cinnamon Pecan Bread.  Both are very tasty.  Nice little treat to keep in your pocketbook or pack in the kids lunch kits.
I really enjoyed this bar. I thought it was really delicious and defiantly will be getting more. I wasn't sure if I would like it but I absolutely love it. I would defiantly recommend this to others.

These taste great and are the perfect portion size for children and adults alike! The kids love them and I keep some in my purse at all times for snacking on the go! Much better than sugary snacks! Highly recommended.

column9: Nice concept, But I don't like the taste
column10: This is a nice concept because it is great for taking on-the-go, but I was not a huge fan of the banana taste. If you like bananas you will probably like this though

column9: Quaker Soft Baked Cereal Bar - banana nut bread
column10: This bar was pretty tasty! I would like to try some different flavors , but all in all it wasn't bad at all. Probably would have been better heated up a little.

I got a sample of this in my Summer VoxBox and it was love at first taste!!!Try them warmed up a bit with a nice cold glass of Almond milk and you are in heaven!I will definitely buy these again and again!

I got a sample of this in my Influenster Summer VoxBox and I thought that it was ok. This bar should definitely be microwaved! It tastes way better warm, than it does when it is cold. I wish that quaker would have upped the amount of spices in the bar because I thought that it was a little bland.

I got a sample of this in my Summer VoxBox and fell immediately in love with it! The wrapper suggested heating the in microwave for 10 seconds and let me tell you, it was fantastic!! Will definitely be buying these on a regular basis!

After receiving this in an influnster program my 2 year old decided he was going to sneak it as a snack. Thinking it was something else. But he loved it.  I would highly recommend these. Great for on the go or just as a healthier snack choice

Quaker's soft baked Banana Nut bread is delicious! Gave it a 10sec spin in the microwave and enjoyed an extremely tasty, warm treat to start the day. Banana nut bread is a personal fav dessert for me, but generally high sugar/calorie--this bar has a good weight and taste for just 140 calories, 5g of fiber, and 6g of protein. This turned out to be a surprisingly tasty AND healthy breakfast or snack option. Definitely going to pick up another box or two on my grocery run this week.

I received a sample through my summer beauty voxbox I got from influenster. Well, let me say that it was so delicious that we went and bought two boxes and it and we've already ate all of them in less than a week!

These are so yummy. It's like fresh banana nut bread, only it doesn't fall apart. I would recommend these to anyone. The Quaker Soft Baked Cereal Bar, Banana Nut Bread is a great grab and go breakfast.

column9: The BEST Yerba Mate Hands Down
column10: There is no better Yerba Mate on the market. I have tried hundreds of brands and the quality just does not compare to Guayaki. I really like how they include stems with leaf. Mate is meant to be drunk this way and the stems add a significant amount of theophylline and theobromine and also add to the sweet and nutty flavor notes not found in other Mate's. I also appreciate that Guayaki uses only shade grown Mate - as it is meant to be. Sun grown mate lacks body and benefits.I really like the companies sustainable business model. The company is true blue when it comes to their mission. Fairly traded products that allow the indigenous people to receive a fair wage for their work. Mate is actually not tea but a tea-like beverage originating from Argentina and Uruguay, and primarily consumed in those countries as well as in Paraguay and southern Brazil; brewed from the dried leaves and stemlets of the perennial Yerba Mate tree. Its name derives from the quichua word "mati" designating the gourd in which it is traditionally served.  On average, 300,000 tons of Mate are produced each year.In its consistency similar to green tea, mate has a distinctive, full, bittersweet flavor with a note of alfalfa, resembling that of tea but milder. Of the 196 volatile chemical compounds contained in Yerba Mate, 144 are also contained in tea.  Knowing its manifold health benefits - among the plant's ingredients are the alkaloids xanthine, theophylline and theobromine as well as vitamins C, E, several B vitamins and numerous minerals - the South American Guarani Indians have traditionally used the plant for medicinal purposes, inter alia as a stimulant to the central nervous system, to promote mental, physical and cardiovascular activity, enhance resistance to fatigue, reduce fever, mitigate thirst and hunger, decrease blood pressure, and as a diuretic, laxative, purgative, sudorific, and antirheumatic.Legend has it that knowledge of the infusion's powers was first imparted to a young Guarani woman and her father by a mysterious shaman, rewarding the woman's faithfulness in staying with her exhausted father while her tribe continued their search for arable land.  In recent years, mate has become a cultural phenomenon throughout large parts of South America, and it is now gaining increased popularity in Northern America and Europe as well.  In South America, sharing mate from the same container and the same straw (bombilla) is a symbol of closeness and friendship, both in a family and in other social contexts.

I have 2 trays and could easily use 2-4 more to freeze the batches I make.  It's annoying to have to keep rotating the food to try to freeze it before it goes bad.

We have 6 of these trays in various colors.  My husband and I both work and make our daughter's baby food instead of buying jars.  We make large batches on the weekends and having multiple trays allows us to make a variety of foods that we can then combine when defrosted during the week.  I love that they stack neatly in the freezer, have a lid (which a lot of other baby food trays don't have), and the frozen portions pop out easily.  Another reviewer wrote they use it as a serving tray for baby instead of many bowls--I will most certainly try that when baby is ready to feed herself.As a tip...the lid isn't completely airtight (as other mentioned) so I wouldn't recommend leaving the food in the tray until you're ready to serve.  We pop food portions out after freezing over night and store in labeled bags.  This is very handy for grabbing foods quickly.

I have several types of baby food molds and this is my favorite. It is soft and rubbery so I am able to push up from the bottom of the mold to remove the food. I don't like having to run hot water over the back, like I have to with my other molds, because I don't like tap water getting on the food. (I'm a little obsessive, compulsive) Just make sure not to fill the molds all the way to the top because the food expands and then you'll have food on the lid. Makes for easier cleaning if you don't get food on the lid.

I am a total sucker for kitchen gadgets, but this just goes too far. The price is insane for what is essentially a glorified ice cube tray, which does not work as well as your basic ice cube tray. It's difficult to get the cubes out of this tray, it has an odd shape that wastes space in your freezer, and it makes 2 ounce servings, which are fine if you know you want 2 ounces, but I prefer to make 1 ounce sizes so that I can combine different flavors, or make just 1 (or 3) ounces if my baby is not as hungry and I don't want any waste. The only reason I gave it any stars at all is because of the lid - that IS handy, I must admit. But you can buy ice cube trays with lids too, that will actually fit in your freezer and stack well. TOTAL WASTE OF MONEY. Okay, it IS cute. I wish it wasn't so cute...

column9: great ice cubes for baby food
column10: I bought one of each color, blue, orange and green. I love this cubes. They are 2.5 oz, perfect portions for my baby. Now that he's eating more, for example at lunch, I thaw 2 cubes for his entree (salty) and one for desert (fruit). Once the cubes are frozen it is very easy to pop them out and store them in a zip-lock bag, they are also very easy o clean. I highly recommend this product.

column9: Perfect storage for homemade baby food
column10: This is the perfect storage for the baby food I make at home.  I am a working mom, so time is not on my side when it comes to doing things for my son.  But, it's important for me to make him healthy homemade meals and this container helps me by allowing me to make large batches of food on the weekends and fill them up for the freezer. I have 2 of these storage containers that are kept in the freezer with the food I prepare on the weekends.  Each night, I pull out my son's food for the following day and allow it to thaw in the fridge.  The flexible material makes it really easy to pop out one portion at a time.  Highly recommend this food storage.

I have used this a couple times when making my own baby food and I love it.  It's really easy to freeze food in.  When the baby food is frozen you just run hot water on the back and pop out the food.  It washes up nicely in the dishwasher.  I think the ammount of food that it holds is good too.  I would highly recommend this product.

I received this freezer tray along with the Beaba foodmaker and spoons from my in-laws.  I am totally told on all Beaba products due to the high quality and great designs.  The food pops out easily and leaves no waste behind.

column9: One of my favorite baby products
column10: The Beaba Multiportion Freezer Tray is one of our favorite baby products.  We use a steamer and a food processor to make baby food.  We put the food in one of these freezer trays, freeze for a couple of hours, and then pop the food out and store it in the freezer in Ziplock bags, labeled with the type of food and the date.I saw a previous comment that the serving sizes were too large.  Um, no they are not.  If you want less - don't fill the cup all the way.  Crazy how that works!  I fill the cups to the top, and my son eats almost the entire serving.  I am glad that the cups are as big as they are.Clean up is a breeze - we don't put it in the dishwasher, we just run it under hot water.To prepare the frozen cubes, I pop them in the microwave for 15 seconds - then stir.  Another 15 seconds, and another stir.  Sometimes, another 10 seconds if I want to serve it warm.Great product for those who want to make cooking their own baby food even easier.

Such a perfect companion to the Babycook! I freeze in this and once the food is frozen, I take them out and put in a labeled ziploc because the lid doesn't quite seal tight enough for my comfort but would definitely purchase again!

I bought this product because I needed freezer trays and was trying to use up the remainder of a gift card I had. Im glad that I had the gift card to go towards this product because I know that it is very expensive. here are the reasons that I enjoy this product:1) I use it often, every 3-6 days. If I think about it like that then I feel like Im really getting my moneys worth2) The silicone makes it not only easy to clean and durable but a breeze to pop food out without having to worry about breaking the device3) I like that it has a lid, and for the most part I really feel like they did the best that they could to make the lid fit on properly and snuggly4) The size of the cubes are perfect for my needs. they are a good helping size and I never need to feed my baby anymore at one sitting. I dont waste a lot of food, if any, and my baby doesnt leave wanting moresuggestions to this product and its use:1) I have a small freezer, its not standard size and therefore things freezer burn in my freezer at double the rate. Due to this issue that has nothing to do with the product, I overfill these cubes so that the top is touching the lid and no freezer burn is able to form before I can transfer them over into a freezer bag2) because the cubes are bigger I thaw them out the night before in my refridgerator so that by midday they are thawed all the way through and i can easy heat the food evenly from there.I gave this a four instead of five stars simply because they could have devised a snap lock lid system for the money they are charging and made this an overall outstanding item and also because the price point is a little high, Im sure that its not even close to that much money to put together some silicone! i think baby items should be reasonably priced so that even those that are a little less fortunate can enjoy quality baby products such as a way to freeze food.

I got these as gifts and absolutely love them. Yes, you can use ice cube trays to freeze baby food & other things but these are so much more convenient for me since they're = a jar of baby food, plus the reason I really love them is that I have continued to use them all the time after we were done with purees. I have 19 month old twins & made all their purees & continue to make a lot of their food and freeze things ahead for easy defrost & prep at the end of my work day when we get home & they're starving.  I'm not sure why another person was trying to scoop the portions out with a spoon (?) but all you have to do is run hot water over the back side for about 30 sec and everything pops out no problem. I have the same issue w/ ice cube trays so I don't really understand the issue others have reported.So, in addition to purees, I have frozen things like the following in these to = 1/2 or full portion sizes for my kids (depending on how old they were, obviously I need to defrost more of them as they get older): risottos, ground beef/turkey, small meatballs & sauce, mac & cheese, small portions of elbow macaroni (when they were younger & couldn't eat as much), and anything else really that can be smooshed into the container. These are things that would not work in an ice cube tray & freezing in a million containers or one big one is not practical, at least for me.It's too bad they're not a little more affordable but I do think they're great.

column9: Gets the job done but not a good value
column10: My parents bought two of these trays as a Christmas gift for me since I make much of our daughter's baby food.Pros:~ Easy to fill~ Easy to pop cubes outCons:~ Awkward, bulky shape~ Large cube size (our mostly-breastfed 7 month old eats at most 1.5-2 oz of food right now)~ Extremely overpriced compared to alternativesI purchased the Annabel Karmel Freeze Cube Tray and not only is it just as easy to use as the Beaba freezer trays, but the cubes are a bit smaller and the tray itself is more compact.  It's also less than half the price, which to me is the most important aspect.  The Beaba trays work fine for their intended purpose but are extremely over-priced.

I love this product! I have several of these that I got for my daughter. She makes her own baby food for our grandchildren. But I have some as well. When the kids come to our home, we keep snacks, fruit, and dry cereal pieces in the cups for the children to enjoy.During the summer we use this to make frozen fruit or yogurt pops. It travels well and cleans up easily. Just an excellent item that I wish had been around when I was a young mom.

I have two.  I like this product for a few reasons and dislike it for only one reason.  This is a good product because it gives you perfect 2oz portions.  It is easy to clean and store and fit in the freezer.  The only down side is that the plastic scent is a bit strong and sometimes the food scent stays on it even after I wash it in the dishwasher.  Maybe it is because I do not take them out once they freeze and place them in ziplock bags.  I just leave the food in and take 1 or 2 out at a time.  I still make and store my little one her apple sauce even though she is a finger food baby and not a puree baby anymore.  I still use this product and recommend it.

column9: Used it twice, won't use it again
column10: This tray is huge, bulky, and awkward in the freezer.  It makes 2 oz portions, which are fine if you want to feed your baby 2 ounces of the same food, but I like to combine one ounce of this with one ounce of that.  Also, the cubes are fairly impossible to pop out of the tray.  You can run it under hot water as other users have done, but that makes a big wet avocado-ey mess.  I prefer to use regular ice cube trays with some saran wrap on top!

column9: Great little freezer tray for baby food
column10: The Beaba freezer tray is flexible and very easy to clean. It has seven slots which is a good amount of storage for a week worth of 2oz puree portions. I make a lot of food for my 9 month old boy and I like to use this tray to store various fruit purees. The top closes securely and feels like it wouldn't come off if dropped.

I was just making my 7 month old son some brocolli baby food when I realized I hadn't written a review for the Beaba Multiportion Freezer Tray.  I have two of them and I absolutely love them.  I make the baby food then freeze it.  If I have too much food and not enough tray space, I freeze some and then pop them out and put them in another tubberware container.  Whenever it is time for him to eat.  I pop one out, put it in the microwave for 30 seconds and we are good to go.  I even freeze my homemade rice cereal which makes it so much easier.  I would recommend this product because it is easy and cleans really well.

We bought two from Williams Sonoma.  I loved them so much that when I saw them listed on Amazon, I bought another one.  They are perfect for making baby food and for freezing small portions of often used items like tomato paste.  I also froze 1 Tbsp portions to use when I cook.  Love this product!
if you freez baby food this is for you!!! very easy to get it out!!!! Gets the job done. Be careful washing it in the dishwasher the plastic top can change its form and after does not cover well.

I like this item because it enables you to freeze baby food in larger portions than ice-cube trays, which is a good thing if your baby is a little pig like mine is.  My biggest complaint is that it is difficult to get the frozen items out of the tray once they are done.  I usually have to run it under hot water for a few minutes, which is not a big deal but just one more step.  Also, the price is very high for what this is.  I could use a second one but at this price I'll make due with the one I've got.

column9: Perfect storage for homemade baby food
column10: This is the perfect storage for the baby food I make at home. I am a working mom, so time is not on my side when it comes to doing things for my son. But, it's important for me to make him healthy homemade meals and this container helps me by allowing me to make large batches of food on the weekends and fill them up for the freezer. I have 2 of these storage containers that are kept in the freezer with the food I prepare on the weekends. Each night, I pull out my son's food for the following day and allow it to thaw in the fridge. The flexible material makes it really easy to pop out one portion at a time. Highly recommend this food storage.
I love this product! I make all my own baby food and this makes the perfect portion size.  A bit pricy but worth it.

This is the second Beaba freezer tray that we've purchased, and still use both.  We bought the second tray so that we can make and freeze more baby food at a time.  The tray makes perfect-sized serving portions, and clean-up is very easy.  We run hot water over the back of each cup for one or two seconds, and the frozen food pops right out.  We store the individual servings in ziplock sandwich bags, makes it really easy to grab his food for the day and go.

I've been making food for my 7.5 month daugher. so far, I haven't made enough bulk to fill up this food saver. And when she does eat, the amounts she's eating wouldn't even be half of the little serving size that is in this container. I cna't wait to use it when she's a bit older and eating more
Love this freezer tray.  I set it on the counter for approx. 2 minutes and then can easily pop out whatever food I have frozen in the cups.  I love that it comes with its own lid.

This is a nice freezer tray. The base is so supple; it's really easy to pop the food out. The size is a little large for what I need at the moment. My baby is 6 months old and only eats the ice-cube size portions right now, but I can see that the larger size of this Beaba tray will come in handy as my baby grows.

column9: Not the best and does take up room.
column10: My daughter wanted 3 of these so she could make my 1st grandbaby her food. I bought them and then 3 boxes of the One Step reusable stackable Fresh and Freeze as i thought the latter would be better.These are hard to remove when frozen and you end up touching the other sections and contaminating them. You have to run hot water over the section you want to remove. You cannot see thru the lid if you put different food in a container.These are way too expensive when you can buy the other Fresh and Freeze by One Step Ahead that can go from the freezer, microwave then the dishwasher.I do not recommend wasting your $$$ when yoy can have the same results with ice cube trays covered to freeze than placing them in baggies. Idea is to make the food freeze it and leave it until ready to use:)

These freezer trays are expensive, but worth the money without a doubt.  They are the perfect size for freezing individual baby food portions, and the frozen food pops out easily when you want to transfer it to ziplock bags.  Great product!

The Beaba Multiportion Freezer Tray is perfect for freezing baby food.  I made my own baby food for my two children, and this is a simple way of getting it done quick and easy.  Plus, it is easy to push the frozen portions out after freezing because the tray is flexible.
