Having said that, however, the bars themselves are actually very good and I will purchase them again, just not through Amazon.

I bought these bars to use as a good snack to help me loose weight. With chocolate and peanut butter, 2 of my favorites, how could I loose? I was very disappointed in the taste and texture. The chocolate tasted and felt like wax and the bar itself had the texture of sawdust with hardly any peanut butter taste. These bars are for those who want to torture themselves into loosing weight.

column9: OK, but no replacement for Clif
column10: I decided to try these when Clif peanut butter bars and Zbars were unavailable. The chocolate coating on the thinkThin bar makes it seem too much like a candy bar -- and it's messy if the temperature goes up at all. The flavor's o.k., but the texture of the inside stuff is mushy.  I'll be glad to have Clif back in a few months.
Great taste , even for a guy who doesn't like peanut butter. This could be the perfect protein bar .
I love think thin bars and eat them almost daily. These bars had arrived in poor condition, very stale and old tasting, with a chalky substance on the outside. Would not buy again

column9: WOW! no sugar added + high protein + yummy = PERFECT BAR!
column10: I had gastric bypass recently and have been searching for 8 months for a low/no sugar added protein bar that wasn't loaded in fat - it is nearly impossible, which shocked me as they are supposed to be healthy snack items (or so I thought).  I wasted ungodly amounts of money on dozens of brands and flavors.  FINALLY I found ThinkThin bars!  Added bonus = they are really delicious - one of best tasting protein bars I have tried, especially the chunky peanut butter flavor.  The chocolate ones are good too if you are a chocoholic (which I am not so they are too sweet for me). They also have mini bars, of which I have only tried the cookie dough - it too is very sweet and perfect size for a snack. I recommend ThinkThin products with every thread of my being and with all my taste buds this is an A++ bar!

These bars are huge, with good texture and very filling. The taste is mediocre (a bit fake). Overall, they'd be fine if it weren't for all the sugar alcohols.... all ELEVEN grams of them. That much maltitol tends to mess with digestion. I'd go with a different bar, if it's going to be a regular in your diet.

I am very concerned that this product does not state anywhere whether the soy used in it (couple of ingredients are derived from soy) is GMO free? From my understanding, over 80% of soy and corn seeds is genetically modified, so chances are that soy from this product is modified which would NOT make it a healthy product at all!

I love think thin bars, but these were old and the chocolate had bloomed when I received these. Go to the store and buy them there. They cost a little more that way, but it's better than eating crumbly old bars.
I eat these all the time as a meal replacement/snack. They're pretty good - I enjoy the taste and you can't beat the convenience. I'd recommend them to people.

I have subscribed to Amazon for these bars & am so glad I did. I have seen them in Trader Joes for a whole lot more. Buying in bulk, I have plenty on hand for a quick protein snack. Always fresh & on time. I think they taste pretty good. It's my sugar free candy bar replacement. I eat one when I'm craving a chocolatey sweet.
I bought this product as it was sugar free, not like all the other bars out there. It taste great and I keep one in my purse at all times. I will be buying more.
I eat one of these for lunch every day. They do a better job of satisfying my appetite than Lean Cuisines or similar products. Tastes great compared to other (higher calorie) protein bars.

Ok Protein bars are gross.  Especially for someone who really doesn't like chocolate as much as the rest of the world. I'd eat a snickers bar, peanut butter cup and a twix but that's pretty much it.  Chocolate cake yuck. Ice cream.  Yuck.  So it was real tough for me to find a tasty protein bar cause they love covering them in chocolate (though I have found some other flavors such as this) but they aren't in large quantity.  SO I read the description and it said chunky peanut butter.  The coating is coca which doesn't takes like the dark chocolate coating i've found everywhere else.  These bars are tasty.  OMG.  Almost like a recies peanut butter cup but a little thicker.  I could eat these all day long and are perfect!

These chunky peanut butter protein bars are pretty tasty. The consistency is good, chewy, but not overly so. I did expect more peanut chunks, though. They are very filling, and serve well as a lunch replacement.

I got these bars in the peanut butter flavor because they were cheaper than what I could buy them for in the store.  Not really low fat but has a good protein content.  Seems to fill you up for a few hours and it's healthier than a candy bar.

I decided to give these a try after being practically addicted to the peanut butter clif builder bars - I wanted to see if I like something else more ... and it turns out I was extremely disappointed with the taste of these bars.  Actually, not only was the taste sub-par, but I did NOT like the consistency either when compared to the more firm clif builder bars.  Won't be buying these again.

I was recently on the LA Weight Loss plan and was hooked on their "protein" bars--that is, until I found out how much sugar they contained, and what little protein they actually had.  No wonder I had reached a plateau.  When I eat one of these a day, I don't crave and have easily dropped 10 pounds.  After 1 box, you'll be hooked too.  They taste great and are extremely satisfying. The price is actually comparable to other bars on the market.
I liked it at first, then started to taste like cardboard.  I like the dark chocolate better, but Atkins Advantage chocolate chip oatmeal is best.
I just opened my latest order and it appears the recipe has changed.  I can't taste the peanut butter and it tastes to sweet.

I bought these to help as I am on the go all the time, and wanted a healthier alternative to keep me away from fast food.  I like the taste of these, and they keep me full.  The Peanut Butter taste is good and rich, no complaints from me on that.  Also love the fact that they are Gluten free as I think I do have a tolerance to Gluten products  haven't had the time to get tested yetI will order these again, they are very yummy for being on the go and helping me stay on a good eating path

I have had many protein bars before and after working out.  I have also recently taken a traveling job and you never know if there will be a descent place to eat.  With these bars you won't go hungry.  Reasonably priced and very good taste, compared to everything else I have had.  High on protein and about as low as you will get in calories and sugar.

These bars pack 20 grams of protien and are actually tasty.  Beware: Not all the bars have so much protien.  Check the labels.  I eat this for lunch with a greek yogurt and some fruit and it's very filling and keeps me going til dinner.

column9: thinkThin® Protein Bars are too Delicious to be so Healthy!
column10: You have got to try thinkThin® Chunky Peanut Butter Protein Bars.  I think these bars are a great substitute for Reese's peanut butter and chocolate bars, but, without the guilt!!  When I want to snack between meals during a busy week or after a workout, eating these protein bars is a nutritious way to tide me over until my meal.  When I'm not so hungry, I can actually think of cooking a healthy meal instead of buying fast food because I'm starving.  Buying thinkThin® Chunky Peanut Butter Protein Bars in bulk is a great value, so make sure to stock up.
Great peanut butter/chocolate taste.  Sugar free. Wonderful, protein-rich in-between meal snack/meal replacement. This is perfect for fitness enthusiasts and body builders.

These bars are a great alternative to typical protein bars. They are not full of sugar and carbs like most other types. They taste good and are filling. One bar was not enough for a full meal for me, but with a piece of fruit or a small salad or something, it's great.

I love Think Thin Bars.  Love them.  I eat one every morning. This crunchy peanut butter is my favorite.  "Subscribe and save" seems like a bargain, but by the time I was six months into the program, the bars I was receiving were bloomed, chalky, and gave every appearance of having been stored in a hot place, which certainly compromised the quality and eating experience (and maybe even the nutritional value, like the vitamins).  I cancelled my subscription, and am back to buying them at a higher price at my local grocery store.

thinkThin protein bars are extremely tasty and filling! Over the years I have tried several brands and flavors of protein bars but thinkThin's exceed taste expectations and are sustaining for several hours. It's also great that they come in several flavors (my favorites: chunky and creamy peanut butter) and are gluten-free. Be aware, these do contain a small amount of dairy. Overall, great solid protein bar with enough grams of protein per serving for complete female (or male) nutrition!

Bars appear to have been either mishandled in storage/transport, or they are just old.  Bars on surface should be uniform chocolate color but instead are dry and ashy.  This is a disappointment, considering I ordered a whole case.  Taste is also dry.

column9: Kind of can't live without them
column10: They taste good, they are healthy and low in carbs.  Great snack and sometimes in a crunch, a meal replacement.That said, my last shipment from Amazon was not so good.  The chocolate had bloomed and the taste was not quite so good.  This means that the warehouse where they're kept probably fluctuated in temperature a lot.  This isn't a reflection on ThinkThin.  I have bought these bars for years but I didn't know where else to post this comment.Otherwise, I am really into these and even take them with me on vacation.

These peanut butter bars are my latest addiction.  I actually don't usually like bars, but I started eating these to slim down post babies.  I eat half for breakfast with an espresso and have the other half for an afternoon snack.  While I don't feel stuffed/full after eating half, I am satisfied and can make it 3+ hours to my next snack or meal.  It tastes great, not too sweet like a candy bar but sweet enough to curb my afternoon cravings.  Also, the subscribe and save deal on Amazon can't be beat!

I could not get through the week without these Gluten Free bars. The biggest problem I have with them is hiding them from my husband. The whole family loves them. Very tasty and does not have that nasty aftertaste that some bars have.
This box was really good and these bars are a great way to snack. They fill me up for about 3 hours and keep me from getting the tired cranky feeling when I'm on the go.

I typically loathe protein/nutrition bars, but these are a little different. They taste pretty good, they are low in sugar and very high in protein. I am not a fan of sweets, but sometimes I need a quick, convenient "meal" and these do the trick. I like them best with a glass of unsweetened soy milk to cut the sweet taste a little, but I can stand to eat them with just water. Considering cost, taste, and nutrition, these are some of the best protein bars I have tasted.

column4: Mary Jo Huntley "Mom of Irish Twins"
column9: Great Product but don't buy it here
column10: These are the best protein bars that I've ever eaten.  It's a huge plus that no sugar is added and they are gluten free.  LOVE THEM. When I got them, I was disappointed to realize that at least part of the protein was from soy -- in general I tend to stay away from unfermented soy products -- and I found the taste rather meh. column9: Great Product, Great Price!! (bars are fresher than Whole Foods too!)
column10: I'm very happy with these bars and Amazon's great price & quick shipping!!!!  I wanted a good, healthy, high protein, low glycemic, etc. meal replacement/ snack bar to eat on the go that I can keep on hand to help me reduce my caloric/ fat intake and stop me from eating unhealthy, fatty foods so I can shed a few pounds. She also told me that Chunky Peanut Butter and White Chocolate Chip were the favorite flavors.  I bought them both and liked them and saw that Amazon has them cheaper so I bought a box of each.  I was concerned when I read the reviews on here and someone said the bars were stale/ old/ not fresh, so I was prepared to send them back if need be. I checked the expiration date and they expire in a little more than a year.  I checked the wrapper of my bar from Whole foods and it expires 11 months from now.  Amazon's is fresher, go figure!!  With subscribe & save I'm saving like 60%...LOVE IT!!

column9: Nice protein bar when you're craving something peanuty...
column10: I really like this thinkThin bar but was surprised when I first tried it as it's not especially crunchy...at least not crunchy like "crunchy peanut butter" crunchy. The inside of the bar is soft with pieces of crisped soy to serve as the "crunchy" bits and the outside has a thin chocolate flavor coating. The peanut butter flavor is not overpowering - just yummy - and I find the bar very filling. I could never eat two in a row! I recently ordered these from Amazon for the first time and am quite pleased with them - they arrived via USPS within a weeks time and were fresh and in perfect condition. I'll keep these tasty & satisfying bars on my Subscribe & Save schedule.

Amazon clearly has stacks of these just sitting around at a warehouse for months! These bars were chalky, so they tasted old. Besides that though, I don't know how much I would've like these bars anyway. I mean I love anything peanut butter, but these bars just didn't cut it. They tasted like cardboard. Allow me to suggest a couple of other bars that I do like, 'pure protein' bars or my favorite 'supreme protein' bars.

Really Good bars. You could cut this baby in 1/2 and have 2 snacks out of it! I bought 1 at the store first to see if I liked them and paid lots more for it. I don't eat alot of meat so this caught my eye. I now have them on auto delivery!!
I eat a bar after my workout (taste great) and it has lots of protein and NO SUGAR, which is what I need.  Highly recommend them, ESPECIALLY when they are on sale (they are pricey!).

Tastey and healthy protein bars to satisfy a meal craving on the go.  I travel a ton so instead of eating ANOTHER airport salad or since there are limited breakfast options (I like egg whites or FRESH fruit) when traveling these are great... I like them best with my morning and/or afternoon coffee. If you love peanut butter and chocolate you'll love these bars!
The bars make for a nice snack and they taste "natural" but are not something that I would eat for pleasure.
Think Thin bars are delicious - no sugar but lots of protein - great for an afternoon pick-me-up snack!

column9: Good value and quality for the price
column10: I've seen this in stores for almost double the price, so this is a great value.  I use these bars to replace a meal a day to help me meet my weight loss goals.  At 20G of protein with no sugar, they're perfect.  The taste is pretty good - while the flavor is listed as "chunky" peanut butter, it's not really that chunky or crunchy.  However, I've never had the "creamy" one to compare.

column9: They were melted and the chocolate had turned white

I guess these bars are what they claim they are.  But the taste and consistency leaves something to be desired.  Did keep me from being hungry. I would buy again if they were on some super sale but not worth the regular price at least for me.
What few people know is that spearmint is an appetite suppressant.  Tazo tea creates a wonderful flavor with this blend.

A very pleasant flavored green tea.  The added Lemongrass and spearmint give it a "softer" flavor and takes off the harsher edge that green tea has.  Sort of a cross between a green tea and an herbal tea.
I love this tea.  Green tea on its own tastes bitter to me.  I love the additions of the spearmint and lemongrass.

column9: Relaxing Zen Experience in a Tea
column10: ****Tazo's Zen Green Tea with Lemongrass & Spearmint has a subtle, mild, light green tea taste, not bitter at all. I don't taste any of the additional flavors Tazo puts into this tea; maybe my palate isn't developed to this point. However, it still is one of their better teas, and has less of an artificial taste than the others I've tried. Maybe the flavorings are just too mild in this tea, but when it comes to flavorings, I prefer them this way; I like a natural, real taste with real ingredients sans vague "natural flavors" and sans flavorings, sans essences, etc. It is not a strong green tea, so it would definitely appeal to people who enjoy herbal infusions and milder teas.The ingredients in Zen  are: green teas, lemon verbena, spearmint, lemongrass, and natural flavors. Zen contains caffeine.Tazo is an interesting company that makes only super premium teas. They are socially responsible, based in Portland, and have the motto, "The Reincarnation of Tea". Tazo is owned by Starbucks. Their web site is fun and quirky, with a Zen-type focus, definitely worth checking out. It is unclear, though, from their web site, how many of their ingredients are organic or kosher, and they do use some "natural flavors" in their teas--this wording seems a little vague for a super premium tea.On the paper tea packet, Tazo writes, "an enlightening blend of the finest green teas and rare herbs available in this world." On their web site, Tazo describes the flavor profile of Zen as "smooth, lemony, earthy, refreshing". Tazo describes the aroma as "lemon, mint".  The web site also says, "Select pan-fired green tea from Zhejiang province in China, artfully combined with lemongrass, spearmint and a hint of lemon essence. Zen's distinct green tea flavor accented with lemon and mint is impossible to express in words. Best simply to experience its sweet, lingering aftertaste." I don't taste the lemon or the mint or the sweetness; still, it is a nice green tea. It is relaxing and enjoyable to drink.I would rate this tea, and Tazo in general, as very good---better than premium teas like Stash or Celestial Seasonings---but not as good as Numi. I'm soooooo spoiled by Numi teas, which is why Zen gets only four stars.****

One of the most unique teas I've ever tasted. I first started drinking this tea because I wanted to start substituting green tea for coffee. So one day I ventured into my local Starbucks and order a green tea. The barista then served me up this wonderful cup of tea. Curious I read the label hanging out of the cup and began my mission to purchase some of this Zen tea. After a few misses I found a Tazo box at my local pharmacy Duane Reade (which is less of a drugstore and more of a supermarket). The tea that brewed was wonderful and flavorful, but I have to admit, I was a little disappointed. I mistakenly thought that the box of Tazo tea housed the sachets like those I had tried at Starbucks. I would later discover the `tins' (as I call them), which are sold locally at Starbucks (duh).In my opinion both the filter bag and the sachet taste strikingly similar. However, I still favor the sachets as they were my first experience with Tazo.Whoever is the Tea Master at Tazo is doing a superb job at keeping taste very consistent.I brew the Zen tea piping out and let it sit for a while longer than usual. I find that if I let it steep for to short I get too much lemon grass, as it takes a while for the green tea flavors to steep out. It's really an art to balance the complex flavors of this tea, yet well worth the mastery.

This is my favorite hot drink to curl up on the couch with in cool weather. It is also delicious iced on a hot summer day. The slightly minty flavor is so tasty. I flavor mine with a bit of honey or raw sugar. So good! I'm super picky about my teas, and this one is perfection for me. Also love the name Zen. I swear it actually relaxes me when I settle down with a cup. This is good tea!

column9: I love drinking this tea! But it stinks that you won't ship it to Hawaii!
column10: The mint in this blend gives it a nice zip to sip in what would be an otherwise boring cup of green tea.  It's offered at a great price too. Unfortunately, this company will not ship to Hawaii. I would be willing to pay for the freight... it's that great!
I just recently purchased this tea after tasting the bottled version.  It makes a very refreshing iced tea with just a touch of sugar or honey.

column9: This is not the exact one like at Starbucks
column10: First, this is a good tea, but it is not the exact one like at Starbucks. The one at Starbucks is different kind of teabag that has a silk like bag. It's leaves are different too. They are more fuller and these are more ground. Now I realize why the tin box (Tazo Zen Green Tea) at Starbucks could be twice as expensive as this (the tin box has 15 bags for $8.00 at Starbucks). If you want the rich experience of the Zen Green Tea, buy the tin box from Starbucks. And of course, 'You get what you Pay'!

ambrosia!!! I love love love it. I am having a cup of Tazo Zen Green Tea with Lemongrass & Spearmint right now. It is low in caffeine and increases concentration. Getting ready for a test and enjoying my afternoon with a cup of Lemongrass & Spearmint + LEMON and HONEY

column9: Tazo Zen Green Tea with Lemongrass & Spearmint
column10: Tazo Zen Lemongrass & Spearmint is the best green tea I have ever enjoyed. Usually, green tea, gives me ashama. Not this brand. It was so smooth, no bitterness. I am in love with this tea.

column9: Best alternative to Moroccan Mint I can find
column10: I find this to be a great alternative to Moroccan Mint when I cannot find any loose leaf form. I do not taste much of the Lemongrass, just very little hints of it. It is strong with the green tea (It's not a gunpowder green like the type I enjoy best, but it's not a grassy taste which I find is often the other end of the spectrum from Gunpowder) and it is strong with spearmint taste.

This was the year I decided to break a few bad habits, one of which was drinking soda. For most of my life soda was one of my major sources of hydration, which recent studies have shown is not the healthiest of drinks even if it happens to be the diet variety.  So, I bought this tea and it has become my favorite tea.  All summer long I made a big pot, let it cool, and then refrigerated it for the next day.  I filled my Klean Kanteen with ice, poured over the green tea with lemongrass, and was good to go for the entire day.  This tea has a clean and refreshing taste.  No sugary coating of the teeth, just a delicious drink that leaves you refreshed, and possibly even with a better breath since it has some spearmint flavor too.
Great product to begin with - this is my favorite green tea!  Great value, well-packaged, and I received it within the expected time period!
I've recently started to drink tea... this it's been a great choiceI mean am a beginer in tea's world

the product was a little slow getting here, but had a nice note from the seller explaining it got lost by deliverer. The product is great! Nice light mint flavor. It is hard to drink regular tea now that I'm used to Tazo emongrass & Spearmint.
Love the zen and awake teas, can also recomend the calm, and the lotus as well. look forward to trying others.
The following recommendation is based on having enjoyed over 100 tea varieties in the last 2+ years.This tea has a pleasant flavor when prepared as recommended.Nice!
Great for iced tea.  Same tea used at Starbucks for their iced green tea.
YUM! Soft, never gets bitter - even if I forget to take out the bag... it's THAT good hot or chilled. At the end, you're left with the refreshing spearmint flavor on your taste buds! mmmmmm!

Tazo Zen green tea with lemongrass is an absolutely wonderful tea. The lemongrass moderates the slight bitterness that is common in plain green tea. I've experimented with adding a twist of lemongrass to a plain organic green tea, and the flavor is similar. The lemongrass complements the green tea flavor, deletes any hint of bitterness, and contributes a very faint lemon scent and flavor that can't be duplicated with ordinary lemon. I drink other green teas (for example, Tazo's decaf Lotus at night, or Tazo's jasmine when I'm in that flowery jasmine mood), but Zen is far and away my favorite. And, no, I don't own stock in the company!

column9: One of my favorite green teas
column10: As a tea lover, I must say that this is one of my favorite teas of all time. Tazo does a wonderful job balancing out the hints of mint and lemon within this green tea blend. This tea is perfect as is. No sweetener needed!
great for making iced green tea. same stuff they use at starbucks and the price of one box is about the same as they charge for a large drink!
I purchased this online because these teabags are no longer available at the Starbucks stores.  They have transitioned to a new loose leaf configuration which costs more and has fewer servings.
I purchased this tea at the very end of September 2010 and paid 19.46 for 6 boxes and now less than 6 months later it is 27.29. Seems like quite a price hike for the same item.

the photo looks great.  Too bad what i got had slivered almonds - not a single whole almond in the box!don't waste your money.  the picture looks NOTHING like what they send. They should have to put up a photo of what it really looks like.  they wouldn't sell any!!!!!  VERY DISAPPOINTED and feel cheated

column9: A quality product at a good price, but not what I was looking for
column10: I was looking for an inexpensive way to get pure hibiscus tea, as I'm a big fan of it.  A pound of it at this price seemed like a good deal so I gave it a try.  Upon receiving the tea, I discovered some other ingredients in this tea, particularly orange peel and cinnamon, that overpower the hibiscus (the eponymous and most important ingredient, as far as I'm concerned) and made it more like potpourri than hibiscus tea.  Fortunately, the components are in recognizably large pieces (which I see as sign of high quality) that I can pick out the undesirable bits.So if you're thinking of buying, be advised that this tea has cinnamon and orange peel.  I wasn't able to find that description anywhere on the product page.

I bought this tea after hearing about reported health benefits and because herbal teas have never really worked for me and I wanted to give another go at it. This tea really blew me away with it's complex melody of flavors, lack of bitter overtones and ability to steep for a long period only making it for the better. I'm actually surprised at my response and feel fortunate to have come across this product (thanks Amazon!).

I originally purchased Davidson's Pure Organic Hibiscus to test it's affect on my blood pressure.  Since that tea is not available at the moment, I decided to give this one a shot.Note that (as others have pointed out) this is not a pure hibiscus tea, and does not claim to be.  It also has orange peel, lemon myrtle, and cinnamon.  The tea IS predominantly hibiscus.  The aroma is very different from the pure tea, but the hibiscus taste and color are still very much there.To me, the additional ingredients compliment the hibiscus taste quite well.  I believe the ratio of hibiscus to other ingredients is spot on, and I personally have no problem drinking this tea as an alternative to pure hibiscus for blood pressure purposes.  You can always strengthen your brew!Just like all other Davidson's bulk items I've purchased, this is a great tea at a great price.

Read carefully...I bought this item thinking it was pure hibiscus tea but it wasn't. It also had dried orange peel, cinnamon and other spices. The flavor is much too strong so be sure it reads "pure" before you buy

This stuff really is amazing. I've never tried hibiscus-based teas before, except as a minor ingredient, and picked some up to help with a relative's blood pressure (there's now a lot of evidence of benefit from human clinical trials) and gave it a try. Absolutely lovely! And remarkably, I even the used leaves are edible, and taste good: try mixing them up with yogurt or fat-free ricotta and a little Walden Farms Chocolate Syrup (Low-Carb) 12 oz or other sweetener.

I have been having problems with this item.  Even though, per the website, it says that this is Te de Hibiscus, in actuality it includes OTHER items -- like orange peel, cinnamon and lemon myrtle.  It's NOT until you actually get the item that one learns that it is NOT 100% Te de Hibiscus.  This item WILL be removed from my list of things to order from Amazon, because of this.

column4: T. Pell "Proud to be a geek"
column10: I purchased this as a less expensive alternative to Tazo's Passion Tea and am very pleased with it. This tea brews up with a very intense flavor and the hint of orange and cinnamon are a perfect compliment to the hibiscus.  Be forewarned that this is a very tart tea and you may need quite a bit more sweetener than you are accustomed to using.  I am still working out the exact ratios for a perfect cup, but it seems like a teaspoon (or a teaspoon and a half) to 14 oz of boiling water steeped for 5 minutes will produce a very strong brew that can been poured over ice and still remain very flavorful.  (I prefer mine iced.)  I know that sounds like a small amount of tea, but this is very concentrated and therefore a terrific value for the money.  Another great perk is that you can let it steep for as long as you like and it will not grow bitter like some other teas do.

Mostly these days I find companies that are liviing in a dream state.  Davidson Tea is obviously, to me, one of the few that does not fall into this catagory.  Their product is the best I have had and their presentation and dellivery are the same.  I meantop end Hibiscus.  Thanks for the service,  Joe

I ordered the Hibiscus tea because it is said to be good for high blood pressure.It did not state that there were spices in this tea.  We cannot use it due to allergies to the spices, and there are no returns on this item.Not happy with it.  I did purchase pure hibiscus tea from another company and it is awesome.

column9: great tasting on a hot or cold day
column10: I drink this religiously when I'm sick or had drinks the night before. for teh cleansing effects and have a cup after lunch for the vitamin c boost. tastes great, mixed with dried orange peel, cinammon. and something else. but I love it. It lasts me quite a long time. I keep them in air tight jars. the bag is so big I give samples to people at work. And it makes great iced tea with some honey or my fav, brown sugar. hell, throw it in some vodka with a sprite. the tartiness is interesting. that's my hibiscus vodka in a tom highball glass

This tea has a strong hibiscus color, but none of the taste.  The taste is all lemon.  It doesn't taste bad, but it's not at all what I wanted.  I am very disappointed.

There are three great reasons to buy bulk hibiscus flowers for tea:1 A cup a day reduces high blood pressure (see more below)2 It tastes great, with nutrasweet and/or a few drops of apple juice3 It's a cheap zero-calorie replacement for expensive juice like Cran-pom that still provides Vitamin CI began to look into bulk hibiscus tea when I found that my blood pressure was high and read in Mother Earth News (and other sources) that hibiscus tea could reduce high blood pressure.  It worked for me.  We make two ½ gallon jugs from 5 tablespoons, add nutrasweet and drink hot or warm.  It has replaced juice in our household.  There are probably 50 gallons in a 1 pound bag, so it's very cheap (about 25 cents a gallon)!  It has a citrusy floral taste.

I just finished my first bag of this tea. I decided to try a brand of 100% hibiscus and was very disappointed.  I enjoy the flavors mixed in this tea.  I tried adding my own cinnamon and orange peel to the other brand but it does not come close to the flavor of this tea.  I gave up and ordered this again.  I might experiment and mix some of it with the 100% brand since I hate to waste that non-flavorful tea.
Purchased this to replace the Organic Hibiscus. It's OK but the Organic Hibiscus is much better. Have gone back to the Organic Hibiscus.

I was looking forward to getting this tea and it did not disappoint.  This tea is very fruity and has a lovely exciting flavor.  I have made it almost everyday with a little bit of sugar and served cold as iced tea and I love it.  It is very refreshing.

column9: All the ingredients for high blood pressure
column10: I expected 100% hibiscus, but was very happy with my purchase and now have it on auto-delivery. I paid big bucks in the past for a blend of hibiscus tea at Teavana. This tea is just as good, if not better. Hibiscus, orange peel, and cinnamon lower high blood pressure. I add a small piece of Needle Ku Ding Tea to the mix and a dash more cinnamon when brewing. The needle ku ding has a very bitter taste so a little goes a long way. I am 100% pleased with this product and the results I have gotten with my customized blend.

I really enjoy Davidson's Te De Hibiscus for iced tea.  The brewed tea is a deep pomegranate-red color and it WILL stain, so you have to be careful not to spill it!  This tea is a good substitute for lemonade.  Why?  The taste is lemony-hibiscus-cinnamon.  The hibiscus lends quite a sour/tart flavor and the lemon myrtle gives a good lemony kick.  As such, I find that I need more sweetener with this tea than with most others (I use stevia or artificial sweetener, so this doesn't add extra calories). Lately I've been really getting into espresso, and this small espresso-based energy drink comes as close to the taste of the real thing as is possible for a drink of this kind. If you buy these bouillon cubes thinking they will be like the salt-filled cubes you buy at any grocery store, think again. The texture is different. Solubility is different. Taste is different.First let's discuss texture. The texture of these cubes is a lot like firm butter that was just taken out of the fridge. You can cut it like butter, so dividing is not a problem the way it is with salty, powdery cubes. It does tend to stick to the foil wrapper, but comes off easily using a knife, fork, or even spoon.We will go on to solubility. When you put these into hot water or put them in cold water then heat in the microwave, they do not break down as quickly as you might be accustomed to. The pieces that come apart in the water need to be stirred momentarily and pressed against the side of the container with a spoon. This does not take more than a minute.The taste is different, too. It has an inviting aroma and tastes like actual vegetable broth.  There is no overpowering salty taste, and these can be used to make a stronger tasting liquid than high-sodium cubes.This bouillon makes a great gravy when you use the whole cube in 1-1/2 cups boiling water. Stir 3 tbsp of corn starch into 1/4 cup cold water. Stir cold cornstarch water into boiling liquid till thickened. Add a little pepper and serve.I've also used it to flavor soy based textured vegetable protein (TVP) for use in meatless meatloaf and other dishes.  I just use it in place of the boiling water.  I like to use a bit stronger broth for that purpose.I give this product very high marks. Buy with confidence. Whether you are vegetarian or not, whether you are salt-restricted or not, this bouillon does not disappoint.

I keep them in the car and at work as a healthy alternative when I'm hungry but can't get to a meal. One day I was driving home from work and was starving and had half a bar and was totally satisfied! Also these don't dry out, I often eat half a bar then eat the other half later and somehow they stay super moist. Maybe it's oil or something bad, I'm not sure, but it works great for me.
