column9: Takes a little getting used to
column10: Since soy and anything made with casein is not an option for us, I was happy to find this mix.  This does not taste or smell like cheese (otherwise I would give it 5 stars), and we didn't like it when we first tried it.  However, since it is still pretty tasty in its own right, I tried it a few more times, with a few weeks between each time and eventually I found the right thickness for us (I also added a little more salt).  This is the case for pretty much all other replacement food items we've tried, because we are on a very restrictive diet which leaves us very few options in the ready-made/semi ready-made category.  By now (5 months later) my 5 year old probably can't remember how the real cheese tastes like, so as long as the food is tasty, he is happy.  As for me, I am happy to find one more item that can save me some time in food preparation.

column9: Great alternative for gluten dairy & casein free
column10: This is a great product for those who need gluten, dairy & casein free foods. We use both these individual packets and the boxes with the GF noodles - both are handy and great.Of course it doesn't taste like REAL macaroni and cheese! Geez - do you really think you can get fake cheese or non-cheese to taste like the real thing?!? If you're looking for something to replicate real cheese or annies GF mac and cheese (which DOES contain dairy) then you will search in vain. You cannot get real cheese flavor from non-cheese products.However, if you're realistic and are aware that non cheese stuff won't actually taste like cheese yet you want something similar to mac & cheese then this is a great option! We really like this mix and the other roads end products. It has a unique flavorful taste. We tend to alternate this stuff Namaste Foods, Gluten Free Say Cheez Pasta Dish, 9-Ounce Bags (Pack of 6) The Road's end is closer to cheese than the Namaste but again, those who want a real cheese flavor/consistency will be sorely disappointed. However, for those of us who cannot have real cheese this stuff is great.We mix in veggies with ours (you know the ones that are little squares of carrots, peas, corn, etc.) and I use hemp milk when mixing for a bit more substance and flavor. Also if you add a bit of trocomare A. Vogel Trocomare, 3.2 Ounce Units (Pack of 4) it makes a huge difference in flavor (actually trocomare makes a huge difference in the flavor of everything! We love it and use it on just about everything.So - for those who expect a real cheese flavor - don't even bother and stick with real cheese or change your expectations.For those who realize it won't taste like real cheese but who want something different and unique (and gluten, dairy, casein free) - buy this, it's great!!!

I liked the taste and it was not hard to make but the Chreese had a terrible consistency.  It was thick and gloppy - not at all like a smooth sauce.  I made it three times with the same result.  It's possible I'm doing something wrong, but I believe I am following the directions to a T.That being said, it does taste really good and definitely satisfies a cheese craving.  I will continue to use it, but probably won't serve it to guests until I can figure out the consistency issues.

I love this stuff. Does it taste like cheese? It depends who you ask. My mom says yes, I say no, not at all. It has a vaguely cheesy flavor, but this wouldn't fool anybody. There definitely are vegan cheeses that taste like cheese (Daiya brand is decent, and Vegusto, to everyone I've prepared it for, is indistinguishable from real cheese) but they are often expensive and have lots of fat and calories. Chreese, on the other hand, is very cheap and has very little fat or calories. Also it contains fiber, protein, and vitamin b-12, which I think is just great. Actually, I'm writing this review while eating a grilled chreese on pumpernickel. And it's delicious. I've had both the gluten and gluten-free varieties, and they're both great - they taste the same.In closing, no, this is not identical to cheese. But it is really, really tasty, affordable, and nutritious.

column9: Mi picky eater toddler liked it
column10: I'd suggest first of all: Use an electric mixer!!!It is a good fake cheese sauce. And my son is SOOOOOOOOOOO PICKY.
This stuff is wonderful, I add it to my own pasta to get a near cheese taste and stay non-dairy!

We have been using this "cheese sauce" mix for several years.  I make a pretty decent Mac and Cheese with it.  Considering we are allergic to all things dairy, this is as close as we get to something cheese-like, so I am not complaining. I add more soy milk and soy margarine....and it has no cholesterol... So, if you can eat real cheese, enjoy. For those of us who cannot, this fills the gap.

column9: Might as well made it from scratch!
column10: Ok, first off I need to mention I didnt but this b/c I need anything gluten or dairy free.  I bought this because I tend to "eat clean" for the most part and wanted a quick semi clean cheese sauce without worry of a ingredient list filled with junk (think of a dyed bright yellow clump of so called "cheese product") My idea was to use this as a cheese sauce for some Quinoa and broccoli, much like a cheddar cheese rice bake, sounds yummy right? Anyways when it came time to make the sauce I almost cried, it smelled like a strong soup base, (like bouillon cubes) The smell seemed to get slightly milder, but upon tasting a lick off the spoon I was more than tempted to trash the whole thing and just whip up some cheese sauce from scratch.  Instead I improvised and added about a handful of mozzarella cheese, a handful of cheddar cheese and and a half a cup of milk to the mix and while it tasted like cheddar and cardboard, my kids and I ate our dinner.  Was it worth it?  Nope, not for me at least.  Now I am sure if you NEED something like this for dietary reasons, such as having a gluten allergy or dairy allergy, then perhaps your taste buds are more "willing" but for me, this was a complete waste.
To sum it up in one word-gross.  Looked gross and tasted gross.  Wish I hadn't bought the case of these. If I could have would give 0 stars.
It looked and smelled really bad could not get my self to taste it. I am sorry I bought this product. The picture is a complete lie.

This is a fantastic, gluten free cheese sauce mix.  Easy to prepare, but seems to require more liquid than the package requires.  No worries, you can figure out the consistency you desire quite easily.
Not sure what the other reviewers are doing differently than I am but it doesn't taste anything like cheese at all!

first if you are a vegan and use to not having cheese this may not be as bad.if you are new to gluten and casein free cheese mixes or new to vegan lifestyle you don't need to try this.it has such a strong garlic smell that turns you off of the taste.pros: it is very easy to make

Road's End Organics Gluten Free Cheddar is surprisingly good. It does have a slightly funky flavor... but it doesn't have an off taste or a horrific aftertaste, as can sometimes occur with vegan cheeses. It's one that would drive away the sparkly vegetarian vampires of The Twilight Saga Complete Collection.Road's End Organics' fake cheese sauce is perfect for mixing with macaroni. It contains annatto, and one of the essentials of vegan cuisine, nutritional yeast. It's delicious and nutritious!

Unfortunately, it does not come close to looking nor tasting like much.  I tried desperately and so did my son, but it did not cut the bill.  If you are looking for a pasta dish I recommend Namaste's Say Cheez (with added bacon it is really good).
Super tasty coffee.  I was leery of purchasing this huge bag, without having tasting it, but there was no need.  This coffee is bold, has a nutty and cocoa-ey flavor to it.  Very good.
I bought a container of this stuff years ago at Sam's and FINALLY found more on amazon....it's THE BEST STUFF IN THE WORLD!!!

column4: E. Bernardino "Addicted to the Gold Box"
column10: I love this pesto! I purchased it while on vacation at my favorite cook's store on Cape Cod, and couldn't wait to get home to try it...it didn't disappoint! Very fresh, nicely blended basil flavor (not too overpowering). I am pleased to see it being sold on Amazon, as I plan to stock up the next go round.Enjoy it with some al dente pasta and your favorite vino...and don't forget to play some Beatles music in the background for some ambiance! :) (It's also okay to have some Andrea Bocelli on as well...)

I bought this sauce at a local grocery store eager to make a pesto dish. I opened it hearing the pop, meaning it was properly sealed, and lo and behold inside was a LIVE beetle. Threw the bottle away. Makes me shudder how many other jars are infested with bugs and larva.

My son loves pretzels and I was excited to get them but he is not a big fan.  They are a bit drier than a regular pretzel.  My husband and I like them, but I was hoping for a better snacking choice for my son.

I was never a pretzel eater, but when I went on Weight Watchers I tried these because 15 pretzel sticks was only 3 points and I never eat all 15 at once.  I can spread them out over the day or only have 5 at a time for one point.  I only gave the pretzels 4 stars because when I started WW the pretzels seemed a little sweeter.  I don't know if the recipe was changed since then, but I still like them a lot and the other added benefit is that they are organic and 100% whole wheat.

These are awesome and you can't beat the price for the 12 pack if you sign up for subscribe and save.  I can't find these locally, so was thrilled to find them here on Amazon.  They taste great, are organic and whole wheat, which meets all of my requirements.  Kind of slow on the shipping however which is why I knocked off a star.  It took 8 days to get these, these were offered with prime shipping but I know that sometimes when you sign up for subscribe and save the shipping seems to slow down, but I didn't expect 8 days.  The bags did arrive intact, fresh and tasty!

I agree with another reviewer regarding the taste of the Snyder's Organic Honey Whole Wheat Pretzel Sticks -- they taste a little stale.  I bought two cases of these based on the reviews because I wanted to eat healthier snacks; however, I'm not crazy about these pretzels.  I've never eaten sawdust, but I imagine this is what it tastes like.

This is my first order and I love the pretzels.  I have been looking for a whole wheat pretzel with low sodium for a long time and finally found these on Amazon.  Can't find anything in stores in a whole wheat pretzel.  They are very good with a slightly sweet taste.  I have been buying the Snyder's unsalted pretzels for a long time (and they are very good too!) but wanted something that would fill me up more and the whole wheat have 3 grams of fiber in a serving.  The only downside to this review is the price has went up quite a bit since I first ordered them.

column9: These used to be really tasty...
column10: Perhaps they've changed the recipe, but these simply don't taste like they used to. Moreover, they don't taste that great. (They now taste a bit flat and stale, for lack of a better way to describe it.)We used to rip through these pretty quickly. Now, we can go for long periods without eating them. And we always need something like a dip or hummus or salsa to eat with them.Bland. boring. tasteless. Snyder's, what have you done to them?Bring back the ones we loved!
These didn't taste as fresh as I had hoped.  They are organic and made with whole wheat flour, so that was the positive!  We eat them with hummus and other dips.
Don't know what I was expecting but I wasn't expecting whole wheat pretzels to taste this good. They are well worth the money and I intend to keep getting them.

My German teacher had this tea at her house.  Rosehip (Rose hip) tea is called Hagebuttentee in Germany.  This particular brand (Teekanne) sells this exact same product under the name FixButte in Germany, so if you've had Teekanne's FixButte tea, then this is the same thing.  I really enjoy the flavor of this tea and in particular this brand.  I often will put one packet of Splenda in it to help sweeten it a little, but it's also delicious as is.  The Amazon description says 2-count, but it's really a 20-count box.  I order the subscription, which is sold as a five box package and save 15%.

We are not big black tea drinkers so this rosehip tea is one of our favorite afternoon teas.  I love the availability in the five pack as it keeps the shipping price low.  Nice flavor and we add just a spot of honey to ours.
My office and I really enjoyed this tea. Different taste and lovely color. And will sure get this tea again, thanks so much.

I was prepared to hate this kit as a gimmick.  But I was blown away and have to consider it to produce something superior to other kits and even to most restaurants.As I was eating the butter chicken, I noted more flavor than I am used to, almost an overuse of cloves...which is not exactly a bad thing.  The result was butter chicken at home, at basically half the cost of going to the restaurant.  The texture was spot on, unlike the goopy or stringy stuff other at home kits produced.As an indian food enthusiast who is normally competent in the kitchen but out of his league cooking the stuff, I can only imagine how good it will be for someone who can hack the recipe (like coconut milk instead of half and half? adding something to counteract the clove?)While the rice could have been spiced up too, it was a good amount of rice and therefore an appropriate addition to the kit.The trick is that instead of one tub of goop added to the meat, there's three different stages of flavor insertion.So yeah, I am going to be trying other products from these people.

This butter chicken is absolutely delicious,the spices are fresh and the rice is wonderful. This meal kit allows you to recreate some of the best Indian food you have ever had in your own kitchen. The instructions are clear and it is fun to put it all together and serve up to 4 adults with this product. All of the Gormantra meals I have tried have been outstanding, give it a try!

This is very good and pretty easy to make.I use precooked chicken packaged chicken beast instead of raw chicken now and it cuts down on the mess and prep time a little.  I tried subsitituting 2% milk for 1/2 and 1/2 to cut down on fat and calories and while it was ok, wasn't nearly as good or creamy.  What I do know is use land of lakes low fat half and half and it comes out just as good as using regular half and half or if the store is out of the land of lakes I will use 1/2 cup half and half and 1/4 soy milk and don't notice a difference.

column9: Incredible Taste and Simple to Prepare
column10: This GOURMANTRA Butter Chicken is a great meal kit. First rinse and start your basmati rice (included). All you need to add is chicken and a milk or cream or non-dairy substitute.  It's very easy to prepare, just cook the chicken in a skillet with some oil (I prefer olive it's healthier), sprinkle in the garlic/ginger spices (included), then add the butter chicken spices (included) and add the tomato puree (included) with water.  Then add some dairy or non-dairy to "cream it up" and simmer.  Couldn't be easier.It is a smidge more than just mild, but I love Indian food any way!  If you NEED truly mild food, this is NOT for you.It is healthier to make it yourself - 1) YOU get to choose how much or little oil you add (I've paid $25 for a very oily Butter Chicken at an Indian Restaurant in London that didn't beat this or a very fattening cream-based Butter Chicken in SF that could stop your heart), 2) YOU get to choose if you want to add cream with fat and cholesterol or non-fat or even non-dairy.  Yes, of course it has some affect on the taste and texture but not enough to concern my palate.Now, the coriander is a little stronger than some other recipes, BUT it is not ruinous or overpowering.  The garlic, ginger and turmeric are all well-balanced.  There are so many versions of Butter Chicken that you can always find something different, but this is good stuff!  The case of 6 boxes of this have a shelf life of 2 years.It serves 3-4 people and the aroma in my house is such an incredible bonus!  True, I have all the spices in my cabinet to make this, BUT this is TRULY an easy and simple way to make good, quality Butter Chicken!  GOURMANTRA Butter Chicken has my 5-stars!

I just tried the Butter Chicken and it is just delicious. I have tried all kinds of Indian food to make at home and have never been really pleased with the results. I have to say this is restaurant quality. I added coconut milk instead of cream and let it cook down and thicken, It is absolutely great. The spices smelled fresh, the rice is high quality,and the finished product could be served to company, The fact that it is non GMO and is gluten free makes it even better. What a treat! I do not live close to an Indian restaurant so this is doubly appreciated.

This was sent to me by a friend as I had never heard of it before. She sent two of these and two of the Channa Masala. Both were very good. I tried the Butter Chicken with chicken first and it was good. The instructions said that you could use lamb also so I tried that the second time and it was better. I haven't had good Indian food in a while, but this was so much better than going to a restaurant. We ate it at home while watching monday night football and even my son was taken back and he's pretty picky. Good stuff!

This product is delicious! We are a half Indian/half American household, so we know good Indian food when we try it. The ingredients are fresh and the kit makes it easy to put together a quick meal.  The other Gourmantra products are equally tasty.<...>

column9: A staple meal in my kitchen pantry!
column10: I LOVE Gourmantra's Butter Chicken.  I've tasted several varieties of Butter Chicken in the past, including those from high-end authentic Indian restaurants.  The combination of spices, garlic, and tomato sauce included in this kit are every bit as tasty as those, and in some cases much better!  I highly recommend this particular product!  I actually crave it and prepare it twice a month.  Very easy to prepare, and it also tastes wonderful the next day.  All you need on hand is chicken and cream, toss together a salad and voila!

column9: Amazing, never going out to eat Indian Food again
column10: This was my favorite dish at an Indian Restaurant. As far as the strong clove taste, there is a very distinct taste that's strong. It's not bad, it's just really powerful. I made it for dinner the other night with some store-bought naan and everything cost about $10, and my brother mom and myself couldn't finish all the food. We're big eaters.My tip is to put a tablespoon or two of tomato paste in the sauce after adding the tomato puree. I think it was missing some sweetness and acidity that I'm used to. This mix is actually very wonderful. If you go to an Indian Restaurant, you get half as much butter chicken for $15-$20.Everything was done in 30 minutes, it was a very quick and flavorful meal.

I thought, its ready-to-eat chicken. I thought to put in oven, heat and eat.But what they sent in the pack is just some rice(raw rice, need to cook), chicken masala powder/paste.The description is not written correctly.Its not worth to buy raw rice and masala with this price.

I first ordered a pound from another vendor, but it just didn't last. This 6 lb. fudge brick is sure lasting a long time! I even have to share it with my 2 kids. I store it in the fridge and it keeps just fine. It is sweet, fresh and fudgy. This might be a little more than you need, but a pound is just not enough.Imagine my shock when I opened the box after it arrived and found...a whole case of peppered gravy packets! The warehouse screwed up and sent my 6 lbs. of fudge to Iowa and I got someone in Iowa's case of gravy mix. So I had to wait to receive my fudge. But I finally did.It's yummy. No nuts.

Got these extracts for baking and smoothies to add variety in flavor. I put 1/2 capful in Crystal Light Orange and it was way yummy. This is great for those who are calorie conscious or going for a low glycemic way of eating since these extracts create a taste treat without doing damage.
it taste really good as long as you don't use too much of it..if you do its really over powering
Superb vinegar, beats $100 balsamic! Wonderful salad dressing.Don't forget to try Pedro Ximenez sherry too.
Sweet, smooth, creamy with a hint of salt at the end.Try it now!  You will be left wanting more....

column9: dog loved but they make a mess
column10: my golden loves dingo bones (big and small) but these things leave red crumbs everywhere. he doesnt usually have any digestive issues from them and we only give him rawhides when he is under complete supervision.

I was pleasantly surprised when I tried this....10 calories per bottle and it has a great taste, a pineapple and mango blend that is oh so delicious.  It is flavored with sucrolose, which to me does not have the diet after taste that many other sweetners have.  I would definitely purchase this drink again and would now try more in the fuze line now that I know how good they are!  As an aside, I bet this would make some pretty good skinny cocktails with a splash of your favorite adult mix-in.Overall, no complaints here, delicious without being too sweet or too plain, a nice blend with a pineapple base to it and absolutely do-able for 10 calories per bottle!

While it looks like this might be the current vaccum sealed lunch to go, it is in fact the older small can. While the the product itself - tuna, mayo, crakers, etc - are fine, the container is unbelevably hard to open. This is  not the normal flip top can, but a "new" design that simply does not work. I'm a big guy, and I need a screw driver to actually open the damn thing - the lid and pull tab do not give enough torque to actually remove the lid without breaking the pull tab - or your finger. The top of the can says - in vey large letters around the pull top: "OR USE CAN OPENER" - but the lid is so recessed that a conventional can opener will not work, and the bottom of the can is too rounded.  Just make sure you are at least a big guy and have your own screw driver to get what you paid for!

This product has problems with the cans not always opening with the flip tab to open the can.  Sometimes it would work and sometime it wouldn't.  If you had easy access to a can opener you were okay, but if not, it was impossible to open the can.When I first ordered this product, I thought it was going to be the envelops, but it turned out to be the cans.

column9: Item in photo is not the right item!
column10: The item in the photo is the flat cardboard "Lunch-To-Go" kit that includes CHUNK LIGHT tuna, butter crackers, mayo, and pickle relish.  The product that I received are the round kits containing ALBACORE tuna and wheat crackers.  I strongly prefer the chunk light tuna to the albacore, and in fact, chose to order these from Amazon because my local grocer has stopped carrying the chunk light kits.  Needless to say, I'm not happy about receiving something different than I ordered, different than what is pictured.

column4: Shira Anthony "Author & Avid Reader of M/M Ro...
column10: I bought these for my kids' lunches, having had them before over the years.  They really are yummy, but there's one huge problem - the new "safer" packaging (top is not as sharp) is nearly impossible to open.  End result - my kids ended up skipping lunch!  My husband, the engineer, says he loves them, but you "need a screwdriver or tool to open them."So, buyer beware!  Unless Starkist changes its packaging, I won't be buying these again.  Sigh...

I WAS A BIT NERVOUS ABOUT ORDERING THIS PRODUCT DUE TO THE FACT THAT I WAS IN HIGH HOPES OF RECREATING THESE SAME TYPE BISCUTS FROM RED LOBSTER....LOL....HOWEVER THEY DON'T QUITE RATE UP THERE WITH THEIRS, BUT MUST SAY THAT FOR A HOME DELIGHT THEY WERE PRETTY DARN GOOD!!! WILL ADD MY OWN SPECIAL TOUCH TO THEM THOUGH NEXT TIME THAT I SERVE THEM FOR SUPPER :)

I am running out of the Amore brand of anchovy paste that is not salted but Amazon is out of stock on the brand.  I enjoy Crown Prince sardines in olive oil so I am giving their anchovy paste a shot.  These do not give as much depth of flavor as the Amore brand so I am going back to the Amore.

column9: anchovy paste spewed a mess in pantry
column10: I bought a 12 pack of this exact product about 6 months ago.  It was not from this seller.  They were kept in a cool pantry in a kitchen that is always temperature controlled.  I used one right away. It was good. They all say Best By:Jan 27 2012.  Today is Mar 2011. The remaining 11 have all swelled up, unrolled the end, and the contents has spewed out.  I am throwing them all in the trash. I had previously purchased a 12 pack of Amore Anchovy paste and had them in my pantry for nearly two years as I used them all without any issue.  I will stay away from Crown Prince.  My packages say Imported From Morocco.

i have nothing to compare it to, never having using anchoy paste before.but what was i missing, this tastes great. i have used it in salad dressing, on toast with grated sheese, in spaghetti sauce, as a sort of 'pesto' in milaneze style spaghetti...odd, i eve added toasted shredded coconut to it on top of toast...and it was pretty good-just seems an odd grouping.we do not feel cheated in any way and would buy again when depleted.

Great way to add salt and flavor to salad, or salad dressing,  or pasta with olive oil, butter, or tomato.  Keeps well in fridge, easy to store, space saving squeeze tube. Good for flavoring stir fried or baked veggies, soups, be creative.

I loved this merguez sausage. It's a little spicy but doesn't burn your mouth off. A nice subtle spiciness. Very nice with Harissa hot sauce.
Tasty french merguez. I could not find these anywhere and was delighted when these arrived as it is the real thing!

column9: I liked these better than some of the other sausages
column10: I liked these better than some of the other sausages from this company.  They are spicey but not over powering.  I either grill or boil them and get good results either way.

column9: This delice Meguez a is way too expensive, and doesn't come close the original North African Merguez
column10: This delice Meguez a is way too expensive, and doesn't come close the original North African Merguez!Merguez is not french it is North African (Algeria, Morocco, Tunisia). If you have a North African butcher in the area you can buy it from them for cheaper.
I ordered one package and wished I had ordered about four more.  They were delicious.  I liked the simple instructions for preparing them, too.
Have you ever visited Paris? Eaten a sausage outside the Versailles Palace? French street food at its best. Takes me back to France every time I eat these yummy sausages. Now I must perfect the bun!

This was a mistake by Amazon.  I purchased this thinking it was organic.  Because it is titled as Organic Fair Trade Certified.  Well, it is Fair Trade & that is wonderful!  But NOT organic!  Not so wonderful.  I contacted Amazon & my money was refunded.  I rated this with 4 stars because of it's Fair Trade certification.  Fair trade means labors get paid a fair wage for their work.  Many don't & get mere change a day for 18 hours of labor.  If you have a choice between fair trade or not fair trade, please choose fair trade.  Yes, it usually costs more but it's the right thing to do.  I feel it's kind of like giving to charity.  Frontier makes wonderful spices & are worth checking out if your interested!

column9: Beware: This is not organic and can't be returned!
column10: OK, this is a great price on organic vanilla extract, normally it would cost twice, maybe even three times as much.  But, it is not orgainic!  Look carefully at the picture.  The label for the Frontier organic vanilla is red at the top with the word "Organic" written on it.  This bottle has a label that is gold at the top with the words "All Natural" written on it.  The left side of the orgainic bottle has the USDA orgainic seal on it, this bottle does not.  Without the certification seal, a product is not certified organic.  The bubble-wrap that the bottle comes in has a white label with the words "Frontier Organic Fair Trade Certified Vanilla Extract", on it, but anyone can make one of those.  Since Amazon refuses to refund my money, not because I am late, but because for some undisclosed reason this vanilla is "not eligable" for return, I am stuck with it.  Don't let this happen to you!!!!

I do have to say thiat I wish this was done in the largest jars, as I feel about 2 medium apples is all that is in the jar; and I have dried my own apples for many years.Hmmmmm --- maybe 3 apples, I will go higher on that one, but still feel, as it is apples, we should get the larger jar.  Good tasting and wonderful cut up and used in a gorp for the kids!

This product rocks.  I've tried all the brands on the market and this is the easiest to work with and the flavor is really good.  Doesn't fall apart when you cook it.  Directions are simple.  Flavor is the best!

column9: Ziyad Falafil Mix is the best
column10: This has been my favorite for more than 10 years.  During  that time I've tried many others, but the flavor of this was always better.  I've noticed the price fluctuate quite a bit on amazon, so try to order whenever a box of 6 is less than $20 and then buy two to get free shipping!  I had to wait a few weeks for the 2nd box, but the first arrived in 5 days.

the very first package i bought was good and flavorful but then I ordered a box which has 6 packages and was so exited to get them and thought they would taste the same  but noooooooooooo I was so wrong they tasted really like animal food I dont know why or what happened, now I have box of falafel that I cant eat. I will never buy it again.

I have trouble finding falafil mix in my local stores, so I was very happy to see this available on Amazon.  Casbah mix (my favorite) is quicker to prepare -- absorbs water for 10 minutes rather than 30 for Ziyad, but Ziyad seems to make more falafil per package.  It tastes great deep fried, and pretty good baked.  Just spray the baking pan with non-stick spray, then spray the patties and bake at 375 til done.  Much lower in calories and fat, terrific with sesame Tahini and hummus.  The package also contains recipes for low-carb breaded chicken and vegetarian chili using the mix.

I took a chance; it was the first time I tried a kit wine ( I make mine from fuit etc.).  This wine is sooo good my wife and I were constantly testing it before it was finished clarifing.  It makes 6 gallons but after all the tasting we only were able to bottle about 4 gallons.  This is great fruity tasting and refreshing wine.  If you don't want your kit I'll buy it from you.  Our stock is running low.

My wife and I made this kit and it is extremely simple to make. We added 2 lbs of dextrose to the primary and aged it for 2 months. I was pleasantly surprised when we tried this on bottling day. It is sweet and fruity, plus it had the ABV that we were hoping for. I highly recommend this kit.

I usually purchase wine kits from the local winery but thought I'd take a chance considering the price difference and boy was I glad I did. The wine is absolutely delicious... I have been making lots of different varieties for my upcoming wedding and will have to buy more of this as it will not make it till the wedding. I am subscribing for sure!!!! The labels are great and you just can't go wrong with the price. I am about to bottle the Moscato and have the Strawberry White Merlot in fermenting right now... Give it a try you will not be disappointed!!!

We prefer a sweeter dessert type wine and all the Cornucopia kits we have done (and we have made several) have proven to be to our liking. Sweet wines with very good flavors. We also enjoy the lower alcohol content these kits tend to have and that they don't over power the flavor. If you like a bit more alcohol, it's easy to boost that with a little corn sugar when you start.Having done a number of kits now, it's hard to beat the price on the Cornucopia kits. Other kits don't include corks, labels and foil wraps and are more expensive. Another bonus for us has been time. The Cornucopia kits are done and ready to bottle well within the 4 week time while "other brand" kits have run longer than the 4 weeks to bottling.

This was the first wine that I've made as a beginning wine maker.  The instructions were clear and even though I didn't follow them exactly to a "T", the wine turned out fantastic.  It might be a little sweet for some people but it's wonderful for me and my wife.  We gave a bottle to our next door neighbor who makes his own wine from grapes that he buys from Napa Valley and he and his wife love it- (they are real italians!).  I'm going to buy more of these.  Just so you know, you need to already have some basic wine equipment.  I mistakenly thought it came with the carboys, hoses, etc...  it comes w/ labels, seals, corks and all the ingredients, but that is it.  Still, a great price for 27 bottles of wine that taste delicious!

I bought this kit and am very pleased with the results.It fermented out to try rather quickly and after adding the F-Pack and finishing the process it turned out really nice and refreshing.  It is a rather sweet wine with very fruity notes.Great Value!!!

This wine was very, very sweet. The kit was super easy, so I have no complaints about the product. It came with everything you need minus fermentation equipment, and had easy instructions. I'm really just giving it a low rating because of the sweetness. If you like sweet wines, you will probably like this too.

This was my first wine kit, it was easy to understand and easy to use. I am about one more week from completing it so I cannot yet comment on the taste. I have to admit before I bought this kit, i didn't realize you also need to purchase all of the necessary wine making equipment.  I really like the fact that the kit includes all the ingredients for the wine in addition to the corks, labels, and sleeves for the bottle necks so that the finished product looks very professional and can be given as gifts, some of the more expensive wine kits from other manufacturers do not include those extra items.

The kit is great. This is the 3rd kit I have made, it is easy to follow the instructions.  I am new to making wines and this is a really good kit to learn by.  The product is quite tasty and is just as good as a  tropical fruit wine that I purchased at the store to get an idea of what I would be making.  I like this better than the store bought one.
This is one of the best wines so far my wife ins in love with it. And our friends can't get enough.
i have never made a wine before but i have made a lot of beer, do i need to purchase anything else with this or does it include everything i need?

this kit was nice to work with. but do not go over 5.25gal or when you put last bag in there not room for it in a 6gal. carboy . i made it at 5.5gal and when i put the sweet bag there was not room for all of it. i think it will be ok.i bottled last night nice fruit sweet love it

I purchased this wine a while back, directions are great. Only problem I had was opening the bags of concentrate! Very difficult, other than that when bottling the wine the flavor is great! We're waiting about 2 months to really let the flavor set in. Everyone at work wanted some wine, thinking this will have to be purchased again soon for a new batch!
I haven't made this yet, but I am anxiously awaiting to since it sounds like it's going to be so great!
I like Cerelac product, they tast good and have a lot of variety. my daughter like is better than any other brand. thank you Amazon for bringing this item.

I grew up in Malaysia on Nestum/Cerelac products. So when I was able to find it here in the US, I didn't hesitate to get it for my baby. He loved it more in his milk then as a 'meal.' Plus I know how rich in nutrients this is & from the time he was born, my husband & I stressed on healthy; nutritionally beneficial foods.

column9: Sweet and delicious--great added to iced tea.
column10: I decided to try this for the diabetics in the house, and now we *all* drink it.  In the summer, I like to add a half a packet to unsweetened iced tea to make half-and-half lemonade tea.  I can't say enough about how great these are--even better than using TrueLemon packets and Splenda to make lemonade, since the True Lemonade flavors use Stevia in lieu of sugar.
Very delicious for an instant Stevia sweetened lemonade! Fast Delivery! The Lemon flavor is just right, not overpowering on the sweetness like some of the instant teas on the market.
Very good product, not overly sweet or tart. Low calorie, all-natural. It's a lighter taste than most lemonade mixes, and very refreshing.

I really like this product.  It is wonderful to have a drink mix with no carbs-no cane sugar that contains only natural sweeteners.  I really don't like the aftertaste associated with "diet" products--and I really cannot detect any in True Lemon drinks...it just tastes like lemonade!  It comes in those little packets like another well known crystal diet drink.  This is really convenient because you can carry it around in your purse-dump it in your waterbottle, make individual servings or, if you like, make a pitcher-full.  I like the raspberry one the best-can't wait to try their iced tea mix.
My all time favorite tea.  I was thrilled to discover that I can buy it year round (stores only carry it during the holidays).
I buy this by the case just like the previous reviewer. All of my family loves it. I drink it all year round. My grandchildren especially expect some during Christmas. It is soooooo yummmmmy!

This is my favorite tea.  I buy quite a bit around Christmas since it gets expensive in the middle of the year.  It is a peppermint softened up with a slight vanilla flavor.  In the spring and summer, I drop a bag into a pitcher of water to make a diluted sun tea.  The tea is almost like a mint flavored water and is very refreshing served iced.

This is my favorite holiday tea! I love this flavor even more because it's not just a strong peppermint! It's a sweet peppermint and Celestial Seasonings also added the perfect amount of vanilla and cinnamon, so perfect this the first tea I ever tried in my life that does not need sugar or anything added to it! It's so yummy this tea tastes just like a candy cane! And since it's decaf I can drink this anytime of the day! My local grocery store was selling these so I bought a few boxes to last me through winter! But the more cups I drank the more I loved it! I went back to back to the grocery store to stock up year round but they were already sold out :( I'm so glad I can still get this on Amazon! I highly recommend this tea if your a candy cane/peppermint fan! :)

This is my favorite tea of all time. I drink many different varieties including teavana and other loose leaf gourmet teas and teabags, and this one is still my favorite. It is great to drink all year and not just during the holidays.
I buy at least a case of this tea every year so I have some all year long and for gift giving.  Most of the people who have received it say that they enjoy it too.

There is a lot of variability in the quality of macadamians, even from the same producer.  I've only received one bag of these, but they are perfect.  I've run across many that have had varying degrees of bitterness, usually accompanied by an unnaturally hard consistency, as though they had been harvested too early.  Not these.  They have perfect consistency and flavor.  The vast majority are whole as opposed to halves or smaller pieces.  [Update:  I've now ordered about 8 bags over a period of about a year.  The quality has be consistently excellent.}I use macadamia nuts as a regular part of my diet.  They preferentially reduce bad cholesterol due to their high content of monounsaturated fats.  They are low in carbs, and have very few simple carbs, so they will not only take the edge off your appetite, they will help keep it off.  Unlike most nuts, they are low in oxalate, which means regular use will not increase the risk of kidney stones.  (Pistachios and walnuts are also low in oxalate.)  The only catch is that their high healthy fat content means high calorie count per unit volume.  To dodge that bullet, I just ration them out as opposed to absentmindedly eating from a large container.This is a great product.  I'm happy to give them yet another 5-star review.

Vegan. Natural. Kosher. Gave as a gift to someone who really appreciates high quality macadamias. Very positive response. "Best quality" mac nuts (and this is from someone who has been to Hawaii frequently and has sampled many "macs" in her time.) This review is out there for those for whom this makes a difference. See all of my reviews for more great choices. Check out "Vegan Grocery Favorites" and "Vegan Grocery Top Ten" in Listmania. Your "helpful" votes count and will be greatly appreciated to benefit the search of others. Thank you.

column9: The absolute BEST, BUT.....they're always running out of stock.  Annoying.
column10: I've tried a lot of macadamias and these are, by far, the freshest and best-tasting of them all.  It'll cost you a little more, but it's worth it. The downside is the fact that they're always running out of stock.  I've read many posts outside of Amazon referencing these nuts and they're quality, so it's not like the market isn't there.  That being said, if you're not addicted to mac nuts it won't drive you crazy; just pick them up when you see them.  Maybe it's a marketing ploy, like the whole "tickle-me elmo" fiasco a while back, but that's a conspiracy for another day.

These are great tasting macadamias. I refuse to pay the outrageous price for these nuts at my grocery store and since my Sams Club doesn't carry them for some reason any more, I decided to try these out. Very good. I'm very happy I could buy a salt-free version as the store brands are too salty for me. I'll be buying these again!!!
I had to hide these in the garage to stop everyone from wolfing them down.  Yummy Yummy
Whole family loves Azar Macadamia nut- Thanks a lot!will buy again! must underlined - no salt added - very special Thanks for this effort!!!!

These Azar nuts, in my judgment, are the best out there.  Excellent overall taste and texture and roasted just the right amount.  I highly recommend these nuts but suggest holding off on purchase until the price is lowered.  They just jacked the price up close to 40%! At the former price, these are the best and also also an excellent value.
This are the best macadamia nuts I have ever purchased online or in a store.  The nuts are fresh and are in whole pieces.  Will definitely be buying more!  YUMMY

These are some of the best macadamia nuts that I have eaten.  The nuts are big and not a lot of small pieces.  They are fresh and have lots of flavor.  I think the packaging helps keep them this way.  32 ounces is a lot of nuts for the money. I have purchased four bag of these nuts and will continue to buy them as long as they are available.

These nuts are indeed  fresh and very delicious.  The resealable package works well. Despite a long journey from my package forwarding company in the US, the nuts arrived  intact.  Unlike some major brands, they not at all greasy.  I will definitely order these again.
The quality of the nuts is ok, but no where as good or as cheap as Costco use to sell.We added the sea salts ourselves, somehow they don't seems to taste as good.
The product is frest and salt free as expected.  Price is still on the high side.  See you can be more competitive in the near future.

These are the best macadamias I've had! The right hardness with a crunchy start and soon after a feeling of them melting away in your mouth :) Great flavor, with no bitterness, excessive oil-ness, etc. And as if that wasn't enough, they're unsalted! That means you're not only getting more healthful nuts, but also getting to taste the real nut (rather than a whole bunch of salt). And the price seems good too (although I haven't really comparison-shopped).
Big bag of fresh, unsalted macadamia nuts. Nicest ones I've ever bought. I add a little seasalt if I want for a snack. Great value.
Grab it when it's available.  Can sell out. Rarely a bad nut. They aren't overcooked like some mac nuts I have bought at Costco. Great tasting and very fresh.

I'm a recent convert to Bahlsen cookies, and these little wafers are a standout among a product line that's hard not to love.  The crisp. toasty, slightly nuttly wafers surround a very light, not-too-sweet creme layer; the combination is an incredible, multi-dimensional treat that would pair nicely with coffee or milk.  The only thing I would think that would make this product better is a resealable package, but the wafers aren't going to last long once opened anyway.  The package size is good in the sense that it's enough to share with one or two other people, but if you eat the whole thing yourself it's not an utter disaster ;)

These crackers are a great way to get whole wheat into your diet & into children's.  They are low in fat & sugar, and they taste great.  I haven't met a child yet who doesn't like them.  The ingredients are good as well.

1.  I love  Amazon's grocery/makeup/cleaning products subscription service.  It is only beta now, but I truly hope they will continue it.2.  This cookie is amazingly delicious.  I like sweets that aren't too sweet, with just the right hint of sugar.  These are cookies just like that.  Like Creme Brulee -- barely sweetened, but if it is done right, the sweetness makes it the best food in the world.  I'm not saying these cookies are Creme Brulee, but maybe they approach the creme brulee of cookies.
The Bahlsen Delobas are my favorite so far. Call them biscuits or call them cookies they are just plain good. Light and pastry like with a nice burst of sweetness from the red current jam. Try Them!

I had these cookies in Germany, but I had a hard time finding them in the US.  I was amused to discover I could order them from Amazon.  They seem to be most closely related to pecan sandies, but they're a little richer and a little moister.  I wish it were possible to order a single box instead of 12, but I already knew I liked them, so ordering 12 wasn't really a problem.  A bigger problem is trying not to eat them all immediately.
Great texture and balance of sweet to butter is just about right. Adults and kids both love them. Recommended

column9: These cookies are $2.19 in my SuperMarket
column10: We were buying Bahlsen cookies at $1.70-$2.19 at lockal supermarket until I found that they are $1.41/box here at Amazon!

If you love the heavenly combination of chocolate and orange, then thisis a cookie to try.  Gotta have your coffee and treat everyday like moi.Well this plays well with coffee. Yum gonna have some right now....
The title says it all! These butter biscuits are DIVINE! Everyone loves them--my parents, my students, my colleagues, and, of course, me! You will love them, too!

These cookies are fabulous. Flaky, not too sweet, fluffy not gooey layers. Small but not too small. Suggested serving size of 6 is good. Lots of things these days have completely unrealistic serving sizes. I know they have sat fat but I really don't care. I have been unable to find anything like them. They remind me of REAL bakery cookies.

These are every bit as good as the other two reviewers stated. Awesome butter cookies!!! There's a lot of butter taste in these cookies and they're not overly sweet. Just right! I'll be buying again when the 12 pack runs out. Amazon please make sure you keep these in stock on a continuing basis!

column4: A Research It Maven "Just the facts please"
column10: These Bahlsen Butter Leaves are the best cookies! Not too sweet, not greasy, soooo "just right!" Order extra! They go fast!
I love this chocolate covered cookies. The chocolate is pure and tasty. Not too sweet.

These cookies didn't disappoint.  They are delicious and go really well with a cup of tea or coffee.  They have just the right amount of sweetness...not cloying.  (I think American desserts usually go overboard on sugar).  I highly recommend them.
Love these tea biscuits. The price was great for a box of 12. I hope you continue to carry.

i tried bahlsen chocolates in europe, but you can't find them very often in the states. these are unlike any usa chocolates i've eaten, the wafer is wrapped over itself 4-5 times. you can't beat the crunch these make, delicious.

Many of Bahlsen's cookies are too sweet and floury for my taste, but these light flaky cookies don't taste stale and are not too rich but are nice and do not taste like sugared cardboard.  I don't crave these but when you eat them, you realize that these are better than the average boxed cookies and unexpectedly delicate and fresh tasting given the supermarket price.

The title says it.  Some of the cookies arrived with the chocolate melted.  Others were stuck together or had the wafer separated and stuck to the chocolate top of the cookie below.  It appears that the box was a little overheated and banged around somewhere along the way here.  It was 65F here when the package was delivered.

Having grown up on these cookies I was pleased to see that they now come in the more healthful whole wheat version.  Same great taste...light on the sugar...even my husband who hates sweets will eat these with his ice cream.

Rich, dark chocolate thinly covering a tart orange marmalade-like substance on a soft sponge cookie. It melts in your mouth and leaves you wanting more. Chocolate and orange are an addictive combination.  There are other brands out there of these sponge cookies, but the Bahlsen brand is by far tops in the quality of the ingredients used.

Have always enjoyed Balsen products. Found  the nuss-dessert cookies while on vacation at Sanibel Island Florida. We were really excited to find them on Amazon, we had searched through out the Chicago area since last April.They are the best. Taste like fresh hazelnuts and are great with either coffee or tea. (or later with wine).So good that I bought a case, but they are reserved for special moments(like now).

This is without a doubt the most incredibly addictive packaged cookie in the world. The dark chocolate dipping at one end is a great contrast to the rolled wafer of the cookie itself. Why did I ever buy a whole case! Bless Amazon for carrying the Bahlsen line of fabulous cookies because it is not available in Montana.

If you are looking for a sweet, try this cookie.  It is extra lightand has a nice crunch to it.  I buy these cookies by the carton.They last for one month between my husband and I.  He likes cookieswith his morning coffee.  We are both satisfied with these cookies.Would buy them again and again.Mary
These are soo good with a nice cup of coffee. They are light, buttery and very flavorful with the finely chopped nuts.
better than grahm crakers and they do not spike your blood sugar (at least not mine.)

Once you try this piece of chocolate you will fall in love with it. Probably one of the best nonbar chocolates produced in Switzerland and Europe as a whole. And I think it is rather cheap for the quality you get.
We've ordered for them every month and only once the package inside the seal had a small hole and wasn't as fresh.

The first time had these cookies was when I visited NYC.  One box of these cost me around $7, so when I found these on amazon.com for about $1.40 per box, I was so exstatic!  I could eat an entire box without feeling full of sugar or guilt.  Perfect with tea as I am not a coffee fan.  There are several reviews that I have read that were complaining about the number of boxes they received (12)- it says right in the product title how many boxes come in the order!  Do people really not read anymore then turn around and have the gall to give a bad review just because out of pure stupidity they failed to read what they were actually ordering?  I am appaled by some people's idiocy until I remind myself that I live in the United States.  Besides, why would anyone complain at $1.40 per box?  I HIGHLY recommend these to anyone, I would give 10 stars if I could.  Oh, and be glad they come in shipments of 12 boxes, they will be gone before you know it!  Thank you, Amazon!

My husband and I have been buying these cookies locally for years because we love them so much; they are far better than the milk chocolate version (but then, we love DARK chocolate!). In the past couple of years, our local grocer has stopped carrying them, we would request them, they would get them for a few months, and then they would stop carrying them again. I am so glad to see that I can get them via amazon.com! These are wonderful cookies with warm milk, cold milk, or a little Scotch . . . mmmmmmm!
This product was delivered on time and included more than I thought I was going to get - a full 16 packages. I first purchased these in England and have loved them ever sense.

column9: I love these cookies. Found them in Sherman .Texas need them in Centennial.Co. Albertsons had them in Sherman.  Sssooo good!!
column10: Will always buy these if I can find them. Hate to have to buy from Germany. Need a grocery store.
I was not very happy when i recieved my order. All the cookies were melted. Very good product. Word of advise. Don't buy any products in the summer time that will melt.
I grew up eating these cookies.  Got a case for a great price.  Will be looking for them again this fall.

Leibniz cookies are truly my favorite, beyond what I make, I am a passionate cook. The whole wheat version of these are particularly superb with a subtly greater flavor than the original and a lovely, slightly more crumbly and grainy texture. It has been a wonderful discovery. Bon appetit.

column9: Great cookies--don't buy in the summer
column10: These are positively the most delicious cookies ever--smooth milk chocolate covering meringue biscuits.  However, when we received them--albeit in the Texas summer--they were fused together in the packaging. They are now not only less attractive, but also hard to eat.  So I would not recommend ordering these in the summer with the way they are packaged by Amazon.
It tastes perfect. I like it.You would "feel" the butter in the cookies.
Great cookies.  Not overly sweet as most American cookies can be, with a hint of citrus.  Could not ask for more.  There is only 12 or so cookies in the box, but a decadent treat.

column9: YUM- like a perfect Rice Crispy
column10: If Rice Crispy bars were made with good chocolate, and didn't taste like wax, they might taste like this.  Wow- What a yummy treat.  These are coated with a LOT of chocolate, and for me are more like a candy than a cookie (and I don't have a problem with that!)  I would not have wanted to order them in the summer, because I feel sure they would have melted.  The chocolate taste is wonderful, and I love the crunchiness.  The Sell By date is not until 9/2010 a full 8 months from today (1/21/2010), so I'm pleased with their freshness.  I don't think they will last very long in our house, but still, it's nice they are fresh.  These are packed very well, so they should not arrive crumbled or damaged in any way.  My cookies are perfect.  If you like crunchy chocolate treats this is for you!  Delicious!

column9: Great- and good Sell By date
column10: I'll start with something really important to me- the sell by date.  I bought these cookies in January of 2010, and they are good until 9-2010, which is important to me, since I hate eating rancid food, so I just throw it out.  I've always loved these cookies, and my market sells them for much more than the subscribe price, so I'm happy to subscribe and save.  I love currants, and it's hard to find things flavored with them.  I have to admit, the currant taste is not strong, but they are delicious anyway, and I love the puff pastry.  Further, I'm allergic to GMO corn starch (genetically modified corn starch)- and just try to find cookies in US stores without corn starch (and 95% of all corn is modified in the US, and does not have to be labeled so).  So these are a real treat for me- since they are a cookie I can actually eat.The cookies are flaky, as puff pastry always is, and slightly sweet.  As other people have said, this is not a terribly sweet cookie, but it is quite sweet enough.  I enjoy mine with tea, and I also take them in my lunch.  If you take them in your lunch, put them in a little box- because they ARE delicate, and you might end up with delicious crumbs if you don't protect them.  I know this because I squashed them once.

This very crispy sugar wafer is perfect with ice cream, or with coffee or tea.  It's got a lovely burnt marshmallow flavor.  I really like these- they seem to harmonize with anything.  I'm allergic to GMo cornstarch, so it is hard for me to find cookies I can eat.  This one is lovely, and it's safe for me to eat.

These have a delicate, nutty, warm, faintly sweet wheat flavor, and a pleasing texture.  Satisfying without guilt, they're truly addictive.  I prefer them to digestives (much less Graham crackers), and even Leibniz's standard butter biscuits don't come close.  The whole wheat is especially good with green and pouchong teas - though predictably satisfying paired with a cup of Assam or English Breakfast. Also great with cocoa or milk, cheese or apples.... a slather of peanut butter..... !They're one of the few biscuits I'd definitely offer to children.
these cookies are a perfect treat....very light and crunchy wafer sweetened by  the right amount of chocolate....great price and fast service

If you've had these cookies already - no one needs to sell them to you. I would just recommend that you keep them in the freezer. That way they're sort of hidden from you (and others) but for some reason freezing them brings out the taste and consistency of the chocolate. Try it!

column9: Bahlsen Dark Chocolate Cookies -  A Treat
column10: I don't know what Bahlsen was thinking over the last several months, but I looked high and low for these cookies in supermarkets and specialty stores...none were to be found. Then, after checking with Amazon (and its tracking mechanisms), Voila! I ordered a whole case and that should satisfy our deep appreciation of these cookies... a perfect blend of high quality dark chocolate and a crisp, thin "chocolate vehicle"--i.e., cookie.

These are great!  And they can get to be habit forming if you are not careful.  I bought the whole case, because you save overall  versus going to the supermarket.  Very rich dark chocolate, crisp cookie.  Worth every penny.  Oreo, eat your heart out!

These cookies are just wonderful!!! The chocolate is deep, dark, rich and melts very nicely in your mouth.  I would say that it is a bittersweet chocolate and very finely made. These cookies give the chocolate lover a satisfying chocolate experience. Do not hesitate to buy them!

These appear to be, on first glance, similar to Nutter Butters.  On taste, however, they are lighter, more delicate, and infused with hazelnut.  There is more air in the cookie, so when you dip it in coffee, it becomes saturated rather quickly and the cookie folds into your mouth, with the sweet center taking center stage.  Nuff said.

I am very happy with Amazon service including the speedy shipment. I am also very happy the product Amazon is carrying. This product is only available in selected specialty stores in the area. And tend to be expensive. Sometime they only carry small selection in store. You have to wait long time for a special order. Amazon is making the product available with a wide selection of variaty and affortable. Thanks.

A light and crisp flaky cookie surrounding a brightly flavorful nugget of jam. The only problem - I can eat a whole box without stopping to breathe! And buying them by the case makes them very affordable. My next order is already in...

I first had these cookies at our Oktoberfest where they were giving out samples.  I loved them and could not find them at World Market so I went to the internet and found them available at Amazon. They are very light and flaky.
When we couldn't find these in our local grocery store anymore, we were very glad to find them available through Amazon. these are light and delicious and a true treat!

column4: A Research It Maven "Just the facts please"
column9: Rich, but delicate,  hazelnut (filbert) cookies that everyone likes !
column10: Buy more than one box - these disappear fast! Bahlsen Biscuits are elegant, impressive, and delight everyone. I keep some on hand for unexpected guests and these "Hazelnut Biscuits" have never disappointed anyone! (Betcha YOU could eat a whole box yourself!)

column9: Oh, so very very very VERY good
column10: I LOVE these cookies.  Most cookies are too sweet for me -- not these.  However, since they follow the  European trend of using  natural ingredients, they are full of saturated fat from butter and cream.WHO CARES?They are the best cookies, for me, in the world, comparable only to"Feullitees Doree," which can be bought on in France.

I bought these cookies for myself and as a gift for my dad for his birthday. Unfortunately, 2 out of 4 of the boxes I gave my dad as a gift had mostly broken cookies, and were stale tasting. Not a great gift idea, and not really packaged or handled well. I have bought the delice cookies in the past and had no problems other than a random broken cookie in a box. I have not opened all of the boxes yet of course, but will hope to find a couple that are not all broken up to give to my dad.

I really like these cookies.  They are made with pastry dough - lots of thin, flaky, crispy layers with a very light coating of honey (or something like honey).  The jelly center rounds the cookie out with a delicious bite of sweetness. It's a robust burst of flavor that makes you want to smile. I am rapidly getting addicted to these fine flavorful confections -- bet you can't eat just one!

I am an adventurous person who likes new things and when Amazon began selling the Bahlsen line I tried a number of their products and found them to be enjoyable and tasty, but the Hannover Wafer Cookies are, to my palate, rather bland and tasteless. The texture is pleasing, though a little grainy tasting and the creme filling has little flavor. They're very high in saturated fat, and  devoid of flavor..Think I'll stick with the Bahlsen Delobas'.

Bahlsen Butter Cookies,4.4-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12)Very Disappointed with your service and deceptive listing of the product ingredients. i am allergic eggs and as per your listing, there is NO mention of eggs and when i received the product, on the box the cookies one of the ingredient is EGG.Also i emailed not send me any cookie with EGGS

Bahlsen Delice Cookies, 3.5-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12)Very Disappointed with your service and deceptive listing of the product ingredients. i am allergic eggs and as per your listing, there is NO mention of eggs and when i received the product, on the box the cookies one of the ingredient is EGG.

column9: Hazelnut (Filberts) in a fragile crescent shaped tea cookie.
column10: Delicate ground hazelnut cookies for a Ladies tea, NOT for children or most men! Appreciated only by sophisticated palates, because they are neither cloyingly sweet or fatty. Set these aside for unexpected guests you'd like to impress.

Amazon sends you TWELVE boxes of these fabulous cookies and each box disappears FAST - in fact, DO NOT sit down with the whole box nearby or you will munch thru all of them without stopping! They are delicately sweet, crunchy, and buttery - without being at all greasy. You've been warned!
Anyone that hasn't tried this product should, it absolutely the best if you are a tea drinker
This tea is fantastic - but this is a TERRIBLE DEAL. Check out another site for a better price.  You shouldn't pay more than $14.00 for a 24 count box of this green tea.

My daughter-in-law, Tyra, and I were recently at Lincoln City on the Oregon Coast, and were checking out of a store when I spied the Tillamook Pepperoni sticks.  I bought a couple for both of us and we couldn't stop talking about how good they were!  I decided then and there that I would search out the container with these tasty pepperoni sticks.  And, lo and behold!  I found the exact kind here on Amazon, AND I got the last pack of 24.  Waiting now for a new shipment.  Was planning to hold out and give the entire box to my daughter-in-law for Christmas, but I couldn't resist.  So, now I'm waiting for more to show up here. And, just so you know...there is a big difference in these that come in the container, and those that are individually wrapped in the plastic that pulls open from the top.  These are more on the dry side and not moist with some kind of something or other that inside the plastic.  Not nearly as good, but also from Tillamook.My favorite way to eat these salty, spicy, savory sticks is with an apple.  Juicy, sweet Fuji apple and bites of this pepperoni.  Yum!

Tillamook pepperoni and beef sticks are the best ever. the taste has you begging for more and more.I wish they sold them locally. they simply have a great smoke taste and aree mild that they don't give you heartburn.

This was my first time ordering rice paper and I didn't know what brand to pick so I was kind of nervous at first.  The product arrived much faster than I had expected and it was exactly what I had needed.  The price was good too so I was quite pleased with the experience and would definately continue to order this item in the future.

I recently started a new medication and unfortunately one of the side effects was dry mouth. My doctor recommended I try sugar free lemon drops to help alleviate the discomfort of dry mouth. After doing some research I decided to give Brach's Sugar Free Lemon Drops a try. I was a bit hesitant ordering a whole box of these lemon drops without knowing how they would taste, what the after-taste would be like and even if it would work. After having used them for couple of weeks, I wholeheartedly recommend this product. I keep a bag in mine and my wife's car, one at work, in my night stand drawer and in a candy dish in the kitchen. My wife usually hates the taste of most sugar-free products because of the after-taste, but I was surprised when she said she really liked these! Give these a try if you too suffer from dry mouth and see if they work as well for you as they have for me.

column9: totally fooled my friends with this awesome cake
column10: This cake tasted as good as a home-made (or better!) cake but took 1/2 the time.Seriously. And I'm a total baking (as well as natural foods) snot!Not convinced of my credentials?You should see the rye, sourdough and challah breads out of my oven today.Not to mention the batches of cookies.The amount of flour and butter I go through on a weekly basis for cookies, cakes and breads would let you know: i'm the one person in 100 whom you'd classify as a good home baker. I'm definitely not a "mix" baker. And while baking my own birthday cake just seemed un-festive,  asking someone else to bake my cake seemed like it'd spell disaster.  But Someone else offered. And that Someone Else, not as comfortable with my cake pans as I, used Naturally Nora. And both of these baker "elves" agree: "it was delicious and easy to make." And from my guests' opinions,no one could tell the difference between this mix and home-made. Soooooo tasty. And the icing mixed up as a breeze.Next year, when I'm considering mixing up my own birthday cake or using a Naturally Nora Mix, the decision is easy. Nora. All the way.!You won't believe how easy and tasty it is.I'd show you a picture, but there's none left.

What a great idea! Nora's chocolate cake and yellow cake mixes are now staples in our kitchen. My daughter discovered that the chocolate cake mix makes great brownies if you decrease the baking time. She makes them for all her sleepovers and everybody thinks they are homemade. She also makes a wonderful coffee cake with the yellow cake mix, spreading a mix of cinnamon and brown sugar and cocoa over the batter and swirling it in with a knife. I'm delighted that she has started to bake on her own and that the ingredients are all natural -- Nora's mixes cost a little more than the artificial-ingredients mixes from Betty Crocker and Duncan Hines, but they are worth every penny. Highly recommended!Naturally Nora Sunny Yellow Cake Mix, 19.1-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)Naturally Nora Cheerful Chocolate Cake Mix, 19.1-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)

column9: this it makes a good cake but a better cupcake
column10: My wife loves this product because my four-year-old daughter loves to have "parties". We found this makes makes wonderful easy and natural cupcakes.
Very tasty!  This mix makes a moist, yummy cake.  We make our own cream cheese frosting with the chocolate cake and it's a winner!

I ordered this cake mix because it has less chemicals and especially for the lack of partially hydrogenated oils.  The reviews were very good and there was a coupon available so I thought I'd give it a shot.  Unfortunately, the cake is a little dry and the flavor is not as strong with chocolate flavor as I would like either.  I have baked it twice now...once as cupcakes and as a cake and the second time I even changed the milk to whole milk and used coffee for half of the liquid. It didn't seem to make much of a difference. It's definitely better than having no chocolate cake, but the flavor of Duncan Hines is more in line with what I'd like to taste. So, after I use the mixes (think I'll try to do less time than recommended for increased mositure)I am going to try and perfect a handmade version.  I had the VERY best chocolate cake at a cafe far from my home a couple of years ago and ever since I just can't get over it.  I hope to some day get close.If less chemicals and more convenience is essential for you, I think this is a good option. Just don't expect it to taste like the normal cake mixes.

I ordered this based on the glowing reviews and was so disappointed.  It is the blandest chocolate cake we have ever tasted.  I've made three boxes of it and always end up spitting out my first bite of the final product.  It also calls for a ton of eggs/oil.  It's just not good at all.  I do, however, love that it is natural.  I don't think "natural" should have to mean "bland", though.  In my opinion this needs a much stronger, richer chocolate flavor.  In my last batch I tried adding chocolate chips for some additional flavor and it did not do the trick.  Not sure what to do with the last three boxes.

Don't expect anything fancy with this cake mix; you have to buy this for the taste alone.  It rises unevenly, as do the other cake mixes I've purchased from Naturally Nora.  The flavor is subtle and sublime.  It's perfect with her chocolate frosting.  Good enough for birthdays or everyday.

I read about St. John's Wort from a herbal medical book, and bought some for my son. He is in college and is intense on getting good grades. With the difficult study load, his anxiety became worse. He tried a couple of the antidepressant/anti anxiety pills, but they had too many side effects including drowsiness, irritability and fatigue. So, I suggested he try this product. It was recommended in herbal literature I read to use the tea instead of capsule form and that is what I got.He drinks the tea while studying which also seems to help his concentration. Now a couple of his friends drink it. They all say that it works. I tried it just to see how it affected my son. I don't suffer from anxiety but am hyper. I think it does have a calming affect without annoying side effects. I would recommend this but start out with just one cup until you see how it will affect you.

We switched over to all Holistic dog food products after our 12 yr old mixed breed started itching,scratching,shedding and losing weight.  I can't say enough good things about the Holistic Select products.  Our dog has never been healthier or happier, no more scratching or shedding!  I highly recommend their products.

column9: Another tasty snack from Holistic Select!

column9: Daisy Loves These More Than Hot Dogs!
column10: I like to feed my dog healthy stuff but one dog trainer wanted me to bring "high currency" treats so I bought some hot dogs and Daisy certainly enjoyed them.However, she actually goes nuts over the Holistix way more than she ever did for hot dogs and I'm happier feeding them to her. Our shih tzu Piper had dental surgery to remove four broken teeth. Her dental surgeon vet blamed hard chew treats for the broken teeth. In hindsight some of the chews were so hard that I had to use a saw to cut them in half for sharing between the two dogs. The vet advised us to use the bend test. If the chew isn't flexible, don't give it to your dog.The Nylabone Healthy Edible passes the bend test. Looking at the bone-shaped treat, one would think it is a hard object and a long lasting chew. Piper and Gabby both like these chews. Depending on the dog, these treats can be long lasting without jeapardizing the teeth of the dog.Being a spudophile, I'm pleased that ingredient number four is potato starch. Despite the Nylabone name, these chews contain no plastic. Also lacking are sugar, salt, preservatives, and gluten. The ingredients are natural and it is edible and highly digestible as advertised. Our pooches give the American made Healthy Edibles their barks of approval.

These are great as a treat, but not as a chew. They are so well liked they don't last. column9: Made my dog throw up bad
column10: Our 14 lb Mini Schnauzer easily started splintering this bone in a matter of minutes and being an 'ever hungry' dog he just swallowed these pieces. column9: Love the cereal, don't care for the new, small size
column10: I am on the record in several reviews here at Amazon as saying that in my experience, which is pretty good with mueslis in the US and Europe, Dorset Cereals make the best mueslis anywhere. I truly enjoyed this great blend that concentrates on sunflower and pumpkin seeds for a nutty flavor, and on raisins and date for sweetness.What I don't like is Dorset's new packaging in 12-ounce boxes. column9: Tone's Cumin, One of Our Favorite Seasonings
column10: We use Tone's Ground Cumin (16 oz) rapidly at our house.  We love Mexican food, and we like to use large amounts of cumin in anything we put chili in.I love the earthy taste.  While developing the recipes for The Collard Patch, we found that cumin goes wonderfully with collard greens.  We also like it with crawfish. Cumin is compatible with many flavors.Here is a popular recipe from The Collard Patch using cumin:  Crawfish Tortellini SaladIngredients½ cup thinly sliced green onions with tops1 small jar artichoke hearts, drained1 cup small fresh mushrooms1 cup large pitted ripe olives1 cup fresh red bell pepper, sliced1 cup thinly sliced carrots12 ounces frozen crawfish tails1 cup olive oil1 teaspoon salt-free Creole seasoning½ cup red wine vinegar¼ cup lemon juice1 tablespoon spicy mustard1 teaspoon Splenda®¼ teaspoon crushed red pepper½ teaspoon freshly ground black pepperSalt substitute to taste1 tablespoon minced garlic1 teaspoon cumin1 tablespoon fresh parsley, chopped1 tablespoon fresh basil, chopped1 cup seedless golden raisins1 package (14 ounces) cheese tortellini4 ounces (¼ cup) feta cheese4 cups tender baby collard leaves, chopped4 cups Romaine lettuce, torn into small piecesPreparationPlace the first 6 ingredients in a big bowl.Place ¾ cup olive oil in the blender.  Add the vinegar, lemon juice, mustard and all the remaining powdered seasonings.  Blend until it is well mixed.  Stir in the parsley and basil.Pour the blended dressing over the ingredients in the bowl and marinate them covered at least 2 hours in the refrigerator.Sauté the crawfish in ¼ cup olive oil and Cajun seasoning about 5-7 minutes.  Even though there will be other seasoning mixed with the tortellini, each individual crawfish needs its own spiciness.  You don't want those crawfish to get lonesome.  After you sauté them long enough to catch the seasoning, set them aside to cool.Cook the tortellini according to the package directions.  Cook it al dente.  Drain it in the colander and allow it to cool.Toss the crawfish, tortellini, and raisins with the vegetable mixture.When you serve the salad, place it over the greens.  Garnish it with feta cheese.---Cumin is believed to help with digestion, to be a natural laxative, to relieve insominia, to help with bronchitis, and to prevent the common cold.

Cumin is such a wonderful background spice for a warm blend of tastes, like garlic, hot peppers, ground chile peppers, paprika, onion, turmeric, honey, maple syrup. . . and the list goes on. This package is the perfect size for keeping close to the stove, because it is so easy to handle - but difficult to find in that size. Amazon always has it, and even ships it to your door!

column9: Is it supposed to taste like this?

It had a delightful flavor - not as strong or overpowering as some of the other Altoids flavors. No - it was just right. Sweet, minty, but not too strong. Something I would always offer to visitors just because I knew they'd like it. (An analogy would be the flavor of Scope compared to regular Listerine. They still carry it. But, just last week, I went to the store and picked up my monthly stash. I noticed that there is a new banner printed on the top of the tin, "NEW GREAT TASTE! SAME PUNCH!"Well, today I finally used up the last of my old, trusty batch and popped into my mouth the first of the new tin, and I found out - to my horror - that they have totally changed the product in a manner that is most unpleasant. One, in the bottom of the cup, or a few in the coffee/tea pot makes life more interesting!  Also, good with just a touch of hot cocoa, added along with Altoids, in coffee.
