The only difference I could find was the older batch had a 2014 date on the bottom printed a little differently from the 2015 best by date the the new one....? I don't understand why this product has such inconsistent quality or maybe Newman's is not making the same quality product as they used to. Too bad since I would like to find a organic cat food that is not super expensive cause I'm not going to buy this one again.

The Newman's Own Organics 2nd Generation Turkey & Vegetable has changed the ingredients from Turkey Liver to Pultry Liver.This is not good if your cat is allergic to Chicken as ours is.The Newman's Own Organics Turkey & Vegetable original is no longer available.
Packing was not appropriate. The cardboard box was torn in several places. Cans were dented. One can had broken and leaked over at least 4 other cans causing a smelly mess. It was quite unpleasant.

My cats have eaten this wet food for years. (Newman's Own was one of the few safe-listed brands during the pet food from China scare.) We saw a significant improvement in their coats, weight and overall health. Our vet noticed, too. I love saving on this product through subscribing and Prime.

I am very happy with this product. Not only is it organic without any by-products but my 2 older cats love it! I bought a case shipped and sold by Amazon LLC so I got free shipping and a good price. Unfortunately when I tried to buy another case the next month Amazon was investigating a problem they were having with the shipping or something and so I am going to have to look elsewhere for my Newmann's Own cat food until they resolve the issue. I am pretty sad about that but otherwise the cat food is great!

column9: I wish this worked with our little darlings!
column10: I do all the research before buying pet food.  I had high hopes that this one would work with out kibble eating cats as one of them needed to eat food containing more moisture as well as healthy ingredients.  When I opened the first can it smelled and looked good.  I was confident our cats would scarf it up and beg for more.  No way.  They made dainty little burying movements and then walked away.  All I could think of was how much I had spent for such puny results.  Now we are back to using the top grade of kibble and Fancy Feast, which our cats will eat.  However, the good news is that everyone we gave some to from the first case reported back that their cats loved it and they were going to keep using it.  Fancy Feast is cheaper so that is good, but I have no idea what is in the product.  I just trust that our cats are getting enough moisture.  I do regret that we are not using  Newman's Own product since I like their philosophy.
Has a light brown color, "mousse" type texture, and my two rather non picky cats will eat about one bite of it.Fortunately we have four dogs to take up the slack.

I love the can size. I can use one per day rather than covering and refrigerating for the next day.  It is great because this food is supposed to go to the cat at room temperature.  Unfortunately,  I believe I checked when I was considering changing to these smaller cans and found that they are more expensive for the amount my cat eats per day than the larger cans.  The only reason I don't give this product a 5 can be remedied by either Newman's Own or Amazon.  I am a prime member but since subscribe and save does not use prime I have to double order.  There are 24 cans so prime once a month (regular shipping time vs. 2 day prime makes it longer than once a month) won't keep my cat feed for the month.  I don't understand why subscribe and save does not honor prime membership.  When customers choose subscribe and save they are giving Amazon long-term consistent business. I guess if Newman's Own packed 40 or 48 cans it would work better with subscribe and save.
It's organic and seems to be nutritious! Plus my cat really like this cat food. I'm pretty satisfied with my purchase!

I have two Siamese kittens who are on a mostly all canned food diet. The Chicken & Salmon formula is one of the foods in their current rotation. They seem to really enjoy eating it, although I wouldn't say it's their favorite food. You can see bits of the ingredients (rice?) in the food, and the texture is not too firm, but certainly more firm than a pate-style food. I have already ordered my second case, and plan to order more in the future. These 5.5 oz cans fit the Petmate Kitty-Kap Can Cover quite well.

column9: I loved that it was organic! My cat- not so much...
column10: I purchased the Chicken & Salmon formula with the notion that- Hey! I watch what I eat, My kitty should too! Needless to say, my cat Mia was less than thrilled. In fact, she took two wiffs and walked away :( Granted I was feeding her Fancy Feast before- which I recently found out is like feeding your cat Mcdonald's every day! Super tasty but void of any nutritional benefits whats-soever... So after a few unsuccessful meal times, I tried spiking her meal with a dash of Fancy Feast? No dice. She ate the Fancy Feast and I swear gave me this look like- 'Nice Try Bucco- and you thought you were SOOO sneaky...'So to the previous Fancy Feast feeders- I say maybe try something else to slowly get your cat onto the health track? Or you might end up like me with 20 cans of food I can't use :( I've been trying other brands that have more gravy- with slightly more success! (Emphasis on the slightly-she drinks up all the liquid and I'm left with chicken strips!) Maybe I have a oober picky cat? But I'm thinking I will keep on trying and probably give this one another run once I've detoxed her from her fast food craves..
This is a pricey cat food, but short of making my own, I don't think I've found a better food.  Brandon Farms is the only other organic food that compares.

I thought I was getting something special for my babies. It was marked down and I thought I was getting a steal. But I had second thoughts as soon as I opened the can. It looks like something you would spackle a wall with. Seriously, it has the consistency of paste. Thankfully, I have one cat that is my little garbage can and I know when he's really hungry that I can get rid of one of these Newman's Own Organic Beef cat food cans.

column9: Organic goodness for the furry ones
column10: I have been feeding my cats Newman's Own Organics Organic Beef and Liver for years now and their health is the better for it.  Whenever I go to the vet and mention that I'm feeding them this they have nothing but good things to say.  The kitties love it and their hairless ape of a dad loves it to... loves to watch them love it, I don't eat it myself... not yet.

I tried literally everything, from high end to low end, before settling on Newman's Own.  The reason?  All of my 5 cats enjoy the flavor (organic turkey) and come running when it is time to eat.  I feed them Newman's Own organic dry cat food as well, so their diet is about half and half.  I have one cat that suffers from IBS. She has to take prednisone daily, so I'm hoping the change in food will improve her condition.  Though Newman's products are expensive, I believe the organic ingredients will make a big difference in my cats' overall health, which in turn will mean fewer trips to the vet and more money in my pocket.  Besides that, I love the fact that there is strict quality control and oversight in everything that goes into a can or a bag, and all the proceeds from the sale of Newman's Own pet food are donated back to animal shelters and the SPCA.  No profit to me means that this company really does have the cats' welfare at heart.

column9: Great food !  My cat loves it.
column10: This product has worked out very well for us.  And the delivery was a breeze.  It arrived in 2-3 days.

This is for the Chicken & Brown Rice Canned Cat Food FormulaMy cat (now 15 yrs old) has always been a picky eater.  The only cat food he would eat consistently was Whiskas canned cat food. But alas, they discontinued that product line, switching to pouches and tubs (both of which he refuses to eat).  He will eat 9 Lives from time to time, but it gives him gas and appears to be high in fat (based on the pool of fat when can is dumped out in dish).  I have desperately tried numerous brands and flavors of cats foods for a number of years, but to no avail (Some brands and flavors I could get him to eat for a day or two, but then he refuses to eat it any longer).Then I came across Newman's Organic Chicken & Brown Rice at Dillon's Grocery (owned by Krogers) during a stay in Hutchinson, Kansas and he LOVES IT!  And, it appears to be fairly low in fat, which is a huge plus for an elderly cat with liver troubles (he currently has to be given Denosyl, which is also available on Amazon, to keep his liver in check).For those unaware, a cat with liver troubles is recommended to receive a low fat, low sodium diet, with no fish meal and no organ meat.  I've read online that vets recommend chicken and brown rice blended cat food. So, while I dont know exactly how much sodium, fat, and organ meat this product has (ingredients do list chicken liver, ocean whitefish, and sea salt), it appears to fit the bill (Ie: it doesnt have a pool of liquid fat when put in the dish) and so far my cat is doing well on this product (at long as I continue to medicate him with Denosyl, due to his liver disease - which helps protect the liver and keep the bile production down to a minimum).Unlike most other canned cat foods, he eats the entire can and begs for another!  Today he's eaten every bite of FIVE of the small 3oz sized cans!Ounce to ounce, it's a little more expensive than some canned cat foods, but well worth it in my opinion, especially since none of it is going to waste (whereas with other brands I have been going through 3-5 5oz cans of the other brands of cat food, twice a day - morning meal and evening meal - simply to find one that he will eat and then he only eats 1/2 to 2/3 of one of them for each meal, which makes for up to 9 wasted 5 oz cans a day!).  So, in the long run it's cheaper for me at least, and no headaches of trying to get him to eat something.I'm am extremely happy with the product and my cat is very happy with it as well.

Product Basics: My cat loves this stuff, although I only serve it once a week.  It's fairly consistent from can to can; to date, I've only opened one can that was "watery"-ish.  The texture is usually very thick and solid.Product Received, including Packaging & Delivery: Since a case will last several months, I was pleased to see the expiration date was well in the future.  The product arrived in a small box, packed with airbags to protect the item - not glamorous, but efficient.  The box was slightly dinged on one corner; one of the airbags had broken from the impact, but the product was protected.  No cans were damaged.  Delivery was quicker than I anticipated (took about a week).Amazon Experience: Amazon makes it easy to order this stuff; I've even arranged for automatic shipping (you can speed up or delay the next shipment, if you're worried about timing).  This is the best price I've found for this product.  Overall, I would buy this product from Amazon, again.
3 out of my 4 cats will not touch this.  Pretty pricey for alot of gravy & grain & little meat.
...even the one who is not fussy and will eat damn near anything.  They would even rather have dry food than this.  Not sure why they are so put off by it, but I won't be buying it again.

I went back and forth on getting my girls some of the beef flavored Newmans because 2 of the 3 can't eat chicken.  I am always looking for a good quality food to add to their rotation.  There was a pretty good sale on the beef flavored a few days ago so I bought it.  I opened a can to give them for their dinner and I absolutely could not give that to my girls!  It had an awful grey color to it and was the consistency of wall paper paste.  My cats like to chew their food not lick it up so I knew they would have an awful time with this one.  Newman's has changed.  I have tried most of the flavors over the years and I have noticed that the cans are underweight and seem to have almost as much rice as pate in them.  Will not be buying again but thank heaven for Amazon that always makes it right without any hassles.

column9: Makes ground turkey taste like real meatloaf
column10: Like many people, I'm eating a lot more ground lean turkey these days and less ground beef.  A package of this seasoning mixed with a 20 oz. package of ground turkey and ketchup instead of milk makes a pretty tasty meatloaf.  This seasoning is usually quite expensive at the grocery store, so I was pleased to find it at Amazon for a much more reasonable price.  The box that I got had an expiration date of about 18 months out -- plenty of time to use it up before it gets stale.
First, I am Japanese and this is my favorite!!!It's not so spicy so don't worry.mmm just Yummy....! You won't be able to stop eating this:)
I've been buying this for years, as mango pickle, not relish. It's the same thing, but this is cut in smaller pieces. It says it's mild, but that's by indian standards; it is somewhat hot.

this is my favorite of all patak's wonderful products . it is delicious and helps turn any veggies or rice into heavenly indian food. i mix it with rice, veggies and greek yogurt on a regular basis for a healthy quick meal . my grocery store stopped carrying it - THANK YOU  Amazon ...

Patak's Mango Relish is my favorite to add to Indian foods. Open the jar, take a whiff and I salivate. Not spicy, but chock full of flavor...intense. I like to chop up the mango into smaller pieces then mix well into whatever I am eating it with. This is hands down my favorite of Patak's relishes. Hard to find, I am going to order a six pack to have around for a while. Delicious!!!

column9: Good and not too spicy -- Just right if you don't like hot
column10: Mangos -- the number one fruit in the world -- are an integral part of Indian food.  Personally, I have deeloped a tolerance for really hot foods.  On a scale from one to ten, I'd put these at about a two or three.This mango relish is not mango chutney (which is a totally different product).  This relish has nice chunks of mango and most people can tolerate the moderate heat.  This is the relish I serve to guests.  Like most Indian relishes, chutneys and pickles, it doesn't take too much.  One jar is probably about 30 servings so do the math: six jars is 180 servings.

I just discovered Barry Farms rice, including the Brown Jasmine.  It was very good, flavorful.  Barry Farms is a pleasure to deal with.  My entire order included other brown rice types, each bagged individually in an airtight bag and then all of those bags inside another heavy duty plastic bag.  The box was full of the little foam pieces.  You could tell it was packed with care.  The order arrived pronto.  This is the first online company I have ordered gourmet food from and I have not been disappointed.  I will be back.

column9: The shipping killed me ---but man the rice is good!
column10: No doubt about it, this is great rice.  cooked up nice & starchy & tastes so good. Shortly after i bought this online i felt silly, thinking how dumb am i to spend that kind of $ of rice. Now that i've finally cooked it up & tasted the great quality i don't regret it at all....BUT...i will buy this at my local grocery store from now on after spotting it on the shelf in the organic/vegan section. With shipping included it was like $14 for 2 bags of rice on amazon. ouch!(i also bought barry farms brown basmati rice but haven't tried it yet. will be sure to review it once i do.)

column4: Tommie "An expert is a former drip under pres...
column10: I had bought my first container of Dynasty Five Spices to smell. I love the aroma! Then I started using it in my marinated cucumbers 'n' onions. Well, it doesn't last forever that way. I tried another brand of five spices but it didn't even begin to compare to Dynasty. There isn't anywhere around close where I can buy it so I was glad to find it on Amazon. True, the shipping is a little steep but I pay more than the total for spices in stores. This was worth it!
The product was such a great price, and it made my food taste so good.  I had a hard time finding this product elsewhere.
If you're looking for an unexpected way to spice up lots of dishes, this is a great start.  Makes Asian inspired dishes a breeze and adds flair to all kinds of dishes from salads to pastries.

I like Dynasty Chinese Five Spice as a product.  I use it in stir fry.  It is a strong flavoring that works well for me since I reduce my sodium intake. I wasn't able to find it locally when I ran out, so I decided to buy  the 6 pack choice thinking it should last for a year and a half or so.  In this case, the spices all came with a best used by 12/15/12 date.. 4 months only. I got.. old(er) spice.  Disappointing.

Best "healthy snack" chips available.  White Cheddar is preferred flavor, but note, they are not "Gluten Free".  Only Sea Salt flavor is "Gluten Free", which is good, but not as good as White Cheddar.

If you like white cheddar popcorn, you may love this transformation of it into an easy to eat chip that is low in fat and sodium. Only 130 calories per serving, it's a great snack for parties and healthier than potato chips.

I have tried many mixes and this is the best tasting, and probably best for me, mix I have tried.  I would give Red Mill a star less.This product also mixes well with other ingredients- like corn meal and corn, blueberries and nuts, and so on.  The mix plays well with other ingredients, is filling, and tastes great.  I have not had a better pancake (and I have tried a lot of mixes and made from scratch)in 20 years.

I'm always working to get whole grains into the family's diet.  The kids are sensitive to grainy textures and heavy flavors, and often they push back on whole wheat breads and pastas.  This pancake mix occupies a sweet spot of healthy and delicious - wholesome, earthy taste but not overpowering.  The kids like it!  I use the substitution recommended on the box to use applesauce (unsweetened of course) in place of most of the milk, and it makes a plump, moist pancake that is delicious for days.  Like another reviewer I keep a batch around for healthy breakfasts or snacks over a few days.Here in GA they stock this mix at some local grocers.  My wife just came home with a box though and we found that it's quite a bit cheaper on Amazon!  I just signed up for Amazon Prime so I am in pancake heaven!

I've tried many pancake mixes in my time, but this is the only one i come back to. I order it by the case from Hogdson Mills' catalog. To jazz up the pancake mix, I usually add some Torani sugar-free vanilla syrup (about a tablespoon for the middle batch quantity)--available at many retailers. I get mine at World Market. I also add about a half-cup (or to taste) of frozen wild blueberries, defrosted. Trader Joe's maple syrup is the perfect final complement. My husband raves about these pancakes! Give them a shot...

column9: Best tasting, healthiest pancakes I've ever had
column10: These are, without a doubt, the BEST tasting pancakes I've ever eaten in my life.  Oh yeah, and by the way, they're SUPER healthy!  I make a batch that lasts about 3 days, and eat a couple every morning.The only problem is trying to find this mix in a store - I haven't had much success. You can order via Amazon directly from the manufacturer if you don't mind the high shipping cost. I'd recommend looking in a Whole Foods or some other natural grocery store. Definitely worth trying to find!!
I love pancakes and consider myself a bit of a connoisseur, and these are without question the best I've ever had. Plus, you eat them for breakfast and don't need lunch, they're so filling.
I use this product for other baking needs besides pancakes.  I have included it in crumbles, "impossible" recipes that require a biscuit mix, etc.  Wonderful product.

column9: Perfect Healthy Pancakes that Taste Great!
column10: I have tried lots of pancake mixes and this is by far the best. Pancakes are not heavy like some whole grain cakes can be and the taste is flavorful but not over over powering. Be sure to get the whole wheat buttermilk style and not the buckwheat which are too strong tasting.  If you like pancakes but want a healthier option then this is the product for you.  Mmmm.

This is the best tea I have every tasted.  It is smooth, refreshing and pleasing to the taste and smell.  I first had it at a Russian restaurant in Newport, TN, GRILL 73 and asked what kind it was.  I fell in love with it and went on the search to find it.  I think it taste best chilled. I acutually steep it in my coffee pot with a filter because it is loose leaf tea and flowers, then I fill the rest of the gallon pitcher with water, sweeten to taste and chill.  I do not drink coffee so if you do you may what to use a different pot or method.  This vender was great to work with and shipped out to me lightening fast.
This is the best tea I have ever tried and I ONLY drink tea. It gas a unique flavor and is very mils.

I have an older cat (5yrs old now) who was constantly getting crystals and urinary blockage. Expensive trips to the vet it was. 3 years ago I adopted 2 kittens. The vet said the kittens had to eat something other than what my older cat was (she was on prescription science diet-like that's not expensive). As all cat owners know, it's nearly impossible to separate them and eat their "own food". I did lots of reasearch and found Orijen. All three cats have been eating this food for 3 years. Guess what? No medical issues...At All! I've been so pleased with this food and how healthy and happy my cats are. I will never purchase anything else for my cats. You might think it may be a little expensive, but not having to take my cats to the vet is worth every penny saved.

column9: Best cat food I have found!
column10: The biggest impediments to me buying this product for the first time were the price and whether my cat would actually eat it.  I have a 3 year old Siamese cat who has been eating Orijen (15.4 lbs @ $[...]) for over a year now, previously she had been on Pro Plan Indoor Care Turkey and Rice Formula Dry Cat Food (7 lbs @ $23.59) which I always considered to be a "premium" cat food until I began doing some research.  As you can see, Orijen ($3.44/lb) is slightly more expensive than Purina Pro Plan ($3.37/lb).  The big difference in price, however, comes from the ingredients.  Orijen is lower in carbohydrates and higher in protein which has resulted in my cat eating approximately 1/3 less food than she had been before.  I love that her new diet is better for her health, but also easier on my pocket.My concerns about whether she would like the new "health food" were completely unfounded.  Of course, when I first began mixing Orijen with her old food she would eat around the new food and save it for last, but that stopped after about the fourth bowl.  She has always been picky about the treats she will eat, but recently I've been experimenting with grain-free treats and she has been taking to them without hesitation.I encourage anyone who is shopping for foods to compare the ingredient labels.  I was shocked to find that Purina's Pro Plan looks more like something that would be concocted by a chemistry lab than a food producer.  For example, Purina Pro Plan contains ONLY Vitamin E, A, B-12, and D-3 supplements instead of the actual sweet potatoes, kelp, pumpkin, carrots, spinach, turnip greens, apples, and cranberries found along with the supplements in Orijen.Finally, the last big difference that I have noticed in my cat is the number of hairballs.  When she was on Purina's Pro Plan Indoor Care, my cat would spit up at least once a month if not every couple of weeks.  Now she spits up approximately 3 or 4 times a year and only when I leave for a decent length of time, such as during the holidays or a vacation.Overall, I couldn't be any happier with this cat food and I can't recommend it highly enough.

column9: Tried them all - this is the best!
column10: Over the course of 6 to 12 months my five year old cat had developed  loose stools and vomiting.  He got to the point that he was throwing up every day and he went from nearly 14 pounds to a low of 10.  The vet found nothing wrong with him so I started looking into his diet.  I had always fed "premium" foods like Nutro and Iams so I thought I was doing the right things.  But after researching online, I learned how misled we all are into thinking that these foods filled with corn, meat by-products and chemicals are actually good for our pets!  So I then tried lots of brands of natural food but I wasn't solving his problems until I landed on the first grain-free, high-protein food.  There was a major difference immediately!  Stools firmed up, no more vomiting at all, and he's now back up to 14+ pounds.  All three of my cats LOVE the taste of this Orijen food.  It is expensive, but they do eat less of it because in has so little filler. They all three also did well on Wellness Core, but it was obvious that they didn't like the taste.  Two out of three liked Evo, but it gave my dairy-sensitive cat loose poo, I think because it contains cottage cheese.  So this food is the all-around winner for everyone.  It has made a huge difference in the health of my cats.  This is a quality product and worth every cent!

column9: Best cat food on the market
column10: Simply put my cats never have hair balls, their coats are beautiful and shiney and lastly they gobble this stuff up. and my cats are very picky eaters. Couldnt be happier.

column9: This is the best pet food manufacturer around. Period.
column10: I am a research fiend.When we bought our cat the vet recommended Science Diet, which, compared to the Orijen nutrition/ingredient lists, is a far cry from a quality cat food. I have found nothing else out there that comes anywhere close to Orijen. It's made where I live (Alberta, Canada), and almost all of the ingredients are sourced locally, which makes me feel confident as to the quality and production standards.All I can say is check out the website, and read the newspaper articles about the company that are available on the web, and you will know that this is the best food available.Also, my cat loves it.

column9: Best Food next to raw food diet...
column10: When my husband saved our first little kitten from being mauled by a dog we just ran to the store and grabbed some IAMS kitten.  He would gorge himself on it and then throw up. All he did was go to the bathroom....he pooed like 5 times a day. He always seemed hungry despite all the eating. By then we had bought a Maine Coon and I switched them to a raw food diet, which was great except it was to rich for our first kitty. I finally went back and forth between EVO and Orijen. Evo is great but gave my cats sticky poo. Orijen is number one in my book. My cats have been eating it since they were about 3 months old (that's over a year now). They have NEVER thrown up or had a hair ball. They hardly shed. They have glossy coats....and they are REALLY active. They don't lay around and sleep all day. They are constantly moving and playing. This food is amazing. And they only eat 1/3c. twice a day and it's more than enough. Sometimes there is food left in the bowl. They absolutely love the taste of it. It's more expensive but a big bag lasts my two cats7-8 weeks. That's about 20-25 dollars a month on cat food. Not bad considering you will save on vet bills.

I have two cats and a puppy and after seeing how well my new puppy was doing on Orijen, I decided to switch my cats off of Iams and onto the good stuff. One of my cats has a big weight problem, has hot spots all down her back, sheds constantly and was overall a very unhealthy cat. Two weeks after switching them to Orijen my unhealthy cat's hot spots COMPLETELY disapeared, her shedding has practically vanished (she's a long haired cat), and she has MUCH more energy and I haven't even finished cycling them off of the old food (currently using half orijen and half Iams). I've noticed a big difference on the volume and firmness of their stool as well. I can't recommend this food enough. It has probably added years onto my formerly unhealthy cat's lifespan.If you are on the fence about this product (probably due to the price), please at least buy a small bag to try and I guarantee that you will notice a big difference in your pet's health and lifestyle, especially if they have any food related allergies.The grocery store brands may be cheaper, but how healthy and content would you be if you only ate grapenuts every meal for the rest of your life?

For the first two years of my cats lives, they were getting Purina One, or the natural/organic stuff found at Whole Foods and Trader Joes.  My two girls were fine with it, but their brother became tubby.  I wasn't sure what to do, the cats were all getting enough exercise since they roughhouse with each other.  The one day my mom's cat was diagnosed with diabetes.  In an attempt to keep her cat healthy, she switched to another brand of "Healthy" cat food (very similar to Orijen).  I took home a sample of it for my own cats and they LOVED it.  Simply out of wanting to keep my cats from ever getting diabetes (most store brand pet foods have far too many carbs than necessary), I began my own research and came across Orijen,This food is amazing.  Yes, it is pricey, but because the content is less filler and more substance, they eat much less than needed, so it ends up breaking fairly even.  Their coats are healthier -- one of my girls was having a dandruff problem (something I didn't think Domestic Shorthair Tabbies could get) which cleared up after switching foods.  Their stool even became more compact because of, again, less filler.  Most importantly, my male cat suddenly began shedding the pounds with no other change other than his diet!  That made me quite happy.Even if you don't decide to try this dry food, research.  Make sure what you're giving your cats is actually GOOD for them and not just stamped with some fancy designer label like Science Diet.  My cats being happy makes ME happy.

I have three cats - an 8 year old "senior", a 5 year old, and a 4 month old kitten. My older male cat is notoriously picky about his dry food. He and my calico have been on Science Diet sensitive stomach food for three and a half years now with an unsuccessful attempt to move them over to Natural Balance. They would scoop out the Natural Balance and eventually went on a hunger strike. Needless to say I switched them back to Science Diet.When I got the kitten things became a bit tricky. My male cat would chow down on the kitten's dry food leaving nothing for my little one. I attempted to be more vigilant with them, but I can't monitor the food 24/7 so when I noticed my kitten chowing down on my dog's food (Orijen 6 fish because the poor thing has allergies and can't have grains) I thought...hmm, maybe I'll try Orijen for the cats. Luckily with the cat and kitten food in one bag I didn't need to buy two different kinds and I could feed them all in one place. Switching them over to Orijen was the best decision I've made for them in a long time. I switched them over pretty much cold turkey (bad, I know), but I haven't had any problems and they ate around whatever was left of the Science Diet. They ALL like it, even my picky eater. On top of all of this, their coats are AMAZING. My big male cat had problems bathing himself and would get dreads towards his tush and now his hair is silky smooth all around. The kitten and my calico also have gorgeous, soft coats as well.My cats are happy and thus, I'm happy!

I've recently switched to a more natural and organic food for my cats and have been trying different brands and I came across this Orijen cat food in a trial 400 gram bag and put it side to side with some of the other dry food that I bought that is also natural with no by products and everytime they both would go directly to the Orijen bowl and leave the others alone. I ordered a 15 lb bag today.

column9: possibly the best dry cat food available
column10: If you read all the reviews, you can tell the common theme is that people who like this food are all research nuts.  I spent hours and hours online educating my self on cat food after my cat got sick.  All these years, I've been feeding them Science Diet because "the vets recommends it".  But after doing my own research, I realized much like any industry, the vets are not immune to financial "encouragement" when recommending food and that Science Diet is just junk.  As it turned out, my cat actually had a rare form of cancer, although I can't be sure whether feeding her better food from the beginning would have prevented it.  She didn't survive the cancer.  But I can still give my other cats a better diet now that I'm more educated on cat food.  After exhaustive research, and of course taste tests by my cats, we've settled on the Orijen brand.  It just makes me feel better that I'm giving them the best food there is out there, or at least that I know of.  It is very expensive, and not a lot of stores carry it.  Wag.com actually has it for a decent price.I give my cats Orijen on top of the wet food they get twice daily.  It seems to work well.  My senior cat has more energy and can now keep up with his younger playmates, and my outside cats gained some lean muscle and overall look healthier.  I just wish I had known about Orijen years ago.

Excellent results! Sphynx cats have improved skin, less oil in ears, and improved teeth and gums.No upset to digestive track switching food. Very pleased that one cat shows improved respiratoryissues.

I wanted to try something new for my two 7 y.o. cats and based on the positive reviews I decided to try this brand. When I put some of this food next to the bowl containing Organix, one of my cats was eating this so fast he actually started choking-this has NEVER happened w/ any other dry food I've given him except for Greenies' treats. Granted it's expensive but so are the other brands I buy and I happened to get this when Pet Food Direct had free shipping. Since I bought the large bag I'm eager to see if I notice any health benefits,(granted my cats are healthy prior to eating this food), particularly the dental ones mentioned by other reviewers. The back of the bag contains a very detailed ingredient list. I'm not sure that cats need all the ingredients listed, but it is impressive.

column9: Switched from Science Diet and WOW!
column10: After a lot of research, not just into types of dry cat food but what was readily available in a variety of local shops (since I had no intention of being dependent on having food shipped in specially) I decided on Science Diet Kitten for my cat, then a kitten, Whisper. She loved the small shape of the food and immediately took to it, though she put on just a tad more weight than was needed.The space of a year later and I've moved to a far more rural area where even a handy selection of Science Diet wasn't available! I'd picked the stuff mainly for it's availability and never been truly satisfied with the amount of protein it offered. Now Whisper is full grown, just this side of being obese and also suffering relatively constant stomach upset.Since availability was no longer the issue I went looking for a food in comparable price range, size of kibble, with a higher protein content and found Orijen. Whisper took to it immediately. Stopped having stomach problems. Her coat improved (she used to shed constantly even when using the furminator on her daily, now hardly at all) and most surprisingly - has lost several pounds on the exact same portion size! Whisper enjoys the small easy to crunch kibbles, is thrilled with her new food and I'm thrilled that she seems to be a healthier, happier cat without expensive vet bills or a steep spike in expenses!Got a new kitten recently and started her right out with Origen. I can't imagine ever going back to something like Science Diet which even my vet says is like McDonald's for animals.

My siberian loves this food. I tried the 6 Fish kind as well from Orijen and although my cat loved the taste, the smell was enough to keep me away. I will continue to buy this food for my kitty. His coat is gorgeous, no hairballs, compact stools, and the convinience of a kibble food (raw diet was too much work with my two jobs). Love ORIJEN!

column9: Great, but wish it didn't have peas!
column10: I've been feeding my cat Wellness Core for 3 years but since they recently changed their formula, I decided to research for another grain free cat food brand.  After reading good reviews on Orijen, I decided on a little bag to see if my cats would like it.Cats didn't seem to have a problem with it and I liked that it's 80% protein so I'm sticking with it for now. I would give this 5 stars if it didn't have peas.  Peas in their food make my cats' poop very smelly.

I have done a ton of reading & research on ALL the dry kibble brands that are in the North American market. Without a doubt Orijen is the best brand available. The ingredients do make a huge difference. I have noticed my persian cats loving every bite, but will not over eat. They get filled a lot faster because of the high quality protein. Thus producing smaller and less stool. That means less kitty litter wasted. So as price is concerned, it does even out at the end. Prior to Orijen I used Purina One. They loved it, but ate much more and were always extremely thirsty. The stool was huge!--no thanks to corn and other cheap grain fillers. With dry kibble, dogs and cats do drink more water as compared to eating canned or raw. But FRESH water is always there. I do include a few medallions of Natures Variety Raw every other day. I have seen improvement in coat, reduction in eye gunk and more energy. My cats have also shown no signs of hairballs. This company is no gimmick. Petfood companies use many ways to get you to buy their food. But just do a little research by looking at the ingredients. Nobody beats Orijen. I am very picky, and am proud to promote this product as A+

Being a person who loves animals, I highly recommend this food. Never has my cat's coat been SOO soft and shiny. She is the healthiest she has ever been. When she uses the litter box, I NEVER smell it. I also never feed her any canned cat food unless it is all natural and good enough for me to eat if I wanted. She is 6 years old and I got her when she was about 1 year and believe me, I have experienced the difference between her life eating cheap cat food and her life while eating Orijen and there is a major difference. I value REAL, HONEST stuff and this brand is my favorite. Keep it real Orijen!!!

My vet was shocked by how improved both my male cats were doing since I switched to this formula..not only could I cut their portions so they would trim up but they were noticeably healthier and though they are close to 8yo, they started having energy like they were half that age. You will not regret spending alittle more for this high quality food and your cats will thrive on it.

I am on my 3rd bag of Orijen, and I am really starting to notice the difference it is making. I have two older kitties (they are 20 yr old brothers) a 7yr old and a 5yr old. The two younger kitties coats are getting ever softer. They have always been pretty playful--but the two of them are getting outright hyper lately. And one of my older guys is suddenly starting to play again, too! I can't tell you how funny/sweet it is to see a 20 yr old cat playing like he's 15 years younger! I have also noticed a HUGE difference in how much they are eating. They are satisfied on much less food than before. My 15 lb bag is lasting much longer than with my old brand. (And my old brand was a very good quality food--just not apparently as good as Orijen!) I am very happy with Orijen. I'd give it 5 stars if they would leave out the potatoes and other starchy veggies. This is still a very low carb food, tho. For sure recommend!

This is the best cat food ever, my cats love it and their coats are so soft and shiny after eating it for a month. I cannot recommend it enough, it is the only food I feed them these days. The only downside is that it smells quite a bit.

Orijen is an excellent quality kibble. The weightiness is substantial and the colour is rich and dark. This product is made at Canada's Champion Foods facility where another favorite kibble, Acana, is produced. The ingredients are impressive and the company appears to be in tune with using regional farmers and fisheries.We have two young cats and have been using a 50/50 mix of Orijen (or other grain free) and Acana Grassland with no complaints. Fur is soft, eyes are clear, litterbox isn't smelly and all seems well. The shape of this kibble is odd, it's not a flat disk nor is it a nugget.At first both my cats weren't interested in this stuff. One even tossed it out of the bowl, prefering only to eat Acana. Altering the mixture percentages over two days, I was able to get both cats to accept the Orijen without problem. Other than an expensive price tag, I can find nothing wrong with Orijen.

The food's quality is evident from the ingredients list, as well as the fact that everyone who comes over comments on how soft and shiny our cats' coats are--even if they've already made that comment in the past!  The cats love it, and there have been no tummy-upset side effects since feeding them this (for the past year) or any other negatives.I also wanted to note that this 5-star review applies to this supplier, as well (who isn't Orijen direct).  They ship almost immediately every time I buy, and I usually receive my food within 2-3 days tops.  And this time, when they were unfortunately out of stock of the 15lb bag, they called me the day after I placed my order and informed me it would be running late, but would be shipped by this week--which, lo and behold, it was indeed.  They're fast, efficient, courteous, and the food always arrives safe and packaged well.  Thank you for providing an excellent cat food with excellent service!
Got the item really fast and was exactly what I wanted.  Shopped with them before and will shop with them again in the future.

column9: Makes the best cafe mocha ever!
column10: I've used Dilettante bittersweet ephemere sauce for homemade cafe mochas for a number of years. I have tried many other powders, etc., and nothing compares. The flavor is thoroughly chocolate, but without the excessive sweetness of milk chocolate, etc. Some people add a little sugar if the bittersweet isn't sweet enough.
This is a quality product. Our chihuahua loves it! Finally a  dog food that we can tell what is in it just by looking at it!

My Akita has to be switched from food to food constantly. He gets bored fat. The trick is to get high quality dry and canned food that doesn't make him sick. He's not sensitive perse...there have been only a few dog foods that affected him adversely. This food is not one of them. He wolfs it right down every time we feed it to him. I'm buying more as I type.

My newfoundland is a fussy eater - would usually leave a lot of his food, wait for treats which he is also picky about and generally did not look forward to mealtimes like most of my other dogs. I kept switching foods - changed to ceramic bowl etc etc... He ate ALL of the weruva food - every day - empties his bowl - looks forward to it. I was skeptical to try other flavors as he loved the paw lickin chicken - but he loves the other ones as well - now mealtime is fun. THank you weruva and amazon for offering.

column9: Great cat food....when they send you cat food (not dog)
column10: Weruva appears to be a high-quality, human grade food.  My cats just love it!  My only gripe is when Amazon does not specifiy if it is cat food or dog food.  When they don't, it usually means its dog food, even when I do a specific search for "Weruva canned cat food".  And then the Amazon representative tries to tell my the cat and dog food is the same!  NOT!

We just recently added a corgi to our family, and I started researching different types of wet and dry foods for our pup. After trying different raw diets, we eventually settled on the Weruva brand of dog food. Our local pet store recommended it to us, and the girl working actually opened up a can and started eating it! It's processed in Thailand, and before that scares anybody, you have to realize that the food processing laws in Thailand are MUCH more strict than in America (read it up online!). They are not allowed to process by-product in their pet food, or use filler product. Weruva definitely does not have any of that--you can actually eat the dog food and it'll taste just like dinner.Our boy has a sensitive stomach and he's a very picky eater. The first night we got him the regular Chicken with Gravy he ate that whole can up. He loved it, and when we tried feeding him anything different he refused. Then we ordered him the Kobe Master flavor and it quickly became one of his favorites. I'd definitely recommend this brand, especially coming from a very concerned dog owner. I won't feed my dog anything else.

My dog is picky with food, I mean PICKY!!!  She is not big on eating.  No biscuit type treat has worked on her.  She even refused a stranger trying to feed her real meat!(She doesn't trust strangers I guess...)  After months of trying every type in the market.  I'm saying all of this to say that she is super pickyk.  She'll only eat real chicken breast jerky, dingo brand bone with chicken in the middle, and the weruva brand wet food.  (And fresh vegies and fruit... mystery)  Anyhoo, of all the dog food/treat in the market, she LOVES this one the best.  That says a lot.

column9: My Shih Tzu LOVES this food!
column10: My 2 year old Shih Tzu boy loves this food.  I mix it along with Health Extensions so he has the benefit of both types and flavors of foods.  He was typically a poor eater, but now just "woofs" it down!
This is a little different with the pork in it however my dogs love all of the Weruva brands. Just good simple food made well for animals. 95% meat which is what they need.

Please ignore the 1 star review.  That's an Amazon mistake and this terrific dog food doesn't deserve a one star because of an Amazon tagging error.  Weruva is one of the only genuinely human grade dog food products available.  My three pugs had totally gone off their food for days until I tried this brand .... I was going to buy Merrick (which they don't like very much) and found this instead.  It is spectacular.  Doesn't even smell like dogfood.  And, Amazon's price is very reasonable compared to my local retailer.  THIS IS A GREAT DOGFOOD PRODUCT and really worth trying out if you are an animal lover.  BTW - I now give it to my cats too and they are the fussiest eaters in the world -- they love it too.

column9: She'd stand on her head for this!
column10: I ordered both this type and the Paella for our Akita, and I have to say hands down, this is the only food that she gets excited about about EVERY time. She is a picky eater, and sometimes the other food, has to be put in the refrigerator because I don't want it to spoil. I don't give her this "flavor" all the time though, because I want it to be more of a reward type meal. Have not tried the Kobe flavors yet, but am looking forward to...am waiting for the economy to pick up a bit more to try these ones just in case she is not as crazy about these as she is the pork version.

While the ingredients look good (though the water content is 80% while most of the better brands have 78%) this food has managed to get two of my dogs sick!  Vomiting and uncontrollable bowel movements.  One dog is 17 yrs old and the other 4 yrs old.  I stopped feeding the older girl this food some time ago but discovered I still had cans so I gave a can to the 4 yr old.  After two days on the food he became sick.  He is now on rice and chicken for the next few days.  I cannot recommend this food to anyone.

I switched my kitties to Weruva a few months ago, and I'm so happy with this product. The food looks/smells/feels like actual chicken a human would eat, and the kitties love it. While they've always been healthy cats, their coats have gotten even shinier since I've started feeding them an all-wet diet (including Weruva), and they're maintaining a healthy weight and activity level. I'd highly recommend this food to other pet owners, and Amazon's price (with the free shipping) is the best I've seen.

column9: decent dog food, but Fromm's is better
column10: This brand is not bad, the ingredients are all good. However, compared to Fromm's canned dog food, I was not impressed. There seemed to be more liquid in the can and the can was not as full. Also, my puppy's stool turned more runny after eating this. I did not have this problem with the Fromm's canned food which definitely was more solid and less liquid. I give the company credit for using quality ingredients but the food truly looked more watery and filled with liquid. Maybe that is good for cats but I tried their dog food for our puppy.  I will go back to Fromm's and exchange the remaining cans of Weruva.

I love Weruva for my dogs, let me say that up front. I ordered 2 cases of this food, and out of 24 cans FIVE were usable. The rest were so badly dented that they were opened and molded. When I tried to return it, I found that This food has a NO RETURN policy. I ended up paying more than $10.00 a can for those 5 cans. NOT ACCEPTABLE. I have been ordering my dog food through Amazon for some time, and this shipping problem is getting worse. Much of the product arrives dented, but unopened. Instead of throwing money away like this, I will pay a little more and pick it up myself! Buyers, please be aware of this NO RETURN policy!!!!
My dogs and cats love Weruva canned food.  My two dogs don't like the Kurobuta Hero as well as the other flavors they have tried but they do eat it.

I have two small-ish dogs (both should weigh about 12-15 pounds each), who are 9 and 11 years old. Feeding them never used to be an issue; we used a nice quality dry food, and they ate out of one bowl together. A few years ago, though, one of them became dangerously ill, and is now diabetic with heavy cataracts in both eyes, so being sure she gets enough to eat at the right times has become much more important. I mix a quarter of a can with a half cup of our dry dog food for each dog twice a day. This gives both of them the right calories (the other dog is more plump because when food falls, she is the only one who can see it!), and the wet food ensures that my diabetic pup eats everything in her bowl. Amazon's price is better than what I pay locally, and it arrives sooner than what the delivery-by date is.

column9: My dog ate it and got sick
column10: My dog ate this product packaged in Thailand and got immediately sick.  She threw up and I am worried there was something nasty in it.

I used to feed my GSD this and she loved it!!  Unfortunately my maltese turns his nose up at it and every other can food I have given him.  I tried explaining to him this stuff is $3 per can but silly dog only wants dry dog food....  LOLRegardless, the ingredients are top notch, and this is a great dog food.

column9: My pup's favorite brand of canned food
column10: My pup, a corgi/chi mix who rarely gets people food yet somehow is so very picky, LOVES weruva. He has tried other very high quality brands and has now been turning his nose up to those after he has tried this. He has so far tried and loved the paw-lickin chicken, grandma's chicken soup, and wok the dog.  These are especially great if you like to have something to mix in with kibble because they have a good amount of sauce in it, though not too much in my opinion to feel like you're getting jipped.I have not yet purchased them from amazon so I cannot comment on the shipping quality.  Although I have bought online elsewhere and it arrived via fedex, some a little dented but all cans still useable.  Glad to see weruva is on amazon, will have to order from here next time I need to purchase.

column4: daemoncycler "When you arrive at a fork in th...
column10: If you have a dog that is a picky eater, well this is the dog food for you.  The local pet store can't even keep this stuff on the shelf.  My dog loves the Jammin Salmon too.
Well, I was envious when I gave this my dog.  It really does smell good and he loves it.
My fussy spoiled mutts really like this food.  Not made in USA is a worry but so far so good.

column9: Excellent quality.  My dogs LOVE it!  =)
column10: My Cavaliers absolutely love this product.  I give it to my nursing moms to keep weight on them.  Some of them tend to get picky when they're nursing, but this brand of food is always more than appreciated by my little mamas.  :) I would like to explain just a bit further.  My largest expense with my show dogs is for their top quality food, even more costly than our vet expenses!  If my spoiled fur family loves this food, I, for one, am convinced it's a top-notch product. I wish it were cheaper, but all things considered, it's an acceptable price for the quality.

column9: My saluki likes it well enough....but then she's a chow hound
column10: I look for grain free food only as my sight hound is mostly raw meat fed.  In the AM she needs something to take up the extra bile her very acid belly produces.  I also need to mix her tick garlic tabs into something in order for her to eat them.  This does the trick as well as a couple other canned meat products do.
Ignore the cat vote - this is food for dogs and it is really good. Dogs love it and it is all meat - can't go wrong.
Our dogs love all of the Weruva flavors. This is a favorite and you can just see them eagerly waiting for the food! Great stuff

Was told by an employee in a pet store that this brand is one of the best. Bought from them and then purchased at Amazon (cheaper). My dog wasn't to happy with the beef selections. After reading the label, realized it was processed in Thailand. Only gave my dog a few cans and then threw away the rest.

warning!!! when you enter 'canned cat foor' this product, which is for DOGS showed up and, because the print is so small and i thought i was looking at cat food, i ordered it. who's running this railroad anyway??

column9: A Standard Candy (Sweety) in the U.K.
column10: Most everyone in Britain knows this candy. I myself grew up eating 'em. The only warning would be that they are highly addictive. They are quite hard, requiring some chewing and do have a habit of sticking to your teeth.Otherwise; I'd highly recommend them!
If you've ever enjoyed these fruity candies in the past, be prepared for a major change in the size.  They are too small to truly appreciate the flavor.

These crackers are ok tasting.There are a couple to avoid.The graphics are what I love.The blue lettering looks like some old salt or jock giving a K-Tel walking dude a lotta crap for his poor posture.The "mixed cracker" is fun too if you kinda are one.I used to pinch an empty packet in my large D-ring to keep it upright.I named it "Footie" and it cheered me up.The blue is super soothing.This sort of cracker is best eaten with chopsticks and soy and hot sauce for dipping.Whole foods "Oriental Mix" is a convenient choice as well.Four stars for the great graphics.One down for the truly funky one or two in almost every handful of this fine product.

These things are awesome.  I first bought them as a gag because there is a dried anchovy on the front cover, and it took me off guard.  Had to try it.  Now, I'm addicted to them.  You only get one or two anchovies in each pack, but, truly, that should be enough for you.  It's like a super-salty prize in the Cracker Jack pack.Enjoy!

column9: Key West Citrus Salt is FANTASTIC!
column10: Red Monkey Foods Key West Citrus Salt Grinder, 2.6-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 6)I bought 1 jar of this from TJ Max of all places! I use it on all seafood and it's wonderful! I'm out and immediately started looking on line for more. SO glad I found it again. It really enhances the taste of seafood with the lemon/lime flavor.  I don't EVER want to be without it! Don't hesitate to buy it - you'll be glad you did!!
Very useful stuff for the little ones. Finger Puffs, aside to be nutritive and really tasty, are a good distractor. Recommended!

A great little fingr food for baby. Be sure to keep closed tight in container or find and air tight bag as they do get soggy and a little yucky. But other than that, a healthy and convenient snack for your little guy.
our toddler loves these puffs. all the flavors. great to pack on the go.  not many calories per serving but its better than nothing if the baby wants to take nothing else.
my kid loves these puffs and enjoys grasping these small size foods to her mouth.good taste and easy melt for infant, excellent

column9: They're puffs, they're crunchy, kiddo loves them
column10: My daughters loves these, often trying to shovel a fist full in her mouth at a time.  They haven't killed her, so I'll give it the proper props.
The description is a little confusing, I thought I was getting 12 canisters. I only got 6. I wish they described the item, so I new what was the total amount of canisters. This is expensive for 6.
I bought this rice because of the reviews that said how good it was.  WRONG!!!!!!!!!!!!!  This junk is nasty!!!!!!!

column9: No flavor, suitable only as bread.
column10: I bought this because of the rave reviews on amazon. When I actually ate a bowl, I found out that this is rice and just rice. No flavor, no seasoning, no taste. It's like buying a microwavable "lunch" bowl of bland, raw chicken. Why??

I'm a bit of a health nut and I've always known I should eat brown rice but I never could get it right. It was always too hard or too..something.This product takes seconds to prepare, the serving size is more than generous and the rice has an extremely pleasant, nutty flavor. Definitely a good buy.

column4: Pat K. Mayer "No energy to cook"
column10: I think this is a great product. So easy. Makes perfect, still chewy, brown ricethat would take an hour otherwise. I love it. I find so many ways to use it.Even eat it for breakfast with milk and maple syrup.

column9: Great product for healthy and on the go!
column10: I really like this product.  Easy to store (no fridge needed) and easy to make (1.5 minutes on high microwave)!  Organic great tasting brown rice. Organic is a plus!  I highly reccomend this.

I am a person who take good care of my health by eating good things. By now, I am very concerning what food should be included in our diets to maintain good health. Especially, high calories food based on carb make me worried about my diet. BUT! Since I tried this product, which is real good, I stop worrying to eat RICE. It's real low calories, healthy organic brown rice, not expensive, and easy to cook (just only 1min. 30sec. in the micro.). Anyway, I really enjoy this product, and of course buy again.

column9: Convenient, Easy to Store, and Tastes Good
column10: I would prefer freshly made brown rice, but that takes a long time to make and isn't easy. This makes it convenient, and takes all the guess work out of making it. I generally have been buying frozen organic brown rice, but that takes up lots of freezer space. The fact that this is easy to store at room temperature is a big plus. I'll be buying more.

Ok, so you can cook up a bowl of chewy tasty brown rice for a lot less than the $2 this will cost you.  But it will take you the better part of an hour, and won't be any better than this rice which takes only 90 seconds.  So keep the non-instant brown rice around for those times when time isn't of the essence, and keep this around for when you need a quick, delicious bowl in less than two minutes.  It's really that simple.
I don't eat oatmeal regardless of how good it is for you. This is my breakfast now, it's sweet and nutty. Takes 90 seconds and is perfectly cooked every time. I'm so glad I found this product.

column9: Ready in minutes, tastes great, and great for you!
column10: This product is really great.  The rice comes out cooked perfectly, just slightly chewy/cruchy, like al dente pasta.  It has a very nice flavor too.

Thank goodness organic food has become more readily available. Organic brown rice in 1 minute? Great! It is very sticky, but I heat it, throw in a little butter, spices, mix in a few veggies, and it's a healthy quick meal for my 3-year-old. He loves it!

I actually had a subscription for this item. The first few shipments were fine, but the last one which was received only a few days ago contained bowls that were full of moldy rice.  Ugh. Poor quality control.And what really sucked was that Amazon wouldn't let me return the shipment.
I am hooked on this product.  It tastes good, is good for you, easy to prepare.  I add some cooked beans (lima beans, corn, etc.) and a little butter.  It makes a great lunch.

column9: Perfect Rice at a Reasonable Price
column10: I love rice, especially brown rice, but cooking on the stove top takes time. I have neither the skill or inclination to take that time, so Go-Go is a boon for me. I often use only half a bowl to supplement a Going Native curry or Tasty Bite Entree and refrigerate the remaining half for the next day's use.

This is a good product and the price was excellent.  However, several of the bowls had mold in them when I opened them.  I wonder if anyone else has had this problem.  It's fairly off-putting, to say the least.

column9: Great Tasting,Fast Cooking.Very Convenient For Those On The Go.
column10: I started a High Fiber diet in order to lose weight/feel better at the beginning of the year. I am not a vegan or vegetarian,just a woman on a busy schedule who is trying to overhaul my eating habits.This is a very good product,easy to take to work,school,etc.It is a lot more convenient than cooking brown rice for close to an hour,especially on nights when you are busy and/or cooking for one.I throw some stir-fry seasoned veggies on top,and just eat it from the bowl.Also,with a little brown sugar,pecans and raisins it makes a great alternative to oatmeal in the mornings.Before this,I had tried Uncle Bens quick brown rice pouches that you microwave,which were nasty--salty ,oily and too much fat. All I can say is just try it,you will be pleasantly surprised.

It's great to find a convenience food that is really healthy.  The rice is bland, which lets you add honey or some other sweetener to make a tasty and filling hot breakfast cereal, or garlic salt or spices as a dinner side dish.
In general, the quality of the rice was quite good, but had one package that was not sealed properly and had gone bad.

column9: Wow!  You all were right - this is great stuff!
column10: First, my sincere thanks to all of the others here who took the time to post a review.  I never would have tried this rice bowl except for the overwhelmingly positive reviews here.  Even so, I really felt like it was a gamble.  So I'm happy to say this stuff is great!  I'm not a big health food nut or anything, but I am trying to eat healthier.  I do like rice, so I was looking for a simple, quick, instant rice type product when I came across this.Yowzer!  This is great stuff.  In my 1000 watt microwave, 60 seconds was all it took and I had a hot, steaming bowl of slightly sticky brown rice that was close to perfect.  For the purposes of this review, I started out eating just the rice "as is" right out of the microwave.  The texture was great and the taste excellent.  Now rice alone does not have a great deal of flavor, but the subtle flavor was very good and exactly how I would want my brown rice to taste.  So all good and I'm already thinking 5 stars for this rice for being so handy, convenient, easy to fix, and tasty.Next I was thinking about having some salsa and chips, and I thought, hmmm...salsa and rice?  So I spooned some medium salsa into my rice bowl and stirred a bit and voila!  A very tasty meal!  I don't think it gets any easier than this.  This stuff will make the perfect base for a variety of tasty meals and fairly healthy ones at that.A big thumbs up and 5 stars for this one!

This rice is super easy to prepare.  I like it with a bit of Frank's Red Hot sauce added.  I'mdeducting a star, however, because the nutritional information on the site is wrong.  I dislike nutritional information that divides a single portion serving into fractions on the label but, at the very least, it should be accurate information.The nutritional information above indicates that it is 115 calories per "serving" or 230 per bowl.  When in fact, the label on the bowls indicate that it is really 170 calories per serving or 340 per bowl.

I hesitated buying this product because it's a bit on the pricey side, but I do enjoy brown rice and it's such a pain to cook.  I was impressed by the glowing reviews of this product, and finally decided to take a chance.  I was not disappointed.  The rice is cooked perfectly, and has that wonderful nutty brown rice flavor.  This rice is perfect with steamed veggies when I am not in the mood to cook a decent meal for myself.  I love it!Be sure to note that the serving size is 1/2 bowl when looking at the nutritional information.  I particularly liked the fact that the product is very low in sodium.  Contents of the bowl are listed as Organic Brown Rice, Water, Calcium Carbonate. From that it seems safe to assume that the fat and sodium levels are those found naturally in the rice.I will definitely buy this again.  Yummy!

This is the best stuff for working people.  The rice is good for you, plentiful, fast and easy to make (microwave).  A little pricy (hence four stars) but so convenient when time is of the essence.  I'm all for making my life easier and this does the trick.  A healthy alternative.
Surprisingly! It has a great taste compared to other instant rice products. Also it has great nutritions all over the rice with lower calories. I am Loving it. Once you try it, you'll keep buying it.

This product is great. I take a bowl with me to work and a Tasty Bite and I have a great meal.  I would say however that the cost on Amazon is high.  I can get a 6pk at Costco for alot less than half of the price on Amazon.

I have this rice on Subscribe and Save because I like it so well.  It has a wonderful natural flavor, and it's healthy, too.  It is so easy to prepare.  It's delicious as an accompaniment for several regularly prepared dishes - beef stroganoff and stir-fry being two.  I also use it to make rice pudding with raisins and cinnamon.  My favorite, though is this one-pan meal:1. Brown half a pound of hamburger (or veggie burger) with chopped celery and onions until the burger is browned and cooked through.  Drain grease thoroughly. If it is especially greasy I will drain the meat on paper towels before proceeding.  (Other meats work as well - chicken and pork, especially, but use a little olive oil during browning.)2. Add a cup of frozen mixed veggies ( the kind with corn, peas, lima beans and green beans) and a cup of salsa (I like medium Pace best).  Reduce heat and simmer until frozen veggies are cooked.3. Top with grated cheese of choice to just cover, and continue to simmer until cheese melts.4.  Spoon some over half a bowl of the heated rice for each serving.  This recipe makes three servings, or two for big eaters.I don't know what to call this recipe, but it is tasty! And soooo easy!Then-I can't resist mentioning this silly thing - the empty bowl the rice comes in is a favorite toy of my two miniSchnauzers. I toss it for them like a frisbee, sometimes, but most often they play with it by themselves.  One of them enjoys holding the bowl in her mouth, putting one foot in the bowl, then skating the bowl around the room that way.  Craziest thing you ever saw!  The plastic the bowl is made of is tough, and doesn't come apart at all when they chew on it.  Okay, this is goofy, I'll admit, but it is a way of recycling isn't it?  ;-)

I am not easy to please when it comes to rice, but this stuff is fantastic. The bowls are just right for adding some edaname or chicken to, maybe a dash of chili and wham! my lunch is the envy of everyone at work. Rice is nice and moist, not crunchy or dry at all-- mmm, mmm! The size is probably enough to serve 2 "average" individuals, but hubby and I eat a lot more than the average person (gym people), so this size is perfect as a side dish. I like that the flavor is very mellow, so you can mix it with just about anything (sometimes tofu, sometimes spicy chicken, sometimes organic black beans, sometimes I stir in some organic butternut squash soup).

column9: Excellent texture for a full grain brown rice
column10: Because of its flavor and excellent shelf life, I have been using this to take to work for lunch and as a substitute for bread products which I am unable to consume.The flavor and texture are very good.  It is harder to find a short grain rice in the stores and this is cooked and ready to go.

I love these for stashing in my desk drawer for a quick lunch at work and keeping in the pantry for when I don't have nearly an hour to cook brown rice at home. The flavor's not bad by itself, but remember this is plain brown rice. Add a bit of leftover chicken, veggies or a dash of sauce to round things out.

I totally LOVE this rice.. it has a great texture and is super easy to prepare. 90 seconds in the microwave and it's done! I throw a little salt and butter on it, but I have had it plain as well and it is still delicious! I 'fluff' the rice up with a fork because it is a little clumped together straight out of the microwave. The best part is that my very picky 12 yr old loves it! She was amazed that she actually liked it. It is good to know that it is healthy for us too. To save $, we get a new shipment automatically every month.

column9: Gogo brown rice bowls excellent taste and time saver
column10: I use the rice bowls as a time saver.  They microwave in 1.5 minutes and have an excellent taste and consistency -- just as good as my Whole Foods brown rice when cooked 45 minutes.  I find this produce adds a lot to my life -- I have one for dinner almost every day -- whole grains with no mess, no fuss.  I recommend this product highly.
GoGo brown rice  is great!  It takes 90 seconds to cook, tastes terrific,  and makes using brown rice so easy.  A must have staple for the pantry.
Excellent taste with reasonable calorie allocation.  I reorder this product on a regular basis.

column9: Good; But Needs A Bit Of Help
column10: This is nutricious, I guess; but certainly easy to stick in the microwave.  The flavor is fine; but I think a bit bland, and a bit dry.  Better to add something to it.I'll add bits of left-over meat or maybe a little canned chicken.  Then some sort of sauce, ranging from soy to sweet & sour or teriyaki.  Use your imagination; but I think you'll be happier using this as a starting point.Then you have a very nice lunch, prepared on a good and easy rice base.
This rice was quick to fix and the flavor was remarkable. Add to that the fact that the rice is organic only adds to the excellence of the product. LOVED IT!!

I am asian and I am used to white jasmine rice.  Brown rice is a healthier alternative so I tried this product.  It tastes different from jasmine rice but it fills you up quick.  Another thing I like about this product is it is ready in 90 minutes. It is good tasting too unlike some brown rice that tastes like uncooked oatmeal.
My wife and I love these!  They are quick and easy plus they provide a nice size portion with a piece of salmon and some veggies.  The rice has a great nutty taste!

This rice is very convenient because it cooks in one and one half minutes in the microwave.  It's also the best tasting brown rice I have ever eaten.  There's kind of a nutty taste and texture to it, which i love. And it's also very filling!  For Weight Watcher people, it's only 3 points!

column9: Perfect portion size and heats up fast
column10: Recently I've been looking for a way to include brown rice into my daily diet for the health benefits. I've been trying to cook some, but that doesn't always work when I'm short on time or at work. These steamed brown rice bowls are WONDERFUL for those times when I need something fast. I pre-cook some chicken and have it ready in the refrigerator. So when I need a fast lunch, I spend 90 seconds heating up a bowl of rice and 60 seconds heating up my chicken and instantly I have a super lean healthy lunch, with fresh organic rice instead of stale reheated rice.I appreciate that this brown rice is organic, since there are studies suggesting that non-organic brown rice is suspected to have 1.4 to 5 times more arsenic than organic brown rice. Because of this I always try and buy the organic version.A quick and healthy meal, these microwaveable bowls of brown rice are a terrific way eating a healthy food even when you don't have time to cook it yourself.

column9: Love it, but gave 3 stars to call attention to new packaging.
column10: I am completely dependent on this product and receive it every month...thats how much I love it. However, the new packaging seems faulty...unless I got a bad batch. The plastic cover is a lot harder to peel back, and some bowls, I had to cut  open. So, if anyone from the GoGo company is reading this, could u pls fix it? Thanks!!!

I liked the convenience of this product and the quality was very good, however, you have to be label-savvy to realize that the bowl holds two servings (although it looks like a single-serve package).  So just be prepared to multiply those calories per serving by two (unless you're sharing with a friend).

column9: 5 stars for the easiest way to cook brown rice on the PLANET!
column10: This stuff is FREAKIN AWESOME. I stumbled upon these a month ago, ordered them asap. They got to my house in a week and I've been eating 2 a week since. You don't have to season this or anything, it's perfect straight out of the microwave.Making brown rice in a pot is a bit of a hassle--not nearly as easy as making white rice. It takes a long time and it's hard to get a decent texture (not too mushy, not dry). This takes all the guesswork out of eating healthy. 90 seconds in the microwave and you have 2 servings of brown rice. I'm seriously never buying brown rice any other way.If you're even considering buying this, DO IT.

column4: Franco D. Fernando "I give a lot of 5-stars b...
column10: I try to eat more dietary fiber and I always have to have rice with my meals (I'm filipino)so eating white rice can really curb your diet and weight loss plans...This brown rice is great.  it helps me portion control and very convenient since I never have time to cook meals at home.Highly recommend this to anyone who has trouble dieting and portioning out their meals

I gave this 5 stars because it is exactly what it is advertised as - brown rice. I am trying to eat more healthy and as a result, have to push my palate a bit. While I can't imagine trying to eat this alone, this rice has been very good combined with other stronger flavored ingredients. I had this with fresh grilled salmon combined in it and with just a bit more seasoning of the rice, it was a very good and filling meal. I love that in 90 seconds I can have a healthy addition to any meal. Brown rice is not something I have the time or patience to try and learn to cook and it would almost double the time it takes to put most meals I prepare on the table. The rice bowls are small enough to be an individual meal, but 2 bowls is enough to have a nice healthy side dish for my family to enjoy with meals. The price, especially with subscribe and save, is very much in line with what you pay in the grocery store for other microwave rice dishes, if not cheaper.With this product, I see brown rice become a much larger part of our diet (especially because we had not incorporated it into our diet in the past). The flavor was mild, slightly nutty, and the sticky texture was really pleasing. A great product and it is nice to see healthier options enter the convenience food market.

Just heat and eat. So easy and tastes great with low sodium content. I love adding a Kitchen of India or Tasty Bite meal on top. Brown rice goes with about anything. These are perfect when we don't feel like cooking brown rice or quinoa ourselves.

Great product for making a quick meal. I usually eat the rice with something else as I think it tastes a bit bland when eaten by itself. The rice when cooked is also quite sticky unlike the rice you would make yourself, but these are minor issues. The quick preparation time (1m 30s) is perfect for what I need and as a plus it is very low in sodium.

column9: Simple and delicious as well as versatile
column10: This rice is delicious and can be eaten in so many ways, either sweet or savory. I have it on auto delivery!! My fave way to eat it as a breakfast...I put milk Spenda, cinnamon and bananas. The portions are large, and I am diabetic, so I save 1/2 of it for a sanc later when I want something sweet. Also , love this with chives nad a bit on onion and white wine vinegar with salmon!! So may ways to experiment, get you vitamns and maintain good health. EZ to prepare, takes only 1.5 minutes and grea to carry aong to the office. Here's to your health!!! You will love this once you try it!!
Takes no time to make, and can be served as a sideto practictly everything. Is also healthy and delicious!

Our family loves these rice bowls! We have a rice cooker for making white rice, but it takes forever to cook the brown rice, so we found that these bowls are an easy and convenient way to have brown rice with our dinner.You don't have to store them in the refrigerator and you just microwave them for 90 seconds. It's so easy and quick to pop this in the microwave once the rest of the meal is ready.Note that it is ONLY rice. There are no added flavors, so they're not meant to be a meal in themselves. (I noticed that people who gave it low ratings said that they don't taste good because there's no flavorings. I guess they thought it was supposed to be a meal?)They are very tasty with the nutty flavor that distinguishes brown rice from white. I would definitely recommend this product!
Shipping was fast and easy! GoGo Rice is very easy to microwave and eat in just a minute!

...but I ding the overall score for the excess packaging. The bowls are in a cardboard box which is fine, but the cardboard box is placed in another cardboard box and the excess space is filled up with platic wrap. I understand why this is done, the manufancturer sends the rice boxed and Amazon boxes it again. All that aside, this is a good value and the rice is very good. Also convenient if you don't feel like using a rice cooker or stove top. These are a convenient, quick and nutrious way to get some quality carbs!
The first bowl of this had gone bad.  If the other bowls are better, I'll update and let you know.

Great nutty flavor, great fiber, organic and enough for two people as a side dish. It seemed expensive at first but when the ease, convenience and health benefits are taken into account it is worth every penny. This is just right for 2 servings. I wanted to purchase 12 more and was unhappy to see the Brown Rice was out of stock.

column4: Daniel Schultz "Not to be confused with the P...
