column9: Cheese Powder is great, Amazon's price hike stinks!
column10: I ordered a 6-pack of this last fall for about $15, which was a great price, and my toddler loves the cheese powder on popcorn, noodles and broccoli! However, there's no way I'm paying $34 and change for it, and I don't see why the price has more than doubled in less than a year. That's $5.83 for just 3 oz of product!

For a long time, this wasn't available here for some reason.But I LOVE this cheese topping product. I use it on popcorn, to give mac & cheese a little extra flavor, and with Ramen noodles (instead of the seasoning packet).I've tried other powdered cheeses, but they were terrible!Kraft's is the best! Keep selling it, Amazon!

This is the cheesiest popcorn cheese ever!  It's not salty like all of the other toppings for popcorn.  You can get your popcorn as cheesy as you want with this topping without oversalting.I also had trouble finding this cheese in the stores.  I couldn't even find it on the Kraft site itself.  I hope they are not going to discontinue this product because there isn't anything even close to it on the market.

column9: This is BEST with one of the microwave CHEEZE popcorns.
column10: This stuff, sprinkled on any one of the "CHEEZ/EXTRA CHEESE/CHEESE" microwave popcorns is BEST.Some folks do not seem to grasp the idea --- it eluded me for a while --- that this stuff works BESTwhen sprinkled on something MOIST. If you attempt to put it on dry popcorn --- even store-bought bags ---it settles on the bag's bottom.==> Buy microwave CHEESE popcorn.==> Pop it.==> Top it.==> Eat it!Amen!"Big Mac"

This is the best cheese topping in the world! Great for putting on your popcorn and your favorite pasta dish. It has become nearly impossible to find this cheese topping in supermarkets. Thank goodness we have Amazon.com.

This was a gift and I was very relieved to hear that the canisters of cheese were intact after the box arrived in poor condition. Recipients told me that the outer carton was completely crushed, perhaps sturdier boxes should be used in the future? The cheese itself is a fantastic item, unfortunately hard to find.
My son LOVES this cheese and you can no longer purchase this at the local stores so we are very happy to be able to buy it online.  Thank you AMAZON!!!!

the product was just as stated  the wonderful cheesey taste that only kraft mac and cheese has  only now it can be shaken onto anything  popcorn was a given but when i sprinkled it on to my no sauce meatballs i was hooked.

I love this powdered cheese in a can.  I don't know why but sometimes when I make Kraft Mac n Cheese, there just isn't enough cheese to it.  When I saw this on Amazon (while looking for another product), I just had to try it and I'm so glad I did.  I love to make mac n cheese according to the instructions and then sprinkle some more on the top.  I read other reviews and some said they put it on top of veggies etc., I haven't tried that yet but I'm sure it's good.  I think it would work really well on popcorn too.  The possibilities are endless and this price is phenominal.

I have used this product for years. It makes THE BEST scalloped potatoes ever. Just use can milk a dob of butter and two to three tab. of Kraft grated cheese and cook like always. Also great to make the Kraft Macaroni & cheese packaged item a little better flavored by adding a tab. of this cheese to the mac. when you add the package in the box.There is never a leftover of this for the next day.
We love Kraft Macaroni & Cheese Topping...Only available on line..no longer carried in the grocery store!Kraft Macaroni & Cheese Topping, 3-Ounce Cans (Pack of 6)

If you enjoy the taste of cheese but don't want a whole lot of added calories to your food, try this great cheese product.  You can have 2 teaspoons of this for only 25 calories. It is a dairy product and tastes just like a wonderful piece of cheddar cheese. Its great on popcorn, potato soup... really anything you already put cheese on. Try it cause you are going to love it!

Been using the dry mac and cheese for years for several recipes, especially au-gratin potatoes.  Then all grocery store where I live stopped selling it.  So I was glad to find it on the internet.  For some reason some recipes are just best with dry cheese and substituting real doesn't always work. As is the case with my potatoes.  So I am very happy with my purchase and it tastes great!

Kraft's Macaroni and Cheese Cheese Topping is great! We recently had a movie-themed birthday party for my co-worker, and I ordered this to give to the birthday girl and as part of workplace birthday decorations. I put these cans inside empty popcorn boxes with other small gifts for some people who attended the birthday party. Besides topping this on popcorn, which was perfect for all the popcorn my co-worker received, you can sprinkle this on many other food items. Since I can't eat popcorn anymore because of TMJ/jaw problems, I sprinkle this on pasta dishes, baked potatoes, mashed potatoes, soups, eggs, soft bread, etc. The cheese topping tastes great, and adds some flavor to your food. Like other people have said, you must refrigerate this after first use. The life of these cheese toppings is pretty good - the expiration date is about eight months past the month I ordered and received this product. This can has 25 calories for the serving size, and has 11% sodium, 2% fat, 1% total carbohydrates, 1% cholesterol, and 4% calcium. The ingredients are: whey, milkfat, milk protein concentrate, salt, sodium tripolyphosphate, less than 2% citric acid, sodium phosphate, lactic acid, milk, calcium phosphate, yellow 5, yellow 6, cheese culture, and enzymes. Is it worth it to order this product? I would say "yes". It's hard to find this product in some stores. And the price on Amazon is reasonable when you consider that you are getting six cans per order. I give a thumbs up to this Kraft Macaroni and Cheese Cheese Topping!

I,ve searched every grocery chain in the entire area in SC and no one had it.I finally though of Amazon and lo and behold there were two suppliers. This order will hold me for a long time (12 ct), but when you want it it's there.I love Mac and Cheese, but the pac of topping included is usually stingy on the cheese, so this way I can give my meal a little boost. Thanks Amazon I needed that.

I was really excited to try this given all the glowing reviews.  But honestly, I can barely taste it.  I have to liberally apply it and still it isn't even close to as yummy as I had expected.  For example, for putting on Broccoli, it doesn't come close to beating shaking on Parmesan Cheese.  Comparing it to Cheddar flavored popcorn from Popcornopolis, it isn't even close.  With popcorn, the problem is perhaps getting it to stick, so try spray butter or something to give it something to stick to.  So maybe with level expectations, it can still be good.  It certainly isn't bad.  But I've let it sit in my cupboard for a long time without using it now.  It was a let down for me.One nice thing is that it seems more natural cheese flavor than some other cheese flavoring shakers, such as Kernel Season's Popcorn Seasoning.  The alternative probably is because others might add salt, so they have more flavor, but taste more artificial.  So this does seem the more pure cheese route.
This is just the same powdered cheese that comes in the cheap mac and cheese NOT the same as it used to be, NOT what comes in the Kraft mac and cheese.
When I was a kid, our idea of mac and cheese was this topping on macaroni.  This is comfort food for me.  It tastes the same as it 30+ years a go.  Hard to find in stores.

I remembered using this popcorn cheese as a kid, so I was happily surprised to run across it on Amazon. It tastes just like what I imagine the powder tastes like for Macaroni and Cheese. It is good on popcorn, or I have even sprinkled it on leftover pasta for a really quick meal and it was decent. Note, though, that there is a label on it saying that it should be kept in the fridge after opening! (I didn't realize that at first; not that you would get sick-- probably just preserves it better). This product is overall very enjoyable!
We love to  use the cheese topping in macaroni-and-cheese, and can't easily get the product here in the Pacific Northwest. It's nice not to have to go to Florida anymore to buy it.

Basically, this is what you need on a short stick. Heck, it even works on the long stick (Just don't show them until after they have tasted it), for those who get to enduldge this product. Pasta-(My favorite), Popcorn, Garlic/cheese bread will be so ever solid using this. Just do yourself a huge favor; Buy & Use this KRAFT product. GKraft Macaroni & Cheese Topper, 3-Ounce Cans (Pack of 6)
Bought this for my popcorn and loving it.  I've been able to use it on other foods to add some additional flavour as well.  Everything tastes better with cheese!
Haven't been able to find these outside the midwest--so glad I found out that Kraft sells somethings on Amazon!

column9: I just discovered this product, and now I can't find it!
column10: I can't believe this has been around for years.  I just bought some about 2 months ago. It was so delicious, I wanted more, and now I can't find it.  Why do products that are GOOD disappear from the stores?!?!?
I use this Kraft Cheese Topping for my popcorn, I couldn't find it anywhere in the stores in my area, Amazon is a savior for offering this delicious item!

I can't find this in the grocery stores around here, so I was thrilled to see that I could get it through Amazon.  (All they carry is Parmesan.) I use it in biscuit dough, put it into tuna fish sandwiches for a little flavor, sprinkle it onto pie dough scraps, mix it into mashed potatoes - lots of things other than macaroni and cheese!

I tasted wonderful cheese popcorn at the Palmer House in Chicago and thought this might be the same when sprinkled on hot buttered popcorn. Sorry I had to purchase six as I can't even give them away. Absolutely no taste whatsoever, even when you use a massive amount of it on popcorn. Don't waste your money.

column9: Not the Same Cheese Topping as the Blue Box Mac and Cheese
column10: This is not the same cheese powder that is in the Blue Box Kraft Macaroni and Cheese.  The color is different and the texture is a much finer powder.  Also, the taste is not as cheesy.  If you make your own mac and cheese, it will not taste like the Blue Box Kraft Mac and Cheese.  The package states it is for shaking on popcorn.  I have tried many store brand mac and cheese dinners and none taste as good as Blue Box Kraft Mac and Cheese.

SINCE MOVING TO KS, MY HUSBAND AND I HAD BEEN UNABLE TO BUY THIS CHEESE. MY SON FOUND THE PRODUCT HERE ON AMAZON AND LET ME KNOW. I BOUGHT IT AND NEEDLESS TO SAY MY FAMILY HAS ENJOYED IT EVER SINCE. YOU CAN ADD THIS TO JUST ABOUT ANYTHING, WE USE IT ON PIZZA, MACARONI, AND GARLIC BREAD. IT IS GREAT.

This ham bouillon base is great. I have used it in dried beans and soups. It adds a smokey flavor. It goes a long way. Do not use to much of it. The first time I used it I put too much in and it was awful. I didn't think that I ws going to like it. I gave it  another try, using less and got a delicous soup.  Try it you'll like it.

I did not purchase product from vendor listed I went to soupsonline website and ordered individual one.  I really like to make homemade ham and bean soup and to me this base gives my soup that extra something in flavor that is needed.We like Great Northern beans but Navy beans work too or any kind of bean you prefer.Measure out 2 cups and sort out bad beans or rocks then soak over night.Next day throw out old water put beans in a crock pot on high with enough ham base broth (follow directions on jar) to cover about 1" above the beans.Add in cut up carrots, potatoes, celery and onions...if you don't like any of those veggies you can leave out any or all.I add a nice meaty ham hock because the meat is softer but be warned it's a fattier part of the pig and cook until about 1 or so hours before done then take out the leg and shred meat from the bone and remove any fat and place back into pot. You can also use plain ham bits.I think it takes about 8 hrs or so to cook ie beans are nice and soft and so are the other veggies.This tastes good on the first day but makes even better leftovers as beans breakdown thicken even more and flavors meldThe very best thing about this recipe is that if you want your soup thinner add more water or ham base broth if you like your soup thicker start with amount I suggested.I make this soup often in the winter because it has stick to your bone goodness.This can also be used to help flavor green beans...

column9: Good alternative if you can't take milk, soy, nuts, etc
column10: I have two kids with food allergies so I am very limited to what I can use in the house. Between two of them, we can't have milk, eggs, soy, wheat, nuts, and corn. So what is left?? only rice milk (well, I tried oat, sunflower, hemp, etc but I could not get used to the taste). I usually buy rice milk from refridgerated section at the supermarket. I needed poweder milk to use for baking and to mix with my coffee. When you mix this powder with any liquid, it does not disolve well and you have to mix it very well. I usually have to use a back of spoon against a cup and stir multiple times. Other than that, the task is good (well it is not like MILK, as you know) and it does give choices to people with food allergies. So, I really appreciated that they came up with this product. If you can take regular milk, you might want to stick with milk. But if you have food allergies, this is a good alernative product to purchase.

I have being waiting for this product to find its way to amazon and here it is.  It was like christmas when I found it on here, I ordered some to make sure it tasted ok and it was great.  Thank you amazon for servicing people of all nationalities and providing a place were we can safely purchase our foods.  I trust amazon to continue the good work.  Ogbono is hard to find in whole form and that is the best form to get it in because the ground form is usually a bit rancid.  The whole form allows for better storage and tastier soups.

My cat used to throw up twice a week until I started feeding her grass gel every morning. Now, she throws up may be once every 3-4 months. At first, I had to smear the paste on her nose to get her to lick it up. Now, I cannot keep her away from it. What can I say, I will be buying this in bulk! (PS: My cat was a stray that walked into my home from the backyard, probably a year old when she moved in - if it helps you decide whether my experience applies to your cat..)
My kittens love this stuff, they like it in their food, and lick it off my fingers...

There is a definate reason these everlasting treat balls are always sold out of the big local pet food stores- they are fantastic! My dog is a very rough chewer- he can even rip apart kongs, and he loves these treat balls. They don't last him for "hours" per say as the package states, but enough time that I am able to have him busy when we have company over. It's especially helpful if you insert a treat ball in both ends of the blue ball, making it especially challenging to pop out the edible discs. Not for an everyday treat obviously, due to quantity and prices, but I will definately buy them again!

I can't tell you how Everlasting Treat Medium Vanilla Mint taste great but my dogs seem to love them and they last a long time.  I got the medium for my 3 pound Chihuahua and 14 pound Chinese Crested Hairless and the size seems to suit them well.

First: If you don't have the ball holder, don't bother with these. They aren't really "everlasting" in the ball, but they'll last you a whole lot longer (for most dogs) when inserted in the StarMark Everlasting Treat Ball, LargeSecond: Make sure you get the right size for your dog. If you have a giant breed, this whole line isn't really for you. My 40lbs Aussie who is a moderate chewer, is about the large ball's limit and once she pops the treat out, the remainder is gone in less than 5 minutes. If you have a tiny dog, get the right size. They aren't going to be able to handle the large. They need to be able to gnaw at it, which they won't be able to do on the larger balls.Third: These are pretty neutral smelling, which is a plus for this line. I know dogs are all about the smell of things and the stinkier something is, the more they like them...but when you have to share the household with a dog, you need to find a happy medium. This is ours when company comes over. It has no real smell, but they aren't her favorite either.

I bought a 2-pack of the liver flavored Everlasting Treats to see if my husky/g.shepherd puppy would like them. She ate the first one in one sitting. That wasn't very "everlasting" and at nearly $4/ea it was an expensive treat. The 2nd one she took 2 - 3 days to eat, so I decided I would buy more of them as an occasional treat. My next puchase included the treat ball and a couple of other flavors (BBQ and Vanilla Mint). I put a Liver and a Vanilla Mint in the treat ball and she went LOVED the VM. It took effort this time to enjoy it, and she worked on it for over a week until there was nothing left but a disk of the treat in the treat ball (so I removed it, gave it to her, and put a new treat in the ball). The ball definitely helped a lot in slowing down the consumption time of the treat and she enjoys playing with it.Two paws up!
My Boxer loves these treats.  Only thing is they get a little sloppy and if you have wall to wall carpet it can be very messy.  She eats it too quick and it won't stay in the toy.

I was looking for something that would keep my dog busy, but also wasn't food that he would just eat and be done with.  This treat, combined with the Everlasting Treat Ball is such a great solution.  My dog (about 60 lbs, Dalmation) has so much fun trying to get this out of the ball, and he seems to love the taste of the Vanilla Mint more than any others.  This takes him a while to eat, but also isn't a lot of food.  it's a pretty decent sized treat.  When I first got it, it took him a while to get the treat all the way out, even days!  Now he can do it in an hour so so, but I still think it's a great buy.Just make sure to get the right size for your dog! Too small and they will rip it apart.

I'd have suspected that the vanilla mint wouldn't be the favorite between our four dogs, but it is!  These treats fit into a variety of the everlasting treat balls.  We have the large blue one that takes two 'dog hockey pucks' and two orange ones that take one each.  These are about the density of bone, and are made of not particularly nutritious stuff but are excellent for cleaning teeth and  giving the jaws a workout.We have a very old, very big malamute, another pretty old pointer, a big...err...we're not sure what he is exactly, part rotty, part small bear, part cat...and a black lab puppy.  Everyone loves the everlasting treats, but this is definitely the favorite followed by the barbecue/smoke one.  The malamute isn't much for chew toys, but he absolutely mauls this like he was 12 years younger.  Everyones teeth look considerably better after a few weeks of these treats.

I have two golden retrievers one is 10 mos old the other is 8 mos old.  Every now and then I need to actually get things done, and with two goldens its quite a challenge.  I like to give them their everlasting treat ball filled with the vanilla mint treat.  It keeps them quite and busy for about an hour.  The treats can be a little difficult to get into the ball and first, but the more you use it the easier it is.  It seems like the big box pet stores and also my local supermarket do not carry these in size large.  They only seems to stock small and mediums.  Very convenient ordering through Amazon.  If you need a little time, these work great to keep the pups occupied and they have nice breath too!Cheryl

Our dogs love the Everlasting Vanilla Mint!  One dog will licks and the other dog chews but it takes them a long time to finish them when they are in the treat balls.  The treat ball has provided them with hours of entertainment this winter when we haven't been able to get out much.  We have tried the Chicken and Liver flavors as well but the vanilla mint is by far the favorite.
My Bulldogs love it, it dose not smell as bad as some of the other flavors.
Our Chihuahua flies through these! They are great for encouraging use of both top and bottom front teeth rather than solely the back as with many bone-type dental chews.

column9: A little too small for even my Shih Tzu & Pekinese
column10: Made my dogs breath fresh but these were a little too small for even my Shih Tzus & Pekinese - I was scared they would choke on them.  I would recommend the company not making them so small and just sticking with the medium ones.

My sister told me about these great treats for the dogs to help keep them occupied when we will be away from home for extended periods of time.The treat may not be everlasting, but with my two German Shepard's it lasts for several hours, unlike the knuckle bones that many pet stores sell. The kongs that are designed to hold these treats are excellent as well, giving a challenge for the dog.I am very pleased and plan to order more in the future. Quick shipments and no problems with payment or delivery.

These treats don't last, my dog can pop them out in a matter of minutes, and it's completely gone in about 5 minutes.  Add to that the seller I purchased from only sent me one (they come in packs of 2, seller opened it and only sent me one treat), I was very disappointed.  Never going to bother with these again.

Great for long lasting chewing...good on teeth. My Labradoodle, who is a very productive, super fast chewer(could compete nationally) takes about 3days to mostly diminish this treat. Many other pets(especially non-chewers who don't get enough chewing d/t non-interest in chew treats(like my poor dental health bearded collie) take much, much longer(months). Does produce a bit of a non-pleasant odor when thoroughly slimed by my voracious chewer Labradoodle.

Both of my chihuahua mutts love these inserts. I use the treat in a bendo ball for one and she's busy for hours! The other pooch doesnt like the bendo ball but loves this treat.  He eats it in about 10 minutes.Def will stock up on these. Especially seeing as the dog that likes the treat in the ball is the more demanding of entertainment than the other - who is contented by just sitting next to me and snugglling.I just wish they were a bit less expensive, however, it's worth the price for a happy (ie. not bored) dog.

column9: Everlasting Treat for Dogs, Vanilla Mint, Large
column10: My dog seems to like these.  He will not stop until all gone.  You can smell item while he is eating it.  Would buy again but not often cause of cost and they only last him about an hour and a half.

column9: "Everlasting" is not quite a good description
column10: I have two Australian Shepherds and they love this product.  I put one in each treat ball and then fill with the small treats.  They get the treats out quickly and then start on the everlasting treat.  If by "everlasting" they mean one day, then ok.  They are agressive chewers, but I was hoping that these treats would last at least a week.  They do love the flavors and there is peace a quiet (except for the loud chewing)for one evening, anyway.  We also end up wasting the last bit of the treat as it is under the lip of the ball and they cannot get at it.  All in all, I will continue to buy this product as a special treat for them from Amazon as the cost is less than at PetSmart.

I bought this for my active dog who won't eat rawhides.  I was afraid she wouldn't like the vanilla mint flavor, but it's a hit.  I also put some of her daily kibble in the large everlasting treat ball StarMark Everlasting Treat Ball, Large, which keeps her active but isn't an increase in her calorie intake.  Make sure you get a ball that's bigger than your dog's jaw so they can't bite the treat in half.  Overall very happy with this product.

Our dogs really seem to love these, but they seem to be softer than the others so they are able to wear them down faster than the other flavors we have used.  Great product though and really keep the dogs entertained
Dogs loved it, but they freed it and ate it in minutes.  Turns out to be a dollar a minute for the dogs' enjoyment.  Might as well have been a milk bone.

column9: I Don't Know If You Could Call It "Vanilla Mint"
column10: It fits the right ball and it is just as "everlasting" as the other disks, but I really don't think this smells at all like vanilla or mint.
Does not last more than 15 min, I have a Terrier mix dog about 55 Ib It took him 5 min to eat one half of the everlasting treat. It is good treat but has nothing to do with it's name.

I bought these for my 100 lb lab/shepherd mix and the first one he got out within 5 minutes.  I takes me about 10 minutes to get the stupid things in! I have to use a screwdriver to get it in the ball.  Unless I have the time to get the large and medium ones in the toys, it's not worth the trouble.  If my lab mix can't get the treat out, he tends to give up and leave it for our smaller dog to just lick.  Wish there was an easier way to get the treats in-if anyone knows of one, please let me know!

My little dog wouldn't even lick it, she isn't going to even get close to it.  Beware!  She loves her treats and I was hoping after reading the other reviews that it would be good for her and her breath, but what a waste of $5.  So frustrated!Just a friendly warning, you might have to send them back.
I love Nong Shim noodles and I have to say this won't be any different.  It is tasty and sure its not the same as having black noodles in a restaurant but its a cheaper and convenient alternative.

column9: Most affordable quality pet food Ive found.
column10: My cats love love love this brand. They were sticking their heads in the bag when I first opened it. So cute! I cant find another brand of cat food with the ingredients I want in this large of a bag for the price.

I have been purchasing Blue Buffalo indoor cat food for some time now and my cats absolutely love it. I first started them off on Wellness hard food but for some reason it gave one of my cats diarrhea. (He does have IBS flare ups at times) I wanted to stick with the natural lines so I tried Blue Buffalo next and it was a great fit! All three of my cats get this hard food and they enjoy it.

I have been buying this through Amazon for some time now for my cat. I had been buying the 7 pound bag, but decided to purchase this 15 pound bag to save a little money. I have previously reviewed the 7 pound size here on Amazon. My cat still loves this stuff so I am still happy with the quality of this food.One gripe that I do have is with the shipping of my order, not the product itself, so I am still rating it 5 stars. This food has a high protein content with less grain than most cat foods.  It is healthier for my cats and great for the entire household as a better food means their droppings are not as stinky nor as frequent.  My cats love chicken and loved the taste of this food.  They free-feed and I did not have to fill the bowl as frequently either as a smaller amount left them more satisfied than with lower quality food.
i have been using blue cat food for 2 years and have been very happy with it. my cat is 18 years old and seems to be healthy and content. i received the food within 2 days, great service.

I have been ordering Blue Buffalo for many months now and they always have been on time and the packaging has been done to keep the cat food fresh and the bags intact.  It is a great way to get the food and saves time and money doing the ordering this way instead of going to the pet store.
This cereal is wonderful. Crunchy and savory. Kellogg's and General Mills look out - Blue Buffalo is coming up big!

Amazon sent the chicken and brown rice by mistake.  I'm old and disabled.  I can't mail it back and get the chicken and regular rice.  It's too heavy for me to deal with.  What a disappointment.  But I still gave it all 5 stars because this brand of dry cat food is excellent even though Amazon sent the wrong kind.  Epilogue.  Amazon kindly sent me a refund.  All's well. column9: a month to get my order? really?......
column10: Yes its a little cheaper online but you better be prepared to wait. For some odd reason they say it takes 2 weeks for them to be able to ship it out. I forgot and didnt order early enough and just had to order a bag on 5/11 and its 5/27 and still no cat food. Says it will be here June 2. Thats nuts. Not sure I will order online anymore. Its worth an extra $5 to just buy from petco.
These crackers remind me of regular "gluten" crackers. They are so good. A nice find since being gluten-free. The toasted onion flavor is really great.

These are the absolute best gf crackers and flatbread - any flavor!  The flavor is subtle, not overbearing, but not understated either.  The crackers and flatbread are crunchy - great with cheese or just plain.  The only problem with them is you can't put them down until the box is empty!  They are a bit pricey, but worth every penny.

Okay.  I wasn't raised Jewish, I grew up in a series of small towns in the south where the possibility of Kosher food was....remote.  I don't even like celery.  So can someone explain to me why I find this stuff so incredibly addicting?This drink is an enigma wrapped inside a mystery wrapped inside a pea-green can.  Most people in the country have never even heard of it.  It seems the only people who do enjoy it are people who grew up drinking it at their local Kosher deli.  And even *then*, it's a niche all to itself.  Mention celery soda to someone, and they won't believe you.  Give 'em some to taste and ninety-nine times out of a hundred they still won't believe it.  But ohhhh, that one percent!  They are hooked for life, and you've found a fellow sufferer.You'd think, with all the "indy" soda companies popping up nowadays, experiments with new flavors and so on, we'd see more innovative flavors along these lines.  I guess we're still playing catch up with 100-year-old recipes from  doctors who may not even have existed.Seriously, not for everyone by any means, but if you're one of the chosen few, you'll never find anything like it.

Dr Brown's Cel Ray soda is the pot of proverbial gold waiting at the end of the rainbow. My favorite part of drinking Celray soda is the fresh, slightly peppery, celery bouquet that greets you upon opening the can. For me, this is one of those rare culinary treats in the world, and I have traveled the world.Dr Brown's Cel Ray soda is best enjoyed freshly poured into a 12 oz glass filled with fresh dry ice cubes. Lifting the glass to your face to feel the tingle of the fine spray of escaping carbonation, you inhale the celery bouquet, as if tasting a fine wine. Unlike wines however, the refreshing bouquet and taste of Dr Brown's Cel Ray is always a dependable and repeatable experience. The increasingly difficult part is unfortunately, that it's becoming more and more difficult to find, even in New York. Someone needs to contact the company and find out why this is so.5 star product!

If you are of a certain age and remember going into a deli and having a hot dog or knish with some celray soda then you are going to be delighted with this purchase. The taste is not for everyone because it really does kind of taste like a combination of ginger ale and cellery - but I just love the stuff. And it's cheaper than a plane ticket back east.

When I lived and worked in NYCity, years ago, I enjoyed celery tonic at various delis as accompaniment to a sandwich. I recently searched for it on the world-wide network and found it at Amazon. Although it was quite expensive (but free shipping), I ordered 12 bottles. My memories of its taste were exagerated. But it is a refreshing drink, and distinctive.

This product is not available where I live.  I bought it for a friend as a special treat.  She is delighted and I'm happy that she is happy.  The bottles were well packed and arrived intact.  The soda tasted as good as ever.
I received the bottles of Dr. Brown's Cel-Ray soda in great condition, and they are as good as when you get them in NY.

I recently tried this soda when I was in NYC in June.  My girlfriend, I and my best friend went to the Carnegie deli for lunch.  I haven't been there in a long time and I asked my friend what he would reccommend on the menu.  He said to get a pastrami sandwich and the cel-ray soda.  I thought to myself, cel-ray soda, yuck as I am not a big soda drinker to begin with and this did not sound too appetizing.  I ordered the Woody Allen which was pastrami and corned beef on rye with cel-ray soda.  The sandwich was huge, only ate half.  The cel-ray soda was simply amazing, a slight hint of celery in a light refreshing drink.  When I got home back to upstate New York, I began to try to find this amazing soda in my area.  I googled it to see who would carry it in my area and it said select Wegmans stores carry it.  I have 5 Wegmans in my area and not one carries it.  The only Wegmans I have seen it in is in Williamsville, NY a Buffalo suburb.  I am lucky I am out that way every few weeks, so I stock up.  Do yourself a favor and try this amazing soda, you will not be disappointed.

I ordered this as a gift for my husband, who loves Cel-Ray but can't find it locally. Unfortunately the bottles appeared to have frozen during shipping -- some still had ice chunks inside when I opened the box. Even worse, some had leaked, making the box bottom sticky and soggy. Most of the bottles were fine, but a few were flat when opened, probably from being frozen. I'd look for cans instead of bottles if I ordered them again; I suppose they could lose their fizz too, but at least it would avoid the soggy mess.As for the flavor (which was new to me), it was better than I expected - definitely a recognizable celery component, but in a pleasant way.

I was very unhappy to see that half of the cans in the package were not the brand that I ordered but Instead were unnamed cans that just read "96% beef".  I've ordered this product before and it was fine, but this time was very disappointing.

If you're like my mom and have an intestinal condition that is aggravated by hard rough food or SMALL HARD SEEDS, don't buy this. The product is tasty enough, but she can't eat it due to it being packed with zillions of hard, miniscule seeds!Did someone change the rules? Last I checked, Preserves = ground up fruit. Jelly = seedless, pulpless... JELLY!Red Currant Jelly is easy enough to find in the store, and it doesn't have any seeds. Is making black currant jelly a crime against nature or something? I can't find it anywhere!Is there anyone out there who makes a seedless Black Currant jelly? Anyone? *cricket cricket*Poor mom. She was so disappointed.Both the people who make this and the people who sell this need to find the highest points in their houses and jump off them onto something sharp for labeling fruit preserves as jelly.
A friend told me about this stuff so I thought I would give it a try. AWESOME! So far I have used it on chicken and steak on the grill. Great flavor with just a tiny bit of heat, perfect.

This sauce's depth and breath of flavor puts it above all that I've tasted.  No store bought product comes close.  Simmer some green and wax beans; sliced shitaki mushrooms and thin sliced red bell pepper until the beans are crisp tender in chicken stock to cover-drain and add this sauce.  Allow to rest for 10 minutes, then enjoy.  It's great hot, warm or cold.

This is a great multi purpose sauce.  It not only adds spicy zest to your food, but also adds flavor.  Use it in all your cooking as well as a table sauce for breads, veggies, meats, or anything you can think of.  A table without Saigon Sizzle is not fully set!!!

I bought this brand without having tried it beforehand because I couldn't find any mulling spices in bags in the local grocery stores last month, and I was ready for some apple juice and mulling spices.  It tastes very good, much the same as another brand a friend shared with me last year.  I have tried other instant brands but didn't care for them.  These are perfect for me, although the amount I had to buy here on amazon was really more than what I wanted.

I was looking for a substitute for my coffee since my Doctor told me I could no longer enjoy my morning cup. I am not a huge fan of Tea, but I do enjoy a glass of Apple Juice. In the mornings now I grab my coffee mug, fill it with my favotite Tree Top apple juice, heat it for 2 minutes in the micorwave, and drop in a bag of this WONDERFUL Mulling Spice. I LOVE the fact that I can have a KICK of flavor and a nice warm beverage. This is the best substitute for my coffee I have ever found.I rather liked the large packaging, this will give me many months of worry free morning routines. The boxes are tucked in the cupboard where my coffee and tea were stored and fit nicely. If you remember this wonderful flavor as a child around Christmas, you must try this product. It has all the right combinations of flavor to make it the perfect addition to anyones morning.
This is great without Apple juice. You can use hot water and make tea. It has no calaries, but on it's own has a sweet taste.

Very excited to see this on Amazon! For the past couple years I would always wait patiently for apple season to see the the R.W Knudsen mulling spices on the shelves.  I used to stock up!  So good in hot apple juice!

I found this stuff at Wegman's grocery store in VA while we were on the east coast for a short time. I've been looking all over for it since! So I'm so happy to have found it here on Amazon! Don't hesitate to try it, it's fabulous! If you like hot apple cider, you'll absolutly love this stuff! I heat up a cup of apple cider then use one of these tea bags and it's heavenly!
Great mulling spices. We add these to our hot tea and hot apple juice and cider. Can't wait to try it with red wine for warm mulled wine! Great price for the convenient small tea bags.
I am addicted to these nuts!  The perfect combination of sweet, salty and crunchy.  An extremely satisfying healthy, low carb snack.
Nice chewie little sugarless Gummies. All the flavor and texture of regular. I just wish the came with sugar alcohol information. Other than that a fine product, with excellent delivery.

column9: The service was quick and well done.
column10: The service was quick and not too hard to order.I will be ordering again.Thank you.
The shipping was very fast!My dogs love these treats! This is the best price I have ever found for them! Will order from again!

When I couldn't find the orange flower water I have used for years I took a chance and bought the Nielsen-Massey brand and I was not disappointed.  Helped us make great Ramon Fizzes on Christmas morning.

column9: Great sauce for fish or chicken!
column10: This sauce makes it so easy to make fish and chicken taste so much more interesting.  It is a unique blend of sweet and spicy (but not too spicy)!  I usually saute fish in a little olive oil.  When just about finished, I add a little of this sauce over the top and then turn the fish over for a minute or two.  It is that easy!I have given away many bottles of this sauce to friends and they end up loving it too...

column9: Sweet, moderately hot. I like it
column10: I actually sampled the Fischer & Wieser Mango Ginger Habanero Sauce, 21-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 6) but the contents are exactly the same, only the bottle size is different.The Mango puree is the main ingredient in the Habanero sauce, followed closely by Honey - so think REAL SWEET. And apple sauce, ginger, some vinegar, sugar, spices and, of course, Habanero peppers. No preservatives whatsoever.I don't know why, I expected a super-hot mixture, something likely to burn a hole in my stomach if swallowed but, as it happens to be the case with the other Fischer & Wieser sauce I sampled, the Fischer & Wieser Razzpotle Roasted Raspberry Chipotle Sauce, 20-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 6), this one too is a well-balanced - it means NOT HOT - concoction that discretely but effectively enhances the taste of whatever it may be added to. My uses so far, and the Habanero met and exceeded expectations: an Egyptian omelette (don't ask how or why), lamb chops, salmon.When used as directed, the Habanero sauce will tilt any dinner toward the mysterious, the flavorful, the exotic.P.S. - it's a 5-star ONLY if you don't mind 'sweet' in a hot sauce.
This is one of the best sauces I ever had. I just about fits to everything. Whether it's beef, lamb, pork, fish or poultry. Really great stuff.
Not as good as the product I was looking for.  Ginger added gives a taste I am not used to and so I did not enjoy as much as I thought I would.

My family loved the Raspberry and Blueberry sauces so when I saw this one at the store I just had to try it.  What a disappointment!  I marinated chicken to grill and everyone agreed it was bland and blah.  I've heard that you can mix the sauces with oil and vinegar to make salad dressing so maybe this would be okay on a salad but it's flavor isn't stong enough to stand up to chicken.  I'd say skip this one and buy the Raspberry or Blueberry ones instead!
This is the greatest marinade. I have used on chicken, pork chops, shrimp. It gives a dynamic flavor to your food. Highly recommend. Hard to find in stores. Thank you Amazon for this product !!!

I urge you to try this seasoning. I had never purchased food items on Amazon before but I liked this so much after purchasing it at a local store, I had to find it somewhere else when they didn't have it the next time. I love it on all types of meat (steak, chicken, pork) and even love it on trout!

Great organic seeds, they appear to be almost unwashed - smell like soil.  They aren't that great for cooking at all.  They have an odd residue coating them that you can get rid of with water, but then the seeds are useless!Stay away if you want quality seeds to COOK with, I'M VERY HIGHly informed on quality seeds.

These are no longer Colorado Spice Seeds. Colorado spice seeds were the best. Unwashed with a crisp, peppery taste. These are no longer those seeds. Otto's are just soggy, heavily washed seeds. Nothing good, just run of the mill stuff. Overpriced at this quality. I won't buy again. This ad is deceptive.

column9: Great product but could be a little cheaper
column10: I agree with the other guy. Great earthy smelling stuff. However, the product could be a little cheaper. I know the containers and printing cost money, but still.  In anycase this company is excellent.
I don't know about cooking with them, but throw a few hand-fulls into your garden.  I have hundreds of these coming up now.

These seeds got to me very quickly ...And for cooking I'm sure there fine...But they are very clean seeds washed washed washed ...No taste... no oil....Might as well buy them from the supermarket...Complete TEA USELESS....I think some of the other reviewers may work for the company....Look Elsewhere folks....

The seeds arrived a day early. These seeds fall into the middle quality.  They are not totally washed but don't have a strong peppery flavour like completely raw unwashed seeds which contain more residue on the outside shell.I would prefer these seeds to totally flavorless washed seeds, but they aren't the dark large aromatic seeds that pop up now and then with that beautiful earthy and peppery flavor that are almost sticky with residue. The packaging was excellent and they arrive really fast for standard shipping.

column9: Good Price & Quality, but Better Deals Are Available
column10: For anyone who does any cooking that involves poppy seeds, it makes total sense to buy in semi-bulk.For the cost of two, twenty-eight ounces of these high quality Colorado Spice seeds, you might be able to buy a few ounces (6-9 bottles) from your local grocery store.There are many great recipes from Eastern Europe that use lots and lots of these tasty seeds. I haven't bothered trying to buy in super-bulk yet, like the 70 lbs bags! But I might in the near future :)I should offer a warning to people who are subjected to random urinalyses: at work, in the military or on probation: some of the recipes that call for a large amounts of poppy seeds (like Hungarian "Beiglis") can cause a positive result for opiate use.I run these tests for people in my department and for some employees, it can cause serious problems, so please be careful! I unofficially tested myself after eating a Czech Kolache, and my pee was positive for opiates for four days!! (using the OPI2000 indicator kit)Probably best not to bring these dishes in to work and share them with your co-workers! They covered this on Myth-Busters I heard, and its absolutely true.

My family love pasta (we are not Italian!) and over the years it seems that we were addicted to the heavy tomatoe base sauces and gradually ventured into others. Then I found Parma Rosa which is just the right combination of tomato, cream, subtle flavors etc. It is perfect for a main dish or a side dish. There are other similar ones on the grocers shelves and I've tried them but nothing does it better than Knorrs!Pasta Lover

column9: Great in a variety of recipes
column10: Slow cooker Italian spare ribs are among our favorite meal.  Parma Rosa sauce forms a base and Knorr's mix saves a great deal of time.
Was sent in 100+ weather and still managed to get here in one piece and without melting!  Used them at my baby shower and everyone loved them!  Would definitely recommend!
I like the secure way Hirts ships their products.  The plants are growing.  They already have shoots on them.  I'm really enjoying watching it grow.

column9: These are not the oysters you want
column10: Crown Prince sells some good oysters, but these aren't it.  These oysters are packed in industrial seed oil (cottonseed oil in this case), which is not only horrible health-wise, it also doesn't taste good.  And they're from China, which has notoriously bad water pollution issues.These are the good ones: Crown Prince Natural Smoked Oysters in Pure Olive Oil, 3-Ounce (Pack of 9).  They're packed in olive oil and they're from South Korea.  Unfortunately, Amazon is currently out of stock in them, but these are the ones you want.

I had two cans at once.  I love these.  Nicely smoked, plump, great tasting, and perfect with Crackers. I recommend that you add these to your pantry for those quick fixes or just to satisfy a craving.
They are big and good!!! They don't have anything hard to bite into inside like others do.  I like crown prince smoked oysters.  I am an oyster snob and these meat the cut.  Very good!!

I'm trying to increase the seafood part of my diet and my local grocery has a small display of canned seafood items. I'm trying them out. One of the items is Crown Prince Smoked Oysters in Cottonseed Oil (3.75 ounce can). It says that one serving size is one can and that seemed just about right for a light evening meal. I had the oysters with some low fat "Wisecrackers" having roasted garlic and rosemary. It was a good combination with the oysters. It was a good snack-sized meat and quite delicious. The oysters were a little high in fat and cholesterol but had 28 grams of protein, 28% of my daily needs! The oysters were quite good tasting and I'll be picking them up again in the future.Gary Peterson

The other oysters from this company are raised in South Korea but these are from China!  Do not buy them!  And you can't return them even still in the bag they were shipped in.  It looks like the trash can will be having oysters for dinner.  I should have known when the descriptin didn't say anything that they were hiding something.  The other oyster products from this company proudly say South Korea as the place of origin.

column9: A little bit of beach in every bite!
column10: Now I can save a trip to the local beachfront and smell the seaweed soaked sand, and maybe even eat a little, each time I open a can of these really beachy smelling and tasting oysters from the good people in Mainland China, where all workers are happy all the time, just like their English radio broadcasts say.  Well, whether it's sand or shell bits that my teeth are grinding on, I'm sure to get some extra minerals that I didn't pay for each time I'm hungry enough to wolf down a can of these little mollusks.Oh, and they come packed in Cottonseed oil.  You know, the oil squeezed right from the seeds of the plant your T-Shirt is made of, and we know how great T-shirts taste!Seriously, what was I thinking?  I suppose I'll finish the package I bought because I abhor wasting food, and there are many in the world who don't even get to eat stuff like this, but I'll never buy this product again.

column9: Whole Smoked Oysters To Die For
column10: Crown Prince Whole Smoked Oysters in Cottonseed Oil are with out a doubt the best there are!  I've been enjoying these since I was a young girl.  I cant imagine a holiday without these delicious smoked oysters. If you want the best smoked whole oysters just go to Amazon.com and start shopping Crown Prince an enjoy!

column9: Buckwheat flour without the strong buckwheat taste.
column10: I had been looking for light buckwheat flour for a while, most available is dark buckwheat flour which has a strong distinct taste.  This still has a little of that, but is much, much more mellow than a dark buckwheat flour.

I use buckwheat flour regularly, and specially like the one that have a good  amount of skin of buckwheat seed in them. Basically, this flour is too much like refined wheat flour instead of like whole wheat flour.

"Soba" is a noodle made from buckwheat flour, and is one of my favorite Japanese foods.  If I lived somewhere in east or west coast, I could find Japanese food restaurant where I can eat it.  However, it have been only the way to use dried noodle here.  Once I tried to make "soba" with a buckwheat flour found in a store, it was ground whole buckwheat including pellicle and inner skin. It's flavor was "soba" but contained too much fibers.  Then I had given up to make it until I get this.This flour is from good part of buckwheat, and suitable to make "soba" noodle.  I'm enjoying making "soba" with this flour on each weekend.This flour is not "sa-ra-si-na" (in Japanese) that is a flour using the most inner starch rich part, but "ichiban ko" (1st grade flour) or "nami ko" (general purpose flour).  "Soba" from this flour becomes "Edo mae" (Tokyo style).  If this has little bit more of inner skin (or pellicle), I can make "Inaka soba" (country style), I like more than "Edo mae".
I just made the bomb chicken fajitas with this seasoning. They were better then any chicken fajitas I've ever had at any restaurant. GOOD STUFF!!!
I cook a lot and my local store stopped carrying this product, I use this on anything bbq'd, anything Mexican. Can't recommend enough all of these flavors they have!! Great stuff.

column9: Awesome! You can get this online!
column10: And here I thought I could only get this spice from HEB in San Antonio...I have been having it sent by friends living and traveling through San Antonio for years now....this product is awesome from eggs to chicken/tuna salad to steak rubs...it adds every bit of flavor and brings out the best in the dish!

column9: Hard to find, love the flavor.
column10: We've been looking for this specific brand of fajita spice for a couple of years and finally found it here.  Very flavorful not only for Mexican dishes, but for many other dishes, even rice and eggs.  Big burst of nice flavor.

This is a great seasoning for meat, eggs, popcorn and just about any other ssavory dish. We use it on so many different things and it just lends and great onion and garlic flavor along with other seasonings!

I lightly sprinkle this spice seasoning on pork,beef,chicken,ground meats for burgers always and have for many years.the mixture is well balanced and needs no extra seasoning to add. I even use on fish with great results. what I like about this seasoning is it does not over power the flavor of the meat or fish you apply it to. I try not to over season anything,I want the true flavors to dominate and for the seasoning to accenuate. this it does very well!!Rosemary...

column9: an essential in any grillers kitchen
column10: hot but not to hot, wild taste, something youv'e never had before, great on cold chicken or just of the grill, tacos, you name it, great marinade.

African Rhino Peri-Peri Sauce is very unique, not your average hot sauce. Relying on a carefully balanced blend of flavors it is  a rich thick sauce that absolutely shines on chicken, shrimp and pork. I love it on ribs! Roasted vegetables are a natural for this sauce. We have a grilled shrimp recipe that is an absolute crowd pleases. Take some jumbo shrimp and marinate them in a mixture of honey and African Rhino Peri-Peri sauce skewer and and pour the marinade on the shrimp while grilling. Works great for chicken kebabs too.

column9: Who doesn't love a tootsie pop
column10: I bought these to put in my office.  They were exactly what I expected- a retail box of tootsie pops!  My box included banana flavor lollipops, which I could have done without, but otherwise, it was the classic flavors that everyone knows and loves!
Due to extreme heat overseas I found this a perfect gift to send to our troops. Most of them love chocolate but impossible to send during summer.

My box was made up of 6 flavors and 25 out of the 100 were chocolate. I didn't expect it be perfectly evenly distributed, but 25% being one flavor was too much. I like the chocolate flavor the least. I prefer the charms blow pops these.

If you've had Tootsie Pops you know what I mean. If you haven't you've got to try them! Flavors are chocolate, cherry, raspberry, grape and orange.All have a tootsie roll in the middle. They don't put enough chocolate flavored one though, and I don't like the new flavor- blue raspberry, but it's a great bargain and a great thing to snack on when on a diet.

column4: Lonnie E. Holder "The Review's the Thing"
column10: Just how many licks does it take to get to the center of a Tootsie Roll pop? While the world may never know, you will have 100 chances with assorted flavors to try for yourself.It has been a while since I last saw Kojak with a Tootsie Roll Pop in his mouth, but I am unable to recall if he ever got to the point where he bit through to the center. I can only suck on one of these for so long and then...CRUNCH! Tootsie Roll Pops are alternatively called Tootsie Pops, as noted on the Tootsie Roll web site.Tootsie Roll Pops, invented in 1931, have been one of my favorites since my childhood. Of course, some of us never quite grow up, and the pleasure of sucking on a Tootsie Pop remains.
Both the chocolate and lemon zest madeleines are soft, fresh, and very delicious.  A real treat.  I highly recommend them and would buy again.

my dog just loves.  Thought I'd try this bacon flavor.  Gosh surprise surprise she loves them.  I now have tried all the flavors of Pet Botanics training rewards and have gotten doggie approval on all.I particularly like the size since I don't want anything huge in my pocket while walking but need to carry a bunch for training purposes.  These are perfect for that.I don't think you can go wrong with this product.

It's a bit pricey with shipping, but I bought this because this brand has unusual colors.  I needed purple for a King Cake, and here in Illinois you just can't find purple sugar.  I actually like this brand quite a bit, and would recommend it.The colors are nice and bright compared to some cheaper brands I've seen.  The first thing I noticed, however, is that the sugar crystals are LARGE compared to the near-shavings I get from the colored sugars I got at the local grocery store.  I guess I'll have to go buy the Green and Gold ones too, so they match next time.
These were awesome on the cookies we made for my Son's Eagle Scout Court of Honor.  Would be great for 4th of July or honoring military.

column9: It is a great energy sources! It is not very sweet also.
column10: I love this chocolate espresso Beans, compare to other products,this one has a better balance of chocolate and the espresso beans, it is a great energy sources and not that very sweet.

I am allergic to many "cholesterol free" oil substitutes and preservatives, I simply cannot process these kinds of fats. La Tourangelle Coconut oil is unrefined Virgin & Organic, it contains zero trans fats and is easily absorbed by the human body. I use it as a substitute for virtually every oil a recipe calls for, save Olive oil. Non-Hydrogenated and solidifies when cold and turns to liquid at room temp, but never spoils! Awesome stuff!

When I purchased this product I thought I was buying Ruby Red Grapefruit juice.  Instead this is a mixture of white grape juice, apple juice, red grapefruit juice, pectin, acorbic acid and "other natural flavors".  The result is a sweetish, cloying drink with only the faintest hint of grapefruit and a vaguely unpleasant aftertaste.  To label this product Ruby Red Grapefruit juice isa complete misnomer.Since this product is unreturnable, I'm now stuck with 24 bottles of mixed juices which I hope I can give away or donate to a food pantry.

These are the best "sugar free" (non-enriched wheat flour) crackers I have ever eaten. These are the best & sweetened w/ fruit juice! I am on the sugar busters diet & one of the few snacks you can have is triscuits. Now, you can dress them up, but a reduced fat triscuit is not very satisfying all by itself. I am very finicky about taste & IMO, these are better than Ritz, which can sometimes be too salty. I love these, I can eat 3 or 4 & stop a hunger craving until my next meal or put some smuckers natural peanut butter on them for a more satisfying snack. I promise you, you will not think they taste bad at all. They may not become your fav cracker, but no nasty after tastes or anything negative about them! One last thing, they come in a plastic bag, so I don't feel compelled to eat part or 1/2 of a roll...I just take out a few & close the box.
Post Selects cereals are wonderful.  I was very happy to find it on Amazon when we needed it, as our store had stopped getting it.  I would shop on Amazon anytime I need anything that we use or eat.

column9: Not sweat, good fiber and protein.
column10: I like this cereal. It is not sweat at all which suits me well. It is also a good source of fiber and proteins. In addition, isn't it simple to make a meal from it?
Taste delicious!  This is one of my favorite cereals, and I'm thrilled to get it for such a great price.

column9: Possibly the best cereal on the planet!
column10: I am a big fan of pecans.  Not a big fan of cereals in general.  However, after years of trying everything, I found this one and am happy to eat it most every day.  I previously found it at my local grocery, but now it is scarce.  Most every store has gone to carrying only the ones with the smallest amount of pecans and lots of other stuff.  I decided to do a search online and was amazed to find that Amazon carried it!  The price was decent, the shipping was free and I'm set for a couple of months!  Thanks Amazon!
This is my favorite adult cereal - low in sugar and fats, high on crunch, flavor, and fiber.  Recommend that parents start their kids on this cereal instead of the sugar-coated cereals.

column4: Just a Mom with her thoughts
column9: So delicious and good for you
column10: I started eating healthy about a year ago which includes eating a nutritious breakfast every day. I was very excited to try the new Post Great Grains Cereals, especially after seeing the television commercial comparison between Post Great Grains and other cereals. The difference really is in the grain. Post Great Grains looks like it was just picked fresh from the field. And the taste is absolutely wonderful. It's not cardboard-y tasting at all; the flavor is delicious and just the right combination of ingredients. Of the two boxes I received, the Post Great Grains Raisins, Dates & Pecans is definitely my favorite but that's probably because I love raisins. :) Do yourself a favor and try Post Great Grains. You'll be amazed at the difference in the grain!

I don't understand how anyone could eat this cereal.  It immediately turned to mush.  Maybe that's because I use almond milk, but I doubt it makes a difference.  Even as I was pouring the milk, I could see the cereal soaking it up like a sponge!  I have never said this about anything before in my life, but it was not sweet enough.  It tasted flat.  I usually choose cereals with little sugar, but even I thought this needed more.  After I added sugar to it, I still couldn't force myself to finish the bowl.  This soggy bowl of slop was just too disgusting to be edible.  I really wanted to like this cereal -- it's got excellent nutritional value.  Very disappointing.

column9: Low quality product for a top quality price
column10: While the pod I received was of the advertised size, it did not meet my expectations in terms of product quality. The container was quite obviously handmade by someone with no attention to detail and poor metalworking skills, using materials that can best be described as city dump scrap. It is stainless steel, but it's pitted and of uneven thickness. The rolled edges were done very badly and are quite uneven. And while the box is of the specified dimensions, what was not specified is that it is not true-to-shape, making the fit between the top and bottom far less than ideal. In my opinion, this box should be valued at no more than a dollar or two. I think the seller has a lot of nerve offering this as first-quality merchandise.

These are just the size the description states- snack size.  Ours came from the 3-in-one (which we LOVE).  I've never used these for anything wet, but it's perfect for pretzel sticks, or to put cucumbers in to keep the rest of the food from getting damp.  The lids always feel secure, but at the same time, easy to pull off.  Four stars insteade of five, because of price.

I BOUGHT TWO OF THESE AND I AM SENDING THEM BACK BECAUSE THEY ARE ABOUT 3 X 1 1/2 INCHES THEY LOOK BIG IN THE AD AND THE LIDS KEEP POPPING OFF.  THE ARE $9.49 EACH--DON'T WASTE YOUR MONEY BUYING THESE PIECES OF JUNK.

column9: Best instant Noodles i've ever had...
column10: I'd have to say these Hot & Spicy Instant noodles are among some of the best out there.  Highly recommend trying some if you like spicy stuff and ramen noodles...
Good noodles, I admit.  It tastes just as good if not better if you only use half of the seasoning packet - still spicy and you don't get sodium poisoning.

This tastes pretty much exactly like the instant/non-cup version, which says a lot.  There's quite a kick to it that the hot/spicy intolerant may find difficult to stomach but that can easily be fixed since the seasoning package (hot) can be adjusted.  Finally, this is perfect for a snack since 2.6 oz isn't enough for a meal.

Note, this is just the ORGANIC; I think their others have sugar--just remember green lid is on the organic.  I love it on whole grain crackers drizzled with local raw honey.  And to keep my carbs/fats/protein balanced, I also usually add some chocolate rice protein.  As well as some healthy sea salt and a teaspoon or so of ground flax.  I blend it all into the butter, then spread.  I really doctor it up, but that's not to mask the taste--which is great on its own--I'm just big on the healthy stuff :-)  Another great thing about sunflower butter (and oil) is that it's a good source of vitamin E and also has magnesium, a mineral many of us need more of. And if all of that isn't enough, I also re-purpose the green lid.  It fits (pretty well) a cute glass salsa jar that I also re-purpose (keep nuts in them in the frig). column9: A marketing fad does not make for a nice tea
column10: "Green Tea with Pomegranate and Acai" seems more like an attempt to cash in on a health fad instead of creating a balanced and delicious tea.  Here you have three products that have recently been hailed as miracle foods all bundled into one cuppa together.Although the health benefits and drawbacks of both green tea and pomegranate juice have been well-documented, the Acai berry's claims are more tenuous.  Acai berries have fewer antioxidants than grapes or blueberries, and no credible evidence exists supporting the other miraculous claims.  Even so, with this tea listing "pomegranate and acai flavors" as the final ingredient on the package, the amount of each fruit is so minimal as to be inconsequential.  There is far more "organic hibiscus" and "organic rose hips" in this tea than either pomegranate or acai "flavors."But the real bottom line on any tea is the "Green Tea with Pomegranate and Acai" just doesn't taste very nice.  It tastes like none of the listed ingredients, and comes off as more of an attempt at making Kool-Aid-flavored  tea than anything else.
I really love the flavor of this tea.  It doesn't taste like the grass in my back yard, like some other green teas.  I add a spoonful of honey and enjoy this tea every day.

column9: Delicious chocolate way to get 14grams of fiber and only 2 net carbs per bar
column10: These Chocoperfection bars taste so good, you'll never believe they are good for you!  I get these at my local Jimbo's for $3.85each but am hoping they will be available from Amazon soon!  What a delicious way to g35 14grams of fiber!Instead of sugar, Chocoperfection uses erythritol which has 95% fewer calories than sugar, 93% fewer than maltitol, and no effect on insulin levels, and oligofructose, a sweet tasting dietary fiber made primarily from chicory (not the same as fructose).These silky-smooth, delicious chocolate bars actually help you lose weight because the high fiber content and the high fiber content also acts as an appetite suppressant.And unlike maltitol-sweetened chocolate, ChocoPerfection bars will never upset your stomach, give you gas, make you bloat, or stall your weight loss.  Chocolate Perfect!On top of all that, Chocoperfection is diabetic-safe and tooth-freindly, too.  What more could you ask of a chocolate bar?What is erythritol?Like xylitol, erythritol is a polyol or sometimes called a sugar-alcohol (although none of them contain sugar or alcohol,) and has some of the cavity-fighting similarities.Xylitol is as sweet as sugar and has about 2/3 the calories.Erythritol, on the other hand, is about 70% as sweet as sugar and and almost zero calories.  Plus it is better tolerated by most peoplewith less gastronomical or laxative reactions.  By the way, XylitolNow sells erythritol in bulk on the main product page.Being only 70% as sweet as sugar, erythritol sometimes needs a little help in the sweetness department. In the case of these bars, that's where oligofrutose comes in.What is oligofructose?OligofructoseFrom Wikipedia, the free encyclopediaOligofructose, sometimes called Fructooligosaccharide or just  (FOS), is a subgroup of inulin, specifically those fructose polymers with a degree of polymerization (DP) <= 10. Unlike most carbohydrates, it is not digested in the human small intestine and thus has a lower calorific value, whilst contributing to dietary fiber. Oligofructose is on the more soluble side, due to its lower chain length, than the general class of inulins and is therefore commonly used as an additive to yoghurt and other dairy products. It is used specially in combination with high-intensity artificial sweeteners, whose sweetness profile and aftertaste it improves. Oligofructose is also a prebiotic stimulating the growth of bifidobacteria in particular.Food SourcesFOS is extracted from fruits and vegetables like bananas, onions, chicory root, garlic, asparagus, barley, wheat, and tomatoes. The Jerusalem Artichoke has been found to have one of the highest concentrations of FOS. (In the case of Chocoperfection, the oligofructose is extracted from chicory root.)Health BenefitsFOS has been a popular dietary supplement in Japan for many years and is now becoming increasingly popular in Western cultures for its prebiotic effects. FOS serves as "fast food" for the probiotic beneficial or "friendly" bacteria that naturally populate the gut, increasing their ability to benefit overall Gastrointestinal Tract (GI Tract) health, especially proper digestion. It has also been touted as a supplement for preventing yeast infections.And this from Steggall Nutrition:Oligofructose is a tremendous substrate for bifidus bacteria, stimulating its activity by several hundred percent. This is called prebiotic activity, referring to stimulation of health promoting bacteria in the intestinal tract. Short chain fatty acids are produced, lowering pH levels and providing an energy source for the growth and maintenance of large intestine cells. This process leads to differentiation of cancer cells, a vital step that is required before cancer cells can be killed.The ideal environment for healthy bacteria is quite different to the environment preferred by pathogens and gram negative putrefactive bacteria. Consequently the undesirable bacteria diminish in number as the healthy bacteria proliferate in the presence of oligofructose.

column9: These dried shiitakes have a slightly smaller average diameter than Havista's 3-5cm shiitakes
column10: Havista's "3-4cm" dried shiitakes have a slightly smaller average diameter than Havista's "3-5cm" dried shiitakes.  The big picture is that there wasn't much difference between "3-4cm" and "3-5cm."  I counted about half as many 5.0cm to 5.5cm diameter dried shiitakes in this product as I found in Havista's "3-5cm" dried shiitake product.  The tiny 2.5cm to 3.0cm dried shiitakes were slightly more numerous in this product than Havista's "3-5cm" product.  Apparently, Havista believes that kilogram for kilogram, their tiny shiitakes are worth slightly more than their larger shiitakes.  Interestingly, the Japanese believe just the opposite.  In Japan, the largest shiitakes are called, "donko," and separated from the rest to be sold at a higher price per kilogram than the rest.  The quality of these dried shiitakes is about as good as any other brand of dried shiitakes.  About 1 mushroom in 30 to 50 might be defective (taste sour or look decomposed).  That's not worse than other brands.  These dried shiitakes will fully occupy just slightly less than 5 1/2 one-gallon plastic jars.  Product of China.Caution:  Havista's dried shiitakes are extremely rich in vitamin D2.  Without even contacting Havista, I can tell that these shiitakes received plenty of sunshine where they were farmed.  I get hypercalciuria (calcium sand in my urine) after eating only two-thirds of the dried shiitakes in a 1-gallon plastic jar.  Hypercalciuria is a symptom of hypervitaminosis D (vitamin D overdose).

column10: Flaxseed's Latin species name, Linum usitatissimum,  means "most useful." Couldn't have picked a better name myself. Flaxseed is a really useful addition to your diet. It contains alpha linolenic acid (ALA) which is an omega-3 fatty acid that helps with heath health, bone health and is an anti-inflammatory.Plus it is great for cholesterol. A study compared people with high cholesterol who added 20 grams of ground flaxseed to their diet. These people were compared to people taking a statin drug. After two months, there were significant reductions of total cholesterol, LDL cholesterol and triglycerides in both groups.So, clearly it's good for you, but lots of things are good for you. Question is, how difficult is it to add flaxseed to one's diet? This is where flaxseed distinguishes itself. Flaxseed can be sprinkled on all kinds of food. I put it on my cereal, in my smoothies, on my sandwiches and I don't really notice it. This is where flaxseed shines, it is invisible.Alright, so I don't notice it. How about other people? column9: Want your dog dead?  If so, buy this product!
column10: I was in a hurry as I shopped at my local pet food store late on a Saturday night.  My dogs needed dog food.  I buy a high quality dog food, it's ingredients contain everything my vet wants me to be feeding me dogs. I also wanted to get them some special treats. But in my haste I picked up a bag of these "gourmet" chicken breast treats.  Usually I read the label on everything I give my dogs.  Not this time, they looked healthy and were very similar to other chicken breast treats I normally buy.  Had I carefully read the back of the bag I would have immediately returned them to the shelf and moved on.  The words on the back of the bag "not for human consumption, wash hands thoroughly with soap and water after handling this product"-"made in China" would have tipped me off!!!  I never saw these warnings until after my beloved jack russell became very ill only mere hours after eating one of these treats.  My vet wanted to know what had she eaten that was different?  I handed him the bag-he looked it over in horror.  My dog developed an obstruction from the treat, which caused bloat because nothing could pass, salmonella and e-coli poisoning, and an infection in her heart giving her a 4/6 heart murmur.  She had to undergo expoloratory surgery, 7 sets of xrays, 2 ultrasounds, multiple blood tests,an ecg and we're not done yet.  She is still in recovery, tests still pending.  This was one of the healthiest dogs my vet cared for before this incident.  Never had a health issue in the past, never a heart murmur.  At 9 years old most people thought she was 3 or 4.  I have been told the heart murmur has been caused by the infection settling in her heart, which is now irreversable.  Which means if she makes it through all of this her life expectancy just went from 16+ to 10 or 11.My vet cultured one of the treats and could not believe what disease and bacteria it was loaded with.  I cannot believe I took such good care of her for 9 years and then put her through all of this suffering because I didn't take the time to carefully look the product over. Thank you, Cadet and IMS Pet Products for contributing to my dog's pain and suffering.

column9: A Happy Dog is a Green Dog
column10: My wife and I share our home with the Three Muske-Terriers: A male Westie, a male Cesky and, the Empress-of-All-She-Surveys, a female Scotty. The Empress is alergic to wheat, (along with corn and soy), so I had my doubts concerning Pet Greens Roasted Chicken Recipe w/ Wheat Grass Dog Treats - wheat grass after all is just "juvenile" wheat. But apparently not to worry! We're half way through our first bag and no allergic reaction, (you haven't lived until you've seen a crazed Scotty in the middle of an allergic frenzy chewing on her tootsies). Now, putting aside her allergies, the Empress will eat almost anything - and so will the Cesky. But the Westie gives new meaning to the term "finicky" - and Asta gives these treats five barks - I mean, stars. So what's up here?The treats are mostly roasted chicken meal, supplemented with dried chicory extract, organic ground wheat grass powder, lecithin, salt, cultured whey and garlic, preserved with "mixed tocopherols," (I'm not a chemist, but I think that's a fancy name for vitamin E, sourced from vegetable oil). The wheat grass doesn't contain any wheat glutten - which I think is the reason it doesn't trigger the Empress' allergies. Wheat grass is an excellent source of any and all of the nutrients contained in fresh vegetables.The treats are small "jerky-like" rectangles - no more than an inch by 3/4s of an inch, and maybe 1/16 of an inch thick, (they may be more appropriate for small to medium size dogs - a large dog would want three or four at a time). They're great for a quick reward and at only about 4 calories a piece, there's not much danger that your dog is going to put on unwanted pounds, (however I wouldn't suggest that you carry them loose in your pocket or purse - they smell strongly of garlic - I keep 'em in a zip lock baggie).As far as I can tell, the ingrediants are all natural, but only the wheat grass is organic - if you are interested in organic treats, I suggest that you check out those made by Wagatha or Robbie Dawg.Bottom Line: I think that Pet Greens offers both a change of flavor and a change in texture from most common dog treats. The Three Muske-Terriers are scarfing 'em down - your furry buddy probably will too.

I was looking for a product that is not made in China, contains mostly meat and does without a long list of unhealthy ingredients. Having older rescued dogs with very few teeth, the treats also needed to be soft enough for them to chew. Pet Greens Treats fulfilled all of these requirements. The dogs aren't crazy about them, but will eat them. With all the dubious treats coming from China, this is a good choice.

column9: Among my top 5 favorites; The Very High End of Basic Chocolates
column10: Whenever my husband flies out west he brings me back a dark assortment of See's. I was extremely annoyed that the product might perish after the UPS man did not leave them at my door as I requested. That's when I called See's and got help and assurance from a phenomenal customer service representative named Theresa. She listened. She didn't interrupt. She didn't use cliche's. She contacted UPS to try to have them redeliver. When I asked how much longer she would be on duty, she told me "31 minutes." (Sweet Savannah! She kept you abreast of every detail)! If she put me on hold, she told me when she would be back, and she was. (Anyone who has been put on hold for three minutes begins to wonder if the person at the other end forgot you, doesn't care, or doesn't know any better). Before she called UPS she asked me which number was the best number to reach me. Sure enough, Theresa called back in 6 minutes and apologized for taking so long. She even offered to send another box, without charge, through a different carrier, no questions asked. It was here the next day.The chocolates were in a very decorative box with bags of ice on top to ensure freshness. The chocolates and ice were wrapped in cellophane and bubble wrap to protect against damage and insulate the cold. Then there was the product itself. Wow!This kind of product and customer service is what makes a customer for life. I hear that their maple peanut butter brittle is highly prized, and I am waiting to try it, and make up a customized box of chocolate. Yes, you can do that too, but you can only get that from the source--the See's Candy website. It's definitely worth it.There is no Godiva, Perugina, Whitman's or any other brand from now on. This is it.I expect my Amazon friend will comment--"See's, I told ya!"
