It didn't taste artificial at all and instantly evoked memories of Thanksgiving dinner for me.I knew this had to be enjoyed hot, so I brought out the gear. I whisked it up, added some milk, and took a sip. And man oh man, is this delicious. The pumpkin pie flavors really pop, especially the cinnamon. I think the spices are a little more pronounced than the actual pumpkin flavor, but it's a delicious and yummy treat.  I even added sweetener to kick it up a notch and it certainly did.All in all, a fantastic desert  and a lot less guilt after having this than a regular pumpkin pie.

Out of the package, this matcha smells strongly like spicy whole cloves with a bit of sweetness.Prepared as a traditional hot matcha, (1/2tsp of matcha powder whisked with 175f water) the spices are very present over top a pumpkiny mellowness. Slightly sweet in flavor as well. I'd call this more of a "Spicy Pumpkin Matcha" than pumpkin pie. I did not detect any bitterness in this matcha. Overall not bad if you are in the mood for spicy fall flavors.Now, this is where Red Leaf's matchas shine - in latte form! I'm doing a iced latte as it is too hot in SoCal right now. I used soymilk, ice, pumpkin pie matcha and a bit of sweetener shaked up in a blender bottle. The result: very amazing flavoring! I can taste the pumpkin pie spice more as a whole, with a bite of spicy cloves and ginger that linger in my mouth after drinking. The pumpkin is present and my brain is making me almost sense the smushy texture of the pie as a I drink this latte. The green tea is in the background and tasty.

My first hot matcha in God knows how long. Summer just doesn't lend itself to hot drinks, I'm more likely to just my matcha with cold water and blend vigoriously. But this one was just crying out to be made hot...so I'm taking it to work with me today (all I ever do anymore is work). Well after a day straight from hell, this tea was sorely needed. After yet another patient called in to yell at whoever was unfortunate enough to answer the phone (aka me), I decided to take a break. I found a quiet corner and curled up with Hunger Games and this beauty of tea.It tastes exactly as advertised! I really did feel like I was drinking a hot cup of pumpkin pie...yum. So much yum. I'm not the biggest pumpkin pie fan, but it's grown on me in recent years. But I am a huge fan of pumpkin lattes, at least I was, so this is definitely going to be mixed with soy milk next time. And cheesecake matcha. And french vanilla matcha. The possibilities are endless! This has made me eager for Thanksgiving and my signature pumpkin pound cake. I wonder how that would taste with a matcha icing...

Nothing makes me love fall more then pumpkin pie. When I saw this I ordered it right away. Its great it tastes just like your eating a piece of pumpkin pie. This is a bit heavier on the cloves but you can still taste the pie sweetness, its still tastes amazing. And the matcha isn't put on the back burner while the pumpkin shines. You taste the pie but also the matcha which is perfect!I think everyone should try this for a lovely fall drink. Made this into a hot latte delicious!

I made a tiny amount of this matcha and added it to a cup of hot skim milk and stirred in a teaspoon of raw sugar.  Oh my goodness!  This is so rich and so decadent, so GOOD!  Don't buy the small tin, because you are going to want to drink this all the time this fall and winter!  This isn't just a drink with some pumpkin pie spice in it, this is a well thought blend of flavors to give you an extraordinary warming experience.

This is the 4th Red Leaf matcha I've tried, and my favorite so far! The flavors are perfectly pie-y: clove, cinnamon, nutmeg, ginger, and of course pumpkin! It is JUST like a warm slice of pumpkin pie. Of course, the flavoring doesn't overshadow the nice, grassy matcha at all. They compliment each other perfectly, heavy dense pumpkin and light summery frothy matcha. This is best as a hot latte with a bit of sugar, such a nice treat.

With the start of September I have been craving autumnal flavors, especially pumpkin.  Upon opening the package, pumpkin pie flavoring filled my nose.  It was AMAZING!  It smelled exactly like a spiced pumpkin pie was sitting in my kitchen.I immediately made this into a cold latte based on the delicious smell alone.  Two ounces of warmed water blended with the pumpkin pie matcha, a smidge of sugar and a healthy 6 ounces of icy-cold milk later, I found myself speechless!  After downing the entire cup in record time, I must admit I really want another one!  This is Fall in a cup!In this particular flavor - pumpkin pie - the spices are rich!  Cloves, cinnamon, and nutmeg - they all mingle with the pumpkin without overpowering it.  It sort of reminds me of the Starbucks Pumpkin Pie coffee lattes I used to look forward to around this time of year.  I loved them so much I'd try recreating them at home.  Well now, I don't have to!  There's a much healthier version right here without the added sugar.This will not last me very long.

This tea has all the traditional spices of matcha with a heaviness on the clove but in a latte this matcha is AMAZING! Creamy spicy pumpkin pie goodness like mom makes!So good it totally satisfies the desire for a sweet dessert! I love Red Leaf matcha the quality is tops!When made into a latte with milk or creamer and ice it is total bliss!Tastes like pumpkin pie!

This green tea has a very natural flavor.  The taste of green tea is present without all of the sugar and sugar substitutes that are added to most other bottled teas.  Because it is unsweetened,  it only has a very slight sweetness and the aftertaste is very mild.  I've tried quite of few teas in my time, and it is not an easy task to find a good unsweetened green tea.  This is definitely it.The only true unsweetened green tea that rivals this one is the powder mix version (All Natural Organic Instant Green Tea Powder 8 oz. - Buy One Get One Free!) which I only keep in my cupboard because of the better price when purchased as a mix, and I drink a lot of tea!  If you enjoy your tea absolutely pure, without any sweeteners, flavorings, or additives of any kind I cannot recommend anything else but these two products.

column9: Made in Thailand! Not the original!
column10: I have been receiving this product for almost a year as a subscribe and save deal. Up until a few months ago Amazon sent the real, original thing. This is unfortunately no longer the case! If you order this you will get Ito En Oi Ocha, yes...but it's made in Thailand and comes in a really weak, pathetic bottle. Ito En HAS NOT changed their suppliers or changed their factory locations completely to Thailand. They still manufacture this product in Japan. Amazon has simply decided to buy the cheaper Thai version of the product, likely due to the strength of the Yen...but I would still gladly pay more to get the original thing...As far as the flavor goes, the Thai version tastes a different, likely due to the taste difference of Thai water vs. Japanese water. You cannot tell if it is VERY cold...but if it is above fridge temperature you can definitely taste (*and even smell!*) a difference.Amazon's image for the product is WRONG. That is not the product you will receive.Unless you have no other options to get this product DO NOT BUY IT until Amazon understands that sourcing "Japanese" green tea from Thailand is wrong and an insult to their customers.

column9: It's for Real Green Tea Lover!
column10: This is the #1 seller Tea in Japan while there are tons of tea options. so i think it says a lot.  It's realllllyyy good tea, from a tea drinker's point of view.  It has the good green tea flavors w every gulp of it, you can enjoy that.  Since I love green tea's flavor so much, now I am so happy to see they now offer a "darker" Oi Ocha version, stronger little bitter flavor.  It has a darker green packaging.  i hope you enjoy this and would love to see this tea more places!

column9: The original Oi Ocha sold in Japan
column10: Nothing against the prior reviewer who does not believe this is the original Oi Ocha, but I must say though...as a repeat buyer both of these 16.9 oz. bottles from Amazon as well as 2 liter imports straight from Japan, the two are identical. Every now and then I feel like having the stronger Oi Ocha Koi Aji (not sold by Amazon as of the time of this review), so I'm familiar with it as well. I've uploaded three photos, comparing the packaging, as well as closeups of exactly 1.0 fl. oz. of each. (The prior reviewer's pic has ice, no listed amount, and appears to be far darker than the Koi Aji he believes it is.) Hopefully, this will help folks decide for themselves...as for me, I'll just keep on drinking my favorite beverage.On to the actual review...for informational purposes, most of the bottled "green tea" sold in the US is nothing like real green tea. It's essentially tea-flavored kool-aid, with ingredients that have no business being there. Do not expect Oi Ocha to taste anything like these beverages and you won't be disappointed.Mellow and ever-so-slightly nutty, Oi Ocha's flavor is delicate, subtle, and amazingly refreshing. Drink it as cold as possible, and store unused portions in the refrigerator after opening. (Left out and oxidized, it turns dark and the taste goes bad. I have a theory that this is what the prior reviewer may have inadvertently done.) It doesn't have a single calorie, and contains 120% of your daily value of vitamin C per serving, but I don't drink it because it happens to be healthy...I drink it because it tastes so very, very good. Oi Ocha is the best.

If you want unadulterated iced green tea, this is it! I don't like citrus added or any flavored iced tea, so this is one of the best plain iced green teas available. I hope Amazon starts to stock the more robust variation of this brand (dark green label) and the one liter bottles too.
Number one in Japan .. and number one in my bookIt is so great now I can save 15 % now and get it shipped automatically every month.No more lugging it in from the car !!
ITO EN'S OI OCHA is the best green tea in the world.  No sugar, no additives ... simply delicious, refreshing, healthy,  iced green tea.
I always buy whenever I go to Japanese store. This product is from major tea manufacture in Japan.

When I first arrived in Osaka, I already had green tea, so I went on a quest to find a quality green tea in a bottle. That's when I discovered Itoen bottled teas. I love Itoen products because they offer a variety of unsweetened Asian teas like Mugi cha (barley tea), Jasmine tea, and Oolong, Lemongrass, and mint teas. I like all of them but Oi Ocha is my favorite. Yes, its easier to brew tea at home but in Osaka, I was always busy and running around so I wanted something that was good that I could pick up at any vending machine or convinence store.Oi Ocha goes well with quick snack foods like Onigiri (rice balls) with sour plum inside or butaman (pork filled buns with Cantonese barbaqued pork inside aka Nikuman outside of the Kansai area.)I am so glad that amazon is offering a 12-pack to buy. I usually take it with me to work because I drink tea and bottled water more than anything else. I used to drink Coke but the excessive sugar puts on the weight. I never had a problem with weight gain from tea drinking.If you're looking for a quality bottled green tea, then try this one. Its great as an everyday green tea without any sugar.Its has no calories or added colors or flavors either.It gets me going in the morning better than coffee.I hate bottled teas from Lipton, Snapple, and Arizona.

column4: N. A. Bumgardner "Not for you, not for me, bu...
column10: Very good!  I love green tea, and this is my favorite.  At about 2 dollars per bottle, the price isn't to bad.  The store I work in sells it for 3.69 per bottle(and it sells quickly).  Recommended.

column9: Don't buy this! Made in Thailand!
column10: I have received multiple shipments of this item from Amazon (a subscribe and save item delivered every month), and they have all been great. The real deal, same as the bottles you get in Japan. Until my most recent shipment - sent out Oct 19, 2011. When I opened the package, the bottles looked different and it said Made in Thailand. Why has the product changed when the price I'm paying is the same? Bring the original Made in Japan bottles back before I order this item from Amazon again.

I've always loved tea in general and prefer to drink tea over most other things.  My story starts last year when I vacationed in Hawaii.  I stayed at my buddies house and we made a trip to Costco.  One of the items that he picked up was a case of Ito En Green Tea in a can, yes I said can.  Being that it is always hot in Hawaii I was excited about trying this drink.We left the tea in his fridge over night and the next morning I opened my first can.  It was surprisingly good.  I would say it has a medium bodied taste that is very, very smooth.  The colder it is, the better.  I liked it so much, that's all I drank on my 2 week vacation.  I actually drank so much, I had to keep going back to Costco to buy more.Anyway, I come back to California and the first thing I do is go to Costco hoping they have this tea.  Sadly, they don't carry any non-sweetened teas in the store.  It became painfully obvious how much soda, juice and sweetened drinks everyone drinks around here.  Since I am a huge Amazon user, I searched and found this version of the tea in a bottle.  No cans to be found on Amazon.  I was worried it might not taste as good, but ordered the case anyway.To my relief, the plastic bottled version tastes just about as good as the can version.  I've always preferred aluminum cans over plastic bottles, but I'll take what I can get.  If the can version is a 10, then the plastic bottled version is a 9.5.  I would say it has a very slight bitterness to it in the bottle.Bottom line is, this is some really good tea and it's healthy for you.  If you want an alternative to sodas, I would definitely recommend this product.

Why oh why drink sugar-laden sodas or even aspartame-filled diet drinks when you can drink something that's tastey and natural as well as good for you? That's what this stuff is - good green tea in a bottle that is ready-to-drink. It's absolutely great when cold. (The taste is nutty and mild.) Best of all, it has ZERO calories. But to be honest, I don't drink this because of the lack of calories. I drink it because it tastes GOOD. Buy some and see why it's getting very popular - even among those who aren't dieting.

This unsweetened Japanese green tea is delicious and calorie free!  It is very refreshing, has a very slight sweetness and a very mild bitterness in the aftertaste.Aside from the flavor of the tea, I really like the packaging of this item.  Specifically, the mouthpiece is made from a thicker plastic than the rest of the bottle, which I find has an excellent mouth feel.A couple comments to clarify/update other users reviews:*One poster noted that the product they received was made in Thailand.  I received a shipment June 27, 2012 and the product was, in fact, made in Japan.*Another poster suggested that this product tea can be purchased more inexpensively at Ito En's website.  However, the 24 pack sells at Ito En for $36 plus a UPS Ground shipping cost (to Los Angeles) of $11.25, for a total price of $1.97 per bottle.  In contrast, ordering here on Amazon, assuming you have ordered through Subscribe & Save and are using Amazon Prime (both of which are essential if you are a regular Amazon shopper) costs $19.92 for 12 bottles, for a per bottle cost of $1.66, a savings of $7.44 on 24 bottles.  The shipping cost may vary if you live in a different locale, and you may not have Amazon Prime, so the cost could be different for you, but assuming that you are using the cost-saving methods set forth above and your Ito En shipping cost is similar, Amazon is the way to go.

column9: I live in Japan and got hooked on this tea
column10: I live in Japan (with the military) and we have fallen in love with this tea.  It is in all the convenience stores, vending machines and grocery stores over here for about $1.20 or so.  We were recently discussing how we could survive when we go back to the U.S. and don't have our green tea.  I am absolutely ECSTATIC to see that Amazon carries it!  Thank you Amazon!

I love this product. It's so subtle, that at first I didn't recognize any flavor. I think the American palette is so used to sweetener in everything, that it is harder to discern what foods or beverages taste like in their natural state. However, once I sipped slowly, Ito En's delicate and light quality was bliss for my taste-buds.It just feels good to know you aren't ingesting sugar, in any of its unhealthy forms, either through high fructose corn syrup, GMO sugar beets, or even fruit juice sweetened drinks that are high on the glycemic index.This tea is what it says on the label: tea! Yum.I even went ahead and placed a case on a monthly auto-order to save on shipping and price. My only regret is that I can only buy enough to have a bottle every-other day. I may go through withdrawal symptoms on those days when I can't drink my Ito En!!!!

If you like the taste of green tea without all of the sugar and sugar substitutes that are added to most bottled teas these days, try this one.  After many trips to Japan, we fell in love with bottled green tea and were disappointed when we tried to find something similar in our local stores.  A friend suggested this one and we have been addicted since our first order.
This is very good Japanese Green Tea.  It is unsweetened and is very refreshing served cold.  It is fairly pricey.

column9: the best mass-market iced green tea
column10: I've tried all the bottled iced teas available, and this is the one I like best.  No sugar/sweeteners.  No floral/fruit flavors. Just perfectly brewed green (sencha?) tea taste.  Perfect for a hot, humid day in Seattle.  Or any day you need a cool drink.

column9: I bought a bottle at my local store and ran to amazon to buy a case
column10: Fabulous taste.  Who would want sugar in this.  Rich Green tea taste!It gives you alot of energy.  I enjoy it warm too.  I leave it on the porch or in the trunk of the car.I am sure it taste best in the refrigerator but I like luke warm drinks too.

If you like pure, unsweetened green tea this is the best out there. Absolutely love this stuff and recommend it to anyone. It gives me great suttle energy and I believe it even enhances my cognitive thinking.

When I first got my order of tea in, I didn't read the label and started drinking immediately, a horrible mistake, it tasted of spinach. However when I did read the label, specifically the "Best if served chilled" part, I put all of the bottles in my fridge. When chilled they taste really good, though I found that shaking them before drinking made it taste better in my opinion.
I love these! It is an acquired taste. My co-workers see me drinking these and had to try it, the face they made was so funny.  I like it and knowing it is healthy makes it even better.
It tasted good, don't know what else to compare it to as I am not much of a tea or green tea drinker, but overall a good drink.

You won't get a better plain cold green tea than this. Refreshing anytime. Also comes in a good strong bottle (which you can even reuse).That said, you can *make your own* green tea for pennies, at almost zero environmental impact, and refill any water bottle with it. Yamamotoyama - Tokusen Kokyu Sencha (Premium Green Tea) 3.5 Oz.So ordering a dozen filled bottles to be shipped to you from far away is, in comparison, costly and wasteful.

I first found this at my local Whole Foods and decided to give it a try after trying some of Ito En's other products.  I loved it.  Oi Ocha actually was what started me drinking green tea on a regular basis and has opened me up to various others since then.  It has a very natural flavor nothing like some of the "green teas" in bottles i have tried that don't have even the slightest tea flavor or color for that matter.  It is slightly stronger and slightly less grassy than self brewed teas (sencha in this case), albeit that may just be the way i brew them.  But it is very convenient, the flavor is great, I highly recommend it for anyone who like a nice cold green tea and doesn't feel like brewing it themselves.

We love Teas tea and they are expensive around here, when they are available.  Wonderful to have them shipped to our doorstep.  So far they are the only tea I have found available that is not sweetened and tastes just like tea, no weird after-taste or funny flavoring.  DELICIOUS.  Thank you for offering this tasty tea!!!
The just right quantity of Japanese Green tea to be able to either drink at one sitting or save for later.It tastes great because it is not sweet.

After reading the other reviews, I was hoping the batch being shipped are made from Japan.Unfortunately, I received the "Product of Thailand" batch today.Really wanted to taste the ones made in Japan as everyone says it is better.Amazon, please specify where these are coming from (Japan or Thailand) so we can decide on ordering or not!Thanks!
best tea especially when its hot!only complaint is it does end up becoming kind of pricey, i still order 12 every month tho xD

column9: It Really Tastes like Green Tea
column10: This is by far the best UNSWEETENED green tea I have ever tasted.I have tried and tasted alot of teas, and it's hard to find a good unsweetened GREEN tea.Many of the green teas in the supermarket have some sugar in them.Some teas are so watered down that the tea favor is minimal.This tea has a much stronger tea taste than the watered down teas.Just like coffee, you have to acquire a taste for tea.  If you like tea, you'll love this tea.
Very good tea, Consistent. Made in Japan is better than Made in Taiwan. Subscribe and save gives you the best price around.Travels well too.

column9: A Tasty Alternative to Sugar Drinks
column10: I bought this product to try to curb coffee drinking, and as means as a more healthy alternative.  I work shift work, so I basically survive on caffeine.  The beverage has a very subtle flavor.  It is definitely one of the better tasting green teas on the market.  The beverage has to be drank cold, otherwise it loses a lot of its flavor.If you are looking for a good green tea with a healthy alternative to other drinks, then I would recommend this product.  It is a little on the pricey side compared to other beverages, but worth the taste.  Be aware that it contains a decent amount sodium (comparable to a diet coke.
This stuff is good for you and after the first couple of bottles I found myself actually reaching for this as opposed to my favorite caffinated beverage.

I first saw this tea in a trip to Japan and was really amazed when I saw it was available in the US. It's very pure, has a strong taste and is actually the only tea I believe is natural. I totally recommend. It's a bit pricey but you can't compare... it's so much better than any supermarket tea.

After drinking this, I always experience a euphoric feeling. Not sure why - but Green tea for me has always had an instantaneous pick me up result. I love this and have it on the Amazon Subscribe & Save where it automatically ships me the next delivery per my requested timeframe. The taste is crisp and great. I agree w/other reviews regarding having this cold vs. room temperature - the colder the better. Also, I noticed on my second shipment, the bottles have changed - same great taste but the bottles are now a different type of plastic, I think maybe a more recycled plastic? I kind of liked the original bottles, but honestly, it makes no difference. Best part of this tea? It is sugar free!! And I have many times opened a bottle and not been able to finish it and put it back in the fridge and have it a day or two or even three later and it still tastes great - I did not see a decline in taste or color as others mentioned.

This green tea is not for those who are new to drinking green tea, and may not be a good choice for those who like their tea sweet. The taste is earthy and bitter. I add raw honey or stevia to mine because I do like it to taste sweeter than it naturally does. At any rate, it's a great green tea that I will continue to purchase through Subscribe and Save.

Absolutely love this green tea.  This isn't for the weak at heart, it's pretty potent stuff.  Although the Ito En Pure Green tea is also good and similar tasting, this one is superior.  Just waiting for Amazon to get it back in stock (Currently out of stock from Amazon.com as of this writing) and hopefully drop the price down a tad so I can grab a couple more cases.

I enjoy a variety of beverages with my meals, and just for refreshment. I've tried any number of bottled teas and I like some of them. Personally, I've always thought that most were either too sweet (whether with honey, sugar or artificially flavored). I was mentioning this to my wife the other day and she came up with a packet of Ito En (Oi Ocha) Japanese Green Tea and suggested I try it. She said it came from Costco, but it's probably available elsewhere or here on Amazon. Well, I took a bottle (16.9 ounces) pored over ice and a later bottle chilled ice cold in the fridge. Excellent. Much better than other brands. Very smooth and light tasting with a ever-so slightly bitter aftertaste. Quite refreshing! Goes well with food. I particularly like the absence of any sweetness of any kind. Plus it has the antioxident qualities of green tea and a surprisingly high vitamin C content. It's a very quality beverage.Gary Peterson

column9: Finally!  Real Green Tea in a bottle!
column10: I love green tea but it's impossible to find the real stuff, ready-to-drink, without sugar.  I won't eat or drink anything with any type of sugar substitute.  I don't care how "natural" it claims to be.  So when a label reads "Sugar Free," it really means "Fake Sugar."  Ugh! So I was VERY happy to find this product, I think I'll have it shipped to me regularly.  It doesn't taste like any "Green Tea" you'd find bottled in the grocery store, it's the real deal.  Wonderful with a splash of cranberry juice over ice!  All the benefits of Green Tea without the sugar and fillers, three ingredients - "Purified Water, Green Tea, Ascorbic Acid."  Yay!

I used to live in Japan for 2 years during my Marine Corps enlistment.Oi Ocha was always in every public vending machine.For those who like a good unsweetened Green tea, this is for you.Roasted rice enriches the flavor of the whole green tea leaves and water.I also noticed for the first time that one bottle has 120% vitamin C per serving (2 servings).So aside from all the healthy stuff you get from Green tea, it's just an added benefit.I'll definitely keep ordering this.

Ito En is the most famous tea company in Japan.If you like healthy green tea, this is what you are looking for.The price might be higher than other, but taste and quality is way much better than any other green tea sold in the states.

column4: Tuesday "Is it just me... or did S/E maybe do...
column10: If you are a fan of green tea, this stuff is absolute bomb. It always tastes crisp and refreshing and doesn't have any sugar or anything added to it so you can change the flavor if you like. I prefer it just how it is, of course! If you have had Tea's Tea, Ito En is essentially the same. Good stuff!
This is one of my favorite Japanese Teas, that are actually decently hard to find. They are wonderful, and wonderful for you!

I first tasted this tea when I visited Okinawa.  The Japanese have all sorts of vending machines, everywhere!  This is such a tasty, earthy flavored tea.  I order by the case.  I used to order it directly from ItoEn, but Amazon is less expensive.  Thanks for carrying this product.  If you like this tea, try the green-jasmine, it's excellent also.

column9: Delivered cheaper than the local store
column10: I ordered this with a discount via Amazon email special offer and then an additional discount for putting it on auto-order.  I am now drinking a very tasty tea at a better price than the nearest grocery store carries it for.  What a deal!

To make this simple the tea is perfect!  It's the same refreshing taste I'm used to during my stays in Japan.My previous delivery arrived in near impeccable condition with only one bottle slightly dented.  I have never had problems with products shipped directly from amazon, with the exception of the one I have just received.The wrapping on the bottles was very dirty and deteriorated.  Most bottles remained intact but a couple were dented badly and on the verge of bursting.  The cardboard packaging has obviously been exposed to a lot of moisture and other elements.  I'm not sure what happened.Unfortunately Amazon wont allow these items to be replaced.  I gave it 4 stars because of the tea and at least they are still drinkable.  I might consider canceling my subscription if they arrive like this again.Great product and true to the Japanese original. Just may not arrive 'AS' great.
I've had this tea before and it is wonderful. Ordered it and got it in two days both times. Will definitely continue the subscription.

column9: You will love this if you are a green tea drinker
column10: I order this for my office and everyone loves it. I dont care that much for it, but Im not a green tea drinker.

We enjoyed this product, we are cutting as much sugar out of our diet as we can so I tried this. It takes a little getting used to, especially for my husband who drinks that sugary flavored iced tea in bottles, and he liked this very much. After the case was finished, I cleaned out the bottles and brewed up a bunch of Tazo iced tea, added honey, and put into the bottles, and he noticed the difference, couldn't even drink it. So I won't be doing that again! I will order this Ito En product again.

I accidently started drinking Oi Ocha after stopping at a local quickstop for plain water; my brand wasn't avail so it seemed a safe bet to grab the green tea.  From the first sip I have been totally hooked.  The other reviewers whom have said American's don't know green tea are 100% right.Living Mainland side the high cost of the 2 Liter size is just crazy!  Shame on those importers/retailers.  In HI it costs about the same as a 2liter bottle of soda.  I have mine shipped to me.

I drink about 10 cups of tea a day. Mostly black, so I'm pretty picky about my green teas. I ordered these so I'd have something to grab when heading out and not wanting to brew a pot. I never sweeten any tea, the taste is much better unsweet. So, I cannot comment on how this would taste sweetened but it really doesn't need it. I would buy these again, they arrived in good shape (no leaks) and fit nicely in the door of the fridge. You def want to drink them really cold for best taste.

This is one of my fav tea since I was little. No suger added real green tea!!YAY!! I've been buying this tea at some asian stores, but they charge for it WAY too much,,like $2.00 for a small bottle? So I decided to subscribe this bottle of tea every month. "Oi Ocha" is the BEST!! In my area, I can not find tea I can enjoy,,,, so if you live outside of Japan like me and craving for tea, you should just subscribe it like do, or just buy variety of tea on amazon. It's actually much cheaper than local asian store and not expired LOL

column9: by far the best and most convenient
column10: I so love getting this delicious and healthy green tea shipped to me monthly.  I pour over ice after putting one sweetleaf (stevia) packet in, it dissolves better if used before the ice, nothing is as satisfying and energizing as this drink.  You won't be disappointed; I can see why it's the # 1 drink in Japan.  It's the # 1 drink in our house :-)

I did not hesitate to sign up for Subscribe & Save for this tea. Both boxes arrived last Thu and I'm already down to the last bottle of the first box. Ito En's Japanese Green Tea is really good and refreshing. No sweetener or sugar necessary. :)

column9: Ito En Oi Ocha (whatever that means)
column10: I'm pretty ignorant when it comes to foreign food & drink. I'm trying to change that. After years of reading the health benefits of green teas, I have been trying all kinds. I have to say, for my Americanized palette, this stuff tastes the worst of all the green teas I have tried. column10: I buy at least 4 packs a week, so I wish they cost less! I even tried stuffing real p-nut butter in other bones, but my 2 bichons could tell the difference. Like the first reviewer, my dogs are crazy about these little bones. It's no use trying to give them something else. Only these will do. Once they suck all the p-nut butter off, they want a new bone. So, they are limited to one per day.  Great little product.

Our 3 dogs love Dingo bones. But these peanut butter flavor bones are an obsession of our smallest rat terrier. He's only 5 pounds, so bones tend to last several sittings for him. Give him one of these and he's occupied for as long as it takes to finish. He'll still play with other bones, but he loses his mind when he sees me go for this bag. I just wish they were priced as well as the other Dingo products and less difficult to find.

This was my first purchase of the Dingo with Peanut Butter, oh my, my little chihuahuas are vicious when the got a whiff of these treats.  Dingo continues to amaze me, when I think I have gotten the best of their best, something else comes up to dazzle the taste buds of my chi's.  Must buy!!!

I usually get the regular dingo bones but decided to switch it up and try these. My dog loves them she starts off with the peanut butter side and then hides the bone, and then continues playing and chewing on it. Definitely buying these again!
My dog(chihuaha mix) absolutelty loves these. He waits to get one every morning. It's the only thing he'll sit still for, as he's only 9 months old & very energetic.

My Pom has always enjoyed Dingo chicken wrapped bones, but I was hesitant to change her treat to the peanut butter ones. She's pretty good about eating but will often leave the chewy parts behind. I offered this new peanut butter indulgence and she went crazy just smelling it. She jumped up, tried to take it from my hand, could barely contain herself long enough to sit on command for her treat. Once she received it, she turned around and immediately started devouring the end with the peanut butter. Nothing distracted her, not even her favorite buddy coming to visit. She ignored him in favor of the peanut butter. I'm very pleased with Dingo's products and have never had a bad one yet.

I have 2 dogs,one is a schnauzer and the other a mix collie-giant mallimute and they enjoy their chew bones and peanut butter and crackers they share with me so I decided to try these and wow they really liked them.The dogs liked them so much that I had to order 2 bags this time and try and limit them to one or two a day.If your dog likes chew bones and peanut butter definately try these,your dog will love you for it.

My dog loves Dingo bones, we usually buy her the original pack but we decided to try the peanut butter flavor. She loved them, but was giving her potty issues so we had to stop giving them to her. Although, my parents in-laws chihuahuas love them with no issues so I take it it's just my dog and not the product! That's the only reason I am giving it 4 stars. The bones keep the dogs busy for a while as they work them down, its great to keep them busy for 30min-1hour!

Both our dogs (Cocker Spaniel and Brittany) love anything with Peanut Butter flavor and this is no exception. As with all rawhide products, overindulgence can give slight diarrhea symptoms, but that is not a fault of the product.
Great Flavor! My dog love it. I give her every day a mini bone as a reward for good behavior, and every day she wait happy (excited) for this award.

My Jack Russell, Rusti, loves these chews. She's a very, very picky eater- even with treats. But she goes nuts over Indulgence Dingos. I once tried giving her a regular Dingo chew (I had ran out of the Indulgence Dingo chews). She sniffed the regular chew, then walked away- but not until first looking up at me with that look that says "You're got to be kidding me, right?"

I started using these syrups in my coffee when I went on the Atkins diet. It uses Splenda and taste  pretty good. It doesn't have that syrupy after taste like a lot of these syrups. It's great if you're dieting & have a sweet tooth because it's carb-free. If I was more creative I could probably add the flavoring to other meals on my diet.
This particular product flavor has become my staple and I certainly love it and recommend it!  Great service from the vendor, too!  A+++++

Recently a student in my class brought this liquorice to share, I took one bite and was stunned at how good it was. Unlike the other reviewer mine were not clumped together, they were actually like pictured on the bag. The liquorice is soft which is what they are known for. I would say if your up for a different type of liquorice than your normal red vine or twizzler try this brand, it was soft and chewy with lots of flavor. Since then I have bought several bags and continue to share this product with friends and family. I also can find it at Marshalls and Target for under $3.00, so far I have only tried strawberry flavor, next up is mango!

Not much strawberry flavor.  The entire contents of the bag stick together into one lump.  I didn't care for the "soft eating" part, licorice should be a little chewy.  The texture is to soft to describe; not quite food.  Might be excellent if you wear dentures.

Usually, Im a fresh fish type of person. However, when I saw this unusual packaging and price, I decided to give this product ago. I will recommend it because it has an unsurpassable flavor that you usually do not find in packaged salmon. Plus the box is a neat keepsake for any fish enthusiast.
I ordered the Salmon on Thursday, January 11th and we received it on January 19th. The Salmon was delicious.  The wooden box has a nice design and can be used to store items in the future.
My English husband asked me, while consuming half-a-pound at one sitting, "Do you have any idea how much this meal would cost at the Savoy?" He felt fantastically indulged, so we are both happy.

Bought this for my husband and he said it was the best he has ever had. He had me order 2 more, 1 for him and 1 for his Dad. They make a nice gift for someone who likes salmon. Also a great price on Amazon!

column9: I buy this as a gift item....I hate smoked salmon
column10: Most of my friends are from South Texas and know as much about smoked salmon as people up here in Wisconsin know about raising cattle for purposes other than draining milk out of them.Everyone I have purchased this product for has said it was great...on crackers. Supposedly it has an acceptable but very present smokey flavor and is made from apparently quality salmon......anyway, I have bought this as a gift item several times and everyone has said they liked it (and my friends are the type that would tell me if something tasted like excrement if it did)......so if you like smoked salmon or are looking for a good gift for someone that likes smoked items....apparently you cant go wrong with purchasing this product.

I don't order often from ANYWHERE but if I do 8 or 10 times it's Amazon. Because I love to eat fish esp. smoked salmon - I though it was a great deal. I was disappointed, packages were small and the fish fillets were thin,and really not that great of taste. Smoked? where?  I would have given it one star - but I didn't hate it - just wouldn't order it again.

I used most of the salmon to create a pasta dish, with an alfredo sauce.  My family absolutely LOVED it! We had a lovely green salad and garlic bread to complement the pasta dish. I would recommend this salmon to anyone. What salmon was not used, I snacked on, as I absolutely love salmon!
I have purchased a few of these as gifts -- the box is a lovely gift by itself. The box is huge, looks just like the photo.  The salmon is vacuum sealed in foil packaging.

column9: Might be good for cat food but doubt meant for human consumption!
column10: Growing up on the Oregon coast, you get used to good salmon.  This stuff was soggy, oily, and did not taste right at all.  I ended up throwing it away after trying it.  First time in my life I've ever tossed salmon!  Disappointing.  Wish I could get a refund.
Great service ,2day I had it, we had the salmon for dinner that night.The box design was very well done . I enjoyed this design.
I love smoked salmon, this is great value over the grocery store, and you get a nice wooden box, makes a great gift as well no gift wrap required. Can not wait till my next one gets here!
Offered one of these to each of my daughters who both found it much to their liking. THis is hot smoked salmon

I have eaten Smoked Salmon for sixty years, I love it, but the stink of this stuff was enough to turn your stomach.  And, if possible the second package was worse than the first. Both tasted as bad as they smelled . . .

I grew up on the Columbia River and have tasted all levels of quality in smoked salmon. This was the worst, and an insult to every salmon smoker who has ever lived. This is Not Smoked Salmon, this is some vile slop.

While I agree this is shipped in a nice wooden box that can be used for other things and the fish has an excellent flavor, I was surprised to find it was not what I expected.  I expected smoked lox salmon like you find at a good deli or grocery store, not fully cooked salmon as this actually is.  For those expecting the latter, this is a great product, however this is not for me as it was smoked (or cooked) too long.

I purchased this item as Christmas gifts for two people on my list who are difficult to buy for.  The price was within my alloted budget, and when I purchased two, they were eligible for FREE Super Saver Shipping, which is always a big PLUS!  The packaging is very attractive and larger than I was expecting (18.5"x7"x2").  Although I have no idea of the quality of the salmon (hence the 4-star rating), if I were to receive this as a gift, I would be pleased.  I'd consider buying this item again when I need a gift for under $20.00.

I like the presentation. I had in mind if I like it to give it as a Christmas gift. But I am glad I have tried it before. Although it came well packed with plenty of juice I found the fish quite on the dry side. I did not expect this at all. The meat had a good flavor but the dryness of the fish was a big desapointement to me.The package arrived well packed shortly after the order was made. Thanks to Amazo fine and efficient mailing service!
The smoked salmon was absolutely disgusting.  The box is very neat but also put together very poorly in CHINA!  I would not recommend buying this.  Don't waste your money.
Thought this was grav lox but its really just smoked fish. Tastes awesome but just not what I was expecting.

column9: 100% Natural. No preservative. Made in China.
column10: Salmon isn't very good quality compared to fresh smoked salmon I have had in Alaska and Maine. And why is it necessary to have the box made in China?  I would much rather pay a few cents more for an American made product.  Reminds me of how Walmart closed down a rolling pin manufacturing facility near my town in Maine and moved production to china to save 4 cents per rolling pin.  Unbelievable.  Disgusting.

This is the best new snack to hit the market in years, in my opinion. I've been buying them several packages at a time when they go on sale at the market, usually for $2.50 a box, which makes paying 6.66 plus shipping really dumb. Even full price, they're only about $3.49 here in Colorado. On a recent trip to California I found them for $2.50 at Vons and they had the full price noted as $3.89. Buy the crackers, but do it locally. Even the check out clerk commented on how wonderful they were and how many she was selling.

I had to return this item, because it was represented on the website incorrectly.  I was looking for the original beef recipe, not the new one, and was delighted when I found it on Amazon (both versions were shown as available).  My cat has a health problem that requires this specific food.  I compared the ingredients, the label, and all the details for a match before I placed the order.  I was very careful.  When I received the cat food, it was the new recipe (not what I wanted).  Apparently, the old recipe is not available at all anymore, so the item should be removed from the website.
Tasty but kind of pricey.  I sort of got hooked on these in Germany, and although I can find other Haribo products in stores Color rado can be really hard to find elsewhere.
I love Haribo candies and the Color-Rado Gummi Candy is great.  I love the licorice allsorts and gummy bears.  I ate the whole package in one day.
By far the best Haribo Gummies. Variety is great and it's always a surprise what you get.
This candy is so good it is habit forming!!  Great taste and fast delivery!!
This tea is amazing. Full bodied taste, well blended. nice chocolate floral scent. i'm getting another tin so i don't run out.

column9: BEST KITTY FOOD YET FOR THE FINICKY CAT!
column10: My Domino is a very picky eater - and I have wanted to get him on a more natural cat food with no grains or filler... this one is tremendous and he loves it... it comes in pouches, small cans, and large cans and there are many flavors desirable to the feline palate.  Dom prefers his fishy and there are many different varieties of fish combinations to keep him interested... THANK YOU THANK YOU!

column9: Perfect food for my old cat
column10: My cat has "put up" with canned cat food and other pouches for years.  Her rejection of all would be evident on my carpets if I didn't have every carpet cleaning device known to man.She only likes the gravy and when she actually eats something solid, it's a great day.  When I brought this food home from Petco she ate two pouches down to the bottom of the bowl within a few hours.Since then, I've bought most other Soulistic flavors and she eats them all.I'm sold enough on this product to order it from Amazon because when I go to my Petco they're sold out.  A wasted trip is worth the shipping for me.My cat gives it 5 stars.

column9: My picky little eater can't resist it!
column10: This is a fantastic, high quality product and it is irresistible to my picky little eater. It also has a very good moisture content.

column9: Coffee Bean Direct Costa Rican Tarrazu, Whole Bean
column10: These beans provide a full bodied not too dark cup of coffee. I am very pleased with my purchase and would recommend this product to any coffee drinker that wants full flavor.

Purchased a bag to give it a try, and  very disappointed.  Bulk Cheap coffee, that's roasted enough to dry the beans with little to no flavor.  I don't usually write reviews but had to let you know that this is not culinary treat.

I am used to Costa Rican coffee after visiting the country many times. I ran out of coffee and ordered this in desperation. I have tried Starbucks and all the other costa ricans but it was not very good. This coffee arrived well packaged and as soon as I opened it you could smell the coffee all over the house. I grind it fresh every day and it is really good coffee. It is better, in fact, than the last batch I brought back from Costa Rica! I will use this company again. Great product and good price.
i am not a coffee expert, but at about 6.50 per pound, this is as good tasting as the coffee from the local coffee house at twice the price.

The tarrazu coffee is my favorite but I normally buy from world market. This Tarrazu from coffee bean direct doesn't have a good flavor or smell. I also have to use twice as much to even come close to the boldness I like from the world market coffee. I bought 5 lbs and will probably throw it away, it is not worth it.

I lived in Costa Rica for over a year and fell in love with the coffee.  I was so hopeful that this would be the same wonderful, aromatic, Tarrazu that I remember.  The beans were very dry.. no oily shine that I was used to.Unfortunately, I was disappointed to find a very mild, dry bean.  If you do buy this, plan on grinding it to "expresso" grind to get a hint of Costa Rican coffee.The coffee by itself is okay... just not what I was hoping for.

column9: REALLY GREAT TASTING COFFEE! BLEND this for a Great Smooth cup of Coffee! Easy to do
column10: These coffee beans arrived quickly in a vacuum packed pouch. Store in freezer (stay cool) to minimize the oils in the beans from becoming rancid & ruining the taste.These beans were nicely and uniformly roasted to a nice brown. No dark, burnt, over-roasted beans here! (If you want a darker roast go for French Roast or Espresso roast(-for morning java consumption, many prefer this lighter roast.)Beans of this Tarrazu are a nice smaller bean, plump (no old dried out beans). These Tarrazu beans will stand alone for a nice, non-acidic, gentle cup of coffee. Note: To minimize/neutralize acidity a very small amount of sugar (tsp or less) is nice.Blended it with 60% Columbian Supremo (more robust, stalwart bean) and 40% Tarrazu, then just load up the coffee hopper on the maker. Those beans in there do fine at room temp for every day use.  This blend is just great for that AM cup-not too harsh, but with a good strength and full bodied taste.
Ever since I visited Costa Rica I fell in love with their coffee.  It is great that it is so easy to obtain through Amazon and so quickly delivered.

I am a big coffee drinker, and wanted to give this a try given the price.  It is very good, regardless of the price.  I found the description to be accurate, and the seller delivered as advertised.  My opinion of the coffee is that it has a good strong flavor while still being smooth.  I just ordered my second bag.

I have ordered coffee beans through Amazon numerous times.  I've also ordered from the particular roasting company on more than one occasion.  I must admit that I have been disappointed with the freshness of these beans which is the likely cause of the lack of flavor.  I won't order these again even if they are less expensive than others.  What you pay for, you get.
Smooth implies weak, robust implies bitter, neither are true as to the negative but true as to how wonderful and complex a simple cup of joe can be. pleased!

column9: Over-roasted beans with no flavor make awesome compost
column10: I've worked as a barista at an EXCELLENT coffee shop that trained us really well about beans (origins, qualities, roasting, etc.). This Tarrazu was a disappointment, even for a mass distributor. These beans have been over-roasted to the point that there is almost no flavor and the grounds are chalky (no oils left = no flavor at all). Tarrazu is usually medium-bodied with bright citrusy notes. Even after preparing it with 2 heaping TBS beans per cup of water, the brew still came out weak, bland and just gross. The seller won't accept returns, so these are going in my compost bin.
These beans make for a really good cup of smooth coffee, the only complaint is the beans were a little dryer than preferable.
Excellent beans, fresh and tasty. Work well with my Capresso espresso machine. Have been purchasing those for the past year or so, great product.
Very weak flavor and not roasted enough. There is a slight "green" taste.This is not comparable to other Costa Rican coffees.
This coffee is great for the first cup, but quickly becomes bitter when left on the warming plate. I have liked other coffee from this supplier, just not this particular one.

column9: Great coffee at a good price
column10: I was hesitant at first to purchase this, but I was very pleasantly surprised. We have bought around 6-7 bags of this coffee and couldn't be more pleased. It has an excellent robust flavor and is always fresh, at nearly half the cost. I  would definitely recommend!

I don't know what happened, but these beans are not very good.  They are dry, fairly bland and just not what I come to expect from Coffee Bean Direct. My boss turned me onto Coffee Bean Direct (from now on referred to as CBD) about a year ago and I fell in love with the variety and freshness. Six months ago or so I found that CBD is now available on Amazon and was a very happy camper since I am a Prime member. The first five pounds I received were the same that I came to expect from the CBD roasters, but now on my second order, Costa Rican Tarrazu seems like they shipped some really old product that is very much past it's prime.  Maybe the CBD Costa Rican Tarrazu are not that popular and have sat in a warehouse waiting for some unlucky person like me.  I would throw them out if I hadn't spent so much on them, I don't even want to mix them with something else since I don't want to ruin another batch of good coffee.I hope it is just a fluke, but I'm not sticking around to find out, too much money to gamble.  I have now found another vendor for my fresh coffee addiction which is unfortunately a bit more expensive, however it IS fresh, oily and so tasty.

This coffee is very good. Not bitter at all. Flavorful without having to make it so strong that it eats through the cup like many coffees today. If you're a fan of whole bean coffee, you'll like this. Price, about $7.50/lb is not too bad.

I've been very happy with the other coffees I have ordered from Coffee Bean Direct, but not so with this one.  It's just bad.  Odds are very good that a fresh bag would taste completely different, but that's not what I got.  For $42, I don't want to have to listen to my wife complain that the coffee is so bad it makes her stomach hurt.
Delicious coffee, on the strong side :) Great for iced as well! I grind a little at a time and keep it in the fridge.

We have been ordering this coffee for over a year and we like it better than any other coffees we have tried. Sometimes the beans are fresh and look oily. Other times they are dry and lack aroma. We were ordering direct from Coffee Bean Direct and got fresher coffee than the coffer we get from Amazon on the automatic ordering system to save money. I don't know if they warehouse the coffee longer than the Coffee Bean Direct or what. There is a difference. If the freshness does not improve soon We will go back to ordering from Coffee Bean Direct and paying more. When it is fresh it is a five-star coffee.
Tastes as good as Trader Joe's Tarrazu Coffee. I plan on ordering more when I start to run out.  I would recommend this coffee to everyone.

This is one of my favorites.  It is very nutty and earthy without being overpowering and bitter.  This works well as an iced coffee/latte as well as a strong hot brew.Earthy/nutty coffee lovers will love this roast.

The coffee bean direct coffee is good coffee, and a great value. It also makes good expresso. It did take a while to arrive, but was worth the wait. I fell in love with Costa Rican coffee while visiting on vacation and this is almost as good as being there

Bear Creek Country Kitchens Chipotle Soup Mix is a delicious explosion of flavor.  It's great by itself, or you can add things such as corn, jalapenos, sour cream, grated cheddar, chicken, pork, and avocaodo slices.When I eat this soup, I want to have about two cups of it.  There are only 110 calories per cup, but there is a problem.  One cup of this soup has 850 mg of sodium.  That is 36% of the daily value recommneded.Although I love the Southwestern flavor and my family serves chipotle soup to me as a special treat when I am a guest in their home, I find it necessary to warn you about the sodium.  The directions say "salt and pepper" to taste, but it already tastes a little too salty.  The ingredients include MSG, a serious souce of sodium.As our doctors tell us, elevated sodium in our diets is one of the causes of high blood pressure.

We love this soup in my home. I tend to add personalized ingredients to prepared meals, and this soup is no exception.  I always make a double batch and add chicken, diced tomatoes, rotel tomatoes with lime and cilantro, and a can of corn. My family and friends love it. Some of them have also begun to use it as a base for experimenting with their own personalized additions, as well. It has the warmth and soothing tone of comfort food. It's even good for breakfast.

Let me begin by saying that I really really like Bear Creek Soups!! Best on the market as far as a dry soup mix (in my opinion) BUT they really missed the mark on this one. I expected more of a tex/mex taste I guess. This taste more like a minestrone soup. Nothing "Santa Fe" OR "Chipotle" tasting at all. Now I have 5 more packages I am going to try to figure out what to do with. Will REALLY have to doctor it up to make it tasty for my family.

We have tried the Chipotle, Cheddar Broccoli, Vegetable, and Tortilla Soup and each one is just totally delicious.  We have served it to guests and they too have raved about these.  I do add additional vegetables and bouillon cubes for extra spice, it does make the flavor pop more, but even on their own they are great.  They are worth the money because you have eaten something totally delicious.  Your tummy might thank you.

I love coffee.  But a few years back I learned that caffeine was really messing with my adrenal glands so I decided to clean up my system.  I found a few good coffee substitutes, but still craved that true coffee flavor.This is one of the BEST decaf coffee's I have ever had.  I also won't buy a decaf unless it uses the Swiss Water Process, and this is also organic.  If I am going to spend the money on quality coffee, I want the best.  This is it.

I just bought this cheesecake after trying a sample taste at Costco and I will most definitely buy it again.  It is extremely rich and creamy and so pretty to look at as well.  I was told this could remain in the freezer for up to a year, but the are no preservatives listed that lead me to believe it is really expected to remain in the freezer for a year.  I also find that at 450 calories a slice, I will be serving slices much smaller than the ones suggested by the nutritional data.  If you like chocolate and you like rich cheesecake and you don't feel like baking it yourself, then this is the one for you.

I can not tell you how good the chocolate covere cashews were, as I received instead chocolate covered cherries.  But I can state that they shipped each bag of chocolate with a cold pack to ensure the contents didn't melt while in shipment.  Nice jester on their part.

I picked this up at Target. Didn't pay anywhere near $25.00 for it. (Seriously? For hot chocolate mix? Who is setting these prices?!) This makes the best hot chocolate I've ever had even when I compare it making it from scratch and the family hot chocolate dry mix. (Don't tell my mother I said that.) Highly recommend.

This tea works wonders for constipation.  I have been having trouble for a long time.  A lady doing my x-ray told me about it.  I have been using it since.  I have a cup after dinner and then it works by morning.  Great stuff and tastes good especially with honey.

Great product! I used this product as a supplement for my cat who was diagnosed with irritable bowel syndrome and his body just could no longer tolerate processed cat food. I started him on a raw foot diet and used this product for a supplement because it contained turine. My cat had diarrhea so much so that his anal area was raw. I had to clean him up at least once a day, yuck, and he sure as heck didnt enjoy it either. Within a few days he was much improved and now is on total raw food diet and has more energy and is running around like a kitten(hes only 5 yrs old). I have my old cat back and he no longer stinks!!! Yea!!!
These are the best breadsticks I've ever had. They're light, healthy and tasty. I'm going to order some more in the next few days. Thanks
These save calories over regular bread sticks and are fun to munch since they are not soft.  I don't care for pretzels, so this is one of my snacks.
This product is great for me as an RV traveler.  It is convenient and saves me a lot of time by having it delivered to my door.
Great size and great taste. One bag (100 calories) is all I need as a snack to get me to the next meal. Recommended!

column9: Great with a cup of tea.
column10: These cookies are very light and not overly sweet.  They were crisp and fresh when they arrived. Good cookies for a snack in the afternoon with your favorite tea or with fruit for dessert.

I ate these with hummus... they turned my stomach. Thinking it might've been the hummus, I tried these again on another day... no good. I thought they'd be a great alternative to Ritz or other crackers... They were not. Very hard. Had a weird aftertase. Yuck.

column9: Stopped caring these at the store......
column10: My store stopped carrying these great, tasty crackers, so of course Amazon did, yay! They were more broken than the ones at the store, but I really like them, so oh well.
Sesmark Savory Thins, Toasted Onion and Garlic, 3.2-Ounce Packages (Pack of 12)  Excellent! Crispy. intense but not overwhelming flavor. Will buy again.

This is BY-FAR one the best alternatives to canned tomato sauces (and it tastes great).  I've alerted my local supermarket to stock it.  If you are health conscious and don't want acid in your tomato sauce this is what you want.
By adding a few ingredients of your own (more canned chopped clams), this is quite good. I keep it on hand, just in case I need a quick meal.
Excellent product.  It is a shame that this product, in this size can (10.5 oz.), is no longer available in most grocery stores.  It is just the right amount to prepare an excellent spaghetti sauce.

column9: Some things need to be taken with a grain of salt
column10: Although it's not one of my usual topicsHumidity's killing us down in the tropicsOur cereals get cold and our icy drinks hotSpaghetti resembles a Gordian knotBut the point of this verse is the seasoning I dumpWhen I go to the bottle and find one big clumpAnd I cry every time that I shell out more cashFor flavor full off-er-ings from Mrs. DashWhen I know fully well that I'll open the sealAnd into the bottle the moisture will stealSo it's either I go on a diet that's blandOr grab me a bottle of this well known brandAnd although the crystals become intertwinedI'll upturn the bottle and proceed to grindFor freshly ground flavor, my taste buds exaltAll hail to the taste of McCormick's sea salt!Amanda Richards, October 8, 2008

First, a confession.  When I cook or eat, I try to use as little salt as possible.Second, though, there are times when salt is an important part of the preparation of food or when it makes sense to add once a meal is cooked.And I far prefer these products, in which you have salt crystals and a built in grinder. I think the end result is preferable to the standard salt out of a box. To me, there is a tastier edge once the ground salt enters the recipe or once the salt hits the cooked food (although it might just be my imagination, too)!Anyhow, this is one nice choice out of the many salt grinders available at the grocery store and I have long been satisfied with it.

column4: N. Ferguson "Two, Daisy, Hannah, and Kitten"
column9: human quality ingredients, unique manufacturing process-- my cat loves it!
column10: Blue Buffalo Spa Select is great! Top of the line ingredients, human food grade-- in addition to the indoor cat formula there's a chicken version and a fish version. This food meets a very high standard. No yucky meat "by-products", meat and meat meals are the top ingredients, plus a host of wholesome and varied ingredients and probiotics.On top of that, this is an incredibly palatable food. My cat LOVES it. In fact, she scarfs it right down, when she typically has just grazed on a piece or two at a time of other premium foods. I have to be careful to use a measuring cup and not overfeed her, 'cause she will seek me out and meow for more!Blue Buffalo uses a unique process to manufacture "lifebits" which are added to the food. These smaller, darker pieces are cold formed in order to maintain nutrients. I don't believe any other company incorporates this kind of element into cat or dog food.I came across this cat food at the local Tractor Supply. column9: Knob Creek is a big dense chewy bourbon with tons of character.
column10: The anchor of the Jim Beam small batch collection (the lowest price, shortest bottle, longest posted age in the barrel and the biggest sales of any small batch bourbon) Knob Creek is a big substantial bourbon that oozes class and quality. It begs to be sipped neat and slow. It stands up to the best bourbons without embarrassing itself.In the glass it's a rich spessarite garnet reddish orange with a tinge of henna. The redness is coming from the #4 char oak barrels. That's the darkest level of char. This char level shows up all over Knob creek - from the color to the nose to the last notes of the finish. Knob Creek's extensive time in the wood is a big part of its character and the fact that the wood was darkly charred is a big part of the wood's character.The nose brings up toffee, leather, and bitter orange. Further nosing brings out vanilla, cream, and some earth mustiness - like forest floor leaves and loam. It's a complex, appetizing, and pretty sophisticated nose for a bourbon that some folks don't respect enough, in my opinion, because it's so universally available.The initial taste on first sip is sweet with brown sugar and moassess. That's followed up by a big midpalate expansion spicy on the edges of the tongue with 100 proof and full of a sophisticated sherry quality. The finish is redolent with oak wood and a bitter orange note in the back of the tongue. There's char in the finish, vanilla, sandalwood perfume and a distant and pervasive backdrop of charcoal and creosote. You don't notice it at first but it builds up as you devour your glass. There's also a sour tang that shows up slowly over time that I have come to associate with Jim Beam. It's very subtle but it's the thread that binds the disparate Jim Beam stable together.This is a big, rough, very masculine bourbon. It's a frontier cabin with leather, musket, and wood fire raging. It's also elegant and refined - to a point. I have no trouble recommending it - but have to point out that Elija Craig 12 has a lot of the same flavor profile (but more sweet and less char) for substantially less money. In any case, you'll have no trouble finding Knob Creek and once you start sipping I sincerely doubt anyone would regret any part of it even for a minute.

I use a simple Cantonese style, with some soy sauce, some oyster sauce, and a little beef stock. Be sure to use plenty of oil when you stir-fry, as the noodles do absorb it. But your dish will be so beautiful, it's so worth it. Lastly, if you are on a no-gluten diet, you are gonna go ga-ga over these!The directions on the package for presoaking are good--but instead of warm tap water (which has more lead in it from the pipes!) use cold water and warm it in the microwave. Be sure your noodle container is large enough so that the noodles won't stick to each other too much (and you will have to stir from time to time--again, to keep them from sticking). If you have to do something else, you can store the partially softened, drained noodles in the fridge--they'll be fine when you get back. Then saute as usual. Serve quickly so that the noodles don't get mushy. Voila! A fabulous and easy meal with minimal work (just a little advance effort).

This is less of a review of the actual cookies; though I rated them 5 stars.  The real merit of this "review" is to provide  information that may help others avoid the confusion that I experienced when I received my order.I stumbled upon the product page on Amazon for "Double Stuf Oreo Chocolate Cream."  The Amazon product image clearly said "Double Stuf Oreo Chocolate Cream" and I had never seen that product description or package previously.  I had seen regular Chocolate Cream Oreos before and even original Double Stuf Oreos (with the white filling) in local grocery stores but never the Double Stuf Oreo Chocolate Cream.  I put my concern about the potential need to buy new pants aside and I ordered a case of 12 boxes, which is the minimum order.I received the case promptly from Amazon.  When I opened it, I found 12 boxes that simply said, "Chocolate Cream Oreo".  I uploaded a picture of what I received.  I called Amazon and told some nice representative in India that I received the familiar regular stuf Chocolate Cream Oreos that I have seen in stores and not the Double Stuf Chocolate Cream I had been expecting.  He apologized and shipped another case.I received another case today and it was the exact same product that I received a few days previously: "Chocolate Cream Oreo".  Instead of calling Amazon, I decided to call Nabisco (Kraft Foods, Inc.) for clarification.  The number is listed on the package 1800-622-4726.The following is probably the real virtue of this review.  I was told that the package now for the Double Stuf Oreo Chocolate Cream does not say "Double Stuf" anywhere.  As I mentioned, I uploaded an image of the Double Stuf product package that I received.  According to Kraft, the only way to tell is the UPC and package weight.  The package weight for Double Stuf Oreos is 1 pound 1 ounce.  The package weight for regular or normal stuf Oreos is apparently 15.6 oz.  The UPC for Double Stuf Oreos is 04472700.  The UPC for (regular stuf) Chocolate Cream Oreos is 044000025298.  Since the package does not say Double Stuf anymore, I am not even sure what my local grocery carries.  I need to check the package weight and UPC at the grocery store.Therefore before you jump, head-long, into buying 12 boxes of this magical Double Stuf Chocolate Cream, you may want to check what your local grocery store carries.  I really do not see the logic in having 2 different products with the same package, but there you go:  that is apparently the case with Double Stuf Chocolate Cream and regular stuf Chocolate Cream Oreos.  I will also mention that it would be interesting to see a side-by-side comparison of Double Stuf and regular Oreo cookies.  My guess is that the difference is not as significant as you might expect since I initially thought my cookies were regular stuf.

Everyone loves Oreos. They're even better dipped in chocolate. I made a plate of them for my son's Cub Scout cookie auction and a plate of my cookies sold for $20. So yummy.RECIPE2 cups semi-sweet chocolate chips2 tablespoons shortening1 package Oreos*optional: 1 cup white chocolate chips and 1 tablespoon shortening**Before you begin, make sure everything is absolutely dry. Even a drop of water will ruin your creation.**Melt the chocolate chips with the shortening in the microwave for 1 minute. Stir until melted. If needed, heat another 10 seconds at a time until melted. Be careful not to burn the chocolate.Place one cookie in the chocolate and coat. Use a fork to scoop it out, tapping against the bowl and scraping the bottom of the fork on the bowl to remove excess chocolate. Place on wax paper and let it set. Store refrigerated.Optional: To make it pretty, melt a cup of white chocolate with a tablespoon of shortening at 70% in the microwave for 1 minute. Dip a fork in the white chocolate and let it drizzle from the fork onto the semi-sweet chocolate covered cookies. If done neatly, your cookies will look beautiful.Hint: I do one batch in semi-sweet chocolate and one batch in white chocolate. Then, I drizzle the cookies with the alternate chocolate. Plate them together for an eye catching presentation.

column9: Soup Can Contains "Small Amount" of BPA

Today I spoke with a Customer Relations person at Amy's Kitchen and asked her if Amy's soup cans had any BPA. She told me that they had a "small amount," but that they were testing other cans and should have no BPA in them by next fall. What I've read is that no amount of BPA is good for you and even a small amount might cause all sorts of bad things in one's body (cancer, heart problems, etc., etc.). I'm not trying to point the finger at Amy's products in particular, just make people aware that even CERTIFIED ORGANIC foods can be packaged in unhealthy containers and consumers should be aware of this.

column9: Holy crow! This sh*t is HOT!! (which is a good thing)
column10: I bought a bottle of Dave's Insanity twelve years ago at a hot sauce store in Boulder, CO, back when Dave's was the hottest sauce made. One or two drops in a pot of soup made the whole thing damn near unbearable (yet my roommate managed to use half the bottle in around 2 months).So when I saw the salsa, I thought I knew what I was getting into. I assumed that the salsa would be pretty ungodly hot  but somehwat milder than the sauce, given that this contains OTHER ingredients like tomatoes and onions. Boy, was I wrong. This stuff is as hot as the Insanity sauce, even though it is "diluted" with salsa ingredients. Which is not necessarily a bad thing. The heat won't kill you, and it won't even cause any real damage. (It'll just feel that way.)Don't expect to empty the jar at the same rate at which you scarf down that chipotle corn salsa or the green olive tomatillo tapanade, though. I eat a little bit of this everyday with tortilla chips and sour cream, sprinkle a tiny amount on a plateful of nachos, and spread an 1/8 teaspoonful on quesadillas, and have for the last three months. I think the salsa level has decreased by a few tablespoons in that time, and to me that seems like progress.Good stuff, but only for committed chileheads (or, more accurately, for those chileheads who should be committed).

i used to be able to buy this at target, but they dont carry it anymore, so i bought it through amazon

We love this Raspberry Tea.  A refreshing summer thirst quencher.  Sweet enough without the sweetner aftertaste.  Also tried the Raspberry Ice, but that is more like a coolaid type of drink.  Wish they made the Raspberry Tea in a single serving "on the go" pack!!!!

column9: Not the item I ordered for the second time
column10: I have ordered Raspberry tea, not tea raspberry flavor.  I have not opened and tried the tea with raspberry flavor, but it is not the same label as pictured on your site.

column9: Great product, great shipping. Very happy!
column10: My dogs seem to love this stuff. It is neat to see the dried fruit bits in the mix of this dog food, my dogs love the bits so much they lick the bowl clean to get all the crumbs. Seems to be quite good quality dog food with good ingredients as I checked against many reviews. I will try to stay with this dog food if cost permits as I had originally purchased from Amazon when there was a special discount offer on it.I am also impressed with the shipping/packing of the dog food. I was worried that would receive bag of dog food that was worn out from shipping but it arrived inside appropriate box and with paper filler for safe shipping of dog food. Very happy!

column9: The dog seems to love it
column10: I have a dog who is a very picky eater. I'd been giving her homecooked meals for about three weeks, but the vet said that I should get her something more nutritionally balanced and more geared towards canines. I got this one because it looked like it had good ingredients (i.e. the first ingredient isn't corn meal) and it was a reasonable price. Normally, my dog won't eat dry food for nearly two days (no joke) after she's had homecooked and/or wet food. To my pleasant surprise, she started eating the food within 24 hours. She's been on it for a couple of weeks now and she doesn't seem tired of it.

My 8 year old female Beagle has always had off-and-on runny stools for the six months or so that I had her. She was on Iams, but even that didn't help her digestion. I saw this stuff on Amazon for a reasonable price, and bought a 50 pound bag. I packaged the 50 pounds into gallon zipper bags so that it would stay fresh, and kept some in an airtight plastic container to scoop out of.Although it's recommended to slowly ease your dog from their old food to this stuff over the course of ten days, I discovered that it only took five days for my dog.....it would have probably been less but I was determined to follow try to the rules and dilute this with her old food. I suspect I could have just switched her over without a transition period, because as soon as she was getting just this food, her runny stools stopped. Since then, she's been very regular and the results have been firm, never runny. (I'd still follow the guidelines for your own dog)I can't attest that this food has made her coat shinier, or trimmed her weight very much (not that she needs it; she's a healthy weight for an 8 year old, spayed, female Beagle), but it definitely helped her digestion a lot.

Product:  I have purchased three bags of this product for my 3-year-old Cane Corso (Adopted).  He loves the food; I love its nutritional value and the result on his coat and energy level.Shipping:  Until last month, the product was received in perfect condition.  Then, last month it was quite the opposite.  The outer box and the bag of food, itself, were broken and torn.  Most of the food was spilled over the inside of the box.  It was a mess.  I could not find where to advise the sender (although I sent a quiry to Amzazon) of the problem. . . . .Nonetheless I am ordering another bag this month -- which is a high tribute to the product.  If the package is broken again, it will be my last order. . . . .It's just not a nuisance to me; it's a possible safety hazard to my dog.

column9: Wow, kibble my dogs actually dance for!
column10: Wheat-free, baby, and so much cheaper than my local pet store's wheat-free kibbles! The kibble's usually the "boring" staple, but this one my dogs dance for when I'm filling their bowls! I get the large-size bites now, but before Castor made the difference sizes, this worked fine. The vegetables are visible, it's actually pretty kibble, go figure! I still give them fresh veggies, especially carrots to keep the cataracts away (my dogs are getting old), but I like knowing they're getting veggies when I'm out of carrots and broccoli. Very digestible, easy pick-up after.

This is a wonderful dry kibble.  I love the real fruit and vegetables in the food and my dogs do also.  I foster rescued Pomeranians and Schipperke for Recycled Pomeranians and Schipperke Rescue in Dallas, so I need a great quality food to get this furkids back up to snuff.  We have seen remarkable improvement in our fosters' coats.  Their coats have gone from sparse and lifeless to full and shiny.I would HIGHLY recommend this food.
We switched to this from Blue Buffalo to give our dog a variety and she loves it, especially the banannas.

I recently switched my two-year-old 55-lb beagle/lab mutt to Ultramix from Blue Buffalo, which he had been eating for the last year. He didn't necessarily have a problem with the BB food, but every now and then he had an upset stomach, would throw up, etc. for no apparent reason, so I decided to try something new. After about a month since switching to the Ultramix, I truly believe he looks and acts healthier. His coat seems much more sleek and shiny, he hasn't thrown up once and he cut his poop schedule down to 2 a day from 3, which i've read means he's getting more nutritional value out of his food.
