Also, while he's always excited to eat anything, you'd think I was giving him a t-bone steak whenever we feed him the Ultramix - he really goes nuts for it. The little fruit pieces seem kind of gimmicky - but overall I feel like this is a great quality food that has truly made a difference in my dog. When I originally went to buy him new food a year ago, I went in with castor and pollux in mind after reading some great reviews about it online but the saleswoman in the petco convinced me to try blue buffalo -- wish I had gone with my original plan the whole time!

column9: Perfect food for my sensitive dog!
column10: Castor & Pollux Ultramix Adult Canine Fomula Dry Dog Food, 30-Pound BagMy pitt-mix has been eating Castor and Pollux Ultramix for well over a year now. Not only does she love it, but it has been the only dog food that she has been able to eat without having some sort of reaction to it. She was fine while she was eating puppy food, but once we started gradually moving her up to adult food, she started having all sorts of reactions. Even with tests from our vet, the process of finding her a good dog food that she could eat became a horrible trial and error process. We went to every extreme and started losing hope and then we found this product!!! Once it became obvious that she could eat it without any sort of reaction, we switched our little dog over to it too, and she's crazy about the banana chips and little dried peas.And I love that I can subscribe and save with this because it's a good deal and saves me the hassle of getting out to the pet store and hoping that they have a deal running while I'm there!

My dogs love this food!!!  at times i see them picking out the dried veggies in this mix and eating those first....Kinda Funny!  well before i started my dogs on this food.... they were having some really bad gas problems.... They would stink me out of a room.... when they started eating this one.... No more Stinky gas!!!

We have been using Castor & Pollux for around 6 months now and our dogs love it. Make sure to mix their old food with the new food half and half when you switch them over to help their stomachs adjust. We also utilize the "subscribe and save" feature. Even if we run out early, we just place an order, receive the discount and it is sitting on our porch in 2 days or less.

I was skeptical to change dog food for my Shepherd, however, I am glad I did!!!  This food is chuck full of fruits and vegtables that contain essential nutrients to help my dog's coat!!!  You can actually see the difference within the first week of feeding!  I was originally buying EVO and Innova brands... also great dog foods and made with food grade ingredients... I would place this in the same category!!!  If you love your dog and want them healthy, this food is an excellent product.

The dog food is great.  My dogs love it and it is made with healthy ingredients.  I did a lot of research before choosing this brand.  One of my dogs is very fussy but she has no problem eating this food.

We have been using this food for both our dogs for 2 years.  They are happy, healthy & have great coats. They never have digestive problems, which is of great importance to us! I means they are using all the food, w/o fillers.  We would recommend this food to everyone! The home delivery is acceptional and always on time.

My dog loves the Lamb Ultramix but hates this formula! :( I will never purchase it again. I may even switch brands because the only food he kinda likes is the lamb. My other pup loves the Grain Free Ultramix formula so she will stay on that. I just may have to take this at a loss and get rid of the food.

I did a lot of research before deciding on this brand. For the price its one of the better choices. My dog doesn't like to eat all his vegatbles and will often leave the carrots on the floor near his bowl, but other than that seems to like it. This isn't one of the dog food's full of filler.

We love getting Ultramix delivered to our house.  We not only save money on the dog food but also on the gas that we don't have to use in going back and forth to the pet store.  Castor and Pollux makes a first rate, healthy dog food.  Our dog happens to be on a grain-free diet and he loves the food so much that we even give it to him as training treats.  Thanks Amazon, for making life more convenient for us.

I really care for the health of my dogs, so I'm willing to pay the price for dog food that will not contain metals or by-products.  After trying many (even more expensive,) organic brands, I'm quite satisfied with Castor & Pollux' Ultramix Adult Canine Formula; and my two miniature dachshunds like it.  The mix comes with banana chips and dried carrots, and mi dogs enjoy the veggies for the most part, except that one of the them separates the carrots from his food all the time.  Just like any kid, he doesn't like carrots!  But sometimes I add a sauce or something else to the food and voila! problem solved!  I used to buy it at Whole Foods but found it $10 less at Amazon.  So, it's a win, win for me.

Some time ago I overhauled my dogs' diet after learning that the so-called "premium" brand I had been feeding them had by-products and other undesirable ingredients. One of my dogs is a little fussy and it was hard to find something else he liked. We finally settled on this brand. I like that you can actually see some of the vegetables and fruits that are mixed in, there are no by-products and it's less expensive than some of the other natural and organic brands.

column9: Wish we could love this food.
column10: I have three dogs a ten year old Mini Dachshund, a 1.5 year old boxer, and a one year old hound mix.  I wanted to LOVE this food because of all the great reviews and how healthy it seemed.  I loved that it had bits and pieces of peas, carrots, bananas.  My dogs seemed to really enjoy the food and ate a lot of it, BUT... my boxer developed TERRIBLE smelling gas.  I mean, enough to clear the room.  Some nights I had to sleep in my daughter's room because it was so bad it would wake me up from a dead sleep.  My dachshund started to develop really bad breath, which can be common in small dogs as they get older, but her breath had no smell before being on this food.  My hound mix's hair started to thin and fall out around the base of her tail.  It just seemed too coincidental to start having problems with all three of my dogs after starting this food.So we switched back to Eukanuba Adult dog food after trying out the C&P Ultramix for about three or for months and ALL of the problems have disappeared.  Well, the dachshund's breath is still a little funny but NO WHERE near as bad as it was.  The boxer still has gas, but it is back to the point to where I only hear it... I don't smell it.  And my hound mix's hair looks good again.Do I think this food is terrible?  No, it seems to work for a lot of people and their dogs.  It just didn't work for us.  I wish it did.  The auto delivery option was so convenient, great service.  It just wasn't for my dogs, I guess.

column9: WTF? C&P Used to be their favorite kibble.
column10: Ordinarily my dogs cannot get enough of this flavor of C&P.  When I spend this kind of $$ for kibble, I expect them to eat every last crumb. This has always been the case whenever I have purchased the same brand, flavor, dog size package from Wholefoods. When not one, not two, but all 3 of my dogs turned their noses up at the first bag ordered through Amazon.com. I almost cancelled the auto-order. Thinking it may have been a single stale bag or similar, I didn't stop the second auto order. I will begin feeding them from that bag this evening. Review to follow.

Bought one bag of this from a local store because it sounds and looks good. My dogs usually have solid stool since I give them coconut meat daily. But after eating this one, they started having very loose stool!

I'm on a diet plan that encourages me to "keep the furnace burning", so I end up snacking twice a day between my three meals. These cookies really taste great, and they also hold me over until my next meal.If there was anything I can compare them to, they're kinda like...sophisticated capt'n crunch. They're light and crispy, with a sort of almond butter in the middle. It's not a formal cookie shape. It's more like eating a large handful of cereal for a snack. The Honey-flavored variety tastes much better though.As a bonus, you don't get that nasty protein aftertaste, or the weird chewy textures.I am stoked to find this snack on amazon. FYI, Kay's Naturals also have "protein chips" that are quite good as well. If you're on a diet, and crave Doritos, aim for the chili flavors. Kay's Naturals Protein Chips, Chili Nacho Cheese, 1.5-Ounce Bags (Pack of 12)UPDATE: THE BATCH I RECEIVED WAS STALE, AND BROKEN IN PIECES. I've had "good batches" of this cookie before, so it still is a great snack. I've emailed the distributor to inform them of the bad batch. It could be that Kay's decided to package up the "bottom of the barrel" so to speak, and that's what I ended up with.

I'm a huge fan of Jelly Belly jelly beans, so I really enjoyed this gift box of 50 different kinds!  My favorite is definitely tangerine - but it's always a treat to try new and different flavors.  This box comes with a guide that tells you which flavors are which, so you can avoid the ones you dislike (for me - peanut butter jelly beans.. gag!).  It's pretty good size with a decent amount of jelly beans for the price - Jelly Bellies have never been cheap!  It's well worth the cost though, and a GREAT gift this year for Christmas!

column9: Top notch gift product or for yourself
column10: I bought both the 50 Flavor Gift Box and the Bean Blast Basket for corporate Christmas gifts. The Basket was much more expensive and didn't have nearly the wow value of this 50 Flavor Gift Box. It's shaped like a Monopoly game box and has the substantial feel of a real gift. It's also reasonably priced at around $15. Of course, the jelly beans are top notch and the unique flavors speak for themselves.This is an excellent gift item or treat for yourself.

column9: Jelly Belly is the BEST out there!
column10: Jelly Belly really does have true-to-life flavors! EVERY SINGLE FLAVOR in that box tastes exactly like what it should. A little pamphlet comes inside the Jelly Belly box, which tells you what different jelly beans you can mix to create a certain food. For example, 2 peanut butter jelly beans + 1 jam jelly bean = peanut butter jelly sandwich. It has a lot of fun combinations and surprisingly, they all taste like the foods that they should!This is really a great gift. Everyone I've given it to can't stop talking about how real these flavors taste, and the kids have lots of fun looking at the pamphlet and mixing the jelly beans to create foods!

column9: They're great, what do you expect?
column10: Nice assortment, the wife and I enjoyed coming up with all sorts of flavor combinations.  I would buy this again
Received very quickly and in time for Valentine's Day.  Very happy w/service.  Product was packed well and in perfect condition when it arrived.  Thank you!

Product is exactly as described and the packaging looks/feels quality.  Haven't opened it or tasted the jellybeans as it is a gift. It was packed for shipping well and arrived in 3 days on the cheapest shipping method.

This Jelly Belly box is a fun twist on the theme, and makes a great gift.  My father enjoyed following "recipes" on the back to make new flavors (e.g. blueberry + butter = blueberry muffin). Since each flavor is sorted into its own compartment, it's easy to figure out which you like the most.  This is not a large volume of beans, but it's a well designed package.

This was a gift for my dad. It came quickly and in pristine shape.It was packaged beautifully and sealed well. My dad loved it. I definitely reccommend this to anyone. It's pricey--but worth every penny!
My Mom and I used to love to eat Jelly Beans.  I now live over 3000 miles away.  For us, giving Jelly Belly was a trip down memory lane.

What do you get the person  who  appears to have 'Everything".  Jelly Bellys !.  A gift  that sat on President Reagan's desk  for 8 years  must be great. It was served to guests who were leaders of the world. Picking out a favorite is both a game  and a definite flavor adventure..............

The 2-pound bag is a better deal (and it's $17.99 at Bed Bath and Beyond, which is over $10 less than on Amazon).This 21-ounce box of separated flavors arrived with all the flavors mixed-up. The clear plastic sheet which is supposed to keep beans in place in their own compartment was not effective, and the beans all piled-up in a few compartments.Yummy beans, but not separated-by-flavor.

This collection defies superlatives.I enjoy them.The kids love them. Each time we take out the box it's like Christmas morning.They even play a game to see who can identify the flavor.A great buy, a great gift and great fun for all.BTW the many different special flavors apparently help the kids to keep consumption limited so they don't get as sugared-out as with other sweets.

We bought a bunch of these since my daughter had a lot of graduation parties to attend.  The boxes were really big and it looked like we spent a lot more than we did.  All her friends loved them.  Such a fun gift.  It arrived in good condition- no problems with packaging.

I ordered this item for my 66th birthday which really came a day later than my birthday.  The box was beautiful and had all the candies labeled in their compartments.  I do not like black licorice so that got thrown out. I have to order more, but did bribed my grandchildren with this treat.  Liquor is quicker but candy is sweeter.  The downside is that I lost a large portion of my old filling. But will order more and maybe sugar-free.
We sent this to our grandmother for a mid-winter cheer-me-up gift and it was a great success.  She enjoyed the presentation of the jelly beans and the recipes.  Makes a great gift.

My friend loves the huge variety of flavors and said they all tasted good, but when the box arrived you could tell that the jelly beans had all gotten mixed together.  That was a little upsetting because I wanted the gift to be perfect. I could have bought the jar of jelly beans, but I wanted them to be seperated by flavor.

The box was bigger than I imaged. Tha package was awsome, the jelly beans are delicious...I bought as a gift for my parents, and they now are jelly beans adicted. They don't stop asking me to send more jelly belly to them. They told me about the 2 popcorn flavors, chocolate pudding, cappuccino, tangerine, etc. It's a good idea for gift for all ages!Cons: a little pricy.

We bought this Jelly Belly collection with a gift card.  It brought us many days of pleasure.  I love the way each flavor is separated.  But they give you a direction to mix flavors for maximum and ideal combinations.  So much fun to bring out at night and share.  The colors and the flavors just prove Jelly Bellies are really top of the line.  Want a fun gift, give this collection.  Want something yummy for yourself a definite must.  Enjoy!

column9: taste great as always but the beans in the box were mixed up
column10: The jelly beans tasted great as always but unfortunately during shipment all of the beans got mixed up within the box.  Jelly Belly needs a better packing system to prevent this from happening.  The whole point of this gift box (vs the bags) is to have the beans separated!
so great to be able to find a decent size assortment of jelly bellies for the fans in the family

The 50 flavors were all mixed up when it arrive to me. It took 2 weeks to receive my box wich is quit long compaired to other things that I ordered on amazon coming from the US. In the end, I have been able to replace almost all the flavors at the right place. The jelly bellys are fun. The tast is impressive, popcorn is unbelivable and pear is great! Try the jalapeno if your game!Have fun!

We rececived our 50 flavor jelly bellies this week and boy do they taste good. The reason for this has to be because they use natural ingredients to create the flavors. My favorite is Tutti Fruiti (tastes like bazooka bubble gum - go figure). My wife's favorite is root beer. The soda pop flavors are good. My only complaint is the beans arrived all mixed up... is this the shipper's fault - I don't know.So when I saw the flavors scattered across the bins instead of being in each individual compartment I groaned. I even attempted to sort the beans - but gave up after 20 minutes. However, my wife who is much more patient than me spent over an hour to sort the beans and came up with every flavor in the correct compartment except for Jalopeno and Green Apple - which have the same coloring. So watch out when you grab a Green Apple. Otherwise this is a good buy.In conclusion - This comes with a menu for mixing flavors and the kids love them too...

I'm sure they were fine, my grand-nephew to whom I sent them for Xmas didn't bother to let me know if they arrived or not, but I am sure they were fine.  Thank you.  I know they were delivered in a timely manner. Happy New Year.

Get this box of jelly beans and plan a quiet evenning with your significant other.  These are great jelly beans and you can have at least a couple hours of fun trying these with someone an making up your own mixed flavors.  This is quite a bit of candy.  Worth the price if you like gormet candy.  You have to try buttered popcorn with either blackberry or blueberry, simply amazing flavor.

column4: Lonnie E. Holder "The Review's the Thing"
column10: Jelly Bellies are the gourmet version of the jelly bean. They are unique because of the variety of flavors and the ease with which you can recognize flavors. Even better, there are combinations of Jelly Bellies that can yield even more flavors. Jelly Bellies are small, but they are packed with a great flavor.Jelly Bellies are a special treat and while there are not an every day snack, I love to indulge upon occasion.  They are worth every penny each time I splurge to get them.Enjoy!

The box was packaged nicely, not mixed up like other people have commented, and I was really excited for this. I watched the package's tracking info like a hawk. Anyway when i opened it up it looked normal but they were all stale, so I gave them to my little cousins who usually love jelly beans, but they threw them at me in disgust. How do I complain to amazon? Everyone has tasted jelly bellies and knows they are great. Its not a matter of quality, I think i just got a bad box. Do i return it? Probably not because tons of jelly beans are missing, the box had been opened, and its a "food". What do i do because i am not happy.

column9: Jelly Bellies don't knock my socks off
column10: The best thing about jelly bellies is that they seem to be using higher quality ingredients than other American manufacturers but I remember when jelly beans didn't have to be gourmet to taste good.  I bought a 7 oz. bag of 30 flavors from Target and I find that bag to be too much for me but I would have bought the full 50 flavor assortment if Target had sold it because of the organization and identification of flavors.  I wasn't supposed to get cantaloup in my 30 flavor bag but I did get one and that flavor was so much better than tangerine.  I also liked the root beer.  The popcorn flavor was interestingly reminiscent of artificially fragrant movie theatre popcorn.  The jelly belly flavors are interesting but I prefer the lightly flavored pastel jelly beans available during Easter.  I believe they are manufacturered by Brachs.  They are gentler tasting than jelly bellies.

DHL did a terrible job with the delivery of my gift box in a timely manner.  I tracked it from a local area for two days and then noticed it went back to Rhode Island for a night and back to the Latham office.  It was finally delivered two days after the stated date.  The contents of the box was all jumbled and mixed together from the "handling."  I will not order from a company that uses DHL again.

Sorry, but this was a disappointment. My husband is a jelly bean fanatic, but these expensive beans did not impress him. Yes, it was fun to see if you could combine the beans to create salsa (you could), but many of the flavors were disappointing. My favorites were the root beer and cream soda; everyone's least favorite was the buttered popcorn.  A novel one-time gift.

I wanted to buy Vomit flavor and other weird ones, but can't do that online, so I bought this 50 flavors, and was disappointed to find that they are all "good" flavors, with no vomit or other known jelly belly weird flavors.

Proper marmalade the way it used to be - this it the type of preserves you'd make yourself if you had access to bitter oranges and about 6 hours' time. Not too cloyingly sweet like most American marmalade, and not bitter, just right, with interesting shreds of orange in it. Bliss spread on thick handmade Italian bread with fresh sweet butter, but also a good glaze for a pork roast, dabbed on wholegrain crackers with goat cheese, and a superb addition to cranberries in a cranberry-orange relish. (And a secret ingredient in Cosmos- use 1/4 teaspoon!)

Im not a big fan of extra strong dark chocolate, but the health benefits are many so I figured I would try a few of them out. This is by far the best one. Actually has more of a sweet taste and any bitterness is hard to even notice. Packed with antioxidants. A few squares a day is a great addition to any healthy diet.

This is a very nice chocolate. It has been cured to a nice crisp hardness. The flavor has dimension to it with a sweet overtone and minimal back end bitterness. I've very impressed. This will definitely be on my "addiction" list for reordering.

I order a package of 12 Chocolove Premium Chocolate Bars, which by the way is an excellent chocolate, but when it arrived the bars were bent and melting due to he heat of the delivery truck. I contacted the seller and without questions or argument I was sent another order. I received the order well packed and cold in 2 days. Because I was stunned to see such customer service I contacted the seller once again to offer payment for the UPS cost, but the seller refused stating that their goal is total satisfaction and that I should not pay for the shipping. Just amazing service! I will recommend this seller to anyone and ask to support them. If there were more stars to give I would had given them the max.I hope this review helps.DF

this is my favourite chocolate ever.  creamy melt in your mouth texture..plus the little squares are domed and fit perfectly against the roof of your mouth (each one has a little heart on it too).  nice dark flavour without the bitterness that can happen in the REALLY dark ones.  i like the darker ones too, but this is my favourite percentage.  the flavoured ones are really yummy as well.  my boyfriend is also addicted to this brand.  maybe you don't think you need to buy twelve at a time, but i think it's a great idea!

column9: The best chocolate bar, hands down
column10: I love chocolate.  Good chocolate.  I've tried fancy bars, local bars, hand-poured bars, organic bars, and almost everything else, and THIS is my favorite.  The chocolate is perfectly dark without being bitter, the orange has an incredibly satisfying crunch and a slight (very slight) chewiness that makes the texture of the bar divine, and the flavor of orange and chocolate together are heavenly.If only they sold it in more places!

column9: mmmmmmfor chocolate lovers you gotta try this one
column10: I am not usually a lover of dark chocolate, but when a friend gave me this chocolove premium dark (55%) orange peel as a gift, I fell in love with it. So for Valentine's I decided to buy a box and give my special friends a bar for a happy. Now they are all addicted. The orange peel gives it a special little tang and crunch at the end and I would recommend it to any chocolate lover. It was funny that each person said they could not hold out to make it last a whole day like I had challenged them to. It is just too good.

Not only have i had just about everry brand of belgian chocolate this side of the atlantic, i have had this one several times.  But this seller sent bad chocolate. It has a powdery appearance and is very brittle to touch and taste.  Can't eat it at all.  And i guess i can't return it either.

I treat myself to Chocolove at my local health food store once a month.  I am very conservative on how much sugar I have, so I make one bar last me a whole month.  Yes, it has real sugar, but it is so delightful for the amount of sugar that it has.  A taste of heaven.  I buy the 70% cacao and I am hooked! Seductive bliss!  One more thing, if you are in to dark chocolate, the taste is quite smooth, not bitter as some darks go.

column9: Delicious and sells out quickly at grocery store
column10: This is the best chocolate bar I've ever tried.  The salty taste is in perfect balance with the chocolate.  I'm not the only one that thinks so, since our local grocery store sells out of this particular bar almost as soon as they arrive.  The other Chocolove bars are fine, but this one is tops.

My husband and I occasionally enjoy a few pieces of dark chocolate in the evening and this chocolate is a real treat. It is hard to find such good chocolate at less than $3 per bar. We order a couple cases each fall and keep them in the freezer till we need a new bar. This is not bitter chocolate and just 1/6 (3 small squares) of a bar is only 80 calories and satisfies our desires for dark chocolate.

column9: Favorite chocolate bar in the world
column10: I first tried this at a small coffee shop and the memory of the taste haunted me until I found it on Amazon.  It is a wonderfully decadent treat in which to indulge, whether to forget your bad day or to reward yourself for a job well done. You can taste the real orange peel shavings in this chocolate and it is that perfect blend of dark chocolate and orange, which is the most divine combination.

So, I do A/B tests.  You know, like buy bar A and then bar B and then eat 'em both.YEARS of doing this shamelessly has led me to become a regular purchaser of Chocolove's Pure Dark.  The 55% one.I don't care much for their other bars -- they're just so-so -- but DANG! the Pure Dark is crazy-good.Do yourself a favor.  Don't just buy this bar.  Buy this bar and then buy ten other chocolate bars.  It's in the name of science, it's okay.  Take all your bars, break them up, then try them all.Yeah, that chocolate that keeps evolving and coating your mouth with subtlety and wizardry?  That's this one.

Bought some of these in New Mexico at a co-op store and couldn't find them locally in Florida. Bought on line thru Amazon at a lower price and free shipping. The candy is wonderful and it's truly a sweet deal.

I am a fanatic about fabulous chocolate and even more so when it's combined with orange. AND, boy oh boy, Chocolove has hit the nail on the head with this delicious chocolate bar! Well worth  the price. I would definitely recommend this chocolate...so fantastic!

My husband a self-proclaimed chocoholic says this is the best chocolate he's ever eaten.  And because it's so high in cocoa content, it's good for him too!  That's all he needed - another reason to eat chocolate ha! ha!  We bought it in 12-bar packs and gave it out over xmas and everyone agreed...great chocolate!

column9: Best orange chocolate i have tried
column10: Someone gave me a bar as a gift.  I had no idea it would be this good.  Better than other orange/choc combos, it has a nice crunch to the peel bits. Yum.

Bought one of these at Whole Foods about a month ago.The secret: they freeze-dry the orange peel and this leadsto a really strong orange taste with each bite. You get a littlebit of peel this way.I've loved orange chocolate since i was a kid and my Dadbrought some home from trips. This is an excellentversion.

I absolutely love dark chocolate (77% seems to be the magic number) and have tried many different varieties.  This is one of my favorites due to the complex flavor and great dense and smooth texture. Also, this pack of 12 is a economical way to purchase.

Chocolove's Orange Peel in Dark Chocolate is one of the best dark chocolates I've ever eaten. If you're a dark chocolate fan, you owe it to yourself to try this. The orange flavor really shines through and the wrapping is colorful and stylish. The price was amazing too, much less than I pay at other stores.
Best candybars. I was skeptical buying food online, but I can't get these anywhere near me except the Chocolate Show once a year in NYC. They're great - no worries!
this chocolate is a true treat to eat, perfect texture, almond toffee mix goes together perfectly. the packaging is really cute too. very highly recommended!
I am a dark chocolate person and I love this bar.  It is low in sugar and high in cocoa flavor.

column9: Best Almonds and Sea Salt chocolate bar
column10: I have tried several and this one has just the right amount of sea salt added to not distract from the chocolate, but adds to the flavor.  It is my favorite.  I have many strong favorites for dark chocolate bars, but this one seems to be the only one to get this combination right.
I really enjoy these Jonny Almonds, any friends I introduce them to like them as well.  Very generous portion, awesome price.Melinda
Our local pet store stopped carrying these and so we were excited to find them online.  Our Dog eats the same brand of food and it keeps her healthy and at a good weight.

column9: Hard to find, but not on Amazon!
column10: Our 7 pound Maltese dog loves these treats, but the local PetCo and PetSmart supply is often depleted.  I was pleasantly surprised that the Amazon supplier shipped these in good packaging and did not ship us old, out-of-date product. I recommend these.

My Pug is so picky, she doesn't like the little ones, but loves the bigger ones.  I don't know what the difference in them is, but she does.  So I would not recommend these if your dog is picky, go ahead and get the bigger ones and break them up.

column9: If you have a respiratory issue its magic!!
column10: I had a cough that was keeping me up night after night and not getting better. I had to sleep sitting up for 4 or 5 nights in a row. My friend swears by lotus root for the lungs and I am not so into homeopathic solutions, but she sent it to me. Within one day I slept through the night, but night 2 I was lying down and the cough was gone. I wasn't taking any other medication. There are no side effects at all. Try it, it doesn't taste awesome but if you add some soy sauce, sea salt or ginger it is better. And drink as much as you can, its food, so its not harmful. There are no directions as to how much to take. Some people make an entire pot out of the packet and then keep it in the fridge and re-heat it a cup at a time. I made a cup at a time and had about 6 cups the first 2 days then less each day. In less than a week I was 100% fine.

I was looking forward to getting this product. I loved the classic brulee, however the chocolate tasted like chocolate pudding with sugar on top. It had no special taste and it was expensive. I gave this a three star only because the classic is still very good for a boxed dessert. If you are looking for a bargain do not order from this store there is better pricing out there.
Perfectly roasted (not burnt)...perfectly groundItalian Espresso I prefer, because it's rich and creamy flavor is not over roasted like Starbucks.

This coffee is simply superb. It strikes just the right balance between Arabica and Robusta, with a well-rounded, creamy, yet robust flavor. It's perfect for both moka coffee makers and espresso makers (I use it with both). This coffee is very popular in Naples and throughout Italy, and for very good reasons. To add to its value, it's also reasonably priced (as far as imported Italian coffee can be reasonably priced here in the US, anyway). If you're looking for the REAL Neapolitan coffee flavor, this is it. As they say in Italy, "Provare per credere" (trying is believing). Enjoy!
Straight from Bella Napoli. This is the best. Try it in your espresso maker or mokka.

column9: Great Quality for a Good Price
column10: I have used this flax meal to prepare grain free breads, pancakes, and cakes with great success.  It also makes a wonderful egg substitute if I am running low on eggs.  Having tried Bob's Golden Flax Meal, as well,  my family prefers the heartier taste of this darker meal. Since the meal is packaged in 4 32 oz bags it is easier to store in the freezer.

column9: A steal at $17 per case, easily used right out of the freezer
column10: I buy Bob's Red Mill ground flax seed meal from Winco Foods grocery store for about $4 per pound and my kids love it--or at least they tolerate it.  We put it in pancake mix to add fiber and nutrients--start out with just a little bit until the kids get used to the different texture and then increase the amount gradually.  We always add a little whenever we bake, or make hot cereal.  But mostly just pancake mix.The packaging is very good, product is always fresh and nutty tasting.  Never bitter.  Should be refrigerated or kept in the freezer.  Lasts a very long time in the refrigerator, not sure how long (about 2-3 months before we finish it all).Whole flax seeds last much longer, even without refrigeration, but they must be finely ground before consumption to get the nutrients.

After trying several of these to see if they could of got better, in the end they didn't. They are now in my cupboard when I am sure I will get aggervated by their mere presence and throw them out. The flavor was disqusting, and the beans were way to big and bitter. Dont recommend them to anyone.

We are currently working in Afghanistan. My counterparts, the soldiers, and myself all love the flavor, freshness, and variety in this bag. It was delivered two weeks faster than estimated. Highly Recommend!

column9: My son loves them. Keeps him going on Campus.
column10: I send the Diletante Espresso Bean Blend to my son in Miami. They are sent directly to him and that in itselfmakes it easier for me. He loves the 3 different chocolate flavors and they help keep him going with a boost of caffiene tomake those Professor's lectures easier to stay awake in!

I recieved these about 4 days after I ordered. Pretty happy with the time it took to ship them. They were shipped in a USPS envelope, it was bursting at the seals. I was concerened that they would be smashed or damaged, but they turned out ok due to the cool weather. During the summer months I think the seller should consider using a box!The beans were of great quality, great flavor and the chocolate had excellent taste. The bag itself seals at the top, so that will help keep the contents fresh. I plan to keep these in a jar for customers on my desk, and of course to keep me awake!Will buy again when a I run out!

I bought this as a gift for Christmas in a nice glass jar from Old Time Pottery. My boyfriend thought they would last forever but they were gone by March. People would come to his cubicle just to take a few. My only complaint is that 1/6 of the bag came stuck together. They easily broke apart but made one side of a lot of the beans flat. This was mailed in December but I guess the warm Georgia winter melted them in transit. For the price, I hoped that all of them would be intact. Taste was not compromised though. Yum!

Actually, for what you are getting here (a little shot of heaven), this is not really a bad price.  I am quite familiar with this brand of pistachio and I have not found a better quality nut anywhere.  In the five pound bags I have bought in the past, I have found on the average only three nuts per bag (yes, I actually counted them...I have an obsessive/compulsive personality) that were scrawny and tasting bad.  The rest have been nice fresh and plump.These are salted but fortunately they have not been soaked in that horrid red dye that gets all over the place much as those cheese snacks do.  As a matter of fact, the only place I have had better pistachios has been when I visit Greece or Turkey.I have a passion for these things that boarders on an addiction.  These are the real thing and they certainly do it for me.  I highly recommend this company and their product.

column9: Was great when it was 16 dollars cheaper
column10: Nuts are of above average quality, though strangely about 5% of the nuts have an almond taste to it. Better than most store bought brands. No real complaints.However, I have to put a low rating on this due to the price increase. I know this type of review note is frowned upon, but the nuts are not worth the money that they jacked the price up to. My total order one week ago was $34.48 shipped. Went I went to reorder, the price is now $50.90 including shipping. I do not understand the reason for the sudden price increase, but while the nuts are good, they are not worth this exorbitant price. At $10 a pound, you can find a better deal for pistachios on an equal or better level.

column9: My pit bull won't eat these
column10: My first review didn't show up, so am trying again. These look and feel like plastic and my pit bull that will eat anything will not eat theses. Thirty bucks lost as I had to order regular pig ears

column9: My dogs can't get enough of these.
column10: My Mastiff and beagle love these. They last longer than normal pig ears, and seem to be less fatty. Great product!

This is absolutely the best chocolate I've ever had. I used to get it periodically at a Dutch import store near me, but I went there today and they didn't have any. Naturally I was inspired to check Amazon and write this review.Let's just say any time I go to Europe, I come home with this in my suitcase.

If you are a milk-chocolate fan, you must try this most wonderful brand.  Not too sweet, it is a beautiful, creamy, delectable and exquisite experience in chocolate tasting! My guess is that Heaven will be paved with Cote d'Or milk chocolate.  The dark is excellent too!

I lived in Belgium for a year or two, and ate a LOT of Cote d'Or Chocolate.  Now just a small taste transports me back to Belgium.  Not as sweet as typical American Chocolate.  Really smooth.  There were many, many chocolates in Belgium to try and this was my favorite of the commerical ones.  Now the small bakery/pastery shop across the street from my apartment had the most amazing handmade milk chocolate...but that's another story.
All very good but I yearn for the Cote d'Or Citron Gingembre I recently had in Antwerp.  All the dark chocolates are heavenly, especially the Noir d'Noir.Ginny Higgins, Danbury, NH
I loved the chocolate, I had tasted it before in school so I knew I had to buy some. It was expensive though, costing me about 10 dollars.
Smooth and creamy!  Bars are double - two packs.  Not cheap, but well worth the money.  Melts easily so I store in the refrigerator.

A delectable treat from the manufacturer of Belgium's most popular brand of chocolates.  It has a creamy texture, and aromatic top and bottom notes; an excellent complement to coffee. A chocolate for the true connoisseur!

column9: Not the puppy food for us
column10: This did not work for our puppy.  It left her with quite the upset tummy.  It was the food she came home from the breeder on, but something must have changed when she got home.  We have since made the switch to eukanuba and she is a much happier pup!  Plus, I am happier too since I'm no longer cleaning up after her all the time!  As always, Amazon was great, but I would not recommend this food for your puppy.

This dog food has all the ingredients you don't want in a dog food - corn, by-products, etc.  For about the same price, Diamond has their Naturals line that is MUCH BETTER in terms of quality.  Diamond Naturals Puppy food doesn't have corn or by-products.I honestly don't know why Diamond puts out this awful dog food when they can make quality ones for right about the same price - given the choice, who would take the one for less quality?Our puppy was on this when we got her, we bought a small bag and slowly changed her food to the Diamond Naturals for Large Breed puppies, and the difference is fantastic.  We'll stick with the Naturals, and never have her go back to this variety.
Good product for the price.  My dog is not picky and he puts it down fairly quick.  Would recommend for the bigger puppys.

I have a 7-month old terrier/german shep mix (a pound puppy, yes) who seems like she's going to end up around 50 or 60 pounds. I did a lot of research before I went with this brand - I can't afford the high-end food but don't want to settle for cheap stuff just cuz the price is right and this fell right in the middle. It came highly recommended and comes out to about a dollar a day for Betsy. She likes it and seems to be benefitting from it - her coat looks nice, her body is filling out in the right places but she's not fat at all. However, I have never seen a dog poop soooooo much! At first I thought it was just the change in her diet - from street food to good food - but she's been on it for almost 2 months now and it's not letting up. She's healthy, has had all her shots, is in great condition, and eats the right amount according to the chart on the bag. But wow! I was under the impression that the better the food the LESS they poop... not the case with this. At least 3 times a day, minimum, and lots of it. I can only attribute it to the food and will change it when this second bag is gone.

Finally a great alternative to the other "Dr" soda!  Dr. Zevia has an intense flavor with a lot of cherry in it.  Not quite as much "pepper" flavor as the mainstream brand.  There is a stevia aftertaste, but it's not any worse than an aspartame aftertaste.  I love it and feel good letting my kids drink it, too.

I have been a fan of Zevia since they first came out a few years ago and before they could market themselves as a food product due to stevia's status at the time. Now that stevia is approved by the FDA as a food additive, many more things are coming out with it. I refuse to eat foods with chemical sweeteners like aspartame, sucralose and ace K that all of the major diet sodas use. I applaud Zevia for being ahead of the curve on choosing natural stevia instead. Dr. Zevia is my favorite flavor--I want caffeine in my soda, but don't like the flavor of the cola as much as Dr. Zevia, so I was extremely happy when they came out with this flavor. Truly a no-guilt treat!

Let me start by saying that I am NOT a person that ever reviews anything. If I dislike something, I throw it away and use it as a learning experience. With that being said, I must also say that I am a HUGE lover of everything Zevia and anything related. Every single Zevia product that I've tried, I've LOVED! That is until Dr. Zevia. I am an avid lover of anything cherry and anything Dr. Pepper related. I was so excited when my case of Dr Zevia arrived that I ran inside, opened the box and immediately opened one. This is when I gagged LOL! It is soooooooooo similar to robatussin that it's nauseating. I thought that maybe it would get better if it was super cold, no it actually got worse. I have 23 cans of Dr. Zevia that I have NO idea what to do with lol. It might be good in a milkshake or in some sort of food as a flavor enhancer but it definitely isn't a great soda.

column9: My favorite of all the Zevias.
column10: I also like the Black Cherry flavor now. I first tried them when I started doing lower carb eating and I have to admit that being someone who has never liked diet soda AT ALL, they took some getting used to. I've tried all the flavors and after not having had any regular soda for about two months, I actually like these. The Dr. Zevia and the Black Cherry seem to be just sweet enough for me with the way I eat now. I'd like it if they came out with a creme soda flavor too.

Dr. Zevia has to be may favorite of all of the Zevia flavors (and I really do like them all).  I think it tastes just like Diet Dr. Pepper.  And the stevia aftertaste is very minimal... more so than the other Zevia flavors.  I would highly recommend Dr. Zevia (plus, the name is so cute!).

column9: The Best Alternative to Diet Sodas With Artificial Sweeteners
column10: Whenever I drink a soda at home, it is always a Zevia soda.  Dr. Zevia has a slight cherry flavor and is similar to the other Dr.  I have noticed very little aftertaste from Zevia soda, much less than from regular diet soda.  From the reviews I've read, it's clear that you either really like this soda or you don't.  I really like this soda.  I was a big consumer of the other diet Dr. and both big-brand diet colas for many years.  I really didn't like the artificial sweetener in the average diet soda.  Thank you to the people who make Zevia soda.  It is more expensive than regular soda, but I think it's worth it.  It is great to be able to enjoy a diet soda that tastes great and contains nothing artificial.  My only negative comment would be about what happens when you pour Zevia soda in a glass over ice.  The carbonation seems to dissipate very quickly when poured over ice.  Not to worry.  Drinking it right out of the can works fine for me.

This stuff has managed to become a suitable sub for coke and is probably responsible for about 10 lbs of the 40 I lost. Tastes like a cross between a diet DP and a cherry coke. Since it's more expensive than regular soda, I limit myself to one a day, but it definitely satisfies that craving! Highly recommend!

column9: Great Taste - Doesnt keep me up - :D
column10: I really like the taste.Awesome how it has no sugar so It doesnt keep me up at night*At first i didnt really like any of the zevias, but after trying them each a couple times, i just cant get enough. though this is my favorite.*And the price went down from 27$ to $21 which is pretty cool.Fantastic!
Unfortunately this soda tastes like cough syrup.  I was really hopeful for this but the cough syrup taste is horrible.  It was fine as a soda, but the flavor was horrible.

I was really excited to find this soda. Taste isn't bad, takes a couple of days to get used to. It's only fizzy when you first pour it out, then it turns into what looks like flat soda. The dealbreaker here is this soda has caused horrible diarrhea. I'm actually posting this review from the toilet as my stomach makes noises. This is my 3rd trip today.I'll try my luck with the occasional Splenda soda. This has been a bad experience. I'm scared to give it to y kids because I don't want them to have an accident at school.

column9: Delicious soda, cheaper than local store
column10: I love Dr. Zevia. I've tried a few Zevia soda varieties, and this is my favorite. I also like the Root Beer. Many of the flavors taste distinctly diet, but Dr. Zevia tastes less diet to me. It does not, however, taste very much like Dr. Pepper at all. I find the flavor more like a cherry cola, which I like. If you're looking for a Dr. Pepper substitute, this might not be for you. If you're looking for a tasty, natural, 0-calorie soda, I recommend this. It is also significantly cheaper here than at my local grocery store.

I have been buying Zevia for a while now and finally came upon it on amazon, way better deal on here than at the store. Dr. Zevia is like Dr. Pepper and Cherry Coke combined, which actually tastes wonderful. I highly recommend this soda but if you are a Dr. Pepper addict you might find it slightly lacking.

I am still looking for some more natural soda like this to curb the occasional craving. I am sorry, but this was gross tasting. Nothing like Dr. Pepper. Maybe other flavors are not bad, but the Cola one is.

column9: For the health minded soda drinker
column10: This is Zevia's version of Dr. Pepper.  Does it taste EXACTLY like Dr. Pepper?  No, but when you pretty much stop drinking soda of all kinds, an occasional Dr. Zevia tastes pretty good.  Given it's a healthier alternative, I don't mind the sacrifice in taste.  Amazon has a really good price too (as of this review) compared to what I can buy it for locally in the health food stores/grocers.  I would recommend someone who is a Dr. Pepper or Mr. Pibb addict and interested in an alternative, healthier version to try this brand and flavor.

Because it has "Dr." in its name, you think you're getting a Dr. Pepper knockoff.  Instead, you get only the cherry flavor of Dr. Pepper.  So, in fact, it's more like Cherry Cola than anything else.  I couldn't taste any of the other major flavors that are in the real (diet) Dr. Pepper.  It's not bad, but I really don't like cherry cola, so it's not for me.

I haven't had soda or carbonation in years. I got this for my parents who, to avoid sugar, drink nothing but aspartame filled fresca black cherry and peach. Figuring that is so much worse, I was so excited to find Zevia and currently am awaiting my parents to try the flavors. I myself grabbed a Dr. Zevia because I loved Dr. Pepper back when I used to drink soda. Now it has been years, so I cracked it open and noted a considerable spice and cherry smell. I took a sip and felt a punch to the throat like I downed some great tasting apple cider vinegar. That's not a problem with this product, it's just what happens when you haven't had carbonated drinks in years. It tastes just like Dr. Pepper, maybe a little bit like a diet but that's not a problem because it tastes great all the same AND you're not compromising your health. This is the benefit of capitalism, someone wants a better product, someone makes a better product. I want to get everyone I know on this stuff and off of their monsters, fresca's, diet pepsi's and so on...

it was ok.  Just ok.  Didn't love it, didn't hate it.  I went to drink it hoping for it to be just like dr pepper.  At first I felt like it was lacking in sweetness, but that was just because stevia lacks that mouthfeel of sugar.  I adjusted to the sweetness thing by the second gulp and that was ok.  It was actually pretty ok except for the lacking bite.  I got the stevia aftertaste (not too bad of one) where I was expecting bite.  Disappointing... not dismal... I got the variety pack... This was the first one I tried.  I'm likely to drink the other one... but its just not the same.  I actually looked back at the can a few times to convince myself it said Dr. Zevia and not Cola... It is passable as a cola (haven't tried the cola yet).  Hopefully the other flavors will be better.

column9: No Dr. taste but still good
column10: I must say, I'm a lover of Dr. Pepper, so when I saw this product made with Stevia I was very excited.  I was disappointed that it did not taste anything like Dr. Pepper.  After I got past the No Dr. taste, I was fine.  As an alternative to sugar sodas it's good.  It has the sweetness and carbonation you expect from regular soda, without the after taste of many diet sodas.  Just more along the generic end as far as flavor goes.

column9: from a former Dr. Pepper drinker... tastes great!
column10: From a former Dr. Pepper drinker,I have to say I really like Zevia's version! When I cut sugar out of my diet I found Zevia, and had been drinking their root beer, ginger ale, black cherry, and orange for a while. Those are all really good. When they came out with this one I wondered if it would be any good. I was happily surprised to find that it tasted great! I think it tastes a bit more like Mr. Pib than Dr. Pepper, though. It's a great alternative to High fructose corn syrup and artificial chemicals.

I've wanted to find a stevia-sweetened soda for a long time, but I don't like typical colas or lemon-lime soft drinks.  I had hoped this would taste a little more like that other, well-known Dr. drink, but to be honest it just doesn't.  I guess my slight disappointment with that difference led me to knock off a star in my rating.  All in all however, it's a good flavor.  Bit of a cherry with a hint of citrus.
After trying Dr. Zevia I am disappointed at the taste.  It is nothing like Dr. Pepper but has a "whang" to it.  I am anxious to try the other flavors however but I can not recommend Dr. Zevia.

It is a naturally sweetened soda with Stevia, but I expect more robust flavor simular to Dr. Pepper.  I wouldn't even say it is close to Dr. Pepper.  I was disappointed, especially when I love the "Cola" flavor of Zevia so much.

This is one of Zevia's more successful flavors.  It's more reminiscent of the flavor of Dr Pepper than a clone, but it still tastes very good.  I don't notice any kind of aftertaste.  I've bought this on its own before, and will again.  It's one of my favorite flavors.
No, it's not Dr. Pepper, but it's pretty darn close. I love these Zevia sodas. I'm purchasing more of this flavor.

column9: Natural and delicious calorie free "dr" soda!
column10: I have searched for a natural diet soda that I like, but kept going back to the nutrasweet diet sodas because of the variety.  I recently discovered Zevia sodas (because of the Belly Fat Cure book/diet plan).  I am SO happy with these sodas, especially the Dr. Zevia, it is very similar to the nutrasweet-sweetened "dr" soda, but without that very unhealthy sweetener.I have tried several of the Zevia soda flavors, and I like the cola, lemon lime and orange; the cream soda and black cherry flavors are really, really good.  The Mountain Zevia tastes nothing like its nutrasweet counterpart (I thought it tasted much like the "Airborne" cold medicine).

column9: If your on the fence just try it
column10: This stuff is so good, one of my fav Zevia flavors.  Sort of Dr. Pepper flavor.  So good.Get off sugar and get on Zevia!  :)

I have tried Zevia Cola and Zevia Root beer. I love both of those. My husband is a Dr Pepper fan, so I decided to buy Dr Zevia. It is not quite Dr Pepper flavor, but really close. It tastes delicious over ice or with most any adult beverage added to it (I like gin or rum). The ingredients listed on this description are slightly different than the ingredients on the can. I did not see clove, but I saw nutmeg instead. I like that this has a little bit of caffeine in it. Overall, will definitely buy again.

I picked this up from my local health food store.  I have tried Stevia and occationally use it in tea or coffee.  I think they used way too much of the sweetner. It was horrible. I wish they just put a lot less of the sugar subsitute.  It did not taste like what it was supposed to.

I gave up soda a few weeks ago and saw this while shopping today. (I'm really new to health food!) I really miss the fizz and buzz of soda, so I thought I'd give it a whirl. I thought it was fantastic. It's sweet, but not in a syrupy gross way like a regular soda usually is. I'm used to Diet, and maybe that's the key to appreciating the flavor of this beverage, or maybe its that I have been off soda for a while. I really love that I can drink this casually and know I'm not poisoning myself with a ton of chemicals I can't identify. I would love to subscribe, if someone who has can tell me how well it ships :)

column9: I Want To Swim In It... But Only Metaphorically
column10: I've taken to leaving soda out of my normal diet. I am in no way a health-food guy, but by simply cutting out soda I find that I amactually shaving hundreds of calories a day. In fact I just had a doctor visit last week, and it turns out that over the course of a year I lost 7 pounds.Now... I'm not saying it is purely due to this soda, but there is not a doubt in my mind that it did indeed contribute to the loss.Thing is; I wasn't even trying to lose weight. I just wanted to keep away from the strange and unpronounceable chemicals found in most soft-drinks.Anyway, this stuff is quite tasty. It took about three cans before I was fully acclimated to the new (to me) taste of Stevia.I also enjoy the Zevia cola, but this is my favorite flavor. I just wish it were a bit cheaper... but if it catches on I'm sure the price will drop.~Rusty

I want to say that this soda does have a very strong flavor, probably the most of all the Zevias, so I can understand why some may not like it. For me though it's a very tasty treat. It's been a long time since I've had a true Dr. Pepper, so I don't feel that it is fair for me to make that comparison. However this is a flavor that I really enjoy.

This was my first Zevia product, so I have no idea how it compares to the others.  But based on the flavor of this, I doubt I'll find the courage to try any others.  Please don't think you will be getting a drink that tastes even remotely similar to Dr. Pepper.  The "Dr." part is fitting because it tastes like medicine.  Brushing my teeth afterwards helped erase the memory.

I purchased a case of this product in the hopes to find an alternative to the high calorie, high sugar beverage I normally drink.  Dr Pepper has been my favorite for years.  I have tried other beverages that were supposed to be cheaper versions of it, only to be disappointed every time.  I thought, with this version (Dr Zevia) being so much more expensive and using stevia to sweeten as a healthier alternative than sugar, that this would likely be closer to the brand name beverage it was trying to be like.  Unfortunately, I found it not only wasn't closer to the flavor, it was much worse than any I had tried in the past!  It was like drinking carbonated cough syrup!  I did not return it because my son decided to drink it and suffer through it to try to reduce his caloric intake, but if he wants more of it, he will have to buy it himself.  I will never again spend 4 times the amount I spend for the real deal, just to be disappointed by what is expected to be a high quality product.

Finally a soda that doesn't contain sugar and doesn't have all the fake sugar poisons either! I wasn't sure I would like the taste so searched for it locally. Finally found it at QFC (just had a few flavors) and PCC (had a lot of flavors including Dr Zevia). And PCC had it on sale for $5.09 for a 6-pack so I lucked out.I'm a Dr. Pepper fan - my favorite soda but I won't drink it (except 1x a year) because they don't have a healthy version. I loved the taste of Dr Zevia but enough reviewers have had mixed reviews so definitely try it first before ordering quantities. I drank it ice-cold. The flavor is pretty dang close.The sweeteners used are stevia and erythritol. Stevia is definitely good for you and won't spike your insulin levels. (From the zevia.com website: "What is erythritol? Erythritol is a natural sweetener found in many fruits and vegetables. It is extracted from those sources by a natural fermentation process. The erythritol in ZEVIA exists in the same form - unchanged - as it does in plants and vegetables. Although erythritol is classified as a sugar alcohol, erythritol does not cause the gastrointestinal issues associated with other polyols like xylitotl, malitol, and sorbitol.") However I've heard that some people can still have digestive upsets with ANY sugar alcohol so suggest you test it carefully. I did OK with it.So glad I found Dr. Zevia - I won't be drinking much of it because I'll stick mostly to water and carbonated water (and add Sweetleaf Stevia like root beer, grape, orange and vanilla creme to make soda-like flavors) for the healthiest options. But love love Dr. Zevia for when I need my Dr. Pepper fix.

column9: Would give it minus stars if I could...disgusting ack ew!
column10: I am from the south and grew up on Dr. Pepper. In wanting to break a near daily habit of 1-2 cans, I first switched to a cane sugar cola (to at least get off HFCS), then tried Dr. Zevia.Honestly I nearly vomited when I took the first sip of this stuff.The strongest taste is the clove, then a funky aftertaste that was just like cough syrup.I tentatively tried another sip - I couldn't detect any cherry, only clove and cough syrup.I tried a three more cans over a 1-month span (thinking maybe it was just the surprise of how NOT like Dr. Pepper it is), and same results.  Yuck.  Yuck.  Yuck.This doesn't taste anything remotely like Dr. Pepper, not even close, not even in the same universe.If you are a die-hard regular Dr. Pepper fan, you will most likely detest this product as much as I do.On the other hand, if you aren't looking for a DP sub, or are used to an aspartame drink, or like clove and cough syrup, then you might enjoy this product.
there is no after taste like other diet items. this hits the spot. i subscribed to it and still find myself order extra. great for kids. they love them and keeps them away from all the sugar.

Hats off to Zevia for making this Dr Pepper like soda. If you've never had Stevia sweetened soda before, it is a bit artificial tasting and Zevia puts less "sweet" in their sodas. If you are looking for something that tastes just like sugar, you will be disappointed, but at least it's natural. The taste is fairly close to the real Dr Pepper. Give it a try.

column9: Very good, but not exactly close to the original.
column10: While I enjoy the taste of Dr. Zevia for itself, the DH doesn't enjoy it at all.  (He was really hoping for something closer to the original.)  That and the fact that it is only available in cans is the reason that I'm giving it 3 stars.Neither of us thought that it has an unpleasant aftertaste, and it's not over-carbonated.  (Some sodas are so fizzy that it feels like you're drinking flavored foam.)  However, the reddish coloring stains like the blazes.  A few drops got on a light green table cloth, and even a stain stick didn't get it out.  Ugh.  Between the aluminum cans, the staining and the fact that I'm the only one who likes the taste, I probably won't be buying this often, if at all.

As a diabetic who likes soda, I mostly avoid sugary sodas.  Until a year ago, I drank the usual Aspartame-sweetened diet sodas; however, being analyzed by a naturopath and being told I was basically embalmed from the Aspartame (which turns to formaldehyde at 90 degrees), I had to quit ingesting Aspartame in any form.  The Dr. Zevia is a tasty substitute for the Dr. Pepper I used to drink.

I stopped drinking soda years ago, due to artificial everything (in regular and diet) and high fructose corn syrup (in regular).  I occasionally enjoyed an all natural soda that's sweetened with cane sugar, but it has too many calories to consume regularly.  Then I discovered Zevia.I first tried Dr. Zevia (although I'm not sure why, because I have HATED "Dr. Salt" since I was a kid).  LOVE IT!!  I still cannot believe that something this sweet and satisfying is zero calories.  Don't mind the caffeine boost to keep me going in the afternoon either.I also have tried Zevia Cola and Black Cherry, but Dr, Zevia is my absolute favorite.

column9: Dr. Zevia from Amazon is great!
column10: I really like Dr. Zevia natural diet soda.  I was trying to get away from caffeine.  And the little bit in the soda is just enough for me.  It has a good taste.

column9: Big fan & great for my diabetic mom
column10: I originally started buying Zevia a year ago for my diabetic mother - we actually did some glucose testing just after drinking a can and our glucose levels did not change so that was good to know. The flavors are good, especially Dr. Zevia. I recently was able to but the new flavors in Chicago (cream, grape and Mountain Zevia) - the grape was the best!Recently I switched our entire office to Zevia since I always felt bad buying sugared or chemicaled drinks for the company. At first a couple people were reluctant but now everyone is hooked.

Someone close to me let me try the black cherry Zevia, which I thought was really pretty good.  So, I sent for it and tried the Dr. Zevia also, since that is the type of soda I usually drink (famous brand).  It is a super alternative, much healthier and satisfying, to this pop addictive person.  Even the fizz is reasonably long lasting (very important!).
I bought these for my son who likes Dr. Pepper.  He didn't like these.  He didn't want me to get anymore Dr. Zevias.

I've tried 12 of the various Zevia sodas by buying the 24 can multi-flavor case.  I liked several of the flavors very much, but not Dr. Zevia.  I'm a big Dr. Pepper fan and Dr. Zevia isn't even close.  It was the worst of the 12 flavors I tried.  It tasted almost like a watered down cherry cough syrup and had a wicked aftertaste.  I won't buy it again.

column9: Love This Line of Products(!) But This One Needs Improvement
column10: Colas sweetened with stevia- truly a product which has come of age BUT this particular flavor leaves an aftertaste which is identical to cherry cough syrup- YUCK.  I have tried many of the flavors so far and you can see my reviews for them on each flavor- I strongly recommend the Grape (white grape used for flavor- yum) and the Root Beer is real good too- and the Cola and Black Cherry both get a thumbs up also.  But this one- NOPE.  Not sure where the positive reviews are coming from honestly...

I've tasted a large number of Dr Pepper imitators, and Dr. Zevia is by far the worst.I like Stevia sweeteners, you see, and I assumed Dr. Zevia would be delicious.Don't buy it, don't drink it. It tastes like chalky cherry cough syrup. I've only been able to drink it when mixed with Coca Cola or Dr Pepper, and that defeats the purpose of diet soda entirely, doesn't it?I'm not even willing to try the other Zevia flavors, I still have 17 cans of Dr Zevia I can't handle. Blech.

Bought some ginger ale and black cherry at my local Giant supermarket. Thought they were okay. My wife's favorite is orange which they didn't carry. I ordered a case on Amazon. It was an incredible disappointment. I can honestly say the worst beverage product we've ever tasted. We threw the 21 of the 24 cans we received. It was undrinkable.

I haven't had any of the other Zevias, but this tastes awful to me. I'm a regular diet drinker and I was pumped this product uses Stevia. But the smell is precisely like cough syrup and the taste isn't much better. I dropped in some vanilla sweet leaf and held my nose and it was tolerable. Wish I didn't buy the whole case.
Wow!  Obviously not healthy since I have to add 1 3/4 sticks of butter to make the crust, and time consuming to make since I had to grate 5 lime peels, but flavor made it totally worth the effort!

Had this for the first time and it was wonderful. The black currants are nice and tart and the walnuts add a great crunch to the whole thing.  I'm not that much of a cereal person but I could get hooked on this stuff!
good cereal.  taste is a bit strong for me (currants) but my husband and daughter absolutely love this and it is my husband's new favorite.

column9: Finally a "healthy" cereal with some TASTE!
column10: I know that Kashi makes an assortment of "good for you" cereals but, quite frankly, I just can't bring myself to eat many of them regularly because they taste like tree bark IMO. And Kashi foods in general *are* healthy but not recommended for someone trying to lose weight due to high amounts of fat, calorie, and carbs. For a VERY long time I've been trying to fine a cereal that A) tastes good, B) is low-fat, and C) has a good ratio of carbs-to-fiber-to protein. TRUST ME - this is more difficult than you would imagine because usually the *really good-for-you* cereals (health-wise) taste terrible but Kashi's black currant & walnut cereal is a WINNER for me!!!!!  EVEN MY DOG likes the teeny little oat clusters - LOL!First of all - I LOOOOVE the currants! The sweetened flakes are a wonderful balance to the tart currants and the walnuts and oat clusters add a nice crunch. I add almond slivers and flax seeds to my bowl as well and my tastebuds are singing with each bite!I'm also very keen on reading ingredients' labels on packages and even though the list on this product initially struck me as long (which usually translates into lots of preservatives via words I can't pronounce), I was pleasantly surprised that the ingredients total about 90% actual food products (natural sweeteners, fruits, grains, etc.) 5% vitamins, and 5% preservatives. That's really good for a wonderful as it tastes  :-)So, all in all, even though I am working on shedding about 50 lbs and need to really watch my fat, calorie, and carb intake, I can eat the recommended serving size of this cereal (1 cup) and not feel like I'm sabotaging my weight loss efforts because I easily burn the 200 calories in my morning workout and the 7g fiber/5g protein/3.5g fat per serving (these numbers are slightly elevated b/c I add my own nuts) are all still "safe" numbers. Sometimes I will even eat the cereal as a mid-morning or mid-afternoon snack if I chose to eat something different for breakfast. It's THAT yummy!!!!The only snag I might run into is trying to FIND this cereal. Right now, I've been lucky to buy it at Grocery Outlet for only $2.99/box but these stores typically don't stock "specialty" cereals on a regular basis. They just get a shipment of something in and when it's gone, it's gone. GRRRR!! So I'm going to go buy whatever stock they have left of this cereal and hope I don't have to buy it through Amazon and pay shipping. Sounds like Costco has it though so I might have to break down and buy a membership - just for the cereal. LOL!

Used to LOVE this cereal, now I don't trust them. Kelloggs took over Kashi. It seems that 'Natural' is not regulated by ANYONE! Even though there doesn't seem to be any GMO'd soy in here (list of ingredients), don't know where else they cut corners to make $$$$.

This is the first cereal I can honestly say I will always eat as long as they keep making it. The combination of the tart black currants with the walnuts and crunchy high fiber flakes....I don't know....it's just so good. It's a shame it's more expensive than most cereals, but it's delicious, nutritious, and worth it. Be aware that this box is slightly smaller than most standard cereals. I try to eat mostly paleo/high protein, but I always keep this around to satisfy my carb/sweet cravings. It's healthier than most options and it's delicious. Delivery was great and the expiration dates were 6+ months out.
Best cereal we have tasted that is good for you.  I have subscribed to it and got an even better price!!!
Ive been eating this for a number of years now. Love the whole grain. The black currants add a tarty flavor and the walnuts just complete the mix.
The best cereal ever, in fact.  Healthy and black currants are my fav. fruit.  Who knew they could be so good dried?  The only drawback is sticking to a serving, and I'm not even a cereal girl :)

column9: great cereal, not so good price
column10: This is a great tasting cereal.  It has a lasting crunch and the whole family loves it.  This price is not good at all.  You can find a larger size for a cheaper price at Costco.

I've been looking for a cereal like this for many years. It tastes great, stays crunchy in milk, and has just the right amounts of fruits(currents) and walnuts. In my opinion when a cereal shows walnuts on the box or lists them on the box, like many do, they should 'have walnuts' in the cereal. This one does and plenty of them. For the price ( walmart has it for $3.50 per box in my area) it has all the nuts you will want unless you just want nuts and no cereal. You don't need to "look" for the nuts to find them. It has taste, crunch, protein, fiber, the nuts provide omega 3s , and all this in a natural cereal that is economical as well. Kashi has many cereals that are good for you , but I was surprised to find this one is so good I probably eat too much of it .  The only thing which isn't top quality with this cereal is the box which is made of re-cycled cardboard. You can enjoy it and know you are helping the environment at the same time.PS: Amazon will undoubtely edit the name of the store I said had this for $3.50 per box in my area. It has "mart" in the name and it is written on the "wall" of the store. Wonder if they'll edit this too ??

This is an incredibly good cereal. I've never had currants before and was a bit suspicious, but they are seriously the bomb.I just make sure that I only get 1 currant per spoonful because they can be a little bit strong, but I'm a bit OCD anyways so you may not mind.Another thing I love about it is the flakes. They are thick unlike most crappy cereals so they aren't all soggy by the time you take your last bite(which is a sad moment).I found it at Grocery Outlet which was super cheap but I don't think they have it there anymore... I'm hesitant to pay $5 for a box of cereal but this one is totally worth it.

I'm not much of a cereal fan, but my wife and I bought a large box from Costco on a whim. Easily the best mass produced breakfast cereal I have ever had, unfortunately it's crazy expensive. The costco box was a good deal, but this is not (less cereal, more money). I'm not willing to pay over $6 a pound for cereal, but if that's not a problem for you I'd give it a try. So delicious

The item pictured may be the old, brown box, but the product delivered is the newly formulated Black Currant and Walnut cereal.  Hmmmm.  I wonder why they took out the added Vitamins and minerals?  And the ingredient list is not quite the same - and now seems to upset my tummy like the high protein 'Crunch' cereals do.  Not nearly as badly though....  Still.  It is the only cereal with black currants that I know of.  The real 'super fruit'.

I have been eating this cereal for about 2 years now and never tire of it.  I used to get it in my local grocery and then I had to get it in the Dallas area - 300 miles away.  Finally couldn't find it even there, so looked online and there is my cereal - wonderful to have it back again and auto-delivered no less!  I don't have to search and call stores to see if they have it and what their price is (some groceries in the Dallas area had it but charged about $2 more per box than the other Kashi cereals by listing it in the organic section).  I know that I can order early if needed so I never run out.  This cereal has a little sweetness and it has the crunch of the walnuts and the wonderful flavor of black currents - delicious with fruit and milk, or just milk or by the handful!
Have yet to try a Kashi cold cereal that wasn't good and this cereal is no exception Best suggestion to Kashi,is to put more of it in a bigger box,13 ounces is gone in a flash.
LOve the taste and crispiness of thie cereal... It has the black currants and walnuts for a great flavor and mouth feel.
This cereal has it all as far as I'm concerned- it's a box of yummy healthful crunch! Perfect for breakfast or a late night snack ;)
Liked it somewhat but a little bland, would have liked more walnuts and fruits.  We did like the non-sweetness which I always look for in cereal and other...

Great tasting healthy cereal.  I was not a cold cereal fan before Kasihi came out with U Cereal.  Now I have it twice a week with lots of fresh and/or frozen fruits.  No need to add extra sugar.  combined with Almond milk -- simply healthy and great tasting.
This a great breakfast cereal. The stores seem to have sopped selling it so it is very helpful to be able to find it on Amazon.

This cereal is so tasty and a nice break from the traditional flake stuff. It has a subtle berry flavor (but not a mock flavor one you get tired of), nice walnut pieces, and very balanced in the sweet/tart factor. It feels very hearty, balanced and filling, on top of being delicious. Does not feel bland or overly sugary. I love that the fruit in this is not another raisin filled box - currants and acai berries, tart and yummy, doesn't stick to your teeth. And NO high fructose corn syrup. This is by far my favorite cereal. I'll even grab handfuls as snacks. So glad I tried this. Whoever dreamed this up hit their target market right on, and I am eagerly anticipating other interesting flavors like this one down the road.

I've always been a fan of whole grain bread, but I've had problems in the past with finding a decent whole grain cereal.  Whole grains don't need to be boring, bland, dry, or like cardboard, and Kashi has a knack for proving this.  I've tried many, many Kashi products and am consistently pleased with this one.This particular cereal has an interesting and satisfying mix of tastes and textures.  The currants have a nice snap to them when you bite into them, and they are very tart.  I happen to adore black currant, but I can see how the taste might prove a bit too tart for some.  If you're expecting a sweet cereal, you should probably keep looking.There are some nice, sizable chunks of walnuts mixed into the cereal, and they provide extra crunch and a nice nutty flavor, which contrasts well with the mild sweetness of the flakes.On the cautionary side, this cereal packs a considerable number of calories in a pretty small quantity.  While it is certainly healthier than most of the junk you'll find in the grocery store cereal aisle, it is still worth noting that, if you don't pour carefully, you could end up with a breakfast of a hefty number of calories.I've checked the price of this cereal at a couple of different local stores, and it is considerably cheaper for to order it via Amazon.  I think the subscribe & save price is pretty much unbeatable.

I've tried so many whole grain cereals, I can't remember them all...to be honest many are best forgotten. Kashi U is easily the best of Kashi's many variants (and I really like several of Kashi's offerings). It is an interesting mixture of textures, but the black currants are the magic ingredient. The cool sweetness they bring to the party makes this a cereal standout. Add a little bit of Silk Light Vanilla soy milk and you are in breakfast bliss.
This cereal is simply delicious. I'm so glad Amazon carries it because I can no longer find it in my local grocery store.
This cereal is so unique and delicious.  Also makes great muffins!This is a favorite in our house.

column9: The very best cold cereal you can buy
column10: This has to be the best researched and best constructed cereal ever produced for the mass market. As other reviewers have said, all aspects of human health were addressed, it is very tasty with great textures. Ever since I bought my first box, the only time since then I ever buy other cereals is when U is not available. Even the box and the ink are cutting edge as far as environmental concerns. I feel good for hours after eating it, and heartily recommend it with Tempt original hemp milk for that much extra omega 3 and 6 (it tastes great with moo milk as well). The retail price when not on sale is about $4.99/box- expensive, but worth it. the bulk price is much better, and if you buy enough to get free shipping, it's a great deal.  Since U is such a wonderful product, you may not want to eat any other cereals, in which case a 4 pack will only last a couple of weeks...

Whole lot going on in this cereal. It is very tasty and just the right combination of ingredients to make it especially yummy. I love nuts in my food, any food and the walnuts in this cereal really make it pop.Thank you,EW

I am not a fan of kashi cereal as most taste like cardboard to me.  I love this cereal.  It tastes good, doesn't get soggy in milk.  I even eat it as a snack.  Very crunchy so quickly satisfies!  Received timely.  The boxes were not bent or crushed in any way.

We really enjoy this cereal. Not only does it taste great, but the ingredients are good for you too, particularly the black currants and walnuts.
