The black currents are real black currants and not raisins as some manufacturers attempt to pawn off.  I highly recommend this cereal for the flavor and the healthy ingredients.

This is one of those cereals where the "fruit" is a mix of 99% grain and chemicals, and 1% extracted fruit juice. If you want a really natural cereal, or one where the fruits don't taste disgusting, look elsewhere.
buy other brands this one isnt worth the money. Loaded with strawberries? What a joke there is more flavoring than berries in this mix and the mix quality is that of much cheaper brands
Anything less then $3.00 a bottle is good, here at Amazon, pay no tax or recycle deposit.  Received in a good box, no damage, fast,
While the large chunks gave my mill a little bit of hard time, the extra effort was worth it.  The flavor is superior and the slight bluish color is lovely.

I purchased this product because I thought it would be convenient to have on hand.  I live alone.  Each package makes six nice sized biscuits.  Water is the only ingredient to add.  What can be more simple?  I found I did need to add a little more water, but it may be because I live at a higher altitude.  The biscuits are light and taste great.  They do not even require butter, honey, or preserves.  They taste perfect all by themselves.  These are a nice accompaniment to a hot bowl of soup on a cold winter's night.

These packets are convenient and easy, a couple of spoons, 1/2 cup water mix and your are ready to go.  The honey butter taste is subtle, I usually like butter and jam on my biscuits but did not need any to supplement the flavor.I have used boxed bisquick for years, for whatever reason, these packets mix easier and are moister than using the standard bisquick recipie.

I was pleased to be able to order this Bisquick mix because the stores in our area no longer carry it.  We love these honey flavored bisquits, but will be hard pressed to use all 22 before the expiration date. I ordered them in the middle of March and they have a June expiration date. It would be good if the expiration date was longer or if it was given in the product description.

Ok, I left off one star because I'm annoyed with company that they don't sell in box anymore, only 'per use' packages. The product is great. Mixes easily, bakes quickly and tastes so good. I make dumplings in the stew also but the recipe is on the box, so I'm winging it...which is why I miss the box as my memory fades!
My family LOVES these and they are sometimes difficult to find.  They are also quick and easy.

column9: Tasty biscuits at a great price
column10: I was buying these regularly at my local market and until recently they stopped carrying the product. My family loves these and they are so fast and easy to make their a perfect addition to any meal. I bought two boxes of 22 packets which per unit came out cheaper than when the market had them on sale. They're a great buy!

Our local grocery store quit carrying these a couple of years ago.  My daughters were crushed.  I found them on Amazon in December and bought them a case for Christmas.  They were absolutely speechless.  I was a hero.  I hope Betty Crocker never quits making these.  I don't understand why the stores won't carry them.  We should all call distributors and make a stink.  Now, I wanted to order them from Amazon again and they're not available.  My daughter wants more of them for her birthday.  Please Amazon, get more of them.  Make my little girl happy.

This product is definatley true to the name complete...They turn out so melt in your mouth good that they don't even require butter!!!! They are simple to make and fool proof....Plus with the free shipping and no retail markups much cheaper than buying them at the grocery store. The case I got had a good experation date and I have no doubt that we will devoure them long before they expire.
I buy this in the store. It is very good. Wonderful flavor & easy to make. I like to make breakfast sandwiches out of these. A good quick item for your pantry. Highly recommend.

There are no stores in my area carrying this product any longer.  I am so very grateful that I can buy it through Amazon.  My son laughed when he came in and saw a box full of biscuit mix, but he was really glad that I was able to grab a handful and send them home with him.  This is a wonderful product and I love that I can get it in just a couple of days without having to run all over town just to find that none of the stores here carry it any longer.We love these biscuits and would be lost without them.

All you do is add water..mix + bake!  Has nuggets of honey in the mix but these do not come out overly sweet, very subtle.  Instant breakfast addition and I also bake them to add something different at dinner.  I use subscribe + save so get them cheaper and always have on hand.  Have tried the garlic/cheese, they're good too!

We have now ordered these twice through Amazon, because all of our local grocery stores have stopped carrying this flavor.  They are quick to mix up and the honey pieces make them naturally sweet.  No other topping needed.

We love this product at home and when we go in our RV.  It is quick, tasty and hits the spot.  We use it for breakfast, dinner or with soup.  My grandchildren love it.  I am a "from scratch" cook so to find something we really like in a easy package I am all for it.  I put the water directly into the package and  mix it in the pouch when we are in the RV.  Can it be any easier?It is hard to find this product in the market, so I just purchased a full case.  It was sent very quickly and arrived in a matter of days.  I will use the service again.Laurel

These things are very good. I make them in a toaster oven with convection setting and can cook 6 average sized biscuits with this mix in about 10 minutes. It's the perfect size and very quick. The flavor is excellent. I'm glad that I found them here and tried them. Thanks, Amazon.
These biscuits are so good.  We bought them a long time ago at the grocery store and then everyone stopped carrying them. When I saw Amazon had them, I had to order them.  We love them!!!

I bought these recently as a Friday special for a great price.  These came quickly and I have one bag open and the others hidden so I don't eat them all.  These are huge bags and the candy is nice and fresh.  Wish the peanut butter ones would come in bags like these and sold thru Amazon, not another seller who charges shipping.  Thanks for the good sale on these.

column9: Great Value for a LOT of M&Ms
column10: What can I say..Amazon does it again...A huge amount of M&M's for a very small price.What makes this a good deal as well is that they are all the individually wrapped M&M packages.These are a great size for snacks, desserts, etc. where you don't want to sit and eat 300 of them...

I loved this great purchase at less than ten bucks, and they're M&Ms!  What's to say about them?  If you haven't had them, go out and buy a pack, they're a fantastic candy!  I prefer the ones with almonds best, but considering how cheap the milk chocolate version was, I wasn't going to pass up a great deal like that!  Thanks Amazon, I will keep coming back!
I use these at work for treats, nice to get a larger sized bag at a decent price. No problems with the quality. They came packed in dry ice which was a pleasant surprise!
My favorite candy by far.  Just the right amount of chocolate and peanut.  I can eat a whole bag by myself.  And no, not the small package, the COSTCO sized ones!!  Yep I'm a huge fan :)

No need to review the product because I'm sure most people in the U.S. who are able to eat peanuts have had these.  These arrived fresh and in good condition.  I can't give even peanut M&Ms more than 4 stars since I think the chocolate used in these products keeps getting worse and worse over time; but they are still a fun, enjoyable snack.I ordered this along with a box of Snickers with Almonds, and Amazon included, as part of my Prime membership, a free "cold pack".This consisted of a very thick and sturdy Styrofoam lidded box, in which the candies were packed, along with four large cold-pack freezable units.The item was in shipping transit for approximately 3 days, and delivered to a hot, humid region.Upon opening the container, I found that the candies were still cold and in good condition, although the cold-packs were no longer frozen or really cold.Amazon did a great job on packing this.  Thought I would share that, in case others are concerned about ordering such products from this company.  I'm even keeping the Styrofoam chest and cold-packs for re-use, since they are of pretty nice quality.
Shipped quickly.  The candy was fresh and tasted great.  What more can I say?  I wish we bought more.  There

column9: they are a little bit too delicious for me!
column10: i had to order another 2 42 ounce bags today. the others i purchased at amazon did not last very long unfortunately. they are fresh. they are in a nice quality resealable bag to keep them fresh. they are delicious. watch for the lowest price. i am very happy with the freshness and quality of this product. it looks fresh and it smells fresh. i have ordered the 42 ounce size multiple times so far and i have no complaints.
This is a great products, kids love it.  Good for cooking!  If you buy them in the store they will cost you quite abit more for a single pack. 6 pack was a good deal.
Sent to my sister and she loved them!  Kind of costly but had free shipping which offset mailing cost to purchase and mail.

column9: What can you say about M&M's?
column10: Obviously if you're reading this you've probably already had M&M's - so don't let that stop you from buying this package!  I love the size of this bag because it fills a candy dish that I have out completely with a few left over for me to eat up right away.  They last for a while - though not as long as they should - in my house, but I'll keep ordering them as they are a delicious treat.

I was tired of getting bags of assorted chocolate candy that always had a variety no one would eat.  I love that amazon was selling this product and it came in "bulk".  I won't run out of the office candy again!  I went ahead and bought all of the favorite brands so I can keep everyone happy.

What can I say! I love peanuts M&M's. I love them more than the regular kinds. They're filling and tasty. I got one of those M&M gumball machines and filled it up with this. I just love them. Go M&M's!

column9: I received my M&Ms just fine.
column10: I ordered the 4 large bags. I received them in a timely manner and appreciated that they were shipped in a minimal amount of packaging. The four bags were simply shrink wrapped together and put in the box with my other items. I have only opened one bag so far but the M&M's were in great condition. Great price, delicious product, excellent service.Edit (10/01/10)- The price for these is now $35 more than when I bought them the first time. I can buy these for less than $10 a bag at the store. So the price is now closer to ridiculous then great.

A pair of these giant bags of your basic peanut M&M's sort of shrinkwrapped together, for the same price others are selling just one bag.  I took these as a gift for a friend in Italy who hadn't been able to find them there.  I had to pull one out of my suitcase to get it back under the weight requirements and put it in my carryon, no problems with either.  My friend was delighted when they arrived and began snacking happily away immediately.

A delicious candy in a hard, milk chocolate shell in different variety of colors at a very good price when available through Amazon including free shipping. Will be purchasing this again in any size as long as the price is right!

I received the package early, which was great. The candy packaging looked fine but I didn't discover the problem until I opened the bag. Half the bag of Peanut M&M's was cracked! I was really embarrassed to share them with anybody because the entire bagful was dusted with M&M debris. Not happy with this purchase at all.

First off, the initial arrival:  It came in a bigger box (since other things were ordered as well) when I opened it the 2 yellow bags set neatly and ready for me to eat!  Packaging, no other boxes or bags were used or necessary.  Review of the value: this is going to put it in perspective;1) The average size bags are about 1.69 ounces2) The larger size bags range from 9-11 ounces depending on which one as they make several.3) This bag was just over 42 ounces and they go up to 60 ounces in certain packaging.In theory you could go out and buy a bunch of the 1.69 ounce packages and to equal the total of about 84 ounces and at about $1 a bag you'd only buy about 48 bags at $.99 a bag it would be cheaper to go with these bags - however, the cost of this item was a little disappointing because I expected a little more in the bags.  Aside from a portion (probably 25% of the height) of the bag being air, I was just hoping for more M&M's.  Overall I give this purchase a C+ value as it was cheaper to buy this way.  But, as always beware of pricing for example another seller on Amazon charges $9.19 for the same bag (but you have to pay for shipping).  If you wanted to buy using Amazon Prime, like myself then you could get regular M&M's (no peanuts) for only $15.63 - about $10 less so that may be worth the savings.  An okay value - but at the end of the day it was cheaper than buying them individually. 73beats

This is my favorite candy of all time so glad Spangler sold the rights to the leaf company .I love them they are so yummy I waited a year for them to come back after they made the announcement .I will continue to order a case a month so I always have my favorite lollipop with me .

So I'd like to start off by saying that I am a huge fan of the original Nuvo (aka the "pink one"). It's very sweet, just the right intensity, everything. I'm not such a fan of this new flavor, however. I guess everyone's different. If you're expecting the signature sweetness of the original flavor, you might be a bit disappointed with the lemon sorbet flavor. I'm not sure but my guess would be that they decided to market this version to please the customers that didn't like the original's sweetness. In any case, you won't like it if you're looking for the sweetness like I was. However, if you're after a pretty strong drink that's kind of tart and maybe a little bitter, you'll like it. I understand why people may go for this one, but I personally won't be buying it again. I prefer the sweeter original flavor.

column9: i am still waiting for this item to be released!!! ughhhhhh
column10: this was due to be released this summer but has yet to reach the shelves whis is crappy!!! what are u waiting on???

column9: It's organic, but it changed my pie too much
column10: I used this organic pumpkin in a pie this week.  Normally, I use Libby pumpkin, but wanted to try organic this time.  I prefer Libby.  This organic pumpkin from Farmer's Market really changes a pie.First, the entire texture is different.  It isn't nearly as smooth, and it is a bit dry.  The other ingredients are the same, so I know it's the pumpkin changing my pie's turnout.The flavor is also different.  Oddly enough, it doesn't have as much pumpkin flavor!Honestly, it makes my home-made pumpkin pie taste more like a cheap store-bought.  Really not nearly as good as when I use Libby pumpkin.  I'm say to say this, as I really prefer organic products, but when it changes the texture and flavor this much, I cannot recommend it.  Too bad I still have another can.If you do end up purchasing some to try, I'd recommend adding just a little extra sugar to your pie to help enhance flavors.  Add a little more cinnamon, too.
This is the cheapest way to buy K-cups. The Milk Chocolate Cocoa is good and quick to make anytime of the year.

I purchased tea from Lana's because I'd been looking for a good flavored chocolate tea. This tea is superb! I also received free samples and the product is well packaged to ensure freshness.  This tea is delicious and I urge people to order from Lana's - there is a long list of tea flavors on her website!
I am more than pleased with this product.  I also appreciate the personal attention that the seller showed to me.  I will definitely be a repeat customer.

This is the crispest, cleanest ginger beer I have ever had.  It says "fantastically fiery" and it is.  Not too, overpoweringly, ginger-y, but definitely not the watered-down, sugary mess you get in every other ginger drink in the U.S.  Can I give it a sixth star?  Hands down, WORLD'S BEST.

If you've never tried ginger beer, it tastes a lot like a very intense ginger ale.  The ginger flavor is simply more pronounced than what you find in ginger ale.Barr's is not so sweet as some of the alternatives, which means you can drink it straight as well as mix it with vodka (Moscow Mule) or rum (Dark and Stormy).We bought a case to mix cocktails at a holiday party and it was a huge hit.  Locally, ginger beer sells for at least $12 for a six pack, so getting this product for less than $1 per can was great.  We'll buy Barr's from Amazon as often as we can.

Out of all the ginger beer's and ginger ale's I've had in my fairly long life I can honestly say that this is by far the best.  It truly is Fantastically Fiery, not too sweet and so refreshing and satisfying it fairly dances on your tongue.  I'm not sharing my case with ANYONE !!  Hope you get it in stock soon so I can order another case, the current one is going fast !!!

column9: Thanks Amazon...this has a Bold taste, a refreshing treat
column10: After trying many Ginger beers I found this product on Amazon and I'm hooked.  A bold ginger taste that soothes my addiction to ginger.  I'd recommend this product to any ginger enthusiast.  Delivered fast too!  Five stars

For me, this brand has just the right amount of zip without being too harsh.  We like it much much better than Goya.  The price was right, and with Prime it came with free shipping.  We are very happy with our purchase.

column9: Way to much sugar, horrible drink
column10: If they used a lot less sugar this might have been a good drink, however there is so much sugar in this drink that it tastes like ginger flavored  sugar syrup.Totally horrible drinking experience.46.5 grams of sugar!Over a ounce and a half of sugar and not a gram of salt to balance it out.This is not Ginger beer, it's sugar beer.If you want real ginger beer flavor, avoid Barr's Ginger beer.This will only disappoint you.There are much better brands available.D & G, Soda Ginger Beer, 12-once (24 Pack)
This was a perfect mixer for our favorite mixed cocktail!  There was just enough bite and sweetness in this ginger beer. Ginger ale just doesn't cut it for a great Moscow mule!

I love Gosling's but have trouble finding it, so hoped this would be a good replacement.  This is certainly better than ginger ale, but not as spicy as really good ginger beer.  It's just too sweet - almost like a syrup.

Pleasingly refreshing. This drink is the perfect answer to quenching one's thirst. When it's cocktail time mix it with vodka for a moscow mule. Either way It's delicious. With Amazon's speedy delivery I never run short of the product.

I had ginger beer for the first time on vacation in Australia. I enjoyed it very much, and was excited to find Amazon carried ginger beer. After reading reviews, I ordered Barr's and really enjoyed it. I found it to have a sufficiently strong, spicy ginger flavor. In contrast, the only ginger beer I have found in my neighborhood supermarket, Reeds Extra Ginger Beer, was quite disappointing. The ginger flavor was not as pronounced, and the lemon and lime flavoring detract from the ginger flavor. I mention this in case you have tried Reed's and enjoyed it, as Barr's may not be to your taste. I hope Amazon begins carrying the 24 case with prime shipping again, as I would like Barr's to become a regular treat.

column9: Good, middle of the road Ginger Beer!
column10: This is a good Ginger Beer.  The can speaks to it being "fiery".  Well, it had a little heat.  What I liked about the GB was that it was not overly sweet so it did not add to the flavours of the drinks I mixed it with.  I also tried Cock n Bull, which was considerably more fiery but a little too sweet for mixing although a great GB for a stand alone drink.  I liked the price and the flavour so I will order again.I am looking for the hottest GB.  So far Fever Tree Premium Ginger Beer has been the hottest.  Anyone have any other recommendations?
The beer is the best of three brands i have sampled.  The cans are 330 ml which is not 12 oz as the product description says.

Recently discovered Ginger Beer. It's just like ginger ale, but more spicy and gingery (to my tastebuds anyways). I picked this up because it sounded like it was "spicy" and was a good price, but I found it to be too sweet. 42 grams of sugar per serving . . .I like Fever-Tree Premium Ginger Beer, 6.8 Ounce Glass Bottles (Pack of 24) much better.

I had no idea what real pickling spice was until now.  Up to this point I had only purchased supermarket brands which pale in comparison.  The minute you see the bottle and open it to smell the spices inside you'll see what I mean.  My corned beef has never tasted so good!

If you like spicy snack food, this is it.  I love this product.  My favorite is the ketchup fries.  I tried the buffalo one and Wow!  Too hot, but good.  The regular ones are good.  My store will not stock up on these so I'm buying here.  These are REAL tasty.  Will buy again.  Also, they don't weight you down.  They are light and no trans fats.  Yum!

column9: One of the best snacks for those who like "hot fries"
column10: My son loves "hot fries".  These are a healthier alternative to Cheetos Baked Flamim' Hot Snacks.  My whole family will eat these.  Obviously they aren't as tasty as the unhealthy version.  However, they are a better alternative :)

Couldn't give these more than three stars. The smell turned me off. Smelt like old ketchup. Hard to explain. The texture was good, and the expiration date is well into 2012. Not something I really look forward to eating, but the flavor is ok. Just expected something different. If you have issues with smells, then you might not like these. Wished I had bought the Buffalo flavor. Won't repeat buy on the ketchup flavor.

My local store frequently runs out of these. They are very tasty, and, wheat-gluten free. My "Pack of 12" shipping/handling is about $7.80 (30.8% of the item cost) to a major US Metro area. As I ordered two boxes which Amazon decided needed to come from two different distribution centers, I'm paying this rather high shipping/handling fee twice! Amazon does do groceries - but at what shipping and handling cost?
These are very good and make a great gluten free and dairy free snack. We are always looking for snacks that are like normal snack and taste good. This one works out great!

So so so good.  Seriously addicting.  Have to disagree with the reviewers who said they were spicy.  I think they taste kind of sweet.  Super light and not filling.  Love them.I have never reviewed (what basically is) a potato chip before in my life.  I guess there is a first for everything.

column9: Too much like pringles, I didn't like them
column10: I tried the Classic baked fries with kethcup.  Had I read the ingredients first I would never have bought them.  They are made from potato flakes like pringles and I have never liked Pringles.  These tasted odd to me and we had a houseful of company and a bunch of children under age 6 and no one liked them.  I crushed them up and put them under the bird feeder and only the chipmunks would eat them.  Nothing wholesome or good about these.  Back to my delicious Cape Cod potato chips, I will never wander away from you again!
I am in love with the cheddar cheese fries.  They remind me of a long forgotten snack food of the 1980's, a spicy crunchy bag of fries, only without the spicy.  As other reviewers have said, "YUMMY!"

This review is for the Southwest Cheddar cheese fries by Snikiddy.  I've tried the regular Cheddar cheese ones as well, but that's a separate review.  I do have to say, the Southwest is much better than the regular flavor.Snikiddy is an all natural brand.  They use better, pronounceable ingredients.  Although there still is corn content.  They claim they are gluten free, vegetarian, no msg and even kosher.  This particular flavor has ramped up spices in its flavoring mix.  It even has white pepper, which is unusual for a snack food.  But good!  There's jalapeno powder too.  So you can definitely tell they took the Southwest aspect of this snack seriously.I really liked the taste of this snack. Unlike the regular cheddar, it had a tastier cheese flavor.  But wow, was it ever spicy.  My nose started running while I ate it because it was so spicy.  But even with the spicy, you could still taste the cheese.  The texture was still a little chewy while eating after the initial crunchiness, but with a better flavor it wasn't as bad.  The spiciness is a little much at times, but definitely worth it for the flavor.I really did enjoy this particular flavor of Snikiddy fries.  And considering there are limited flavors of Snikiddy snacks in my area I'm glad I liked at least one of the flavors.Review by M. Reynard 2012

I felt deeply motivated to say that I have to disagree with the reviewer who said these smell like old ketchup. I just didn't get that at all. To me, they smell like what they are. Disclaimer: I can't say I even know what old ketchup smells like. I'm kidding, but I do disagree and if I had read that review before trying, I may not have tried them.Anywho, found these at a local grocery store first. Took a chance on them and we were very surprised about how good they are, so I came here to buy them in bulk (quite a bit cheaper). They taste fresh and they don't leave me with a heavy feeling like the "andy capps" (or however you spell that) hot fries do. Super good snack and quite a bit heather than the others for sure. Every one we've shared them with ends up eating a bunch.
I was surprised that the bottles are large enough to hold a substantial amount of sauce, and everything you could possibly want is included! thanks
Great buy and great service. The product was exactly what I ordered. I would definitely buy from again when I have the chance.

column9: Coconut Chai Green Tea is the best!
column10: I have become addicted to Zhena's Gypsy Green Tea Coconut Chai! The flavors blend so well together, coconut, cinnamon, ginger, etc., is not overpowering and is so refreshing. I drink it every morning. I am sensitive to caffeine and the caffeine content is only 20 mg. I add a small amount of stevia or honey and a little fat free half and half, occasionally. DELICIOUS!

column9: A real treat for green tea lovers
column10: I learned about Zhena's Coconut Green Tea from, um, O Magazine.  I NEVER buy items recommended by magazines, since it is impossible to know whether something really IS good, or whether the recommender is simply making a bunch of money from the endorsement. But I love green tea and need to drink more of it because of its health benefits.  And yet, I find it a little... dull.So I indulged myself. And I am delighted that I did. Sometimes chai spices can be overwhelming. Those in Zhena's Coconut Green Tea (ginger, cinnamon, clove, cardamom, nutmeg, black pepper) are understated, smoothed out by the coconut. That the tea is organic and fair trade-certified seals the deal for me.I am going to stock up on Zhena's for Valentine's Day gifts, by the way, so don't buy it all!

My only complaint is that on the bottom of the package, the expiration date is 2001.  I don't think that's correct.  I made several cups of tea before I noticed it, and figured that since I hadn't had any adverse effects, either it was incorrect or it didn't matter.  It tastes refreshing and smells great! The combination of coconut and green tea is awesome!

This is the only green tea my husband will drink.  The spices are wonderful.  They cover the flavor of the green tea and make for a very aromatic cup.  My only complaint is that it is very expensive for the quantity. After buying these tea bags packaged in a can we bought the tea again in bulk packaged in a bag. It was much cheaper per pound to buy it in bulk.  I think with this product we mostly paid for the can not the small amount of tea inside.  At least it is a nice can and we have found a way to use it to store cat treats.
The giant gummi bear is awesome!!! My boyfriend loved it and said it was his favorite birthday present! And pineapple is the best flavor!!!
I bought this for my girlfriend on valentines day. she loved it! I got her the pineapple flavor, although it didn't look as cool as the others it tasted great.

This thing is huge! I got it for my fiance's birthday, and although i knew it would be big, i really was surprised with how big it really was. The hight and thickness is similar to a 2 liter bottle of soda. He loved it and thought it was the best thing ever! We all took a bite and it tasted just like the original small pinapple gummy bears. Its such a great gag gift and a great price to pay for all the smiles you will get!

column9: The Best Gluten Free Snack Ever!
column10: If you like pralines, you'll love these!  Only, they have less sugars and no butter in them.I was diagnosed with Celiac disease less than a year ago and used to feel very deprived of most of what I liked for snacks, until I discovered Oskri products.My first order of Pecan Cinnamon Crunch came this week and I like these the best of all the products. (They aren't low fat, though, so that's a differentissue.)  I don't feel deprived anymore when everyone else is eating their cookies or candy bars.

I agree with the previous reviewers heading!  This is the best gluten-free sweet treat I've had in a long time!!  I decided to order these, when they were the "deal of the day" (along with some other Oskri products).  The price was right ($10 for pack of 6), and the favorable lone review made the decision an easy one!Everything is of the perfect balance.  Not too sweet, or salty.  The cinnamon flavor is just right!  They're in softly formed square shapes.Nutrition Info:  There's said to be 4 servings in each 3.53oz bag.  The serving is 1/4 cup (25 g.)Calories per serving: 150 (calories from fat: 120)Total Fat: 14gSaturated Fat: 1gTrans Fat: 0gCholesterol: 0gSodium: 20 mgTotal Carbohydrate: 7gDietary Fiber: 2gSugars: 5gProtein: 2g**SEE COMMENT BELOW**

These are tasty POWDERED pecans.  Amazon fulfillment warehouses apparently have an even worse policy: ZERO PADDING in a box.To experience the "quality" of pecans I received place your pecans in a paint shaker for an hour.

The ingredients are great, the taste is great.  My only problem with this product is that there is more than one serving per bag, and I always eat the whole bag!I love the distinct texture which is only slightly crunchy, somewhat soft, somewhat chewy.  This product is heavy on the pecans and light on the honey, so if you don't care for the taste of honey, you might still like this.
Not crunchie and few pecans. Similar to Krispie Bars without the crisp.Soft,sticky,lacks flavor. Not what I expected at all.
This is the best "healthy" snack I've ever eaten. But be forewarned --- there are 600 calories in that little bag!

This snack is a great treat. But you must be mindful of the calories. There are 4 servings in each package. The snack is SO YUMMY, it is very tempting and easy to consume the whole package at once! The entire package contains more than 700 calories. I open each bag and divide it into 4 servings. This way, I can stay on my diet and enjoy this delightful treat without feeling guilty!

The name of the company is Oskri Organics.  Not everything they sell is organic, however.  These are an example.  Look for the USDA label to make sure.I think these taste fantastic and are very filling.  Its hard to finish the package.  My wife does not care for them, so your taste may vary as well.  If you like other Oskri products, chances are you will like these.  Read the ingredients.  If you like all of them, you should like these.

column9: I wasn't expecting raisins in the product
column10: I was really looking forward to having this little snack arrive.  However, when I tried it for the first time, I tasted an unexpected flavor.  After trying it a few times and then disecting it, I realized that there were raisins in it.  Unfortunately, no one in my family likes raisins.  After checking the list of ingredients on the website and the product package, there is no mention of raisins. Putting all of that aside, I think this product would be tasty to those of you who like raisins.  I must warn you that I think the presence of the raisins make this Pecan Honey Crunch more like Pecan Honey Chewy.Amazon's cutomer service was quick to respond and helped me fix the problem.  Thanks, Amazon!

As a distance runner finishing college, Gatorade can really hit the wallet hard. Luckily, I found NRC Sports on Amazon.com. It may seem like a lot to shell out for Gatorade at first, but when you realize you're getting Gatorade at $2.15 a gallon with shipping costs included, a smile begins to show.
Compared to the grocery store, its more than 50% off.  So what you have to mix it up, don't be a sissy. ;)

column4: John Abbott "I shoot people.  And they pay me...
column10: Good hydration that keeps in the fridge for a long time.I've had a cold for the past week, and it really helps to keep my electrolytes up.

I discovered this coffee (Columbia Supremo)at a friends house.  I love strong coffee, but dislike the bitter after taste of some of the popular expensive brands.  I drink about a pot per day and love this.  If you are a coffee lover, give it a try.
I love Flaming hot munches. They are my favourite kind of snack. I love the mix of doritos pretzels sunchips and cheetos . SO GOOD

column9: My Lucky Boy just loves this stuff!
column10: I believe this is one of the Milo products that is NOT made in China. If I am wrong, please let me know! But my guy loves it and it is the one treat he knows by name and asks for every day. It's the one that gets him in his crate when I have to go shopping. It's the one he will roll over and beg for. No adverse reaction (unlike some of the other treats we have tried, including chicken jerky and sweet potato duck ones made in China which give him the runs). This one appears to be quite healthy for him and his poops are normal tootsie roll poops. So we are hooked!

These are okay for a mass produced product frim a factory.  Nothing spectacular.Ordered direct from the company's web site. Faced w/ 3 confusing choices: ship & deliver ASAP, ship whenever, deliver in time for Christmas. I chose the first thinking it was the fastest. My items were not delivered until 12/27. When I contacted Swiss Colony, they said, "Too bad."Next time I'll get real petit fours shipped from an actual bakery.

These cakes are fairly exploding with flavor and the kids love making charts depicting which flavors can be found under the robes of confection.  We order these at nearly every special occasion.  One warning that merited knocking a star off is that there are invariably four or five within the box that are hard and dry within.  That's not very nice when serving these to guests and there is no way to tell just by looking at it.Also, my last batch had one whole flavor (the chocolate-robed with green diagonal stripes) where every one of them was dry.  It only happened once and my family loves these too much to knock it down another star for that.
The Petits Fours were excellent, moist and beautifully decorated. Great desert for a holiday buffet.  They also make a great hostess gift.
These Petits Fours have become a holiday tradition.  For at least five years, my now-seven-year-old granddaughter has looked forward to selecting a "cakey" after dinner.  (:
I sent Swiss Colony's petits Fours as a gift to my cousin and she loved them (as I knew she would).

We've started replacing the white flour in our diet with whole grain barley flour as it tastes better than whole wheat.  And at Amazon, we save almost a buck a bag getting in as a subscription delivery.  Christmas cookies this year are going to be HEALTHFUL this year.....but shhhh,  don't tell anyone  :)
Great flour, its packaged individually and makes it nice to store, the bread I have made with it tasted great, very happy with this flour.

I ordered what I thought was pictured and described but instead received the Gluten Free version. Not thrilled. Also the bags are so beat up they are about to fall apart.  Who's filling these orders...Return, return return.....

"The Food and Drug Administration (FDA) is again cautioning consumers that chicken jerky products for dogs (also sold as chicken tenders, strips or treats) may be associated with illness in dogs. In the last 12 months, FDA has seen an increase in the number of complaints it received of dog illnesses associated with consumption of chicken jerky products imported from China. These complaints have been reported to FDA by dog owners and veterinarians."

column9: Good Taste and Texture if you handle the gas
column10: As other reviews have commented, this is great alternative in terms of taste and texture to sugared licorice candy.  However, eating more than a small quantity will cause lower tract distress from mild gas to mover severe symptoms.  So, if your system doesn't react badly, this is a good choice for the licorice lover.  My rating of 4 out of 5 stars is based on these effects.

column9: Satisfy your licorice craving without sugar.
column10: The individual boxes are tiny, and these pastilles aren't big either -- but they definitely taste of licorice. And they have the right sort of hard gummy texture that I associate with licorice. I've been dieting lately, and one or two or these definitely satisfies the sweets craving. You can eat 7 pieces and and only ingest 5 calories.I also keep them in the car when I'm on a long drive. Delicious and guiltfree.
As a person who is forever counting calories, these are a great little treat for any black licorice lover. And for 7 pieces it's only 5 calories! Been hooked ever since I tasted them.
If you can handle the sorbitol, these are great little licorices. The flavor is great, they melt at a reasonable rate, and they have no sugar.

column9: LOVE LOVE LOVE THESE!  (edited because NO longer available in prime)
column10: Perfect...just a little something sweet to keep you going...no aftertaste of any kind.  (Because of the reviews, just ordered the berry and orange...can't wait to try those, too.)  Great tasting sugar free candy is not always easy to find...this one hits a home run.  And as a bonus, the box is adorable..easy to pop in your purse. :)***************************No longer available in prime so that takes care of that item.  Nice going Amazon or whomever is responsible. Let me know when the shipping is not off the charts.

A sugar free licorice with the real taste of licorice.  These are hard to find as are the Jols forest berries - I'm happy to know Amazon carries them.Daprano & Co Licorette Sugar Free Hard Candy, 0.88-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12)
Excellent chewy full flavored licorice that satisfies my food cravings, without adding hardly any calories! yum!  yum!  yum!  yum!  yum!
I love the Licorette Sugar Free Candy.... The best part about it is you feel like your cheating because its so delicious, but your not!!! The whole box is 35 calories.

column9: Great SUGAR FREE Licorice Hard Candy
column10: I enjoyed the old fashioned licorice taste in this sugar free hard candy. It doesn't seem to have the nasty side effects that other sugar free candies can exhibit.

Licorettes are guilt-free and delicious pastilles, full of flavor and chewy goodness.  Only 25 calories for the entire box.  it's not the cheapest alternative, but for weight-conscious licorice-lovers, or even casual fans, it's a terrific choice.

column9: Little Sugar-Free Candies with BIG Licorice Flavor
column10: I'm hooked on these little sugar-free licorice candies!  As a diabetic, I'm always looking for something with a real black licorice flavor; these have that AND the texture of those old-time licorice buttons we used to go crazy for at my aunt's house as children.  No after-taste like a lot of artificially sweetened stuff, either.  YUM!!
Tried Licorette once and have been hooked ever since. Also anyone who tries it also asks me to buy them some. Nice tasting candy, I recommend this product to all.

column9: Sugar free and full of flavor
column10: These are great little candies that are sugar free and satisfy your black licorice craving.  They are good for work b/c you can put one in your mouth like a mint and it lasts for awhile.  Very flavorful with a true black licorice taste and no weird sugar free aftertaste!

column9: Nice licorice taste, but beware of it containing Acesulfame K and "Artificial Sweetenet"
column10: I love the black licorice flavor and am thankful for a sugar free option (there are so few and no candies I've found that contain what I consider to be the only safe sugar-free option, stevia); but I wish all websites would list all ingredients so you know before purchase in case you're sensitive or wish to avoid a substance.  This does contain Acesulfame Potassium (K), which I would rather it didn't since it stimulates insulin secretion in a dose dependent fashion thereby possibly aggravating reactive hypoglycemia ("low blood sugar attacks"), which I experience at times.  Because of this I only consume at most 1 pastille every other day, partly to prevent developing a sensitivity to anything in it.  It also lists "Artificial Sweetenet", which I would like to know what that is. Would I have purchased this/purchase again with full disclosure"? - I'm not sure at this point.

I love these.  They have a great licorice taste.  There is only 1 problem....I eat them too fast because I like them so much.  If you like black licorice, don't hesitate to buy.  You will like these.  The low calorie aspect is just a bonus!

I love these little licorice candies, and have a hard time finding them anywhere.  They are small, and not too strong like some licorice lozenges.  I was glad to find them on Amazon, and for a reasonable price.

column9: I Can't Believe It's Sugar Free
column10: My father is Diabetic and enjoys licorice.  He has always been finicky about "sugar free" sweeteners.  He believes that he has discriminating taste and does not like the aftertaste that often accompanies sugar free products.  I gave him some, one day and neglected to mention that it was sugar free.  He loved it and asked for more. I bought him a box through Amazon and he is like a little boy in a candy shop. If you like black licorice but are concerned about the sugar- this is the candy for you.
These are yummy!  But don't eat more than 1 box a day as they can cause diarhea from the sorbitol in them.
We like these Sugar Free Licorice candies. They are small and strong with good licroice flavor. Small box fits in your pocket or purse easily.

These bars were soft and not too sweet.  The blackberry center actually tasted like blackberries and not that fake, super sweet, not-real-fruit taste.  The graham crust compliments the blackberries.  The wrappers keep the bars moist so they travel well.  They are small but filling and a great snack or part of a breakfast at just 110 calories each.  I will buy these again.

I am not always sold on Kashi products because some just taste a little too healthy for me (even though I do like to eat healthy).  This bar is delicious however.  It is comparable to nutri grain bars but is actually good for you.  The blackberry center is so good, yum.

I purchased these for my grandsons, but had to try one for myself.  They are delicious!  The texture is like a soft textured oatmeal cookie.  I loved the taste of the fruit, too.  It was not too sweet, almost like homemade preserves. The size is just right for a child's snack.  They have whole grains and 3g. of fiber, a healthy addition to anyone's diet.ps.  the kids loved them too!

I bought the exact same product in the supermarket for a third of the price. I mistakenly thought I was getting more than I could get in the store. My family and I love the flavor but with the cost of shipping we will not be ordering this again.
Just didn't like these - seemed like a cookie (fig newton, but blueberry) with jam in it.  Wish I could find someone that liked them so I could ditch them.

column9: Used to be perfect, now just good
column10: I used to love these, with my only complaint being that they were a tad on the dry side. Unfortunately, they changed the recipe last year and now they are just a little better than other cereal bars. The main changes in the ingredients list seem to be that they changed the proportions and no longer include sesame seeds. The changes seem minor, but the taste is noticably worse (I wouldn't have bothered checking the ingredients if I hadn't notice the different taste). Oh, the calorie count also went up from 110 to 130.

Caveat: I'm pregnant, and I bought these to head off nausea when I get hungry (which occurs about every 90 minutes). I don't have too many food aversions, just HAVE to eat, so I'm pretty sure that this is not just being pregnant, but it could be my taste is off. Having to eat so much, I really wanted to get something which wasn't QUITE so bad in terms of corn syrup, additives, etc., but I may have to go back to Nutri-grain bars, which I know I like the taste of. The filling on these was good, but the graham surroundings just tasted weird to me. The texture of the crust was also slightly off. I force myself to eat these on occasion as long as my stomach isn't heaving, but I wish I had bought a single box in the store to make sure I liked them before buying a lot off Amazon (though at the time, I didn't feel like going to the store at all). If you are at all picky, you might want to do the same.

I have been fan of Cereal Bar and eating them on daily bases, this Cereal Bar is very small compare to other product I use from different companies but taste is good, I wouldn't say Best taste but good and price is little high compare to product's taste, size and quantity.

Kashi's SOFT-BAKED cereal bars have a very good texture and flavor in a soft shell that is better than most others in almost every way. I have one of these every morning on my way to work (along with their many other varieties). If you're like me and you like soft cereal bars you won't be disappointed.
I usually love Kashi products but this one caught me off guard.  They have a nice flavor but they are kind of dry and pasty.  Very hard to eat without having a drink nearby.

column9: Yummy bars- but not as flavorful as other Kashi bars
column10: Let me just say- we are a "bar family". It is one of the first snacks my kids, and even my husband grabs when in a rush...so we've pretty much tried them all. As stated in my review of the Kashi apple cereal bars- this brand offers something that is truly hard to find in a cereal or snack bar- nutrition. I tried the blackberry bars for me- since I LOVE blackberries. After reading the reviews, I am surprised at the low level of flavor in the bars. The apple bars are MUCH more flavorful, but I don't love apple bars as much...so even though I'm not as excited about the blackberry ones, they are still good for me as a healthy snack option, and they do still taste good. Just don't be surprised like I was when you take your first bite.

What made me by this was the fact that it had 9g of sugar in each bar. A lot of bars nowadays, even protein bars, have an insane amount of sugar.Anyway, these taste like Nutrigrain bars, which I use to love. Then I learned about High Fructose Corn Syrup and after years of eating Nutrigrain bars from Kelloggs, I read the ingredients (I'm 20, started to look at the things I ate) and I couldn't believe it had HFCS.Then Kashi came around with their health foods and while they are really expensive, I think this is a good deal on amazon.36 bars for 15 or 17 dollars is pretty good.It's also a great snack for those who want to lose weight, when it comes to calories. It isn't a good significant source of protein or anything else. Just a healthy snack.

We thoroughly enjoyed these bars.  These were a good deal on amazon; they work out to about 50 cents a bar, which is cheaper than I would pay for a nutri-grain bar at work, but more healthy, and just as delicious, and maybe even more filling!  I would sometimes eat two within a short span, although one is filling enough.  I did start to get sick of these when I was close to finishing the pack of 36 bars, but I wasn't quite sick of them, and could see eating more of the same flavor after a short break.  I will try another flavor next and see how they match up, although I would imagine all the flavors to be equally tasty.

These are a perfect breakfast on the run or anytime snack. Tasty and filling! But I got them at Kroger for $3.00 per box, so this is a bit expensive, even with free shipping. Check your local stores first, but don't hesitate to try them. I'm not a big blackberry fan, but it is mild, not too sweet or tart and the graham crust is very flavorful, if you like Graham Crackers, you will like these.

I found these in a local grocery story and wanted to try them before buying a larger quantity here. They were extremely dry so I checked the 'best by' date which was 5 months out so I don't think they were stale. But I needed liquid just to wash this bar down.
Sent these to my elderly mother and she just loved them.It is a  true fruit flavor and not to sweet just a great bar.

column9: Great reasonably healthy option for breakfast
column10: These have excellent flavor.  The blackberry bars are actually better than the strawberry ones.  The strawberry are good too, they are just a bit drier.  We used to really like the Fiber 1 pastries for the kids in the morning.  They had some fiber and tasted much better than regular pop tarts.  Well the Fiber 1 pastries aren't made any more so we've been searching for something else.  We tried some organic/fiber pastries but they were way too dry.  These are finally a good replacement.  I use these to give the kids something eat while I'm getting ready for work.  It does the trick until mom gets up and makes them breakfast.And life doesn't get much easier than Amazon's subscribe & save!
MY HUSBAND LOVES THESE CEREAL BARS.  THEY ARE EASILY EATEN IN THE CAR ON HIS WAY TO WORK, THEY TASTE GOOD AND THEY ARE LOW IN SUGAR.  I KEEP A JAR FULL OF THEM FOR HIM.

I really like these bars.  So far they're the only breakfast bar that I've found that actually keeps me full till lunch.  Other things I eat for breakfast tend to leave me looking for a snack around 10:30. Only downside is they make some crumbs...
Excellent price for a nice product.  Kashi is a trusted brand for us and I haven't seen a retail store offer a price this good.  We get a shipment each month and its a relief when they arrive.

column9: Perfect for toddlers on the go
column10: My 3-yr-old hates to sit at the table and eat breakfast, she always wants to take a snack in a cup and run around.  Most days, she would rather go without breakfast than sit down and eat.  I finally compromised and got her some Kashi cereal bars that she could eat on the go.  I was so pleased to find something with whole grains, real fruit and no high fructose corn syrup that I could give her.  She loves them, I love that she eats them and they are better for her than other bars on the market.  I wish they had more flavors than the three I'm always buying, I would purchase more to give her more variety!

column9: Perfect for mom and her little guy!
column10: These are delicious and a perfect on-the-go snack for me and my little boy. I love the texture -- a little firm around the edges and soft in the middle -- and the filling is sweet, but not overpowering. I've compared the nutritional facts with a few popular organic or specialty-kids' fruit bars, and these have less sugar (and no high fructose corn syrup) and more fiber. Of course, it's still processed food, but overall, it's pretty healthy, tastes great, and is an affordable quick snack.

Kashi does it again with a snack or breakfast that tastes great and healthy at the same time. You know it's healthy because it's KASHI!!! I receive this on Subscribe and Save. Every time it's the same highest quality.

I am an ER nurse, and I often don't get time to eat lunch at work. So I keep a stash of these in my locker, so that I can grab one if my blood sugar starts to get low. Not only are they delicious; moist and very flavorful, they also have nothing artificial in them and give me 3 grams of fiber. I highly recommend them!

I have not tried any of the other Kashi cereal bars and it may be awhile before I do as I absolutely love the blackberry taste!  I like to eat them as a quick breakfast/snack.  The only thing is if you eat it without drinking anything it gets kind of dry after a while (but cereal bars are generally like this so I can't give it a bad rating)!

I didn't eat these,because I am not a fan of Blackberry,but I bought these for my VERY picky husband as a healthy snack.He loves them.He wants me to have them in the house all the time now.I am a big fan of Kashi anyway!They are an awesome company that makes great food!
These dudes taste great. Excellent way to get your daily intake of fruits. Who knew health food could taste so good?
These are very good.  Not too sweet like most "fig newton" type bars and not gritty like some high fiber or high protein bars.  We eat them for afterschool snacks or breakfast on the run.

column9: Great Snack Bars for Weight Watchers!
column10: I love these bars! If you are on WW, they are only 2 points. They are much largers than the WW 2pt. bars and very filling. You could treat them as a snack or meal replacement. My local grocery is no longer carrying these bars as a result, I made my purchase through Amazon at a great price. I was paying a dollar or more for individual bars. The chocolate peanut is fabulous. Can easily curb your craving for a Snickers! I was also pleased with how fresh they were.

I bought these bars because I never eat breakfast.  I hate eggs, don't like most cereals, etc.  I know breakfast is important so I decided to try these.  They taste okay, leave a gritty aftertaste.  With these particular ones I can taste the chocolate but it's lacking in the peanut butter taste.  I will definitely keep eating them though because they do work.  I had one for breakfast two days in a row and did not find myself feeling hungry until it was lunch time.  On the third day I decided to try a bowl of cereal (Cheerios to be exact) because it was convenient.  An hour after I ate the cereal I felt as if I was starving.  Thank goodness I had an apple with me because I devoured it but was still hungry!  Obviously the cereal did not satisfy me the way the bars did.  I will keep eating them and am curious about trying the protein shakes.

Great product! These snack bars total only 110 calories and keep you full till your next meal. The first time I tried these, I found it difficult to believe I wasn't eating candy. If you're trying to lose weight or if you just want a healthier alternative to your daily candy fix, this is the item for you.
I love these bars. It is hard to believe that they are good for you. Having chocolate and peanut butter. How much better can life be?

column9: Excellent Taste-but not really a meal
column10: A great treat for between meal snacks.  The protein makes it filling, and the flavor cures the craving.  The only think keeping it from being a 5 star treat is the fact that it advertises itself as a meal replacement.  Not quite filling enough for me.

When we came across this product, we were looking for a quick and easy way for my teenage runner to get her protein while on the go.  She had told us she was feeling tired but didnt' understand why as she was eating her carbs.  When we sat down and looked at her diet, there was little to no protein.  These protein bars do the trick.  She can put them in her purse or backpack and off she goes.  They don't take long to eat and taste good.  My son also takes them with him if he is going to have after school practice.

column9: Great meal bars for chocolate lovers
column10: I purchased these to enjoy for breakfast or lunch on days when I'm really in a rush. So far, they've definitely filled that spot. I've found that if I eat one for breakfast, I am hungry by lunchtime, but not overly so. If I eat one for lunch at around 1pm, I am generally very hungry after 5pm.They are a good size, not overly chocolaty, and the peanut butter isn't overpowering at all, it's almost subtle. The bsr doesn't stick to your mouth, it's easy to eat, and it has a nice texture, not too hard. Plus the slight crunchiness from the rice parts kind of reminds me a bit of a candy bar.
Seriously, these bars are like eating candy - these really are the best of the available flavors!  I normally eat one of these each morning and they keep me full until lunch.

I prefer these Special K bars over candy bars, because being almost 50 I have to closely monitor my weight.  Obesity is a serious health problem in this country, besides being unsightly, it is unhealthy for all parts of the body, and I need healthful snacks like these to keep my hunger cravings at bay. I know cynics say they are no better for you than candy bars, but what do they know?  One candy bar has almost 55% of one day's(!) portion of fat, whereas the special K bars are substantially less, because they cynics are not working at the Special K factory.  I think they are overpriced, however, I will not pay $1.00 for them, but when they go on sale for $4.00 then I will get a box of six.  I find they taste great and they are not too hard, and I will absolutely not buy any snack bar that doesn't have a little 'give' when I press down with my thumb.  I don't want to eat any snack bar that is harder than my teeth, and the Special K bars are a nice filler between meals.  Any flavor is good.
These bars are very good. I eat one for breakfast every morning. I have tried all the slim fast bars and most of the special k bars and this is the only one that doesn't have a yucky aftertaste.

column9: Chocolate Peanut Butter are the best!
column10: Keeping in mind that a meal bar is supposed to be a "meal", I find these perfect for my busy mornings.  I can eat one for breakfast, take the kids to school and hit the gym.  I can usually go up to 4 hours before feeling hungry again.  These bars are very tasty and chewy and I don't find any aftertaste to them. As with any food, when eaten sensibly and as directed, these can be a great assist in efforts to satisfy appetites and cravings.

column9: Better than a regular granola bar

The only "complaint" I have is that they aren't available in more flavors.  A little spendy, but ounce for ounce probably about the same price as any other similar bar.

column9: great tasting and good source of fiber
column10: these are great and fill you up, great for me as I do over night and up at 6am and not off until 8am, so now I don't have to go hungry until I get home, these hold off the hunger until noon.

My dogs are somewhat choosey eaters.  After my fiance did much research, we found that this was one of the top tier dog foods.  My dogs seem to eat it with no problems. With salmon in dog food...they're eating healthier than I am, who can complain?

column9: Dog likes it and ingredients look fine to me.

Great with dunkin donuts ground coffee- i prefer it to the plain cream now. easy storage and no hassle as compared to powdered creamers that make a mess!

column9: Whether you call it Rooster Sauce or Thai Ketchup, it is a condiment you won't put down
column10: Andrew Knowlton, restaurant editor at Bon Appétit magazine, predicts sriracha will be one of the biggest food trends of 2010!Knowlton was a guest on the CBS Early Show and shared, "If you walk into any chef's kitchen or home, you will find sriarcha. Sriracha is a hot sauce with flavor -- it livens up every dish you put it on."Once only found on Thai or Vietnamese restaurant tables, a bottle of Sriracha (sree-RAH-cha) Hot Chili Sauce is now a telltale sign of a great eatery, whether it is on a sidewalk hot dog stand, a family hamburger joint or my favorite Asian restaurant.Last year, New York Journal News reporter Kara Newman provided some background about the condiment nicknamed "Thai ketchup." Here's an excerpt:[[The two most commonly-found brands are Huy Fong, which sports a white rooster on the label, and Shark. (Supposedly, the shark is in homage to the shark-infested waters off the coast of Sriracha). Shark brand is made in Thailand and is used widely there as well as imported to U.S. stores and restaurants. Huy Fong is made in California by a Vietnamese immigrant, David Tran, and is the U.S. favorite.]]Sriracha is made of sun ripened chilies that are ground into a smooth paste with garlic. The sauce is nearly as thick as ketchup, which makes the squeeze bottle a handy way to deliver a spicy kick to your favorite foods. Speaking of ketchup, a little sriracha can add a nice kick to ketchup or your favorite dipping sauce without overpowering the other ingredients.Newman's story featured recipes were adapted from Greg Gilbert, Jackson & Wheeler.Sriracha Remoulade1 cup mayonnaise1/4 cup sriracha2 tablespoons red wine vinegarWhisk together until smooth. Serve as a dipping sauce with fried calamari rings.Fried Calamari1/2 cup calamari1 cup milk1 cup flour1/2 cup semolinaVegetable oil for fryingSalt and pepperSoak calamari rings in milk for about 20 minutes; drain.In a bowl, combine the flour and semolina. Dredge the calamari in the flour mixture, and shake off the excess. Heat the oil to 350 degrees, and fry the calamari until golden brown. Season with salt and pepper and serve with Sriracha Remoulade.Sriracha Spicy Buffalo Wings6 chicken wingsOil for frying3 tablespoons Frank's Red Hot Sauce1 tablespoons sriracha1 tablespoons butter, softenedBaby mache or other lettuce to garnishFry the chicken wings until crispy. In a bowl, combine the red-hot sauce, sriracha, and butter. Toss the wings in the sauce and serve. Garnish with baby mache or other lettuce.In summary, I grew up with pepper, salt and Tabasco pepper sauce on the table for breakfast, lunch and dinner. Did sriracha replace my bottle of Tabasco? Yes. Sriracha is hotter but with a light, sweet finish that sets it apart from the vinegar tang of other pepper sauces.Rating: Five stars

I first discovered this sauce as the "secret ingredient" from my favorite restuarant's hot wing recipe, they called it Rooster Sauce because of the Rooster on the label.  I now use in my hot wing sauce recipe.  I often use it as a condiment for just about everything from eggs, spice up thousand island dressing to pad thai noodles.

I love Sriracha Chilli Sauce because it goes with everything you want to add a little spice too. One of my favorite dishes is adding it to a chicken salad. HMMMMM! Add to meat before placing other ingredients to salad. I usually chop the chicken and add some Sriracha and place in fridge for a hour or two before actually making the salad. I've always received rave praise from guest concerning this simple dish. My 12 yo uses it with everything, forcing me to keep a spare bottle in the pantry. I purchased it from Kroger, so I am sure other store have it also, Check the Asian Food Section ...

column9: I don't understand what this means

column10: This drink mix is refreshing and not over-the-top sweet. I use it sometimes as a meal replacement (I hate eating breakfast) and drink it especially after working out.Most of us don't drink enough water and almost everyone needs to get more fiber in their diet. I use it pretty much every day and I've found it does take the edge off my hunger.

I tried the powder mix but it doesn't completely dissolve and leaves a grainy taste in your mouth and in my job I don't have many places to stop and mix the powder in the water. column9: Some Dogs love them; Owners question
column10: Two little Yorkies basically love these little chicken wrapped biscuits.  Each morning each one gets 2 of them and they start the process of enjoying them.  Then after a few minutes they finish with a nice little mess.  I do not understand but near the end of the process they either just get tired of eating them or do not like them or they are suggesting that they want to share the leftovers with us.  Regardless, we always have a few pieces on the floor that have to be vacuumed.  No big deal, however. I would love to have a return of all the money we have spent on other treats that did not make it to the eating condition.  Yorkies are blatantly picky (or at least these ones) and it's one sniff and eaten or gone to the neighbor's dogs.  Maybe that's where the expression "gone to the dogs" originates.  If you buy food and do not like it then give it to the dogs.  Bottom line:  great for us, love the little plastic container and they love the treats.  We'll be back for more.

However, I gave it only three stars because I strongly object to the ad's omission of the fact that Labrada Nutrition's Lean Body contains sucralose.Sucralose replaced aspartane---which from its invention at Searle was known to damage brain cells---as the no-calorie sweetner of over whelming choice by food packagers.Regrettably, sucralose is known to kill off our probiotics, the bacteria that enable food's digestion!We all have the right to take our chances. Nevertheless, the vendors of products that they encourage us to eat have the duty to inform of what those chances are.

This product is the best meal replacement drink I have seen to date.  I keep waiting for other products to catch up to them, but so far they haven't.The main difference between this meal replacement and other meal replacement products I've seen is in the carbohydrates they provide.  Most other meal replacements I've seen either use sugars or maltodextrin as their main carbohydrate.  The problem with this is that they have a high glycemic index.  This means that when you eat them, your blood sugar rapidly rises and your body responds by making a lot of insulin.  Then in a very short time, your blood sugar is low and you have no energy and are hungry again.  This product is low sugar and no maltodextrin which is great.  Hopefully it has a low glycemic index.The oil blend is this product looks to be good.  They don't report the exact percentages of omega 3, 6 and 9 fatty acids but they do contain omega fatty acids.As for the protein, it's a blended protein that's 40 grams per serving.In my opinion, the taste of these products is great, but that's only an opinion.  Concerning the nutritional value of this product, everything I've said here is easy to validate with a little research.The only downfall of this product is the cost.  It's a lot cheaper to just blend protein powder, oatmeal and Udo's oil in a blender, but that obviously isn't nearly as convienent.  All in all, this is a great product, but be sure to shop around because the price can vary greatly.

Jack Mackerels are like big herrings, better known as sardines. They are headless and tailless, and they measure about the length of the can (perhaps by design).I saw a review in the listing for the Chicken of the Sea, Mackerel, 15-Ounce Cans (Pack of 24) that said something like they were God-awful or whatever. That's obviously a subjective POV, but I personally couldn't disagree more. THEY'RE SARDINES. Someone was bound and determined to get people not to eat these fish for whatever agenda. Personally I don't distinguish them taste-wise FROM sardines or herrings; they're just about twice or 3x the size. If you like sardines, you'll like jack mackerel.How to fix them? I like to open the can and dump them into a colander to drain away the salt brine they are preserved in. I do that with any canned good. Once out of the can, I like to bone them and put them in containers such as GladWare Deep Dish Containers with Lids, 8 Cups (64 oz) 3 containers and put them in the fridge; I can make one can last a long while that way. The bones are edible, like those of other sardines; I just prefer not to eat them. If you need the calcium, though, that's a great natural source. Anyway, whenever I'm ready to use them, I can eat them as is, maybe warm one or two up in a pan. They're not at all salty. Sometimes I make a mackerel fried rice that's delicious too, with mushrooms, green peas, rice, then add one or two filets of mackerel. People have even made salmon croquettes except of course substituting with mackerel meat.Pick them up in your bare hand, and you see they have some heft to them. In fact, feeling how heavy they are in my hand makes me a little sad that they were once living creatures, but like all of us they were put on earth to serve a purpose. They come individually in a 15 oz or 425g can. Serving size is 1/3 cup - which is a dumb measurement. I'll say one mackerel is a serving. It says there are about 5 servings per can, and there are 5 fish in the can, so do the math. One serving is 80 calories, has 280 mg sodium, 12g protein, 40 mg cholesterol, & 3g total fat. A serving also has 25% daily requirement for calcium. So that's not bad really for one small fish!I know it's probably easier to find Chicken of the Sea brand products in the store than the other brands, at least in my part of the world, so if you've ever been curious about this inexpensive canned fish that's usually found with the sardines and canned salmon, go ahead and give it a try. People are feeding their pets with this, but trust me, it's perfectly fine for human consumption. Enjoy them, and I hope I've helped you make a decision that works for you.

For comparison I then tried a can of the Cafe du Monde C&C which is also a dark roast and it isn't nearly as good (had kind of a burnt taste) as the French Market City Roast.Also found that if you make the French Market City Roast a little strong it has kind of a chocolate taste to it.  I've read that C&C has chocolate undertones but never tasted it until I made the dark roast a little stronger than I usually do.

I love most of the New Orleans/Louisiana coffees -- Community, French Market, CDM etc. but this is the one closest to what my Grammaw Couvillion used to brew up each morning. Dark and delicious. Not a bad price either. I can buy it at my local store but it's $8.99 each there so I just order it.

When I was offered an automatic shipment option, I thought this was the way to go, no lines at the grocery store.  Before the second shipment, I was notified that I could change my order or drop it.  Great service, great coffee, great option.

Make no mistake about it. This is the taste of New Orleans. The oldest coffee company in America still makes the best coffee in America. They actually put a full pound (16OZ) of coffee in a 1 pound can; not 13oz like some brands or even 11.5 oz. like Choc-full-O-Nuts. so you get more coffee for your money!It's delicious and always the perfect complement for any meal. column9: The best Earl Grey on the market
column10: I enjoy a good cup of tea and my absolute favorite is Earl Grey. Twinings Early Grey is among the best on the market, alongside Rishi loose leaf. A traditional English tea, Earl Grey is a black tea whose principle flavor is from the rind of bergamot oranges. Although there are various accounts of its origin, it is most likely was an Indian recipe (China is also a commonly attributed with creating the recipe) which made its way to England in the early 1800s. Named after Lord Grey, the tea is a flavorful black tea that is best served nearly boiling hot with or without lemon. It is NOT served with cream.Twinings is one of the oldest conveyors of Earl Grey and still use the same recipe as they have for well over a hundred years (soon to be two-hundred). Their tea is also endorsed by the 6th Earl Grey and his signature appears on their packaging. Not that this means the tea is superior because of any endorsement; in this case the tea speaks for itself.I prefer loose leaf teas to tea bags. There is something in the process of measuring tea into a cozy and letting it steep that makes the resulting cup of tea that much nicer. There is a reason they have tea ceremonies in most of the world (and although less rigorous, so do the British in their own way). Twinings is the quintessential British Earl Grey, and if you've never tried it, you owe it to yourself to do so. Enjoy!

column9: Excellent flavor, good value, but some issues to be aware of
column10: It's hard to find good decaf loose tea that is affordably priced and tastes good. I'm pleased to report that this English Breakfast from Coffee Bean Direct hits the mark on both counts. Excellent taste - depending on how long the steeping process, it ranges from a very light, refreshing taste that goes well as an iced tea, to a very hearty - but not bitter - taste that really hits the spot.I've had better tasting tea, but on a cost/value basis, this is outstanding.The downside is that, as with any decaf loose tea, you're not getting the full leaf format that our caffeinated tea brethren enjoy. This is very fine, almost powdery in consistency. This is where the higher priced teas pay off -- whilie their decaf process also results in broken leafs, it is not anywhere as fine or powdery as this.The fine/powdery nature presents some challenges in brewing, since the typical perforated tea ball will not be suitable. I'm using a mesh tea ball and it works pretty well, albeit there is still some tea residue in the bottom of the cup. If you want absolutely zero leaf residue you'll need to use one of those tea bag systems where you put the loose tea in a bag. Those, however, are not reusable more than a few times. As usual, trade-offs.Of greater significance is that the decaf process for this particular tea is not perfect - there is still some caffeine left. I'm very sensitive to caffeine levels, and this tea clearly has more caffeine than, for example, a bagged Lipton decaf. I'd put the caffeine level below what a regular green tea would hold, but there is still enough there to be noticeable. Again, I'm very sensitive to caffeine, so for most people I imagine that would not be an issue.

My wife is a big tea drinker and has had trouble finding loose leaf decaf tea. When I saw this I got it for a gift along with a tea brewing contraption and she raved about how good this tea is. I'm a coffee drinker so tea just tastes like dirt to me but she says this is excellent tea and likes it so much she's re-ordered more.

column9: Perhaps I got a bad bag
column10: I've been trying various teas since I had to give up coffee years ago (blood pressure problems).  This is the first one that I've questioned whether the dominant taste I perceive is a contaminant.  The taste is quite strong, and unlike any tea I've tasted (and I have tasted a variety of English breakfasts, Ceylons, and Assams, among others).  I've given it 3 tries (interspersed with pots of other tea), and established that the taste is not the water or the vessel.I concede the possibility that some people may value this taste, but I don't.  Now I'm going to compost it and move on.

There aren't a lot of choices of decaf tea that isn't prebagged, so I was happy to find this.  I put it in a coffee filter in my iced tea brewer, and it works great. It doesn't have a super-distinctive flavor, though.

The tea is amazing in taste and color. I highly recommend it.The "dust" described in another review is due to the Co2 decaf process they use. It is a natural process that does not use toxic chemical solvents to de-caffeinate the tea leaves.If you want a decaff tea that tastes like regular English Breakfast Tea, give this a try. You will not be disappointed with the taste."To decaffeinate using carbon dioxide (CO2), water-softened materials are "pressure cooked" with the gas. At high pressures and high temperatures, carbon dioxide is in a supercritical state, acting as both a gas and a liquid. It becomes a solvent with its small, nonpolar molecules attracting the small caffeine molecules. Since flavor molecules are larger, they remain intact, which is why this process retains the flavor of the material better.".  "Caffeine is not removed completely using any of these methods, but under federal regulations in the United States, caffeine levels must not be above 2.5 percent of the product in order for a product to be labeled "decaffeinated."".Update:I am in my second order of this tea.  I have noticed in this batch that the tase is inconsistant.  I take small portions from the 2lb bag and put it in a zip lock, forcing most of the air out and stor it in a dark container.  Some cups will be amazing and some have a rather stale aftertaste.  I didn't notice this with the initial order.  I have downgraded the rating to 4 stars.
