column10: Very good Porridge. I thought 6 pack will be a lot for me. I was wrongGreat gift for people who appreciate good porridge at the morning
This is tasty stuff. Very creamy and smooth. It cooks in my microwave perfectly in 2:50. I just add a teaspoon of honey and enjoy. My wife loves it too. Economical  in the 6 pack sold here on Amazon.

column9: Lovely way to start the day
column10: If you think you know oatmeal but haven't tried Flahavan's Irish Porridge Oats, then you aren't living yet.  Our "porridge" is so flavorful and hearty that I feel like it's the "good mood" breakfast.  Of course my favorite way is with butter and brown sugar, but a spoon full of blackberry preserves or a handful of Craisins and we're into a whole new experience.  Enjoy.

I bought this because I could not find a good comparison to the porridge I had while visiting Ireland. I just love this porridge. I definitely prefer it made with milk. And then I just put a tablespoon of honey in it. YUM YUM!
Came back from GB with a hankering for porridge - saw this on the "A", and it is truly great!  We are hooked!
I am very impressed with these country ham slices. A very high quality prooduct greatly exceeds standard racecar driver ham slices from the supermarket. Great flavor not too salty or too sweet.

Have used dehydrated green peppers for many, many years.  They used to be readily available in grocery stores, then they just sort of disappeared.  Knowing Amazon comes through for me all the time, I was able to locate them through Amazon and am again ready for any recipe requiring green peppers.  I seldom re-hydrate them and generally use them in recipes that have enough moisture to begin with.  Very happy to again have this product.
I've been looking for dried bell peppers ever since I ran out of a small bag that I bought in Amish country.  This stuff is great in chili and soups, keeps for months, and doesn't require chopping!

It would probable be good in chili, but it sucks mixed with instant rice.  There was a bitter after taste that lasted long after the meal, as well.  I'll try pre-washing the dust off, and rehydrating in a seperate pot, next time.  Part of the problem might be that the pepers were not cooked before dehydration.
I got just what I paid for. No complaints. I will be buying more for my food storage. Light and easily stored, so perfect for that.

column9: Bitter taste, not my favorite dried veg
column10: Over the past year or so I have come to appreciate the depth of flavor in many dried and dehydrated vegetables.  They are great in anything that requires a long cooking time.  I was, however, disappointed in these peppers.  They are quite bitter and the container has many seeds in it.  If you are looking for the flavor of sweet bell peppers, it is not to be found here.

Harmony House is a family owned company.Founded and based in North Carolina.1 800 696 1395 -- A quality company.Their fruit is freeze dried and the vegsare dehydrated.The mixed green/red peppers are wonderful.You can use them in ANYTHING! The peppersare very hard to find.  I used to buy minefrom JUST TOMATOES but they quit makingthem.A GREAT PRODUCT ! It is a little pricey-with the $7.95 shipping.bbp okc 63 rtired

column9: VERY powerful taste, not a snack
column10: Yipes, I can't wait to try these in eggs and nutrasystem lunch cups, but they are very powerful on their own. Might be exceptional in meat loaf. These are not spicy - they're bell peppers.

column9: As fresh as you can get without being in the field picking them.
column10: Harmony House Foods Dried Mixed Red & Green Bell Peppers, diced (10 oz, Quart Size Jar) for Cooking, Camping, Emergency Supply, and More Wholesome food with no Preservatives, Salt, or Synthetic Flavors added. Just add water as called for and heat, good to mix into other foods also. This is next to fresh out of the field..
This ingredient was getting harder and harder to find and more expensive.The last bottle I found was 1/10 the size and 1/2 the price, so thank you.

If you love Cheez-It's as much as I do, then you will simply love these.  They are the exact same product as the smaller cracker, but over twice the size.  Because they are larger, air seems to form in the center of the cracker, making them even more crispy than their little brother crackers, the traditional Cheez-It's.  Once you try the large size crackers, there is no turning back, trust me on that.  The flavor is explosive and they are the best cheese cracker on the market.  Now, if only they could offer a Cheez-It in a "well-done" version, where all the crackers in the box were a little burnt, my favorites, I would be ecstatic!

I love these big cheez-its, but, the boxes I received were all ground up.  At least 30% or more of the contents were ground into very small pieces, and the rest was broken up into larger pieces.  The salt flaked off most of the crackers that were big enough to look at, and they had an odd taste to them.While I will buy Cheez-Its again because I do like them, I will not ever buy them over the internet again.

These have to be my favorite cookies of all time! I've gifted boxes to family and friends and every person that has tried them has wiped out the box within a day. The Milk Chocolate Lace is definitely the best, but you really can't go amiss with any of Poppie's other orders as well. Highly recommended.
Wow, these cookies are amazing, I ate the whole bag right after I opened them and my friends ate the rest faster than I could blink.  They are bite size, crispy, and delicious.  YOU MUST TRY THESE!!!

A friend suggested that I try Poppies Cookies and this is some of the best advice she has ever given me.  Poppies Cookies are a staple in my pantry and any event that I host.  The cookies never fail to impress, my favorite are the chocolate lace and cranberry white chocolate.  Give these a try, other cookies don't compare.

These are great cookies - a treat when a treat is what is needed. Can't eat just one. Unless it is the one bag of them. I don't like crunchy cookies in general but these are the exception. The are not completely crunchy - they have a bit of a shortbread texture to them to soften that crunch a bit. Lovely chocolate - and that is very important to me. When I make homemade chocolate chip cookies (that my Dad says are the best of everyones) I use only the best chocolate chips (Ghirardelli or Scharffen Berger. These are a great substitute when I don't feel like baking!!
This is the best Chocolate Chunk cookie ever.  Tons of delicious chocolate and bite size crispy cookies.  I ate the whole bag when I opened it, yummy!
This is seriously the best cookie I have every eaten.  It is jam packed with all kinds of chocolates and Reese's Pieces and M&Ms.  Addictive!
I bought these cookies as gifts. Once they are open, they don't last very long at all. They are that good! They make great gifts and would definitely buy them again!

Normally, I like chewy cookies.  These are the exception!  They melt in your mouth and are wonderful.  Love the fact they are a family company.  My only criticism is that the container is hard to open...warning for long fingernails!!!!  So you have to "work" to get them open -- totally worth it!

All the reviews sounded so yummy...and they were right.  I absolutely love these cookiesBUT....they've got to solve their packaging problem.  I've opened two canisters so far and have a grand total of 2 unbroken cookies in one canister and 3 whole cookies and 2 more half cookies in the other.  The rest is tiny, tiny crumbs.  It should make good pressed pie crust.  It really is so yummy and I do have two more canisters to open, but I'm so disappointed that they are too broken up to serve to guests.  ADDENDUM...just opened another canister and these cookies are fine...and very delicious.
Tried these on the recommendation from Popppie's tall, pale, and handsome grandson. They are unbelievable!
I don't eat many sweets but I will have a chocolate chip cookie every now and then. Poppie's cookies are incredible. Impossible to have only one though so watch out.

column9: Not terrible, but way too sweet
column10: I don't want to say these are bad cookies, but I'm not impressed at all.  I guess I should have checked the label more carefully to notice that they were more than a quarter sugar.  It's so crunchy that it feels like you're just eating a sugar cube.  It's good with tea as a substitute for sugar.I'll stick to cookies at a local grocery store - cheaper and better.

column9: Good for cats - Loved by cats
column10: Approximately 20 years ago, I began to exclusively feed our cats Iams or Science Diet.  Those brands were recommended by our Veterinarian after our first cat showed signs of Feline Urinary Syndrome (FUS).  I had previously fed the cats the typical brands such as 9 Lives, Purina and Friskies.I continued with IAMS and Science Diet, because the other brands caused FUS, caused other digestive problems and the good reputation of IAMS and Science Diet.Then last year, one of our cats developed bladder disease and died.Not long afterward, the pet food scandal broke. Cat and dog food from nearly every pet food company, including premium foods like IAMS and Science, were tainted by melamine.  More than 150 brands of cat and dog food were recalled.  IAMS and Science Diet were two of the recalled brands, as was natural sounding brands such as Nutro.I vowed to never again purchase pet food from the brands that had betrayed my trust.  I began searching for pet food that was all natural and organic.  Newman's Own is both natural and organic.  It was also one of the few brands not recalled. Although it was difficult to find a local source, I finally found a few, including Amazon.My cats love Newman's Own canned and dry food.  They also love Innova EVO.  I love it because I don't have to worry about tainted food poisoning my cats.Pros:1. Peace of mind2. Does not cause FUS, as did Purina and other similar brands3. Much less likely to be tainted by lethal contaminants4. The cats love it5. Does not cause the other digestive problems.Cons:1. It is more expensive than the non-premium brands2. It can be difficult to find a nearby store that sells Newman's Own.Overall, the pros outweigh the cons.  And I can now add Amazon to my list of sources for the food.

I bought Newman's Own after the cat chow scare as well but was surprised at the change in my cat's behavior and activity level within the first month of the switch. I wish it were available nearby but I'm signing up for the auto ship which gives you free shipping and a lower price. My cats love the flavor and respond well to the nutrition and absence of processing in their food. I know how lethargic I feel when I get busy and eat too much processed food-why would they react any differently? It's well worth the money-I've tried cat chow naturals and while it is better than regular it does not produce the level of improvement that PN does so I'm sticking with the good stuff!

...and he hates everything. I fed my cat Iam's for years, because his vet reccomended it and therefore I figured it must be the best for him, but after the cat food scare, I wanted to get out of all the traditional brands. The vet reccomended another brand, which I cannot think of the name right now... that you can buy at PetSmart. It was pretty pricey - about $28 for a 64 oz bag. My cat hated it, he refused to eat it, and it looked wooden.But I took him to a playdate at a friends and he has this habit of eating out everyone's bowl and came across Newman's Own in his friend's food bowl. He loved it! My friend sent me home with enough to transition him and I ordered a bag instantly from Amazon. And if you are looking to go organic with your kitty, comparatively, the price for Newman's Own is right. Much cheaper than those in the same class.

column9: Cat Food Review - Newman's Own Organic Adult Dry
column10: [...]Ingredients:Organic Chicken, Chicken Meal, Organic Soybean Meal, Organic Sorghum, Fish Meal, Organic Peas, Organic Brown Rice, Organic Millet, Organic Rice, Chicken Fat (Naturally Stabilized with Mixed Tocopherols [a Source of Vitamin E]), Organic Oats, Organic Barley, Organic Flax Seed, Organic Canola Oil, Chicken Liver, Organic Carrots, Cranberries, DL-Methionine,  Dicalcium Phosphate, Sea Salt, Potassium Chloride, Taurine, Parsley, Choline Chloride, Zinc Amino Acid Complex (Source of Chelated Zinc), Iron Amino Acid Complex (Source of Chelated Iron), Vitamin E Supplement, Manganese Amino Acid Complex (Source of Chelated  Manganese), Copper Amino Acid Complex (Source of Chelated Copper), Niacin, Vitamin B12 Supplement, Vitamin A Acetate, Ascorbic Acid (Source of Vitamin C), Lecithin, Calcium Pantothenate, Thiamin Hydrochloride, Riboflavin, Cobalt Proteinate (Source of Chelated Cobalt), Vitamin D3 Supplement, Rosemary Extract,  Folic Acid, Biotin, Pyridoxine Hydrochloride, Rosemary Extract, Potassium Iodide, Sodium Selenite, Dehydrated Lactobacillus Acidophilus Fermentation Product, Dehydrated Bacillus Subtilis Fermentation Product, Dehydrated Bifidobacterium Thermophilum Fermentation Product, Dehydrated Bifidobacterium Longum Fermentation Product, Dehydrated Enterococcus Faecium Fermentation Product.

column9: Great for cats with corn allergies--meat #1 ingredient
column10: I have 2 cats.  One is fluffy and finicky and won't eat anything but wet food and human meat.  The other one is athletic, lively and will eat only dried "crap" food.Well, the athletic one started having terrible eye problems (red and weepy) and she constantly scratched at them.  We tried oral Lysine, Terramycin antibiotics, and swapping out the plastic dish for ceramic.  Still she had eye problems. column4: Steven R. Gruchawka "Shop till you drop"
column9: Switched to Newman's Own Organic and all 3 cats stopped vomiting
column10: Our three cats throw up every day and have been doing this for years. I am not talking about hairballs but vomiting up undigested food. The vet says they are very healthy but "cats do this".Last week we switched from "Purina One" to "Newman's Own Organics Adult Formula Dry Cat Food" and low and behold the vomiting completely stopped -OVERNIGHT!Prior to "Purina One - Urinary Track Health Formula" we fed them "Prescription Diet c/d" with the same vomiting.One caveat -the chicken in this Newman's Organic dry cat food is "Natural" and not "Organic" so I contacted Newman's Own to ask them what they feed their "Natural" chickens. We received a quick response from L.Phillips Brown, DVM, confirmed that even though they are not Organic chickens, they do NOT feed these free-range chickens GMO grains.We recently learned that since the mid-90s, food companies have been slipping GMOs into human and animal food, without our knowledge or approval, even though studies say these are quite harmful (causing damage to internal organs). The Europeans are smart enough to ban GMOs but not us "dumb Americans". So unless it is organic you are best to avoid all non-Organic meat, poultry, and "farm raised" fish (they are all fed GMOs) and non-Organic corn, soy, cottonseed, Canola products (these are GMO).Perhaps this cat food stopped the vomiting issue because Newman's Own has no GMOs or perhaps it is because there are no grains. In either event, it works. And this is nothing short of a miracle! We are astonished that the change was so immediate.All three cats love this food. The cats have not vomited once since we switched. Also, the cats seem calmer and their food cravings - to have their bowls constantly filled - have gone away.We really lucked on to something here. What a great cat food!

A little too expensive for me as I have 4 cats.  But I have read the ingredients,  and being familiar with most of the higher end brands this one is right up there with them.  It is good for cats that have sensitive tummies.

This is the best cat food I gae ever tried on my cat,  She loves it, it smells all natural and is good for her.

column9: Saved a lot of $$$ at the vet--be patient, though, it might take some time!
column10: I bought this food based upon other reviews from people who said that it helped their cats who had been licking off their fur. She also said that we could consider giving the cat Benadryl to see if that helped (but didn't necessarily see the need to do either at that point).Eventually, though, the cat got to the point where she was pretty much licking off all of the fur she could reach--we literally had a half naked cat! She also had lots of small "scabs" (which she'd gotten before, but not to this extent), which was probably at least partly why she was licking the fur off. We figured the vet, if she saw the cat at that point, would recommend allergy testing. I decided to give this food a try first.I'm very happy to report that it worked! Some other reviewers said that it worked for their cats in a couple of weeks. With our cat it took at least 4-6 weeks. At this point she's grown all of her fur back and the scabs are gone, too.And she has loved the food from the very beginning--no problems eating it (as at least one reviewer mentioned), even though it is in very small pieces.So if your cat is licking off his or her fur, consider trying this before spending all of the money for allergy testing (unless, of course, your cat is having other medical issues, too, that you're worried about). Great stuff!

column9: Cheesy Bean and Rice Burritos - Yum!
column10: I use this product to make a great burrito just like what is made at our local Taco place. I make up the mix according to package directions, but don't add the chicken. I heat up a can of refried beans and then make burritos by putting about 1/4 cup of refried beans, 1/4 cup of the enchilada filling and a tablespoon or two of picante sauce on a flour tortilla and then rolling up burrito style. These have been a big hit every time I have served them.

In an effort to have something "quick and easy" on hand and as one who basically lives on white meat chicken, I tried this box mix not expecting much more than some flavored rice to accompany my otherwise boring white meat chicken.  Since I often buy bulk boneless skinless chicken, frozen, it seems that I never have the forethought to defrost the chicken for a meal.  However, I've found that while I cook the frozen chicken in a frying pan, just a tiny drop of oil, on low, it's like steaming the chicken...no additives, just plain chicken. While the chicken is "cooking" I prepare the box mix (without adding the chicken like the box says) - the simmer time on the mix is just about the same time it takes for the chicken to cook - I cube the chicken still in the cooking pan (to ensure it's fully cooked post freezer), toss it into the now finished box mix - saves lots of time as I never have anything defrosted when I need it :)Like others, I have experimented and added frozen corn (much better than canned I've found) - now my staple in this "mix", plus I sometimes add shredded cheese atop it before serving. I've tried the diced tomatoes and peppers...not a big fan.  I always top with a dab of sour cream.The mix freezes very well and reheats with ease.  I tend to add a sprinkling of water when microwaving for some extra moisture in the rice.  A leftover favorite is a flour tortilla with the mix, sour cream and a dash of taco sauce.Friends to whom I've served this mix have been shocked it was indeed a "mix" (that is, when I've confessed!)...not your typical flavorless or overpriced "helper mix"!

Just through basic experimenting, I've also found that adding diced up imitation crab to this 'box mix' creates a great recipe. I then like adding a little chopped up tomato, black beans, and guacamole.It does not look like a lot from the box, but wow, a little bit of this dish really fills me up. It's definitely a good buy if you have to stretch a meal for a couple of days.

column9: Once acquired...This (satisfying!) miso soup might be your new addiction.
column10: I first picked this off the shelf at a military commissary in Kansas one summer... and I never stopped. The first time you try this stuff, it's like wine or avocados; it's a taste that is certainly acquired, and like nothing else. I have fed it to a friend and to my significant other; few like it the first time, but you find yourself strangely coming back for more until it's a staple in your house, like it is in mine. Kind of reminds me of sushi; first time I tried it, I was like, "this is odd, why do people eat this?", then, I found myself craving it a week later. Haha. Now I love sushi and miso! (By the way, it comes in an envelope with 3 individual packets). Mix it in hot water, to taste. You might like it with more or less water, depending on how salty you like your food. -Experiment with it to your satisfaction, and I guarantee, there is much of that to be had.I usually add all 3 little individual packets (it's low-fat) to a decent-sized cup of hot water, add my favorite vinegar, and let it sit and "cure" for a minute or so, since the little green sea-vegetable flakes (and green onions + tofu squares) need time to rehydrate and turn a little chewy and palatable. I then sip it and fish the sea vegetables out to my heart's content.(I also hear that miso can be generally healthy for you!)If you let it sit, the miso will start to separate from the rest of the soup and you have delightful little clouds of miso particles floating in your bowl, which is sort of entertaining and visually delightful, too. I think of it as cheap, delicious entertainment. But then again, I am easily amused. ;)

My love affair with miso, the flavorful paste made from fermented soybeans, started when I lived in Tokyo several years ago.  So, since then, being the miso snob that I am, it has been unimaginable to me to try any instant variety.  But I have to say that when I finally did break down and try Kikkoman Instant Tofu Miso Soup, I was amazed to find that it was practically indistinguishable in flavor and consistency from miso soup made from the actual paste.  While I would still choose the actual product whenever time permits, I would now not hesitate to substitute this great product when I am on the run.

column9: Holds its own against any restaurant miso soup
column10: This is the best miso soup to be found anywhere; it is fabulous and the flavor is just amazing considering it's an instant soup. You can add a variety of vegetables, chicken pieces, pork, beef or shrimp if you like, and chopped spinach and if you love tofu you can add either the firm or soft variety, I prefer the soft.The soup is comprised of fermented soy beans and comes in red (sweeter) or white (saltier) miso paste and fish stock made from bonito flakes and contains kelp as well. I am going to a local Asian market where I live and make my own miso from scratch but bought more of this as backup just in case mine doesn't turn out. It is a very delicate soup and cannot ever be boiled once the bonito is added as it would collapse and the flaovr would be ruined, so I watched videos on how to prepare it.Many years ago when I was in college in downtown Los Angeles, we would go to little Tokyo for lunch and indulge in the then relatively unknown treat, sushi and have the miso and a wonderful salad of finely chopped cabbage and rice vinegar to start.Now I can buy (and do) sushi freshly prepared at my local supermarket and have instant miso whenever I want and that is my idea of Heaven. Miso has the most delicate flavor imaginable, it is absolutely unique, nothing else tastes remotely like it and it is very healthy for you as well.When I went to a fat farm the main reason we all lost so much weight was because the diet plan at this particular place included having a large cup of hot broth before every meal thus cutting the appetite down considerably. I could really put it away before, just huge gluttonous portions, but after finishing the cup of broth, I could eat what they gave us but no more than that.So whether you want in instant soup like no other or want to incorporate this soup into your diet plan, either way you'll be very happy and remember to experiment by adding whatever you like and making it more of a meal.To paraphrase a quote from Benjamin Franklin (re beer) miso is proof God loves us and wants us to be happy. Enjoy!

And if you forget a spoon, it's okay - just drink it like broth.Making miso soup "from scratch" is one of the things I've failed miserably at every time I've tried, but with these packets I can save myself time, heartache and money.  It even tastes better than some of the miso soups I've had in restaurants.

The miso is delicious; Its an easy way to have a quick breakfast. I have an egg with the soup, and eat something else at lunch time. The miso in the morning is very light, and not heavy on the stomach.

column9: easy to make, a bit salty
column10: This is good for a powdered product. I prefer the separate soybean paste with a packet of dried seaweed & tofu, but this has a good flavor. A bit salty for my taste.
This was quite tasty, but the saltiness was overwhelming. If you have to limit your salt intake, steer clear of this item.

column9: Both My Husband and Me Like This
column10: It is so easy and nothing to add except water.I like it with more water than my husband.Yum!Great for late late night too...you know, instead of eggs!

I love this soup it is the best tasting instant miso, except it has MSG added that is the only bad thing about it. If Kikkoman would take that ingredient out it would be almost perfect for instant miso.

I am a HUGE fan of miso soup.  I've tried many of the instant miso soups thanks to my asian market.  Kikkoman's Instant Miso is by far the best soup out there.  It's the closest you can get to the "real" thing without actually making the soup yourself.However, this company is selling it at a ridiculous price!  I've purchase the EXACT same thing at Walmart for $1.99/package (which comes out to $0.67 per packet).  This company is trying to sell them for over $3 per package (or over a $1 per packet!) - not even including shipping.  I'd do my homework and buy elsewhere because this company seems to specialize in rip-offs.
I trusted the other good reviews, but this tastes awful and has a bad aftertaste.  Yuk.

I researched some of the ingredients on this item and i found that powdered bonito is a fish derivative however the ingedients listed on the page here only says powdered bonito but on the actual package it says powdered bonito(fish).I think the people who sell this item should modify the ingredient listing on this page.

We really love these crackers.  They taste a lot better than the regular peanut butter crackers.  But when you add shipping costs, they are much more expensive on Amazon than in other stores.  We generally buy a box with 8 individual packs for $2.00.  I bought these thinking that there must be a mistake in the description, and there would be more boxes.  I admit, that was my mistake!  But the packing slip said it was 6 boxes of 8 individual packets.  So there is a disconnect between what is on the site, and what the packing slip says.  My recommendation - check your grocery store before you buy.  Chances are you will get them at a much more reasonable price.

These crackers cannot be found in many supermarkets. I bought them in Florida when visiting and fell in love with the wholesome crunch of the healthy wheat cracker and the perfect taste of peanut butter filling. They make a perfect snack and they are always in any purse I carry. Lance has come up with the perfect product!!!! I am grateful I can order them from Amazon!!! Thank you. S Lewis

column9: A treat for your turkey sandwich
column10: I did a "cold" purchase of this, just because it looked interesting and combined two of my favorite flavors. It exceeded by expectations, and I use it on sandwiches and as an added flavor for sweet and sour dishes. It is a great compliment to any poultry dish. You will love it!

column9: Best strawberry jam on the market
column10: Hard to believe you can buy strawberry jam on the market that tastes like my mother's homemade southern strawberry preserves!!It is delicious,  and the best part is that it has No sugar added.  The sweetness comes from fruit only.  Awesome!,

column9: The BEST tasting fruit preserve you will ever have!
column10: I tried St. Dalfour All Natural Fruit Spread at a bread and breakfast and was just blown away at how delish it was! I was so impressed that I found our hostess and commented on how much I enjoyed the scones and fruit spread. To my surprise, she told me it was St. Dalfour and I was very surprised that it wasn't home made, it was THAT good! It's a little on the pricey side, but please believe me when I tell you, it is worth every penny. I also love that it has no added sugar. This is truly a quality product at it's finest!
Made without sugar and just plain fruit and fruit juice.The flavor is wonderful and I will buy it again!

column9: great product, maybe a little pricey
column10: Great product, good taste and texture, not much more you can say about pasta really!

These are one of the best caramels we have ever had.  They are always soft but yet come out of the wrapper easily, rich and buttery.  A real tasty treat.  My husband is very picky about his caramels and these definitely pass the test.  We have also tried the chocolate ones, which are also tasty, but prefer the regular caramels the best.

column9: Great Grain Free Food at a Great Price!!
column10: This food is definitely worth trying!  I called Hi-Tek Rations to confirm that all of their ingredients are sourced here in the USA.  They have also never had a food recall.  I love that the food is delivered to my door.  The dogs love it too!

I was looking for a less expensive alternative to Wellness Core. After doing quite a bit of research, I decided to give Hi-Tek Naturals Grain Free a try. I liked that it's protein-focused, but at the same time not ridiculously high in protein like some foods can be. I liked that the food is sourced and made in the US. (The company answered my email in under 20 minutes when I asked them about it.) I also liked that it has probiotics, and I've been able to tell from past experience that my dogs really seem to do better with foods that have probiotics as opposed to those that don't. Far fewer loose stools and upset stomachs in general. But most of all, I'm pleased that my picky dog actually likes the food. The nuggets are quite small, about the size of peas, which is fine for us but something to keep in mind if your dog likes a bigger nugget.

I have been wanting to get my dogs on a grain free diet to help with allergies and have struck out with a previous brand but my dogs love this food!  One of them actually jumps around like crazy when I start putting it in the bowl.  Great dog food for a great price.
My papillons really seem to enjoy the Hi-Tek food. No digestive problems. Excellent ingredients and  at a good price too.

Hi-Tec Naturals Grain Free Chicken and Sweet Potato Formula has been a real life saver. Finding a dry dog food our three Picky Pekingese would eat wasn't easy.Our Vet suggested we try Grain Free dog food after our two year old male began to have signs of digestive problems. Also, our older female had been licking her feet (most likely allergies from something in her diet).We tried several types of Gluten Free (dry kibble)dog food and my picky eaters wouldn't touch it. They had always been fed a small kibble mixed with a small amout of canned dog food. We also tried chicken and rice (which I prepared for them) of course they liked it.  However, it didn't seem to correct the digestive problem for our little boy.Since we discovered Hi-Tek Naturals, Grain Free, all three of our Pekingese will eat it and are doing fine. They seem to like the taste and will chewthe kibble, chewing is better for their teeth anyway.We are former breeders of "Show Pekes" and wish we'd found this produce earlier.Thanks, HI-TEC NATURALS from Bach Choy Pekingese

Got this for my dog as the vet advised that she go on a low-protein/low-phosperous diet to maintain kidney health. Dog LOOOVVVVESSSS it, but don't sniff the can, just trust that it smells bad, and keep your nose away!!! Otherwise, you WILL have regrets!!!!Would give this a 5-star except that it doesn't outline how much regular dogfood to feed with it. I'm having to play by ear.

I have tried tons of these sweeteners and I really dislike aspartame as it have a funky aftertaste and is generally too sweet.  These, however, are powered by Splenda and that are terrific. There is no after taste, they are not too sweet and I do not think you can tell the difference between these and the "real" thing.  Great option for those of us trying to cut back on sugar!

column9: Glad I found this on Amazon
column10: I have been using this 4C Totally Light 2 Go lemonade mix with Splenda for several years.  I initially purchased it at Walmart and then when WM stopped carrying it I was getting it direct from 4C.  I'm glad I finally checked Amazon as it if half the cost versus getting it direct from 4C and paying shipping charges.  I really like the taste and when I use this lemonade mix I find that I drink more than when I recently tried to just drink plain water.  I do mix it half strength and like it fine that way.
I have tried to skip citrus juice to cut calories. This item is a little too sweet for me, but still tastes good. Couldn't stand the brands with NutriSweet, Loved Arizona, this one's OK.

This product was so misrepresented that I no longer use Amazon as my first choice when I'm looking for a product.  I ended up spending my gift certificate and was totally ripped off for 3 packs of nuts that I can purchase in a store for $5.  Don't be fooled by this product no matter how they try to dress it up.

I had ordered these on line, they come 4 gift packs per order. The first shippment came with one gift pack so I called customer sevice and they said to keep the one I got and they would reship the order. The next shippment came and was the same thing, one gift pack instead of 4, so I called again and they said they would send out two more. I waited weeks and nothing came, so I called again they could not tell me why I did not get my order, they asked if I wanted a refund for the last two gift packs I did not get, I really wanted the two gift packs but I said i would take the refund. Next I ordered some Doritos toasted corn, they come 6 in a order, I got all 6 but every bag had nothing but busted up corn chips. They were packed in a big box no packing around the bags. I would like to order these items again but ......

column9: Good dark, rich coffee for breakfast time
column10: After trying lots of different blends in K-Cups over the past couple of years, I've settled on a mix of Tully's French Roast and Newman's Extra Bold as my go-to choices for morning wake up coffees.  Both have a strong, deep flavor that pairs well with weekend waffles and other "sweet" goodies.  It's a shame that the price has gone up so much, but it's not the fault of the coffee.  I'll keep drinking this one -- it's one of my simple pleasures and still much more affordable than picking up a cup at the local espresso stand.
This is a rich, full flavored coffee  If you like a full bodied taste but not too strong this is the one.
It seems like I am always sampling new coffee for my K-cup brewer, but for consistent good taste this is one of the best. It makes a quality cup of coffee with real coffee taste.

Tully's French Roast is my favorite morning coffee. This supply is unusually bitter.  Since I have been buying locally in smaller quantities, I feel I have been dumped upon with old product in this purchase - and will likely toss it. Advice:  buy nearer home and check "use by" dates.  This box comes with loose K-cups inside and no date whatsoever.
When I was opening the boxes I noticed there were some Tully's House Blend KCups included in each box. Besides that issue - I enjoy the Tully's Frnch Roast.

My favorite out of all the k-cups! We fell in love with the kuerig in our sunday school class simply for its convenience unfortunately though I honestly am a major coffee lover and somewhat of a coffee snob so when we traded our aeropress (which I recommend 100%, I just want something faster these days)I had a hard time finding a k-cup that was bold enough for me-if you like dark french roasts, you know what Im talking about, well to this day, Ive tried many different k-cups, I even have the eco cup where you can put your own coffee in and nothing matches tulleys french roast...the only one that I would drink besides it is jet fuel but its def still not numero uno like tulleys!
My wife tried quite a few brands of K cup coffee, and finally decided on Tully's French roast as the one she wanted. Saw the great offer on Amazon, and couldn't pass it up.
Out of all the K-cups I've sampled Tully's French Roast is the tastiest, no bitter after taste, a good waker upper!
If you enjoy dark roast, full flavor coffee, this is the best I have found.  And, my husband agrees.  We have tried numerous brands and find Tully's to have that "something extra".
This is my favorite coffee.  I like a strongly flavored brew and this fills the bill and the "smokey flavor" is an enhancement I like.

I didn't think I was a Green Mountain Coffee Roasters fan - I usually think their coffee is mediocre, at best - but this is excellent.  I make one cup per "small" Keurig serving - and it's almost an espresso.  I love it, and I am very fussy about coffee.
I ordered this coffee because we were having guests for a week from out of town.  I knew they liked French Roast coffee.  Well it was a total success.  Great coffee and conversations.  Thanks.

This is a great option if you are looking for a bold roast K-Cup. This is my new favorite. Coffee People Organic used to be a favorite but they seemed to have quit making it or the new replacement is not as good.

column9: good taste but a little strong
column10: having trouble finding a k kup with right strength, either too weak or too strong, but this one is better than most.
I love this coffee.  I love my coffee strong and rich tasting and this fits the bill. I will definitely purchase this again.

Tully's French Roast is a solid choice and one of my staples.  This is my favorite French Roast currently available in a K-cup.  Maybe someday Peets will come in a K-cup, sigh.  One trick if you find it isn't as rich as you normally get in your favorite bistro, is to make a smaller size portion.

I'm a big time coffee drinker and I tend to like my coffee strong and Tully's French Roast blend delivers! I'm not going to go into all the details about how it taste like "this or that" because everybody's taste are different. But if you like a strong, not bitter, cup of coffee that will get you going in the morning, then this is for you.
When I want a nice strong cup of coffee, Tully's French Roast is my choice.  Strong but not bitter.I will buy it again!
strong, not much flavor, very little aroma. I tried it once, will not purchase another time. I have other similiar brands that met the standards i expected.
Best tasting coffee. Love dark roast with a bit of a bite. Can't go wrong with Tullys. Well worth the money.
Extra Bold and Smooth ! Great coffee. I'll be ordering more of this. I like an extra bold cup and this certainly fits and it is just a little better than the Tully's Italian Roast !

I prefer my coffee to be a bold Flavorful roast and this Tully's French Roast does that, and then some. I've tasted a number of different K-Cups and Tully's seems to satisfy the boldest tastes, their coffees always seem to be a little bit of heven.

column9: Waking up with a hot cup of coffee
column10: For coffee lovers who enjoy a strong  cup of coffee in the morning then French Roast is the coffee for you. It has a rich bold flavor that will kick start your day.

Great coffee. I love this k-cup flavor. Delicious full bodied coffee for bold coffee lovers, doesn't disappoint. I always buy in bulk, because the price per cup decreases, but also because I KNOW I'm going to drink a lot. Love this coffee!

column9: Bit stronger than the wife likes.
column10: We normally get Deidrich's French Roast but it is no longer carried in "Subscribe and Save" so I thought a good alternative would be Tully's French Roast.  It's a wee bit stronger than the wife would ideally like, but it's O.K.  Personally, I like it!  (My real favourite is Tully's Italian Roast.)
Excellent flavor-properly done French Roast. Smokey and rich. Sufficiently strong,  though I always think k -cups need more coffee in them.

I've recently purchased Tully's French Roast K-Cups from Amazon. Well this is the best coffee no bitter after taste, wonderful smell of coffee brewing, very  easy to make.The French roast is a darker coffee for those who like stronger blends.I'd recommend this to all who purchase K-cups .Only bad thing about this product is it goes to fast ,in other words I drink to much of it. LOL  Buy some and enjoy your cup of coffee today.
This coffee has turned out to be my very favorite in K-cups.  It is the best of the "bolds"- full-bodied, rich tasting and is a great way to start my day.

I need to say I absolutely love my Kuerig brewing system. French Roast is one my favorite types of roast. I don't want to sound biased, but anyone who loves a strong aromatic coffee would love this kind. I would recommend it to the coffee enthusiast, but that's just me. This won't be so good for those who don't like a very strong, extra bold coffee. If you are one of those who doesn't like a coffee this strong...this isn't for you unfortunately.

column9: Makes a good cup of coffee
column10: I was given a keurig B70 as a gift and was asked which coffee sample type(s) I wanted with it.I decided to take a chance on this one.  It was a good choice.The coffee was smooth and full bodied.An excellent french roast.
Wonderful bold brew. Stands alone or with Hazelnut, Vanilla or half and half w/sugar or not, too. Tully's great blend! C'est Magnifique!

We sampled a number of different K-Kup blends and this one seems to be the closest to what my wife describes as a smokey flavor, overall a great cup of coffee. I prefer a less bold taste but it's a  a definite 4.5 stars.
One of the best cups of coffee that I have every consumed at home. If you are a person that enjoys a rich and robust cup of coffee this is the one that you may enjoy.

Addicted to this brand and found this coffee fresh, bold and unbitter.The delivery was super fast and my only complaint is it came in an unmarked box meaning I felt I had to count. But the count was right on & for the savings I'm not complaining so will order again. This coffee being bold but with no aftertaste is one I never tire of it. Everyone who tries this loves it. I find if I brew a small cup makes excellent iced coffee or warm latte. My coffee maker does have size options so considering cost of lattes my homemade version using liquid stevia/almond milk is money saving plus healthy. I have used both plain/flavored stevia and my coffee flavor stays true. All in all addicted and loving every cup.I am adding to review ordered a few days ago and a super charged delivery this was in original package this time and I am a very satisfied customer. Fresh cup in hand while I write this!
Tully's coffee French Roast coffee is yummy! It tastes bold and we have even used it to make iced coffee.
Very Strong! Excellent taste. If you want a coffee that is full of flavor even on the largest cup size, This is the one to buy.

I give Tully's an AAA+ for marketing a great coffee. When you drink Tully's it tastes good from the first sniff to the last drop and leaves a pleasant that was real Coffee after taste.If you like Sumatra you love Tully's French roast K cups. Please note that some people do not agree with me but to each their own. It's what makes the world an interesting place.........

I am a great coffee lover and am constantly searching for the perfect cup that I can brew at home.  Tully's French Roast is at the top of the list with my K-cup brewer.  The coffee is delicious, great dark roast taste, and I do look forward to each morning great cup of coffee....Each night before I go to bed I am excited to get up the next morning to my great cup of coffee.....
Comparable flavor to Starbucks and cost much less. I don't know why anyone would buy a 12 pack. All flavors are good as well.
I've tried several different coffee's and this is the best so far. If you don't like  strong coffee, then this is not for you.
Ok not as good as Starbucks French roast but less expensive. Sprinkled a little cinnamon and added cream. That helped.

column9: Best K cup for coffee lovers!
column10: My husband thought the Keurig coffee maker was just another gadget, only to be used when guests wanted to make their own choice for flavored coffees.  When I purchased a small box of this  extra bold coffee, he said it was the best coffee he has ever had...home or in a restaurant!  I purchased this larger box, and he said, "Why don't we put the Keurig in the kitchen, and put our 12 cup coffee maker away"!  He is now having less cups of coffee...enjoying it much more...and absolutely no waste!

column9: Tully's Coffee French Roast K-Cup for Kuerig
column10: This is one of my husband's favorite's.I found it to be less expensive than at GMCR so got it here at Amazon.It shipped quickly and I was very pleased with the order.I will be ordering more soon! Thanks

Realllllly good!, I saw this reviewed on Seattle Coffee Gear's site and being me I thought oo I wonder if its on amazon! sure enough.. They had the whole bean version which I wanted more but but no grinder yet so I bought drip and since I hadn't tried it before I was wondering if it was really good or if it was just meh. This is awesome coffee, the drip grind is really great too and strong! I learned quick that you do not want to use too much now if your big on strong coffee go nuts, I used a cone type filter and used 2 1/2 tablespoons and I didn't really level off much and it was sooo strong but not bitter it was super smooth and it was chocolaty really good, love this coffee plan on buying more :0) if you can't find it on here just go to their website.
Great soup, this is my favorite, but I like all Progresso soups! Makes a great meal when watching one's weight, and for a little extra protein I add 1/4 cup of lentils and there you go!

column9: What a difference a vendor makes.
column10: The last review I wrote was a true pan, this one is the exact opposite. My Buttered Popcorn Jelly Belly beans arrived today. They were packaged in a labeled plastic bag explaining what I got which was exactly what I ordered. The beans were fresh, tasty, had the Jelly Belly logo and splashes of yellow on each bean: just what I expected. This vendor gets top billing in my opinion.
This snack isn't a overly sweet, the outside part is like a cracker not a cookie.  And the filling is not overly orange tasting.

I will admit that I was worried about buying these after reading the review from the person whose pup became sick after eating four of these, but I decided to take the risk and carefully monitor my own pup.  My 3-month old Golden Retriever puppy came to me with giardia (for which he has been treated, but at the time, he was still experiencing some problems), so I didn't want anything to exacerbate his gastro issues.  I'm relieved (no pun intended) to say that my puppy, along with my two Great Pyrenees, and my gimpy old lab/husky mix, have all four gone through this 5-lbs package of rawhides (in just a little over a month) with no problems at all.  I sent some home with my mother for her terrier mix and for my sister's doberman, and they've had no problems, either.The rawhides are a good mix of small and relatively thin, along with a some (more than half of) which are larger and thicker.  There is no odd (eg., chemical) smell coming from the rawhides, and the bag is resealable - like a giant ziploc bag.  I'm placing my third order (sent one bag to mom and sis for their dogs); the quality is excellent and the value is unbeatable.August 2011 Update:  I have had these on a monthly auto-shipping order for several months, but the last two shipments were bags with rawhide chips that are almost entirely small and thin, and have not included the larger & thicker pieces I mentioned earlier.  I hope the next shipment will bring back the larger pieces.  If it does not, I do not think I will continue to purchase these.  They are fine for small to medium dogs, but are simply too small for my 70+ lbs animals, and they just don't last very long.December 2011 Update:  The last three shipments have seen a return to a more diverse sizing of the chips.  I expect that there will continue to be some variability, but I am especially pleased with this month's bag, since it has many of the thicker chips I prefer for my big dogs.  These thicker chips might be less than ideal for the smallest of dogs, though I think most determined pups would be okay with them.  I plan to continue to receive this bag on a once-a-month automatic shipping order for the foreseeable future; I think it might be possible to make this bag last more than a month even giving all four of my dogs one chip a day, but we're never that orderly, and I find that I'm usually out of chips several days before a new shipment.  With fewer dogs, you can expect this bag to last several months.

column9: Warning - Made Lab Retriever Sick After Only 4 Rawhide Chips
column10: I read the positive reviews and I really liked the price so I ordered these rawhide chips. My yellow Labrador Retriever weighs 80 lbs and daily gets a rawhide chip (primarily Walmart generic brand) as a treat in the evening for years.  My Lab will eat everything in sight (including socks) and never has stomach problems. After giving him only four rawhide chips in two days, my Lab developed a severe case of diarrhea and he's still sick after four days.  He is an inside dog which makes it a real problem since he needs to go out hourly to do his business. Plus he's not feeling well and just lies around. I called the vet right away, and he recommended some immodium-type medication short term only. Since his appetite is fine and he isn't throwing up and he isn't getting any worse, his vet and I think he will be fine.  The vet advised me to throw away the rest of the rawhide which I have done.  I called Amazon.com and my money was cheerfully refunded which I greatly appreciate since I used the refund to buy the immodium medication.This is just a warning to make sure you only give your dog one bone chip at a time and wait a day or so to make sure he can tolerate it.  I don't know why these rawhides made my dog so sick but it could have been just a problem with this batch. I won't be buying this product again but I will definitely continue to buy from Amazon.com

My dog absolutely LOVES these... though he's not sure why.  He takes them and runs circles... every once in a while he'll drop it and bark at it... then picks it up and start running again.  Considering the rawhide is gone by the time I get home, I think he eventually figures it out... either that or I've got a TON of rawhide bones buried in my yard somewhere :o)Seriously though - no extra stuff, just plain chewy rawhide fun - it's a winner in my boys eyes!

I like to give good reviews but unfortunately, this time I can't.  This product made my doberman very very sick, Twice!  I thought, the first time it could have been something else.  Then I remember reading the post that said warning don't feed, her lab had explosive diarrhea, well same thing happened to my doberman.  So the second time, I tested it out, gave her two chips as a snack, then the next day, the same thing.  So, that's the end of those chips for me!  I will say, I think it's only for certain dogs as my heeler can eat them, with no problems.  So, it just depends on the dog and dobermans are known for having sensitive stomachs although, no other raw hide chips have ever bothered her in this way whatsoever.  Just want to put it out there, to help give you an informed decision.

Dog-la loves 'em and just today, he was asking me to order another 5-lbs before he runs out.  Which I did, because the price is right w/s&s, he gives me 3 minutes of peace while he chews, and his teeth are pretty clean on a chewie-a-day.  And, well, he's got me trained to serve him obediently.No problems for him, and he's got a bit of a sensitive stomach (he can eat random cat poop no problem, but let 'im swallow the tiniest piece of plastic while eating through a bottle to get to the treats inside, and, bam, massive surgery bill and lifelong intestinal scarring).  I appreciate the reviewers sharing their tails of caution, but I've had no problems.  I give one with dinner and dog-la noshes on (inhales? magically adsorbs?) some kibble and veggies (30 seconds, max), and then grabs the rawhide and enjoys a relaxing chew.  Once in a blue moon, I give him a rawhide unattended (but that's a bad idea with basically ANY chewable, because dogs can gnaw off a chunk and inhale/swallow it).  He's sitting on my foot 99% of the time he's chewing these and he's never choked or suffered stomach upset from 'em.Dog-la seems to digest these perfectly; I sometimes see pieces of other rawhides in the pooper-scooper, but not these.  And he's a definite fan.  He won't eat some types of rawhide (especially flavored ones), but he he gets all eager and pushy when I pull these out, as if to say, "good human, GOOD human! Now, release. Drop it, drop it! NOW, gimme, gimme, gimmmeee!"  6 months of daily use, and he's still madly in love.  And he's not getting fat on them.EDIT to add: Dog-la did "choke" on one of these.  He started breathing funny and kind of clearing his throat - he was still breathing, but it stuck in the back of his mouth and after a couple minutes he hadn't cleared it on its own.  I freaked out a little, but it was easy to grab and pull it out - he then finished chewing it (yuck).  I keep a couple week supply of these in a tub for easy access, where they dry out a bit, so that may make them a little harder to chew.  I'll still buy them.  I've had food get wedged in my mouth the wrong way (luckily, I have fingers, so I can pull it out) and I'm not a complete and utter pig like my dog. LOL  I don't think having a flat object lay flat in the dog's mouth and slip back where he can't quite chew it is a product defect at all.  But I no longer give him rawhides unattended, ever.

Our dogs go through so much rawhide, I thought it would be a good idea to buy a bag in bulk but was a little scared that I might end up with something low quality that I didn't want to feed my dogs--this rawhide exceeded my expectations--great value, great quality, shipped quickly and the the dogs love it.  It's also not from China, which I also give two thumbs up!

This was a very large bag of rawhide chips for the money.  The only complaint I would have is quite a few of them are just too small for my dogs to chew.  I have large dogs, so the ones that are 2" square are too small.  I would say maybe 10% of the bag contained small ones.  Still a good deal I would say.

column9: These Are MOST EXCELLENT Rawhide Chews
column10: I was very happy with these rawhide chews.  Most of them were very thin, which is JUST the way my dogs like them.

I have been ordering these for a while.  My dogs have always liked them until the last batch.  All of a sudden, they do not like them and just leave them lying around.  I thought they smelled funny, like a chemical smell when I first opened the bag, so I called the company.  They said that they would check into it, and sent me a box of replacement dog goodies. Guess I never thought much more about it until I read some of the reviews about these chews making dogs sick.  Guess I won't buy them anymore...

column9: Makes my dogs go "NOM NOM NOM!"
column10: This is a good deal. A great deal cheaper than buying any size bags in local stores. If you have two big dogs who can chew through rawhides at an alarming rate, this is a good deal.I only give this 4 stars because of sometimes wild inconsistencies in the bag - some are very thick (~0.75") and some are paper thin. With two large dogs who will literally eat anything (including inorganic items that were once, at some time in history, touching or in close contact with food) this isn't a concern, but for folks with smaller dogs, this could pose a problem.A couple of the negative reviews on here said this product made their dogs sick. I've gone through about 6 bags with no such problems. Granted, one of my dogs has eaten 10 ears of corn, cobs included, along with enough cat food (very occasionally the "litter box buffet") to create regional shortages.In conclusion: A great deal that will make your best friend(s) very happy.
My dogs loves these chips after they have their meal, my Vet is always so amazed how good thier teeth look, no tater build up.

they are the best thing in the world my dogs love them never been sick from them i think most of the hype of dogs being sick is made up probably from people trying to sell their own dog treats... any way my dogs love them!!!

column9: Inedible and dangerous!!!!!  DO NOT BUY!!!
column10: I had ordered these rawhide chips in the past and they were terrific.  Over the past 2 months or so, they changed distributers.  Upon receiving the bag of rawhide, I opened the bag to give one to my dog and an overwhelming stench of Ammonia came out of the bag.  There was no way my dog would get one of these. I repackaged it up to send back but you CAN'T RETURN this item per Amazon policy.  So, I am out the $26.  I am so angry!!!  I wish I could give negative stars for the product and Amazon.

I have been buying this product regularly for over a year, and my dogs love them. They became unavailable for a while, and are now back, but it is absolutely not the same product as I was getting previously. The rawhides in the new bags do not seem to be of as high quality as before (they are not as white and have a different texture), and they smell VERY strongly of chemicals. If this was a solvent used in the treatment of the rawhide, I would expect it to evaporate off, but this smell persists, even leaving the bag sitting open for days.I complained of this after the receiving the first recent bag from amazon, and they considerately sent me a replacement, but it is just as bad. I tried rinsing the rawhides well in water, which seems to help with the smell, and gave one to each of my dogs, and they loved them as much as always and showed no adverse effects. However, I don't think I can continue to use them -- the smell is really alarming.

Bernie, my 60-65 pound labrador retriever, loves these strips. I give her about 1 per day. The rawhide strips are on the order of 2-3 inches by 5-7 inches. They vary in thickness, but I'd say the majority of the strips are of slightly thin to normal thickness.The five pound bag is resealable, though it's not the toughest of plastics. I've received some bags that have some small holes from being punctured by the rawhide strips.The strips come from Brazil, purportedly from grass fed cows, which is excellent. I've noticed that most of the options I have in local stores are made in China. I'm not comfortable getting food products from China, given their recent past history with tainted pet foods.The Amazon price at more than a quarter of a Benjamin feels steep, though when you consider you're getting five pounds and consider the price per pound, it's actually a good value compared to local options (at least for me).

My dog has chewed a lot of rawhide in his almost 7 years of life.  This was a great find because it was very nicely priced.  For some strange reason though, these seem to get caught in his throat.  I don't recall other rawhide posing a choking hazard like these chips.  After my dog is done with a chip, I have to fish out whatever is caught.  He's never had a serious consequence but I can't imagine what it would be like to have this chunk of rawhide lurking in the back of his throat for very long.  So, just like any other chew exercise, supervise your dog.

column9: Good product but size is inconsistent.
column10: My dogs, two Lab mixes, love these chews.  The only problem is that the size of them is inconsistent.  The last bag I received they were all about a foot long.  The latest bag they are all about 4" - 5" long.  I think the shorter size works better because I feel the larger size is just too much and the with the smaller ones the bag will last longer.

column9: Excellent value for quantity and high quality
column10: First thing is first. The value for this bag is EXCELLENT. 5 lb's of rawhide from grass-fed cows that aren't bleached for around $25 is one of the best deals out there. It's the epitome of why Amazon is Amazon. I always come to Amazon to search for the best values on products that I use daily in my life to see if I can lower my overall expenses via buying in bulk.When I got this bag in the mail I was shocked at how large the back really is. 5 lbs of rawhide is a lot of rawhide!I have a small chihuahua that is about 8 lbs. So, needless to say, I expect a 5 lb bag to last at least a year, even with me giving some of the bones away to friends.My dog is a chew FREAK. He is always chewing on some form of rawhide or bully stick and after doing some research I saw that there were different types of rawhide. Some were bad for dogs due to bleaching and coming from unhealthy animals, so I found these, which *seem* to be from healthy cows and in their natural state.As mentioned in other reviews, the chips can be really thick, which is really nice. It gives a nice sturdy chew for your dog to enjoy and is a good size.*UPDATE*I am editing this because I previously marked these down because my dog was ignoring them. Since that time my dog has gone through quite a few of these and they've turned into an excellent treat for him.These chews have caused no issues with him health wise - not a single one. I've given some to my friends and their dogs have loved them too. They have no odor, they don't get too "slimy" like some chews can get and when he gets to the "end" and there's just a little bit left it becomes really soft and he's able to chew it until it's small enough for him to finish and I don't worry about him choking because he's really good at chewing something thoroughly before swallowing and they become really soft.So, I take back my lower rating and give these a 5 star because they've turned into a great treat for the price and I still have a whole bin full of them after all this time (small dogs have their perks).

column9: Put my dog in the hospital
column10: I have a black lab/border terrier mix.  She hasn't had any problems with any other rawhide (even the cheap brands).  These made her violently sick with excessive vomiting and diarrhea (I was up all night taking her out every 20 minutes).  This went on for 24 hours with no signs of stopping. She became severely lethargic.  She wouldn't drink water or eat food and our vet decided that we should bring her in to put her on fluids because she became so dehydrated.  In the end it cost $175 in vet bills.  Today she is back to normal and the rawhides are at a garbage dump somewhere.Amazon refunded our money with no problems whatsoever and I would still highly recommend them to consumers.
If your dog goes through dog chews as fast as mine do, this is a great buy!  The chews were good quality too!

What happened? We've been buying these rawhides for over a year and they were thin for the most part, but the last 2 bags the chips were so thick that I ended up giving them to dog shelters. Our dogs are labs not small dogs but the rawhides are so thick, they can't chew them. Disappointing to say the least. I wish there was a way to order them thin.

I purchased these chips for my greyhound, who gets one rawhide chip per day as a treat when he is crated.  I paid twenty bucks for the bag, making the cost four dollars per pound.  Typically I buy my chips at Agway, and pay more.  These chips were great because they are not flavored - they do not leave a beef or chicken colored residue on his bed.  They are the typical size, ranging from 3 to 5 inches square.  Some are thick, some are thin.  These did not make my dog sick at all.  He is used to rawhide and only gets diarrhea from eating those large rawhide rolls or bones (which he gets only rarely).  I would highly recommend this product to anyone with a dog who loves rawhide!

This is a nice big bag, well-priced, of flat rawhides.  If that's what your dog likes, these are perfect.  I'd given my dogs rawhide bones and twists before and they like them...but for some reason these flat rawhides aren't nearly as popular with them.  I have to put some peanut butter on them to get them to chew on them for any amount of time.  It's going to take us a really long time to get through this bag.

This is one of the best purchases I've ever made for my 2 dogs. They love these bones and when they eat them, they finally leave my wife and me alone for a few minutes! The bag is huge and it lasts a lot longer than any other combination of rawhide purchases I could have made somewhere else.
Paris is a Yorkie, loves me to throw the Rawhide so she can capture it. Provides hours of chewing enjoyment.

Both our dogs love these.  1 each will keep them busy for about 5 minutes.  They have never chocked on them or anything.  This is the only product on amazon that we have a subscription to get this every 2 months.  It's a huge bag and the price is great.
Great!  Dogs love them and really helps keep their teeth clean.All 4 Dogs get at least 1/2 each day.  Thanks.

column9: Green Cow Rawhide, Natural chips for dogs
column10: The rawhide chips are clean and easy for my older Golden Retriever to chew. She loves them. Hallanger

column9: These raw hides are the best!!
column10: My dogs love these "chewies"!!  I also love them, the ones I recieved are very white, thin to medium thickness, and just right for chewing!.

column9: This is one big bag of rawhides!
column10: We just got the package today, and five pounds of rawhide is a lot more than you might think. They are mostly thin, square or rectangular shaped pieces about 2 1/2 inches wide, of a good size for a medium-sized dog like ours. I'm not quite sure how many there are, but this bag is going to last a very long time for us. Very happy dog this evening, and I'm happy to have a more natural product and a very good price at about $5.20 per pound.

column9: Fantastic and healthy for all dogs
column10: I am so thrilled to find a rawhide that is from free range cows (hopefully this means grass fed) for my dog. Being a dauschund, he really needs something to chew. Since he destoys every type of toy, even the supposed "tough" ones, this is a great thing for him. Dauschunds, even though they are small, have very strong jaws and were bread to seek out badgers (one of the most viscious animal out there).Also no preservatives, that means no formaldehyde which other rawhides have,which can not be good for them! Would you eat soemthing with formaldehyde?No coloring is great so it does not leave stains on the rugs or his bed.I have been giving him a rawhide in the morning for years, so am not sure why others have heard it is bad for their dogs. My vet even thinks it is a good idea since, as I said, dauschunds really need to chew.I very highly recommend this to anyone who gives hawhide to their dogs, or has a dog that "needs" to chew.Of course, like anything I have purchased from Amazon or through Amazon, it arrived quickly and is exactly what they described.

we have 3 dogs of various size (15 lbs, 50lbs, 80lbs) and they all liked different kinds of rawhide-chews until we got this bag... all 3 dogs love these!! It seems that they satisfy the desire to chew on something substantial, but are still "soft" enough that they are enjoyable the entire time (pressed rawhides can be too hard, rope/fabric toys are WAY to soft.)  great product when balanced with this price! In fact, I'm here writing a review because I'm ordering another bag... :)
bought this product several times - dogs love it - all natural and helps tremendously clean their teeth. i recommend it strongly.
My two dogs weren't crazy about these at first (they are used to flavored hides), but now they love them. Not many thick ones, but still a great value.

I love this product b/c you really get more than what you pay for.  The chewies are different sizes in the bag so my babies can pick what they want.  With 3 big dogs, I went through them alot.  It seems that this bag is so big that they last a little longer.  The best part is they are always available and super fast delivery!  Wal#@$t were always out and it would take up to 3 months before they may get 5 bags.  Dogs with chewie withdraws IS NOT fun.

This was a first purchase of this product and the description sounded great along with the price. The product I normally purchase was not available. Within a half day of having eaten just one or two of the chips my dog has developed diarreah each time (about four times now).  Definitely not normal and has not occurred with other rawhide products.  I'm sure it's this product that is triggering it.  No issues since I have discontinued using. Does have a bad odor in the bag.  I will be discarding and unfortunately can't even consider donating to rescue groups.  It's not an allergy, it's a bad quality product.

I was very happy to once again see these are available.  For 5 lbs of rawhide, this is a great value!Every night, at bedtime, my two dogs each get what they know as a 'chewie'.  It's a part of their nightly routine that they really enjoy.The rawhide sizes are perfect for the larger dog but too large for the small, 5 lb dog.  To remedy this, I have cut them with a saw to a more suitable size.  Works great!Although some dogs may not be able to tolerate these type of 'treats', my dogs have not experienced any problems at all.  My dogs absolutely love them!!
Three 90 lb dogs  2 goldens and a german shepherd love these. No adverse effects. They are large enough and thick enough that they do not get stuck in their throats. Great product.

column9: Great product- just ask our dogs!!
column10: We really like these chews- I should say, the dogs do. The price was great and we had it on subscribe & save- just found out it was cancelled by Amazon. :(  I hope it returns soon!We liked the variety of sizes of chips- certainly let one know these are natural products- but also because we have a big chocolate lab and a little silky terrier!! The thinner pieces made them easier to cut with penny shears for the small dog.We never had a problem with our dogs getting sick from these chews and are very satisfied.  Hope to see them back soon!

The brand I usually give my dogs has become a hit 'n miss findable item at the stores so I ordered 'Green Cow'.  I find that  My dogs still prefer the 'beef' or 'chicken' flavored chew flips they are used to and they get them when I can provide them.  'Green Cow' is a large, thick rawhide chew toss (6-7" L x 2.5-3" W).  I cut one in half using a jig saw to give to my smaller dog.  It's a bit thick for her.  'Green Cow' is a very good quality and something I trust and provide for my three dogs.

column9: Great Value, But Makes Dog Sick
column10: I bought this product because it is a great deal, rawhides in any brick and mortar store are outrageous, so I was very excited about this deal. However; this product makes my dog throw-up, and I know its not just rawhides in general because I have given her other ones with no difficulty. I also noticed she is not as interested in these rawhides as she has been in past brands (although this is not an issue because they as getting thrown either way. I have not contacted the seller about this yet but will be in the next couple days. I contacted amazon and they had great customer service and said they would look into the issue.

We have 8 canines of various breeds, age and size. There is no 1 size fits all for us.These rawhide chips are the absolute best in quality we have found. The teeth cleaning ability of them is a God-send, the taste is enjoyed by our '4-paw kids', and..they last which gives them a good chewing session. I hope they come out with a smaller chip for our 'little kids' so they can have some as well. This particular product size is for larger dogs (80lb to 100+lb)which is hard to find. 1/2 the size of the original would be perfect for the smaller dogs (up to 50lb).We love these chews and will promote them to friends and relatives as well as anyone that will listen. Our dogs love them and their teeth sparkle!A superior product!
5 pounds of rawhides will last you quite and while, and my dog loved them! Nice and small to not fill him up too much but gives him something to do!

Honestly, we got these because it was cheaper per pound than the regular chips we buy. Our dog doesn't like them as much, but she also doesn't hate them so much that she finds other, inappropriate things to chew. One time I gave her one of these  and she took it into her bed, but fifteen minutes later I saw the chip outside her bed while she stared at it wistfully. I didn't even know dogs were capable of being wistful about a rawhide chip.

MY TWO LARGE DOGS JUST LOVE THESE CHEWS.  THEY ARE LONG SO THEY CAN HOLD THEM WITH THERE FRONT PAWS AND CHEW AWAY.  THEY ARE A GREAT VALUE AT ABOUT $5 PER POUND IN A FIVE POUND SACK WITH FREE SHIPPING.  I WILL ORDER THESE AGAIN.  SOME DOG CHEWS CAN UPSET MY DOG'S STOMACH...AS THE ONE HAS IRRITABLE BOWEL SYNDROME.  BUT THESE ARE OKAY.

From previous reviews I worried about huge variations in size, while there some different sizes (which is good), there are very few scrapy pieces. Quality looks very good, super deal, for a little more than you would pay for 2 pounds at Walmart, you get 5 pounds of better chips

After reading other reviews, I decided to try these. Many of the chews are too big for my 40lb Schnauzers, but a jigsaw took care of that; we cut most of the chews in half.We had been using another brand but over time, the chews were getting smaller and smaller so we had to throw out about 20% of the package.All in all, these work well and the dogs like them. We can also report no stomach problems whatsoever.

I love the green rawhide chips. The bag is large and a great dental workout for my five dogs. I also enjoy the fact that I am getting the chips as a monthly subscription. I don't have to keep remembering to order more rawhides.
Very good rawhides. No digestive problems. Keeps dogs busy. My only complaint would be that they are big for toy dogs (but my lil guys still enjoy them).

After reading the other reviews about dogs getting sick on these I was hesitant to make a purchase. I usually purchase rawhide chips at walmart but could no longer find any at any stores in my area or online. I finally decided what the hell I'll give em a try. I was surprised to find how large these were when they arrived which was sooner than expected and at a decent price too. I have a black lab and a dachshund so I need small and large chips (good thing I have a band saw). I was able to cut three to five chips out of each which was perfect as these chips will last me many months. BTW my dogs never got sick on these chips so I don't know what that's all about.
I would like to know the approximate size of the rawhide chips. The last bag I received had chips that were twice the size of the chips in the previous bag.

column9: Tasty rawhide chews at a GREAT price!
column10: I have been purchasing these dog chews for almost a year using subscribe and save. I have a 30 lb beagle and 75 lb Pyrenees-Brittany mix, and they both LOVE these chews. My big dog asks for one every morning. Sometimes the chews will not be cut in half (imagine a full foot long rawhide chew, instead of being cut in half down to a 6inch long chew), but that just means it keeps my dogs occupied for twice as long. I haven't seen any diarrhea or stomach issues as a result of these chews.You get what you see - a GIANT 5 lb bag of rawhide dog chews. I've shopped around at Petsmart, Petco, Pet Supplies Plus, and my local grocery stores, and if you have a dog that likes to chew, this is going to be the most cost-effective, get-your-money's-worth option. $22 gets me rawhide chews for TWO dogs for a MONTH. You just can't beat that.
The price is excellent, the chips are big suckers though, some are longer than my dogs!! However I can cut them so it is a good deal.

The price certainly is right but for our two dog's (Lab and German Short Hair) chew treat experience nearly half of the chews are too large and much too thick. In competitor's products there are always some of the large/thick chews that I need to cut in half using a tin shears. With Green Cow many chews are so thick they will have to be sawed. We will use them up eventually but I have cancelled my subscription for periodic repeat orders. Just didn't work out for us!!

column9: Great price, my dog loves these!
column10: Can't believe what a huge bag of chips you get for the price.  My pitbull gets two of these every day--we have ordered them probably 6 times now.  EXCELLENT value!
These rawhide treats are a great value for the money. My 3 dogs love them! If they have it at this price, I will continue my subscription forever!

My 8 year old dog and 6 month old puppy love these! I give them 1-2 per day because they love to chew. I am almost finished with the first bag and there have been no problems that other users have mentioned. Great price and the dogs love them!

My dogs get a variety of rawhide bones, from dingo's to the generic Wal-Mart rawhides. My German Shepherd and Boxer loveGreen Cow Rawhide Dog Bones, Natural Chips, 5-Pound Bag rawhide bones and with the costs of these bones skyrocketing, I was looking for a bulk pack that was affordable. I found it in the Green Cow listing here on Amazon. We ordered, and it arrived, very surprisingly, the next day. The good news is that this is a large bag and most of all, has not upset the sensitive stomach of my 120lb big GSD baby and my sweetie Boxer is very happy with her new treats.  I have recommended this product to friends and family and will be ordering on a regular basis.

Unfortunately, my dog has apparently become very picky in her old age. I've bought her rawhide from various places online and in stores, but haven't, until recently, had any problems with her not wanting to eat them.  These rawhide look very good. They are clean, smooth, and a good size.  I've given her multiple chips because she'll eat one, and not the other. I kept trying because she would eat one, and seemed happy with it; then the next day, she would put it down and walk away.Bottom line, I believe this to be a good product and a great value for the money. Just not sure if the issue is with the rawhide itself, or my dog's changing preferences. She didn't like the bag of rawhide I bought right before this one either.

column9: My Wheaten Terrier Mix Loves Them
column10: The Green Cow Rawhide Chips are a great treat for your dog.  The chips vary in size and shape, but most are about 6" long by 2.5" wide.  Most of the chips are wafer-thin, but some are slightly thicker.My 25-pound Wheaton Terrier mix gets one a day (when she's been a good girl) and she enjoys eating and tossing the treat around the house.
