just like home;I grew up in cincinnati and thought I would never again enjoy the "taste of home",until I tried this product!It was delicious,and just like "being there" again(I live on the east coast)nowAfter about 35 years,I again enjoyed the taste of home

This is a very good chilli mix for Cincinnati style chilli.  It reminds me of the great chilli parlors when I lived there. Yummy! Recommend you serve it over spaghetti, topped with kidney beans, green onions and sharp cheddar cheese.

I was born in Cinci and have ties there.  My mom made something like this growing up and I found this at Kroger many years ago, but cannot buy it anywhere and must buy online.  I make it all the time and love it.  Better than Skyline anyday.

Our neighbor brought a packet of this stuff back with him as a gift for us.  3 years later I am still hooked.  We don't eat beef, so we substitute it with chicken and actually make it a more of a crockpot style type of chili and we love it (and so does everyone we have served it to).  Great taste.  I have never been to cincinnati so have nothing to compare it with, but I really like the flavor of this.

This is the one and only Cincinnati Chili mix.  I am so happy I can get this gourmet delight on Amazon.If you are not familiar with Cincinnati Chili, it is different from traditional chili.  It has a Geek influence with hints of cinnamon and spices.  But it is hearty and delicious for any occasion.

We love Cincinnati Chili. I purchased the seasoning mix and I really like it. The directions are easy. Since we cannot get that famous dish here in California, it is the next best thing to visiting one of Cincinnati's  chili parlors. We like it over spaghetti with onions and cheddar cheese, lots of cheddar cheese. Yum!

This mix was given to me originally by someone from Cincinnati. But in the East Coast city where I live, can't find it anywhere. Good mixture of spices, keeps for years, a nice recipe you can make which is a little different but tasty and quick. Always a hit when I make it.
This product is great, full of flavor and so easy to make.
Great stuff.  Easy to make and a nice meal(s) every month or so.  Great to share with friends.

We used to get this chili mix in Sacramento when my husband worked there and we lived in LA.  I would visit him on the weekends and make this chili for him.  It was so easy and delicious.  He is from Cleveland so it was a taste of home for him.  We had not been able to find it in LA so I was delighted when I found I could order it through Amazon.  We have already had it at our family night dinner once and we are having it again tonight!  It was a huge hit! I had to re-order the 12 pack to share with family members.
To me, it's not chili without beans.  To my family from Cincinnati, THIS is chili.  They're nice people though, so I like them anyway.

I used to live in Cincy, now in California.  Thank goodness Cincinnati Chili comes in a package!  I bought 12 so I won't run out for awhile.  This is the best spiced chili ever and so easy to make. Thanks!

column9: My picky friends really loved it
column10: I bought the items for friends who specifically asked for this brand, as their family was from the mid west and they missed the flavor. They seemed very satisfied with the taste, so I would recommend the product based on their reactions.

column9: Not the Real Deal for Skyline Chili
column10: This is definitely not the real deal for Skyline Chili.  I was very dissappointed with the end result.  Taste was a bit stronger than what you get at the restaurant.  I will not purchase again.

I got tricked into buying 12 of these, its got WAY TOO MUCH SODIUM!its not Skyline chilli, read the package first.  This one makes my Hypertention go wild.THIS CHILLI HAS 800+ MG of sodiumGOLDSTAR CHILI PACKET 580MG of Sodiumif you're looking for Powder packets of Chilli I recomend GoldstarSkyline doesnt sell non Canned chilli packets.JJ

As a former Cincinnatian, short a special trip to Cincinnati, this is a wonderful alternative. I used it when I lived in Cincy ... and now in CA.  I use it here for theme dinners (both the spaghetti and a chili dog) with friends ... always a hit.  I suggest adding less water initially or reducing the amount of water via extended simmering.  The former maybe a better approach so less gas or electricity is used.
This "Chili" is the best!!! Especially, the myriad ways to fix it. Service was especially fast and good. Will do again when I need more!!!

If you love Cincinnati chili and can't afford to buy the cans, then this is the way to go.  I usually buy this at least once or twice a year and give some to my family members and friends.  It is as close to Skyline chili as you can get.  We love it in our family, and as long as it is on sale here we will be buying it.
If you are a fan of Skyline Chili but don't have access to it anymore, this stuff is great.  Tastes just like Skyline. Top off a hotdog with cheese and onions and look out!

Cincinnati chili is good.  I found out about it when traveling for business and it can't be bought were I live so I looked for the best deal online without buying an over abundant of packages.  This is what I found.  It was delivered in satisfactory time.

A friend introduced us to Cincinnati Chili.  Their parents mail these packets to them, because they sell this in the stores in Ohio, but you can't find this in California.  I was so excited when I found this on Amazon!  I ordered it, it arrived promptly and very well packaged.  I love this stuff!
First of all, this stuff is YUMMY!  And it's really easy to prepare.  My package was shipped very quickly and exactly as advertised.

It's great to have a way to purchase this product outside of Cincy! My order arrived extremely fast, well before the estimated shipping date.  Thanks for making this delicious and unique chili more widely available!
We love Cincinnati chili!  This is a quick easy way to have lots of chili.
This product is very good and easy to make. If you like both Spaghetti and Chili this product is for you!!
The packs of Chili Spaghetti mix arrived quickly by mail. It was so nice to be able to buy them without having to bother friends to buy and mail them to us!
This order came very fast We used to live in Cincinnati and Dayton and love that we can get our favorite Chili  Order came very fast and for good value.Mary

I used to live in Cincinnati and I was excited to taste that Cincinnati Skyline Chili again...this is not it.  It was not a bad taste but it was not what I was expecting.  I would not recommend this for anyone who knows Cincinnati chili.

We originally found these Club bars while we were on vacation in England..and they were instantly our favorite candy bar.  Unfortunately, when we got back to the US we couldn't find these bars anywhere...until now!  Our order arrived much quicker than we expected and the bars were just like we remember.  MMMMmmmm!

I buy this gum for my sister. She says it helps her to breathe better when she chews this gum. This gum costs so much more in all of the other stores that I use to buy it from. For the price you can't beat it.

This package of Winterfresh is the same as the kind you find in the stores.  When I looked at the packaging, I thought it was something new but it is the same as the 5 stick packs, but these are 15 stick packs.The packaging is slim and can fit in your backpack with no problem.  nice to have 15 sticks in a pack with a "crush proof" box to leave in my backpack.Nice minty flavor, and great to chew after having a meal or smoke.
This is the best gum ever! Can't find this particular gum anymore in Costco so this is the best bet.No problems with the order.
Best value on your dollar with this multi-pack. I buy it for my son since it's his favorite brand and flavor - no complaints at all, plus fast shipping.
Received packaged and by expected date. No damage to packaging.  Love chewing this gum as it freshens my breath.  Also it lasts long.

The sugar comes out almost immediately, then it turns into a goopy mess for the next 5 minutes until it finally starts to stiffen up. I admit I don't like gum that much, but this is awful. Maybe I just got a bad batch or something.

Molina vanilla has always been my favorite. It has such a robust flavor that it makes everything taste better. I used to be able to buy it in Mexico, but living in the northeast makes that a little difficult. I was so excited to find this 12-pack for a great price!

Even thought I did not need a 12 pack I love to bake with Molina Vanilla so I purchased this item from  you only to find out the the description and the product are not the same thing .I received 12 bottled of Molina  Vanilla Blend in the mail , now I have to go throught  the hassle to calling Fed ex to pick them the box up and send it  back. Very frustrating

column9: Excellent! Have been using it for years.
column10: I stumbled accross this product a few years ago when I got tired of paying the grocery store prices for real vanilla.  This product's blend of real vanilla and vanillin tastes great and saves us a bundle, especially this 12 pack.  It's going to last us a few years.  I recommend it highly.

I have been using Molina Vanilla for a number of years as I used to live near the Mexican border and would go to Mexico in person to purchase it.  We have found through experience it far exceeds that which one can purchase in the grocery store and much less expensive.  Great in all cooking and especially in home made ice cream!
This is the best mix for pancakes and waffles. Nothing else compares.But paying $24.50 is outrageous. I buy this at Sam's Club for $6.38!

I have a pancake junkie in my house and this, by FAR, is the absolute best mix available on the market.  It's just so very light, just like cake flour when you use it.  The only one i've found that's better is the Pioneer brand and that's only sold in the South.  Being a Northerner, I just have to suffer through but this brand is a very close second.  It's SO easy just to make one pancake too - just 1/2 cup of this and a 1/4 cup of water and it's in the pan!  Great for busy school mornings, especially with chocolate chips.  I also add an egg into the mix to give it more protein so the kids can make it to lunch without starving.  Great, great product, LOVE it! Highly recommend!
I've made waffles for over 40 years.  I followed the instructions.Two bites of this heavy, rubber garbola and the ten pound bag went in the trash can.

This like all Krusteaz products is simply outstanding, which can't be said for most "add water only" mixes. It is particularly well suited for a really large family or a vacation cottage not continually used. Kids actually prefer this to time consuming scratch 'cakes, although adding a few fresh berries, a little corn or oatmeal is popular, too. Only poor packing that resulted in minor spillage prevents a five star review.
Love this pancake mix.  This is the only brand we have used n years.
This stuff is wonderful.  I have always been amazed at how great the taste when all you add is water.  You can use it for waffels by just adding a bit less water for the thicker batter.Chas

column9: Absolutely the best pancake and waffle mix ever!!!
column10: Just add water!  It doesn't get any easier than that!  I've been using Krusteaz brand pancake/waffle mix for years.  It's absolutely the best on the market!
I AM VERY DISSAPPOINTED THAT I PAID THIS PRICE FOR THE PRODUCT. I DISCOVERED THAT WALMART HAS THE SAME PRODUCT ONLINE FOR %7.42.

I am satisfied with the taste and the product.  It does what it says and while it is not the most gourmet, it is good for the money.  I would buy this product again.  If mixed right the pancakes are fluffy.

I always buy Krusteaz Pancake Mix from our local warehouse store.  Let me tell you, ten pounds is *a lot* of pancakes.  My kids love the flavor, and I like it because it's so quick and easy.  What could be quicker than "just add water"?  Mix until the batter is slightly lumpy, just a few strokes, then cook.  The pancakes come up nice and fluffy.  We always keep a bag of this around the house for those mornings when I want to feel like I'm cooking -- but not.

I think this is the best waffle mix I've ever eaten, An my whole family agree's. The pancakes are good an light too! I shop at Sam's club an it is alot cheaper there. So save some money but do try the mix,its GREAT!! ITS CHEAPER TO BUY IT IN THE 2LB BOXES ON AMAZON.................
I have tried many types of pancake mixes and this one does nothing for me. Even the Food Lion buttermilk pancake mix that you just add water to tastes better.

Happy is the word for extreme trail mix in a granola bar.  The texture is good and chewy, the family really likes to have these bars for all occasions.  Most of the time is when they are hunger for candy, this is so much better.

I usually rotate between several brands of moist dog food to keep breakfast interesting for our JRT.  This product is wonderful to have on hand and our dog loves it.It's the moist food I normally stock up on when we plan to be away and our friend tends our pet.  It's extremely quick and easy to tear, empty and toss the individual packets.I'm glad Amazon sells it since many of our grocers seem to offer only individual packets.
My dogs absolutely love this stuff. I put it over their dry food and they eat it all because everything is coated in gravy. I only wish I had bought a larger supply!

Since I know I will be needing this item on a regular basis, it is quite beneficial to me to order this through a subscription. Plus, I get the reduced price. The reduced price is better than any I can acquire from any store (except when on sale). The packaging is great because I can stack the unopened boxes in the pantry. I can also use the opened box as storage with easy access to the packs. I use this as a "gravy" for my dogs' hard food so do not use a full pack each time. The box allows me to sit the opened pack in the box to prevent spills.
We always feed our Boston Terrier this brand of wet food....she likes a variety and this fits the bill since each packet has either beef or chicken in either sauce or gravy. She loves to eat them.
My little puppies love this food, I ordered this 3food times and have no bad comments...Thanks for making my puppy experience a good one

column9: SMELLS SO GOOD THAT EVEN A HUMAN'S MOUTH WATERS!  LOL
column10: Now this is a 5-Star meal in a little pouch! When I tear open a pouch of Pedigree Little Champions Grilled Flavors Variety Pack for Dogs it smells so yummy that I think I've just made dinner, but my 5 rescue dogs know better .... they know those little, delicious, mouth-watering pouches are for them! Easy to order online at Amazon, easy on the pocketbook, easy to store in my cabinets, easy to tear open and pour over kibble, and so easy for even the most stubborn eater to gobble down their dry kibble and think they are getting a Thanksgiving Dinner at every meal!

I have two little dogs - one Boston Terrier and one picky Miniature Dachshund.  The Boston Terrier tends to eat anything, and produces the gas to prove it.  The Miniature Dachshund is very, very picky.Both of them eat Pedigree Little Champions, and it produces *less* gas in the Boston Terrier than other foods (I serve this product with kibble).I'm pleased to be able to purchase this from Amazon, too, on the monthly order schedule. :)

On Sale for less than ELEVEN bucks and Super Saver Shipping Eligible what's not to love? Oh, the dog enjoys it very much! An issue with his usual dry dog food caused me to find "mix-ins" to get my pooch to each his usual grub. This fit the bill well, his tummy issues do not permit having canned type dog food by itself. Therefore I can't tell you about his reaction to eating this by itself.

I feed my terrier's a dry, healthy dog food; however during their dinner; I mix the Pedigree Little Champions in with their dry food.They go CRAZY! I have never seen dog's eat so fast; and then continue to lick the bowl even when there's nothing left inside.Great buy! Great find! And Great taste!

I bought this food as an additive to my dog's regular dry dog food.  My dog, who is actually quite large, has shown less and less interest in her dry food.  Now that I mix the two together she can't get enough!  Pedigree Little Champions has made life easier for me and my pet.

My dog loves getting this mixed in with a little bit of dry food. I have a small pom so i give her a tiny scoop of dry food and then 1/2 a packet of whatever flavor i grab and she loves it. I will be a long time customer
This was a no brainer.  I bought it on sale so it was less expensive than the grocery store and had free shipping.  My dog loves this brand and it is a no mess no fuss package.

Love this honey, love the taste, it is a bit pricey, but well worth it. I like to use it in an olive oil and lemon dressing to help cut the acid.  Also in a little bit of plain seltzer with fresh lemon juice for lemonade.

This is absolutely delicious honey.  I don't know about the health benefits.  I was having a spoonful a day for about three weeks.  Didn't notice anything health-wise, but the taste is natural and amazing.
Found this product at the Gfaf expo in Naperville. Daughter loved them so much we needed to order the refills one week later. Definitely a must have in college.
Great Product - Thanks!! Great Seller!! Needed this for fall pumpkin cupcakes!Should have gotton 3 or 4 more, but will have to order later.
I received the product overnight and it arrived completely defrosted and starting to rot, the smell was very bad. Unfortunately a waste of money.
No Bones, No cleaning required. Took just minutes to prepare. Before I knew it, I had my favorite dish of ackee and salt fish with the same great taste.
I moved to Birmingham Alabama and there are no salted fish. This is the best ever with akee or by itself with your favourite dishes.

I would not take the risk to eat this fish as it is from China.  Wish it was said in the description because here I lost 15.69 for one pound of wet fish (thought it was dried but it came with lot of water as the weather is hot I am also afraid it might have gone bad with such hot weather.Again, I will not eat it.

Since I left Florida over four years ago it's been a challenge to find this in Chicago. I too was skeptical what the quality of this would be like once received. I finally cooked this today, of course after letting is soak for a day. I love it. Just as good as what my mother made and that use to cook with in Florida.  I am glad I bought two packs!
I bought a case two months ago and just placed another order today! I use a couple bags at a time and add a bag or two of mint bags. So tasty!
I love these sprouts and my Sprout Master.  The service from the company was great.

I agree with the other reviewer. I bought this from a local store because I could not wait to try it....the flavor sounded so good. What a letdown!!! I was choking after the first sip from the completely awful taste! Don't waste your money like I did.

I love coconut water and it is pretty expensive, so I took a chance figuring the acai pomegranet might be pretty good. It is not. It tastes like some kind of yucky medicine you had to take as a child. I could not even choke down a second sip.

column9: HOT COCOA - MUST ADD MILK - NOTINSTANT
column10: The item description is lacking here.  There are 4 packets/servings in each box. So you get 12 totaal servings for the price.  Must add milk (not water).  I tired this as I read a review on hot cocoa in my local paper and this was rated #1.  It does taste really good.  I suggest splurging and make this with 2% or whole milk.  Dont make it with skin or 1% - at this price you want the full effect!

My husband and I are hot chocolate lovers.  WE have searched high and low for the perfect hot chocolate and have tried upwards of 10 different brands.  We found are perfect hot chocolate in this.  It is the best hot chocolate we have EVER tried and you can't go wrong with eithe the milk or dark.

One pack contain 2 milk and 2 dark cocoa pack. what about the taste? just say no more.however buying the whole tin could be more economic option. You really don't need to taste 'sample', just buy this one and enjoy the whole holiday season.

I've sampled different hot cocoa/chocolate in the recent months.  The Godiva Hot Cocoa is rich without being too rich and has just the right amount of sweetness that doesn't get in the way at all of the wonderful flavor.  It has a delicious distinctness from store bought brands and is a notch above the rest, in my opinion.  An "elegant" choice for hot cocoa lovers.  Thank you, Godiva!

This was the first time I bought this brand of gluten-free mac and cheese. The instructions said to boil until the noodles are the desired tenderness. I obviously didn't cook them long enough because they were really tough. I would have liked to have exact cooking instructions.  The cheese flavor was fantastic and I love that they didn't use any artificial dyes.

Great product.  I love the flavor and the zero calories makes this drink ideal for an energy drink, or just a tasty drink.  However, the price here is way overpriced.  Walmart sells these in a 4 pack for $5.99.  Buy 6 of them (24 cans) for 36 bucks...Product, 5 stars, price, 1 star...hence the rating

It's good to know that while i'm serving in Afghanistan, I can still get access to my favorite drinks. It took a little longer than i was expecting, they still arrived in the shipping window. The drinks were packaged safe and secure and arrived without any problems. If i need more, i'll be coming to these guys for it.

There isn't much to say that hasn't been said by Mr. Scoggins, so I'll keep it short. If you like energy drinks, but don't like the idea of intaking all the sugar and calories, then this is what you want to be drinking!

Case arrived damaged, only offered a return of item, are they joking? Really no value in buying this way, actually cheaper at a large liquor store, such as SPEC's here in Houston. No response initially from vendor until actual claim filed. Beware...

I conducted a taste test of six different brands of energy drinks and this one tasted the best.  I had tried one of them a long time ago and it had a strange taste I couldn't get used to despite what the kids at work told me.  This one tasted OK and was the only one that gave me the boost I wanted at the time. They are kind of expensive so I plan to use them sparingly.

column9: What else is there to say?
column10: Awesome taste, no calories and with the caffeine kick you need!  Sure you'll still die of a heart attack, but at least now you can do it while skinny!  :)

I think that this is the best Monster drink on the market right now, I used to be a die-hard rockstar drinker but I am officially converted!  Only thing to keep in mind when buying a case of this stuff is that it is heavy so shipping is a lot.
Product arrived on time, but about 6 of the 24 cans were banged up pretty good.  Nothing spilled, but tough to drink.

After I did some research on Americans' diet & diabetes and what not (my expanding pant size), I decided to reduce my carbs.  Which sadly meant cutting out my favorite energy drinks Monster & Rockstar.  Both brands have had low carb (diet) versions for a while, but they use artificial sweetners I'm not comfortable with & that, in my opinion, don't taste very good.Then along came Monster Absolutely Zero, sweetened with Erythritol, and I'm back in.I wish Monster would just make a non-enery drink with this sweetener & their flavor combinations, so that I could enjoy it later in the day, but at least I'm not chugging down 54 carbs per can in the regular stuff.I did mention that the taste is great right?  Yeah, that's a good thing.  Give it a try!

Having lived more than two decades in Los Angeles....with endless access to a variety of Mexican (and other) cuisines that use smoked Jalapeno chilis (i.e., chipotle), this sauce is a great find.  Some of the ways we've used it so far (and love it):  mixed 50/50 with mayonnaise yields the "Subway chipotle sauce" good for sandwiches, mixed 50/50 with Italian dressing makes a deliciously different salad dressing, as a marinade for pulled pork...makes excellent Carnitas, alone on grilled chicken breast,  in burritos and tacos with ground beef or roast beef, etc.  Have not tried it on seafood or fish (and probably won't; it would overpower those).  If you enjoy the flavor of chipotle, but want to save the time needed to make chipotle sauce from scratch, you'll enjoy this condiment.

column9: YES, we found an easy way to make Subway's Chipotle Sauce
column10: We searched all over the internet trying to find Subway's Chipotle sauce.  We were not interested in the various recipes we came across, too much time, effort, etc.  Then we found "Monkey's Monkey Farm" review, here, that stated if you mixed this sauce with an equal amount of mayo--you'd get Subway's Chipotle sauce.Well, my son absolutely LOVES subway's Sauce and wants their subs all the time, despite us making subs at home, all because Subway's tastes better due to the danged sauce.  So, even though I felt $21.00 was a lot of money for condiments, I bit the bullet and bought this sauce.I followed monkey's instructions, 50/50--and YIPPEEE, it tastes identical! If you are looking for Subway's Chipotle sauce, this is it!  Thanks Monkey!

column9: Taste great, just what i wanted
column10: First off, this is not glorified mustard, it is spicy chipotle sauce, someone i think didnt like the price so they had to cry about something.But, Mixed with good mayo, it does taste like Subways sauce, I mixed mine with regular Hellmann's, at a 1 1/2 tablespoon Hellmann's to 1 tablespoon Chipotle sauce, it was just the taste i was looking for, if you have a stronger tasting mayo or like it fairly spicey, mix it 50/50.The sauce was well worth the price and mixing it with mayo for sanwiches or burgers, the bottles will last a pretty good while.OH, try it on porkchops, it adds a nice kick to pork.
I wanted to try and create the Subway southwest sauce at home.  Mix a llittle mayonaisse with this, and it's very close!

I never run out of creativity when trying to eat simply and healthy. Creamy, spicy, way better than ketchup! Add to soups, casseroles, on chicken or fish, french fries or pasta. Put it on vegetables you don't like and they will taste delicious!

I bought this after reading other reviewer's comments about mixing it with mayo to imitate Subway's Southwest sauce. Kind of an expensive gamble as far as condiments go, but it would have paid off if the mixture was close enough. Unfortunately it wasn't. I love Subway's chipotle sauce, but I'm sad to say that this is NOT it -- no matter how much mayo you mix it with, it still tastes just a bit like spicy vomit.Two stars only because I feel bad faulting the product based on someone else's recommended use for it. I'm sure there's a better use for it, and at least now I have two and a half bottles left over to experiment with, though I'm not looking forward to it. Just don't buy it expecting Subway sauce or you may be as disappointed as I was.
This stuff is glorified mustard, there are better products of this type on the market. G King, Troy, AL

I have a small collection of finishing salts that I use for different things. This one is my favorite for things like salad and desserts. It's gorgeous with large crystal shapes that are very thin, some are just flakes, but other pieces are like shallow hollow pyramids. The flavor is mild and they have a nice snap which adds a textural interest to chocolates and candies.For more robust flavors, I prefer stronger flavored salts like smoked or Peruvian pink salts.

column4: Gail Volkert "Cat lover, kitchen gadget freak"
column10: This has a great, fresh, finishing salt. I personally prefer Murray River Pink Salt for the more delicate crunch, but I do like this for a change. Try both!

To those who believe salt is simply salt this should change a few minds. I've mainly used it as a finisher for salads and other dishes, however, in a bind had to use it in pickling as well and the results were fantastic.

This is the most flavorful salt you can imagine.  After you cook a nice thick steak and carve it, sprinkle a little of this salt on the cut side to make the meat pop in your mouth!!!  If you've never experimented with finishing salts, then this is a great starting point!
I love two cups of coffee in the morning, but the caffeine can get to me.  Using Half-Caff cups works perfectly and it tastes great!  I'd recommend this coffee to any K-cup guy or gal! :)
I drink nothing but half caff coffee. This coffee is so smooth and rich you can drink it late into the evening and still be able to go to sleep without the jitters

Having to eat gluten free I have tried almost every type of bar available and was pleasantly surprised when I got to try this bar- it was moist ,and delicious and tasted like a blueberry lemon cookie with big bursts of blueberries in it.I cannot wait to try the other flavors-Thanks Pamela for making another great tasting product !!

I eat ALOT of food bars.  I work,go to school,complete my ADL's, and well....I am just too lazy to cook and sometimes feed myself.  These are one of THEEE BEST bars I have had.  I don't have to make part of my exercise routine chewing these things, AND they tast NORMAL. No mediciney,vitaminey stench at all, only 180 calories and I can power one down in 90 seconds.

column9: A MUST for every gluten free diet
column10: Love, love, love the new Pamela's Whenever Bars.  The flavor is true to the name and the convenience can't be topped.  Perfect for the gluten free diet and also for insulin dependent diabetics.  They have found a way to make the carbs slowly digestable and the use of agave nectar gives a sweetness without the typical blood sugar spike from regular sugar.  Can be used as the perfect breakfast bar or afternoon snack.  Delicious!

column9: Still getting used to gluten-free foods
column10: I am new to the gluten-free world and am still exploring my options. These are certainly a good choice if you like blueberry and lemon flavors because that is exactly what they taste like. They are a soft cookie. I have nothing bad to say about them. From what I've tried on the gluten-free market, these are among the better choices. My friend's 6 year old really liked them so I gave her a box.
I purchased these bars for a quick breakfast expecting to be hungry in an hour. To my surprise I was good until lunch.They taste good too.

We have purchased Pamela's products in the past and guess we thought we couldn't go wrong.  Then we bought the lemon blueberry bars.  My daughter, who has Celiacs, doesn't like them..  I tried them and I don't like them.  Unfortunately, I have a case of whenever bars that no one likes.  For future reference, we will definitely purchase a sample before the case.

column9: Excellent taste and texture shame about the deceptive packaging
column10: First I have to say I purchased these from a specialist store and not Amazon but I will be placing a Subscription order for them soon. The product was moist with an almost fruit cake texture which was perfect for me. The flavours where bold and I was excited to tell everyone I know about how good it is. On the downside, the packaging was very deceptive. I know it tells me the weight but when the wrapper is 50% wider and 50% longer than the bar it is really misleading. 'Pamela's' I would expect you to trim some of that waste so I do not feel so stupid and so guilty for the extra wrapper.
My whole family loves Pamela's oat blueberry lemon bars.  We takes them on hikes and bike rides.  They are a bit like a muffin cookie.  great flavor not too sweet but sweet enough.

column9: Could be my tastebuds, but these are dry and tasteless
column10: Sure, everyone has differing tastes, but I found these to be quite horrid - the point that I ate one bar, and threw the rest away. They are too dry, too flavorless and just uninspired. There are lots of better options out there with more flavor.
Just did not like Pamela's Oat Blueberry Lemon bars that much.  They did not have much taste.  I thinkthey could have had more nuts.  Another reason was I do not care for blueberries that much.

I love these whenever bars. My favorite flavor is the cranberry ones. But these make a nice change. The blueberry is complemented by the lemon, and the lemon is very mild. I order these on subscription and that makes the price much more reasonable than buying these locally, i.e. Central Market or Whole Foods.

To compare it to a situation for example, say you walked into an office and they had a little bowl of these on the counter - it would be like grabbing one of those and you could tell it sat out for a couple days...not bad, still chewy but you could sort of "tell it wasn't fresh" - that's the only bother sometimes.For the above reasons, that's what I gave it 4 stars...1 star off just because the 1 in 3 bags that aren't as fresh as i'd want. If you don't want 5 lbs, you can shop at a local grocery store.But I must recommend this: if you will not eat all of the gummy bears right away, transfer them to an air tight container. column9: Nice little treat for the kids--and yourself
column10: These gummis are by far the best; the taste is tart and sweet, and the consistency is yes, gummy but not sticky. The bears resist the teeth with a pleasant rubbery consistency. Every time I get close to picking this HUGE bag up, my heart starts racing.These Gummis were made in Turkey and imported into Baltimore.The bag is not resealable so ensure you have some tupperware or a resealable bag when you open it.  A resealable bag is a must.  Gummis that have been exposed to air will harden and lose flavor.  To waste a single, solitary gummi would be a crime.For those who track such things, the average gummi serving is 17 pieces.  That serving will get you 140 calories.  With FIVE pounds of gummis, you will be counting all night long.It takes, on average, approximately 45 minutes for a gummi to melt away in your mouth -- that is, if you can keep it in your mouth that long.  Most people, myself included, will immediately start chewing on the gummi to get at the tasty fruit flavors.Speaking of flavors, let's talk about the goodness that goes into a gummi.  There are many ingredients:  Corn Syrup, Sugar, Gelatin, Dextrose, Citric Acid, Starch, Artificial and Natural Flavors, Fractionated Coconut Oil, Caarnauba Wax, Beeswax Coating, and Artificial Colors -- Yellow 4, Red 40, and Blue 1.I'm not sure how they cram all those ingredients into a gummi less than an inch tall and a 1/4 wide...but they do...and it tastes amazing.Even now, as I write this review, I'm enjoying a pair of gummis.  My mouth is doing a dance as I type.You won't be disappointed.

column10: FLAVOR AND QUALITYHaribo is the original Gummi Bear manufactuer, and arguably produces the best Gummi Bears.STORAGEGummi Bears are actually mostly water---so they can dry out and get hard.  Openned packages (if not eaten immediately, generally the case in my home), are best refrigerated in sealed packages.DIETARY BENEFITSThe main ingredient in Gummi Bears is gelatin.  Gummi Bears are essentially very thick Jello.  Many folks actually eat/drink pure gelatin (usually dissolved in warm water) for the health benefits---claimed to improve fingernails, hair, and joints.  Since I've begun making fruit-juice gelatin deserts regularly, my fingernails are less brittle, and the "lizard skin" on the backs of my hands (I'm a gezzer) seems to be getting better.NON-VEGANGelatin is an animal product, not suitable for strict vegans.  Vegan brands made with starch are availableNON-KOSHERWhile kosher varieties are produced using only beef gelatin are available, if the package does not say it is kosher, then the Gummi Bears are probably made with pork gelatin.CHOKING HAZARDGummi Bears are a choking hazard for small children.  I haven't seen guidelines, but I suspect that Gummi Bears should not be given to children under 6.  There are other brands of Gummi Bears made from starch which are softer and less of a hazard.DO-IT-YOURSELFYou can make your own gummi-candy with Jello or unflavored gelatin and fruit juice.  Knox Original Gelatin (32-Count Envelopes), Unflavored, 8-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 2)  Double the basic recipe and you get "jigglers", which should be safe even for small children, and easier to digest.  Quadruple the amount of gelatin, pour the mixture into candy molds, and you get "gummi" candy.  For sweetening sour fruit juice, you can use artificial sweeteners such as spenda instead of sugar.ECONOMYI put these on my wishlist, waiting to get up to $25 for free shipping.  Then I went to the local grocery for other things, and noticed that they sold 3 storebrand 13oz bags for $5.  That would be 78 oz for $10 which would be 12.8 cents per oz---roughly the Amazon substription price.  I didn't buy the no-name grocery store gummi bears, but I did go home and do the math.  This is a bargain compared to buying Hairbo gummi bears in single 4 or 8oz packages.  But if you are just buying bulk candy for the crumb crunchers---you may be able to do just as well at the local grocery---or your crumb cruchers may prefer more healthy fruit juice jigglers instead.

It is commonly used as a gelling agent in food, pharmaceuticals, photography, and cosmetic manufacturing. Substances containing gelatin or functioning in a similar way are called gelatinous. Gelatin is an irreversibly hydrolysed form of collagen, and is classified as a foodstuff, with E number E441. It is found in some gummy candies as well as other products such as marshmallows, gelatin dessert, and some low-fat yogurt. Household gelatin comes in the form of sheets, granules, or powder. Instant types can be added to the food as they are; others need to be soaked in water beforehand.Buyers beware of the ingredients of products you are buying, just because it says it's vegetarian doesn't always mean it is.  Look up the ingredients just to be on the safe side.  I hope this is helpful. It's also much cheaper to buy them in bulk like this, instead of buying them in their smaller packaging.If you buy these, just sit back and enjoy. :-)

Oh.my.god.  A five pound bag of Haribo gummi bears.  My wife thought I was having one of those big-box moments when I bought these, thinking we would never finish the bad in months.  I bought it for the kids, though, not me!  Right!  Right?  Right.  It has been a week, and the bag is already half empty.  The kids, well, they have had ten.  I had to sneak them to work to hide my cravings.  They are so, so little.  And cute.  And sweet, but not too sweet.  And they stand so nicely on my desk.  And have just enough resistance when you bite into them.  No where did I put that bag....

column9: So many... so many little gold bears!!!
column10: Who needs five pounds of gummi bears?  I didn't think I did, but how wrong I was.  The bag is huge.If you peruse the one star reviews, a lot of people say these aren't as good as the retail packages, that they're hard or that they melted in transit.  I just wanted to say that the package I got is just as good as the Haribo Gold Bears in the labeled packages and that they were just as soft.  They were also delivered in 80-90 degree heat and didn't have any problems with melting.  I also wanted to mention that the bag I got was manufactured in Turkey... they may differ a bit from country, but these were fine.If you have any reservations due to the bad reviews, don't.  These are great... just make sure you don't eat them all at once!
i love the taste and freshness. new to Haribo but like several varieties, especially the frogs- something about that marshmallow-y texture and taste.
In my humble opinion the standard of which all jummi candy should be judged.  Simply put its the best.

5lbs is a whole lot of gummi bears.  I originally ordered the small individually packaged habribo gummi bears and it was a bit hard.  Seemed like they have been through cold weather and got stuck being cold.Anyways, with this bag, they were soft and what I expect from Haribo.  I had to share these because that's just too many gummi bears.
As others have said, this is a high quality gummy product. Not the cheapest out there, but very tasty. Would purchase again.

column9: How can these be so perfect??
column10: When we were kids, all we cared about when thinking of candy was how sweet it was. We never cared about the flavor really, or even texture. I remember eating these tubes of sugary sour blue goo from a tube.Haribo 'Gold Bag' gummy bears should be winning awards left and right for the taste, texture, and just overall appeal. Even at 28 years old, I routinely clean out the local 7-11 because these things are just so adictiing. I always have to tell the cashier 'oh, they're for the kids.'The texture of these guummy bears is perfectly firm. They have an explosive flavor, too. Lots of other gummy bears are too big and too mushy, and they have a odd plastic kinda of taste. These are in a league of their own. They're good if you leave them in the fridge for a little too. They're also good to just suck on.I don't know how else to describe these. I'll just say, I'm not a picky eater and I'm not picky about whether I'll only eat one brand of something over another..... Except these. I will NOT eat other gummy bears.Haribo or nothing! Get them, you won't regret it!

column9: Remove from bag and put into a ziplock container
column10: At first I was going to give these a 4 because I felt like they were harder than the ones I get from costco.I put these in a ziplock container shortly after and noticed that releasing them from their plastic home reallysoftened up the bears.Delicious and as good as the costco bags for a few bucks cheaper!

I've tried all kinds of gummi bear brands through the years.  Black Forest, Trolli, you name it I've likely had it.  Haribo tops them all, without question.  They're just consistently good.  Really good.  I also really like the cola bottles, but my wife doesn't, so we compromise with the gummie bears.Best gummi bear at the best price.  Enjoy in moderation, this 5lb bag is huge.

I've never liked gummie bears.  One day recently while paying at our favorite restaurant I decided to get a small bag of gummie bears to try.  They were pretty good so I decided to see what was available on Amazon.  I ordered a bag of the Haribo Gummi bears and was hooked.  Even hubby loves them.  We went through a 5 lb bag in just a few days.  I decided to go ahead and order 2 more bags.  Then I decided that they wouldn't last very long and ordered 2 more bags.  Now I'm well stocked.  When I get down to 1 bag I'll be placing my next order.The flavor is superb!!!!  You won't be disappointed. Each flavor is distinct and doesn't blend with the others.  Each bite is enjoyable.  Another good thing is they don't stick to your teeth.  I've had a lot of major dental work and was afraid I'd be picking them off of my teeth and haven't had to.Order some and if you don't like them you can return them.  I bet you'll enjoy them to the point you'll be ordering another bag very quickly.  I know when my granddaughters come I'll have to make sure and order extra so that they can enjoy them also.

If you really want good gummy bears, you can't really get any better than the "gold" standard, Haribo Gold-Bears. I have always found these gummy bears to have a step up in flavor and possess just the right amount of chewiness- not too stiff, but not too soft either. On top of all this, Amazon offers a great price in terms of value. If you were to buy the equivalent amount of gummy bears in 5 oz. bags for around $1.50 each, you would end up spending $24 as opposed to the roughly $15 that Amazon charges. On the flip side, willpower is probably a good quality to possess before purchasing, seeing as a five pound bag doesn't offer much in the way of deterrence from binging. Also, make sure to store these bears in an airtight or almost airtight bag, or they will become stiffer as they lose moisture. Overall though, a great value purchase for the best gummy bear available!

These gummi bears have become a standard goodie for my friend and I when we need to feel better. Nothing makes us smile like a yummy gummie. Whenever one of us gets sick or has a surgery of any type, the other can almost expect a bag of these golden gems to arrive at our door. There are plenty to share with the family but they usually don't last long. If you want to put a smile on someone's face, send them some of these Yummy Golden Gummi Bears :)

column9: Excellent purchase, very impressed with quality
column10: Product arrived as expected in Florida but in November. They were very soft and oh so tasty. Not all clumped together as others have complained. They were perfect. So much fun for Thanksgiving. They've been out in the open air now for 3 days and still soft and taste remarkable!  So glad I made this choice.  Will be buying more for Christmas, too.  Thank you.

column9: A whole lot of Gummi Bears
column10: Decent value for the quantity.  The candy arrived fresh and was exactly what I expected.

5 pounds of gummi bears. WOW great deal. I shared these with my mom and she was very into them and she doesn't like candy the way I do...Try them out you will not be dissapointed. You get soo much for your money..I love the flavor soo much. I wish i had some now
Hard to argue- it is what is says it is- 5 pounds of delicious Haribo goodness.  Word of warning- if you are making Gummi Shot Glasses, 5lbs doesn't go as far as you might think...

column9: Hard to stop at just a few
column10: Because the price is so reasonable at Amazon.com, I ordered two five-pound bags of these wonderful gummi bears. They arrived this week and are so fresh and tasty that I don't think anyone can stop eating just a small handful. These are very fresh, have excellent flavor and are almost like thirst quenchers.I take a few moments to repackage them in small, doubled, plastic food bags. I use a small, plastic scoop to put them in the bags, and store them in larger bags to keep them fresh until the supply is depleted.When I make frosted cupcakes, I generally stand a couple atop each cupcake then watch as family or guests grab one at a time daintily between thumb and finger and pop them into their mouth.Thank you Amazon for making these available to your customers.

I purchased *five pounds* of gummi bears because I've had Haribo gummi bears before and really enjoyed them, plus the price can't be beat (usually just five ounces is two to three dollars, imagine getting five whole pounds for fifteen dollars!).I was very uncertain buying gummi bears online, because I wasn't sure if I would get cruddy old stale gummi bears that endanger your teeth and taste of old wax.That was not the case with me.  I purchased the gummi bears on Jan 27 2009.  I received them on Jan 30 2009.  They were fresh and squishy, and well packaged.  They shipped from Indianapolis and arrived in DC three days later.  Terrific.Too bad you have to buy two bags to get free shipping, now I have 10 pounds of candy lying around!

I love gummi bears and these are by far the best!  I would have never thought that there are big differences between gummi bears, but there are. Some are too sweet, too mushy, too chewy, too sticky, etc.  These bears are just right.  Germany carries some of the best candies and chocolates and these gummi bears are the best of the bunch!  If I order 5 pounds gummi bears, I will eat 5 pounds in a short amount of time, so I cannot order from Amazon.  I have to get them in a retail store and get one small bag at a time, otherwise I will gain lots of weight in gummi bears!

Just a note: this is a LOT of candy. If you are ordering this make sure you have a lot of friends and family that will help you finish off the bag.After the first handful (which is excellent, mind you) I was set for a few days. Apparently no one else in the house cares for gummy candy and it took me a few weeks to finish up the candy.Other than that, they taste good and have a good chewy consistency. These are premium gummis and are highly recommended.

While living in the UK in 1981, I was sitting in church with an USAF family, (Norm and Bonnie Kapaska),who were stationed nearby. "Momma" Kapaska, asked me if I wanted a Gummy Bear.I said "huh"?She Handed me a handfull of Haribo Gold Bears.Now for 27 years I have been an addict, but life is a little sweeter because of that Sunday!

Monetarily it's a fair deal, not extraordinary.. but fair. Take a moment and think about yourself. You are reading a review about gummi bears. Clearly you are the type of person who would find a 5 pound box of Haribo Gummi's to be a wonderful thing. And it is.

It would have been good for me to know the ingredients prior to purchasing. I expected the German-made version which has real fruit extracts. This 5-pound bag is from Hungary and contains artificial and "natural" flavors instead. The difference in taste is noticeable, not to mention the obvious advantage for one's health to have something with real fruit rather than something with flavor.On a side note, expect to pay a lot for shipping. There appears to be no land option, airmail only. But, that might depend on whether you live in the same country as the retailer or not.I realized after the purchase that I would save 30-40% by purchasing the small bags at a local store that imports them from Germany.

These are kind of hit and miss.  The first time I bought them, they were great, I bought two five pound bags, and they were great.  A second order and they were pretty stale.  Some more consistency would be nice...  Might be better to just buy them at your local supermarket or drugstore...

Well, thanks for all the mouthwatering reviews.  You people reeled me in like a Tarpin.  I obviously need to go somewhere now and seek professional help.  I am starting to have bad thoughts towards family members who I catch eating my bears.  Please help!

I have looked through many online stores selling these Haribo Gold Bears, and all sell in the range from 15~20 dollars, but all of them include shipping of 5~10 extra dollars. Amazon is the only place you can get free shipping on these yummy gummy.

I have tried many different brands of Gummi Bears, but Haribo have always been my favorites.  They are very chewy, slightly harder than other brands (which is good), and have excellent flavor.  Don't bother with any other brand!
I ordered this product and clicked two-day shipping.I didn't get it for 6 days.The gummi bears are okay.Quite a bit chewy,Other than that they are okay.

These are from Europe, and they are the best. Haribo are kinda tough to eat, but that's what makes them good. They are so much better than the kind you buy at Circle K. Buy in the 5 pound bag, and you will save money as opposed to buying from the Sweet Factory at the mall.

Great product but Amazon has these way too expensive.  You can get a 5 ounce bags at Kmart or Walmart for $0.99 per back which 5 lbs translates to $16.00.  For $2.00 more for 5 pounds, I'd rather have small convienient bags.  But these are by far the best gummi's out there!

This was a great purchase!!! We all love these in our house but have been unable to find them around here.  What a bonus to find them sold in 5-lb. bags.  So, of course I had to get us each our own bag.  We got them shipped quickly in time for Christmas!
The Haribo brand are the best gummi bears on the market. Really fresh and soft, the whole family loves them!
I love Haribo for this product, they have the best gummy bears on the market and their gummy line is without competition when it comes to taste and texture.

This product is excellent. I have been buying these for over 30 years and your price is the best I have found in recent times. I started buying them atthe US Army Commissary in Frankfurt, Germany for my children, and now I buy them for my grandchildren; but that was a long time ago and far far away.Wilford Voehl

column9: I know my gummi bears and these are the best!!!!!
column10: These are the best!  The texture is perfect, not to hard or too soft.  All the flavors are yummy. I have tried every kind of gummi bears I could find.  My kids know I am addicted because I have to have some hidden for just one of those days.  They are easy to find here where I live and as others have said, they are all over Europe. My daughter spent the summmer there taking classes and brought some home from Vienna and Croatia.  I buy them at Wal-Mart but the 5-pound bag is just the best deal I have found....no more having to worry about running out too soon.  It's too bad these have calories because they are like chips, you can't eat just one! :)
For a five pound bag of gummi's, these were excellent.  They were still nice and fresh when I received them.  Again ~ Excellent, and I would definitely re-order!

Had these for the first time as a kid in Korea and have tried others but the Gold-Bears are the best.  It's been years but the taste is as great now as I remember it then.What a price....can't beat it.

I spent the first 8 years of my life in Germany.  I remember the first time we got a care package from Germany with the gummy bears in it.  I was thrilled.  There is nothing like eating the original gummy candy!

This package arrived in Florida on a lovely June day. All the little bears had fused into a single five pound gelatinous block. I'm sure that I will find something to do with it, but it will not be what I had planned when I ordered this package.

Once you get them it's hard to quit! Then again they are fat free.My order came quickly and very fresh vs the overpriced candy stores where they're in a bin and you don't know how long they've been sitting there, or spending almost $2 for 5 ounces. Great deal right now, and with 2 bags, you get free shipping! I got regular gummi bears and cola bottles, and I think my husband ate more of them than I did and he isn't a big gummi fan! He said they were just good, fresh, and had a great flavorful taste, not like any other gummis that are just colored shaped goo.

column4: Clint Arthur "creator of the DVDs 'NEW  S E X...
column10: To have a 5-lbs. bag of gummi bears is to really feel RICH.Who doesn't love them?  Who doesn't want another?Who can eat gummis endlessly?  -- Only the owner of a 5-lbs. bag.Yummi gummi!

These are my favorite candies, even more than chocolate.  These are far and away the best brand of any.  I have tried several brands and these are the absolute bestest.  I will be definitely buying more.

column9: Best gummy bears around, but they give your jaw a work-out.
column10: Just like everyone else here it seems, I first experienced Haribo's magic in Germany.  I was at a train station and I needed a quick snack, so I bought a little bag of the Gold-Bears.  Ever since I ventured to find them in the States, but couldn't.  A few years ago, however, I noticed them popping up in their little bags, and had to buy one.While they're still the best gummy bears Stateside, I was a bit disappointed since they were harder than I had them in Deutschland.  But that's understandable, as I'm assuming they're imported from Germany, and gummy bears really can't retain their freshness for long when traveling across the sea, and then sitting on a store shelf waiting for someone to buy them.  They're not hard-hard like some of the other gummy bear brands you'll find here; they're just harder than in Europe.The flavors are strong and fantastic, and I have to stop from eating so many gummies at once for fear of my jaw getting sore--but they're so good!The 5lb bag is a great deal, but just be sure no one else is around.  I already had a bunch of co-workers coming up to get some, assuming they'll last forever since it's a large bag.  After ordering this about 2 weeks ago, I'm already having to consider reordering a second bag!
These are the DEFINATIVE gummis by which all others are measured.  If you do not love these, fine--you do not love gummis.  That is all there is to it.

These taste great. The only problem is stopping after you start eating them. I tend to go for the green and red bears because they have better flavor. They have kept soft after having them for about a month... I keep the bag sealed with a rubber band. They've been a hit to visitors to my humble abode.
I love these gummies like big time, they're the best...but the bag should be a little stronger though!¡! And it should have a ziplock too!
Accept no imitation as this is the gold standard in gummy bears.  You will be hooked and you will not put down this bag.  Also delicious frozen, or so I hear.  You have been warned.

I was very pleased with this purchase.  I feel like I would eat a ton of these in each sitting, and yet the bag still lasted a really long time.  Obviously not the healthiest snack, but who doesn't love some tasty gummy bears from time to time?

I am a full-fledged carb addict who just recently started a low carb diet. It has been painful, but I have to say I am losing weight and feeling better everyday. These little candies have really helped me get through the after meal sweet cravings. They are rich and buttery and fun to suck on. Highly recommended for the sweet tooth!

I am diabetic with a major sweet tooth and am always looking for sugar-free low-carb snacks as they are the ones that don't affect my blood sugar. Being sugar-free isn't enough. Anything with Maltose will make me sick. HOWEVER Werther's Original Sugar-Free Hard Candies taste exactly like the original sugared candy. If you're looking for a little treat without worry, try them. You won't be sorry.

These are the BEST cookies!  They have a great texture, the lemon is strong and tangy, and the little ginger 'bite' at the end is a fantastic finish.  I also love the little wangs of saltiness you get from them.Don't buy unless you plan on eating many, many cookies and craving more after they are gone.  These are not your average boring boxed cookies!
I had these at a wedding shower and I couldn't keep my hands off of them.  The ginger and lemon mix together extremely well.  Plus that little after-tingle on your tongue is wonderful.
excellent value and service from amazon.com.  Excellect product - purchased a case as gifts for the Holidays.  Everyone has called wanting more.

column9: Lemon & Ginger in the same cookie!!
column10: I love lemon cookies and I love ginger cookies.  To get them both in the same cookie is almost more than I can take.

column9: The best cookie in the world
column10: Carr's Ginger Lemon Cream cookies are, by far, the best cookie I have ever had.  They were hard to find in local supermarkets, but Amazon came through on my first try.  I recommend you try these as soon as you can.
WARNING: Highly addictive!  :)  A little pricey, but worth it. The flavors are intense and perfect for parties, brunch or snacks.

These cookies are delicious!  So light and crisp and tangy. They are not readily available in local groceries, so when I searched online for them I was happily surprised to find that I could buy them from Amazon!  Now my family takes turns buying the pack of 12 boxes and sharing them.

column9: Didn't live up to the hype
column10: I was really excited to try these cookies, after reading the reviews. I love tart lemon desserts, and am a huge fan of ginger in all forms. The cookies were very nice, and I am sure that all 12 boxes will get eaten eventually. For me, however, the lemon was not tart enough, and the ginger taste was very mild. I would rate it right alongside the lemon cookie sold by the Girl Scouts - also over priced, but at least you feel like you are contributing to a good cause!

Oh, boy. These cookies are TOO good. I cannot put them down.This order is a lot of them. But the sleeves are wrapped individually, so they can live in the garage and come up one at a time (so you don't look like a fiend).

column9: Ginger Lemon Creme cookies are wonderful!
column10: Ginger cookies that aren't hard as rocks are hard to find, until my daughter shared a box of Carr's Ginger Lemon Creme cookies. The cookies are light with a nice ginger zing to them. The lemon creme in the middle melts in your mouth so that every bite is a creamy lemon/ginger delight.  It is impossible to follow the 2 cookie recommended serving. I must admit, I ate a whole box! I couldn't find them where I live, so, oh joy..I found them on Amazon. Thank you, thank you thank you!

I think it was five years ago when I ate my first Ginger Creme.  I must go through a box a week: Summer or Winter, it makes no difference. My biggest mistake is that I let my wife try one and now I have to create my private stash so that when the overwhelming urge is on me - I can get my hit.  A typical hit is three.  I can get by with two, but one is simply never ever sufficient and only serves to whet the appetite.  I sometimes nibble a couple with a small glass of good Malt at night.One of the few benefits of living in Masachusetts is that my local grocery chain carries these on a regular basis - at only $2.50 a box!! Costco also carries them periodically - which is when I really stock up.  Last Christmas many people received a 3-pack for Christmas - alas they have not appeared at Costco this year so people will be bitterly disappointed this year.While I am at it - you should also try the equally addictive Carr's Cheese Melts perhaps with a touch of Major Grey's chutney - adding cheese is definitely overkill and detracts from the cracker!  In a pinch, when the cupboard is bare and the supermarket is closed, they might even substitute for a ginger creme.Please note: I have no financial interest in Carr's - just the desire to ensure that the demand is sufficient so that my supply will go on forever.

column9: Danger!  Step Away From The Ginger Lemon Creme Cookie
column10: OMG!  I just tried this cookie today for the first time.  I've seen them on the shelf for years next to the other Carr's products but never had an inkling to buy a box and try them out.  Well, a co-worker brought them to the office today...these things are addictive.  The cookie has an absolutely delightful crunch - it's not an overly-dense cookie and then you get to the lemon center with a perfect balance of sweet and tart.  You are forewarned.  These little ditties are a bite of heaven. Try - I DARE you - try to eat just one.

column9: Awesome Cookies, back at Costco too !
column10: The best ginger cookie I have ever had, this has the perfect blend of the sweetness of "creme", the tangyness of ginger and a small dash of lemony aftertaste that, as someone else said here, guarantees that you will be on an official cookie binge (after cookie no. 1) ! Highly recommended, got them recently from Costco where they are selling them by the crates !

column9: Once you taste the first, you're officially on a binge!
column10: Like a fellow reviewer, first got these cookies at [...], but cant seem to find them again, so I was devastated (yes, it is possible to feel devastated about cookies you love!) and the search that commenced eventually led me to AMZN.  Now that I've paced my way (I try) through a few of the 12 boxes in the box, I know there's no going back.  The cookies have a mild ginger flavor, and a just-barely-more-than-mild lemon flavored filling in-between.  Delicious!  Gotta try it, trust me.
Just the right amount of ginger in the cookie and the lemon creme is light but lucious.  They are a good dessert or tea cookie.

column9: Love These Hard to Find Cookies
column10: These cookies have wonderful flavor and texture.  They are great with tea and really okay by themselves as well.  I have been unable to find them in a store for almost two years now, but luckily found them on Amazon.  My only problem is that I tend to eat more of them than I should.

Carr's Ginger Lemon Creme cookies are sold only at Costco and not all the time it was pleasent to find out from a friend that I could get them at Amazon.  My friend is elderly and does not use a computer so now I order a case and split them with her.  We no longer have to wait and see if Costco will be selling them.Thanks,
The cookies were great and just what I needed for a present when visiting a friend.  The shipping costs for a rather small case of cookies seemed to be quite outrageous.

Originally discovered these cookies at Costco. Costco discontinued carrying them. I was pleased to see that I could find these on Amazon and at such a great price. Without the shipping chage this was an excellent value. I have many of these fine cookies to enjoy for the months ahead.

As other reviewers have pointed out, these are great cookies.  The lemon and ginger flavors are perfectly combined.  The only reason not to buy these cookies is because you fear the potential weight gain these addictive cookies might lead to.  That said, these are worth working out a little more for.
Lemon, crystallized ginger and shortbread cookies?  What could possibly be better with a cup of tea?
Oreos with a twist. Great ginger cookie sandwich with a snappy lemon filling refreshes the mouth, great after taste lasts and lasts.

column9: So sad to read trans fat content!
column10: Total bummer because these cookies truly are delicious.  Just bought a box at Trader Joe's, ate one cookie with my tea (loved it!) then I read the trans fat content (1g per cookie), so I had to throw them away!

Very good ginger for the low cost.  The crystalized ginger I received was sweet, spicy, and had excellent fresher-than-usual flavor.  Pleasantly surprised.  Highly recommend this product and this excellent store (Mother Nature).

column9: Superb Quality and Price, Though Not the Cheapest Around
column10: A pound of crystallized ginger can be made to go a long way, and we made this pound last about 4-5 months by chopping the round slices into dices, transferring it to the freezer in resealable sandwich bags, then using it over time to make about 4 batches of Ginger Snap cookies.If you'd like to make more than that, or get more ginger for half the price, you'll want to checkout the 6-pounder (http://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B000UXY2J2?tag=a52-20&ie=UTF8) from Roland. Both are about equal as far as visual and cooking quality, but Roland is about half the cost per pound.Frontier's crystalized ginger was a bit stiff and woody, meaning it was likely left in the ground too long before harvested. While the cookie quality was decent, I wouldn't recommend it for raw consumption.Ideal ginger (crystallized or not) should be tender. Try the stuff from Australia (http://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B000G818BQ?tag=a52-20&ie=UTF8) for some of the finest consumption-quality ginger around, but do know that it's spicy no matter the origin. (Hey, they don't call it a spice for no reason!)Hot Tip: Discovery Channel's Mythbusters proved that ginger is an exceptional remedy for motion sickness. It WORKED when practically no man-made remedy did! Amazing.

whew...I wish someone had told me how SPICY HOT ginger is! I ordered this big bag to take to help my hot flashes but it is so spicy that I can't eat enough to make any difference... so  I can't tell you if it works or not

column9: Very Good Quality But Too Expensive
column10: I'll always try to support a "Made In USA" product and/or a product distributed by a US business but the price/ounce for this product is high. Quality is very good. If you use Thyme Leaf in larger volumes go with the Frontier brand available here at Amazon. Two 1lb bags (32oz total) for about $17.00 currently and less with Subscribe & Save. That's a lot of product but it's also very good quality. I gave one bag to a friend of mine who owns a commercial bakery and he's hooked on Frontier now.Again, if you only need an ounce for occasional home cooking this product is fine, and you're supporting a US business.

column9: Love that they offer different amounts so you can get what you want!
column10: I have order several things from this place and will continue. Hard to find items available, quick shipping, fresh products. Thank you so much!!

I have just found out today that the gelatin in this product is coming from pork. I do not know why they would add gelatin in the first place. DHA from fish oil is fine, but the lady that answered my phone told me that all DHA Gerber baby food items have pork gelatin. Do infants need gelatin at this age?

column9: Why do their organic foods contain gelatin???
column10: I used to buy Gerber baby foods and was thrilled when they started carrying organic foods. Then I discovered that they add gelatin! Why? It is disgusting and has absolutely no nutritional value.  I will not be buying Gerber products again. Earth's Best is actually organic.
Do not buy product contain gelatin. Gelatin in baby food ??? Why gerber ???, Do not buy if you follow vegetarian or kosher/Halal regime.
My twins love this!! BUT Walmart sells them for $1/ for a 2pack!  Worth going there to save the extra $!

My baby likes the mac n cheese in the jars. So, when I couldn't find the jars at the store I was at, I tried these mac n cheeses thinking they were the same. They are not. She doesn't like these. Maybe it is a texture issue mainly as these are much runnier than the jar kind. Looking for more mac n cheese jars.
My twins recently got a little picky on the baby food... We tried this one, and they both love it.  They are now 10 mos old.My twins love it!

I have just found out today that the gelatin in this product is coming from pork. I do not know why they would add gelatin in the first place. DHA from fish oil is fine, but the lady who answered my phone told me that all DHA Gerber baby food items have pork gelatin. Do infants need gelatin at this age?

My picky eater loves this! She will eat only Gerber Organic Mac n Cheese and Gerber Organic Green Beans w/o any fussing. Yes, it is a bit runny, which makes it perfect for 4-6 month olds but it gives you the flexibility to thicken it with whatever you want for the older babies (e.g. rice cereal, meats, spinach, etc).Mommy loves it, too! Great taste!

column9: Good and good for the baby
column10: It tastes fine and the baby loves it. has DHA and is organic - which is important when having berries (but redundant when it comes to bananas)

He spits out most veggies, except sweet potatoes of course, and even a lot of fruits, unless I mix them with cereal to thicken them up a bit!  He loves the thick texture of this food!!! My 18m old loves this for his morning breakfast. This is one of the few flavors he will eat. We give him 1x baby food breakfast & 1x yogurt every day.
My daughter loves this food! I tried it and its good!Added bonus is the DHA.
I wouldn't say my twins are picky eater, but they wouldn't eat this one.  They eat just about every Gerber's organics.

column9: I got this for a diet i tried
column10: Ok, sounds crazy i know but i heard about this baby food diet and figured whats there to loose. The food tastes good, and im sure your baby will like it too hahaha!

column9: Not vegaterian - has fish oil and gelatin
