column9: A good value and a can that lets you get to it quickly.
column10: To me these are just average.  They're not great, and there's nothing off-putting about them.  They're the medium size fishies that get called "sardines", and not the more expensive tiny fishes (which taste better in my opinion), and not the herring that show up in the really cheap sardine cans.The easy-open can is a great idea.  No more splattering tomato sauce over myself when despite my best efforts to open a metal can correctly I just don't do it with quite the right touch.The problem is that I've been spoiled by the little sardines, and I just can't see myself staying with these.  I'll finish off what I bought (and enjoy those easy-open cans, but I won't buy them again.

I've tried many different brands on sardines on amazon and Season sardines are my favorite ones so far. I highly recommend these. The Season sardines in olive oil are also delicious and healthier than some of the other (non-olive based) oils used by other brands. And yes, these easy-to-open cans are another big plus in book.
It's healthy without a lot of garbage in it and my two cats love it. What more need I say?
My family loves Laffy Taffy, but my husband LOVES grape.  Found it here for a great price and was delivered fresh and delicious.
What a value! They are 10-15 cents at the store. This way I have a constant little treat without leaving the house. Great for treat bags, too.

Hansen's Products are the best juice on the market.Buying them through Amazon is the worst.  The shipping cost more than the drink.Hansen's does not seem able to get their product out on the shelves, in the New England area.If they want to sell product, then get the cost to the consumer down.

I have never purchased wheat berries to grind into flour before. I did my research to make sure I could handle the task well. Before milling this wheat I took out a cup full at a time and examined it carefully for dirt, stone, bugs, etc. This grain was perfect! It was pristine clean, no rocks or dirt, and no bugs. I was super pleased and then I milled the grain into a wonderful flour and baked up a loaf of bread that rose beautifully and tastes like a million bucks! So very happy with this wheat. I will be purchasing more very soon!

One of my New Years Resolutions is to eat more whole grains so I've been substituting this White Winter Wheat where ever all purpose flour is asked for. Tonight I made up pie crust & cookies.Lost a few pounds & my blood sugar is much more stable.Very happy with the quality no dust in with the grains.Grinds up beautifully!

column4: S. Pyne "Army Wife and Regular Mom"
column10: The product is exactly what I wanted and showed up in great condition and in good time. I love that I can get this with the subscribe and save and that it is organic! We grind up the wheat and use in any kind of batter recipe, pancakes, waffles, muffins, cakes,etc. We love it!

I wanted to try grinding wheat and also wanted to get more whole wheat in my diet so I decided to try this out.  So far, I've been very impressed.How I use it:1) Grind it using a Blendtec blender (I set it to the maximum speed and let it run to duration, 50 seconds.  I repeat this once).  By the time the Blendtec is done it is very fine though not quite as white/'pure' as store bought white flour (but I guess that's kind of the point)2) Mix it in with whatever I'm baking.-I haven't tried using only this flour in recipes.  I typically substitute between 1/3 and 1/2 of the flour in a recipe with this flour.-It has worked great for breadmaker bread, pancakes and cupcakes.In using about 1/4 of the bag so far, I did find one of the little black balls that another reviewer mentioned but that has been the only 'imperfection' that I've seen.I'm certainly planning on getting more when this is finished, the Amazon price isn't too bad and the wheat seems great!

So I dump my bag of wheat into my existing half full wheat bucket and find the package littered with what seems to be little black seeds of some sort- definitly not wheat!!! Not bugs- but perfectly shaped little black balls.  I have looked for an answer online with no luck...I tried calling the manufacture and the office was closed- I have yeast proofing on the counter that I now have to dump- and my good wheat is now mixed in with the "bad".....so basically I'm out of dinner, and money.  Only alot annoyed at this point.***Okay this is an add on to the original post- Looks like it's something called smut balls.....a dried fungus ball.  Not toxic- as far as I can see.  But still is considered an unpure grain.  I don't see why I should pay top dollar for less than quality grain and that I paid for weight with these included (i'm guessing 4-5 lbs worth mixed in).  I could sit and pick out millions of these tiny things or just figure out how to get a refund (p.s....i have no idea how I'm going to repackage it for the return).  I will not be a return customer of this product unless it is shown to have improvement.

column9: Fabulous product for a great price!
column10: I've ordered both the Soft Winter White and Hard Red wheat from Great River and have been pleased with both!  I use these in my grain mill for baking flour.  The taste and texture is perfect!  Also, you can't beat the price per ounce, even better than our local bulk foods store!
Great Product - Thanks!! Great Seller!! Needed this for fall pumpkin cupcakes!Should have gotton 3 or 4 more, but will have to order later.

Hamburger Helper Stroganoff / B0010VO7HAI've loved Hamburger Helper Stroganoff for years, and I am excited to see it on Amazon available in bulk quantities for cheaper than the supermarket price. The pasta is easy to make, just brown the ground beef, dump everything into a pot, boil, cover, and simmer undisturbed while you go do something more useful than standing at the stove.The stroganoff is thick, creamy, and yet relatively `light' tasting - 1 cup of prepared stroganoff is approximately 0.5 grams of fat, according to the nutrition facts on the box. I always cut back on the meat - it calls for a pound of meat, but half or even a third of a pound is plenty for me. I use organic whole milk and unsalted butter and the result is a creamy deliciousness that I don't feel too terribly guilty about. I think the result would even be good without meat - for the vegetarians out there - if you wanted to experiment.I'm really pleased to be able to order this on Amazon - the bulk ordering is cheaper and I don't have to lug it home from the store, which saves gasoline money. The boxes come tightly packaged in the box to prevent spillage, and the expiration dates on the boxes aren't too close - the last order I received in September, with a "best if used by" date of the upcoming January. Although, really, I don't think Hamburger Helper is terribly perishable.This product, according to the ingredients list, contains wheat, milk, soy, and egg products, in case you might be allergic.~ Ana Mardoll

column4: Jacki Gunter "good movie or book lover"
column10: I have looked for this particular Hamburger Helper for years since moving from California to where I am.  The stores here just never carried it.  Now that I can obtain it we have really enjoyed it.  I don't use hamburger in it, I use canned roast beef including all the gravy and it makes a wonderful side dish or main dish with salad.

We might not be a gourmet club, but we know when something looks and tastes like wall paper paste. (And please don't get us started on the strange smell!)I have used Hamburger Helper for years (admittedly not that often) but had never before used the Stroganoff variety. Well... we will never, ever use it again. What a waste of perfectly good beef. And, FYI, I thoroughly followed the directions, and used fresh, lean hamburger purchased only an hour before. (Honest!)Gross.

This beef stroganoff mix is not bad--just bland, not a particularly tasty use of a pound of ground beef and a container of fresh mushrooms.  I thought it was worth trying because it's cheap and it's available in my local grocery stores. The stroganoff mix I'm comparing it to, Annie's Homegrown Organic, is less convenient for me; I have to order in bulk from Amazon or stock up when out of town.  And the Annie's mix is a bit more than twice as expensive.  Whether a box meal is organic isn't important to me, so I'm not taking that into account.  But considering flavor vs. convenience and cost, I think that the Annie's mix is the better value.  Of course, taste is a personal thing--this is just my view.  Here is the link for the Annie's mix:  Annie's Homegrown Organic Beef Stroganoff Skillet Meal, 6.5-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)
This is so yummy. This is also good with can chicken in it instead of hamburger. However, I do recommend using real milk in this. I've tried soy milk and it just tastes a bit off.

Guide Dog approvez bEEfy stroganoff. it R teh 1337 awesomeness.High quality, ships in a secure box from the factory within the shipping box. I reccomend using a half-brick of philly cream cheese per box, or a large spoonful or two of sour cream, depending on your preference. :)Thank you.

I like having Betty Crocker Helper mixes in the pantry. They come in really handy on grocery shopping day. Inevitably there will be something that needs to be used up fast to make room for the newer product in the fridge. Usually it's the last of the milk. Sometimes it's the last stick of butter, or the last packet of cheese. Even leftover meat and vegetables can go in there. There is always something. Betty Crocker pasta meals are awesome for making those odds and ends disappear. The Helpers kind of need doctoring anyway, so the odds and ends wind up well used, and the Helpers are so cheap it makes sense to use them as a recipe starter. The Stroganoff is one of my favorites, partly because I like Stroganoff but also because it's an easy way to get rid of the last of the sour cream. Truthfully, all of the Helpers are great for using up odds and ends, but I'm nostalgically fond of the beef ones.

As the previous reviewer indicated, it does look ground but when you put it into the dish and separate it, you can tell that it is indeed flaked.  I brought this one home on a fluke and wow, did it disappear quickly.  My rescued Persian never had anything like it before and just didn't quite know what to do with this food.  She loved it so much, she just came up and purred all night after eating it.  Looked like she just had Thanksgiving dinner.  She rolled over on her back, burped soundly, and took a very long snoozer.  And did I see a smile on her face?  Looked like it to me! Great, great selection, highly recommend!

column9: My cat likes it just fine
column10: A little confused by the word "flaked" as it looks ground to me.  However my cat doesn't seem to care as he eats all of it.  Does smell pretty bad though.

The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf's Lemon Chamomile tea is a nice and pleasant-tasting tea for unwinding and relaxing. The lemongrass was picked in Thailand (lemongrass is widely used in Thailand for many cooking recipes). I order any product from The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf online since there are no Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf stores near where I live. If you want to try other excellent teas from The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf, try these two Limited Edition teas sold directly from The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf's website, Spring Peach Oolong and Blueberry Peach Green Tea. The Spring Peach Oolong was grown 5,000 feet above sea level in the mountains of Thailand and the Blueberry Peach Green Tea was grown 1,200 meters above sea level in the Mae Salong region of Thailand. Besides the three teas I've mentioned from The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf, I also highly recommend their special Dutch Chocolate Powder, Vanilla Caramel flavored coffee, Raspberry Cream flavored coffee, and Limited Edition Blueberry Streusel flavored coffee. In summary, this is a great chamomile tea. Another great chamomile tea to try is Fairmont Egyptian Chamomile. I was introduced to the Fairmont Egyptian Chamomile tea in 2010 when my sister and I dined at the Fairmont Dallas Hotel's Pyramid restaurant (a restaurant with a fresh market concept and with the largest hotel/restaurant herb and vegetable garden in the Dallas region). I visited the Fairmont Dallas Hotel's gift shop and they had an excellent array of organic teas with their Egyptian Chamomile being one of them. The Egyptian Chamomile has a nice sweet taste and it's sold on fairmontstore.com in their online gift store, the tea section. I strongly recommend the Fairmont's Organic Hawaiian Kei Lani Orange Pineapple, Organic Chinese Jasmine Butterfly #1, and Organic U.S.A.'S Cascade Peppermint teas. Anyways, I'm glad that this Lemon Chamomile tea from The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf is available for purchase on Amazon. I think it's a great economical deal to purchase this from Amazon - you get a pack of three containers (each containing 20 tea bags). I have one container at home, one at my workplace, and I gave one container to my sister. I'm satisfied with this purchase.

Wonderful tea for relaxing at the end of a hard day. I first found this product at the Coffee Bean and Tea Leaf store in San Francisco and loved it. After it was gone I thought a trip to San Francisco was my only option as you cannot find this tea in stores, but I checked Amazon and there it was!! My husband even likes it and he is a coffee drinker.

Coffee Bean and Tea Leaf products have always been a favorite of mine.  However, we do not have one where we live.  To buy directly from the company for one container of tea was much more expensive than to purchase from Amazon (and I got a 3 pack).The price was right, and it shipped quickly!YUM!
Mild tasting tea, very pleasant. It helps when you can't get to sleep. So far this is the best chamomile tea I've tasted, and I have had many before. Highly recommended!

Amazon hasn't figured out how to get canned goods to the customer.  Every time, 90% of the cans are severely dented. Makes me fear food poisoning. If they could solve this problem I would order this soup & many other canned products regularly.  Buy the soup in a store. It's not bad...a bit too much tomato & carrot but good taste.  Amazon, please address this packaging / shipping deficiency. A few minor dents are acceptable but not cans that must be discarded.
I enjoy the subtle, delicate taste of blueberry in this white tea. It has become my favorite. I know it's better for my health than coffee, and it leaves me feeling serene and cared for.
It's Reese's peanut butter cups, formed into scrumptious little pumpkin shapes...'nuff said! 'Hope you all had a very Happy Halloween!

Since they love all things potato and sweet potato, I knew the girls would like these snacks. They're a nice small size and thin in the middle so I thought it would be an easy thing to break the individual bones in half. Not!These are tough, chewy little bones; giving a whole treat to one of our small-mouthed girls might be the equivalent to giving her a stick of gum.Thus I cut these treats up into little pieces  for the girls. They like these bones quite a bit and look forward to them. Larger, less fussy dogs might not need to have their treats cut first.Be aware that these treats are made in China.

I saw this new flavor in my local store last week and thought it sounded good, so I bought a box. OMG!!! When I took the first bite, one thing came to mind...This tastes just like a Samoas Girl Scout cookie (my fav)!Every year I buy 10+ boxes of the Samoas, this year I'm trying to loose about 30lbs. I thought cookie-selling time would tempt me, but now I'm not worried. These things are delicious and completely replace my desire for the Samoas.

Samoas are my favorite girl scout cookies; however, it comes with minimal nutritional benefits.  That goes without saying of course since it's not a 'health' food. Enter the FiberPlus bar with caramel, coconut, and fudge.  In my opinion, the bars are delicious and closely resembles the taste of the Samoa, while offering 35% of the daily fiber.  The following is a summary of the nutritional information:SamoasServing Size: 2 Cookies (29g)Calories: 140Total Fat: 7g (11%)Saturated Fat: 5g (25%)Dietary Fiber: 1g (5%)Sugars: 10gFiberPlusServing Size 1 bar (36g)Calories: 120Total fat: 4g (6%)Saturated Fat: 3g (15%)Dietary Fiber: 9g (35%)Sugars 7gAs noted above, the FiberPlus bar is far superior to the Samoa in every category, in addition to being larger in size (36g vs 29g serving size).  I still purchase Samoas for its unique taste and once-in-a-while treat, but now I can actually enjoy fiber bars on a daily basis for my in between meals.  I highly recommend this product.
been girl scout cookie free for three years, this has curbed my craving to buy from them in front of the grocery store another year! as close as you can get while saving calories and fat!

These bars used to taste like Samoas, BUT a few days ago I bought a new box. The bars taste different. The box is flimsy and difficult to open, too.My neighbor first mentioned the bars don't taste like Samoas anymore. Today another friend said she bought two boxes, and the bars don't taste like Samoas.New bars have less chocolate on top.  I compared wrappers on old and new bars.  Old bars have 120 calories, 6 percent of carbs, 20 percent of zinc.  New bars have 130 calories, 9 percent of carbs, 25 percent of zinc.  Could these differences change the taste?Has anyone else noticed a change, or are my friends and I crazy? Thanks.

column9: Great product but WAY to high on price
column10: Great product, great flavor but you can buy this at Walmart for  about $2.50 a box. These people are charging WAY too much money

column9: Well, It Isn't a Samoa... But I Get the Comparison
column10: Everyone keeps saying that these taste JUST like girl scout cookies, and I will admit that the taste is similar.  However, don't do what I did and, having never eaten a fiber bar, go into this expecting it to REALLY taste like a cookie.If you are on a diet, you know that you start to get used to foods that don't taste quite the same as their more fattening alternatives.  Well, this is a similar deal.Yes, they are good.  No, they aren't cookies.

These taste exactly like Samoas (girlscout cookies). It's a yummy way to get your fiber. I read in other reviews that some people felt gassy after eating these but I have not had that problem. I think it only occurs in people who are not used to consuming high fiber foods.

Tastes exactly like Samoas...The bomb! I love these they are my new favorite...Just 6 weeks ago I ate an entire box of GS Samoas...now I am on a diet and watching what I eat...these little beauties make me feel really BAD like I ate a box of Samoas however the calories are perfect and the fiber fills me up! YUMMMMMMMY!
Agree with the other review 100%. These taste like Samoa cookies, but much healither!! I also bought them from the grocery store, but thought I should spread the word that they are amazing!

I purchased this for my Mini Schnauzer. His gums were infected from a cut and onset gum disease. We were going to get his teeth professionally cleaned, but we knew the infection needed to be eliminated first, so we decided to save $150 and go the holistic route. This, in conjunction with a homeopathic infection drop, cleared up his infection in three days, with noticeable results after one. I would highly recommend this for anyone with yuck-mouth doggy.However, this isn't a vet replacement.

My two Cavaliers were constantly scratching, so I decided to try an Omega 3 supplement. I'm pleased wirh this product and so are the dogs. I have tried other VentriScience products with success. Works as advertised.
THIS PRODUCT I HIGHLY RECOMMEND IF YOUR DOG HAS A HUGE SWELLING BECAUSE I BOUGHT THIS FOR MY DOG AND SHE HAS PERIODONTITIS AND HER SWELLING WENT WAY DOWN AND I CAN OPEN HER MOUTH BETTER.

column9: Possibly the best small dog food
column10: I've got a small poodle-mix. I've tried almost every premium food for my dog. With completely grain free foods, I've seen the coat dry out and become dull. Solid Gold produced too much gas. Canidae ALF and grain-free went too stale for her taste in less than two weeks. The other foods I've attempted simply were rejected.Wellness Small Breed to me is a miracle. She will even eat it without having to load it up with cheese. Her coat is a shiny silver. She's actually grown a healthy undercoat. Like most little dogs with allergies, I've noticed the eye discharge is minimal compared to other foods.So for any super-finicky small dog parent, I would definitely recommend this kibble.

column9: My picky dogs eats every piece!
column10: I have a three year old yorkipoo who has always been extremely picky about his food.  We had some success (by "some success" I mean he'd eat half of what he was supposed to) with the Prarie brand by Natures Variety, but he always had runny eye problems and had trouble keeping weight on.  My mother's vet recommended the Wellness brand for her dog to lose weight and suggested I try the small breed formula for my picky dog. I'm so glad I tried it! Since switching my dog to the Wellness small breed formula my dog eats every single piece.  I don't have to sit there and encourage him to eat. He willingly eats the whole bowl and cannot wait for his next meal. I'm convinced that I could feed him 5 times a day and he'd still eat every last piece because its just that good. I have never seen him so excited to eat! On top of this his coat is as soft as ever and his watery, running, cloudy eyes are completely clear. He has the same amount of small dog energy but doesn't seem as anxious when I leave (apparently filler in dog foods can cause anxiety in sensitive dogs).  I'm amazed at how great this product is working for my little man. Highly recommend for those with picky, small breed dogs.

column9: Hands down one of the best foods on the market today
column10: I have two Basenjis both of who are under breed weight/size and who have corn allergies. I cannot stress enough how awesome this food has been for them. Their appetites are up, they are putting on weight, they have more energy where their other food (which was also on the Top Ten Dog Foods List) made them sluggish and caused one to lick a hole in herself. This food has given me my girls back and I recommend it highly to anyone who has issues with small breeds with allergies. I could go on and on about the differences but honestly, buy a bag and try it. There is nothing I can say that you won't see for yourself.

column9: One of the best dog food you can buy for the price
column10: Ok let me clarify first of all, why I gave it 4/5 instead of 5/5.If it were to up to me alone, this food is 5/5.The ONLY reason why I took 1 star off, is because my dogs hate the taste :(I have a Pomeranian and a Maltese. Both of them would often just sniff the food, and walk away. They will eventually eat it when they are really hungry, but they just look very disinterested in the food overall. I have the same issue with Blue Buffalo.However, when I alternate them to Orijen, or Taste of the Wild, or Acana, or Fromm, they pretty much gobble them down instantly. (I tend to alternate around different brands and flavors just to make sure they are not deficient in a specific nutrient/mineral).This *small* problem is NOT universal. I have friends whose dogs love this food, and I have seen dogs that absolutely won't touch Wellness. Every dog has its preferences, so its best to experiment around.However, I like feeding my dogs WELLNESS most.Their poop is solid and doesn't stink, and based upon the ingredients list, it seems really good!No by-productsNo cornNo fillers (well except for tomato pomace, which some people consider it as a filler. I personally don't)Omega 3 and 6 levels are on the higher side (which is a big plus!) compared to other brands/foods!!! ^_^I have fed about 2 bags so far, and my dogs haven't had any health problems.Only thing I wish the product can improve, is to maybe include Chicken Fat, instead of using Canola Oil. That will probably make the taste much better for my dogs making them much more interested in it. Canola oil is a cheaper alternative, but its really not a biggie.This is definitely something I recommend to include in your feeding rotation!On the sidenote: if you do not want to risk having a 15 pound bag of food that your dog hates, contact Wellness for a sample! They will send a 4oz packet to you, so you can "test" if your dog likes it.

column9: Excellent healthy food for your dog!
column10: My Shih Tzu's have allergies, they licked and about chewed their paws off. Spent $$$$'s at the vet for pills, shots, etc..I did research and came across Wellness and I am soo happy I did. It is all natural food, no corn, wheat, soy.. No additives.. Small pieces just right for small breeds. I highly recommend it! and so do my babies! They love it!

column9: She's licking the bowl twice a day!!
column10: I have been trying to find a nutritious food for my picky 6 pound, 1 year old, terrier/poodle/mutt and runt of the litter. Went through Puppy Chow, generic puppy chow, and Iams and then I started reading up on dog foods- and boy, did I learn a lot! No more grocery store food unless it is an "emergency" where getting online is not possible or we run out before the shipment arrives. That stuff is pure crap.We then went through a bag of Orijen, which I think is an excellent food, but not for her. She would eat it with toppings only and rarely ate all of it. Stools were often loose- not to mention the gas.A tiny dog can only eat about 1/2 to 3/4 cup of food per day so he/she needs to eat it all and it needs to be packed with nutrition. Back to the drawing board since the Orijen didn't work!Next we tried the Wellness Super5Mix Adult Small Breed. She eats every bite and licks the dish and sometimes wants an evening snack of the plain Wellness kibble. She eats it without any topping but I do usually mix in a TBS of wet food (or cottage cheese) which Wellness recommends in order to give the dog a bit of extra fluid. We live in the desert, so that's important. Anyway, she REALLY loves that! She has cleaned her plate twice daily ever since I started her on this wonderful food. The stools are formed and no gas.It seems to be the perfect food for her- and maybe for other dogs too which is why I am writing this. It is such a relief to see her eating a good nutritious dog food and enjoying it.I would definitely give it a try if your dog has "pickyness"/appetite/digestion issues, or if you just want to provide 4 star nutrition. It costs more than the grocery store stuff, but a small dog doesn't eat much so I make it fit into my budget. I try to include it in with the occasional larger Amazon order and get  free shipping. It may be available in pet stores as well, but I have to go 15-20 miles out of town to find a pet store, so ordering online is easier.I highly recommend trying this food.

column9: every dog deserves to eat well
column10: i have two yorkies, one weighs six pounds and the other weighs sixteen pounds.  i started them out on the puppy formula and then gradually onto the adult small breed.  the quality of the food is good and i like that the bits of kibble are small enough for my little dog, but hearty enough for my big boy.  my vet recommended dry kibble over wet dog food since it keeps their teeth cleaner which is important to me.  it may be more expensive than the brands available at the local grocery store or walmart, but my dogs are certainly worth it!!

I can't say enough good things about this food.  I have a ½ Pomeranian ½ Yorkie mix.  I don't feed Jake human food and his meals are measured according to his size.  As he matured into an adult he started to get blocky looking.  His stools were loose and he was constantly eating grass and even other animals fecies.  After much research on line I determined that though I thought I was giving him good dog food, I in fact was not.  I narrowed it down to this as being the food that I was going to switch him to.  The difference is like night and day.  He now has the shape that he should  Broad in the chest and narrow down through his belly and hind end.  He no longer eats grass or other fecies.  His coat is softer and his eyes do not water near as much.I highly recommend this food.  As an aside, Holistic bought Wellness.  Once I finish this bag of food I am going to switch Jake to Holistic, not because Wellness is not excellent but because Holistic is one step above and they now have Small Breed food.  It is important if you have a small dog that you feed them food specially for small breeds.  The little ones need more protein and fiber because of the energy that they expend.Switch your dog to this or Holistic and you will not regret it.  You will see a change in less than a week.

Add the noodles to the pan and let them fry for a few minutes while they absorb the flavor.  if there is still sauce in the pan- drain it!  and let these noodles 'dry' fry for a bit.  This while thicken the texture of the noodles and also allow the soaked flavor to be sealed in.  I usually stirfry Shrimp or chicken, broccoli, mushrooms, peppers and onions, and cabbage into EVOO with garlic and a little salt- then add the FULLY sauteed mixture into the now 'dry' frying noodles...and let it sit.  the taste is out of this world- it's so good that my friends thought i'd made rice noodles!To add tomoto sauce or alfredo you must first put a frying pan of extra virgin olive oil on the stove and let simmer while you rinse your noodles.  let them dry just like before- then add the noodles to the EVOO on the stove.  The EVOO makes the noodles thicker- they soak up the oil and become thick like angel hair.  rinse any excess oil and let the noodles 'dry' fry for a few minutes.  Once you done this- you will see and feel the texture change- now go ahead and add sauce to this mix- it sticks perfectly to the noodles and tastes just like the original recipe.  You just have to know how to get those lil noodles texturized and they will do what you want! :)These recipes are fool proof- i've done them many many times and taught my roomate- who doesn't know to cook, how to properly cook these!  they are always a big hit!!!  If you want more recipes that i've come up with for these noodles- let me know, i'd be happy to send them to you!

column9: I found the best price on these!
column10: Purchase them directly from the manufacturer and look for an online coupon.Btw, I Love these. . . .  maybe its because I lived in Japan for 3 years .. . the ones at the grocery are made from soy/tofu (not good for me) so they are not an option.The customer service from this company is sterling.  And the price is great for the 30 pack bought directly from them esp. with the online coupon.

These are the perfect noodle for peoe wanting to diet without having to keep a diet appealing to them.  The noodles are very easy to prepare.  They already come "cooked.". All I did was drain then rinse them and then heat them for a couple of minutes in whatever flavor I wanted them to be.  I did not have an issue with them feeling or tasting like slime, as another reviewer stated.  They have a similar texture to rice noodles.  They are perfect for my currrent diet of no carbs, no sugar, and no added fat.  This way I can stick to my diet and still keep it exciting enough to stick to.

These ZERO calorie noodles are the answer to every no-carb dieters prayer. The liquid they are packed in has a distinct fermented odour and they recommend rinsing them well. This doesn't really get rid of the smell but, after some experimentation, I found that drizzling vinegar over them and letting them sit for a minute, then rinsing again, removes all trace. After they are rinsed, fry them with a bit of cooking spray to dry them, this gives a better texture, then add your favorite sauce or just stirfry veggies, noodles and soy for an almost no-cal snack anytime.

I read the reviews before I bought so I prepared by purchasing a small fine strainer before they arrived.  I did notice the funky fishy smell when I opened the package and dumped the noodles into the strainer.  I rinsed them and gave it another sniff and couldn't smell it anymore.  I let them drain for a few while I made my sauce. Then I tossed the noodles in the sause to coat them and gave it a try.  I was suprised to say the least.  The noodles taste like nothing!  All I could taste was the sauce.  The texture isn't bad at all; I like rice noodles and these are similar in appearance and texture.  I am very pleased and will make these a regular ingredient in my meals.  To cut a bowl of pasta from 300-400 calories down to 30-60 is just awesome.  I usually eat Ancient Harvest Quinona products but will make the switch to the Miracle products.  They are ready to eat which makes them even more appealing.

The Miracle Noodles are great for avoiding gaining weight, no calories. They work great and take only a minute to make. I put some salt into the water for cooking and they taste great.Lisa Lirones likes them also.

column9: The best alternative to regular noodles
column10: Miracle noodles are the best alternatives for having noodles without the calories.  Granted, it takes more than a minute to get used to that initial smell when you open them up.  Just follow the instructions for rinsing and preparing for use.The noodles are quick to absorb the flavor of whatever you choose to mix with it.  For ZERO calories, it is the absolute ideal method for snacking on something that tastes great and working for you.

These noodles just arrived yesterday and I now know the secret of their weight loss properties: they will have you throwing up all night. I ate some of these for dinner last night and though I didn't really like them I thought I could at least tolerate them but I started feeling very full after I'd eaten a small ammount (which I thought was a good thing at the time) and ended up waking up at 2am this morning with intense stomach pain, nausea and vomiting. I have never had stomach pain this intense in my life and I have a very strong stomach so this was a horrible shock. I would NEVER buy or reccomend this to anyone ever.
These are a delicious alternative to regular noodles- great for rounding out a meal if you are on a low carb or low calorie diet.

15 second rinse, one minute blanch into boiling water. They taste like nothing, and are almost calorie free. I make my own random dressing concoctions to flavor them, eat two or three packages as on-the-go meal at work, and they are filling. The 24 pack is the most economic for sure! I plan to continue them into my diet and therefore replace as I run out.

Some people don't like these, but I found them to be very good. If you don't smell them before rinsing and blanching, you would never know they had an odd scent. One review said they were fishy smelling, but I thought it was closer to ammonia than fish. Either way, the smell disappears when they are prepared exactly as the package instructs. If you are looking for a wheat or grain pasta-type substitute, this is not it. But, if you like cellophane noodles and similar Japanese 'pastas' then this is your zero calorie version. They don't have any of their own flavor, so you will have to mix them with something obviously.

What we go through to lose weight. This stuff has to be put in a thick sauce or gravy of some kind. If you try to just use soy sauce or something like that the texture of it going down your throat will make you want to hurl. Pretty much like a big gob of spit. Eww...

I was looking for a better quality food for my dog and I did a little research and tried this one. She actually eats the food when I put it in her dish rather than staring at it all day until the cat tries to eat it, then she would only eat it so the cat wouldn't. This food she really seems to like and it hasn't affected her digestion any that I have noticed. I would buy it again. Great price too!

column9: Great food for a great price
column10: This is the first non-organic or three dog bakery food that my rescued Aussiedoodle has gotten excited over. She loves the small disk-shaped pieces and the taste! I love that I can feel good about the quality of the ingredients and nutrients, but also the price. Highly recommend. Pro Pac is cheaper then the other high-grade dog foods because they only do their most of their marketing in local pet stores.

column9: Perfect snack for extreme banana fans.
column10: Me and my 11 month old son could eat these all day. The only warning i will give you is that Freeze Dried Bananas Get Stuck in your Teeth!  If you  know this and you can look past it because you love freeze dried bananas as much as we do, then your'e in business. They melt on your tongue and have a great initial crunch.

i am a huge fan of freeze-dried fruit, and i have tried almost every brand.  this is the best.  i recommend any flavor of brothers-all-natural.  i eat them with yogurt like chips and dip.  try it and you will be hooked!

I was looking for a low-fat snack that I could use to get in my fruits each day. I am a member of a well known weight loss organization and this snack fits in very well with that program. They are only 1 point per package, plus they are crunchy and tasty! And it doesn't contain any fat like the banana chips you find in many grocery stores.

I'm always on the lookout for portion controlled snacks and Brothers All Natural Banana Crisps fit the bill.  They are nothing but 100% freeze dried banana slices, with a delicate crunch and sweet banana taste.  Each single serving pouch is only about sixty-six calories.  It's great for throwing in a kid's lunchbox or for when you just want a little non-guilt inducing treat for yourself.  I recommend these and plan on trying their other flavors soon.

I am a subscriber on Amazon for this product. I get some every month! They're healthy - no additives, just bananas - and delicious! I wouldn't change a thing about them. They're great in cereal and oatmeal, or on their own. Great on the go too! Highly recommend them.
My kids love these banana chips, and I love the fact that they are easy to pack and take along in the car. I keep some in my car and in my diaper bag in case we need emergency snacks.
I found these chips very tasty and filling and would recommend them very highly.They are light and crunchy and have a very good banana taste.

I love freeze dried bananas. They are a great alternative to banana chips which have added sugar, oils, and just junk. Who adds sugar to fruit anyway? This is my 2nd time ordering and will definitely order again. Maybe next time I will get bulk. I go through them quite quickly.

i had purchased some freeze dried strawberries and bananas (in same package) and determined that i did not enjoy freeze dried strawberries and found these bananas.I just received them today and they taste perfect. 100% satisfied.
These are delicious! Good in oatmeal too! I love the portion control. Much better than banana chips if you're like me and need to watch what you eat.

No added sugar or fat- and very good.  I will definitely be ordering these again. I never go through bananas fast enough when I buy fresh- these are the perfect solution- and would be great on cereal!!  I like them out of the bag!
This is a great product. It is healthy and tasty. My kids love it. We can only find plain bananas online.

(yes, I had to try a package before mailing them off).  I'm going to look for other varieties for my next box.  These deserve more than 5 stars!

Delicious!  Great for lunches or an anytime snack.  Would definitely buy again.  All natural without the sugary, crunchy, artificial taste of normal banana chips.  Even my 2 year old grandson loves them!  Highly recommended!

This, after the recent melamine-laced baby formula scandal in China.When I received my two boxes of this item, I was surprised and dismayed to see "Product of China" printed on the box. The Amazon site for this item does not specify country of origin as China, or I would not have ordered it in the first place.Don't get me wrong, I am not generally against products of China. These banana chips may end up being a very fine product (I did not open the box and even try it yet), and I will probably end up eating it myself.But I cannot recommend it if you, like me, are concerned about Product of China food products for your kids, because it is from China, according to the box.

Terrible product. the bananas were brown and had an 'off' taste. when I looked at the ingredients it said product from china. well that answered it. threw them out. won't eat stuff from China. what a waste.

I have not purchased Gudrun from Amazon but have locally at another large retailer that brings it in annually for Christmas/holidays.  I used to have my own retail shop and I actually put in refrigerated cases and storage in order to import this line from Belgium.  I was a candy/gourmet buyer for 16 years.  When I bought Gudrun for resale, they were so concerned about quality control that I was told by the vendor in order to make the mocha cream for the Zebra piece, they bought the coffee beans, had their own grinding equipment and developed the chocolate from A to Z in house.  I had one customer come to my store before hurricane Kate, hoping to get a couple Zebras to get her through the storm.  So, not high school chocolate, which is waxy.  However, it is vital that this product be handled appropriately and not outdated.  Any chocolate, if mishandled and old, will not taste as the manufacturer intended.  If it has whitish discoloration on the surface, it has gone through a temperature flux, separating the oils.  Incidentally, the Zebra was my favorite.  Very hard to find now.  It was a mocha cream on a burned sugar/croquant base with white chocolate coating (yellowish-cream colored, very rich) and dark chocolate zig-zagged across the top to make the "Zebra."  Apparently now made in a dark chocolate as well.  HTH.

These are pricey, but make for a great gift because (1) they're beautifully packaged and (2) they are excellent chocolates. When I was in Brussels I sampled chocolates from many different chocolatiers, and I think Gudrun represents Belgian chocolate well: creamy & smooth, rich and distinct flavors, and good consistency. I wouldn't buy a box of these for myself because there are probably better values for comparable haut chocolat, but these are impressively packaged and would make a distinctive gift for a client or associate.

column9: It's decaf, how good can it be?
column10: Is this the best, smoothest cup of coffee? No. Not by any means. However, it is better than nearly all the roasted decaf coffees you can buy in stores. If you're a home roaster and need decaf, this isn't a bad choice. But don't expect it to really wow you.

you will find this capellini the best you will ever eat. It takes two minutes to cook and it is finer than angel hair. with a lemon /shrimp sauce over it. OMGoodness!!!!!!!!!!!!

I eat DeCecco Capellini almost every day, but most supermarkets don't carry it even if they have other DeCecco products.  I got tired of looking for it so I was delighted to find it on Amazon for a reasonable price with no shipping on Prime.

I do not know why we can not get this pasta in our local stores, but when we found it on Amazon we purchased 18 boxes. The taste of this pasta is fantastic and the capellini is so thin is cooks quickly.
Great tasting pasta! The De Cecco Capellini is the best of thin pasta. It is my favorite of pasta's brands. This pasta type is hard to find and not sold everywhere.

I've ordered this before and was good. This time the spaghetti was thin and the page for ordering didn't say thin. The box says "cooks in 2 minutes" but doesn't say "thin." It cooks faster of course and tastes good, but I like the standard, normal thickness of spaghetti.

column9: If You Like Spicy Sprouts, Try This
column10: I like spicy sprouts like radish sprouts, and this one is even better. There are just enough mustard seeds in the mix to kick up the heat "just a notch." I'll be buying these seeds again.

The seeds contained in this mix seem to be sprouting reliably, but you'll have to turn to your favorite sprout guide for suggested amounts and times - there is almost nothing besides the main label you can see in the images provided by Sprout House. Possibly they have a growing guide they want you to buy. The back label simply includes a bar code and list of the seeds contained.Because seeds go through a complicated change during the sprouting process, there can be some slight danger associated with consuming certain seeds too early. Particularly with seed mixes, you would expect to see some suggestions as to how long they should sprout before you start sampling to see exactly where you like them; how many table/teaspoons of seed produce a pint, quart, etc.-sized container.Additionally, the listings on Amazon sometimes come with warnings that particular sprouts do well or poorly with a jar, tray, or bag type of sprouter, but the products themselves don't. There is also no suggestion for how to store the remaining majority of the half-pound container after you pull 1-4 tablespoons out for your tray. Seeds are as different as people and some store best in a freezer, others the fridge, and some a 70-degree space. I would expect some further clarification about storing their seeds from Sprout House.As I said, the seeds seem to be reliable, but if it's your first time out of the gate, you might want to pick up a unit with complete directions. I also like the ability to spice up salads, sandwiches and stir fry with fresh options, know that I like the spicy sprouts, and was delighted to see them in a mix that will save me time. I will buy these again, but I think there are better places for people to start sprouting
My Cocker Spaniel has his ears cleaned on a weekly basis and knows that if he's good he get his treat, which he loves!

I HAVE ENJOYED THIS COFFEE FOR THE LAST 2 EARS. I FIRST SAMPLED IT WHILE IN GRAND RAPIDS MICHIGAN. I HAVE SINCE ONLY DRINK THIS BRAND. IT IS VERY SMOOTH AND HAS NO BITTER AFTER TASTE BUT A RICH AND SMOOTH HAZELNUT FLAVOR.

This yummy chews comes in a bulk-box of 20 small boxes, and each small box contain 10 candies making a total of 200 candies. Each candy / chew is wrap in an **edible** rice paper and then in a wax paper. I'm very impress with the whole packaging, and the edible rice paper is a nice surprise. I thoroughly enjoy this product.  It soothes my throat, and I believe has a calming effect on my nerves.  I dont have to take an aspirin, or anything stronger if I feel a little upset, as I do when I have to drive on the highway, for example.  I put one of the chews in the roof of my mouth and let the essence flow into my mouth and throat.  I am calmed and ready to roll.  It's better than a cough drop too.

Based on the reviews I tried these, and I LOVE them. I've tried the other ginger chews made by the ginger people, but these are far superior. I've had the ginger people chews for months and haven't come close to finishing the package. I've had the Reed's ginger candy for a couple of days and I've already finished my first pack. If you like ginger then you will really like these. I know it may be a splurge, but it's worth it. You get 20 packs with each package containing 10 individually wrapped candies. I got these to ease nausea from my RA meds. It seems to help with that but wow is it TASTY! Sweet, chewy and spicy. I'm in love!

column9: this candy helps a lot with my nausea
column10: I am a migraneur.  My mom found this candy for me.  I absolutely hate being nauseated and this candy really helps with the nausea.  Frequently I am at work or someplace where it is inconvenient to take an anti-nausea pill and this candy fixes me right up.  Now if they could just find something for the bloody headaches, I would be completely happy.

I eat almost no sugar, but I have one of these after dinner, and they seem to settle my stomach. They can be very sticky and difficult to get out of the wrappers, but I solve this by keeping the box in the freezer. The candy pops right out and melts quickly when I put them in my mouth. My husband uses his voice for a living & often when over using it he developes a great deal of congestion & the Ginger Chews is very soothing for him.

First off this candy is spectacularly tasty. It's chewy, spicy, and has a coating of powdered sugar. The texture is great. If you like ginger anything, especially ginger beer, these will certainly be a winner.Second though, I carry these in my bag all the time. If you ever have sudden nausea or indigestion chewing one or two of these will clear things right up. I hate feeling queasy in class or a meeting, but now I never do. It really is a miracle and I didn't have to buy any pricey (and foul tasting) drugs. Chewing these works better than pepto bismol for settling a stomach.I can't recommend these enough.

this candy is absolutely delicious. i was disappointed,however, because the candies came in 20 small boxes fit into a larger box. it was said that there were 10 candies in each, but there were only 9 candies in each box. hence the order was short 20 candies. i think that the description needs to change and the price needs to come down. otherwise these cant be beat. i use them for chronic nausea and just for pleasure. lynne neylan

column9: Best source of ginger I know
column10: I used to be able to buy these at local health food stores but no longer, so I am very glad to have found an online source through which I may order them.  I have many digestive troubles and ginger is a great help.

It is supposed to also lessen  the effects of nausea with chemo patients.  I asked her if it was working and she confirmed that it took the edge off the nausea after her treatments. my first order of this product was wonderful! I reordered the candy which was not chewy like the first order. I will no longer order this product.

Good product. It Was cheaper than what i found at local world market store. Would recommend. Great alternative for nausea treatment in place of medications.

I loved this candy. I never thought I was a fan of ginger, but this candy is addictive. I was disappointed to see how fast the candy was going, because I didn't want to run out. I will definitely buy again.

This is definitely the best ginger candy outside of eating crystallized ginger root. It is not too sweet or too hard and packed with ginger, which is yummy all the time but especially good for nausea. I am buying more for my pregnant friend to get her through her first trimester.

These are superb.  I have to make weekly drop-offs at a cafe for work, and they have these... they're my guilty pleasure. GREAT PRODUCT AND DELICIOUS GELATIN, THIS SUGAR FREE IS GREAT I DO NOT NOTICE ANY DIFFERENCE WITH THE SUAR ONES. IT IS MY FAVORITE FOR MANY REASON.

column9: Pasta from Umbria like you find there
column10: We had strangozzi pasta in Spoleto some time ago. This brand by a small farm and factory near Perugia is so good we keep needing more. This kind of pasta is unusual in that you're not supposed to stir it for the entire time it cooks in boiling water. We added it to a truffle sauce, but once we had it with a spicy tomato sauce. Either way, the pasta is so good you don't really need much to dress it up.  It's good even with just some olive oil and pecorino cheese or something like that. It's one of the best pastas we have ever had. Absolutely hands down delicious!

column9: A Good Lunch, But Not A Great Lunch.
column10: This was one of those afternoons when I was all alone and needed a quick afternoon lunch. So I opened a can of Amy's Organic Lentil and Vegetable Soup and added some crackers and a drink. It worked out well. The soup was thick and hearty and tasted rather well. If I had a complaint, I thought the soup to be a little bland. I order these peanuts still eating on them now fresh and delicous will def order these again love that all indivalially wrapped

FYI: In the package, you get two each of: Bananas and Strawberries, Apple Cinnamon Oatmeal, Tender Chicken and Stars, and Vegetable Beef Pilaf. Good value, though I wish they came in packs of 12 like the 1st and 2nd stage foods do.

I wish they had more variety packs available for stage 3, but compared to other products out there it is hard to complain.Now I am just waiting for the day that earth's best moves away from glass jars. column9: If you can't afford canned Alaskan Sockeye Salmon, then canned Alaskan Pink Salmon has advantages
column10: The Alaskan pink salmon cannot be more than 3 years old while the Alaskan sockeye salmon can be up to 8 years old.  More Alaskan pink salmon is harvested each year (by weight) than all other Alaskan salmon species put together.  Thus, pink salmon is the smallest, youngest, and most plentiful of the Alaskan salmon.  This means that you will probably save a huge amount of money and also get slightly more delicious salmon skin inside of each can than you would from canned Alaskan sockeye salmon.  True, one can of Alaskan sockeye salmon has more fat than one can of Alaskan pink salmon.  The meat of the Alaskan sockeye is higher in fat and higher in the beneficial carotenoid, astaxanthin, which gives salmon, trout, crabs, lobsters, shrimp, krill, flamingos, and some bacteria their red or pink color.  Yes, the canned sockeye is slightly better than the canned pink but the price is almost twice as high.  Interestingly, Masahide Kaeriyama compared the stomach contents of the Alaskan pink salmon against the stomach contents of the Alaskan sockeye salmon and discovered that:  (1)both species of salmon are eating almost the exact same things when in the ocean, (2)squid is the favorite food of both species of salmon, comprising about one-fourth to one-third of their total diet, (3)red krill (a euphausiid) comprises less than 10% of the total diet of both species of salmon, (4)fishes comprise only about 5% of the total diet of both species of salmon, and (5)copepods, amphipods, decapods, pteropods, octopods, euphausiids, polychaetes, chaetognaths, ostracods, halocypridids, cumacea, gelatinous zooplankton, and barnacles were also found in the stomachs of both the Alaskan pink salmon and the Alaskan sockeye salmon.  Because of different DNA, however, 1 pound of Alaskan sockeye salmon meat has 18.33mg of astaxanthin but 1 pound of Alaskan pink salmon meat has only 2.45mg of astaxanthin.  Average amounts of astaxanthin contained in 1 pound of other salmon species:  2.55mg for Alaskan chum (keta, silverbrite) salmon, 6.26mg for Alaskan coho (silver) salmon, 4.04mg for Alaskan king (chinook) salmon, and 2.40mg for wild Atlantic salmon.  Finally, wild salmon is considered even healthier for us to eat than farmed salmon, partly because wild salmon has better omega-3 to omega-6 fatty acid ratios than farmed salmon.  The average omega-3 to omega-6 ratios are as follows:  farmed Atlantic salmon 2.55 to 1, wild Atlantic salmon 11.72 to 1, canned wild Alaskan sockeye salmon 10.94 to 1, canned wild Alaskan pink salmon 12.74 to 1, wild Alaskan chum salmon 12.31 to 1, wild Alaskan coho salmon 7.15 to 1, and smoked Alaskan king salmon (lox) 1.11 to 1.

column9: The vertebrae were the straw that broke... well, you know
column10: I tried this after trying the packet.  I was so impressed with the packet, I thought "I can drain this, and for a little less sloth I get more servings for less cost."  It's... not the same.  Upon opening the can, there was a round "thing" looking at me.  I assumed it was just cartiledge, then while eating this on a sandwich I pulled out 5 more, in a row.  Turns out... I think they were spine parts.  Add to that the skin and bones, and I'd rather pay more for the packet thank you very much.  I LOVE salmon, but not enough to eat any more of this.

column9: Petguard is a high-quality, pure, nutrient-dense pet food
column10: Petguard is one of the main brands of food I feed to my pets.  I love it because it is wheat-free, corn-free, and free of all fillers and junky ingredients.  It contains high-quality protein and other nutrients.  It is one of the few brands of pet food out there that I feel really good about feeding to my animals.  I highly recommend it.

Best tasting crushed pepper on this planet.  Yes it' s smoking hot but what a unique flavor.  The smell of this smoked pepper arouses the taste buds.  Full body and flavor, resulting in craving for more.  Not bitter such as bonnet or habanero.  Best to try with a tooth pick to determine one's tolerance, then sprinkle accordingly and enjoy this unique flavorful smoked pepper.  Hmmm good and well worth every penny as a little goes a long way.  Lingering flavor has the brain craving for more.

My sister in law gave me a small bottle of this.  It was incredible. When I ran out, I was lost, then I found it on Amazon. Makes the best pizza, spaghetti, and anything else Italian.  This is a "55 gallon drum" size, but it is well worth it.  Once you try it, you have to have it in your spice rack.

column9: Have been using these for about a year
column10: After paying full local retailer price it was great to find the Sentry Medi-Wraps at such a great price. They arrived promptly and above all the first bag opened was completely fresh.Freshness is important with this product. It should have about the consistency of Playdough perhaps a touch dryer. Sometimes one or a few will be dryer and those just become treats because they won't form around the pill. When they are fresh I can break them in two and use just 1/2 to wrap a pill the size of an aspirin. If you get a bag that is all dried I suggest contacting the place you purchased it for an exchange. Make sure to use the built-in zip lock to keep them fresh after opening.The dog loves them and they have almost no odor so I like them too.Hope this helps.

My dog was just diagnosed with Flea Dermatitis. His Vet prescribed him some tablets that help with the itching, and some pills that are antibiotics which make sure no infections start. I went to the nearby Petco because I knew first off it would probably be a challenge to give my dog his medicine since it isn't "treat" flavored like vitamins/other medicine such as Comfortis. I first saw the Greenies brand and was sort of scared of the price. About $12.99 for the 25 count bag that was only good for the tablets and about $9.99 for the 30 count bag good for the pills (I know those were the two prices but I might have switched them around on accident). Well since this is the first time I have ever had to give medicine to my dog, I wanted to look more. I found these which were $8.99 and noticed that it was good for all size medicine. I grabbed these because I didn't have to get two different bags for the two different sizes. Brought it home, and hid the medicine in the "treat" for my dog. It's kind of messy- it will probably crumble a little bit. But it did the job for my dog. I was able to squish it and hide the medicine in the little treat. For the bigger "pill", not the tablet- it was only a TINY bit harder because it was so big and the treat was almost not big enough. But with bit more tweaking of the treat (it's very soft and easy to "transform") I was able to administer it to my dog so he could take. Only once has he been able to "not" take the pill and that was the first time administering. I let him eat it out of my hand and keep holding my hand out below his mouth-works really well, not sure if he knows he can't move it to the ground and chew it up? Not sure. But ANYWAYS, unfortunately I cannot compare it to the name brand Greenies. Not sure if that one crumbles also and not sure if you could just buy one bag and any size medication will fit even if the bag says it only fits a certain kind. But it is definitely working for me and I am satisfied.

These are my favorite type of Jelly Bellies. I had been eyeing this product for some time. After a few glasses of wine, I decided that this was a must buy because its price per pound was much lower than a single pound of this flavor. The price is still pretty high, but it is about the same price as buying 5 single pounds. I have been snacking on these for a few months. They are still around, and I still love them.The product arrived in a cardboard box with the jelly beans directly in the box. No plastic bag or anything, just the shipping box filled with jelly beans. I am not a huge germaphobe, but would have preferred a better container than the shipping box. This was the only reason why I docked it a star.

This was one of my freebies from registering my Tassimo and boy did I choose a good one.  There were a lot of good reviews on this flavor, so I didn't doubt that it was tasty, but after only a week I'm pretty well addicted to the Caramel Macchiato flavor, so I wasn't sure that I'd enjoy a Latte lacking the caramel.  Well, this is wonderful in its own right.  Jacobs espresso is good and smooth, not burnt or harsh tasting.  The creamer is sweet enough with not being sickening and yields a nice foamy top.  I added about a teaspoon of sugar to this, but it is definitely delicious enough without this addition.If you're into aesthetics, use a clear mug for this one because you truly do get the layered effect that is pictured on the package.I'll definitely be ordering more of this.  I would consider this variety in my top 3 for the Tassimo.  Give it a try, if you haven't yet!  Cheers :)

I've been trying various European Tassimo varieties, and this one is by far my favorite. Every time I have one, I feel like I've given myself a special treat. I love surprising my husband with it on weekends (okay, so he is easily amused.) The flavor is rich and creamy but not overly sweet. For macchiato aficionados you must try this. For an everyday European coffee, I recommend, Mastro Lorenzo Crema. Equally yum.
My husband has the machine and has tried about every type of coffee and mocha and latte that will work on the machine.  He likes this one very much.

Absolutely the best. Hands down I love this over any other coffee I have tried. Yes, it really does the layers if you have a glass cup. Only downside is I went through them so fast cause they are delicious.

I've been ordering these t-discs for over a year and finally made the move to subscribe and save. I noticed the change in packaging - but have never encountered a faulty t-disc. The milk in these sets are extra frothy which I love. I will definitely continue to enjoy these :-)

I love this coffee, they use a special creamy milk, much better than any of the other lattes normally around - thanks why it's frequently on back-order.  Great production but pricy and often hard to get in multi packs.

While I roast my own beans for my Jura automatic coffee maker, my mother-in-law uses her Tassimo for her one coffee a day.  She loves these Cappuccino's so I keep her stocked up.  When visiting, I use the machine also and can see the allure in using one if you can't understand the complexities of a real coffee machine.  The real down side is the cost of using the Tassimo or Keurig for coffee.  Crazy expensive!  But it's better than buying the crap served at $tarbucks, which is burned beyond recognition and then sweetened and flavored to the point where you can't taste the coffee.  Get an espresso there some time with no cream or sugar.  I dare you!
Tried Jacobs while waiting for Maxwell House to start producing Tossimo Latte products again and was pleasantly surprised. I'll reorder!!

I got these as a freebie for registering my Tassimo machine.  I made one in a glass and got the pretty layering effect.  This was a delicious drink, very smooth, wonderful coffee flavor.  I may buy some of the Jacob's espresso to make iced coffee.

column9: Messy, huge servings, more milk than coffee
column10: This is not a bad beverage but great either, and given how messy it is to make I wish I hadn't bothered with it. The serving size is huge; I used my biggest mug and I still had to stop the machine early to keep it from overflowing. It uses 2 milk cartridges and in between them 1 espresso cartridge. It's hard to taste the coffee at all in the result because there's so little of it compared to the milk. Unsurprisingly the milk tastes like reconstituted powdered milk and the flavor is just a bit off compared to natural milk. So you get a huge serving of milk that doesn't even taste great, with a tiny bit of coffee somewhere in it. I ended up making it with just 1 milk and 1 espresso cartridge and even so it tasted a lot more like milk than coffee.The visual effect of coffee sandwiched between milk looks beautiful on the packaging, but keep in mind that you won't see it unless you actually have transparent mugs or heat-proof glasses.Finally there's just no good way to remove the used milk cartridges from the machine without spilling hot milk on your fingers and making a mess. They're only half empty when they're done and if you don't flip them over extremely fast, you'll get hot milk on your fingertips. I am particularly sensitive to heat so this might not be a problem for others - however the issue about the cartridges dripping over the machine and all the way to the trash can will always be there.The beverage has an interesting flavor and it's a pretty original idea for a coffee machine so I don't regret trying it once, but it's not worth bothering with on a regular basis.

Jacobs Latte Macchiato, 8-Count T-Discs for Tassimo Brewers (Pack of 3)I love Jacob's Latte Machiatto for the Tassimo; however, since they came out with the new packaging, every package I have opened has had about 75% of the creamer disks defective.  The barcode reader won't read it, and the machine goes into manual mode.  If I wanted to use manual mode, I'd be using a Dolce Gusto machine!  The problem only occurs with the creamer disks, not the coffee disks, and not with any other brand of beverage.  I have checked and cleaned and cleaned to scanner surface, but that is obviously not the problem - the problem is in the bar code on the packaging of the creamer disks.I'm very disappointed. When you consider what these things cost, it's not fun having 75% of them defective.

My whole family has tried these.  They like the flavor of these SUGAR FREE cinnamon altoids better than the regular altoid cinnamons.  The flavor in these is more true, you can not tell they are sugar free.  I would highly recommend these to ANYONE! They are great!

Finally! Have been searching for these small tins of cinnamon Altoids for months - could not find this flavor at drugstores, gas stations or grocery stores. So, I'm very happy that my dear husband thought to look online for me. In my opinion, these are far better than the larger Altoids and I prefer the smaller tins. They fit better into pockets and small handbags.
These little mints don't let me down. I like them better than the "full-sized" Altoids. A kick of cinnamon - what's not to like?

I started with these mints when I quit smoking and the cinnamon flavor was the only thing that helped. They are just strong enough but not over powering.Best little mints on the market, just wish they were still available in the stores

column9: Thank you Amazon! Can't find these locally
column10: I used to be able to find a similar mini cinnamon mint,(store brand), but they were discontinued.  I have never seen these mini Altoids locally, so I ordered this pack of 9 tins.  They taste VERY similar to the ones I used to be able to buy... similar size tin, similar taste.  Thank You Altoids and Amazon!!!  I find that one or two of these mints and a glass of water help keep me from snacking non-stop.... yes, they are tiny, but they have BIG FLAVOR. And the tiny tin makes it easy to carry around.

These are hard to find retail in the upper left-hand corner of the U.S. And I like to carry a mix of Peppermint, Wintergreen and Cinnamon mints with me to offer folks a patriotic mix of mints to freshen their breath.

column9: all the groceries around here stopped carrying this flavor
column10: So it's very handy to be able to order it online.These are yummy little mints, sugar-free, and yet full of flavor.I like the wintergreen too, but the cinnamon are my favorite.  They're strong, but not hot.  A whole lot of flavor and breath freshening in a teeny mint.And because they're small, you don't have to monitor intake like with other sugar-free mints, where the sugar alcohols can cause GI side effects if you eat more than 2 or 3.

Altoids Smalls Sugar Free Cinnamon mints are our household favorite, hands down.  For some ridiculous reason, local retailers have stopped carrying them (what's up with that??), so trusty and reliable Amazon.com has filled the bill, along with the super-fast vendor.  Thanks to everyone; we are now enjoying our tasty mints once again!

THese are small enough not to over power you, but big enough to give you a burst of cinnamon and freshen your breath.  I rarely could find these at gas stations/stores in this size.  I love the small size for I carry the tin in my pocket.  A great product.  Shipped promptly.

This little sugar-free mint packs a powerful, longlasting punch. The cinnamon is true to the cinnamon flavor. The mint can be discretly held in your mouth and still carry on a conversation. These are by far my favorite of mints. Great Job Altoids and thank you Amazon.com for supplying these mints.

These little cinnamon Altoids are my favorite mints -- not too strong and not too sweet. The small tin is the perfect size to carry in my purse or pocket, but it's very hard to find in my area; I've only been able to find them at World Market. I love ordering them by the box on Amazon and having them delivered right to my front door, and the price can't be beat.

column9: LOVE THESE! Cinnamon is the best.
column10: I like all of the Altoid smalls, but cinnamon is my favorite. Usually avoid fake sugar products, in favor of natural varieties...but, I tend to pop so many mints during the day, I prefer not to rot my teeth. Smalls are perfect. Cinnamon is SUPER strong! Thrilled when I thought to check Amazon, and found them at a good price. These are delicious. I like the smalls because the little tins can go in your pocket or bag or the console in the car. Much more portable than the bigger tins.

Great way to buy Altoids.  MUUUUUCH cheaper than buying single packs in the storews.  I was going to pay this price for a 6 pack so when they came in and I got 9 packs I was VERY pleased.  Great bargin.

column10: I have been using Try Me Tiger Sauce for many years now and cannot just buy one bottle at at time.  I use it on meatloaves, in soups and stews and on Mexican fare. Start with enough to cover the honey and fish and then when you keep making it, use more like I do to season to taste. When this is all done, place in pre-heated oven (350) for 30 minutes. That's it. Hope you like it. Gloria...TryMe Original Tiger Sauce - 10 oz

column9: Mild heat combined with far too much vinegar
column10: This is a mild hot sauce. That means you can apply it liberally and it's unlikely you will make any dish too hot. So it is user friendly.Ingredients (as copied from the label): Aged cayenne peppers, distilled vinegar, water, salt - etcYet why have I rated it 2 stars? The simple answer it has far too much vinegar and it ends up tasting like vinegar and a bit bitter too. In addition, this sauce lacks any character beyond that heavy dose of vinegar. Now, if you happen to like a lot of vinegar in your hot sauce - then you might love this sauce and my 2 star rating is way off base. I don't like anywhere near this much vinegar. I've blind taste tested over 30 hot sauces and there are much better ones, including ones that have a fair amount of vinegar.What is interesting is that the original Tabasco sauce has a near identical taste to Franks once it is diluted.BTW: You will find mention that this sauce was top rated by Cooks Illustrated. That is absolutely true but what these pundits fail to mention is this was a casual test, done in 2005, comparing only three hot sauces!Suggestion: Since tastes vary and if you happen to like this sauce - then you can save a lot of money by buying it in one of its larger sizes - at least 23 oz and consider the gallon size. They don't cost much more than the smaller sizes.I'd encourage everyone to experiment with a sauce that is not so heavily laden with vinegar or is at least - better balanced.Try any of these:a) Huy Fong Sriracha Hot Chili Sauce - This sauce has considerable heat but it is nicely balanced against a bit of sweetness combined with a vague hint of garlic. Virtually every supermarket carries it - look in the Asian section! It has no vinegar, is considerably more potent than Franks, yet just a bit sweet. Compared to Franks you have to be careful not to add too much.b) Cholula Original Hot Sauce - features a fine blend of peppers - low to medium heat and readily available - look in the Mexican section. It has a hint of vinegar but is diluted, much like Franks yet with a far superior taste. Highly recommendedc) Valentina Salsa Picante Mexican Extra Hot Sauce - a great blend with more vinegar than the above but not too much. Another great blend and not so hot that it is unforgiving.d) Valentina Salsa Picante Mexican Hot Sauce - a decent blend but with a lot of vinegar. Still it is much better than Franks.e) Tapatio Hot Salsa Picanta - another widely distributed and excellent Mexican Hot sauce. A lot of vinegar but still far less than Franks. Once again you will find this in your Mexican isle.In my opinion, all of the above are far superior to Franks.If you happen to like Franks and are at the least bit curious, you should try any of the ABOVE. For only a few bucks for a bottle, what is there to lose?I hope Amazon customers will rate my review after taste testing one of these other hot sauces.My very bestThanks
